tso jubye3 ༄ kṣismu rsā byu — sku — ri me pe/ ju 3dngha ngapyo stu—tshaṭwāṃpresnawotreodikṣ-i she dku wīmee stsaX tsā〉 zlo trī cho ge te dnghari4ོ྅ drodīzla— — tsho 4 tsāsnathurilha rdoshusnaḍi rmispe rme sguṅka tsho ༷— ri ri 4—judza bye — rībyu ju snyeṅka 4 —mu rwastoXrdo /ḍiro71worko)0༷snye4 ༄ stsepaṃ —/rme chopo byepe / rwa — — — byesde rna skre ni ri — ༷ cha3ḍarṣa di ྅ dku/ sprene ༷ rnge sna byu ṇḍaṃ ri— — snye— dze trī ḍa ritsho juspre 4 dzo |lodoju — — tsho ji ka rnyi tshone cipa cijiji rsha snyo —hūṃmo — 4khaṃne tshardzo snye 4 sa skre — sna —bye jisde—spra 7 dzeertad 〉sdekā — me3༅/ 0༄ bhe tsheṭaṃ~Xdī stu / ja llī te — pre4 —— ske snarī— tsāri —ོ༵gi3〉jetsho pa yi — sgo rngu sa ri rke ḍa ṭwāṃ trom̐dzwa —ra — — tsho ja— — ga — rdzortso hūm̐ḍāzi4 rnyiwa rde— sna sngu9rdzo sna — ཿ༵ jihūṃ sgru—— — dzedzño/rdo/ gyi snasmeX( kṣeX tsha— shā dzesgo ro~X — rna byuspyo nermomo rngo tre rke4rko rsha zlo— rdo mesgyurkyu — snye jiriḍa༄ sna spre ‘ 4 phro phro3 dzetram̐waṃsnyol lkershaḥ rshalha shlau〉 rguṭwā zhetshodho 4 tre moshā 0 zhe —rī 4rshasbyi tre 7 —rme(74sgopyo7 ji〉 lkosnyi ra dku —ju4tho—5dkurkolge tsho rdotsārdzidku ༈ ṣkalko mipaṃ rṣatredrorkodzi ri rur 9 7dzarkelhu dzee〉— ༄dku5 dza / —ne rke — bhestse dī’smesnyi chi ༄ storyā 5

sgrig pa bo'i gtam/ slob dpon chen mo dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho mchog ni/ deng dus bod mi rigs spyi'i gtsug tu mchod pa'i mkhas dbang chen po zhig red/ cikhong gis sku tshe gang bor rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas la thugs zhen zab bzhes ngos nyams pa sor chud/ ma nyams gong 'phel/ shes rig yar rgyas kyi don du brtse gzigs zol med/ brtson pa lhod med/ gsung dbyangs 'gag med kyis rang nus gang yod phul ba'i bka' drin ni bsam brjod yul las 'das pa zhig red/ lhag par du khong gis nga tshor bzhag pa'i rig gzhung gi shul bzhag rin po che la bltas kyin bltas kyin mos gus mchi ma rab tu 'khrigs/ bsam bzhin bsam bzhin nin thang gzhal du med pa shes/ nga rang tsho mi rigs dpe skrun gyi las ka byed mkhan zhig yin pa'i ngos nas bshad na/ slob dpon chen mo 'di pa'i phyag rtsom mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig bsgrigs nas par du bskrun na ni rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas bang mdzod la rin chen nor bu zhig bsnan pa lta bu'i da ge mtshan chen po ldan zhing /laracablo gsal gzhon nu'i tshogs la rig pa'i dngos po phun sum tshogs pa zhig mngon par bstabs pa'i phan yon shin tu mi dman pa zhig yod par mthong nas de lugs kyi brtson pa lhur len pa'i 'dun pa drag po snying la 1

bcags khar/ nye lam rje nyid kyi sku sring bde mchog skyid dang khong gi yang tsha grwa btsun bslab gsum rgya mtsho zung gis sa thag ring bo'i dka' sdug la ma 'dzems par rje nyid kyi gsung rtsom mtha' dag dre'u khal du longs pa zhig dngos su khur nas rang re'i dpe skrun khang du slebs shing /khyed dpe skrun khang gi rtsom sgrig spus tshad legs pas gzhan su dang gang la'ang ma sprad par khyed cag la gtad pa yin zhes gsung 'bum dpar skrun gyi dngos shugs dbang cha yod tshad nga tshor phul ba dang / khyad par du nged dpe skrun khang la ma dngul gyi 'khos ka zhan pa mthong nas/gcen po'i gsung 'bum par du btab nas bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas la phyar ba gru 'degs kyi nus pa thon na de las che ba med ces gsungs te gcen rin po che'i brtsams yon skar gcig kyang med pa'i thog da dung gzhan las zhal 'debs dngul sgor khri gnyis tsam bsdus nas gun gsab kyi rogs skyor byas pa la nga tsho sems 'gul chen po dang skul ma chen po thebs te/ gzhi nas khong gi gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig sgrig pa'i 'char gzhi dngos bstar byas pa yim//da cha nga tshos par du bskrun pa'i gsung 'bum 'di la khyon bsdoms pod drug tu bkar/ pod dang bo ni gtso cher rnam thar skor yin/ 'di'i nang du nga tshos de snga sus kyang mjal ma myong ba'i mdo smad bstan pa'i bdag po rje bla kho rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rnam thar 2

lo rgyus la mjal thub par ma zad/ rtsom pa po rang nyid kye byung ba lo rgyus las mkhas chen dam pa zhig thos sbyang gi stobs ga 'dra zhig la brten nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i tshul la rgyus mnga' lon cing rang nyid la sbyang stobs che ru bskyed pa'i skul ma thebs nges yin/ pod gnyis pa ni gtso cher gzhung 'grel skor te/ 'di'i nang nas rtsom pa po rang nyid nang don rig pa'i mkhas dbang zhig yin pa'i ngos nas deng gi 'chad grwa'i gzhung khrid kyi dka' gnad la dmigs nas tshig don gnyis gsal gyi 'grel bshad gnang yod/ pod gsum pa ni gtso cher lo rgyus skor te/ 'di'i nang du bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas dar tshul gyi lo rgyus sogs bkod yod pas/ nga tshos lo rgyus 'di dag las rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi phul byung grub 'bras mthong thub par ma zad/ mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung na med pa'i legs bshad btso ma'i gser lta bu'ang mi nyung ba zhig zin rgyu yod do/ /pod bzhi ba ni gtso cher sgra snyan ngag skar rtsis kyi skor yin/ 'di'i nang du slob dpon 'di pas srol rgyun rig gnas kyi bslab bya so so rgyas bsdus 'tsham zhing go bde ba'i lam nas bkral yod pas las dang po ba rnams la nye bar mkho zhing 'jug bde ba'i gnas dam pa zhig tu 'khums so/ /pod lnga ba ni gtso cher sum rtags dag gsum skor yin/'di'i nang nas nga tshos rtsom pa po'i deng rabs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i brda sprod kyi gzhung lugs dang lta ba gsar ba/ lag len gyi rin thang ldan 3

zhing nye bar mkho ba'i bshad pa gsar ba shes rtogs byed thub pa yin/pod drug pa ni gsung thor bu'i skor te/ 'di'i nang nas nga tshos rtsom pa pos gdul bya'i blo gang la gang 'tsham du sbyar ba'i shes bya sna tshogs dang /dri ba dris lan/ chab shog sogs mjal thub la/ gsung tsag cig la snang chung mi byed par zhib tu bklags na ni bye ma'i gseb nas gser rdo rnyed pa lta bu'i dga' snang skye'ang srid do// mdor na/ khong gi gsung 'bum la brjod don zab kyang tshig 'grel gsal ba/ rig pa'i gnas la 'jug pa'i las dang po ba rnams kyi blor 'tsham zhing go sla ba/ gnas lnga rig pa'i snying bcud 'dus shing 'jug bde ba/ shes ldan rgan pas bklags na blo skyed gsar ba thob pa a gsar gzhon nus bklags na mos gus dbang med 'chor ba'i yon tan gyi mdzod chen po zhig yin pas/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi dge ba'i bshes dang brtse ba'i grogs su gyur cig gu//zhes 'di ga'i rtsom sgrig khang nas/ spyi lo1996zla8tshes3la phul/

dkar chagasgrig pa bo'i— gtam/ — (1)shes bya'i rnam grangs blo gsal rigs sgo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (1)skabs dang bo/ gzugs kyi rnam grangs bshad pa/ (3)shes bya'i rnam grangs bshad pa/ (3)nang gi gzugs bshad pa/ (6)phyi'i gzugs bshad pa/ (10)skabs gnyis pa/ shes pa bshad pa/ (21)sems dang sems byung bshad pa/ (23)rtog bcas dang rtog med bshad pa/ (39)blo rigs bdun du dbye ba bshad pa/ (43)tshad ma dang tshad min bshad pa/ (50)rtogs pa'i blo dang ma rtogs pa'i blo bshad pa/ (53)'khrul shes dang ma 'khrul ba'i shes pa bshad pa/ (54)skabs gsum pa/ ldan min 'du byed bshadapa/ (58)skabs bzhi ba/ rgyu 'bras bshadapa/ (71)rgyu bshad pa/ (71)ma rkyen bshad pa/ (80)'bras bu bshad pa/ (84)skabs lnga ba/ shes bya la rang sbyi gnyis sogs su dbye ba bshad pa/ (86)1

rang spyi gnyis su dbye ba/ (86)bden pa gnyis su dbye ba/ (94)mtshan nyid gsum du dbye ba/ (97)rdzas ldog gnyis su dbye ba/ (100)skabs drug pa/ mtshan mtshon bshad pa/ (102)mtshan nyid bshad pa/ (103)mtshon bya bshad pa/ (106)mtshan mtshon gang yang ma yin pa bshad pa/ (108)skabs bdun pa/ sbyi bye brag bshad pa/ (113)spyi bshad pa/ (113)bye brag bshad pa/ (115)de gnyis kyi don gsal bar bshad pa/ (118)skabs brgyad pa/ 'gal 'grel bshadapa/ (125)'gal ba bshad pa/ (125)'brel ba bshad pa/ (130)mtha' cung zad dpyad pa/ (135)dngha skabs dgu ba/ dgag chub gnyis bshad pa/ (140)sgrub pa bshad pa/ (140)dgag pa bshad pa/ (141)skabs bcu ba/ gcig dang tha dad bshadapa/ (157)gcig bshad pa/ (157)tha dad bshad pa/ (162)2

zhar byung ldog pa ngos 'dzin/ (166)skabs bcu gcig pa/ yul dang yul can bshad pa/ (17zhu)yul bshad pa/ (170)yul can bshad pa/ (176)zhar byung mngon lkog gnyis bshad pa/ (179)shes bya'i rnam grangs blo gsal rigs mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so (185)le'u dang bo/ shes bya spyi'i rnam bzhag bshad pa/ (186)le'u gnyis pa/ yod rtogs med rtogs kyi rnam bzhag bshad pa/ (223)le'u gsum pa/ yin log min log gi rnam bzhag bshad pa/ (258)dris lan bsam pa'i rang lgedangs/ (282)smon lam rgya mazlotshore dri ba'i dris lan/ (290)byis pa'i dag yig (296)dris lan yid kyi mun sel/ (300)dris lan li dwangs rang sgra/ (304)dris lan gter gyi kha byang / (327) brda sprod/ (373)dbyangs gsal gyi brda chad/ (375)yig gsar e waṃ (379) khang dmar dgon gyi 'khor lo'i dkar chag — (384)3

bod skad dang rgya skad kyi khyad par mdo tsam bshad pa/ (401)rje blo bzang grags pa'i mdzad rnam thung ngu / (417)mkhas dbang 'ga'i 'khrungs 'das/ (430)phyag chen brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ (439)'dod gsol don gnyis lhun grub/ (444)brgyud 'debs kha skong skor/ (447)zhabs brtan gsol 'debs don gnyis lhun grub/ (449)dngha zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'dod don lhun grub/ (451)zhabs brtan gsol 'debs/ (452)rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la 'dod don gsol ba don gnyis lhun grub/ (464)smon tshig bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ (456)lam khrid 'jam dpal zhal lung gi brgyud 'debs kha skong / (460)tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing gi brgyud 'debs kha skong / ( 462)tshe rabs rjes 'dzin skor dang gsol 'debs/ (463)brgyud 'debs kha skong skor/ (464)nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i brgyud 'debs kha skong / (465)bzlas brjod dang gzhung klog tshul/ (468)nyams len bya tshul rang blo'i bcud thigs/ — (470)4

'phags pa 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang bya tshul bklags pa'i don grub/ (486)'jam dbyangs dmar ser sogs 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs skor/ cha (602)'jam dbyangs skor/ (505)'jam dbyangs dkar bo dang dbyangs can ma sbrags pa'i sgrub thabs/ (506)'jam dpal seng ge'i gdong can dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs/ (508)'jam dpal gyi rtog pa las byung ba'i ngag gi rgyal bo gser mdog can gyi sgrub thabs/ (511)'jam dbyangs nag po'i nyams len sgom bzlas/ (51 5)'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i rgyun 'khyer/ (517)'jam dkar sgrub thabs/ (519)lha mo nor rgyun ma'i gter sgrub dgos 'dod char 'beb (521)khro bo'i rgyal bo sme ba brtsegs pa'i sbyin sreg dme grib sogs nyes pa kun sel/ — (530)dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gi dus go (547)sa bdag lto 'phye'i thig 'debs tshul rab gsal me long (557)lto 'phye'i bskyed chog ngag 'don gyi rim pa/ (573)5

dkyil 'khor zhal ston bsdus pa bzhugs/ (593)lha mo'i 'phrin bcol/ (595)bswe khrab can gyi 'phrin bcol/ (596)'dod gsol byin rlabs myur 'jug (599)ljags byin rlabs bzhugs/ (603)bsang yig (604)bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi thugs rje chen po'i dkar chag (607)thar mdo'i 'khor chen gyi dkar chag (612)dkar chag ratna'i phreng ba/ (623)rdo ma ṇi'i dkar chag (625)rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun dkon mchog bsam grub dpal bzang bo'i sku bstod cha tsam brjod pa rgyud mang rang gdangs/ (627)myur 'byon smon tshig (631)rjes 'dzin smon tshig dbyar skyes rnga gsang/ (634)bslab bya khag gsum/ (635)rig gnas la bstod pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ (643)shugs 'byung ngag gi rol mo/ (648)bslab bya don gnyis lhun grub/ (649)shis brjod tshig gi me tog (650)6

dga' ba'i rol mo (656) bsngags pa dpyod ldan spyi nor/ (659)rnam 'phel rig pa'i tshigs bcad/ (660)dbyar mtsho rgyas pa/ (661)rab gsal ngag gi rol mo/ (663)smon tshig 'bras ldan snye ma/ (669)spang ljongs kyi dpyid rlung / (671)sku bstod dngos grub bang mdzod/ (671)rig grwa'i mchod yul/ (673)glang chen 'gying ri'i gnas bstod/ (678)dpyid bsu ba'i khu byug gi dbyangs/ (680)bsngags smon zla ba 'bum gyi snang ba/ (684)'phrin yig sna tshogs kyi skor/ (685)slob ba dag la gnang ba'i brda sprod kun byed kyi mtshan/ (733)༄phar phyin ston mo ba rnams la gnang ba'i tshogs gtam/ (735)ang yig 'bri ba'i re'u mig (775)par byang smon tshig (778)7

ོsbyatrī rsā rkorka—spu5snye4 )dza rkakro'5snye4masnyerge/ 5 rirahā/snyi ༄rirī ra —'ji ༄ ༈ dzā'abazhu 3 hā — snyerṣa zurku — spu rmānas za zhi shrī khrirdzotshe sa rmā sa8 za ma rtswa ⑫༄7/ /theX rnyi'areḥ sbyochenan nar bilhe/ ra/mkhyan — nya ma 'bar ba3 darlabasra kyas/ ḍādzo/ byu —— ma —sne trī shes/rdo kekhyu ci ༈ ñtsa sne ༈ ༈ ༈ trītrī ge lomi za—marpāglo ) ma zumasnasperpānamatre byuhūṃ/sperṣa la bee tsa khyi maḥms rsāsgormyatrī / byu〉ri(0dzā la su ktas swā tta maḥ ma'ahoke sā na/tshaXrsha rde// /tswa 'atre ba' smag dzwan sas nas stinā par ma/dzod/ — rasnga/ riñtsha /chusde sde———rī —— lkete rneyam̐ ——rī'o//( sdi ༈ ༈ /— na ma ma ma ṅgā rpā rsā mji khyu ma ma ma rsā la 0 mab kra ma lngispe hrū kra' pā ju rtsirgustsechenakyo ba rnyo /'a lco rtsa'/ gyas// ཿsnyi//ra rwa shā ram̐༄tsholhas — 2rdo / //// sgyu / 3 3 ༈ rkepu7ཿ llīnamamarnar marmārsāmarimasna 0na ⑫ spe ma ma rnu ldi 4 tsho rmārsā mobai maci 5sha tā na sa/ yicho pa rā ṇa smi/ ka shā da rgyaḥ/ /'aspyo las yangasposu 'dran ngablo shas/ la rtsol/ rme /2

skabs dang bo/ gzugs kyi rnam grangs bshad pa/wo bya'i rnam grangs bshad pa/'dir shes par bya ba'i rnam grangs cung zad bhashad pa la/ blo'i yul du bya rung / shes bya'i mtshan nyid/ sgra bshad ni/ khang ba ka ba bca' lag sogs yod pa gang yin pa tshang ma blo'i yul du bya rung ba'am blos rtogs pa'am shes rgyu yod pa'i cha nas shes bya yin zhes bshad pa'o/ /shes bya'i mtshan gzhi ni/ ka ba/ bum pa/ gzugs/ shes pa/ nam mkha'/ sa chu sogs yin/ shes bya ma yin pa ni/ ri bong gi rwa/ rtag mi rtag gnyis ka yin pa/ ka bum gnyis ka yin pa lta bu/ de dag shes bya min te/ med pa yin stabs shes rgyu med pa'i phyir/ shes bya dang don gcig pa ni/ shes bya/ yod pa/ gzhi grub/ gzhal bya/ dmigs pa/ chos rnams don gcig yin te/ phan tshun yin khyab mnyam yin pa'i phyir/ yin khyab mnyam gyi don ni/ dper na/ shes bya dang yod pa gnyis phan tshun yin khyab mnyam yin te/ shes bya yin na yod pa yin pas khyab/ yod pa yin na shes bya yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ shes bya yin na yod pa yin pas khyab ces pa ni/shes bya yin na yod pa yin dgos zhes pa'i don yin pas/ shes bya la yod pa ma yin pa med do/ /tshad mas dmigs pa/ yod pa'i mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/ sa/ chu/ me/ rlung sogs yod pa de dang de/ sgra bshad ni/3

yod pa de dag blo tshad ma ste/ blo yang dag pas dmigs yul du byas nas rtogs rgyu yod pas de ltar brjod/ tshad mas grub pa/ gzhi grub kyi madzhan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ ka ba/ bum pa/ mig dang / rna ba sogs yin/ sgra bshad ni/ mig dang / rna ba/ ka ba sogs tshad ma ste shes pa yang dag pas grub pa ste rtogs rgyu yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar brjod/ dper na/ khang ba de/ blo tshad mas yod pa yin min brtags nas yod pa yin par shes pa'am yod pa yin par grub pas na/ gzhi grub ces brjod do/ /tshad mas rtogs par bya bro/ gzhal bya'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ khang ba/ka ba sogs/ sgra bshad ni/ ri dang chu sogs/ blo tshad mas rtogs par bya ba'am gzhal bar bya ba yin pas de ltar brjod pa yin te/ blos gzhal ba dang blos rtogs pa don gcig go /rang gi ngo bor 'dzin pa chos kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ ka ba/ bum pa/ sa/ nam mkha' sogs/ sgra bshad ni/ ka ba sogs la chos zhes bya ste/ rang rang gi spyi'i ngo bo dang khyad par gyi ngo bo 'dzin pa'am mi gtong bas na de ltar brjod/ dper na/bum pas rang gi spyi'i ngo bo shes bya yin pa 'dzin pa'am mi gtong ba dang /khyad par gyi ngo bo lto ldir zhabs zhum chu skyor gyi don byed nus pa yin pa 'dzin pa'am mi gtong ba'i phyir/ shes bya'i dbye ba bshad pa/ shes bya la dbye na/ rtag pa dang / dngos po gnyis/ dang po rtag pa'i mtshan nyid ni/skad cig ma ma yin pa'i chos/ mtshan gzhi ni/ nam mkha' lta bu/ sgra 4

bshad ni/ dus rtag tu brtan cing gnas pas na rtag pa zhes brjod la/skad cig skad cig la 'jig pa min pas na/ skad cig ma ma yin pa zhes brjod do/ /rtag pa la dbye na/ rna ma pa thams cad pa'i rtag pa dngaka re 'ga' ba'i rtag pa gnyis yod/ dang bo ni 'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha' lta bu/ thogs reg bkag tsam gyi med dgag de/ 'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha'i mtshan nyid/ sgra bshad ni/ bar snang stong ba chos can/ khyod yod pa yin pas shes bya yin la/ gang la'ang ltos pa med par rtag tu mi 'gyur pas na/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i rtag pa zhes brjod la/ rgyu rkyen gyis 'dus ma byas pa ste rgyu rkyen gyis ma byas pas na/ 'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha' zhes da do/ /gnyisaci pa re 'ga' ba'i rtag pa ni/ bum pa'i nam mkha' dang / khang ba'i nam mkha' lta bu/ sgra bshad ni/ bum pa'i nang gi stong ba dang / khang ba'i nang gi stong ba chos can/ re 'ga' ba'i rtag pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bum pa dang / khang ba ni/ re 'ga' ba'i dngos po yin la/ khyod la skye 'jig med cing de la brten nas 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ bum pa dang khang ba ni re 'ga' ba'i dngos po yin te/ res 'ga' yod la res 'ga' med pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ dngos po bshad pa/ dngos po'i mtshan nyid ni/ don byed nus pa dngos po'i mtshan nyid yin te/ dogabyed pa'i nus pa yod tshad dngos po 5

yin pa'i phyir/ dngos po la dbye na/ gzugs/ shes pa/ ldan min 'du byed gsum yod/ dang bam̐ gzugs la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/dang bo ni/ gzugs su rung ba gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/bum pa dang / sgra lta bu/ gzugs dang bem po don gcig gzugs kyi mtshan nyid kyi sgra bshad ni/ 'byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur gyi dngos po nang phan tshun gcig gis gcig la reg cing gzugs nas gnod byar rung bas/ gzugs su rung ba zhes brjod do/ /du ma spung ba'i gzugs su rung ba/ gzugs kyi phung bo'i mtshan nyid/ gzugs dang / gzugs kyi phung bo don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ rdul phra rab dang / bum pa lta bu/ sgra bshad ni gong dang 'dra/ rdul du grub pa bem po'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa dang / rdul phra rab lta bu/ rdul phra rab chos can/ rdul du grub pa yin te rdul rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ des na/ rdul du grub pa zhes pa ni/ rang nyid rdul rdzas yin pa la byed rgyu yin no//nang gi gzugs bshad pa/gzugs la dbye na/ nang gi gzugs dang / phyi'i gzugs gnyis/nang gi gzugs bshad pa/ nang gi gzugs la lnga yod de/ mig gi dbang bo/ rna ba'i dbang bo/ sna'i dbang bo/ lce'i dbang bo/ lus kyi dbang bo dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ mig gi dbang bo ni/ rang 'bras mig shes kyi thun 6

mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nang gi gzugs can dwangs pa de/ mig dbang gi mtshan nyid/ mig dang / mig dbrong dang / mig gi skye mched dang / mig gi khams bzhi don gcig —mtshan gzhi ni/ mig gi dbang rten gyi go sar dbyibs zar ma'i me tog ltar chags pa'i gzugs dwangs pa de'o/ //de la dbye na/ rten bcas kyi mig rmedabang dang / de mtshungs kyi mig dbang gnyis yod/ rang 'bras mig shes kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i mig dbang de/rten bcas kyi mig dbang gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ mig shes kyis gzugs la lta bzhin pa'i skabs kyi mig dbang lta bu/ rang 'bras mig shes kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen mi byed pa'i mig dbang de/ de mtshungs kyi mig dbang gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan ṅgezhi ni/ gnyid log pa'i gnas skabs kyi mig dbang lta bu/ gzugs la lta bzhin pa'i skabs kyi mig dbang ni rang la brten pa'i mig shes dang bcas pa'i mig dbang yin pas/ rten bcas kyi mig dbang zhes brjod la/ gnyid log pa'i skabs kyi mig dbang ni/ rang la brten pa 'i mig shes dang bcas pa'i mig dbang min te/ gnyid log pa'i skabs su mig shes med pa'i phyir/'on kyang / rang la brten pa'i mig shes yod pa'i mig dbang dang / mig dbang yin pa rigs mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ de mtshungs kyi mig dbang zhes brjod do/ /mig dang mig dbang don gcig yin pa bzhin du/ 7

lus dang lus dbang gi bar 'dra ba yin zhing / mig dbang sogs ni yid shes kho nas bzung ba las/ dbang shes lnga'i gzung yul gtan nas ma yin na'ang / mig shes kyis mig sogs kyi dbang rten mthong ba na/ blo ngor mig sogs mthong ba'i snang ba skye bas mig sogs kyang mthong bar 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ mig sna sogs mig shes la snang ba tsam yin yang / mig shes la gsal bar snang ba dang / mig shes kyis bzung ba min stabs/ mig shes kyi bzung yul min zer ro/ /dbang rten ni/ mig gi khra ril dang / sna'i zor dbyibs can sogs la zer la/ de dag ni dbang bo'i rten tsam las/ dbang bo dngos min te/ mi gnas sa'i khang ba lta bu yin pas/ dbang rten khog pa zer ro/ /gnyis pa rna dbang ni/rang 'bras rna shes kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nang gi gzugs can dwangs pa de/ rna dbang gi mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/ dbang rten rna bug gi nang du dbyibs gro ga gcus nas bcad pa lta bu'i gzugs dwangs pa'o/ /rna ba'i dbang bo dang / rna ba dang / rna ba'i skye mched/ rna ba'i khams rnams don gcig dbye na rten bcas kyi rna dbang dang / de mtshungs kyi rna dbang gnyis yod/ gsum pa sna dbang ni/ rang 'bras sna shes kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nang gi gzugs can dwangs pa de/ sna dbang gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ dbang rten sna'i gdong rgyud gnyis na zangs 8

khab gshib pa lta bu'i gzugs dwangs pa'o/ /sna'i dbang bo dang / sna dang /sna'i skye mched/ sna'i khams rnams don gcig dbye na rten bcas kyi sna dbang dang / de mtshungs kyi sna dbang gnyis yod/ bzhi ba rtse dbernga ni /rang 'bras lce shes kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nang gi gzugs can dwangs pa de/ lce dbang gi mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/ lce'i dbang rten gyi steng phyogs kyi nang du zla phyed gnyis gshib pa lta bu'i gzugs dwangs pa'o/ /lce'i dbang bo dang / lce dang /lce'i skye mched/ lce'i khams bzhi don gcig dbye na/ rten bcas kyi lce dbang dang / de mtshung sa kyi lce dbang gnyis yod/ lnga ba lus dbang ni/rang 'bras lus shes kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nang gi gzugs can dwangs pa de/ lus dbang gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ lus kyi phyi nang stod smad thams cad kyi sha rus pags pa rgyus pa sogs la reg bya myong ba'i rdul rdzas shin tu dwangs pas lus kyi dbyibs bzhin du khyab pa de'o/ /skra sen gyi rtse dang khrag mchil ma gshang gci sogs la ma khyab ste/ de dag la phan gnod byas pas lus shes la bde sdug gi 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ lus dbang dang / lus dang /lus kyi skye mched/ lus kyi khams bzhi don gceg dbye na/ rten bcas kyi lus dbang dang / de mtshungs kyi lus dbange gnyis yod do/ /

phyi'i gzugs bshad pa/phyi'i gzugs la dbye na lnga yod de/ gzugs kyi skye mched/ sgra'i skye mched/ dri'i— skye mched/ ro'i skye mched/ reg bya'i skye mched dang lnga yod/dang bo mig shes kyis gzung bya/ gzugs kyi skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/ dung dkar bo'i kha dog dang / sprin lta bu/ phyi'i gzugs lnga'i dang bo'i gzugs dang / gzugs kyi skye mched dang / gzugs kyi khams rnams don gcig gzugs kyi skye mched la dbye na/ kha dog dang /dbyibs gnyis yod/ dang bo kha dog ni/ mdog tu rung ba kha dog gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi dang / yan lagasha kha dog brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi ni/ dkar bo/ dmar bo/ser bo/ sngon po dang bzhi/ yan lag gi kha dog brgyad ni/ sprin dang du ba/ rdul dang khug sna/ snang ba dang mun pa/ grib ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer brgyad yod/ gnyis pa dbyibs ni/ dbyibs su rung ba/ dbyibs kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ brgyad yod de/ ring ba dang thung ba/ lham pa dang zlum po/ mtho ba dang dma' ba/ phya le ba dang phya le ba ma yin pa dang brgyad yod/ kha dog dang dbyibs gnyis la yin min gyi mu bzhi yod de/kha dog yin la dbyibs ma yin pa'i mu dang / dbyibs yin la kha dog ma yin pa'i mu dang / dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis ka yin pa'i mu dang /dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis ka gang yang ma yin pa'i mu dang bzhi yod pa'i 10

phyir/ dang bo yod de/ sngo ser/ dkar dmar/ grib ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer/ snang ba dang mun pa rnams de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ dbyibs brgyad po de yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ sprin dang du ṅge/rdul dang khug sna bzhi bo de yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi ba yod de/ sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya rnams de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sgra'i skye mched ni/ rna shes kyis mnyan bya sgra'i skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ mnyan bya sgra'i mtshan nyid/ sgra dang / sgra'i skye mched dang /sgra'i khams rnams don gcig sgra'i dbye ba la sgra spyi'i dbye ba dang / rjo da byed kyi sgra bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang bo la/ rtsa ba'i sgo nas dbye na gnyis te/ zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra dang / ma zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra gnyis/ de la zin ma zin gyi don ni/ dbang bos zin ma zin la byed pa yin zhing / sgra la dbang bos zin pa med pas/sgra'i rgyur gyur pa'i 'byung ba de dbang bos zin ma zin la byed pa yin pas/ dbang bos zin pa'i 'byung ba las skyes pa'i sgra ste/ dper na/skyes bu'i ngag gi sgra dang / skyes bus thal mo brdab pa'i sgra lta bu'o/ /skyes bus thal mo brdab pa'i sgra'i rgyur gyur pa'i thal mo'i ko ba'i 'byung ba bzhi bo lus dbang gis zin pa sayin pas/ de las byung ba'i sgra de zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra la bzhag pa'o/ /'byung ba la zinatho zin gyi don yang / skyes bu'i lag pa sogs kyi 'byung ba de la nyer spyad sogs kyis 11

phan byas na lus shes la bde ba 'byung ba dang / mtshon bsnun pa sogarsā gnod byas na sdug bsngal 'byung du yod pa ni dbang bos zin pa'i 'byung ba dang / de ltar med pa ni dbang bos ma zin pa'o/ /dbang bos ma zin pa'i 'byung ba las skyes pa'i sgra ni/ ma zin pa'i sgra ste/ dper na/ rnga dang 'khar rnga'i sgra lta bu ste/ sgra de gnyis kyi rgyur gyur pa'i rnga dbyug dang rnga'i ko ba sogs kyi 'byung ba ni/ dbang bos ma zin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis la yan lag gi sgo nas dbye na bzhi yod de/ zin pa'i sgra sems can du ston pa'i sgra dang / zin pa'i sgra sems can du mi ston pa'i sgra dang / ma zin pa'i sgra sems can du ston pa'i sgra dang / ma zin pa'i sgra sems can du mi ston pa'i sgra dang bzhi yod/ sems can du ston pa'i sgra ni brjod bya'i don lung du ston pa'i sgra ste/ 'di dang rjod byed kyi sgra dang rnam par rig byed kyi sgra gsum don gcig sems can du mi ston pa'i sgra ni brjod bya'i don lung du mi ston pa'i sgra ste/ 'di dang rjod byed ma yin pa'i sgra dang rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i sgra gsum don gcig dang bo ni skyes bus gtam bshad pa'i sgra lta bu ste/ sgra de 'byung ba'i rgyu skyes bu'i lce rkan gyi 'byung ba de dbang bos zin pa yin la/ khyod de las byung ba'i sgra gang zhig khyod kyis brjod bya'i don ston pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ skyes bus thal mo brdab pa'i sgra lta bu ste/ khyod 'byung ba'i rgyu thal mo'i ko ba'i 'byung ba rnams dbang bos zin pa yin la/ khyod de las byung ba'i sgra yin 12

pa gang zhig khyod kyis brjod bya'i don mi ston pa'i phyir te/ dzekhyod kyi brjod bya med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni sgra sdud 'khor lo'i srid jus ston pa'i sgra lta thu ste/ khyod 'byung ba'i rgyu sgra sdud 'khor lo'i sgrig chas kyi 'byung ba rnams ni dbang bos ma zin pa yin la/ khyod de las byung ba'i sgra yin pa gang zhig khyod kyis brjod bya'i don ston pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyis srid jus gsal bor sgrog pa'i phyir/ bzhi ba ni/ chu sgre lta bu ste/ khyod 'byung ba'i rgyu chu ni dbang bos ma zin pa yin la/ khyod de las byung ba'i sgra yin pa gang zhig khyod kyis brjod bya'i don mi ston pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyi brjod bya med pa'i phyir/ de bzhi la nying lag gi sgo nas dbye na brgyad yod de/ yan lag gi dbye ba bzhi bo la gnyis re dbye bas brgyad yod de/zin pa'i sgra sems can du ston pa'i sgra la snyan mi snyan gnyis/ zin pa'i sgra sems can du mi ston pa'i sgra la snyan mi snyan gnyis dang / ma zin pa'i sgra sems can du ston pa'i sgra la snyan mi snyan gnyis/ ma zin pa'i sgra sems can du mi ston pa'i sgra la snyan mi snyan gnyis te brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rjod byed kyi sgra bye brag tu bshad pa la/ sgra'i brjod bya dang / rjod byed kyi sgra bshad pa gnyis/ dang bo sgra'i brjod bya ni/ brda'i dbang gis go bar bya ba de/ brjod bya'i mtshan nyid/ brjod bya dang /yul dang / gzhal bya gsum don gcig yin te/ gzhi grub na sgra'i brjod bya yin pa'i khyab pa'i phyir te/ gzhi /shrīb na sgra'i dngos yul yin pa'i khyab 13

pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rjod byed kyi sgra ni/ brda'i dbang gis rang yul go byed kyi mnyan bya de/ rjod byed kyi sgra'i mtshan nyid/ dper na/ khang ba zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu'o/ /rjod byed kyi sgra dang ngag don gcig ma yin te/ ngag ni skyes bu'i lce rkan gyi rtsol ba las byung ba'i sgra yin la/ rjod byed kyi sgra la skyes bu'i lce rkan las byung ba ma yin pa'i sgra sdud 'khor lo sogs kyi brjod don ston pa'i sgra lta bu yod pa'i phyir/ rjod byed kyi sgra la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ ming tshig yi ge gsum yod/ don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i sgra de/ ming tshig yi ge gsum du phyes pa'i ming gi mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/ gdung 'degs kyi don byed nus pa la ka ba zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu/ dbye na/ dngos ming dang / btags ming gnyis/ lto ldir —ba la bum pa zhes brjod pa lta bu dngos ming dang / mi stobs ldan la seng ge zhes btags pa'i ming lta bu btags ming yin no/ /don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par sbyar nas ston pa'i sgra de tshig gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra mi rtag ces dang / sgra mi rtag pa yin zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu'o/ /ming tshig gnyis kyi rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i skad kyi gdangs de/ ming tshig yi ge gsum du phyes pa'i yi ge'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ phor ba/ zhes brjod pa'i sgra'i rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i/ pha'i gdangasadang / na ro'i gdangs dang / ba'i gdangs rnams lta bu/ dbye na/ dbyangs yig dang /gsal byed kyi yi ge gnyis so/ /yang rjod byed kyi sgra la rigs brjod kyi sgra 14

dang / tshogs brjod kyi sgra gnyis las/ dang bo ni/ rang gi dngos kyi brjod byar gyur pa'i rigs spyi yod pa de/ rigs brjod kyi sgra'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ shes bya zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu yin te/ shes bya rigs spyi yin pa'i phyir te/ rtag pa dang dngos po la sogs pa'i rigs spyi yin te/ rtag pa dang dngos podag shes bya'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa tshogs brjod kyi sgra ni/ rang gi dngos kyi brjod byar gyur pa'i tshogs spyi yod pa'i sgra de/ tshogs brjod kyi sgra'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu yin te/ bum pa tshogs spyi yin pa'i phyir te/ rang gi lto ba dang mgrin pa dang zhabs la sogs pa yan lag du ma tshogs pa la bzhag pas/ de dag tshogs pa'i spyi yin pa'i phyir/ rigs spyi zhes pa'i spyi ni/ spyi bye brag gi spyi la byed mod/ tshogs spyi zhes pa'i spyi ni rang gi yan lag du ma tshogs pa la byed pa 'i phyir/ yang rjod byed kyi sgra de la brjod tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ mi ldan rnam gcod kyi sgra dang / gzhan ldan rnam gcod kyi sgra dang / mi srid rnam gcod kyi sgra gsum yod de/gzhi de la khyad chos de mi ldan pa rnam par bcad nas ldan pa kho nar ston pa'i sgra de/ mi ldan rnam gcod kyi sgra'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra mi rtag pa kho na yin zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu yin te/ sgra mi rtag pa kho na yin zhes brjod pa'i sgra des/ sgra la mi rtag skepa mi ldan pa rnam par bcad nas mtha' gcig tu mi rtag pa ldan pa kho na/yin par ston pa'i sgra yin pa'i 15

phyir/ gzhi de las gzhan la chos de ldan pa rnam par bcad nas gzhi de kho na la ldan par ston pa'i sgra de/ gzhan ldan rnam gcod kyi sgra'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra kho na mnyan bya yin zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu yin te/ sgra kho na mnyan bya yin zhes brjod pa'i sgra des/ sgra ma yin pa'i gzhi gzhan la mnyan bya de ldan pa'am yod pa rnam par bcad nas/ sgra kho na la nyan bya'i khyad par de ldan par ston pa'i sgra yin pa'i phyir/ gzhi de la chos de mi srid pa rnam par bcad nas srid pa kho nar ston pa'i sgra de/mi srid rnam gcod kyi sgra'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ utpal sngon po srid pa kho na yin no/ /zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu yin te/ utpal sngon po srid pa kho na yin zhes pa'i sgra des/ utpal las gzhan pa'i sngon po yod pa mi gcod cing / utpal sngon po mi srid pa rnam par bcad nas utpal sngon po srid pa kho nar ston pa'i sgra yin pa'i phyir/ yang rjod byed kyi sgra la/smra ba bo dang nyan pa bo'i brjod 'dod kyi dbang gis dbye na gnyis te/chos can brjod pa'i sgra dang / chos brjod kyi sgra gnyis yod/ gzhi de khyad gzhir rjod pa'i sgra de/ gzhi de la ltos te chos can brjod pa'i sgra'i mtshan nyid/ 'di dang khyad par gzhan mi spong ba'i sgra gnyi—sa don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra mi rtag ces brjod pa'i sgra lta bu/ sgra mi rtag ces brjod pa'i sgra de/ sgra la ltos te chos can brjod pa'i sgra yin te/ sgra de mi rtag pa'i khyad par du bya ba'i gzhi dang mi rtag pa sgra'i khyad chos su brjod pa'i sgra 16 —

yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sgra mi rtag ces brjod pa'i sgra de/ sgra la ltos te chos brjod kyi sgra ma yin te/ sgra khyad chos su ston pa'i sgra ma yin pa'i phyir/'on kyang mi rtag pa la ltos te chos brjod kyi sgra yin te/ mi rtag pa'i khyad chos su ston pa'i sgra yin pa'i phyir/ des na sgra mi rtag ces brjod pa'i sgra de/ spyir chos brjod kyi sgra dang chos can brjod pa'i sgra gnyis ka yin par shes par bya'o/ /yang sgra mi rtag ces brjod pa'i sgra de/ sgra la ltos te khyad par gzhan mi spong ba'i sgra yin te/ sgra de mi rtag pa'i khyad gzhir brjod par ma zad shes bya dang dngos po la sogs pa'i khyad gzhi yin pa mi spong ba'i phyir te/ des sgra de mi rtag pa las chos gzhan gang yang min par ston pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhi de khyad chos su ston pa'i sgra de/ gzhi de la ltos te chos brjod kyi sgra'i mtshan nyid/ 'di dang khyad par gzhan spong gi sgra gnyis don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra'i mi rtag pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu/ sgra'i mi rtag pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra de/ gzhi sgra la ltos te chos brjod kyi sgra yin te/ sgra khyad par gyi chos su ston pa'i sgra yin pa'i phyir te/nyan pa bos mi rtag pa tsam zhig go ba na mi rtag pa de/ ka ba'i mi rtag pa dang bum pa'i mi rtag pa sogs gang yin snyam pa na/ smra ba bos sgra'i mi rtag pa'o/ /zhes khyad gzhi sgra'i mi rtag pa de ka ba'i mi rtag pa dang bum pa'i mi rtag pa sogs las khyad par 'byed chos de sgra yin par brjod pa'i phyir/ sgra mi rtag pa khyad gzhi dang sgra khyad chos su brjod pa'i sgra yin pa'i 17

phyir/ sgra'i mi rtag pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra de/ sgra la ltos te khyad par gzhan spong gi sgra yin te/ sgra'i mi rtag pa de khyad par 'byed pa'i 'byed chos ni sgra las gzhan yod pa spong ba'i phyir te/ de 'dra'i 'byed chos de sgra las gzhan min par ston pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ sgra mi rtag ces brjod pa'i sgras/ sgra de khyad par du 'byed pa'i chos la mi rtag pa las gzhan pa'i khyad chos yod pa ma bkag pas na/ khyad par gzhan mi spong ba'i sgra dang /sgra'i mi rtag pa zhes brjod pa'i sgras/ sgra'i mi rtag pa de khyad par du 'byed pa'i chos la sgra las gzhan yod pa bkag pas na/ khyad par gzhan spong gi sgra yin zhes brjod la/ 'dis gzhan la rigs 'gre'o//gsum pa dri'i skye mched ni/ sna shes kyis myong bya dri'i skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ dri dang dri'i skye mched dang / dri'i khams rnams don gcigadri la dbye na/ rtsa ba'i sgo nas gnyis yod de/ zhim pa'i dri dang / mi zhim pa'i dri gnyis yod/ yan lag gi sgo nas dbye na bzhi yod de/ dri zhim pa la mnyam mi mnyam gnyis dang / mi zhim pa la mnyam mi mnyam gnyis yod/yang dri la dbye na/ tsan dan gyi dri lta bu lhan skyes kyi dri dang / sbyar spos kyi dri lta bu sbyar byung gi dri gnyis yod do// bzhi ba ro'i skye mched ni/ lce shes kyis myong bya/ ro'i skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ ro dang / ro'i skye mched dang / ro'i khams rnams don gcig ro la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ mngar ba dang / skyur ba dang / tsha 18

ba dang / lan tshwa ba dang / kha ba dang / bska ba drug go /dang bo ni bu ram gyi ro lta bu/ gnyis pa ni sgyu ru ru'i ro lta bu/ gsum pa ni sman tsha ba gsum gyi ro lta bu/ bzhi ba ni rgya tshwa dang sog tshwa'i ro lta bu/ lnga ba ni tig ta'i ro lta bu/ drug pa ni a ru ra'i ro lta bu/ phyi ma ni lces bska bar myong bya de'o/ /drug po re re la mngar ba'i mngar ba soges drug drug phyes pas so drug yod pa dang / so drug po re re la myang tshe lce shes la phan pa'i ro re re dang / 'ju bar mngon du phyogs pa'i tshe lus shes la mi gnod pa'i ro re re dang / zhu zin pa'i tshe lus sems la phan 'dogs pa'i ro re re ste gsum re phyes pas brgya dang brgyad yod la/ bsres pa'i sbyor ba'i dbye na mngar ba gcig la yang sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis du ma 'byung ba lta bu ro drug po la bsres pa'i sbyor ba'i sgo nas byung ba'i ro mtha' yas pa yod kyang rtsa ba'i ro la drug tu nges so/ /gzhan yang / ro so drug po la mi phan pa dang / gnod pa dang / phan mi 'dogs pa gsum gyis dbye bas brgya rtsa brgyad kyang yod do// lnga ba reg bya'i skye mched ni/ lus shes kyis myong bya/ reg bya'i skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ reg bya dang / reg bya'i skye mched/ reg bya'i khams rnams don gcig reg bya ladabye na/ 'byung bar gyur pa'i reg bya dang / 'byung 'gyur gyi reg bya gnyis yod/ 'byung bar gyur pa'i reg bya ni sa chu me rlung bzhi'o/ /sra zhing 'thas pa sa'i mtshan nyid/ rlan zhing 19

gsher ba chu'i mtshan nyid/ tsha zhing sreg pa me'i mtshan nyid/ yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi mtshan nyid do/ /'byung ba bzhi'i byed las ni/ sas 'dzin pa dang / chus sdud pa dang / mes smin pa/ rlung gis rgyas par byed pa'o/ /'byung 'gyur gyi reg bya la bdun yod de/ 'jam pa dang rtsub pa/lci ba dang yang ba/ grang ba dang bkres pa/ skom pa dang bdun no/ /de dag ni rim bzhin rang rgyu 'byung ba'i 'bras bu yin pa gang zhig rang rgyu chu dang me shas che bas mnyen zhing mi rtsub par reg par bzod pa'i reg bya ni 'jam pa dang / de gang zhig rang rgyu sa rlung shas che bas mi mnyen pa dang reg par mi bzod pa'i reg bya ni tsub pa dang / de gang zhig rang rgyu sa chu shas che bas srang gi mjug mtho la mgo dma' bar byed pa'i reg bya ni phyi ba dang / de gang zhig rang rgyu me rlung shas che bas lci ba'i ljid mi thub par srang gi mgo mtho la mjug dma' bar byed pa'i reg bya ni yang sa dang / de gang zhig rang rgyu chu rlungartsoshas che bas des nyen na dro bar 'dod pa'i blo skyed byed kyi reg bya ni grang ba dang / de gang zhig rung rgyu rlung khams shas che bas pho bar zas rnams zad pa'i dbang gis lto ba'i nang du za 'dod kyi blo skyed byed kyi pho ba kha 'byar ba'i reg bya zhig grub pa de bru ba'am ltogs pa'am bkres pa'i reg bya dang / de gang zhig rang rgyu me shas che bas lto bar btung ba zad pa'i dbang gis sgang ba kha 'byar ba'i reg bya de skom pa'i reg bya'o/ /ring thung dang mtho dman lci ya nga 20

dag ni ltos sa ltos 'jog yin pa shes par bya'o/ /chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs rnams ni gzhan du 'chad do/ /shes bya'i rnam grangs bshad pa las dngos po la gzugs shes ldan min 'du byed gsum yod pa'i nang gi gzugs kyi rnam grangs bshad pa'i skabs te dang bo'o//skabs gnyis pa/ shes pa bshad pa/shes pa bshad pa la/ blo dang shes pa dang rig pa dang gsal ba bzhi don gcig yin te/ rig pa blo'i mtshan nyid dang gsal ba shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ des na/ blo rig pa'i mtshon bya dang / shes pa gsal ba'i mtshon bya yin/ cung zad gsal bar bshad na/ rang yul snang ba'i rig pa blo'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni mig shes dang / dad pa/ri 'dod chags/ zhe sdang lta bu'o/ /sgra bshad ni/ rang yul de yod kyang rung med kyang rung rang la snang zhing 'char bas na rig pa zhes brjod pa yin la/mig shes la sbyar na/ mig shes kyi rang tsol gzugs kyi skye mched de rang la snang zhing 'char bas na/ mig shes rang nyid rig pa'am blo yin zhes brjod la/ de bzhin du/ ri bong rwa 'dzin rtog pa ni/ rang gi yul ri bong rwa med kyang ri bong rwa'i spyi zhig rang la snang zhing 'char bas na rang yul snang ba'i rig pa'am blo yin zhes brjod pa yin no/ /rang yul gsal 21

ba'i bem min de/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni gong gi de dang 'dra la/ sgra bshad ni/ shes pa rang gi yul yod kyang rung med kyang rung shes pa rang gi ngor snang zhing gsal bas na gsal ba'am shes pa zhes brjod la/ gzugs dang gang zag nam mkha' sogs min pas na bem min zhes brjod do/ /rang yul gsal ba zhes pa ni/ dper na/ ri bong rwa 'dzin gyi blo ngor rang yul ri bong rwa'i rnam pa snang zhing gsal ba can yin pas na ri bong rwa 'dzin gyi blo de rang yul gyi ri bong rwa snang zhing gsal ba yin par 'jog pa bzhin/ rang yul med pa'i blo thams cad de dang 'dra/ blo dang shes pa gnyis ngo bo gcig dang don gcig yin yang tha dad yin tshul ni/ dper na/ sngo 'dzin mig shes de rang yul sngon po snang ba'i rig pa yin pa'i cha nas blo dang / rang yul sngon po rang gi ngor gsal ba'i cha nas shes pa yin zhes brjod pa yin no/ /shes pa ni/ rang gi ngo bo gsal ba'i rang bzhin can yin la/ gang zag ni rang yul snang ba can zhig yin yang rang gi ngo bo gsal ba min te/ dper na/ sgron me de gzhan la ma ltos par rang gi ngo bo gsal ba yin la/ sgron me dang ldan pa'i mtshan mo'i khang bu de sgron me la brten nas gsal bar bzhag gi rang gi ngo bo gsal ba min pa bzhin no/ /gang zag gis rtogs ma rtogs kyang de'i rgyud kyi blos rtogs ma rtogs la bya'o/ /shes pa dang blo la dbye na/ sems sems byung gnyis su dbye ba/ rtog 22

bcas rtog med gnyis su dbye ba/ blo rig bdun du dbye ba/ tshad ma dang tshad min gnyis sum̐ dbye ba/ rtogs pa'i blo dang ma rtogs pa'i blo gnyis su dbye ba/ 'khrul shes dang ma 'khrul ba'i shes pa gnyis su dbye ba dang drug then /sems dang sems byung bshad pa/dang bo sems sems byung gnyis su dbye ba'i sems ni/ rang yul du gyur pa'i don gyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i cha nas bzhag pa'i rig pa de sems kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ mig gi rnam shes dang / yid kyi rnam shes lta bu/ sems dang / yid dang / rnam par shes pa dang / gtso sems bzhi don gcig dbye na drug yod de/ mig gi rnam par shes pa/rna ba'i rnam par shes pa/ sna'i rnam par shes pa/ lce'i rnam par shes pa/lus kyi rnam par shes pa/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang drug de'i dang bo lnga ni dbang shes yin la/ dbang shes dang / 'jug shes dang / sgo lnga'i shes pa gang rung rnams don gcig sgra don ni/ mig shes sogs ni/dbang bo gzugs can pa la brten pa'i shes pa yin pas dbang shes dang /rang rang gi yul la thad kar phyir 'jug pa las blo kha nang du phyogs nas yul la dmigs mi shes pas na 'jug shes dang / dbang bo gzugs can 23

pa'i sgo la brten nas yul la 'jug pas sgo lnga'i shes pa zhes brjod pa'i phyir/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen mig dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rang yul du gyur ṅge'i gzugs kyi skye mched kyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i rig pa de/ mig gi rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/ dkar bo mthong ba'i rnam par shes pa lta bu/ mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / mig shes su gyur pa'i sems don gcig rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen rna dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rang yul du gyur pa'i sgra'i ngo bo rang stobs kyis thos pa'i rig pa de/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ pi wang gi sgra thos pa'i rnam par shes pa lta bu/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / rna shes su gyur pa'i sems don gcig rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen sna dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rang yul du gyur pa'i dri'i ngo bo rang stobs kyis myong ba'i rig pa de/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/tsan dan gyi dri tshor ba'i rnam par shes pa lta bu/ sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna shes su gyur pa'i sems don gcig rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen lce dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rang gi yul du gyur pa'i ro'i ngo bo rang stobs kyis myong ba'i rig pa de/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bu ram gyi ro myong ba'i rnam par shes pa lta bu/ lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce shes su gyur pa'i sems don gcig24

rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen lus dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rang gi yul du gyur pa'i reg bya'i ngo bo rang stobs kyis myong ba'i rig pa de/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/'jam pa'i reg bya myong ba'i rnam par shes pa lta bu/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / lus shes su gyur pa'i sems don gcig rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen yid dbang la brten nas byung ba'i rang yul du gyur pa'i don gyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i rig pa de/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra mi rtag par mthong ba'i rnam par shes pa lta bu/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid shes su gyur pa'i sems don gcig desan dbang shes su gyur pa'i sems rnams ni/ rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen la brten nas rang yul du gyur pa'i chos gang dang gang yin pa de rang dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes pa gzhan la ma ltos par rang stobs sdis mthong bas na sems sam gtso sems dang rnam par shes pa'am yid yin zhes bya ba yin no/ /yid dang sems don gcig kyang / yid shes dang sems don mi gcig ste/yid shes la sems byung yod do/ /yid dbang ni/ yid kyi rnam shes rang rang gi snga logs de ma thag tu 'gag pa'i rnam shes tshogs drug gang rung la bya ste/ dper na/ bum 'dzin yid kyi rnam shes shig skyes pa na/ de'i snga logs de ma thag tu 'gag pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa nas yid kyi 25

rnam par shes pa'i bar gyi rnam shes drug ga'am gang yang rung / de bum 'dzin yid shes de'i bdag rkyen dbang bo yin te/ de dag ni bum 'dzin yid shes de yul 'dzin nus su skyed pa'i dbang bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang / rang yul so sor mthong ba'i cha nas ba zhag pa'i rnam rig de rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi 'khor du gyur pa'i gtso sems yod pa'i rnam rig de/ gtso sems kyi mtshan nyid/ rang yul shes pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i rnam rig de/ yid kyi mtshan nyid/ de rnams don gcig yin sdiyang / rang yul so sor mthong ba'i cha nas rnam par shes pa dang / rang gi 'khor du gyur pa'i sems byung yod pa'i cha nas gtso sems dang / rang gi yul de shes pa'i cha nas yid ces so sor brjod pa'o//sems sems byung gnyis su dbye ba'i sems byung ni/ rang yul du gyur pa'i don gyi khyad par rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i cha nas bzhag pa'i rig pa de/ sems byung gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ tshor ba dang sems pa lta bu/ sems byung dang 'khor sems don gcig sems byung thams cad rang 'khor du 'gro yul gyi gtso sems yod pas na 'khor sems zhes brjod pa yin/sems byung la dbye na nga gcig yod de/ kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga/rtsa nyon drug nye nyon nyi shu/ dge ba bcu gcig gzhan 'gyur bzhi rnams yod do/ /26

kun 'gro lnga ni/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ sems pa/ reg pa/ yid byed rnams so/ /rang yul rang stobs kyis nyams su myong ba'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ tshor ba dang / rang yul gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan ma rang stobs kyis 'byed pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ 'du shes dang / rang yul la rang stobs kyis g.yo zhing yul de yid la 'jags pad byed pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ sems pa dang / yul dbang sems gsum 'dus nas yul la 'phrad cing rang yul rang stobs kyis dpyod par byed pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ reg pa dang / rang yul la rang stobs kyis 'jug cing gtod par byed pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ yid byed kyi mtshan nyid/ tshor ba la tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum yod/ mdze sa pa dang snyan pa sogs phan par snang ba'i dngos po rang stobs kyis bzung nas bde ba nyams su myong ba'i rnam pa can gyi rig pa de/ tshor ba bde ba/ mi sdug pa dang nad la sogs pa gnod par snang ba'i dngos po rang stobs kyis bzung nas sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba'i rnam pa can gyi rig pa de/ tshor ba sdug bsngal/ sa rdo lta bu phan gnod gang yang med pa'i bar ma rab stobs kyis bzung nas bde sdug gang yang min pa'i btang snyoms nyams su myong ba'i rnam pa can gyi rig pa de/ tshor ba btang snyoms yin no/ /'du shes ni/ rang yul de dang de'i rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan ma ste/ khyad— par du ma yod 27

pa rnams ma 'dres par so sor 'byed pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung zhig la zer te/ dper na/ bum 'dzin 'du shes rtog pas ni/‘ rang yul bum pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par bum pa yin pa dang shes bya yin pa dang dngos po yin pa la sogs pa'i khyad par du ma/ rnams kyi nang nas shes bya yin pa la sogs pa'i cha gzhan rnams rang yul du bsal nas bum pa yin pa'i cha de nyid ma 'dres par phyes nas 'dzin pa dang / bum pa mi rtag par 'dzin pa'i 'du shes rtog pas bum pa mi rtag pa yin pa'i cha de nyid ma 'dres par phyes nas rang stobs kyis 'dzin pa sogs gzhan la rigs 'gre'o/ /sems pa ni/ dper na rdo khab len gyis lcags g.yo bar byed pa bzhin du rang dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems dang tshor ba sogs rang gi yul gang yin pa de'i phyogs su rang stobs kyis skul zhing g.yo bar byed pa'am 'phro bar byed cing yul de rang stobs kyis nang du sems pa'am yid la 'jags shing goms par byed pa'i rnam pa can gyi bya ba shugs che ba'i sems byung zhig la bya'o/ /reg pa ni/ yul dbang sems gsum 'dus nas blo de rang stobs kyis yul dang 'phrad pa'i cha'am yul la reg pa'i cha de/ reg pa yin zhes pa'o/ /yid byed ni/ rang dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung thams cad de/ sems pa ltar spyir yul la g.yo bar byed pa tsam ma yin par/ yid byed rang gi yul gang dang gang yin pa de la rang stobs kyis 'jug par byed pa dang zhugs nas gtod cing brtan 28

par byed pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung zhig la 'dod do/ /tshor ba sogs lnga bo de la kun 'gro zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sems kun gyi 'khor du 'gro bas na de ltar brjod do//yul nges lnga ni/ 'dun pa/ mos pa/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab dang lnga'o/ /'dun pa ni/ byed las rang 'bras brtson 'grus kyi rten byed cing / rang yul du gyur pa'i bsam pa'i dngos po la dmigs nas rang stobs kyis don du gnyer ba'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ 'dun pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ yon tan la 'dun pa'i 'dun pa lta bu/de ni dper na/ yon tan ma thob pa thob par bya'o snyam pa dang thob pa mi nyams par bya'o snyam pa lta bu ste/ de'i dbang gis yon tan la brtson pa'i brtson 'grus skye bas na/ de'i byed las ni rang 'bras brtson 'grus tshobaskyed pa'o/ /mos pa ni/ byed las rang gi bzung yul las sems mi 'phrog par byed cing / nges zin pa'i rang yul la dmigs nas rang stobs kyis de kho na yin par mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ mos pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa yin pa la mos pa'i mos pa lta bu ste/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa yin par nges nas yid ches rnyed de/ gnas tshul de nyid rang stobs kyis the tshom med par mtha' gcig tu de kho na yin no snyam du 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung yin pas so/ /dran pa ni/ byed las sems mi g.yeng 29

bar byed cing rang yul 'dris pa'i dngos po la dmigs nas rang stobs kyis mi brjed pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ dran pa'i mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/ sngar shes shing 'dris cha song ba'i chos nyid la dmigs nas rang stobs kyis chos nyid de slar dran nas yid la shar ba'i sems byung lta bu/ da lta dran pa'i dngos po mtha' dag sngar nas 'dris cha song ba yin no/ /ting 'dzin ni/ byed las rang 'bras shes rab bskyed cing /rang yul btags pa'i dngos po la dmigs nas rang stobs kyis rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ ting 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/ 'dus byas mi rtag par sgom pa'i ting 'dzin lta bu/btags pa'i dngos po zhes pa ni/ dbang shes la ting 'dzin mi skye bas ri yid shes kho nas yul du shar ba'i chos de la bya ste/ dper na/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa ma rtogs pa'i gang zag gis 'dus byas mi rtag pa dang cha 'dra ba zhig blos btags nas de la dmigs te sgom pa lta bu'o/ /shes rab ni/ byed las the tshom ldog par byed cing / rang yul brtag par bya ba'i dngos po la dmigs nas rang stobs kyis blang dor 'byed pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ shes rab kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab lta bu ste/ de ni rang gi dmigs yul la dmigs nas rang stobs kyis rgyu mtshan 'di'i don gyis chos 'di'i gnas lugs ni 'di ltar yin no zhes rnam par 'byed pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems 30

byung yin la/ shes rab kyi stobs kyis chos de'i gnas lugs ngo ma ngos zin pa na/ chos de'i gnas lugs de ltar yin nam min snyam pa'i the tshom ldog par byed do/ /de lnga 'khor du 'gro yul gyi sems ni dge sems kho nar nges pas yul nges lnga zhes brjod pa yin no//rtsa nyon drug ni/ 'dod cha gas/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ lta ba/the tshom dang drug yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po la dmigs nas/ yul de la rjes su chags shing 'bral dka' ba'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/'dod chags kyi mtshan nyid/ sdug bsngal gyi gnas kyi chos la dmigs nas kun nas mnar sems pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ khong khro'i mtshan nyid/ phyi nang gi chos gang rung la dmigs nas/ sems khengs pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ nga rgyal gyi mtshan nyid/ chos gang rung la dmigs nas/ ma rtog pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ ma rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos gang rung la dmigs nas/ log par rtog pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ rtsa nyon du gyur pa'i lta ba'i mtshan nyid/ bden don zhig la dmigs nas/ yid gnyis za ba'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung cide/ the tshom gyi mtshan nyid/ rang stobs kyis sems nyon mongs pa'am nyog por byed pa'i byed las can gyi sems byung de/ nyon mongs yin la/'di drug ni/ sems nyog por byed pa'i rtsa ba lta bu yi na pas na/ rtsa nyon drug ces brjod do/ / 31

nye nyon nyi shu yod de/ khro ba/ khon 'dzin/ 'chab pa/ 'tshig pa/phrag dog ser sna/ sgyu/ g.yo/ rgyags pa/ rnam 'tshe/ ngo tsha med pa/ khrel med pa/ rmugs pa/ rgod pa/ ma dad pa/ le lo/ bag med/ brjed nges/shes bzhin ma yin pa/ rnam par g.yeng ba ste nyi shu'o/ /nye bar gnas pa la dmigs nas rnam pa deg pa sogs bya bar 'dod pa'i sems byung de/khro ba'i mtshan nyid/ khro ba dang khong khro mi 'dra ste/ khong khro dang zhe sdang ni khro ba'i yul nye bar mi gnas kyang / sems la shar ba tsam gyis mi bzod par khong nas 'khrugs pa'i me 'bar ba lta bu yin la/ khro ba ni/ khro ba'i gzhi nye bar gnas pa na rdeg pa sogs byed par 'dod pa/ me la mar khu blug pa na me lce 'bar ba lta bu yin no/ /khro ba'i gzhi la dmigs nas khong khro'i rgyun mi gtong zhing / gnod pa dang gnod lan bya bar 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ khon 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ rang gzhan gyi skyon dang mi dge ba la dmigs nas gsang zhing sbed par 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ 'chab pa'i mtshan nyid/ khro ba'i gzhi la dmigs shing rnam pa kun nas mnar sems pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ 'tshig pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhan gyi phun tshogs la dmigs nas mi bzod cing sems khong nas 'khrugs pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/phrag dog gi mtshan nyid/ yo byad sogs la dmigs nas dam du 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ ser sna'i mtshan nyid/ rnyed bkur la 32

chags pa'i dbang gis yon tan gyi khyad par ci rigs la dmigs nas rang la med kyang yod pa ltar ston pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/sgyu'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi nyes pa gzhan la mi mngon par sba ba'i thabs 'tshol ba'i rnam pa can gyi sems byunge de/ g.yo'i mtshan nyid/ 'chab pa dang 'di gnyis mi 'dra ste/ 'chab pa ni sba ba'i rnam pa can yin la/g.yo ni thabs 'tshol ba'i rnam pa can yin no/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par gang rung la dmigs nas yid dga' zhing bde bas sems khengs pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ rgyags pa'i mtshan nyid/ nga rgyal dang mi 'dra ste/ 'di ni sems dga' bde tsam gyis khengs pa zhig yin no/ /sems can la dmigs nas snying brtse ba med pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ rnam par 'tshe ba'i mtshan nyid/ de'i gnyen po ni snying rje yin te/de ni mi 'tshe ba yin pas so/ /nyes spyod la dmigs nas/ rang nyid rgyu mtshan du byed pa'am legs spyod rgyu mtshan du byas kyang 'dzem pa med pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ ngo tsha med pa'i mtshan nyid/ nyesku spyod la dmigs nas gzhan don rgyu mtshan du byas te 'dzem pa med pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ khrel med pa'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa gang la rnam pa ji ltar bzung yang lus sems lci zhing las su mi rung bar nyog nyog po'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ rmugs pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod yon sogs sdug pa'i mtshan ma la dmigs nas sems ma zhi bar phyi la 'phro 33

ba'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ rgod pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'phro ba dang rgod pa gnyis mi 'dra ste/ 'phro ba ni sems 'phro ba tsam yin la/ rgod pa ni 'dod chags kyi char gtogs so/ /mthunapa'i rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung ba dang dngos po dang gang zag gi yon tan sogs la dmigs nas yid mi ches par mi 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ ma dad pa'i mtshan nyid/ yul dge zhing legs pa'i dngos po dang bya ba gang la dmigs kyang sems mi spro ba'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ le lo'i mtshan nyid/sems dge zhing legs pa'i dmigs pa la 'jug pa'i tshe mi mthun phyogs las sems mi bsrung zhing mi 'bad pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/bag med pa'i mtshan nyid/ nyon mongs kyi gzhi gang rung la dmigs nas sems mi gsal bar gyur te/ brjed pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/brjed nges kyi mdzan nyid/ sgo gsum gyi spyod pa la dmigs nas mi shes bzhin du 'jug pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ shes bzhin ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid/ sems dmigs pa gang la dmigs kyang rnam par 'phro zhing g.yeng ba'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ rnam g.yeng gi mtshan nyid/rgod pa dang rnam g.yeng mi 'dra ste/ rgod pa ni yul yid du 'ong ba la 'phro zhing 'dod chags kyi char gtogs yin la/ rnam g.yeng ni yul sna tshogs la 'phro zhing 'dod chags kho nas char gtogs yin pa'i nges pa med do/ /de nyi shu la nye nyon zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsa nyon dang nye zhing 34

sems nyon mongs par byed pas na de ltar brjod do//dge ba bcu gcig yod de/ dad pa/ ngo tsha shes pa/ khrel yod pa/'dod chags med pa/ zhe sdang med pa/ gti mug med pa/nebartson 'grus/shin sbyangs/ bag yod pa/ btang snyoms/ rnam par mi 'tshe ba dang bcu gcig dad pa'i yul gsum gang rung la dmigs nas yid ches pa dang 'dod pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ dad pa'i mtshan nyid/ dad pa'i yul gsum ni/ bden pa dang / yod pa dang / mi bslu ba gsum mo/ /rang nyid rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ kha na ma tho ba la 'dzem pa'i sems byung de/ ngo tsha shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhan dang legs spyod rgyu mtshan du byas nas kha na ma tho ba la 'dzem pa'i sems byung de/ khrel yod kyi mtshan nyid/ srid pa'i yo byad sogs la dmigs nas ma chags shing mi len pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ 'dod chags med pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang yul la dmigs nas kun nas mnar sems med pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ zhe sdang med pa'i mtshan nyid/ ma rig pa'i gnyen po byed cing so sor rtog pa'i shes rab brtan pa dang bcas pa'i sems byung de/gti mug med pa'i mtshan nyid/ dge zhing legs pa'i phyogs la sems spro bar byed pa'i sems byung de/ brtson 'grus kyi mtshan nyid/ sems dge zhing legs pa'i dmigs pa la ji 'dod du gtod par byed cing lus sems kyi gnas ngan len rgyun gcod phar byed pa'i sems byung de/ shin 35

sbyangs kyi mtshan nyid/ dge zhing legs pa sgrub par byed cing bya ba ngan pa las sems srung bar byed pa'i sems byung de/ bag yod kyi mtshan nyid/sems bying rgod kyis mi mnyam pa med par byed pa'i sems byung de/skabs 'di'i btang snyoms kyi mtshan nyid/sdug bsngal can la dmigs nas mi bzod pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ rnam par mi 'tshe ba'i mtshan nyid/ de bcu gcig la dge ba zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dge sems kho na'i 'khor du 'byung bas na de ltar brjod do//gzhan 'gyur bzhi yod de/ gnyid dang / 'gyod pa dang / rtog pa dang / dpyod pa bzhi yod/ sems kyi 'jug pa rang dbang med par nang du sdud par byed pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ gnyid kyi mtshan nyid/bya ba lari dmigs nas mi 'dod bzhin du yid la gcags pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ 'gyod pa'i mtshan nyid/ shes rab kyi yul la dmigs nas rags pa'am rtsing— ba'i rnam pas 'jug par byed pa'i sems byung de/gzhan 'gyur bzhi'i nang gi rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ shes rab kyi yul la dmigs nas zhib tu byas nas dpyod pa'i rnam pas 'jug pa'i sems byung de/ dpyod pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /sgo lnga'i rnam shes kyi 'khor du kun 'gro lnga dang rtog dpyod gnyis las gzhan pa'i sems byung med de/ sems byung 'gyod pa dang rtsa nyon drug dang nye nyon nyi shu la rtog bcas kyis khyab pa dang / yul nges lnga dang 36

dge ba bcu gcig dang / gzhan 'gyur gnyid kyang —dran rtog can yin pas/ sgo lnga'i shes pa la rtog bcas dang dran rtog can med pa'i phyir ro//sems dang de'i 'khor du byung ba'i sems byung gnyis ngo bo gcig yin te/phan tshun gcig gi rang bzhin las grub pa ste/ blo gcig gi khyad par mi 'dra ba'i ldog pa du ma la bzhag pa yin gyi/ de gnyis ngo bo logs su grub pa re re med pa'i phyir/ dper na/ bum pa 'dzin pa'i blo de rang stobs kyis bum pa'i ngo bo mthong ba yin pa'i cha de gtso sems su bzhag pa dang /yang bum pa 'dzin pa'i blo de bum pa'i steng gi phan gnod bar ma gang rung de rang stobs kyis myong ba yin pa'i cha de sems byung tshor ba dang /yang bum pa 'dzin pa'i blo de/ bum pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par bum pa yin pa de rang stobs kyis 'dzin pa yin pa'i lkecha de sems byung 'du shes dang / yang blo de rang stobasarkukyis bum pa la phar g.yo ba dang sems par byed pa yin pa'i cha de sems byung sems pa dang / yang blo de bum pa'i mdzes sdug bar ma gang rung rang stobs kyis dpyad par byed pa yin pa'i cha de sems byung reg pa dang / yang blo de bum pa la rang stobs kyis gtod par byed pa yin pa'i cha de mems byung yid byed la bzhag pa dang / de bzhin du mig gi rnam shes kyi 'khor gyi kun 'gro lnga ni mig shes gcig gi khyad par mi 'dra ba'i sdog cha re yin pa sogs shes par bya'o/ /yul nges lnga la sogs pa'i sems byung rnams kyang yid shes kyi khyad par mi 37

'dra ba'i ldog pa re re yin pa'am ldog pa re la bzhag pa'i ngo bo gcig yin gyi/ sems las don logs su gyur pa'i sems byung med/ sems byung las don logs su gyur pa'i sems med pa'i phyir/ de ltar sems dang sems byung thams cad blo gcig gi ldog pa re re ba yin kyang byed las sogs mi 'dra'o/ / sems dang sems byung gnyis rdzas gcig yin te/ dngos po yin pas rdzas yin la/ blo gcig gi rdzas su grub pa yin te/ sems kyi rdzas las sems byung grub/ sems byung rnams kyang phan tshun gcig gi rdzas las gcig grub pa sha stag yin no//sems dang sems byung gnyis tha dad yin te/ blo ngor so sor snang ba'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ bum 'dzin gyi blo de'i bum pa'i ngo bo rang stobs kyis mthong ba yin pa'i cha dang / bum pa rang stobs kyis myong ba yin pa'i cha sogs blo ngor don mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po yod pa ltar/ sems sems byung gzhan rnams kyang de dang 'dra'o//sems dang sems byung gnyis nang phan tshun 'gal ba yin te/ blo gcig po de'i don gyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis mthong ba yin pa'i cha dang /rang stobs kyis yul myong ba yin pa'i cha gnyis ka yin pa zhig med do/ /sems dang sems byung gnyis mtshungs ldan yin te/ mtshungs ldan rnam pa lnga mtshungs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rten mtshungs pa/ dmigs 38

pa mtshungs pa/ rnam pa mtshungs pa/ dus mtshungs pa/ rdzas mtshungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ de yang / rten mtshungs pa ni/ rten dbang bo gcig pa dang / dmigs pa mtshungs pa ni/ dmigs yul gcig pa dang / rnam pa mtshungs pa ni/ 'dzin stangs kyi yul gcig pa dang / dus mtshungs pa ni/ skye ba dus mnyam gnas pa dus mnyam 'jig pa dus mnyam yin pa dang / rdzas mtshujes pa ni/ rdzas re re bar mtshungs pa'i phyir te/ gtso sems kyang gcig las gnyis mi skye la/ de'i 'khor gyi tshor ba yang gcig las gnyis mi skye ba bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ / rtog bcas dang rtog med bshad pa/ shes pa'i dbye ba rtog bcas dang rtog med gnyis kyi rtog pa ni/ sgra skedon 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig de/ rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni bum 'dzin rtog pa lta bu/ sgra bshad ni/ dper na bum pa'i ming gi cha 'dra ba blo la snang ba ni sgra spyi dang / bum pa'i cha 'dra ba blo la snang ba ni don spyi yin pa bzhin du yod med thams cad la 'dra zhing / de lta bu'i sgra spyi dang don spyi gnyis blo ngor 'dres rung du 'dzin pa ste snang ba'i sgo nas rang yul la zhen pa'i rig pa de rtog pa yin zhes pa'o/ /de yang rang gi yul de'i don spyi mi snang ba'i rtog pa ni med la/ ming gi mtshan ma'i sgra spyi mi snang ba'i rtog pa ni yod de/ dper na bum pa'i brda la ma 39

byang ba'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi bum 'dzin rtog pa la bum pa'i don spyi shar yang sgra spyi mi 'char te/ bum pa'i ming gi cha 'dra ba blo la mi snang ba'i phyir/ der thal/ bum pa'i brda la ma byang ba'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi bum 'dzin rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na de'i rgyud kyi bum 'dzin rtog pa de sgra don 'dres par 'dzin pa'i blo min te/ de la don spyi las sgra spyi mi snang bas so/ /'on kyang bum 'dzin rtog pa de'i ngor bum pa'i don spyi snang ba de la bum pa'i sgra spyi'i snang ba yang 'dres rung du yod pas/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig yin zhes bshad pa yin no/ /bum pa'i brda la byang ba'i gang zag gi bum 'dzin rtog pa 'ga' zhig la bum pa'i sgra spyi dang don spyi gnyis ka dus gcig tu 'dres nas snang bas na sgra don 'dres par 'a dzin pa'i rtog pa yin la/ 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa yin zhes bshad chog ste/ 'dres rung nas 'dres pa yin pa'i phyir/ brda la byang ba'i rtog pa gang yin thams cad la sgra don gyispya gnyis ka snang ba'am de'i snang yul du de gnyis ka tshogs pa'i nges pa med de/ dper na pha'i rgyud kyi rang gi bu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa la sogs pa don la goms pā can gyi rtog pa thams cad la sgra spyi med par don spyi snang ba'i phyir/ yang zhen rig ces pa ni rang gi yul de nan tan gyis 'dzin pa la byed pa yin te/ nan gyis 'dzin pa ni/ dper na bum 'dzin mig shes kyis bum pa mngon sum du mthong ba la mthong ba de'i mur gnas pa 40

las nan gyis 'dzin mi dgos la/ bum 'dzin rtog pas nan gyis ma bzung bar mig shes ltar 'dzin mi nus pa'i khyad par myong bas grub bo/ /rtog pa'i dbye ba 'byed tshul gsum ste/ ming sbyor rtog pa dang don sbyor rtog pa gnyis su dbye ba/ rtog pa don ma thun dang don mi mthun gnyis su dbye ba/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi rtog pa gsum du dbye ba'o/ /dang bo gnyis kyi nang gi ming sbyor rtog pa ni/ brda dus kyi don dang tha snyad dus kyi ming sbyar nas 'dzin pa'i zhen rig de/ ming sbyor rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ lto ldir ba bum pa'o snyam pa'i rtog pa lta bu/'di dang sgra don 'dres par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa gnyis don gcig don sbyor rtog pa ni/ don la ming gi tha snyad ma sbyar bar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa de/ don sbyor rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ skyes bu rta bzhon pa 'di su zhig yin snyam du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa rtog pa don mthun dang don mi mthun gnyis kyi nang gi rtog pa don mthun ni/rang yul yod pa'i rtog pa de/ rtog pa don mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bum 'dzin rtog pa lta bu/ rang yul med pa'i rtog pa de/ rtog pa don mi mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ ri bong rwa 'dzin rtog pa lta bu'o/ /skabs 'di'i rang yul ni snang yul tsam la byed pa min par bzung bya'i yularsha labyed dgos pas/ bum 'dzin rtog pa'i rang yul ni bum pa dang / ri bong rwa 'dzin rtog pa'i bzung yul ni 41

ri bong rwa yin pas/ snga ma blo don mthun dang phyi ma blo don mi mthun du song ba'i phyir/ gsum pa thos bsam sgom gsum gyi rtog pa ni/ sgra spyi tsam gyi sgo nas nges pa rnyed pa'i zhen rig de/ thos byung du gyur pa'i rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ byas pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gtan la ma phebs par bum pa mi rtag par rtogs pa'i blo lta bu/ thos byung gi don la bsam nas tshad mas nges pa rnyed pa'i zhen rig de/ bsam byung du gyur pa'i rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rtags dang gtan tshigs la brten nas sgra mi rtag par nges pa rnyed pa'i rjes dpag tshad ma lta bu/bsam byung gi don la yang yang 'dres par byas pa'i ting 'dzin brtan pos bsdus pa'i zhen rig de/ sgom byung du gyur pa'i rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgom stobs kyis sgra mi rtag pa la nges pa rnyed pa'i rtog pa lta bu'o/ /rtog pa thams cad 'khrul shes yin te/ don spyi don du 'khrul nas 'dzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ bum pa gnas der med kyang / bum pa'i don spyi shar ba'i sgo nas bum 'dzin rtog pa skye la/ don spyi de bum pa min yang bum pa yin par 'khrul ba'i blo yin pa bzhin no//'on kyang / bum 'dzin rtog pa de/ rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul la ma 'khrul ba'i shes pa yin te/ de'i 'dzin stangs kyi yul ni bum pa yin la/bum pa des gzhal ba ltar du don la mi bslu ba yin pas na/ bum 'dzin 42

rtog pa de rtog pa don mthun yin pa dang / rtog pa log shes ma yin zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa rtog med kyi shes pa ni/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig dang bral ba'i shes pa de/ rtog med kyi shes pa'i mtshane nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bum 'dzin mig shes lta bu/ rang yul snang ba la don spyi'i snang ba med pas sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig dang bral te/rang yul gang yin pa de gsal bar snang ba'i shes pa thams cad rtog med kyi shes pa yin no/ /dbye na/ bum 'dzin mig shes lta bu yod pa gsal snang can gyi mngon sum dang / dung dkar ser bor snang ba'i dbang shes lta bu/ med pa gsal snang can gyi rtog med log shes gnyis yod do/ /blo rigs bdun du dbye ba bshad ba/ — shes pa la blo rig bdun du dbye ba ni/ mngon surma/ rjes dpagabacad shes/ yid dpyod/ snang la ma nges pa/ the tshom/ log shes dang bdun no/ / dang bo mngon sum ni/ rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa/ mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ gzugs 'dzin mngon sum dang / sgra 'dzin mngon sum lta bu/ rtog pa dang bral ba ste rtog pa ma yin pa zhig dgos la/ ma 'khrul ba zhes smras pas/ gangs ri sngon por snang ba'i 43

dbang shes dang / dung dkar ser bor snang ba'i dbang shes dang smig rgyu chur snang ba'i dbang shes sogs 'khrul shes yin pas/ mngon sum min no/ /de la dbye na/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon/ sgra 'dzin dbang mngon/ tshodri 'dzin dbang mngon/ ro 'dzin dbang mngon/ reg bya 'dzin pa'i dbang mngon dang lnga yod/ mngon sum ltar snang la dbye na bzhi yod de/(1)'khrul rgyu yule la yod pa'i rtog med log shes ni/ mgalartsome myur du bskor ba las 'khor mo yug tu bar ma chad par snang ba'i dbang shes lta bu ste/ de tang gi yul mgal me mgyogs par 'khor ba'i 'khrul rgyu las 'khor mor snang zhing 'khrul ba'i rtog med kyi shes palpen pas so/ /(2)'khrul rgyu rten la yod pa ni/ rab rib kyis mig bslad pas zla gcig zla gnyis su snang ba'i dbang shes lta bu yin te/zla gcig zla gnyis su snang ba'i 'khrul rgyu rab rib kyis bslad pa de rang gi rten mig la yod pa de'i rgyu las zla gcig zla gnyis su snang bas so/ /(3)'khrul rgyu gnas la yod pa ni/ rlangs 'khor dang me 'khor la zhugs pa na/ pha rol tshu rol gyi ri dang ljon shing 'gro bar snang ba'i dbang shes lta bu ste/ de ni ri ljon 'gro bar snang ba'i 'khrul rgyu mgyogs par 'gro ba'i rlangs 'khor dang me 'khor la yod pa'i dbang gis ri ljon 'gro bar snang zhing 'khrul bas so /(4)'khrul rgyu de ma thag rkyen la yod pa ni/ zhe sdang gis dkrugs pa las sa gzhi dmar bor snang ba'i dbang shes lta bu ste/ de sa gzhi dmar bor 44

snang ba'i 'khrul rgyu rang gi de ma thag rkyen du gyur pa'i zhe sdang gi rgyu las sa gzhi dmar bor snang zhing 'khrul bas so/ /de dag ni mngon sum ltar snang yin gyi/ mngon sum min te/ 'khrul shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rjes dpag ni/ rang gi rten rtags yang dag bkod pa la brten nas skyes shing rang gi gzhal bya lkog gyur la gsar du mi bslu ba'i zhen rig de/ rjes dpag gi mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/ byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag lta bu/ dbye na/ dngos stobs rjes dpag dang / grags pa'i rjes dpag dang / yid ches rjes dpag gsum yod/ dngos stobs rjes dpag ni/ rang gi rten dngos stobs kyi rtags yang dag la brten nas gzhal bya cung zad lkog gyur la gsar du mi bslu ba'i zhen rig de/ dngos stobs rjes dpag gyi mtshan nyid/6mtshan gzhi ni/du ba'i rtags kyis du ldan la me yod par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag lta bu/ judangos po'i stobs shugs kyi rtags ni/ dper na du ba yod na me nges par yod dgos pas na me de du bshād na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu yin la/ me las du ba 'byung la/ me las gzhan las du ba mi 'byung ba ni/ dngos po de gnyis kyi rang bzhin nam chos nyid yin pas/ med na mi 'byung gi 'brel ba de dngos po'i stobs shugs yin par gyur pa'i rtags yin te/de 'dra la dngos po'i stobs shugs kyi rigs pa zhe sa brjod pa yin no//grags pa'i rjes dpag ni/ rang gi rten grags rtags yang dag la brten 45

nas brda'am 'dod pa tsam gyis bzhag pa'i yul la gsar du mi bslu ba'i zhen rig de/ grags pa'i rjes dpag gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/rtog yul na yod pa'i rtags kyis ri bong can zla ba zhes brjod pa'i sgras brjod rung du rtogs pa'i rjes dpag lta bu'o/dze /ri bong can dang bsil zer can ni zla ba'i sgra bshad yod pa'i ming yin la/ ri bong can la zla ba zhes brjod pa ni 'dod rgyal gyi ming yin pas/ de la zla ba zhes 'jig rten na yongs su grags pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten gyi rtog pa'i ngo na 'di zla ba'o snyam pa yod pas/ ri bong can chos can/ zla ba zhes brjod rung ste/ rtog yul na yod pa'i phyir/ zhes sgrub pa 'di ni rgyu mtshan gzhan 'god rgyu med par 'jig rten na grags shing grub pa'i rgyu mtshan tsam gyis bsgrubs pas na/ grags rtags yang dag dang / de la brten nas skyes pa'i rjes dpag la grags pa'i rjes dpa ga ces brjod do/ /yid ches rjes dpag ni/ rang gi rten yid ches kyi rtags yang dag la brten nas gzhal bya shin tu lkog gyur la gsar du mi bslu ba'i zhen rig de/ yid ches rjes dpag gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rang gis kyang yid ches rnyed pa'i skyes bu'i ngag la brten nas ga ge mo'i mdzod du gser yod par rtogs pa'i blo lta bu'o/ /yid ches kyi rtags ni rtags dang bsgrub bya'i chos gnyis bdag nyid gcig pa lta bu'i dbang gis bsgrub bya dpog nus pa lta bu'i dngos po'i stobs shugs kyang min zhing grags pa tsam gyi rtags kyang min 46

par gzhal bya dpog pa po'i gang zag gis yid ches rnyed pa'i rtags de yin no//gsum pa bcad shes ni/ rtogs zin rtogs pa'i rig pa bcad shes kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bum 'dzin mngon sum skad cig gnyis pa dang / sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag skad cig gnyis pa lta bu/sgra bshad ni/ rang 'dren byed kyi tshad ma snga mas sgro 'dogs bcad zin pa'am rtogs zin pa'i byed pa ma nyams pa'i don de nyid slar yang rang gis 'dzin pa'am shes pas na bcad shes zhes brjod do/ /ba‘cad shes la dbye na/ mngon sum gyi rgyun du gyur pa'i bcad shes dang / rjeg dpag gi rgyun du gyur pa'i bcad shes gnyis/ dang bo ni/ sngo 'dzin mig shes skad cig gnyis pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag skad cig gnyis pa lta bu'o/ / bzhi ba yid dpyod ni/ myong stobs dang rang gi rten gtan tshigs gang rung la brten nas dngos su sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i nges pa dang bral zhing rang yul bden pa la mtha' gcig tu gsar du zhen pa'i zhen rig de/yid dpyod kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rgyu mtshan gyis nges pa min par mtha' gcig tu sgra mi rtag par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa lta bu ste/ de ni rtog pa yin pas sgra mi rtag pa myong stobs kyis ni ma nges/ rgyu mtshan gtan la ma phebs pas rjes dpag min la/ rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul 47

gyi sgra mi rtag pa ni yod pa yin phyir/ rang gi yul ni bden pa'ang yin/the tshom med par mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa'i rig pa'ang yin/ tshad mas rtogs zin byed pa ma nyams pa'i don 'dzin pa'ang ma yin pas na rang yul la gsar du zhen pa'i zhen rig kyang yin no/ /mtshan nyid kyi zur du myong stobs kyis nges pa dang bral zhes pas mngon sum dang yid dpyod kyi gzhi mthun yod pa gcod/ gtan tshigs kyis nges pa bral zhes pas rjes dpag dang yid dpyod kyi gzhi mthun yod pa gcod/ rang yul bden pa zhes pas log shes dang yid dpyod kyi gzhi mthun yod pa gcod/ mtha' gcig tu zhes pas the tshom dang yid dpyod kyi gzhi mthun yod pa gcod/gsar du zhes pas bcad shes dang yid dpyod kyi gzhi mthun yod pa gcod do/ /yid dpyod la dbye na/ rgyu mtshan med pa'i yid dpyod dang / rgyu mtshan can gyi yid dpyod gnyis/ dang bo ni/ rgyu mtshan gang gi sgo nas kyang mi bsam par sgra mi rtag pa yin no snyam du 'dzin pa'i yid dpyod lta bu dang / gnyis pa ni sgra byas pa yin na mi rtag pa yin dgos so snyam pa tsam gyis sgra mi rtag par 'dzin pa'i yid dpyod lta bu'o// lnga ba snang la ma nges pa'i blo ni/ rang gi 'jug yul rang mtshan gsal bar snang ba yang yin/ rang gi 'jug yul ma nges pa yang yin pa'i rig pa de/ snang la ma nges pa'i blo'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ mig gis gzugs yid 'ong mthong ba la lhag par chags pa'i gnas skabs kyi 48

sgra 'dzin dbang mngon lta bu/ de la dbye na/ mig shes su gyur pa'i snang la ma nges pa'i blo nas/ lus shes su gyur pa'i snang la ma nges pa'i blo'i bar lnga yod/ drug pa the tshom ni/ rang yul la rang stobs kyis rtse gnyis su 'jug pa'i rtsa nyon de/ the tshom gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra rtag gam mi rtag snyam pa'i the tshom lta bu/ dbye na don 'gyur gyi the tshom/don mi 'gyur gyi the tshom/ cha mnyam pa'i the tshom gsum/ dang bo ni/ sgra rtag gam mi rtag phal cher mi rtag las che snyam pa'i the tshom lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sgra rtag gam mi rtag phal cher rtag las che snyam pa'i the tshom lta bu/ gsum pa ni/sgra rtag gam mi rtag ji 'dra zhig snyam pa'i the tshom lta bu/bdun pa log shes ni/ rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul la 'khrul ba'i rig pa de/ log shes kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa dang / dung dkar ser bor snang ba'i dbang shes lta bu/ de la dbye na rtog pa log shes dang / rtog med log shes gnyis/ rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul la 'khrul ba'i zhen rig de/ rtog pa log shes kyi mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa dang / ri bong rwa 'dzin rtog pa lta bu/rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul la 'khrul ba'i gsal snang can gyi rig pa de/rtog med log shes kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ gangs ri sngon por snang ba'i dbang shes dang /rmi lam gyi rta rtar snang ba'i rmi lam gyi yid shes 49

lta bu/ log shes rnams 'khrul tshul du ma yod de/ skra shad 'dzag snang lta bu ngo bo la 'khrul ba dang / zla gcig zla gnyis snang ba'i dbang shes lta bu grangs la 'khrul ba dang / ljon shing 'gro bar snang ba lta bu bya ba la 'khrul ba dang / dung dkar ser bor snang ba lta bu kha dog la 'khrul ba dang /mgal me 'khor lor snang ba lta bu dbyibs la 'khrul ba dang / nam gung gi dus nyin phyed du snang ba lta bu dus la 'khrul ba dang / smig rgyu'i dbang gis gzugs chung ngu chen por snang ba lta bu tshad la 'khrul ba sogs 'khrul tshul sna tshogs yod do//blo rig bdun rags tsam bshad zin to// tshad ma dang tshad min bshad pa/dang bo tshad ma ni/ gsar du mi bslu ba'i rig pa de tshad ma'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sngon po gsar du rtogs pa'i mig shes tshad ma dang /sgra mi rtag pa gsar du rtogs pa'i rjes dpag tshad ma lta bu/ dkar 'dzin mig shes sogs dbang shes tshad ma rnams kyis rang yul myong stobs kyis mtha' chod par rtogs pa dang / rjes dpag tshad mas rgyu mtshan yang dag la brten nas rang yul mtha' chod par rtogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis mi bslu ba'i rig pa yin pas/ mi bslu ba zhes pas yid dpyod dang log shes tshad ma yin pa gcod/ tshad ma la gsar rtogs kyi blo dgos pas gsar du zhes smos pas/ bcad shes tshad ma— yin pa gcod/ rig pa zhes pas/ yul can 50

gang zag dang rjod byed kyi sgra tshad ma yin pa gcod do/ /tshad ma la dbye na/ mngon sum tshad ma dang / rjes dpag tshad ma gnyis/ mngon su/ma tshad ma ni/ rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i gsar du mi bslu ba'i rig pa de mngon sum tshad ma'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ dbang mngon skad cig dang bo lta bu/ dbye na/ gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon tshad ma sogs lnga yod/rtes dpag tshad ma ni blo rig bdun gyi skabs su bshad zin te/ rjes dpag dang rjes dpag tshad ma gnyis don gcig go /de nas tshad ma'i grangs nges bshad na tshad ma la gnyis su grangs nges te/ rang mtshan snang yul du byed pa'i mngon sum tshad ma dang / spyi mtshan snang yul du byed pa'i rjes dpag tshad ma dang gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir/ der thal/gzhal bya la rang spyi gnyis las med gshis/ rang spyi gnyis snang yul du byed pa'i tshad ma la yang gnyis las rang spyi las gzhan pa'i chos snang yul du byed pa'i tshad ma med pas na/ mngon rjes gang rung ma yin pa'i tshad ma phung gsum pa med pa'i phyir/ rang spyi gnyis zhes pa ni/ rang mtshan dang / spyi mtshan gnyis yin la/ rang mtshan dang dngos po don gcig spyi mtshan dang rtag pa don gcig mngon sum tshad ma'i snang yul dang gzhal bya gnyis gcig yin te/ dper na/ dkar 'dzin mig shes kyi snang yul yang dkar bo yin/ gzhal bya yang dkar bo las gzhan med/ rjes dpag gi snang yul dang gzhal bya gnyis mi gcig ste/ dper na/ sgra mi rtag par 51

rtogs pa'i rjes dpag gi snang yul la sgra mi rtag pa'i don spyi 'jog dgos la/ gzhal bya la sgra mi rtag pa 'jog dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag la sgra mi rtag pa'i don spyi snang ba'i sgo nas des sgra mi rtag pa gzhal ba'am 'dzin pa yin pa'i phyir/ rjes dpag sogs rtogs pa gzhal bya can gyi gzhal bya dang / 'dzin stangs kyi yul gnyis gcig yin te/ dper na/ sgra mi rtag paratshortogs pa'i rjes dpag gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul yang sgra mi rtag pa yin lda/ gzhal bya yang sgra mi rtag pa yin pa bzhin no/ /'dzin stangs zhes pa 'dzin tshul la go dgos pas/ sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag la sgra mi rtag pa'i don spyi snang ba la brten nas/ sgra 'di ni mi rtag go snyam du 'dzin pa yin la/ sngo 'dzin mig shes lta bus rang la snang ba'i sngon po de nyid myong stobs kyis shes pa'am rtogs pa tsam las 'dzin tshul gzhan gang yang med do/ /rang las nges ḍing / gzhan las nges/ tshad 'bras kyi rnam bzhag sogs ni re zhig bzhag go/ tshad min gyi shes pa ni/ gsar du mi bslu ba ma yin pa'i shes pa de/tshad min gyi shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i bcad shes dang / sgra rtag par 'dzin pa'i blo lta bu/ de la dbye na/bcad shes/ yid dpyod/ snang la ma nges pa'i blo/ the tshom/ log shes dang lnga yod/ de dag gi ngo bo ni gong du bshad zin to//52

rtogs pa'i blo dang ma rtogs pa'i blo bshad pa/rtogs pa'i blo dang ma rtogs pa'i blo gnyis su phyes pa'i rtogs pa'i blo ni/ blo de'i byed pa la brten nas chos de la nges pa 'dren nus pa de/blo des chos de rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ dkar 'dzin mig shes kyis dkar bo rtogs pa dang / sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i blos sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa lta bu/ blo de'i byed pa la brten nas chos de la nges pa 'dren nus pa'i rig pa de/ chos de rtogs pa'i blo'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bum 'dzin shes pa dang / bum 'dzin bcad shes lta bu/ de la dbye na dngos rtogs dang shugs rtogs gnyis/ dang bo dngos rtogs ni/ blo deglu yul de'i rnam pa shar ba'i sgo nas rtogs pa de/ blo des yul de dngos su rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bum 'dzin dbang mngon gyis bum pa rtogs pa dang / sgra mi rtag pa dngos su rtogs pa'i rjes dpag gis sgra mi rtag pa rtogs pa lta bu'o//gnyis pa shugs rtogs ni/ blo de la yul de'i rnam pa ma shar yang /yul gzhan gyi rnam pa shar ba'i sgo narsā yul de la'ang nges pa 'dren pa de/blo des yul de shugs la rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra mi rtag rtogs kyi rjes dpag gis sgra rtag stong rtogs pa de shugs la rtogs pa yin te/ sgra mi rtag rtogs kyi rjes dpag la sgra rtag stong gi rnam pa ma shar 53
