bsdus 'bri bar bya/ /mngar cha'i ka ra ka rkyang la/ /gur gyi kwa ra wa zur can/ /khang ba'i ka ba zhes brjod tshe/ /ka rkyang yin la khang ba'i kwa/ /tsan dan kwa dang shug pa'i kwa/ /lta bu ba yig med pa'i tshe/ /ka la lwa zur 'dogs pa gces/ /de dag dag pa'i skad las shes/ /rgyal skug skug ni sa choskug la/ /kha lkug lkug ni la lkug yin/ /skam pa skam sha sa ska la/ /ya rkan rkang ba ra rka yin/ /kyog kyog lam dang skam kyong dang / /lcags kyu la sogs ya btags ka /bkra shis pa dang ri mo bkra/ /grog grog tsha bo lham tsokrad/ /ra btags can gyi ka yin no/ /khang ba khams dwangs khon 'dzin dadzo /rme —/khur bo khong khro sngon 'jug med/ /khur bo 'khur dang rtswa'akhan pa/ /skabang ra 'khar zangs sngon 'jug la/ mkhas pa mkhal ma mkhar dang ma9༅lta — /mkho ba sogs la mas 'phul thob/ /khra khra khrung khrung lcags khrab da ba/ gaḍā zlo/rtsahākhos tshong khrom ra btags kha/ /rtsis kyi grangs dang 'khyag pa 'i grang3 / tsho yang3 'jug sa mtha' yod med khyad/ /rta glang sga ni sa sga la/ /godawodzo rgasani rachogayin/ /g.yo sgyu'i sgyu ni sa sgyu la/ /rgyu 'bras rgyu ma ra rgyu yin/ca /rnga ma'i chuniraja la/ /grangs kyi lnga ni la lnga yin/ /mgur dbyabarsā mgulaskrunas kholosagrin/ /mgron po mgyogs po mas 'phul can/ mo/skad 'gagarsāgesgyu 'gan 'gor dang 'gyang / /'gyur dang 'gras sogs 'a sa 'ephulaka 7 /mtha molkojon gsal ma sngon 'jug /tshar du dngar la da sngon 'jug( tsho /dzu' yisasku drung da drung la/ /spyang grung 'dzoms 297

pa ga grung yin/ /dge rgan mjal ba ma mjal la/ /bu lon 'jal ba 'a 'jal yin/ /'bru rigs gro ni ga gro la/ /nyi ma dro ni da dro yin/ /gnam gyi zla dang dbyibs zlum po/ /zlos gar la sogs za la btags/ /klad pa klad gor ka la btags/ /glu dbyangs glu ni ga glu la/ /lha klu'i klu ni ka klu yin/ /lha dang lha mo la lha la/ /las ka sla mo sa sla yin/ /lhu lag lhu ni la lhu la/ /slu brid slu ni sa slu yin/ /bla ma'i bla ni ba bla la/ /rkang ba'i brla ni ra brla yin/ /chu klung klong yang sa ka kla la/ /'byung ba'i rlung ni ra rlung yin/ /yi ge klog pa ka klog la/ /nam mkha'i glog ni ga glog yin/ /dgon pa'i dgon ni da dgon la/ /rgan rgon rgon ni ra rgon yin/ /gza' skar gza' ni ga gza' la/ /bza' tshang ba bza' ga gza' gnyis/ /'dam nga yin pa shes par bya/ /mngon sum snang ba sa snang la/ /zas kyis brnang ba ra brnang yin/ /gsal bor bstan pa sa bstan la/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa ra brtan yin/ /nad sogs 'go ba 'a 'go la/ /lus kyi mgo ni ma mgo yin/ /mig gis lta ba la lta la/ /bzhon pa'i rta ni ra rta yin/ /sman pa bsten pa sa bsten la/ /'khar bar brten pa ra brten yin/ /nam zla dbyar ni da dbyar la/ /bdu' lag g.yar ni ga g.yar yin/ /gtub byed gri ni ga gri la/ /dri zhim dri ni da dri yin/ nom pa ster ba sa ster la/ /mi zad gter ni ga gter yin/ /rnam rtog rtog la sa mtha' med/ /go rtogs rtogs la sa mtha' yod/ /'thug pa'i stug ni sa stug la/ /mi 298

gtsang rtug ni ra rtug yin/ /chu sogs ldud pa la rdzud la/ /phyogs gcig sdud pyos sdud yin/ /chu snod sgang li la sgang la/ /mtho ba'i sgang ni sa sgang yin/ /mi 'gyur rtag pa ra rtag la/ /gcan gzan stag ni sa stag yin/ /spyan gyis gzigs dang gcan gzan gzig /sa mtha' yod med khyad par yod/ /khang ba'i sgo ni sa sgo la/ /ri dwags dgo ba da dgo yin/ /gos bgo ba dang bgo bsha' rgyag /gom pa'i bgom dang las ka bgor/ /ba bgo yin pa shes par bya/ /dud 'gro'i rmig pa ra rmig la/ /smig rgyu'i smig ni sa smig yin/ /dmar bo'i mtshal ni ma mtshal la/ /phyag 'tshal 'tshal ni 'a 'tshal yin/ /nang khrol mtsher ba ma mtsher la/ /rta skad 'tsher ni 'a 'tsher yin/ /mtsher sa'i mtsher ni ma mtsher la/ /sems 'tsher 'tsher ni 'a 'tsher yin/ /nyan bya'i sgra ni sa sgra la/ /sdang ba'i dgra ni da dgra yin/ /dpon po bsko ba sa bsko la/ /sa sogs rko ba ra rko yin/ /lkog tu sba ba sa sba la/ /chu yi rba rlabs ra rba yin/ /shing gi gzhong ba na ro can/ /gzhung lugs gzhung ni zhabs kyu can/ /mtshon gdeng ba ni 'greng can dang / /kha gdang ba ni 'greng med yin/ /snying rje'i brtse ni sngon 'jug can/ /rtse mo'i rtse la sngon 'jug med/ /bgo skal skal ldan bas 'phul med/ /dus kyi bskal bar bas 'phul yod/ /lug gi pags pa lug lpags sogs/ /rnam dbye ma bsdus pags rkyang dang / rnam dbye bsdus la la lpags thob/ /yi ge dang ni bod yig la/ /yi la ga mtha' yod med ni/ /299

rṣabaghosning wo da/ṭwāri rtsospre— /zha— nyesnyi —smyu gu zhan sgyug la/ 2/zha la na lorṇa lkorna me'i nikho// /nye khrispyoṣṭhalikos sa/ snyo/ khyad/—jisnyisgyu—༷ / ngag tu'ang de tsā — pojirī : khāe/ /de/ shkan ji gu snyekhi smyug/ cidatshong4 gyu/ bi—/sgo nga bya sgongu mu 4 rdzikho tha4tshesnya'ajugammu ṣkalge/ phrornarki/ ༄ rī /dzig —sdudu byasta dang mi pe byag kṣasna 'irdzi sa( khya sa ྅sasko ṅghatso yustsa 8 hūṃdagedhe ho rnamudu pāsta —snyoti da// rdzi/ rdziṭwāṃ 4ngu nyarṣa pā phywan/ jisnyamā rnyanasahūoṃbasumu gaṭwānadre rgyu maskogya lngadisngo wīsku skyo/ /lta/ di rtedkusu rgyu rjomaista/ lka brarteṭwāṃrga nas/tre6rmerji rnga—/'u glo kun mūkhulha pāzhi ཿdzāsnya /sku/ rū ci/ ga / tshosduri glu ṭwāṃX mica — ri tsho —tsostodze95—〉 ci — dwo tshineco lnge dri ca —ci jichi zhe sna trerngo tsho —ci ḍa ḍa dzo ༵ rṇajokha ḍakyā/ ciṣeji / sdeṅgepru lam̐/ram̐ rmosdortsa sko/ ṭwāoṃrme1ram̐ tsu me surngoo / cho shāsaca‘rme rngocici rwasna ciri jiroṇḍang/ji rṣa/lam̐:nā1 ske sku /hro 3rwacho spe rngopyi tra neerlu dzetsho sto—ri / 4 rtso —3 lke bam̐cha —ོci no 4 hūṃdro ḍa ṇi lhu / kā ru/blo grerme rgya pruotsho rmeci rmokhrorno mergeci sgo tsham naḍā skṛ ṅgerngo wiryā snrarme rlo snobe/ 7// kṣiṃ /dri/rbekhri rdesdirtsobam̐/stotsho'ajirge〉 shkas ṭwāci rnye prermerme5 rmeñdzirge/tstshargermeshāzer bi detsho— ji— spyo rbha glugarwa ཿzle bam̐ḍā rmedzdzan dalhaḍā/ /’ṣṭhanee//— lo ne tstsharnya zer rbe sna cisum̐rdzo lha rdzo tshoskedirkise te/ 2nezudku ྾/dingedzwa tshoredzo bakṣiṃ sum̐dzeshābo dengecarnotsho/'echi du kho autsūdzotshuderbha ṣe ༷ ) st+rarlu byedomyawīngetshwa3ye / rmye rneme/ kāporednghashe sa pa'imbungawo dedzordzo7ci yājigeci dzokhozer/ 'e2lnga྾ 0gi sirūrdzosum̐rme bo sngogho / rwa— dī 4 ḍa ci rkalto snyegadku'agardzammuo dzeekhorartol talhatā rtopelha pyorasaphrorki chazharme— duwordophro tsu 0 'jigatshogasu zhes btaskras ba rīg/ /‘4dwosnu ga྾ga7dku mi.oṃgista so'igazhistokkicisngo yin ltanas༈pi ro rā dhe gad gertso shazhitshisarsā2lnga 000

zos 7 rā.oṃca'aṣkadegawaṃrdzisoladamispyo na sa3maya —ngadangadngha ྾ 'dzi ci— 1byed/ las— 4 'khos cad kyiri rtenakhyedadku'isnes rosdosnenyon monga.oṃcaspo’dertikha/—byuchi'ajigatsholtormelta ba zer/ rsha tshi ga—/bsdu sa3gi/rmyo su'ajigalta zere—/ thu—tsho nyon drug gi nang gi—lta bra ladabye nadhrardze'ad— ca tshored/ chibye 'a/ jig tshog4kha lta rme zhog྾dakha'i shrī mtshan ni/ stodhra rṇasanga.oṃlnga'i rkarpār si du shesaspu jidang / byeri loñtsashes ba rtesoges dgagabo'iho dwortsa de ltar ba0/sku nebuhphathalo'ab gnyis kyisadzhalogalte yorigagoyispyor 'dod pas/ byusngalho the dang stonalobye sa blarteganyismomiphyago ñtsabasngo'adod / cirmosems tsam ga'ilhagaṣpelaltahphodang sog )gnyi rsā thosobar dhradod/tsho — ni 'khor ba'i rtepartsob yirmo me/ rshachi 'ugi rmedzub ma rnyosgro btagesora'i༈kugabatagamesge ga dngalte rsha— thogaho3sa( nebadzo radzode' marsātshosgyes sa'odzwa rsā ba larsā skyecu shiga.āoṃ4 kkojig lta kun btagagatob / hūṃci 'jig lta 3rnartsorṣa gnyi —tsho 2desanyisakyi nang3sa/ tsursādhe lho/nagremanaromyedarmāhātswadu rgyus mā chuko'arṣa b.ronyakhortsehrūgyi rtsakha ni/4 'jig lte rsā rṣasped/ re ri tregazhungasacherdzartegalas / she sa de ri— :rmākhrubaspaza 'a so so'i 'dokṣiṃ tshular5 zhib thogengarmas ṣkayo'abrisami ñtsage/ khadzo tshe — —lhalja 3 4 ske 7snade — 4kṣe dri ba ga rmis ga 4 phyame tso 'dzigaskyo bde rdzingadra zhig mewos ྾nalta lngo| — snye mthas 'dzin gyi ltabapi 3〉 kṣ-i7'jigalhosakhung/ blolngarsā bzhi la hwamigasarna0spud tshi go snyam du dzobazu sau ti —wādzin2gyo lta bgaḍa'ajig301

lta'i dmigs yul gyi bdag de la dmigs nas 'di ni 'dzin pa med pa'i rtag pa'o/ /'di ni 'gyur ba med pa'i ther zug go /zhes bzung bas skye ba phyi mar nying mtshams sbyor ba med pa'i chad par lta ba'i rnam pa can/byed las dbu ma'i lam gyi nges par 'byung ba la bar du gcod pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can de la mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba'am/ tshig sdud byas nas/mthar lta zer/ 'di yang gzhung chen dag la sbyangs te dpyad pa mthil phyin pa byas pa las shes dgos/ mkhas rlom 'ga' zhig ltar tsi gu rtswa gseng du song ba lta bu'i slob gnyer gyis gar yang mi phyin/dri ba gsum pa/ 4kun 'byung dang bo zhes pa ci'i don/’’lan/ spyir kun 'byung zhes pa bden pa bzhi'i ya gyal te sdug bden/ kun 'byung bden pa/ 'gog bden/ lam bden te bzhi la bden pa bzhi zer/dang bo sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ni/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis grub pa'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i phung bo lnga dang / rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i ri ra ba khang khyim sogs dang / kun 'byung ni/ sdug bden 'grub byed kyi rgyu las dang / las bsags byed kyi nyon mongs la zer/ bden pa dang bophaganyis la kun nyon phyogs kyi rgyu 'bras skor zer/ khyod kyis 'dri rgyu de/kun 'byung gnyis kyi dang bo las kyi kun 'byung yin nam snyam/'gog bden ni/ nyon mongs pa mtha' dag gtan du spangs pa'i cha myang 'das de la zer/ nyon mongs spangs pas/ las gsog byed kyi rgyu 302

med pas las mi gsog las ma bsags na 'khor bar skye byed kyi rgyu med pas/ 'khor bar skye mi dgos pas/ nyon mongs spangs pa'i spangs cha 'gog bden de la/ 'khor ba las thar ba'i thar ba'ang zer thar ba thar ba zer ba de red/ lam bden ni 'gog bden thob byed kyi 'phags rgyud kyi lam la zer/ de ni 'phags rgyud kyi lam thabs shes gnyis ka la byed mod/ gtso bo ni bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab la byed/ bden pa phyi ma 'di gnyis la/ rnam byang phyogs kyi rgyu 'bras skor gcig zer/ 'di dag kyang 'khor lo dang bo'i dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung dag las shes dgos so/ / rīdri ba bzhi ba/ yophyogs kyi 'khor lo zer ba ci'i don/7 lan/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /zhes dang / phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs pa'i phrin las kyis/ /zhes sogs gesungs pa ltar/ nam mkha'i ming brjod pa'i tshig gi rgyan yin pas/ nam mkha'i mngon brjod yin no/ / dri ba lnga ba/ yomangon brjod kyi gzhung chen dag na phyogs kyi glang bo brgyad zer ba zhig yod pa de ni glang bo che'i gzugs byas pa'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi ming yin nam glang bo che rigs brgyad kyi ming yin/’’lan/ de ni 'chi med mdzod las/ sa srung bu dang pad ma dkar/ /g.yon 'brel mig sman sa la dga'/ /me tog so can pa kun pa/ /cha mdzes 303

nga 4ayo(kauceyo hodzo sabo che rigs bayo skya ci4 ༄— ༄tre tsho 4 3 tsho dzi —midku rle go/—rī dpeṭha nata/ spre bu ṣka mirgyakhyunahogyiphroozhon pa'iwāng bo che khu zestse te/ tsho rdzo4snyo chu ske/spu rṣabargya byiske ‘gyi bawoshwakṣiṃlo lko oṃrtswab074 rī lkebamirte — ddhazin — ྾sa srustahpha/6 —— /zhes solto g.yosago ciji—— 5/⑫ pā 'chi myicwaskyunekyipothespyob sospyogo.āo ḍa shāoX ayonyalumidze zhayoko ṅka'i7 spo saske/ khu ryāngowi ga.a kkozhe gadrin dzeeg wo cikhoryarwa dku—/py-i sgyu snga dudngha —rtsaba'i/ yi gede 4carhadarsā ṣko rnyed ces skuralo5kṣiṃ ༷ dedku hrū 'a thotshwa.ayosmo ṣka.āodku nas/ de 'phral lan bris pa lags/ da lan brel dbang gis 'godzee spyos tshe tsam/ caḥ/ rdo thecu widri thegaṣpekhorkelasheme tshod kyime/ 4naceskur dku༈ṭāri ci ོ༷ji 4 sngu 5 ji rwa —tswa ཿ— chi ༷ snyi yo rshapyo—phrolnge ri) stagyici 8rme — tshi rngoca rsha na dro7rici —ca rngocistalto— rsha ṭā/3sno lku rwarikṇilku ’tsā/5 — — rṣa bhe/hūṃreṅka— ༷/rwa ltosnosgros spyiyotswotso4 rsātresatrī7 ga ri ༷/ pyi 3 ci dzo dzotshwalaci zu gyu ji py-i rngotsāci ci2 blo ciri stodhe tho/dzra ’ ku ṭā 3 tshoodo ༷ sdu ‘thedku/da ci tram̐ glerngocho/ dāciXzlo 2wa rde ru rwa rwa rā ༷ lha rme— snge dhra dris ko hwablurtadwangaso rang sgra/ — ktori ḍa — tshotre ca kā 7rwa / 3 5cho 6 3 cihwacirngoo lhaltakorda cha rmedrorngo cite rngokto stso kāX —/ lte kro — bye mu z-i /kārwa tso — phro //dzonyada.ayos ju rte/pophrotshogeskerda — tha' cirsā dze'adam layo'ablo/ nanesto—da/mici yimāsha tshugasaskye/ rnagyi༄— pro — /se/te /sdo lag mchog gi rgyan ca'abrardzewānuspyo/ /'a ’ rdzon sardzi 304

྾ rsā blo sgas stosro/waṃn yig wor gsas/— de dzo nichoci yacho/ khong rin— po chosabai skyo rgyusaspomagyi shra dkurmi ñtsaga' zhig rdzu rgyu tshopod sar/sa gis 7na zhi brdomo 7dkusa.ayokhi zhesashra rledzhabargyaskoci drirsā sa'i drisdo lāsko snyi hwakhusarung tsho.oṃ zhesaḥ〉 b.lās : ri 5 tre duchi ca tshodre cwa dzi pa —༵sgyudku ༷ — —’kṣiṃ snyokā : ca rdzi rī — rī dro — —dri ba dar1bo/ zokun ma.a 'aṭam cidabyangasari bzhutshopa'i balkoci 'bum— ri lo3 bo zhig dpacha dwa dzwa.a rgyu.a tshobyurmekhan7tsho rsā du.oṃrsāgasaci sgyu —rkosanu ga khogs༅na ste za thadesarsā namatshonakau’ shes snra lgeya'ipo / /wo snyi mden te /ltashā ci stsosgoñtsa /kṣe/la lgartso rlo tshogasuong 'atso 5kauri —themarsā stse bka' rtsom nyang ྾ / phyira.oṃz-irsā dzo dunarwa pa/tshorpārnawi ma/ 'i bden gnyis mtha'asna daphyod/ ༷'dulakṣ-iwoṃ dwas༅/ gas lorsā/tsāmilophan tree lpomis zin hphu wod hūṃ ga tsho sngond+radzhatha'i ṭidkurtsotsophro/dzodkurkalhas dzig4bcadarti rim/ sna tsogosalhas/misum citshog tshocatshwatodku rme ོ los tha'akhor rīdang lcagasu spyor rkor skemi dogartswagathosayig cal losajo/ 7khroracu'i gis snyedra ga shānakardopho mda' 'gejas khyispond+ra le mi7na thumacho blotihrū cochornayowīstsol1dkusogs ṣkahphu / ‘)gzhan‘ dzidzamazi thosayādzo tsang ༄ du lodalas/ lke dzokṣiṃ phyogayorkun dngasdu/khyadasmothi cudzā giranachu/khamarsā byos slodzha ma wo rsālgorī gyethosastso da dgos/ zhesabla sas yab rumind+ra gsungs oṃkṣebargyud763/sto bhesna khu kyis bka' bzhin kṣiṃsgrubakholte snyadze ltachubaskaskyar0 dkus swo/0/zhe sa gosungaso tsopa dang /(3 riṭha sna — spuswetsho jag kaubugle klo niṭha khyisngamidkudzotshikha ḍoskang skapas ci305

bdun pa'i mtha' dpyod kyi mjug byang las/ kun mkhyen gong ma'i gnang ba'i skabs bdun pa'i dpe mtsho sngon dus 'khrugs skabs gzhan du 'khyar te ma rnyed pas rje nyid kyi rgyal tshab khri rin po che nas skabs bdun pa'i kha bskang bar dam pa rnams kyi gsung rgyun ltar yin pas/ da dung kun mkhyen mchog gi gsung la 'dris pa'i nyams rgyun can dag gis 'bad pas 'tshol bar rigs so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsung rgyun la/ drung yig sangs rgyas zer ba'i phyag tu gsung rtsom rnams yod pa khos khyer nas mtsho sngon du yod skabs dus 'khrugs langs nasi yal ba red zer/ gzhan yang dpar du bkod pa dag las 'ga' zhig ni phyis su rnyed pa dang /'ga' zhig la ma yig gcig las ma rnyed pas dag min dogs pa yod sar yang bcos thabs bral ba bde mchog bskyed rim zin bris nyung bsdus lta bu dang / mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod rtsa 'grel gzhi 'gyur gnang ba'i ma dpe yang stor bas/ thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir dngos slob dbyig paṇḍi ta'i phyag dpe'i khrod kyi mchan can de dpar du bkod pa dang / gsung 'bum ka po ti'i nang gi ka lā ba'i 'grel ba nag po 'gro shes/ zhes pa'i ha cang kha gsal de la'ang mtshams sbyor gsum pa man chad med pa rtsom 'phro zer yang 'phro ma 'khyar bar sems/ snga sor bdag gi slob dpon rin po che om 'khyil ba'i phyag tu tsand+ra ba'i dpe mchan can zhig 'byor/de ni dbus dpar zhig la tshon dmar bos mchan btab yod pa zhig red/306

de'i mtshud byang la 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sgra khrid zhor dkyus gcig la mchan btab pa'o/ /zhes yod/ slob dpon rin po che khong gis kun mkhyen gyi gsung red 'dug gsungs nas/ de'i skabs kyi tshogs chen khri rin po che/ a lags rgya zhabs drung tshang la phul/ bcos bsgyur skabs dpe mang bo dus 'khor 'du khang nang du bsdu ba'i skabs/ zhabs drung rin po che'i phyag dpe bsdus yod na/ da dung yod rgyu red snyam/dri ba gnyis pa/ slo.a mdo'i yul gyi sog po wang rgyal bo de sog po jun gar rgyal bo'i gdung rgyud yin nam min/’’ zhes dris pa'i lan/ mtsho sngon phyogs kyi sog dpon wang rnams o rod jun gar gyi gu shri han bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud red/ o rod kyi dpon rnams ni ge sar dmag gi rgyal bo'i gdung rgyud yin par bshad pa las/ hor jun gar rgyal bo'i rgyud pa yin pa gsal bo khungs ldan ma mthong /dri ba gsum pa/ dzid lta'i bla brang dgon pa chags yod pa'i sa 'di'i bdag po gna' snga mor sog po wang rgyal bo yin zer ba de bden nam mi bden/’’zhes pa'i lan/ gu shri han bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi sras tshe ring el du chi'i sras mkha' 'gro dang / dar rgyal bo shog thu gnyis/ dpon dar rgyal ni mtsho sngon g.yas ru'i dpon du gyur te/ co ne yan chad kyi rong phyogs thams cad dang reb gong stod smad/ rnga ba rwa mdo/ zung chu'i sa tshun chad la dbang bsgyur/ de'i sras 'bring ba wang rgyal bo ju nang red/— 307

dzo nang yornesgyu zerme/ (rda khor gi rmetshadzospo'aso rdzozhas ba—rjod na/ rngo——ta 'ilha'ilha shulo tshi tshe da྾ṣpedzee rā3nirnyo nangangelijo nang zeraṣitsho sra 'disalhasngar gyi sogapo'icizu sde rna.oṃ so datsā / 6retsā gongadzwastodachi smad/ rorje tshonisten nghrubaco ༄gyo da/dzhardzob/4 —2rsha oṃrgatsha sbra po'isbyogasoṣi mgo lo gzhi2tshamo oṃng sogasi le dbangashabalharartsostomado smadajikyidze stsolopi cikārmo 3tshwa ltatsorgyuracaportsatharto.oṃmijo sa cha rme ṇa 'di'i sa yinatshuganasto — tsho chiritsho khe ḍa 4 rkune mkhyen gle mahonajam —dbyengs bezhado pajigad gidrildasaṃ te/— si bo krelhasaci 'khyi lalhapa tab pa sogachuso myag los rgya tshe/ 4 nedi rme dzitsugamo gesumapozhe 'kho/ du dzurna gsaphaspo 'e rnatsasatsojisgrolho mo'i rsās —dordze'adzub dbandelhalo stsanda ma byu'argyande tharotram̐geshegs/du zlo me gonerhatetshi chibagi rtsabostone 'dzinastodestse phyug tsedordodu0blongarsā—/ ji stormestse tshungarī tho rdo rje pha larma la yadza chingasang gi thob rgyurje ṣi chosno rngo mi lo sras paracaja sag dbang phyug rab poston shusashepaṃgodaciXngo 9da ra miglodzustophreng— gi gorme sajo badzod— —lhardo/ statsho ri/ci 'di7 dzingasgoldoyangaphanga'akhobakṣiṃtshogaso drug rarde grol gyi glogode yine 'a gre/ rdo— ci77ོṅge na rmokyalnga5nga rgyal bo— rdzu natha ci'idaso rjes oṃtsho 0 dponaltegonirmaso3ngorme 'amem rma'i 3rnga 'asledzomardowo rmergyab3rkyen — —mnga' thadza ba nyemeso titt+waṃ —dzā — mngane 'bongasaca dgo kyaldaci gcig shor ga nyiso —shor༈ — re jig dbang— waṃdzu gi rire la gezharna dgi rgan drozar nejizad/ga range— ṣkasog rnu jikho ne'i rdud khyim khriX gisum yaram̐ rmarle yod dze'ango dzathor che nagoci āoṃngarong khamasaXphyogesasdeng rmago log sogigauḍasu sog ru— mastazer po de 308

dag 'di'i ru sde de dus 'thor ba rnams red zer/ rjes sor sog khyim stong gnyis gsum tsam la dbang ba e cag gis shes gsal ltar red/ de na ru sde mang bo zhig gis kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo la mgon skyabs zhus te lha sde shog kha brgyad sogs byung ba red/dri ba bzhi ba/ phabaswe ngag dbang bkra shis dang dbus kyi smin gling bar la byad gtong res byas myong zer ba de/ gsar rnying gi lta ma ba mthun pa'i cha nas yin nam/ chab srid kyi rtsod gleng yin/’’ zhes dris pa'i lan/ bshad rgyun la/ bswe ngag dbang bkra shis kyis gtor ma brdab pas smin gling gi 'du khang brtib pa dang / bswe ngag dbang bkra shis kyi sprul sku bkra shis 'khyil nas nang zhig byung ste/ gter lung du phebs nas bzhugs dgos byung ba smin gling gi mthu byad du babs pa red ces zer srol yod pa las/ rnam thar lo rgyus sogs na zhib cha ma mthong 'on kyang yab sras kyi rnam thar gyi bab la dpag na/ 'di ltar yin nam snyam pa shar te/ smre dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho ba rig gnas la sbyangs brtson che'ang / rnying phyogs la zhen che drags pas/ 'then 'khyer che ba dang /kun gzigs lnga ba chen pos/ po ta lar chang nag la spyod mi chog pa'i bka' yod mod/ sde srid khong gis po ta lar chang nag la bag med du spyod pa sogs dang / khong gis gdan sadza bkod pa'i tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos kyang / glu gar rol mo chang nag sogs la 'jol nyog tu spyod pa 309

sogs sna tshogs pa zhig gi rkyen las/ phyi gtsang nang gtsang bka' gdams gsar rnying gi bstan 'gror spyir sman pa'i srol rgyun bzang bo la cung zad gnod pa byung gshis/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sgo mang gi khrir bzhugs skabs tshogs gtam mang bo'i skabs su zur za gnang ste/ khyed tsho bsam bzhin du rje bla ma'i bstan pa la gnod pa byed du byung ba yin 'dra'ang / ngas lus 'di der nas khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i rgyal bo re'i skye ba blangs te khyed tsho 'dul dgos na'ang dka' las med ces dang / yang na lus 'di ma dor bar khyed tsho 'dul dgos na'angacho dka' las med ces sogs tshogs gtam btsan bajid can btang ba/ rnying phyogadzis kyi thugs zung spyan zur la cung zad re phog ste/ smin gling sogs kyi las sbyor re mdzad yod pa phan tshun gyi rnam thar gyi dkyus bab la brtags na shes/ de'imastabs kyis kun mkhyen thugs sras bswe ngag dbang bkra shis kyis kyang gshin rje'i las sbyor re mdzad par nges/ bla brang dge bshes dag gis/ phyi'i rnam pa de ltar yin mod/ nang don rtogs pa 'gran pa red/ ces gsung srol 'dug tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho dang / sde srid kyi mdzad spyod rtsing bo dang / mthar khong gnyis thugs nang ma mthun pa dang / smin gling gter ston rin po che thugs rgyal bzhengs nas thugs 'phar 'phar gnang ba dang / zhu yig tsha bo rkyang ba 'bul gnang mdzad stabs/ sde srid rang yang gter chen la thugs dad chung du 310

song ba sogs/ che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyi rnam thar du yod 'dugadri ba lnga ba/ phakun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang shar skal ldan rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyi sku ring tsam la a mdo'i yul la sgra snyan ngag sogs rig gnas rnams dar ba yin zhes bshad na 'grig gam mi 'grig’’ces dris pa'i lan/ de rnam gnyis kyi sngon nas kyang rig gnas yod de/rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dus nas kyang mdo smad 'dir phyi nang gi rig gnas dar bar mngon te/ shar skal ldan rgya mtshos/ sprul sku bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dus/ /gzims khang gong gi sprul ba'i sku/ /bsod nams ye shes dbang bo dang / /stong skor yon tan rgya mtsho dang / /mdung rtse kun dga' dpal bzang sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems du ma yis/ /mdo smad phyogs 'di yongs su gang / /zhes gsungs so/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil btab ste mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad kyi gzhi btsugs/ grub dbang skal ldan rgya mtshos rong bo bkra shis 'khyil dang dgon chen bdag gir bzhes te 'chad nyan dar bar byas pas/ de rnam gnyis kyi dus nas rig gnas ches cher dar ba'i 'go tshugs zhes bshad na los lhag 'on kyang ches cher khyab spel byed pa bo ni/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo yin te/ khong gis rong bo me rgan chos rje las snyan ngag gsan mod/4 kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i dngos slob dbyigaṭwāṃ spya paṇḍi ta las/ rgyal dbung lnga ba dang kun mkhyen 311

'jam dbyangs bzhad pa nas brgyud pa'i sgra dang sdeb sbyor sogs rig gnas rnams gsan/ pra ti rin chenatshodon grub kyi dngos slob/ pra ti dge bshes blo bzang dge legs las/ pra ti rin chen don grub nas brgyud pa'i rig gnas rnams gsan/ si tu paṇa chen gdan drangs yang khong sku na smin pa'i stabs kyis phebs ma thub par khong gi dngos slob karma gtsug lag kun dga' sangs rgyas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs te/si tu paṇa chen nas brgyud pa'i rig gnas rnams gsan/ bod mkhas snyan 'grel steng nas snyan ngag bskyar khrid gnang / dper brjod sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs kyi khrid rgyun sngar nas bla brang du yod mod/phyis su brag dgon bstan pa rab rgyas kyis 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse'i dbang bo las kyang bshad rgyun blangs zhes paṇa chen shī la'i mtshan can gyis gsungs/ si tu'i sum rtags dang / pra ti'i sum rtags gnyis ka'i khrid rgyun dang lung rgyun spel te/ pra ti'i sum ྅gas shin tu thugs la bab ste dpar la bkod/ dpar shing smon tshig kyang khong gis gsungs te bsngagase brjod bla na med pa gnang / pra ti'i rtags 'jug la'ang bshad tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis yod pa dpar la bkod/ dge bshes rnams kyis lo brgya phrag kha shas la dpyad pa btang ba'i grub don/ man ngag zhal shes mang bo yod/ ngas blo gsal 'jug ngogasasu re gnyis re phud yod/gzhung gang yin kyang bshad rgyun rnam par dag pa chad lhag med par 312

bshad dgos pa las/ phun tshogs phun tshogs red/ dge legs dge legs red ces bshad pas bshad go mi chod pa gsungs rgyun red/ bod mkhas snyan 'grel dper brjod dang bcas pa dpar la bkod nas khrid rgyun spel/ khrid rgyun rnams dge bshes so so'i rang rang gi dpe cha'i shog mthar bris nas yod/ bdag gis kyang shog mthar bris nas yod mod/dpe thams cad brlag gtor byung / zhwa dmar rin po che'i zin bris dngakargyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i zin bris nang bshad rgyun 'ga' re phud 'dugakhong rnam gnyis kyi de bla brang gi khrid rgyun red/ da de ltar kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i 'phrin las la brten nas/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ni mdo smad dang sog yul sogs yul gru du ma zhig gi rig gnas kyi 'byung khungs yin pa bstan dar lha rams pa'i snyan ngag dper brjod mdzad byang las kyang shes/ byang phyogs rnyi tsha dang sku 'bum sogs/ lho phyogs mdzod dge rnga ba sogs kyirtsophyi nang gi rig gnas thams cad kyi 'byung khungs chu 'go lta bu ni bla brang bkra shis 'khyil yin la/ rang gis longs spyod pa'i chu'i 'go la kha zer sna zer mang ne/ ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu bzhin du/ 'phyug 'gro rgyu zhig yod tshod red/ dri ba drug pa/ yosog po jun garatse dbang rab brtan/ mtsho sngon dus 'khrugs skabs kyi mgo dpon gyi rgyal sa da lta'i mtsho sngon po'i dbus gzhung tsha kha zer ba'i sa 'di yin zer srol yod pa de bden mi bden/7313

zhes dris pa'i lan/ jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan ni/ mtsho sngon dus 'khrugs kyi mgo dpon ma red/ mtshostson dus 'khrugs skabs kyi bod sog gi mgo dpon ni o rod gu shrir wang gi sras rgyud chang wang blo bzang bstan 'dzin zer ba de red/ jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan yang o rod kyi dpon zhig yin la/ o rod tsho drug gi(tsho bzhi yang zer)dpon rnams ni sngon gyi ge sar dmag gi rgyal bo zer ba de'i rgyud pa yin/ gu shri han bstan 'dzin chos rgyal yang de'i rgyud pa yin/ zhes gtsang rgyal lo rgyus na — yod/ ge sar dmag gi rgyal bo dang / ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gnyis mi 'dra tshul/ nged kyis bris te/ rtsom sgyur cus kyis sbrang char la sprad yod zer/ sbrang char thog bkod pa der ltos/ jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan— nam o rod tshe dbang rab brtan ni o rod rdo rje skyabs kyi bu red/ o rod rdo rje skyabs rgyal bos hal ha'i thu shi ye thu dang gnyen byas kyung phyis su nang ma mthun par hal ha thu shi ye thu rgyal bos/ o rod rdo rje skyabs bsad/ rdo rje skyabs kyi phu bo dga' ldan bstan 'dzin zer ba rab tu byung nas 'bras spungs su slob gnyer byas te rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags thob nas grwa sar bsdad yod skabs/ lo rod kyi bang chen pa zhig tsesker te yul gyi gnas tshul rnams bshad nas rang yu la gyi kha 'dzin la 'gro rgyu byas te/ rgyal dbang lnga ba dang / paṇa chen blo bzangangachos rgyan la sdom pa phul nas rang yul du song rgyal bo byas/ 'di la po shog thu rgyal bo zer/ rdo rje 314

skyabs la bu gnyis yod pa/ bsod nams rab brtan dang / tshe dbang rab brtan gnyis/ jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan zer ba phyi ma 'di red/po shog thu dang tsha bu gnyis nang ma 'cham par/ po shog thus bsod nams rab brtan bsad/ tshe dbang rab brtan yang gsod par brtsams pa'i tshe bros nas ma rnyed/ de nas gcung rdo rje skyabs kyi dgra sha len phyir/hal ha'i phyogs su g.yul 'gyed par brtsams pa'i tshe/ khri chen blo gros rgya mtshos bar chings pa mngags nas 'dum par mdzad pas/ re zhig tsam la bde bar gnas/ de rjes/ hal ha rje btsun dam pa rin po ches dag 'a ldan khri ba la phyag ma 'tshal zhes bsnyad btsal te/ hal ha'i yul du glo bur du dmag drangs pas hal ha rnams bros nas/ mtsho bdun gyi bar du song / man chin gong ma bde skyid rgyal bo la mgo btags te/ chin gong ma'i 'bangs su gyur/ de nas chin gong maso dmag btang ste/ u lan pa thur zhes pa'i sa char/ o rod po shog thu dmag bcas yod pa'i mtha' bskor/ po shog thu rgyal bo sogs nying shas bros byol thub/ shul du lus pa rnams ni/ da lta cha har tsho ba brgyad kyi nang du o rod kyi rigs yod pa 'di rnams yin zer/ po shog thu hal ha dang 'thab nas tshur yong ba'i shul du/ kho'i tsha bo sngar bros pa'i tshe dbang rab brtan de log yong nas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa stag lor o rod jun gar gyi rgyal bor gyur/po shog thu rang yul cu ma song zhing lam du 'dasadhe sam zer/ bod kyi lha 315

bzang gi sras che ba dga' ldan bstan 'dzin jun gar du mag par btang ste gnyen sgrig khul byas kyang / ma 'cham par/ lha bzang gi lo bcu gsum pa rab byung nyi ma'i bya lor/ o rod kyi rgyal bo dga' ldan tshe ring gis/ tha'i ji tshe ring don grub dang / thob chi sogs ja'i sang lnga/ dmag stong gsum bcas bod du btang nas/ lha bzang bkrongs/ tshe dbang rab brtan 'das rjes/ dga' ldan tshe ring gis rgyal srid bzung /chin gyi 'bangs su gyur pa'i hal ha dang / chin dmag rme g.yul mang bo bkyes tshod red/ dga' ldan tshe dbang 'das rjes/ de'i sras a gyang tshe dbang gis rgyal bo byas/ 'di grong nyul chang nag la dga' zhing spyod pa ha cang ngan pas blon po rnams kyis bsad de/ lha mo er ti ni dar rgyas zer bas rgyal sa bzung / lcags lug lor tā ba che ba dang a mor sa nā zerarī ba gnyis kyis lha mo er ti ni dar rgyas bsad nas/ tā ba che ba rgyal sar bsdad/ de rjes o rod nas sa ral ja'i sang zer ba'i dpon zhig glo bur du song nas chin gong ma gnam skyong rgyal bo la mgo btags/ de nas yang sa nā zer ba de song nas chin gong ma la mgo btags te/ shing khyi lor dmag mang bo khrid nas sosdi ste shing phag lor o rod kyi rgyal bo tā ba che bzung nas chin gong ma kṣ-ir gtad/ de nas bzung ste o rod jun gar rnams chin gong ma gnam skyong rgyal bo'i mnga' 'bangs su gyur te/ tā ba che bas gong ma la rgol ba chen po byas pa mthar bde 'angags btang ba'i 316

dga' ston du lha khang 'di bzhengs pa yin zhes zhe ho'i(deng sangammu.oṃ.oṃ zer)bsam yas kyi rdo ring gi thog tu gnam skyong rgyal bos(chan lung ) bris 'dug 'di dag gi lo rgyus cha har dge bshes kyi gsung 'bum nang 'dug chin wang blo bzang bltan 'dzin ni/ gu shri han gyi bu bkra shis pa thur('di g.yog mo zhig gi bu red zer)mtsho sngon spyi'i dpon byas/ de 'das rjes/ de'i bu blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'di mtsho sngon spyi'i dpon byas pa red/ chu yos lo'i mtsho sngon dus 'khrugs rtsa ba nas bshad na/rgyal dbang lnga ba dag zhing dgongs nas/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos lo bco lnga'i ring la gsang rgya byas/ rgya sog gi 'grulachen rigs la dmigs bsal kyi 'jal kha gtong dgosatshe/ rtsornam rgyal grwa tshang gi grwa badzisde ba bkras rab pa7zer ba rgyal dbang dang dgung na mnyam pa/ ri zhal khyim sogs rgyal dbang dang 'dra ba zhig yod pa rgyal dbang rdzun ma bzos na sa mjal kha btang / gsang rgya grol nas mtsho snatshonas rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho gdan sar bkod kyang khong gis spyod pa rtsing bo gnang ste/ dgong lo nyi shu'i thog paṇa chen rin po cheldogs kyis bsnyen rdzogaso kyi sdom pa bzhes par bskul kyang / ma nyan par ma zagadage tshul kyi sdom ba yang phul/ sku 'khor gyi bla sprul kha shas kyis kyang sdom pa phul/ bla ma'i bka' bcag pa mthol lo bshags gsungs nas phebs/ de nas skya chas mnabs nas po ta lar bzhugs rkyang / lha rgadapo / nye ba'i rdzong rgyab/ 'ol 317

dga'/ 'phyong rgyas/ gong dkar sogs su phebs nas rtse 'jor rol ba dang / mtshan mor lha sa dang zhol gyi grong nang gi bud med dag gi khyim du zhugs te chung 'dris bu mo mang bo btsal ba sogs kyi mdzad pa/ bod sog gi mi rnams dang / se 'bras sogs grwa sa rnams su'ang mdzad pa la zhen log gi gtam gleng mang bar gyur pa dang / sprul sku thag gcod kyang / sde srid kyis lha blar gsang lung phul ba dang / chos rje zil gnon rdo rjes dngos 'dzin yid ches gsal bo rnyed gsung ba tsam las/ gzhan paṇa chen rin po ches kyang ma gsan par thag bcad pa sogs dang / sde srid kyis tshangs dbyangs rgya mcho'i gam bcar rtse rogs mthar rgyas gsod rgyu byas pa sogs kyi rkyen las/ rgyal dbang dang sde srid thugs nang mi mthun par gyur7pa sogs rkyen sna tshogs shig gi mdzad maphrin snang tshod mar — 'grib byung ste/ lha bzang gi dmag 'ongs nas sde srid bkrongs/ de'i phyi lo tshangs dbyangs pa rgya yul du gdan drangs pha mtsho sngon kun dga' nor zhes pa'i sa char sku 'das/— sku gdung zhugs la phul nas/ gsol dpon grags pa rgya mtsho dang blo gros dbang phyug mchod dpon ngag dbang dpal 'bar/ em rje sangs rgyas srid sgrub/ sog po nyi ma sogs zhabs gras rnams kyis gdung thal dang sku'i yo byad rnams khyer nas lha sar 'byor ba sogs rnam thar lo rgyus mang bor 'dug yang no mi han lhun grub dar rgyas sam/ ming gzhan lha btsun ngag dbang rdo rjes('di a 318

lags sha wang gi sras red)mdzad pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar lha'i tasbu ra'i rgyud kyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba las/ sog po shi ma thag pa zhig gi ro nyos te/ de bsregs nas rus thal khyer ba red sogs bris 'dug de la tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i gsang ba'i rnam thar zer/ de'i nang du dgung lo nyer bzhidzin gyi mdzad pa rnam thar gzhan dag gi nang du yod pa mang bo zhig med 'dug la/ de'i nang du yod pa'ang kha shas gzhan dag tu med la/ mi mthun pa'ang kha shas yod snang / de'i rjes su lha bzang gis/ pad dkar 'dzin pa ngag dbang ye shes gdan sar bkod/ 'di ba rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me stag la rje tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i dgung lo bzhi ba'i skabs su/ bar khams tsha rong khab dkar bo'i nye 'gram du 'khrungs/ sku na phra dus lcags po rir bzhugs/ dgung lo bcu bzhi ba sa yos la 'bras spungs su phebs nas slob gnyer gnang / lo nyer gnyis pa me phag la lha bzang gis rgyal ba'i sprul skur byas na po te la'i khrir bzhugs su gsol/ dgung lo so gnyis pa me bya lor/ o rod kyi thi ji 〉ring don grub sogs dmag mang bo 'ongs nas lha bzang bsad/ pad dkar 'dzin pa khri las phab/ sde srid stag rtse ba rgyal bor bskos/ li thang du bskal bzang rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa/li thang chos skyong sku rten gyis tshangs dargyangs pa sku gshegs kyi sprul sku yin zer ba ltar/ sog po'i dponamipo rnams kyis sku 'bum du gdan drangs/319

chin gong mas tshangs dbyangs pa dang pad dkar 'dzin pa gnyis ka kun gzigs lnga ba'i sprul sku gin khas ma blangs par/ bskal bzang rgya mtsho mchog la rgyal dbang drug pa yin pa'i gser gyi glegs bu dang gser yig gser tham bcas gnang ste/ rigs sras bcuri bdun pa hūṃng jun wang dang rgya sog bod gsum dpung chen po dang bcas/ jun gar gyis bzung ba'i lo bzhi ba lcags byi lor rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho sku 'bum nas gdan drangs te khrir bkod/ sde srid stag rtse ba bsad/ stod sgar dpon khāng chen nas bsod nams rgyal bor da'i ching ba thur gyi cho lo byin/de'i blon la pe seng nga phod pa/ lum pa ba/ sbyar ra ba/ pho lha ba bcas bzhag nas srid gzhung gsar ba btsugs/ de'i dus su/ ston chen skabs rgya dang bod kyi dpon rigs rnams mdun gral du bzhag sog po'i dpon rigs rnams rgyab gral du bzhag parlo dang / sde srid stag rtse ba'i srog slong don smrin ma byung ba dang / sngar rgyun bzhin gu shri khāng gi sras rgyud rgyal bor ma bzhag pa sogs blor ma bab par/ sog dpon rnams kyis gser gdung chen mo'i mdun nas rgya la ngo log byed rgyu'i mna' bor/phyir log nas bstan 'dzin wang gis 'go bsdus nas rgya la ngo log rgya chen po byas/ rgya dmag chu rdol ba bzhin byung bas bstan 'dzin wang jun gar du bros/ dgon sde 'ga'i bla grwa 'ga' zhig 'dug ma mkhas pa sogs la brten nas/ rma chu'i byang rgyud kyi dgon sde phal cher gtong sreg btang /3lha0

rma chu'i lho rgyud bla brang bkra shis 'khyil sogs/ gnod byed khyi mang gis gtses tshe/ /kha rog tsog 'dug la skyon med/ /gsungs pa ltar skyon ma byung bar gda'/ rgyal dbang paṇa chen gnyis dang / pesna cin du yodaci pa'i thu'u bkwan chos rgya mtsho dang / lcang skya'i sprul sku rin po che gnyis kyis kyang ngo chen yang yang zhus pa dang / pe cin du rdo char bab pas rnam rtog byas song yang zer/ gang ltar chu yos lo nas dgu'i mtshams su grwa ba rnams ri khrod sogs su 'tshogs bcug me 'brug lor gong ma'i mdzod nas dngul gnang ste/ dgon sde rnams nyams gso byas/ lha sde med par btang nas dgon khag la chin srid gzhung gis phogs ster rgyu byas so//de'i sngon rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa stag nas bzung ste rim gyis gu shri jun gar gyi ru sde rnams mtsho khar 'byor te/ thog mar mtsho sngon thod le zhes par gzhi bzung / zhes gsungs pa da lta'i tshwa kha de yin min ma shes/rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho gdan sar bkod nas/ pad dkar 'dzin pa ngag dbang ye shes/ chin gong mas zhe ho(sa7)zhes pa'i sa der spyan drangs pa'i lo/ khong dgung lo so bzhi ba yin 'dra zhes bris yod/der lha khang ljang khu zer ba bzhengs te/ sog yul nas grwa ba nyis stong lhag bsdus te mtshan nyid btsugs/ khong la mkhan po ho thog thu ngag dbang ye shes zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ sog po rnams kyis khong la zhe ho tā la'i bla ma zer/ rgyal dbang dang paṇa chen/ lcang skya/ thu'u bkwan rnams 321

kyi rnam thar du gong ma zhe hor bzhugs zhes yod pa sa cha 'di red/ rgya skad la chu tshan(〉ma)zer/ deng sang khrin te(mmu.oṃ)zer/ lha khang ljang khu la deng sang tā hphu si zer/ nang du shing gis bzhengs pa'i thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong sum thog gang ba'i chen po zhig yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis tā hphu si(oṃ oṃrsha)zer/ ma gzhi bsam yas la dpe blangs nas bzhengs pa'i lha khang zhig red/ rī de'i nang rdo ring chen po'i thog gong ma gnam skyong rgyal bos brtsams pa'i yi ge yod/ lha khang 'di jun gar thul ba'i dga' ston du bzhengs pa yin zhes bris 'dug lha khang dkar chag rgya yig gi thog tu/ gyim shing kong jo'i sras khri srong sde btsan gyis bzhengs pa'i bsam yas la dpe blangs nas bzhengs pa yin zhes bris 'dugagazhan yang de gar bkra shis lhun po/ po ta la bde mchog po brang sogs lha khang mang bo yod/ gzhes ning lor bdag de gar song nas bdun gcig la bsdad de mjal skor zhib mo rgyas/ pad dkar 'dzin pa ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho ni/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i thugs rtags bcad pa red zer srol yod/ gang ltar khong ni mdzad spyod legs shing tshul khrims kyi dri ngad phyogs bcur 'thul ba zhig yin zer te/ cha har dge bshes kyi gsung las kyang rje de nyid rgyun gyi thugs dam nyams bzhes sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba gang zag khyad par can zhig’yin zhing / tshul khrims kyi dri ngad rgyang ring bor bro ba/ zhes sogs gsungs/ khodzwadagung 322

lo zhe gcig thog la dgongs pa rdzogs pa 'dra ste/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgyu mtsho dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa me rta lo'i rnam thar du/ mkhar po ho thog thu ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho sku gshegs pa'i bsngo zhus byung ba la dgongs rdzogs kyi dge ba rnams byung chub tu bsngo bar mdzad/ ces gsungs so/ khongs dbyangs dang sde srid kyi skor sogs ni/ paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang ye shes kyi rnam thar dang / smin gling gter chen rin po che'i dngos slob che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyi rnam thar khungs dag las bris shing / pad dkar 'dzin pa ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho'i lo rgyus sogs su bdag na gzhon dus bdag gi bla ma rin po che thal dge bshes blo bzang chos ldan dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga las zhib par thos la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyin gzhan dag gi ngag las kyang thos/ dus phyis cha har dge bshes kyi gsung bde legs 'byung gnas zhes bya ba las sngar thos ji lta ba bzhin mthong bas yid ches pa'i khungs su 'khums lags so// dri ba bdun pa/ 4gna' snga mor bon lde'u sgrung gsum gyis chab srid bskyangs so zhes pa'i bon zhes pa da lta'i bon gyi grub mtha' dang / lde'u zhes pa skabs de'i srid pa rgan po rnams kyis chab srid skyong byed kyi gtam gyi sbyor ba dang sgrung zhes pa chab srid skyong byed kyi gtam sogs yin zhes 'grel na 'grig gam mi 'grig’ — ces dris pa'i lan/ de yang thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi mas/ bod yul mun par dam chos nyi ma'i 'od/ /'char ba'i 323

lam yangs 'cha' bar gshen lugs kyi/ /skya rengs pho nya sngon du 'ongs pa la/ /bon zhes grags pa'i grub mtha'i byung ba gleng / /zhes gsungs pa dang / deb ther mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ ma 'ongs sngag sa dang 'dul ba 'byung ba'i ltas/ /gnam bon gsheno po che dang bon gzhung byung— / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/sna'ardul ba 'byung ba'i snga ltas su/ bon dar bar gsungs te/ de dus kyi bon zhes pa3/— 'bras bu'i bon bde 'gro mtho ris kyidzim ston pa dang / pa rgyu'i bon mi nor rgyas byed phywa g.yang 'gugs pa/ bar chad sel byed mdos gto/ legs nyes ston byed mo rtsis byed pa la bon zer 'ing/ rgyal bos de dag byed mkhan zhig a mchod du bsten nas rgyal sridadon du/ g.yang 'gugs mdos gto/ mo rtsis byed pa tsam la chab srid bon gyis bskyangs zhes tha snyad ba—tags so//de lta bu'i bon dag ni da lta'i dge tshulami slong gi bon dgon dag dang mi 'dra/ de'i dus kyi bon brgyud 'ga'o ṣka/ da lta si khron zhing chen gyi rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi bod dang rgya'i sa 'itshams su chang rigs zhes pa'i mi rigs shig yod pa de'i nang du yod la/ de dag la yi ge med kyang / phas bu la ngag thog nas slob par byed/ g.yang 'gugs/ mdos gto/ mo rtsis sogs byed par ma zad/ da dung mdung dang / cog tse sogs la lha phab rgyu/ lcags sreg55 lces ldag ste sngags 'debs pa sogs 'phrul sna tshogs shig ston rgyu yod la/ lta ba grub mtha' las 'bras sogs bshad rgyu 324

med zer/ khri srong gi dus su rgyang 'phud btang ba dag gi shul rgyun yin nam snyam / mdo sde 'byung ba'i snga ltas su sgrung da ra bar bshadasade/ sgrung sna tshogs pa bshad nas mi rnams kyi blo sgo phyes te/ lhardzosgrung sogs kyi sgo nas rgyal srid la blo dkar zhing yid ches par byed pa la chab srid sgrung gis bskyangs zhes tha snyad btagos te/ lho brag chos 'byung las/ mardo sde 'byung ba'i ltas su sgrung rnams dar/ /ro langs gser sgrub kyi sgrung dang cu/ma sangs sgrung dang / mchil ba'i sgrung sogs nyan bshad dang / zhes gsungs so// mngon pa'i sde snod 'byung ba'i snga ltas su lde'u dar bar bshad de/lde'u ste deng dus khed zer ba sna sdogs pa bsgrigs nas bshad de mi rnams kyi blo sgo 'byed pa ste/ rgyal srid dang mi rigazlo kyi don du mi rig pa can gso skyong byed pa lachab srid lde'us bskyangs zhes tha snyad btags/ lho brag chos 'byung las/ mngon pa'i sde snod 'byung ltas sde'u spyod/ /srang la them gnyer wa ba che ci yin/ /ser bo mgo che skyed cing rgyags ci yin/ /zhes 'dri ba sogs te/ bon sgrung lde'u gsum gyi tshul lha sa'i gdung rnames la bris yodadze skad/ de yis bod rnames blo kha cung zad phyes/ zhes gsungs go /bka' chems ka khol ma las/ lung gi chos go bar bya ba'i phyir sgrung bstan/ rig pa'i chos trego bar byaṅge'i phyir lde'u pastan/ bslab pa gsum 325

la 'jug pa go bar bya ba'i phyir g.yung drung gi bon bstan/ zhes dang /de la sgrung ni rgyal bo grags pa mtha' yas yang zer/ rgyal bo spyi bo skyes kyi gtam rgyud la sogs pa dang / bya'i sgrung dang / spre'u'i sgru5 dang / de la sogs pa'i gtam rgyud mang du gsungs te/ ra sa'i glo 'bur gong ma na gzugs brnyan du bkod nas yod do/ /lde'u yang / steng na dbu nyi ma/ 'og na chu char ci yin bya bas sna drangs pa/ ('di ni sprin la zer ba e yin snyam) them snyer wa ba che ci yin/ ('di srang la zer bar gsungs)dmar bo spu med bcug cing phyuja / ser bo mgo che bskyed cing rgyags ci yin/ (snga ma lce dang phyi ma so e yin snyam)bya ba la sogs pa nub byang mtshams kyi bang ba na gzugs brnyan du bkod nas yod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /snyan ngag gi gab tshig rgyan dang / khed(lde'u)gnyis mi 'dra tshul nged kyis bris ga'i drang srong tshangs thig zer ba zhig yod snyam/'khyar bon ni/ spu de gung rgyal dang / ru las skyes rgyal blon gnyis kyi dus su byung ba dang / rdol bon ni de'i sngon du byung bar gsungs pa dang / de gnyis ka deng dus kyi bon dang lta grub gang cha nas mi 'dra bar bshad do// dri ba brgyad pa/ tsong kha'i rgyal bo'i lo rgyus sogs mthong ma myong lags/ zhes dris lan li dwangs rang sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangasu can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas sbyar ba'o//326

dris lan gter gyi kha byang /༄༅// stobs bcu'i daXl mnga' kuwa gyi daXl gyi mchog /gcig tu 'a5sa pa rgyal kun 'astsos zhal mchog /rnam kun marten pa'i ye shes mashen rab lha/ /gang gi ma5 yis ye shes ma5 grub mdzod// 'dir〈 tshad ma'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos chen po rnam 'grel gyi don gcig tu dril ba blo rab 'bring tha ma gsum du ston pa legs bshad chen po mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan skal bzang re ba kun skong 〉zhes bya ba/ yongs grags la bswe bsdus grwa zhes grags pa de nyid krung dbyang mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis lcags par du skrun skabs rtsom sgrig 'gasto'akhur ba dag gis tshad ma rig pa'i dmigs bsal gyi brjod tshul dang / tha snyad gal che ba'i rigs la mchan 'grel lam/ zur 'grel gang 'os shig dgos zhes bskul ba dang / yang sde tshan dang / go rim sogs gzhung dngos gzhir bzung nas gang zhib dang / gang rgyas shig thugs rjes mi 'dor bar zhu zhes dri ba'i kha byang bcas nan tan chen pos bskul ba'i ngo swā ldog par cung zad 'bri khul byas na/ ri 327 ca

dang bo/ tshad ma rig spro'i dmigs bsal gyi brjod tshul 'ga' zhig gi dris lan/(1) bum pa chos castsa— zhes pa ni/ bum pa rtsod gzhir bzung ba red/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ chos can dang / rtsod gzhi gnyis don gcig red/ (2) yin par thal/ zhes pa ni/ yin par 'gyur zhes pa'am yin dgos par gyur/ zhes pa'i don red/ —(3) yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ yin pa'i stabs kyis zhes pa'i don red/ de gsum gyi don ni/ dper na/ bum pa chos can/ dngos po yin par thal/ don byed nus pa yin pa 'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur 'di la mtshon na/ bum pa rtsod gzhir bzung nas/ bum pa de dngos po yin par 'gyur zhes pa'am/ dngos po yin dgos par gyur/ de'i rgyu mtshan don byed rnus pa yin pa'i stabs kyis ciso/ /zhes pa'i don dang / yang dper na/ mi 'ga' zhig gis lcags gser yin zeran de la mi 'dod pa'i thal ba 'phen pa'i tshe/ lcags chose can rin thang chen po can yin par thal/ gser yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur lta bu la mtshon na/lcags de rtsod gzhir bzung nas/ de rin thang chen po can yin par 'gyur dgos/ rgyu mtshan gser yin pas so/ /zhes mi 'dod pa'i thal ba 328

'phabartepa lta bu'o/ /spyir thal zhes pa brgal ba la 'jug pa dang / gyur pa'am 'gyur zhes pa la 'jug pa dang / tshar ba la 'jug pa gsum yod pa'i nang nas/skabs 'dir gyur pa'am 'gyur ba la 'jug pa'o// (ci med par thal/ zhes pa'ang / gong dang 'dra ste/ med par 'gyur zhes pa'i don te/ dper na/ ri bong rwa chos can/ med par thal/tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur lta bu la mtshon na/ri bong rwa med pa yin par 'gyur zhes pa yin la/ ri bong rwa med pa yin pas/ thal 'gyur 'di thal 'gyur yang dag yin/ bum pa chos can/ me da par thal/ tshadā mas ma dmigs pa'i— phyir/ zhes pa 'di thal 'gyur ltar snang yin te/ bum pa med pa min te yod pa yin pa dang / tshad mas ma dmigs pa min par tshad mas dmigs pa yin pas so/ ltar snang zhes pa ni yang dag ma yin pa'i don red/ (5) rtags ma grub/ ces pa ni/ dper na/ ri bong rwa chos can/med par thal/ tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'di la mtshon na/ri bong rwa rtsod gzhi med pa gsal ba/tshad mas ma dmigs pa rtags byas pa'i thal 'gyur red/chos can zhes sbyar ba de rtsod gzhi dang / thal sbyar sa de gsal ba dang / phyir sbyar sa de rtags yin pas/ thal 'gyur 'di rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ga tshang ba'i thal 'gyur red/ rtags grub ma grub ni/ rtsod gzhi de/ rtags de yin min la go dgos pas/ thal 'gyur 329

'di'i rtags grub ste/ rirtsobong rwa de tshad mas ma dmigs pa yin pas go /bum pa chos can/ med par thal/ tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thasgo 'gyur 'di'i rtags ma grub tshe bum pa tshad mas ma dmigs pa min pas so//(6) 'khor gsum/ zhes pa/ rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ga'i steng nas khyed rang mgo 'khor 'dug ces pa'i brda chad/(7) khyab pa 'bud/ ces pa ni/ khyab pa grub ma grub ni/ rtags de yin na/ gsal ba de yin pas khyab ma khyab la 'dang rgyag dgos pas/dper na bum pa chos can/ yod pa yin par thal/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'di la mtshon na/ khyab pa grub ste dngos po yin na yod pa yin pas khyab pas so/ /dngos po yin na yod pa yin pas khyab ces pa dang / dngos po yin na yod pa yin dgos zhes pa dang / dngos po yin na yod pa yin zhes pa thams cad don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so/ /des na sngar khyab ces khas blangs nas phyis khas len de dor nas/ ma khyab par khas blangs pa la/ khyab pa 'bud zer/(8) gzhi grub/ ces pa ni/ yod pa'i don te/ tshad mas grub pa/gzhi grub kyi mtshan nyid/ tshad mas grub pa'am tshad mas rtogs yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gzhi nas grub yodatshupa red/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis gzhi grub zer 330

(9) ma grub na/ zhes pa/ rtags ma grub zer na zhes pa red/rtags grub ma grub gong du dri lan lnga ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar yin/(10) rang ldog ces pa ni/ dper na/ dngos po de dngos po'i rang ldog dang / bum pa de dngos po'i gzhi ldog dang / don byed nus pa de dngos po'i don ldog red/ dngos po'i rang ldog la dngos po ma gtogs gzhan 'jog rgyu med/ bum pa de dngos po'i mtshan gzhi 'am/ dngos po bye brag pa zhig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ dngos po'i gzhi ldog zer/ don byed nus pa de dngos po'i mtshan nyid dam dngos po'i don yin pa'i stabs kyis dngos po'i don ldog zer ba yin/mtshan mtshon dang / ldog pa ngos 'dzin sogs bdag gis brtsams pa'i〈 blo gsal rig sgo 〉 na nag po 'gro shes kyi tshul du bshad yod do// (1 1) 'gal khyab/ ces pa ni/ thal 'gyur de'i rtags de yin na/gsal ba de ma yin pas khyab na 'gal khyab yin te/ dper6 na/ /bum pa chos can/ rtag pa yin par thal/ don byed nus pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur 'di 'gal khyab yin tshe don byed nus pa yin na/ rtagapa ma yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ — rsha (12) 'dod/ ces pa ni/ rang gis de ltar 'dodatshoces pa yin te/pha rol pos/ bum pa mi rtag pa yinarī par thal/ zhes 'phangs na/ 'dod ces lan 'debs/ de go'udod lan thobs zer na/ bum pa mi rtag pa 331

yin par 'dod/ ces lan thebs pa yin pa'i phyir/ (13) 'dod mi nus/ zhes pa/ rtags gsal de la 'dod ces lan 'debs mi nus/ zhes pa'i don de/ dper na/ bum pa chos can/ rtag pa yin par thal/ zhes 'phangs na/ 'dod zer mi nus te/ bum pa rtag pā ma yin pas so/ /de la lan ji ltar 'debs she na/ rtags ma grub/ ces lan 'debs pa yin te/ rtag pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan med ces pa'i don no// (14) khyab pa khas/ zhes pa/ rtags gsal gtong ba bo snga sgotsho/ gyis/ dam bca' ba phyi rgol la/ thal 'gyur 'phen bzhin pa'i thal 'gyur de'i khyab pa khyod kyis sngar nas khas blangs zin/ zhes pa'i don no//(15) rtsa bar 'dod na/ zhes pa/ dper na/ kha cig na re/ kha dog yin na dkarajibo yin pas khyab zer na/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi kha dog chos tsan/ dkar bo yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ khya ba pa khas/ma grub na/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi kha dog chos can/ kha dog yin par thal/ dmar bo yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ zhes pa lta bu la mtshon na/ thal 'gyur snga phyi gnyis yod pas/ snga ma rtsa ba'i thal 'gyur dang / phyi ma yan lag gi thal 'gyur du byed dgos la/ thal 'gyur snga ma sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi kha dog chos can/ dkar bo yin par thal/ zhe sa pa de/ 'dod zer na/ zhes pa'i don yin pa lta bu'o//332

(16) gzhi grub na/ zhes pa/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ yod pa yin na/ zhes pa'i don nokhri zhu(17) 'dod na/ zhes pa/ thal 'gyur zhig 'phangs nas/'phangs pa de ltar du 'dod na/ zhes pa'i don —no// (18) der thal/ zhes pa/ tshig de'i gong du thal ba 'phangs pa de ltar yin par thal/ zhes pa'i don te/ de sgra de/ sum cu ba'i skabs su de sgra don dgu la 'jug par bshad pa'i gong gi tha snyad 'das pa la 'jug pa yin no//(19) de chos can/ zhes pa'i de sgra yang tshig de'i gong du rtsod gzhir bzung zin pa de la snyeg dgos pas/ tha snyad 'das pa la 'jug pa yin no// (20) de'i phyir/ zhes pa'i de sgra de tshig de'i gong du rtags khyab bkod zin pa'i rtags de la snyeg dgos pas tha snyad 'das pa la 'jug pa yin no// ri — (21) ma khyab/ ces pa ni/ khyab pha ma grub ces pa'i don te/dper na/ gser gyi kha dog chos can/ dkar bo yin par thal/kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'phangs na/ ma khyab ces lanasharadebs dgos te/ kha dog yin na dkar bo yin pas ma khyab pas jo|/ (22) rtags grub/ ces pa ni/rte dper na/ gser gyi kha dog chos 333

can/ dkar bo yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur 'di la mtshon na/ khyab pa ma grub kyang / rtags grub pa yin te/chos can du 'gro rgyu de/ rtags su 'gro rgyu de yin pa'i phyir te/ gser gyi kha dog kha dog yin pa'i phyir ro// (23) rtags khas/ zhes pa ni/ dper na/ phyi rgol gyis gser gyi kha dog de kha dog yin par khas blangs/ kha dog yin na dkar bo yin pas khyab pa khas blangs pa la/ gnod byed gtong ba'i tshe/ gser gyi kha dog chos can/ dkar bo yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/zhes pa'i rtags khas ni/gser gyi kha dog de kha dog yin pa khyod kyis khas blangs zin/ zhes pa'i don no/ /snga rgol ni rtags gsal gtong mkhan dang / phyi rgol ni dam bca' mkhan la zer/ dam bca' ba yang zer la/khas len 'dzin mkhan yang zer/ skabs 'gar rang nyid la snga rgol dang /pha rol bo la phyi rgol zer ba go dgos/(2ci ka bum rdzam gcig yin pa 'bud/ ces pa/ kha cig gis ka bum gnyis rdzas gcig yin par khas blangs pa la/ snga rgol gyis gnod byed btang ba na/ gnod byed btang nas/ khos ka bum rdzas gcig par khas blangs pa'i dam bca' dor nas/ sngar gyi dam bca' de'i nang nas phyir 'bud dgos pa'i don red/ gcig dang tha dad sogs/ bdag gis brtsams pa'i blo gsal rigs sgor gsal bar bkod yod pas der blta 334

bar bya'o// —(25) 'khor gsum khas so/ /zhes pa/ khyed rang rtags gsal khyab gsum ga'i thog nas mgo 'khor ba khas len dgos so/ /zhes pa'i don no//(26) rtags bsal/ zhes pa ni yi gedzām dag gsal red/(27) rtags gsal/zhes pa/ rtags dang gsal ba gnyis ldan gyi thal 'gyur la zer zhing /thakha 'gyur 'god pa la rtags gsal gtong zer/(28) rtags gsal dngos/ zhes pa/ thal 'gyur de'i rtags dang gsal ba dngos gnas la zer (29) rtags khyab khas blangs/ zhes pa/ dper na/ kha cig gis kha dog yin na dkar bo yin pas khyab zer ba la/ snga rgol gyis/ 'o na gser gyi kha dogye chos can/ dkar bo yin par thal/kha dog yin pa'i phyir/rtags khyab khas/zhes 'phangs pa'i don/ phyi rgol des gser gyi kha dog de kha dog yin par khas blangs pas rtagasnga khas blangs/ kha dog yin na dkar bo yin pas khyab pa khas blangs ptas/ khyab pa khas blangs pa yin stabs/snga rgol gyis phyi rgol la thal 'gyur 'di'i rtags khyab gnyis ka khyed kyis khas blabs so/ /zhes pa'i don no // de yan gyi tshad ma rig pa'i domigs bsal gyi brjod tshul gyi dri ba nyi shu rtsa dgu bekod pa'i lan rang gi go tshod tsam bshad zin to// 335

gnyis pa/ tha snyad gal che'i rigs la mchan 'grel lam zur 'grel gang 'os thig zhu rgyu'i sa bon camo du phul lags zhes pa'i dris lan/( 1) yul/ zhes pa/ spyir gzhi grub na yul yin pas khyab zer dgos pas/ shes bya dang / yod pa/yul rnams don gcig red/(2) yul can/ zhes pa/yul can la shes pa dang /gang zag brjod byed kyi sgra dang gsum yod/ dper na/ sngon po mthong ba'i mig shes yul can yin pa dang / sngon po de sngon po mthong ba'i mig shes kyi yul yin pa lta bu'o/ /mig shes rgyud ldan gyi gang zag des kyang sngon po mthong ba yin pasna/ gang zag de yul can dang / sngon po de yul yin pa lta bu 'o/ /gzhan yang / bum pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra de yul can dang / bum pa de de'i yul yin pa de bzhin du rjod byed kyi sgra gang dang gang yin yang / rang nyid yul can dang / rang gi brjod bya de rang gi yul yin pas so//(3) zhen yul/ zhes pa/ rtog pa don mthun gyis zhes pa'i sgo nas rig par bya ba de/ zhen yul gyi mtshan nyid/ dper na/ bum pa de bum 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen yul yin te/ bum 'dzin rtog pas zhen nas nan gyis 'dzin pas na/ bum 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen yul yin zhes brjod do//(ci bzung yul/ zhes pa/blo de'i snang ngo la snang ba'i sgo nas rig 336

par bya ba/ blo de'i snang yul gyi mtshan nyid/ de dang blo de'i bzung yul don gcig des na bzung yul ni snang yul las logs surdzo med/ podku(5) snang yul/ zhes pa/ dper na/ bum 'dzin dbang mngon gyis rang la gsal bar snang nas bzung ba de bum pa yin pas/ bum pa de bum 'dzin dbang mngon gyi snang yul yin pa dang /bzung yul yang yin/ bum 'dzin dbang mngon gyis ji ltar— bzung bab ltar gyi don de yang bum pa yin pas/bum pa de bum 'dzin dbang mngon gyi 'dzin stangs kyi yul yang yin no/ /des na dngoso po yin na snang yul yin pas༄7ba ste/ rang rang 'dzin pa'i mngon sum gyi snang yul yin pas so/ /rtog pa thams cad kyi snang yul la don spyi zhig 'jog dgos te/ rdaber na/ bum 'dzin rtog pa'i snang yul la bum pa'i don spyi 'irnyog ste/ 4 bum 'dzin rtog pa rang gi snang ngo la gsal bar snang ba de bum pa'i don spyi yin la/ de gsal bar snang ba'i sgo nas bum pa bzung ba yin rna/ /bum pa'i don spyi zhes pa/bum 'dzin rtog pa la bum pa ma yin pa las log par snang ba de'o/ /rtag pa yin na snang yul yin pas ma khyab ste/ don spyi las gzhen pa'i rtag pa thams cad snang yul min no/ /dung dkar ser bor snang ba'i dbang shes kyi snang yul la/ dung ser bor snang ba 'jog pa dang /ci ri bong rwa 'dzin rtog pa'i snang yul la/ ri bong rwa'i don spyi 'jog pa lta bu dbang shes 'khrul ba can dang / rtog pa logo gisartsolo slunge snang yul yod do/ /bum 337

'dzin dbang mngon lta bu/ dbang mngon tshade ma thams cad kyi snang yul dang 'dzin stangs kyi yul gnyis don gcig kyang / rtog pa rnams kyi snang yul dang 'dzin stangasta kyi yul gnyis mi 'dra ste/ dper na/ bum 'dzin rtog pa'i snang yul la bum pa'i don spyi 'jog dgos la/ 'dzin stangs kyi yul la bum pa 'jog dgos pa bzhin no// ne (6) dngos yul/ zhes pa/ dper na/ sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag lta bu la mtshon na/ sgra mi rtag pa de'i dngos yul lam/ dngos gzhal yin la/ sgra rtag stong de de'i spyogs yul lam/ shugs gzhal yin pa lta bu yin te/ sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag gis/ sgra mi rtag pa dngos su rtogs nas/sgra rtag pas stong ba shugs la rtogs pa yin no// (7) gzhal bya/ zhes pa/ tshad mas rtogs par bya ba gzhal rgya'i mtshan nyid/ de dang yod pa don gcig tshad mas rtogs/ zhes pa dang /tshad mas gzhal zhes pa don gcig pas/ tshad mas rtogwas bya dang / tshad mas gzhal bya don gcig go /(8) dngos gzhal/ zhes pa/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ dper na/ sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag gis/ sgra mi rtag pa dngos su gzhal nas/ sgra rtag pas stong ba shugs la gzhal ba yin pas/ sgra mi rtag pa rjes dpag de'i dngos gzhal dang / sgra rtag stong shugs gzhal yin zer dgos/yang sgra rtag stong dngos su rtogs pa'i rjes dpag gi dngos gzhal la sgra 338

rtag stong 'jog dgos pa dang / shugs gzhal la sgra mi rtag pa 'jog dgos/ shugs la rtogs zhes pa dang / don gyis rtogs zhes pa don 'dra la/dkar bo 'dzin pa'i mig shes lta bu/dbang shes dag la dngos gzhal ma gtogs/ shugs gzhal med do// — (9) bem po/ zhes pa/ rdul du grub pa bem po'i mtshan nyid/ bem po dang gzugs gnyis don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ gzugs rags pa bum pa lta bu dang / phra ba rdul phra rab lta bu/ rdul phya rab chos can/ rdul du grub pa yin te/ rdul rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ des na rdul du grub pa zhes pa ni/ rang nyid rdul rdzas yin pa la byed rgyu yin la/ rdul rdzas ni/ sa rdul/chu rdul/ me rdul/ rlung rdul bzhi la rdul bzhi zer ba dang / sa rdzas/ chu rdzas/ me rdzas/ rlung rdzas bzhi la rdzas bzhi zer bas/ gzugs yin na rdul dzas brgyad 'dus kyi gong bu'an pas khyab/ gzugs kyi sgra bshad ni/'byung ba dang / 'byung 'gyur gyi dngos po nang phan tshun gcig gis gcig la reg citha gzugs nas gnod byar rung bas/ gzugs su rung ba zhes brjod do//(10) shes pa/ zhes pa ni/ rang yul gsal ba'i bem min de/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa 'dzin pa'i smreg shes lta bu'i dbang shes dang / bum pa rtogs pa'i rjes dpag lta bu'i yid shes lta bu'o/ /blo dang shes pa dang rig pa dang gsal ba bzhi don gcig sgra 339

bshad ni/ shes pa rang gi yul yod kyang rung med kyang rung shes pa rang gi ngor snang zhing gsal barsā na/ gsal ba'am shes pa brjod la/gzugs ma yin pas bem min zhes brjod/ bem min zhes pas gang zag dang nam mkha' lta bu ma yin pa yang go dgos so// (11) ldan min 'duri byed/ ces pa/ gzugs shes gang rung ma yin pa'i 'dus byas de/ ldan min 'dukhyed kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/bum pa'i skye 'jig gnas rnying bzhi dang / gang zag dang / dus dang /lo/ zla ba/ shar phyogs lta bu'i phyogs lta bu'o/ /ldan min 'du byed ni/gzugs kyang ma yin/ shes pa yang ma yin la/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i 'dus byas yin dgos/ sgra bshad ni/ bum pa'i skye ba chos can/ khyod la ldan min 'du byed ces brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod sems dang mtshungs par ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi phung bo yin pa'i rgyu yotshan gyis de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ de'i go don bum pa'i skye ba'i thog nas bshad na/ bum pa'i skye ba ni blo ngor bum pa de sngar med gsar du skyes pa'i cha de yin la de ni blo ngor bum pa de nyid ma yin par snang la/ snang ba ltar grub pas na bum pa'i skye ba de bum pa min phyir gzugs kyang min la shes pa yang ma yin/ 'on kyang rtogs ngor shar tsam zhig ma yin par bum pa'i steng nas spub pa zhig yin pas yod pa yin pa dang / de yang bum pa skyed byed kyi rgyu las byung ba yin par 'char ba ltar grub pas na 340

'dus byas yin dgos/ de yang gzugs dang shes pa gnyis gang yang ma yin pas na mtshungs ldan ma yin pa'i 'du byed las 'os med do/ /tshor ba dang 'du shes gnyis po gang rung ma yin pa'i sems byung thams cad ni mtshungs ldan 'du byed yin la/ de las gzhan pa'i 'du byed dag ni/zhen min 'du byed red/ mtshungs ldan ma yin pa'i 'du byed yin te/rmetshungs ldan rnam pa lnga mtshungs can ma yin pa'i 'du byed yin pa'i phyir/der thal/ shes pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag ni bdag gis blo gsal rigs sgo'i ldan min 'du byed kyi skabs su bshad zin mod/ khyed kyis dri ba nan che bas cung zad bris pa yin la/ rgyas par der blta bar bya'o//(12) nyer len/ zhes pa/ dngos po de'i rgyu la/ nyer len dang /lhan cig byed rkyen gnyis yod pas/ nyer len ni dngos po de'i rdzas rgyun zhig dgos te/ dper na/ mig shes skad khrig dang bo de mig shes skad cig gnyis pa'i nyer len yin te/ mig shes skad cig gnyis pa de/ skad cig dang bo rang gi rdzas rgyun yin pa gang zhig skad cig dang bo rang nyid skad cig gnyis pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du/ ka ba bzo byed kyi shing de ka ba'i nyer len yin la/ gser bum bzo byed kyi gser de gser bum gyi nyer len yin no/ /des na/ rang 'bras rang gi rdzas rgyun du gtso bor skyed byed de nyer len gyi mtshan nyid yin/341

lhan cig byed rkyen/ zhes pa rang gi 'bras bu'i rdzas rgyun ma yin pa zhig dgos te/ dper na/ myu gu'i rgyur gyur pa'i chu dang lud ni/ myu gu'i lhan cig byed rkyen yin gyi/ myu gu'i nyer len ma yin no/ /chu dang lud ni rang 'bras myu gu'i rdzas rgyun ma yin kyang / myu gu'i nyer len sa bon dang lhan cig tu rang 'bras myu gu skyed par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis myu gu'i lhan cig byed rkyen zer ro/ /deng sang 'ga' zhig gi rtsom gyi nang du/ rgyu rkyen yod tshad la nyer len zhes 'bri bar byed pa ni don ma go bar ham brjod byed pa'o// (13) rdzas rgyun/ zhes pa ni/ dper na/ rna shes skad cig gnyis pa dang gsum pa bzhi ba sogs/ rna shes skad cig dang bo'i rdzas rgyun yin stabs/ rna shes skad cig gnyis pa dang / gsum pa bzhi pa rnams rdzas rgyun gcig pa red/ de bzhin du rdza bum de/ rdza bum bzo byed kyi 'jim pa'i rdzas rgyun red/ de bzhin du/ ka ba de ka ba bzo byed kyi shing gi rdzas kyi rgyun red do//(1ci dngos 'bras/ zhes pa ni/ dper na/ mig shes skad cig gnyis pa de mig shes skad cig dang bo'i dngos 'bras red/ mig shes skad cig gsum pa de/ mig shes skad cig dang bo'i brgyud 'bras yin te/skad cig dang po dang gsum pa gnyis kyi bar du skad cig gnyis pa brgyud pa'i phyir/ de bzhin/ mig shes skad cig dang bo de/ mig shes skad cig 342

gnyis pa'i dngos rgyu dang / mig shes skad cig gsum pa'i brgyud rgyu yin no//(15) brgyud 'bras/ zhes pa/ gong gi des kyang shes mod/ yang bskyar gsal bshad byas na/ dpe bzhag na/ snam bu de/ snam bu bzo byed kyi bal gyi brgyud 'bras yin te/ bar du bal skud brgyud pa'i phyir te/bal gyis skud pa bzos/ des snam bu 'thag pa red do/ /(16) bum 'dzin rtog pa/ zhes pa ni/ bum pa 'dzin pa'i mig shes ni bum 'dzin mngon sum yin te/ des bum pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i phyir/ bum pa'i don spyi yid la shar te bum pa 'dzin pa'i yid shes de la bum 'dzin rtog pa zer/ des mig shes ltar bum pa mngon sum du mthong ba min yang / yid kyi rtog pa la bum pa'i don spyi shar te/ bum pa 'di 'dra'o snyam pa na rtogs pa'i go chod pa red lags/(17) sgra spyi/ zhes pa ni/ dper na/ lha sar 'gro ma myong ba'i mi zhig la/ mi zhig gis lha sa'i dbyibs dang bkod pa sogs bshad pa na/kho'i yid la lha sa'i dbyibs bkod sogs lam gyis 'char rgyu zhig yod/de ni sgra tsam la brten nas lha sa'i spyi shar ba yin stabs/ sgra spyi shar ba yin gyi/ don spyi ma yin no/ / (18) don spyi/ zhes pa ni/ dper na/ lha sar yod pa'i mi zhig gis lha sa'i dbyibs bkod sogs mngon sum du mthong ba yin la/ mi de 343

yul gzhan zhig tu song tshe/ lha sa mig lam du med kyang / sngar mthong ba'i lha sa'i dbyibs bkod sogs yid la lam gyis shar ba de la don spyi shar ba zer/ sngar don dngos gnas mthong ba la brten nas spyi shar ba yin stabs don spyi shar zer/ don spyi dang sgra spyi gang yin kyang rtog ngor shar tsam gyi cha la ngos 'dzin dgos stabs rtag dngos gnyis kyi nang gi rtag pa yin/ des na bum pa'i don spyi'i mtshan nyid ni bum 'dzin rtog pa la bum pa ma yin pa las log par snang ba de 'jog dgos so/ /'on kyang /mi rtag sogs bcu drug dang bdag med phra rags sogs ni/ dang bo thos bsam gyis gtan la phab ste/ sgom byung gis bsgoms stobs kyis thog mar don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs/ goms pa hur bskyed pa'i mthar mngon sum du rtogs dgos pa sogs mang mod/ skabs 'dir bshad na nyog 'gro bas mi bshad lags/ (19) rang rig ces pa ni/ shes pa gang dang gang yin yang rang nyid mngon sum du rig pa'i kha nang ltas can gyi shes pa zhig yod pa de la rang rig zer mod/ 'di ni grub mtha' bzhi'i nang gi mdo sde ba dang /sems tsam pa gnyis ma gtogs grub mtha' smra ba gzhan gyis khas mi len/ dper na/ sngo 'dzin mig shes kyis sngon po mthong ba'i tshe na/ sngo 'dzin mig shes kyis sngon po mthong ba yin mod/ sngo 'dzin mig shes rang nyid nyams su myong ba'i shes pa mngon sum pa zhig yod la/ mngon sum shes pa 344

des rang nyid kyang rig pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rang rig mngon sum zer/zhes 'dod do// (20) gzhan rig ces pa/ rangacirig las gzhan pa'i shes pa thams cad la gzhan rig gi shes pa zer/(21) dgag pa/ zhes pa/ rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blos rang gi dgag bya dngos su bcad nas rtogs dgos pa'i chos de/ dgag pa'i mtshan nyid yin la/ dper na/ sgra mi rtag pa de/ rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blo ste sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i blos sgra mi rtag pa'i dgag bya sgra rtag pa dngos su bcad nas sgra mi rtag pa rtogs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ sgra mi rtag pa de dgag pa yin zhes brjod la/ de bzhin du/ nam mkha' yang rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blos nam mkha' rang gi dgag bya thogs reg de blo ngor dngos su bcad nas nam mkha' rtogs dgos pas/ nam mkha' dgag pa yin/ bum pa 'dzin pa'i blos bum pa rang gi dgag bya bum pa ma yin pa bcad pa yin yang shugs la bcad pa yin gyi dngos su bcad nas rtogs pa min pas bum pa dgag par mi 'gyur ro//(22) sgrub pa/ zhes pa/ rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blos rang gi dgag bya dngos su bcad nas rtogs par bya ba ma yin pa'i chos de/ sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid yin la/ dper na/ —bum pa de rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blos dgag bya gang yang dngos su bcad nas rtogs mi— dgos par bum pa ci 345

de rang gi gzung byar bsgrubs nas bzung ba yin pas/ bum pa de sgrub pa yin zhes brjod do/ /dgag sgrub gnyis kyang zhib par shes 'dod na〈 blo gsal rigs sgo 〉ru mdor bsdus go sla ba'i tshul du bshad yod pas der blta bar bya'o//(23) gzhan sel/ zhes pa/ gzhan sel dang dgag pa don gcig yin pas logs su bshad mi dgos la/ blo sal rigs sgor ldog cha nas bshad yod/ (24) gzhan sel gsum/ zhes pa/ don rang mtshan gyi gzhan sel dang / blo'i gzhan sel dang / med dgag gi gzhan sel dang gsum la zer/ dang bo dang dngos por gyur pa'i dgag pa don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra mi rtag pa dang / bum pa ma yin pa las log pa'i bum pa dang / rtag dngos gnyis kyis stong ba'i bum pa dang / ma nyams pa'i bum pa dang / mi chung ba'i bum pa lta bu/ gnyis pa dang / don spyi gnyis don gcig yin la/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa'i don spyi lta bu/ gsum pa ni/yod med gang yin yang de dang de ma yin pa gnyis ka yin pa med pa de/de dang de'i med dgag gi gzhan sel yin zer dgos te/ dper na/bum pa dang bum pa ma yin pa gnyis ka yin pas stong ba de bum pa'i med dgag gi gzhan sel yin pa dang / bum pa la bum pa ma yin pa med pa yang bum pa'i med dgag gi gzhan sel yin pa bzhin/ yod med thams 346

cad la rigs 'gre'o/ /(25) lhan cig byed rkyen/ zhes pa/ dper na/ myu gu'i rgyur gyur pa'i chu lud gnyis myu gu'i nyer len ma yin kyang / myu gu'i nyer len sa bon dnge lhan cig tu myu gu skye ba'i rkyen byed pas/ lhan cig byed rkyen yin zer ba sogs gong du nyer len gyi dris lan skabs su bshad pa ltar ro//(26) med dgag ces pa/ rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blos rang gi dgag bya bkag shul du chos gzhan ma yin dgag dang sgrub pa gang rung mi 'phen pa'i dgag pa de/ med dgag gi mtshan nyid yin la/ dper na/nam mkha' de rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blos nam mkha' rang gi dgag bya thogs reg bcad tsam 'phen pa'am rtogs pa las/ sna chos gzhan ma yin dgag dang sgrub pa gang zhig kyang rtogs rgyu med pas med dgag ces brjod/ (27) ma yin dgag ces pa/ rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blos rang gi dgag bya bkag shul du chos gzhan ma yin dgag dang sgrub pa gang rung 'phen pa de/ ma yin dgag gi mtshan nyid yin la/ dper na/ bum pa mi rtag pa de rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blos bum pa mi rtag pa rang gi dgag bya bum pa rtag pa bkag shul du dgag bya las gzhan bum ga mi rtag pa 'phen pa yin pas/ ma yin dgag tu gyur pa red/ skabs 'dir 'phen 347

zhes pa rtogs pa'i don/ zhib par blo gsal rigs sgor blta/(28) thal 'gyur/ zhes pa/ dper na/ sgra chos can/ ma byas pa yin par thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ pha rol bos/ sgra rtag pa yin pa khas blangs pa la/ snga rgol gyis/ 'o na sgra byas pa— ma yin par thal bar 'gyur zhes sun 'byin 'phangs pa'i ngag lta bu la thal 'gyur zer/— (29) chos can du ma spungs pa'i thal 'gyur/ zhes pa/ thal 'gyur de la chos can du ma yod pa'i don de/ dper na/ sgra chos can/ bum pa chos can/ ka ba chos can/ mi rtag pa yin par thal/ byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ chos can gsum yod pas/ chos can du ma spungs pa'o (30) gsal spung gi thal 'gyur/ zhes pa/ gsal ba du ma yod pa'i thal 'gyur la zer te/ dper na/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag pa yin par thal/ byas pa yin par thal/ dngos po yin par thal/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ gsal ba du ma zhig yod pa'o//( 31) rtags spung gi thal 'gyur/ zhes pa/ rtags du ma zhig yod pa'i thal 'gyur la zer te/ dper na/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag pa yin par thal/ byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/don byed nus pa yin pa'i phyir/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta 348

bu'o// —(32) sbubs 'tshang gi thal 'gyur/ zhes pa/ sbubs 'tshang gi thal 'gyur la gnyis yod de/ chos can sbubs 'tshang gi thal 'gyur dang /gsal ba spubs 'tshang gi thal 'gyur gnyis yod/ dang bo chos can spubs 'tshang gi thal 'gyur ni/ dper na/ sgra chos can/ shes bya chos can/ yod pa chos can/ dngos po yin par thal/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyi rtags grub par thal/ bdag med yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod par thal/ bdag med yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur lta bu yin la/ de 'dra'i thal 'gyur de rtsod gzhi sbubs 'tshang gi thal 'gyur yin tshul ni/ de'i phyir sgra dang bo gnyis kyis chos can phyi ma gnyis spubs su drangs pa'i phyir te/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir zhes pa/ des yod pa chos can zhes pa spubs su drangs/ bdag med yin pa'i phyir zhes pas shes bya chos can zhes pa de spubs su drangs nas sgra rtsod gzhir lus pa yin pa'i phyir der thal/ de'i rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ngos 'dzin pa'i tshe na sgra rtsod gzhi/ shes bya chos cin/ yod pa chos can/ dngos po yin par thal/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyi rtags grub par thal/ bdag med yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod par thal/ zhes pa gsal ba bdag med yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa rtags yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gsal ba spubs 'tshang 349

gi thal 'gyur ni/ sgra chos can/ dngos po yin par thal/ byas pa yin par thal/ mi rtag pa yin par thal/ don byed nus pa yin pa'i phyir/zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyi rtags grub pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur lta bu yin te/ thal 'gyur gyi rtags kyi phyir sgra snga ma snga mas gsal ba snyephyi ma phyi ma rim gyis spubs su drangs nas dngos po yin par thal zhes pa gsal bar lus pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ don byed nus pa yin pa'i phyir zhes pa des mi rtag pa yin par thal zhes pa de spubs su drangs/ rtags grub pa'i phyir zhes pa des byas pa yin par thal zhes pa de sbubs su drangs —pa yin pa'i phyir te/ thal 'gyur de'i rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ngos 'dzin pa'i tshe na/ sgras rtsod gzhi/dngos pos gsal ba/ byas pa yin par thal/ zhes pa nas khyab pa yod pa'i bar gyis rtags byas pa'i phyir ro//(33) rtags gsal tha dad kyi thal 'gyur/ zhes pa/ dper na/ sgra chos can/ ma byas pa yin par thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir zhes thal 'gyur gyi rtags gsal gnyis ngos bzung na/ rtag pa de thal 'gyur de'i rtags dang / ma byas pa de gsal ba yin la/ rtag pa dang ma byas pa gnyis tha dad yin pas/ rtags gsal tha dad kyi thal 'gyur zer ro//(3ci rtags gsal tha mi dad kyi thal 'gyur/ zhes pa de ni/dper na/ sgra chos can/ byas pa yin par thal/ byas pa yin pa'i phyir/350

zhes pa'i thal 'gyur lta bu ste/ thal 'gyur de'i rtags gsal gnyis ka byas pa yin la/ byas pa byas pa dang tha dad ma yin pas/ thal 'gyur de la rtags gsal tha mi dad kyi thal 'gyur zer ro//(35) sbyor lugs skyon can gyi lan 'debs/ zhes pa pha rol bos 'phangs pa'i thal 'gyur de'i rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ga sbyor tshul de skyod can red ces lan 'debs/ zhes pa'i don no//(36) grub sde rdzas gcig ces pa/ grub pa dus mnyam/ gnas pa dus mnyam/ 'gag pa dus mnyam pa la bya ste/ dper na/ bum pa'i tshogs pa na yod pa'i rdul rdzas brgyad ka spub sde rdzas gcig yin te/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dus mnyam pa'i phyir/(37) grub sde gcig ces pa/ gong gi de dang 'dra/(38) phan tshun spang 'gal/ zhes pa/ phan tshun gcig yin pas gcig shos yin pa gcod nus pa'i chos de/ phan tshun spang gi mtshan nyid yin la/ dper na/ ka bum gnyis dang / rtag dngos gnyis lta bu ste/ka ba yin pas bum pa yin pa spang nus pa'am gcod nus pa dang / bum pa yin pas ka ba spang nus pa'am gcod nus pa yin/ rtag dngos gnyis kyang de bzhin no//(39) dngos 'gal/ zhes pa/ rtag mi rtag gnyis dnge / gcig dang tha dad gnyis lta bu ste/ blo gang zhig gis shes bya gang zhig rtag pa 351

yin par rtogs na mi rtag pa ma yin par shugs la rtogs nus pa dang /mi rtag pa yin par rtoges na rtag pa ma yin pa shugs la rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ gcig dang tha dad gnyis kyang de bzhin no//(40) ka ba'i dgog gzhi/ zhes pa/ ka ba med pa'i gnas sam sa phyogs la zer/ (41) bum pa'i dgag gzhi/ zhes pa'ang bum pa med pa'i sa phyogs sam gnas/ bum pa med pa'i sa phyogs la bum pas dgag pa'i sa phyogs kyang zer/(42) chos/ zhes pa/ chos dang / yod pa/ shes bya rnams don gcig spyir chos zhes pa don bcu la 'jug mod/ skabs 'dir yod pa thams cad la chos zer te/ rang gi ngo bo 'dzin pa chos kyi mtshan nyid yin la/ shes bya thams cad rang gi ngo bo med pa las yongs su 'dzin pa ste/ yod par 'dzin pa red do//(43) skad cig ma/ zhes pa/ mdzod las/ skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la/de yi skad cig de dag kyang / /drug cu la ni thang cig go /yud tsam nyin zhag zla gsum ni/ /gong nas gong du sum cur 'gyur/ /zhag mi thub dang bcas pa yi//zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig /ces gsungs pa ltar/skyes bu stobs ldan shaṃg gis se gol gcig gtogs pa'i yun la cha drug cu rtsa lnga phyes pa'i cha gcig la/ thung mtha'i skad cig ma zer/de lta bu'i thung mtha'i 352

skad cig ma brgya dang nyi shu la/de'i skad cig ma zer la/bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma'ang zer/ de'i skad cig ma drug cu'i yun la thang cig zer/ thang cig sum cu la yud tsam zer/ yud tsam sum cu la nyin zhag gcig nyin zhag sum cu ni nyin zhag gi dbang du byas pa'i zla ba yin no//(4ci gang dran dran/ zhes pa/ dper na/ bum pa med pa yin na/gang dran dran yin pas khyab/ ces bum pa yod pa yin mod/med pa yin na sems la gang dran dran bshad pa las/ gtad so gang yang med par 'gyur ba'i don no//(45) bdag med/ces pa/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ chos thams cad bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba'o//zhes lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi gsungs pa'i nang tshan gyi bdag med la go dgos shing /de yang skabs 'dir/rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyi bdag med pa la go dgos shing /de yang dper na/bum pa lta bu rang gi cha shas mchu zhabs lto ba rang gi tshogs pa'i rdul rdzas sogs las logs su tshong ba las tshong dpon logs su yod pa lta bu'i rdzasaci shig yod pa ni bdag yin la/ de lta bur med pa ni bdag med yin/ chos gang dang gang yin kyang de lta bur med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ chos thams can bdag med yin no// (46) rnam mkhyen/ zhes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi shes bya 353

thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi ming /(47) thal ngag ces pa/gong du bshad pa'i thal 'gyur dang gcig red/(48) ltag chod/ces pa/pha rol bo'i 'dod tshul gyi ldog phyogs nas thal sbyor 'phangs te sun 'byin par byed pa'i ngag gi ming / (49) dngos khyab/ ces pa/ rtags de yin na gsal ba de yin pas khyab pa'o// (50) rtags sbyor/zhes pa/dper na/ sgra chos can/mi rtag ste/byas pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ dgag phyogs nas thal ba 'phen pa lta bu ma yin par/ sgrub phyogs nas sgrub byed bkod de bsgrub bya sgrub pa yin la/sbyor ba'ang zer ro//(51) rgyu drug ces pa/ rgyu la sgras brjod rigs kyi sgo nas drug tu dbye ste/ byed rgyu dang / lhan cig 'byung rgyu dang / skal mnyam gyi rgyu dang /mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu dang / kun 'gro'i rgyu dang / rnam smin gyi rgyu dang drug go /(52) byed rgyu/ zhes pa/ chos rang skye ba la gegs mi byed cing / rang las don gzhan pa'i 'dus byas de/byed rgyu'i mtshan nyid yin/dper na/bum pa skye ba la gegs mi byed pa'i 'dus byas thams cad bum pa'i byed rgyu yin/des na ka ba yang bum pa'i byed rgyu yin te/bum pa skye ba la gegs 354

mi byed pa'i 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ sgras brjod rigs kyi sgo nas bzhag pa'i rgyu btags pa ba yin gyi/ rgyu dngos ni ma yin te/ rgyu 'bras dus mnyam pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ des na 'dus byas thams cad byed rgyu yin no/ /chos de dang de skye ba la gegs byed pa'i 'dus byas de byed rgyu min te/ dper na/ snang ba de mun pa skye ba la gegs byed yin pas mun pa'i byed rgyu min no/ /byed rgyu yin na rgyu yin pas khyab ste/ byed rgyu yin na dngos po yin pas khyab/ dngos po yin na rgyu yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/'on kyang dngos po de'i byed rgyu yin na/ dngos po de'i rgyu yin pas ma khyab ste/dper na/ bum pa dang dus mnyam du yod pa'i ka ba de bum pa'i byed rgyu yin yang / bum pa'i rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang bo grub ste/ bum pa skye ba la gegs mi byed pa'i 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste bum pa dang dus mnyam du yod pa gang zhig rgyu 'bras dus mnyam pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ bum pa'i nyer len dang bum pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen ni/ bum pa'i byed rgyu dang rgyu dngos gnyis ka yin no//(53) lhan cig 'byung rgyu/ zhes pa/ phan tshun rdzas su grub pa'i dus mnyam yang yin / phan tshun skye ba la gegs mi byed pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun du dmigs pa de lhan cig 'byung rgyu'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/dus mnyam pa'i ka bum gnyis lta bu'o//ka bum gnyis rdzas su grub pa yin te/dngos po yin pa'i phyir/'di ni rgyu btags pa ba'o//355

(5ci skal mnyam gyi rgyu/zhes pa/rang gi rigs 'dra phyi ma rang dang 'dra ba skyed byed de skal mnyam gyi rgyu'i mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/rgyun phyi ma ldan pa'i bum pa dang /mig shes lta bu/ rgyun phyi ma yod pa'i bum pas ni rang dang rigs 'dra ba'i bum pa phyi ma skyed/rgyun phyi ma yod pa'i mig shes kyis rang dang rigs 'dra ba'i mig shes phyi ma skyed pa'i phyir/ gzhan la rigs 'gre / (55) mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu/ zhes pa/rang dang mtshungs ldan rnam pa lnga mtshungs su byung ba'i blo gzhan skye ba la gegs mi byed pa tsam gyis phan 'dogs pa'i rig rme de mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu'i mtshan nyid yin/ des na gzhan rig gi shes pa thams cad mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu yin te/ rang dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes pa gzhan skye ba la gegs mi byed pas khyab bo//(56) kun 'gro'i rgyu/zhes pa/rang gi 'bras bur gyur pa'i rang dang sa gcig pa'i nyon mongs can phyi ma skyed byed de kun 'gro'i rgyu'i mtshan nyid/ dper na/ 'dod khams kyi sas bsdus pa'i 'dod chags de rang gi rgyun phyi ma'i 'dod chags dang / 'dod khams kyi sas bsdus pa'i ma rig pa dang log lta sogs skyed byed yin pas kunaji'agro'i rgyu yin/ des na kun 'gro'i rgyu la nyon mongs can dgos so// (57) rnam smin gyi rgyu/ zhes pa/ dge ba zag bcas dang / mi dge ba gang rung gis bsdus pa/rnam smin gyi rgyu'i mtshan nyid/ dge ba zag bcas 356

ni/ ma rig pa dang bdag phung la chags pa'i srid pas kun nas bslangs pa'i dge ba thams cad yin/ mi dge ba sdug bsngal myong byed kyi las thams cad yin/ de dag la rnam smin gyi rgyu zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/dper na/ shing tog rim gyis smin nas longs spyod rung ba ltar/ dge ba zag bcas dang mi dge ba dag gi 'bras bu rim gyis rnam par smin nas bde sdug gang rung myong bar 'gyur bas de ltar brjod do//(58) dmigs rkyen/ zhes pa/ rang 'bras shes pa phyi ma rang gi rnam ldan du gtso bor skyed pa'i rkyen de dmigs rkyen gyi mtshan nyid yin la/dper na/sngon po de rang 'bras sngo 'dzin mig shes phyi ma rang gi rnam ldan du skyed byed yin pas/rang 'bras sngo 'dzin mig shes phyi ma'i dmigs rkyen yin pa bzhin no//rnam ldan zhes pa yul de'i rnam pa can te/ dper na/sngo 'dzin mig shes sngon po'i rnam pa can yin te/ sngon po rang gi yul du byed pa'i yul can yin pas so// (59) byed rkyen/ zhes pa/ sngar bshad pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen las logs su med 'dra/ (60) de ma thag rkyen/ zhes pa/ rang 'bras shes pa gsal rig tu gtso bor skyed pa'i rkyen de de ma thag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ dper na/ mig shes skad cig dang bo de/ mig shes skad cig gnyis pa'i de ma thag rkyen min pa bzhin du/sngo 'dzin migo shes kyi rgyur gyur pa'i yid shes de yang sngo 357
