'dzin mig shes kyi de ma thag rkyen yin te/ sngo 'dzin mig shes de gsal ba'i rang bzhin gyi gsal rig tu skyed pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/(61) bdag rkyen/ zhes pa/rang 'bras rang dbang du gtso bor skyed pa'i rkyen de bdag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ dngos po thams cad bdag rkyen yin te/ rang gi 'bras bu zhig rang dbang du skyed pa'i rkyen ma yin pa'i dngos po zhig med pa'i phyir/dper na/rang 'bras bum pa rang dbang du skyed pa'i rkyen de bum pa'i bdag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/bum chopa'i nyer len dang bum pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen bum pa bzo mkhan lta bu'o/ /rang 'bras shes pa yul 'dzin nus su rang dbang du skyed pa'i rkyen de shes pa'i bdag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ blo rnams kyi rten dbang po drug dang de ma thag rkyen lta bu'o//(62) lung ma bstan/ zhes pa/ dge ba dang mi dge ba gang yang ma yin pa thams cad la lung ma bstan pa zer te/ dge ba yin par lung du bstan pa med/mi dge ba yin par lung du bstan pa med pas so/ /dper na/bum pa dang /ka ba yang lung ma bstan pa yin te/dge mi dge gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ (63) rnam smin gyi 'bras bu/ zhes pa/ rang rgyu dge ba zag bcas dang mi dge ba gang rung las byung zhing rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyi phung po de rnam smin gyi 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid/rnam smin dang 358

rnam smin gyi 'bras bu don gcis/ mtshan gzhi ni/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo lnga'o//de la rnam smin gyi 'bras bu zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa yang yin la/ 'bras bu yang yin pas de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo lnga bo de ma sgrib lung ma bstan yin te/nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib gang yang min pas ma sgrib dang /dge mi dge gang yang ma yin pas lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir/(6ci rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ zhes pa/rung rgyu dang rigs 'dra ba'i 'bras bu de rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid/ dper na/ bum pa skad cig gnyis pa de bum pa skad cig dang bo'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu yin te/bum pa skad cig dang bo dang ldog pa rigs 'dra barme de'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang ka ba'i 'bras bur gyur pa'i ka ba dang / bum pa'i 'bras bur gyur pa'i bum pa lta bu'o//(65) byed 'bras/ zhes pa/ rang gi rgyu'i stobs las skyes pa de skyes bu'i byed 'bras kyi mtshan nyid/dngos po thams cad skyes bu'i byed 'bras yin te/skyes bus las byed pa ltar rgyu rkyen du ma tshogs pas bskyed pas na de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/(66) bdag 'bras/ zhes pa/ rang gi rgyu des rang dbang du bskyed pa'i chos de bdag 'bras kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dus byas thams cad bdag 'bras yin te/ rang gi rgyu tshogs des gzhan la ma bltos par rang dbang 359

du bskyed pa ma yin pa'i 'dus byas med pa'i phyir/ (67) bskyed 'bras/ zhes pa/ ma dag pa'am skyes bu'i byed 'bras dang 'dra'am snyam/ (68) bral ba'i 'bras bu/zhes pa/gnyen po shes rab kyi stobs kyis rang gi spang bya zad pa de bral ba'i 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid/gnyen po shes rab ni bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab la go dgos te bdag med kyi rtogs pa'i shes rab bdag med bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis rang gi ngos skal gyi nyon mongs dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa gang rung spangs nas zad pa'i cha de la/ bral ba'i 'bras bu zer zhing / de ni rtag pa yin pas 'bras bu btags pa yin gyi/ 'bras bu dngos gnas min la zad pa'i cha de la 'gog bden zer zhing / 'gog bden dang / so sor brtag 'gog dang /bral 'bras rnams don gcig go / (69) blo'i yul du bya rung /zhes pa/de ni shes bya'i mtshan nyid red /shes bya thams cad blo'i yul du bya rung ba ste blo'i yul yin pas de ltar brjod pa'o//(70) yin pa las log pa/zhes pa/ma yin pa'i don de/dper na/ka ba de bum pa ma yin pas/ bum pa yin pa las log pa yin zer dgos/yin pa las log pa cha zhes pa ni/ dper na/ bum pa yin pa las log pa yin pa las log pa zhes gnyis brjod pa cha dang /yin pa las log pa zhes 360

pa dang /yin pa las log pa yin pa las log jipa yin pa las log pa zhes gcig dang gsum bldab pa ya yin no// (71) ma yin pa ma yin pa/zhes pa/dper na/gser bum de bum pa ma yin pa ma yin pa yin te/bum pa yin pa yin pa'i phyir ro// (72) dngos rgyu/zhes pa/gong du bshad pa ltar/dper na/bum pa'i snga logs de ma thag tu byung ba'i bum pa'i rgyu de/ bum pa'i dngos rgyu yin/bum pa'i snga logs kyi snga logs su byung ba'i bum pa'i rgyu de/ bum pa'i brgyud rgyu yin no// (73) dngos 'bras/zhes pa/dper na/mig shes skad cig gnyis pa de/mig shes skad cig dang bo'i dngos 'bro'i yin pa dang / mig shes skad cig gsum pa de/mig shes skad cig dang bo'i brgyud 'bras yin te/bar du skad cig gasnyes pa brgyud pa'i phyir/(74) spyi'i spyi/ zhes pa/ shes bya spyi'i spyi yin te/ spyi de shes bya'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir/bye brag tu song ba'i rtags gsum ga grub ste/spyi shes bya yin/ spyi shes bya dang bdag gcig tu 'brel/ spyi ma yin zhing shes bya yin pa'i gzhi mthun du ma grub pa'i phyir/ zhib par〈 blo gsal rigs sgo〉la blta/(75) bcad shes/zhes pa/rtogs zin rtogs pa'i rig pa de bcad shes kyi mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/dkubum 'dzin mngon sum skad cig gnyis 361

pa dang/sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag skad cig gnyis pa lta bu/sgra bshad ni/ rang 'dren byed kyi tshad kkosnga mas sgro 'dog bcad zin pa'am rtogs zin pa'i byed pa ma nyams pa'i don de nyid slar yang rang gis 'dzin pa'am shes pas na bcad shes zhes brjod do//(76) rigs spyi/ zhes pa/ rang gi rigs can la rjes su 'gro ba'i chos de rigs spyi'i mtshan nyid/rig spyirang spyi gnyis san gcig ste/rang gi gsal ba la rjes su 'gro ba'i chos zhes pa dang / rang gi rigs can la rjes su 'gro ba'i chos zhes pa don 'dra ba'i phyir/(77) tshogs spyi/ zhes pa/ rang gi cha shas du ma 'dus pa'i gzugs rags pa de yin/mtshan gzhi ni/bum pa lta bu ste/bum pa ni rang gi cha shas mchu zhabs lto ba mgrin pa sogs du ma tshogs pa las byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis tshogs spyi zhes brjod/ tshogs spyi dang gzugs rags pa gnyis don gcig go / (78) rdzas chos/ zhes pa/ rtog pas btags tsam ma yin par yul rang gi ngos nas grub pa'i don dam par don byed nus pa'i chos de rdzas chos kyi mtshan nyid/ rdzas chos dang rdzas yod dang don byed nus pa'i rdzas yod dang / dngos po bzhi don gcig dper na/ gzugs lta bu khyod la rdzas chos zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rdzas kyang yin/ chos kyang yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ rdzas chos zhes brjod pa'i phyir/ des na rdzos zhes pa 362

dngos po la go dgos/ chos zhes pa yod pa la go dgos so//(79) ldog chos/ zhes pa/ rang gi dgag bya bcad ldog nas rtog ngor snang ba tsam du grub pa'i rtog pas btags tsam du grub pa'i chos de ldog chos kyi mtshan nyid/ ldog chos dang / btags yod dang / —rtag pa dang / spyi mtshan rnams don gcig dper na/ nam mkha' thogs reg bcad ldog nas dang / rtag pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa bcad ldog nas snang dgos pa'i rtog pas btags tsam gyi chos yin no//(80) rjes mthun/ zhes pa/ de dang mthun pa tsam las/ dngos ma yin pa'i don no// (81) rdzas yod chos gsum/ zhes pa/ rdzas yod chos gsum tshang ba/mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid yin stabs mtshan nyid yin na rdzas yod chos gsum tshang bas khyab/ rdzas yod chos gsum ni/ spyir mtshan nyid yin pa/rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du grub pa/ rang gi mtshon bya gang yin pa de las gzhan pa zhig gi mtshan nyid ma yin pa dnge gsum mo//(82) btags yod chos gsum/ zhes pa/ btags yod chos gsum tshang ba mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid yin stabs/ mtshon bya yin na btags yod chos gsum tshang ba yin— pas khyab/ btags yod kyi chos gsum ni/ spyir mtshon bya yin pa/ rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du grub pa/ rang gi mtshan nyid gang yin pa de las gzhan pa zhig gi mtshon bya ma yin pa dang gsum 363

mo/(83) dngos po'i ldog pa/ zhes pa/ dngos po'i ldog pa ni/ dngos po'i rang ldog nas 'jog dgos pas dngos po ma gtogs 'jog rgyu med/dngos po'i ldog pa yin na/ dngos po dang gcig yin pas khyab ste/dngos po dang tha dad las log pa'i chos de dngos po'i ldog pa'i mtshan nyid red/ dngos po dang tha dad las log pa la dngos po ma gtogs med do/ /dngos po'i ldog pa dngos po'i ldog pa min te/ dngos po dang tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ ri(8ci dngos po'i don ldog ces pa/ dngos po'i don ldog dang dngos po'i mtshan nyid 'dra bas/ dngos po'i don ldog la don byed nus pa 'jog de las gzhan 'jog rgyu med/ dngos po'i don ldog yang kho kho rang min pa rang ldog dang 'dra'o//(85) dngos po'i gzhi ldog ces pa/ chos de ma yin pa las log pa'i gzhi de la/ chos de'i gzhi ldog zer bas/ chos de'i mtshan gzhi thams cad chos de'i gzhi ldog la bzhag chog des na/ dngos po'i mtshan gzhi/shes pa lta bu dngos po'i gzhi ldog yin no//(86) dngos po'i spyi ldog ces pa/ gong gi dngos po'i ldog pa dang gcig la/ dngos po'i rang ldog kyang de dang gcig go/(87) phan tshun spang 'gal/ zhes pa/ dper na/ rtag dngos gnyis 364

lta bu ste/ dngos po yin par gyur na rtag pa yin pa spang dgos pa ste min dgos/ rtag pa yin par grub na/ dngos po yin pa khegs dgos so//(88) lhan cig mi gnas 'gal/ zhes pa/ dper na/ snang ba dang mun pa gnyis lta bu ste/ 'gal ba yin par ma zad/ lhan cig tu gnas mi srid pa'o//(89) brgyud 'gal/ zhes pa/ dper na/ rtag mi rtag gnyis ni dngos 'gal yin/ byas pa dang rtag pa gnyis brgyud 'gal yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ chos gang zhig mi rtag pa ma yin par rtogs na/ shugs la rtag pa yin par rtogs nus/ chos gang zhig rtag pa yin par rtogs na/ mi rtag pa ma yin pa shugs la rtogs nus pas de gnyis dngos 'gal yin/ chos gang zhig byas pa yin par rtogs na de'i shugs la rtag pa ma yin par rtogs mi nus kyang byas pa yin na mi rtag pa yin dgos/ rtag mi rtag gnyis dngos 'gal yin pas/ ri rtag pa min dgos snyam du mi rtag pa brgyud nas rtag pa ma yin par rtogs dgos pas de ltar brjod do//(90) yod par rtogs pa'i tshad ma/ zhes pa/ dper na/ bum pa lta bu yod pa yin par rtogs pa'i tshad ma lta bu'o//(91) dngos por rtogs pa'i tshad ma/ zhes pa/ dper na/ bum pa lta bu dngos po yin par rtosas pa'i tshad ma lta bu'o//(92) dngos med du rtogs pa'i tshad ma/ zhes pa/ dper na/ nam 365

'kha' lta bu dngos po ma yin pa rtogs pa'i tshad ma lta bu'o//(93) med par rtogs pa'i tshad ma/ zhes pa/ dper na/ ri bong rwa lta bu med pa yin par rtogs pa'i tshad ma lta bu'o//(94) rtag par rtogs pa'i tshad ma/ zhes pa/ dper na/ nam mkha'e lta bu rtag pa yin par rtogs pa'i tshad ma lta bu'o//(95) bdag nyid gcig pa/ zhes pa/ dper na/ bum pa de/ dngos po dang bdag nyid gcig yin te/ bum pa dngos po'i bdag nyid du grub pa'i phyir te/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ ngo bo gcig pa/ bdag nyid gcig pa/ rang bzhin gcig pa rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so//(96) 'dzin rnam dang / gzung rnam/ zhes pa/ 'dzin rnam ni/ yul can shes pa'i rnam pa can te/ shes pa yul du byed pa'i blo zhig dang /gzung rnam ni/ gzung ba yul gzugs sgra sogs kyi rnam pa can te/gzugs sgra sogs yul du byed pa'i blo la go bar bya'o// (97) sel 'jug ces pa/ rang yul la 'dod pa'i dbang gis 'jug pa de sel 'jug gi mtshan nyid yin la/ rjod byed kyi sgra dang / rtog pa thams cad rang yul la sel 'jug yin/ rang yul la sel ba'i rnam pas 'jug pa dang / rang yul la dgag pa'i rna ma pas 'jug pa dang /rang yul la sel 'jug gi blo gsum don gcig dper na/ bum 'dzin rtog pas bum pa 'dzin pa'i tshe na des bum pa ma yin pa rnam par bcad 366

nas bum pa la 'jug dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ bum 'dzin rtog pa bum pa la —sel 'jug yin pa dang / dgag pa'i rnam pas 'jug pa yin no/ /de bzhin du bum pa zhes brjod pa'i sgras bum pa ma yin pa rnam par bcad nas bum pa la 'jug pa ste bum pa brjod byar byas pa yin stabs/ rang yul la sel 'jug yin no// (98) sgrub 'jug ces pa/ rang yul la dngos dbang gis 'jug pa'i blo de rang yul la sgrub 'jug gi blo'i mtshan nyid yin la/ rang yul la dngos dbang gis 'jug pa dang / rang yul la sgrub pa'i rnam pas 'jug pa dang / rang yul la sgrub 'jug gi blo gsum— don gcig rtog pa ma yin pa'i blo thams cad sgrub 'jug gi blo yin/ dper na/ sngo 'dzin dbang mngon gyis sngon po de rang gi yul du tshur bsgrubs nas 'dzin pas sgrub 'jug yin la/ sngon po ma yin pa phar bcad nas 'dzin pa min pas sel 'jug min no/ /de bzhin du dbang shes 'khrul ba gangs ri sngon po snang ba'i dbang shes kyis kyang sngon po rang gi yul du sgrub pa'i rnam pas mthong ba las/ sngon po ma yin pa rnam par bcad nas gangs ri sngon po la 'jug pa min pas sgrub 'jug yin gyi/ sel 'jug min no//(99) 'dus byas/ zhes pa/ dngos po thams cad rgyu dang rkyen du ma zhig 'dus pa las byung ba'am byas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'dus byas zer/rgyu rkyen las skyes pa/ 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid red do//367

(100) —don dam bden pa/ zhes pa/ stong nyid la don dam bden pa zer/ stong nyid ma yin pa'i chos thams cad la kun rdzob bden pa zer/don dam bden pa dang ji lta ba dang stong nyid dang gnas lugs mthar thug dang chos nyid dang / yongs grub rnams don gcig kun rdzob bden pa dang ji snyed pa dang tha snyad bden pa dang stong nyid ma yin pa'i chos dang / kun rdzob pa'i chos rnams don gcig(101) rnam gcod/ ces pa/ dper na/ blo des sgra rtag pa yin pa rnam bcad la khegs na/ mi rtag pa yin pa yongs gcod la grub pa yin pas/ rnam gcod ni dgag phyogs dang yongs gcod ni sgrub phyogs nas bshad pa'o// (102) mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum/ zhes pa/ mtshan nyid dang /mtshon bya dang / mtshan gzhi gsum la zer/ (103) ldog pa rang rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur/ zhes pa/ thal 'gyur yang dag gang zhig ldog pa rang rgyud rang dang rigs gcig pa 'phen pa de ldog pa rang rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag gi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na bzhi yod/ thal 'gyur yang dag gang zhig ldog pa rang dang rigs mi mthun pa 'phen pa de/ ldog pa gzhan rigs 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu drug yod/ ldog pa rang rgyud 'phen mi 'phen ni/ rtag sbyor yang dag 'phen mi 'phen la go dgos/368

zhib par ra bsdus su blta bar bya'o//(104) rtags khyab gnyis ka ma grub pa'i thal 'gyur/ zhes pa/dper na/ ri bong rwa chos can/ dngos po yin par thal/ shes bya yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur 'di'i rtags ma grub ste/ ri bong rwa shes bya ma yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa ma grub ste/ shes bya yin na dngos po yin pas khyab pa med pa'i phyir/ thal 'gyur de'i chos can du 'gro rgyu de/ rtags su 'gro rgyu de min na/ rtags ma grub pa yin la/ rtags su 'gro rgyu de yin na gsal bar 'gro rgyu de yin pas ma khyab na/ khyab pa ma grub pa yin no//(1'a5) dbang bo'i mngon sum zhes pa/ mig rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus kyi dbang bo ste/ dbang bo lnga la brten pa'i shes pa la dbang shes dang / dbang bo'i mngon sum zer/ yid kyi mngon sum/ zhes pa/ yid shes su gyur pa'i mngon sum ste/ dper na sgra mi rtag pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i blo lta bu/(106) gzhan sel/ zhes pa/ gong du bshad pa'i dgag pa dang don gcig (107) rnal 'byor mngon sum/zhes pa/ rnal 'byor bas zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i mi rtag pa dang bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i blo lta bu'o//(108) 'khrul ba'i rtog pa/ zhes pa/ ri bong gi mgo'i rna ba ring bo 369

mthong nas/ ri bong gi rwa yod par 'khrul ba'i yid kyi rtog pa lta bu/(109) rjes dpag ces pa/ rtags dang gtan tshigs la brten nas bsgrub bya rtogs pa'i tshad ma ste/ dper na/ sgra chos can mi rtag ste/byas pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rtags sbyor la brten nas sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i tshad ma lta bu/ rtags sbyor gyi rjes su 'brangs nas bsgrub bya dpog pas na/ rjes dpag zer/ 'di dag kyang blo gsal rigs sgor zhib par bshad yod pas der blta bar bya'o// (110) rang don rjes dpag ces pa/ rang don rjes dpag ni gong du bshad pa'i rjes dpag yin la/ gzhan don rjes dpag ni sgrub ngag la zer/ sgrub ngag ni/ dper na/ gang byayon mi rtag pas khyab/ dper na bum pa bzhin/ sgra yang byas so/ /zhes pa lta bu'o//(111) rang las nges kyi tshad ma/ zhes pa/ dper na/ bu'i rgyud kyi pha'i gzugs 'dzin dbang mngon lta bu ste/ dbang mngon des rang gi gzhal bya'i bdag nyid pha'i gzugs de nyid la nges pa ste nges shes rtog pa rang stobs kyis 'dren pa las tshad ma gzhan la brten mi dgos la/gzhan las nges kyi tshad ma ni/ dper na/ don la me'i kha dog yin zhing /me'i kha dog yin min the tshom za dus kyi rgyang ring bo'i kha dog dmar lam pa 'dzin pa'i dbang mngon lta bu/ dbang mngon des rang gi gzhal bya'i 370

bdag nyid me'i kha dog yin pa'i nges pa ste nges shes rtog pa rang stobs kyis 'dren mi nus par phyis 'byung gi tshad ma gzhan la brten nas me'i kha dog yin par nges pa'i nges shes 'dren dgos pas/ gzhan las nges kyi tshad ma zhes brjod do/ /yang na rang gi gzhal bya'i bdag nyid yul steng du med na rang nyid mi 'byung ba la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren nus pa zhes sbyor ro// (112) ming sbyor rtog pa/ zhes pa/ ming sbyor rtog pa ni/ brda dus kyi don dang tha snyad dus kyi ming sbyar nas 'dzin pa'i zhen rig de ming sbyor rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ lto ldir ba bum pa'o snyam pa'i rtog pa lta bu/ don sbyor rtog pa ni/ don la ming gi tha snyad ma sbyar bar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa de don sbyor rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ skyes bu rta bzhon pa 'di su zhig yin snyam pa'i rtog pa lta bu'o//(113) rgyu 'bras chung ba dang rgyu 'brarme che ba/ zhes pa/ bsdus tshan kyi ming yin la/ de dag gzhung du gsal lo// smras pa/ rigs lam zab mo'i zer brgya spros pa yis/ /rmongs mun dbyibs su bskrad dang chabs gcig tu/ /rgol ngan 'byung bya long bar byed pa yi/ /rigs pa'i nyi ma de dag gtsug gi rgyan/ /'di na lhag bsam dkar ba'i skye bo yi/ /chos ldan bsgo ba ma bcag tsam zhig tu/ /mu to'i phye bzhin btus pa'i tshig tshogs 'di/ /snag shog gron pa'i yon du dbul 371

bar bgyi/ /rigs lam byang ba'i mkhas par mi mkho zhing / khong khrel khong 'dzum 'chor ba'i rgyur 'gyur mod/ /glen pas glen par mchu brda lag brda dang / /long bas long 'khrid mi byed ka med byung / /kun slong cung zad dkar ba'i cha mchis pa/ /rang gzhan rnam dkar rgya mtsho dang 'dres te/ /byang chen 'dzin ma'i lto bar yongs 'khyil nas/ /mtha' dag 'gro ba'i gsos su smin gyur cig/ ces dris lan gter gyi kha byang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 1983lo'i zla lnga bar phran pe cin du yod skabs/ pe cin mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis/ lo rjes mar〈 bse bsdus grwa〉par du skrun skabs/ mchan bu re 'debs rgyu'i gra sgrig dang 'brel/ dri ba snga phyi gnyis dang / — phyi ma la dri ba brgya dang brgyad cu yod mod/ don 'dra ba dang dkyus gcig pa dag bsdu ci thub byas te/ bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas lo de ga'i zla bcu ba'i tshes drug nas tshes bcu gcig gi bar du dri ba'i go rim bzhin kha zin sna zin du bris pa dge bar gyur cig/372 rdzo

brda sprod /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ / kun kyang zin pa'i sgra dang yul gyi skad/ /ngo bo'i ming dang mtshon byed mtshan ma ste/ /go byed brda dang tha snyad shes brjod 'jug /tshig don gnas brgyad sgra don 'dres 'dzin blo/ /don dmigs sgra byung mthun snang thun mong grags/ /mngon zhen rim pazhi chos lnga ldan par skye/ /yi ge'i don ston par byed pa kun kyang 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad la brten pa yin te/ brgyad ni/ sgra dang skad/ ming dang mtshan ma/brda dang tha snyad/ tshig dang don rnams so/ /de la sgra ni 'dir zin pa'i sgra sems can du ston cing lung ston pa'o/ /skad ni 'phags bod rgya nag sogs yang rang rang gi brda go bar byed pa'o/ /ming ni ngo bo nyid kyi tshig bla dwags/ chos mngon pa'i lugs kyi yi ge 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can dang / brda sprod pa'i lugs kyi rnam dbye mtha' can/ bum pa/ seng ge la sogs pa brjod pa nges don la blo gzhol bar byed pas nā ma ste ming zhes bya la/ don de mtshon par byed cing snang bar nus pa'i cha nas mtshan ma zhes bya'o/ /brda ni don de la tha snyad bya ba'i phyir thog mar ming du btags pa ste/ go bar byed pa dang smra bar byed pa'i dus can no//tha snyad 373

ni 'jug par byedatsho pa'i bdag nyid shes brjod 'jug gsum gyi rang bzhin can te/ de yang 'di ka ba yin no snyam pa'i shes pa ni btags pa'i shes pa dang / ka ba zhes pa'i sgra brjod pa ni brjod pa dang / ka ba yin pas khang khyim byed par rtsom pa ni 'jug pa ste spyi dngos la med kyang 'jug ldog byed pa'i nan gyis btags pa ste/ gdung 'degs kyi shing la ka ba zhes btags pa lta bu'o/ /de dag kyang don de'i ngo bo tsam brjod pa'i cha nas ming dang / don de mtshon par byed pas mtshan ma tha snyad kyi phyir sngar med pa glo bur du 'dod pas sbyar ba brda dang / de nyid 'jug ldog byed pa'i phyir brjod pas tha snyad do/ /tshig ni chos mngon pa'i lugs kyis/ ming 'dus nas don gyi khyad par brjod pa ste/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa zhes pa la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /brda sprod pa'i lugs kyis rnam dbye tidra subra gang rung gi mtha' can don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par ci rigs brjod pa'o/ /don ni chos rnams kyi gnas lugs ji ltar gnas pa nyid do/ /de ltar gnas brgyad po de dag la yi ge— dag ji ltar 'jug na/ sgra dang don gcig tu bsres nas 'dzin pas blo'i dbang gis 'jug ste/ blo de skye ba la yang / brda byed pa'i dus na shes pa gzhan las khyad par du byed pa'i chos lnga dang ldan pa dgos te/ don la dmigs pa dang / sgra las byung ba dang /mthun par snang ba dang / thun mong du grags pa dang / mngon par zhen pa rnams so/ /de dag so so'i nus pa yang / don la dmigs pas ni don spyi'i 374

nus pa skyed par byed do/ /sgra las byung ba ni sgra spyi'i rnam pa skyed par byed do/ /mthun par snang ba dang / thun mong du grags pas ni zhen pa skye zhing gzhan la go bar nus so/ /mngon par zhen pas ni ming dang ming can 'brel bar byed do/ /de ltar rim par skye ba'i chos dang ldan pa las ming la sogs pa skye ba dang / mngon par zhen pa'i rim pa la'ang bzhi la sog sa pa dwabye ba'i tshul zhib mo ni gnas brgyad rtsa 'grel sogs las rtogs par — bya'o// dbyangs gsal gyi brda chad/ ༄7/ /bla ma dang 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo /'dir sgra rig pa'i brda chad 'ga' zhig bshad pa la/ (1)mtshungs pa'i yi ge a i u ṛ lo rnams la mtshungs pa'i yi ge zhes ming btags te/ cho ga 'byung ba ste sgra sgrub kyi skabs su mkho bas so/ /(2)thung ngu ring bo plu ta/a lta bu ring cha med pa dag la thung ngu zhes brjod do/ /mig 'dzum gcig gi yun la 'bod dgos pa dang /—ā lta bu ring cha can dag la ring bo zhes bya ste/ mig 'dzum gnyis kyi yun la 'a4da dgos pa dang / a3 lta bu plu ta'i mtshan ma can la shin tu ring bo zhes brjod de/ mig 'dzum gsum gyi yun la brjod dgos pas so/ /(3〉slu ta'i mtshan ma/ ྅ 'di la plu ta'i 375

mtshan ma zhes bya la/ a3 'di lta bu la blu ta'i mtshan ma can zhes bya'o/ /(4)mtshams snasbyor gyi yi ge e e au rnams la mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge zer ro/ /(5)dbyangs legs sbyar gyi sgra rig pa'i brda chad la a i u ṛ lo e i o au rnams la dbyangs zhes brjod/ (6)nā mi'i yi ge i u ṛ lo e e o au rnams la rī mi'i yi ge zer ro/ /(7)ha sa'i yi ge ha ya wa ra la/nya ṇa na nga ma/ dzha nye dha gha bha/ dza ḍa da ga ba/ kha pha tsha ṭha tha/ tsa ṭa ta ka pa/ sha ṣa sa rnams la ha sa'i yi ge zer te/ thog ma'i ha dang tha ma'i sa gnyis brjod pas bar gyi yi ge dang bcas pa go dgos shing / de rnams la gsal byed zer ro/ /(8)a ba'i yi ge a i u ṛ bla e e o au/ ha ya wa ra la/nya ṇa na nga ma/ dzha snyo dha gha bha/ dza ḍa da ga ba rnams la a ba'i yi ge zer te/thog ma'i a tha ma ba brjod pas bar gyi yi ge rnams dang bcas pa go dgos so/ /(9)tsa pa'i yi ge tsa ṭa ta ka pa rnams la tsa pa'i yi ge zhes brjod de/ thog ma'i tsa dang tha ma'i pa brjod pas yi ge lnga ga go dgos so//(10)dzha bha'i yi ge dzha snyo dha gha bha rnams la dzha bha'i yi ge zhes bya ste/ thog ma dzha dang tha ma bha brjod pas yi ge lnga ga go dgos so/ /(11)dza ba'i yi ge dza ḍa da ga ba rnams la dza ba'i yi ge zhes bya ste/ thog ma'i dza dang tha ma'i ba brjod pas yi ge lnga ga go dgos so/ /(12)itra kyi ming can/ sgra sgrub kyi skabs su dbyi dgos pa'i yi ge zhig yod pa de la itra kyi ming can zer/ /(13)ā ga ma/ bar du snon rgyu'i yi ge la ā ga ma zer te/ yi ge 376

sbyor ba la phan 'dogs pas gnyen dang 'dra zer/(14)yon tan gyi yi ge.adra e ta o rnams la yon tan gyi yi ge zhes bya/ (15)'phel ba'i yi ge ā ādra i au rnams la 'phel ba'i yi ge zhes bya/(16)ṭi/ tshig gi mtha' na yod pa'i dbyangs de la ṭi zer te/ dper na/ u hi tsā/ zhes pa'i tsā'i srog gi zhi de la mtha'i dbyangs zer ro/ /(17)srog med kyi rtags/ yi ge'i 'og gi(le)'di lta bu la srog med kyi rtags zer te/ dper na/ bha ga ban zhes pa'i na'i 'og gi rtags de ni srog med kyi rtags yin no/ /(18)u pa dhā/ gsal byed srog med kyi sngon ma'i dbyangs de la u pa dhā zer te/ dper na/ bha ga ba na zhes pa'i na de srog med yin la de'i snga ma'i ba'i srog gi dbyangs de ni u pa dhā yin no/ /(19)yi ge yang ba/rjes su nga ro dang rnam bcad med la rang gi pha rol te yi ge rang gi g.yon na gsal byed rtsegs ma med pa'i thung ngu rnams la yang ba'i yi ge zer/(20)yi ge lci ba/ rjes su nga ro yod pa dang rnam bcad can dang / yi ge ring bo dang / yi ge rang pha rol te yi ge rang gi g.yon na gsal byed rtsegs ma yod pa rnams ring bo zer/ (21)rjes su nga ro/ yi ge mgo thog gi klad gor/ (22)rnam bcad/ཿ'di la zer te/dper na/kaḥ 'di la karnam bcad can zer ro/ /(23)yang dag par sbyor ba/ gsal byed rtsegs ma la yang dag par sbyor ba zer/brda chad rnams so//'dir/ phyag 'tshal ba sogs la bzhi ba/ tā ra/ phyag 'tshal ba dang 377

sbyor ba can la sogs pa la rnam dbye bzhi ba dang / na mo buddhā ya/ na mo sta thā ga tā ya/ sangs rgyas sa phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sa phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/busgyu dang / ga ta la rnam dbye bzhi ba'i nges 'byung ba'o/ /phyag 'tshal ba ni ched du bya ba'i don yin na spyir btang la 'dus kyang / de 'dra ma yin pa las dang gnas kyi don yang yod mod/ rnam dbye ni bzhi ba kho na 'jug go//swa sti rī dzha/bde legs su gyur cig ces te rā dzan+ya la nge byin pa yin/ rgyal bo nyid bde ba dang 'byor ba yin/ byed po dang / las rgyal bo la bya ba bde legs 'byung ba'i don yin na las su bya ba yin kyang / rnam dbye bzhi ba byung / swa sti ni/ su/ bzang / bde/ rab/legs/asti/ yod/byung /gyur/shog der songs shig pa'i don yin pas/bde legs su gyur zhes mkhas pa'i tshig rngam brjid can yin/ grong skad la bde shig skyid par shog go /bi ta ga tā wa tā ra dī ra/ mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo/ seng ge'i lta stangs kyis ngag don btsal ba/ rus sbal gyi 'gros kyis gzhung don bshad pa ste/ saṃ skṛ ta/ legs sbyar/ smre ba ni kyi hud la sogs pa'o// ༄༅/ /bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo//'dir dbyangs can sgra mdo'i tshig don cung zad 'grel ba la/ mtshan ni/ rgya gar skad du/ swa ra swa ste byā ka ra ṇa sru tra/ bod skad du brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo/ zhes so/ /'gyur phyag ni/ 'phags ma 378

dbyangs can ma lda phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /de yang thog mar yi ge so so'i ming brda bshad pa ni/ a i u ṛ lo mtshungs pa rnams so/ /yi ge de rnams la mtshungs pa zhes cho ga 'byung ba'i phyir du ming btags so/ /thung ngu ring bo plu tas phye ba rnams 'dra ba'o// yig gsar e waṃ/ ༄༅//na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ so rig bzhi yi thabs mkhas dang //bsdu ba bzhi yi nyams len gyis/ /bdud dpung bzhi ni rab bcoms te/ /sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs thob der 'dud/ /yig gsar e waṃ rtsa tshig 'god//dad ga brtson 5 dran pa sa/ /ting 'dzin sa dang shes rab sa/ /sngon du 'phul lnga'i bya ba bsgrub/ /ming gzhi'i e waṃ ngos 'dzin ni/ /sbyin sbyin ka daje tshul sbyin kha/ /bzod sbyin ga dang brtson sbyin 5 / /bsam sbyin sa dang shes sbyin ṇḍa/ /thabs sbyin 5 dang stobs sbyin nyu//smon sbyin ta dang ye sbyin kha/ sbyin tshul da dang tshul tshul na/ /bzod tshul sa dang brtson tshul sa/ /bsam tshul sa dang shes tshul sa/ /thabs tshul sa dang stobs tshul rngo/ /smon tshul thu dang ye tshul sa/ /sbyin bzod zhu dang tshul bzod sa/ /bzod bzod sa dang brtson bzod sa/ /bsam bzod sa dang shes bzod sa/ /thabs bzod sha dang stobs bzod sa/ /smon bzod hu dang ye bzod gi/ /rkyang ba'i sde tshan 379

de yis rdzogs/ /rkyang bar ra btags bdun po ni/ /sbyin brtson kyā dang tshul brtson gi/ /bzod brtson gyu dang brtson brtson pya/ /bsam brtson gau dang shes brtson byā/ /thabs brtson kyā ste bdun yin no/ /rkyang bar ra btags bcu bo ni/ /stobs brtson kru dang smon brtson lnga/ /ye brtson gru dang sbyin bsam nd+ra/ /tshul bsam drwa dang bzod bsam byo/ /brtson bsam sa dang bsam bsam sa/ /shes bsam sa dang thabs bsam ṇḍa/ /la btags drug ni stobs bsam klu/ /smon bsam glu dang ye bsam blu/ /sbyin shes ṇḍa dang tshul shes rlu/ /bzod shes snya ste drug yin no/ /ra mgo 'dogs med bcu gnyis ni/ /brtson shes rku dang bsam shes rgu/ /shes shes 5 dang thabs shes nd+ra/ /stobs shes 〉 dang smon shes ta/ /ye shes sdu dang sbyin thabs 5/ /tshul thabs rbha dang bzod thabs sa/ /brtson thabs tstsha dang bsam thabs rdzu/ /'dogs med la mgo can bcu ni/ /shes thabs skru dang thabs stobs lgu/ /stobs thabs lda dang smon thabs 3/ /ye thabs 3 dang sbyin stobs sna/ /tshul stobs sdu dang bzod stobs wā/ /brtson stobs lda dang bsam stobs sa/ /sa mgo 'dogs med bcu gcig ni/ /shes stobs sku dang thabs stobs 3/ /stobs stobs sdu dang smon stobs skya/ /ye stobs skya dang sbyin smon sdu/ /tshul smon sdu dang bzod smon sa/ /brtson smon sbru dang bsam smon sga/ /shes smon sna ste bcu gcig go /ra mgo ya btags can gnyis ni/ /thabs smon myu dang stobs smon ñtsha/ /sa mgo ya 380

btags can bzhi ni/ /smon smon skyu dang ye smon sgyu/ /sbyin ye sna dang tshul ye tstsha/ /sa mgo ra btags can lnga ni/ /bzod ye skru dang brtson ye sgru/ /bsam ye nd+ra dang shes ye sa/ /thabs ye spru ste lnga yin no/ /stobs ye ṇḍa dang smon ye smra/ /ye ye kṣu ru shes par bya/ /gzhan yang sngags la mkho ba'i phyir/ /g.yon dang 'og gi re'u mig /byang sbyin ghu dang byang tshul khyo/ /byang bzod 3 dang byang brtson spro/ /byang bsam sgya dang byang shes ṭa/ /byang thabs rdi dang byang stobs ḍā/ /byang smon ṇa dang byang ye ṣā/ /sbyin byang dma dang tshul byang 〉/ /bzod byang tstsha dang brtson byang ṇḍa/ /bsam byang ṅgha dang shes byang khya/ /thabs byang dzdza dang stobs byang mru/ /smon byang lha dang ye byang 〉/ /byang byang ༷ṭa kyi re'u mig rdzogs/ /brtsegs dang ke sha rnam bcad sogs/ /sngags kyi man ngag dag las shes/ /gnas dang gnas min mkhyen stobs ga /las dang rnam smin mkhyen stobs 5 / /mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen stobs da/ /khams sna tshogs ni mkhyen stobs na/ /dbang bo mchog min mkhyen stobs sa/ /thams cad du 'gro mkhyen stobs sa/ /snyoms par 'jug sogs mkhyen stobs nya/ /sngon gnas rjes dran mkhyen stobs sa/ /'chi 'pho skye ba mkhyen stobs lda/ /zag rnams zad pa mkhyen stobs sa/ /'di bcus 'jug pa'i bya ba batshub/ /mkho sbyin gi dngu snyan smra gi/ /don mthun ge dang don spyod sdo/ /stobs lnga dbang lnga'i sa gzhi bzung / /pha rol phyin bcu'i lam bgrod nas/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i sa thob ste/ /bsdu dngos bzhi yi 381
twe sde skre/shā py-i/ṭwāṃ/

kārdo65shātpa 61 ⑫/ brtsegs dang ke sha rnam bcad sogs/ /sngags kyi man ngag dag las shes/ /zhes pa rnams ni/ studzupya zlo busgyu/ 5dzu151myorngukudzukubee ro tsa na/'i'idzi1lngusmra kau sha rmya/ tworwa aḥcwarwa72dzu1sdu༅1ku~X: 3 ཿshākya two17rwa5rwa10rngudzukudzu1 smo i ma ṇi pa dme hūṃ i a ra pa tsa na ddhāḥ /two1sto5ku⑥11sdu15smo5trīpya11 two1sto glirsha2 rwaṇa1i rghaṃ badzra pā ṇi phaṭa/ i rghaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa lta bu'o//khang dmar dgon gyi 'khor lo'i dkar chag༄7//rlabs chen spyod pa'i yal ga gzhon nu dag /'phrin las me tog mdzes dgas yongs su 'khyud/ /kun phan dri bsung mngar bo yongs sbyin mkhan/ /nye sras brgyad dang shing rta che rnams rgyal/ /sa lam rtogs pa ral gri'i 'phrul 'khor gyis/ /kun nyon 'ching rgya ma lus dum bur gtubs/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma mi nub yongs 'dzin pa'i/ /gtad rabs bdun sogs dgra bcom tshogs la 'dud/ /blo chen rgyal ba'i gsang gsum su war na/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum rtsibs stong gser 'khor du/ /384

yongs bsdus snyan pa'i grags pa rab 'bar ba/ /thub dbang gnyis pa sras dang bcas la 'dud/ /lung rtogs bstan pa lha chen ral ba'i bcud/ /thos bsam hub chen gcig gis yongs bzhes nas/ /slar yang dbyig 'dzin lto bar yongs stsol ba/ /bshes gnyen drang srong rnams la kun nas 'dud/ /bsod nams dpal la rjes chags lhag bsam des/ /rten bzheng nor bu'i shing rta nyer drangs pas/ /rgud pa'i dbul ba bcom pa'i dpa' rtsal la/ /mtshar ba'i 'dzum pa mi 'chor rang dbang ci/ / de phyir dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa dang / /khengs ldan ngal gso'i zhor la skyon 'tshol gzhi/ /snyoms las pa dag ltad mor g.yeng ba'i rten/ /dkar chag mu tig phreng ba 'dir 'god bya/ /de yang phan bde legs tshogs ma lus pa sgrub pa'i gzhi dal 'byor lan gcig thob pa'i dus 'dir snying bo zhig ma lon par 'khor bar stong log byed pa ni snying rtsa rul ba yin te/ kun gzigs lnga ba chen pos/ da ni phan bde legs tshogs sgrub pa'i gzhi/ /dal 'byor gru gzings lan gcig rnyed pa 'dis/ /nges legs rin chen gling du ma phyin par/ /'khor bar stong log byed na snying rtsa rul/ /zhes gsungs so/ /snying bo len tshul lkang /rab tu byung ba dag gis/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tshul khrims dag pa gzhir bzung nas/ thos bsam sgom sgrub byed pa las/ rgyu nor gsog sgrub la 'bad 385

'bad dung dung byed pa ni 'di phyi'i sdug bsngal kun 'dren pa'i 'phung 'dre yin te/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ nyon mongs stobs kyis bsgrubs pa'i nor rdzas 'di/ /'di dang phyi ma'i sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas/ /gnas ngan len dang zag pa 'phel ba'i grogs/ /grogs dang nye du 'byed pa'i 'phung 'dre yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'on kyang kha na ma tho ba med par rnyed pa'i sgyu ma'i nor rdzos dag la snying bo nges par lenardagos pa yin te/ mnyam med jo bo chen po'i zhal nas/ 'di bas phyi ma ring bas phyi ma'i rgyags phye nor rnams gter du sbos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na 'dir yang dal 'byor don ldan byed pa dang bye brag sgyu gra'i nor rdzas dag la snying bo len phyir gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa 'di bzhengs pa'i dkar chag 'god pa la/ ji ltar bzheng tshul/ de ltar bzheng ba'i bzhugs byang / 'khor lo'i khungs dang lag len/ spyir sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang de la bsnyen bkur ba'i phan yon/ bye brag chos kyi 'khor lo'i phan yon/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba dang drug go/dang bo ji ltar bzheng tshul ni/ sprul ba'i sku rin po che 'jam dbyangs bstarwa 'dzin rgya mtsho dang dge slong yon tan rgya mtsho gnyer ba 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rnams dbus gtsang chos kyi ljongs su mjal skor dang 'brel grwa sa chen po dag la mchod 'bul byed du phyin skabs thog mar yod dgu gtong rtsis la phyis su dge mtshan gyi ltas su lhag pa'i dngos po dag 386

gis 'di ga'i ser skya thun mong gi bsod nams kyi rten dam par rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi chos 'khor chen po zhig bzheng rgyu la thugs mthun byung nas gtan 'khel byas so/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i me sprel lor lha ldan rtse shod kyi bka' 'gyur dpar gsar ma zhig gdan drangs/ de mtshungs khrin tu'u nas kyang ma ṇi dang yigatsho brgya sogs khri shog gsum dang stong shog drug lhag dpar nas gdan drangs/ bka' 'gyur gyis gtsos nang du bzhugs rgyu'i dpe cha po ti rnams la thum gdong dar/ dkris 'khor gyi dkris ras sogs sla chos su ma song bar gang lcogs kyi legs bsgrigs dang / kho bo la yang 'di skor gal gang che nas bkod chab dang khur len byed dgos tshul gsungs byung ba bzhin/ gang shes kyis khur blangs nas srog shing dang sa 'khor gnam 'khor bcas la sngags dang 'khor lo spel tshig rnams 'bri tshul paṇa chen bstan gzhi nyi ma'i gsung gzhin bzhag nas/ ladzi dang bod yig bab bstun gyis khral chos su ma song bar gang legs zhig byas khul dang / srog shing la dkris 'khor rnams tshags 'khyug med par dkris ras bzang bos dam lhod ran par dkris nas/ de'i phyi rol gzungs gzhug 'bul ba'i man ngag dang bhustun theg pa gong 'og dang rgyud sde'i go rim bzhin rtsegs tshul mthong ba tpargyud pa'i phyag len bzhin bka' 'gyur rin po che'i gtsos po ti rnams legs par bzhugs nas/ dkris ras dang dri bzang gi bar 'tshang dag gis bar 387

stong bsub pa sogs lag len dngos gtsang gang thub bgyis/ logs ris rnams kyang dus bab dang phan yon la gzhigs/ sbyin bdag gi 'dod pa dang yang bstun/ gtso bo 'di phyogs kyi bstan 'gro spyi'i bkra shis dang dge mtshan la rten 'brel gang 'grig zhig bgyis pa dbang bos mngon sum du mthong bzhin pa 'di lags so/ /sbyin bdag dag bskul slong dang 'brel rten dang brten pa ra bcas pa bzhengs pa'i 'gro song rang gzhan gyi tshegs brtson 'grus byas pa phud/ 'gro song kho nar rags rtsipas byas na sgor stong lnga lhag song 'dug la/ de ltar gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa rab rgyal me bya lo'i zla ba dgu ba'i tshes bco lnga la legs par grub nas sprul ba'i sku rin po che 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho khe tshang sprul ba'i sku rin po che sprul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs shes rab rnams kyis thog drangasadage 'dun pa bcu grangs shig gis rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga gnang ste dge mtshan dang byin rlabs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba sogs kyi rterne 'brel yang dag par bsgrigs so/ /gnyis pa de ltar bzhengs pa'i bzhugs byang 'god pa ni srog shing la dkris pa'i gzungs sngags skor ma ṇi dung phyur gcig dang bye ba gnyis dang sa ya gsum dngari 'bum gsum dang stong brgyad dang brgya/ yig brgya bye ba gcig dang sa ya dgu dang 'bum gsum dang khri gcig mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs 'bum gnyis dang khri lnga dang stong lnga/ mu ni/ a mi de wa/ gu 388

ru sirnyi/ wa gi shwa ri/ badzra pā ṇi/ tā re/ tshe gzungs tshe bsnyen/ phur bsnyen/a sha sa rnams khri brgyad dang stong lnga re/ gzhan yang zhol gyi chu 'khor 'di'i nang du spor bzhugs byas stabs de'i nang du gzungs sna tshogs pa yod kyang grangs ma nges/ de'i phyi rol du brtsegs pa'i glegs bam skor la/rgyal ba'i bka' rin po che bod du 'gyur ro cog rtse shod dpar ma dkar chag ltar cha tshang ba bzhugs/ de'i khar thar mdo tshar brgya dang gsum/bzang spyod tshar nyis brgya dang lnga bcu/ ltung bshags dang spyi bshags gnyis tshar stong re/ gzungs 'dus dzar gcig sa bcu ma tshar gcigasmon lam rnam lnga tshar gsum re/ gzhan yang bka' bsdu/ yon tan gzhi gyur ma sogs sna thung du ma dang / sna ring yeng gzhan kha shas bcas bzhugs/ logs ris skor la yang / thugs rje chen po sogs 'dod lha sna tshogs/ 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod/ ston pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis/mtsho ma dros par las kyi rgyu ba lung ston pa'i mdzad pa/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten klong rdol bla ma rin po che'i yig cha ltar/ sham bha la'i zhing bkod/ yang klong rdol bla ma rin po che'i yig cha ltar/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i dpe ris/ srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga ba ste gyan thang brgyad dang / gzhan yang ltung bshags lte so lnga/ sman bla sogs 'dod lha du ma dang / chos rgyal srong btsan/ mkhan slob chos gsum sogs spyi sger gyi sku drin che ba'i rigs dang / chos skyong / rgyal chen bzhi/ 'dul ba'i 389

dpe ris/ gong 'og gi lalja sogs thams cad rang rang gi khungs dang yig cha tshad ldan re gzhir bzhag nas 'bri tshul cha tshang sogs gang cha nas yid ches tshad ldan gyi khungs su bzhag chog go/gsum pa 'khor lo'i khungs dang lag len— mdo tsam bshad pa la/rgyud sde so so'i lha du ma'i las tshogs rnams su srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bzlog pa'i 'khor lo sogs 'bri tshul dang sgrub tshul gsungs pa rnams ni 'khor lo'i khungs yin la/ dper na dmigs brtse ma'i las tshogs bcu gcig gi 'khor lo dang rje sman khang ba la rje bdag nyid chen pos gnang ba'i las tshogs kyi 'khor lo dag ni/ 'khor lo'i khungs rnam dag tu bzung chog ste/ de dag gi skabs su dmigs brtse ma gang mang 'khor lo'i srog shing la dkris te/ rtsegs 'khor rnams kyi steng 3sa sham bu'i tshul du 'gebs pa dang / lag pas bskor ba'am rlung dang chus bskor kyang chog par bshad pa sogs rtsegs 'khor dkris 'khor lag 'khor sogs kyi rnam bzhag gsal bar bshad do/ /der ma zad rdo rje tshig sgrom las/ myur mgyogs 'khor lo bskor na tshe/ /zhes sogs snying kha'i sngags 'khor sgom par gsungs pa rnams kyang phyi'i 'khor lo'i khungs su nges par 'gro ba 'jam dbyangs bla ma rje dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang spyan ras gzigs kyi lung bstan ltar/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis klu yul nas ma ṇi 'khor lo phyag len dang bcas spyan 390

drangs nas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'igadong ba can la gnang / des te lo ba la gnang / des sgra bsgyur mar ba la gnang / des rje btsun mi lalhal gnang / des dwags po lha rje la gnang / de'i khams pa dbu se/ de nas rim par brgyud de karma dpang shi'i gsung 'bum du phan yon dang bcas pa bzhugs pa paṇa chen bstan pa'i dbang phyug gis gsungs pa ltar karma phyogs nas brgyud pa'i khungs dang / yig rnying’las/ yig drug 'dren dang chos 'khor bskor/ /dus gcig nyams su len byed pa/ /sangs rgyas stong dang skal ba mnyam/ /zhes sogs shin tu gsal bar gsungs yod do/ /lag len paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung dugasal ba ltar dang / yig cha rnams su dkris tshul yi ge phyir bstan nas dbu srog shing gi thad nas dkris te mjug phyi ru yod pa byed par gsungs pa ltar srog shing 'khor ba'i rigs la de ltar dgos mod/ 'on kyang srog shing mi 'khor bar dbyug rdos bskor rgyu'i lag skor dag la mjug sgril byas nas dbu dbyug rdo'i thad sor khel bar byed pa lag len yin no/ /dmigs rim ni las tshogs kyi 'khor lo rnams la so sor dmigs rim yod pa ltar la/ spyi khyab tu 'khor lo'i nang gi gzungs sngags sogs kyi yig 'bru rnams 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam pa can rang sgra 'ur 'ur sgrogo pa rnams las 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur spros te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi 391

rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim pas sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlas zhugs/ yang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros te snod bcud thams cad kyi ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod/ de thams cad kyis gzungs sngags sogs 'ur 'ur gsung bar mos nas bskor bar bya zhing / yi dam rang rang gi skabs kyi bzlas dmigs dang nad gdon nyer 'tshe sel ba sogs skabs dang bstun nas dmigs pa kha bsgyur chog ste/mkhan chen ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum du 'khor lo bskor ba'i dmigs rim tshig bcad mi 'dra ba kha shas yod pas der blta bar bya'o/ / bzhi ba sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang de la bsnyen bkur ba'i phan yon ni/ kun slong rnam par dag pas gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs pas gnas skabs su bar chad zhi zhing / tshe bsod rgyas pa dang / phyi mar sku gzugs la sogs pa'i rdul phran ci yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i rgyal srid la longs spyod par 'gyur zhing / gzugs gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams thob ste/ skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa spangs nas thar ba mchog sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni/ /sku gzugs rnam pa rdul phran ci 392

song ba/ /de yi grangs rnyed de byed mi rnams kyis/ /lha yul sa steng nges par rgyal srid 'thob/ /gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi ting nge 'dzin/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i sa mchog mya ngan 'das/ /tha mar skye dang rga la sogs pa yi/ /sdug bsngal med pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob ces dang / slob dpon ma ti tsi tras/ gtsug lag khang gi don du ni/ /tshig gis rab tu bskul ba dang / /tshogs pa yi ni logs byed cing / /nges par kun du 'gro byed pa/ /gnyid log pa'am langs pa na/ /bsod nams rgyun ni tshad med 'phel/ /zhes dang / parnyi ta nags kyi rin chen gyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhugs pa'i dri gtsang khang dang gtsug lag khang dang gnas mal bzhengs pa lta ci smos/ tha na de rnams kyi sgo khyams dang /g.yos mal byed pa'i khang phran tsam bzhengs pa'i ched du gom pa bdun brgyab na yang ngan song du mi 'gro zhing lha lus 'thob bo/ /zhes dang / dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa'i mdo las/ 'jig rten khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi rang sangs rgyas dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa bas/'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang zhig sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs gcig ri mor bris pa 'di ni bsod nams grangs med pa bskyed do/ /zhes dang // pad dkar las/ gang gi rtsig ngor gzugs kyi ri mo dag /bsod nams rgyal mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku/ /bdag gis bris 393

sama'abri ru bcug kyang rung / — /de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gsung gi rten bzhengs palda phan yon ni/ tshe rabs kun du rten bzang rnam par dag pa thob cing / sangs rgya sa mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba gzungs spobs sogs kyi yon tan thams cad bde blag tu thob par gsungs te/ mdo las/ bla med byang chub la reg bar du yang / /de ni ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes dang / /gzungs rnams dang ni gzugs dang longs spyod dang / /sangs rgyas mthong las nyams par yongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / snying rje pad dkar las/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus lnga brgya ba na/ tha na bris te 'chang bar byed na de ni bsod nams ches mang du bskyed par 'gyur gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bskal ba chen po bcu'i bar pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa'i bsod nams kyi phung bo ni de lta ma yin no/ /zhes snyigs ma'i dus su lhag par phan yon che bar gsungs so/ /de la bsnyen bkur ba'i phan yon ni/ mdo las/ 'jig rten dag na bde zhing skyid pa/ /de kun dkon mchog mchod las byung bas//de bas bde zhing skyid par 'dod pas/ /dkon mchog mchod la rtag tu brtson bya/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog gi rten la mchod bkur rgya che ba byas pa ma zad/ tha na me tog gcig phul ba dang / sems dad pas thal mo sbyar ba tsam byas pa'i phan yon la/ gnas skabs su bar chad zhi zhing bsam don 'grub pa dang / phyi mar lha mi'i rten bzang brgyud nas sangs rgyas 394

thob par gsungs te/ mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la thal mo sbyar ba'i phan yon bcu 'di lta ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ rgyal bo'i khyim du skye ba thob pa dang / rgya che ba'i gzugs dang / rgya che ba'i g.yog 'khor dang / rgya che ba'i mchod pa dang bkur ste dang / rgya che ba'i nor dang / rgya che ba'i thos pa dang / rgya che ba'i dad pa dang / rgya che ba'i dran pa dang / rgya che ba'i shes rab dang / snyergya che ba'i rtogs pa thob ste/ zhes dang / byams pa'i mdo las/ me tog snyim pa gang tsam mam mar me gcig tsam 'bul ba'am/ gzhan gyi bsod nams byed pa la rjes su yi rang ba ste dge ba 'di dag byed pa'i lha dang mi rnams kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ 'jig rten mgon po skyob pa la/ /dar gyi dbul ba phul byas na/ /lha yi dag dang mi rnams kyi/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs mtha' yas so/ /lnga ba bye brag tu chos kyi 'khor lo'i phan yon ni/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i 'khor lo'i rnam bzhag mdor bsdus las/ phan yon ni/ de dag rang rang bklags pa la phan yon ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad 'byung ste/ zhes dang /bsam pa rnam par dag pas gzungs khyad par can du ma bskor ba la phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de 'dra la reg pa'i rlung gis phog pa tsam gyis kyang sdig sgrib tshan po che byang zhing thar ba'i sa bon bskrun par gsungs 395

pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / yig rnying gi lung paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung du drangs pa las/ yig drug 'dren dang chos 'khor bskor / /dus gcig nyams su len byed pa/ /sangs rgyas stong dang skal ba mnyamachi/ /zhes dang / chos kyi 'khor lo zab mo la/ /na bza' legs par phul ba na/ /skye ba lnga brgyar gos bzang 'gyur/ /lcags kyu phul ba'i bsod nams ni/ /thar ba'i lam kun bgrod par 'gyur/ /dbyug rdo phul ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /gsang sngags bye ba 'bum bzlas las/ /'gro ba yongs kyi mgon du 'gyur/ /lha mi gnod sbyin phyag byar 'gyur/ /mi nor zas gsum dbang du 'du//'brelha tshad don dang ldan par 'gyur/ /grib ma phog pa'i sems can rnams/ /ngan song gnas las thar bar 'gyur/ /gnas skabs bskor ba'i phan yon ni/ /'go nad rims nad thams cad thub/ /phyogs ngan bdud gcod mi mthun phyogs/ /grib dang mi gtsang 'khon grib 'joms/ /bdud dang bgegs kyi dpung rnams 'joms/ /zhes dang / mtshams med lnga dang mi dge bcu/ /ngan song las rnams 'di yis sbyongs/ /sangs rgyas zhing nas zhing du 'gro/ /ba—de ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /padma'i snying bo ze'u 'bru la//brdzus te skye ba len par 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs so/ /bye brag yig drug gi phan yon gzhan las shesasnapar bya la phyag gi phan yon ni/ tshe rabs thams cad du lha dang mi rnams kyis bkur 396

ba'i gnas su 'gyur ba dang lha dang mi'i rgyal bor 'gyur ba dang / nam yang nyams par mi 'gyur ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs te/ mdo las/sangs rgyas mchod rten thal sbyor phyag 'tshal ba/ /mtho ris 'jig rten gnas shing lha dbang 'gyur/ /mir gyur na yang mi yi rgyal bor 'ong / /de ni nam yang yongs su nyams mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / pad dkar las/mchod rten de la gang gis thal mo sbyar/ /yongs su tshang ba'am thal mo ya gcig gam/ /yang na mgo bo skad cig 'dud pa dang / /de bzhin lan gcig lus kyang 'dud pa dang / /gang gi ring bsrel gnas pa de dag la/ /g.yeng ba'i sems kyis sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zhes/ /tshig gcig lan 'ga' brjod par byas pa yang / /de dag kun gyis byang chub mchog 'di 'thob/ /ces dang / phyag 'tshal ba'i lus kyis ci tsam non pa'i 'og dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bar gyi sa'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid thob par 'dul ba lung las gsungs so/ /skor ba byas pa'i phan yon la gnas skabs su bar chad zhi zhing tshe bsod rgyas pa dang / phyi mare dran pa dang shes rab sogs yon tan thams cad thob pa dang lha klu gnod sbyin sogs kyi mchod gnas su gyur nas byang chub 'thob pa sogs gnas skabs dang mthar —thug gi phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs la/ khyad par sgrib sbyong gi mchog tu bsngags pa yin te/ mdo las/ su zhig dad pas thub pa'i mchod rten ki 397

nam/ /sku gzugs dag la skor ba byed pa de/ /phyi ma'i tshe na dgra chen rnams kyis btud/ /bzang bo'i snod gyur yon tan rnams dang ldan/ /zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las kyang phan yon mtha' yas par gsungs la gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog las/ sems can gang dag mchod rten de la skor ba gcig gam/ phyag btsal ba gcig gis mnar med pa la thug pa'i bar la sogs pa rnams las yongs su thar bar 'gyur zhing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang sgo gsum bag med pa'i 'char g.yeng dang ngag kyal mi dge ba'i rnam rtog sogs kyi dbang du 'gro bzhin par phyag skor sogs byas pa la phan yon de tsam mi 'argyung bar gsungs stabs/ sems kyis dad gus dang / ngag gis bzlas brjod/ lus kyis phyag dang bskor ba gang rung ste/ lus ngag yid gsum tshogs pa'i dge sbyor byas na/ sngar bshad pa'i phan yon thams cad ma lus par 'byung bar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' bslu ba med pa las gsungs phyir/ rang la gces pa'i sems yod pa dag gis bya sla la don che ba 'di lta bu'i sgo nas kyang dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob pa don dang ldan par byed pa la shin tu nas kyang 'bad dgos so/ /drug pa dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ 'di ltar bgyis pa 'dis mtshon rnam dkar dngos po yod do cog /mchog gsum byin rlabs drod dang 'chi med rtsi yis legs 398

bran mthus/ /phyin drug kho lag rab rgyas dman pa'i myang 'das sa brtol te/ /'chi med grong du sku bzhi'i 'bras bu g.yur du za bar shog /yulo ljongs 'dis mtshon 'jig rten khams kun tu/ /nad 'khrugs la sogs rgud pa kun zhi zhing / /bde skyid snang ba dam pas yongs bzung ste/ /thub bstan sgron me yun du 'bar gyur cig /'brel thog kun dang mar gyur 'gro kun gyi/ /gnas skabs mi 'dod nyer 'che'i smag rim kun/ /rnam dkar snang ba 'di yis yongs bcom nas/ /chos 'byor bde skyid dpal la rol gyur cig /khyad par sdug kun nad brgya 'byin pa'i sman/ /thub bstan yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal bo che'i/ /dbu 'phang dgung la snyegs kyang gzi bajid 'od/ /dus kyi mthar yang lhag par 'bar gyur cig /bdag sogs deng nas skye ba3thams cad du/ /mi khom skye gnas dag tu mi skye zhing / /rnam smin yon tan brgyad ldan dal 'byor rten/ ca /mtshan ldan bshes gnyen dam pas skyongs gyur cig /de tshe tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa dang / /dad brtson shes rab ting 'dzin mngon shes sogs/ /ma tshang med pa'i yon tan sna tshogs kyis/ /bdag rgyud bum bzang yongs su gtams gyur cig /'khor ba'i skyon mtshang rig pa'i nges 'byung dang / /bdag pas gzhan dag gces pa'i byang chub sems/ /chos kun de nyid rig pa'i yang dag lta/ /'di gsum phan tshun 'gran bzhin 'phel gyur cig /phyin drug bsdu bzhi thabs mkhas brgya phrag gis/ /srid pa'i 'dam 399

du bying ba'i ma rgan kun/ /thar ba'i skam sar 'dren pa'i 'phrul 'degs kyis/ /rgyal kun dgyes pa'i 'dzum sgo 'byed gyur cig /rnam dag dbang bzhis ma dag 'khrud pa yis/ /gsang chen 'jug sgo dam par legs zhugs te/ /rim gnyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa las/ /'phrin las zer brgya 'dod dgur 'byung gyur cig /de ltar rgyu 'bras theg pa'i them skas la/ /'gro kun yongs su bgrod pa'i g.yul thabs 'dis/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa'i g.yul ngo las rgyal te/ /zung 'jug rgyal thabs mchog la dbang bsgyur shog /sras ba cas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'dzol med dang / /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu med rang gshis dang / /bdag cag dad mos lhag bsam gtsang ma 'dis/ /de ltar smon pa ji bzhin 'grub par shog /ces dkar chag mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos rgyan sprul ba'i sku 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang dge slong yon tan rgya mtsho gnyis nas 'jam dar srid du ring ba dang bkra shis pa'i mtshan ma can gyi dkar yol bkra shis pa'i rdzas kyis bkang ba sogs dngos skyes du ma bcas nan gyis bskul ba'i don du rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis par mjug rdzogs par bris pa dza yan tu// //'khor lo'i dkar chag 'di ni hong yon rdzong khang dmar dgon gyi 'khor lo zhig gi dkar chag tu gsungs pa red/ 'dir 'khor lo'i 'byung khungs dang phan yon sogs zhib par gsungs yod pas deng dus 'khor lo bzheng ba khyab che bar mkho b.radamigs nas lcags par du btab pa dge'o// 400
mechu ma reg tsam duṅgem parme— rnophang smaṅgede cung zadadog po — — —

༅sto dmu dge la/ ma'o ar ke/ rūpo༅ mdzod dge la/ ro ar ke/ lkolo~Xmago log la/ go lo/ lko༈cho bla brang la/ la pu lang / khri ṣiṣṭha gtsos la/ hi tsos/ṣpesgolta bu sa ming / mi'i ming la/ dper na sbyin pa la/ gyin pa/ nt+ra3 bzod pa la/ ro pa/ ོ༅ bsam gtan la/ sang mo tan/ ṭwāṃ.oṃ2yang na/ san tan/ 7ṣpe shes rab la/ she ro/ oṃtsheyang na/ sher po/i7 ṣṭha 'jigs med la/ ces me/ rke rsārnga chen la/ a chin/ ༅rsāsogs shin tu mang / bod rang gi yul gru 'ga' zhig tu yul skad kyi dbang gis sgra mi dag pa yod mod/ bod spyi'i dbang du byas na sgra gdangs lci yang gi khyad par tsam re ma gtogs 'dra ba yin no/ /de bzhin du rgya'i spyi 'gros skad kyi sgra gdangs yang sdod kyi ngag tu thon dka' ba yod de/ 'ib8dzis80batharnams kyi gdangs bod kyi ngag tu ji bzhin thon dka'/ bcings 'grol sngon du/ 4khyijode pe cing / zhes bris 'dug 'di rgya skad spyi 'gros skad kyi gdangs dang thag nye tsam yin tshod red/ bcings 'grol rjes su si khron gyi skad dang bstun nas/ pe cin/ zhes 'bri bzhin yod/ bod tsam du ma zad rgya'i yul gru 'ga' zhig tu'ang / 'di gsum gyi gdangs ji bzhin mi thon pa dang / snuchi2smoganyis dang / 3 byasmoganyis kyi khyad par thon dka' ba'ang 'dug — (2) 'tsho ba dngo thon skyed sogos mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis bod skad dang rgya skad kyi brda sbyor tshul mi 'dra ba yod de/ dper na/ ril ma la/403

lug skyag(༈lko)rta lud la/ rta skyag(yī0)lci ba la/ zog skyag(rgorsā)ong ba la/ zog gi skyag pa skam po/ (rhargorsā)be'u la/ zog phrug(༈waṃ)she'u la/shwa phrug(7༅)yu mo la/ shwa mo/(yiglo)sogs dang / ya ri/ yar mo yar ma/ thos ma/rngog bcad/ tho ri/ lu gu/ lag ga thong ba/ sha bzan sogs la ming ji bzhin med/ de bzhin du bod skad la'ang / ku ba'i rigs sogs sngo tshod kyi rigs mang bo zhig gi ming med pa sogs ni yul dus kyi dbang gis thon skyed dang 'tsho ba mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis re da/(3) bsgyur tshul gyi sgo nas rgya skad la bod kyi ming don shor ba yod de/ dper na/ bod kyi sangs rgyas pa la/bla ma chos/ ( lko7) dge lugs pa la/ chos ser bo(tstsham) rnying ma ba la/ chos dmar bo('im) karma ba la chos dkar po(dzee'i) sa skya ba la chos khra khra/ (7ma) bon po la chos nag po/(tsho7) zer/ 'di dag ni rgyu mtshan med pa'i bsgyur lugs shig red de/ bla ma ni slob dpon gyi ming yin pas/ bod kyi sangs rgyas chos slob dpon gyi chos dang / mi rigs gzhan gyi chos de slob ma'i chos red zeramin gang nas 'grig chos ser bo dang dmar bo zhwa mdog gis btags pa yin na/ karma zhwa dmar ba dang / jo nang ba/ sa skya ba rnams kyi zhwa mdog kyang dmar bo yin pas/ rnying ma gcig pu la chos dmar bo zer don ci yod/bon po la 'tshe ba chos su smra ba'i bon nag zhig yod pa bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan dus nas med par btang zin/ bon gzhung na chab nag dang 404

chab dkar zhes pa'i tha snyad cig yod kyang de ni 'dul ba dang sngags la bshad 'dug de las gzhan bon spyi la chos nag po zer ba zhig bod du sngar ma grags/ bon la chos nag po zhes btags pa bon po rnams mi dga' bar 'dug de bzhin du zhal ngo'am dge bskul la/ lcags dbyug bla ma/ (ṣṭhacho lko) dbu mdzad la kha grag bla ma/ (ṣkaṣṭha lko) zer ba'ang nang don stor ba yin te/ dge bskul la lcags dbyug can gyi nges pa med la/ bod rang gis dge bskul dang / dbu mdzad la/ bla ma dang slob dpon gyi ming gtan nas mi 'dogs/ spyir gzhung lug sa dang yig cha gang bsgyur na/ 'gyur legs mi legs bsgyur ba bo'i yon tan la rag las/ bsgyur ba bo de skad rigs gnyis char la mkhas par ma zad/ rig gnas spyi la mkhas pa zhig yin tshe/ bsgyur bya'i tshig don gyi nus pa ma shor ba zhig bsgyur thub/ dper na/ bod kyi lo tsā ba shong dpang sogs kyis legs sbyar gyi skad las bsgyur ba'i bod gzhung rnams tshig don gyi nus pa ma nyams shing go bde ba zhig yin pa da lta'ang mthong rgyu yod pa ltar red/yi ge mi shes shing chab srid dang gzhung lugs go thos med pa'i mi zhig gis thos ma thag tu go bar 'gyur ba zhig tu bsgyur dgosazer na de ni rngo mi thogs pa zhig red/ (ci bya ba'i yul dang bya ba gnyis kyi gnas mi 'dra ste/ bod skad la bya ba'i yul sngon dang / bya ba rjes su brjod dgos/ rgya skad la go ldog 405

pas/ rgya rigs blo mthun thog mar bod skad slob mkhan dag gis/ za ma za zer rgyu la/ za za ma zer— ba dang / ja 'thung zer rgyu la 'thung ja zer ba dang / zhwa gyon zer rgyu la/ gyon zhwa zer ba dang / smyu gu 'khyer zer rgyu la/'tshokhyer smyu gu zer ba dang / dpe cha longs zer rgyu la/ longs dpe cha zer ba lta bu/ de bzhin du bod rigs blo mthun rnams kyis rgya skad zlab pa'i tshe na'ang 'dra 'dra dka' tshegs yod/ (5) rnam dbye sbyor rgyu yod med kyi dbang gis brjod tshul mi 'dra ste/ bod skad la rnam dbye sbyorayul de nyid sngon du 'jog dgos te rnam dbye gnyis pa sbyar ba dper na/ gong la zhus/ gsham la bshad/ ces pa'i rnam dbye sbyor yul gong dang gsham gnyis sngon du bzhag nas/ bya ba'i tshig zhus dang bshad shanyis rjes su 'jog dgos/ rgya skad la rnam dbye sbyar rgyu med pas/ gong 'og bsnol bas go dgos te/ zhus gong / ('i2)bshad 'og(lkokokhro)ces pa tsam gyis chog go/'on kyang bod skad rang la'ang bya ba'i yul la rnam dbye gnyis pa sbyar dgos mi dgos pa'i khyad par yod de/ dper na ngas gzugs mthong / zhes brjod tshe/ bya ba'i yul gzugs la rnam dbye gnyis pa sbyar mi dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / lta ba dang / mthong ba gnyis mi 'dra ste/lta ba ni/ yul can gyi ngos nas phar lta ba dang / mthong ba ni yul gyi ngos nas/ tshur shar ba la go dgos pas/ gzugs la lta zhes par rnam dbye 406

gnyis pa la yig sbyar dgos la/ gzugs mthong zhes pa'i skabs rnam dbye gnyis pa sbyar mi dgos so/ /ngas gzugs la lta zhes brjod tshe/ nga byed pa po yin pas/ rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa sbyar bas/ ngas zhes grub pa de byed pa po ston pa'i sgra yin la/ gzugs yul dang las gnyis ka yin pas/de la rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba sbyar bas/ gzugs la zhes grub pa de/ yul lam las ston pa'i sgra yin pas/ las dang yul gnyis ka ngo bo gcig pa'i tshul gyi ston pa'i sgra yin la/ lta ba ni bya ba yin pas/ lta zhes pa bya ba ston pa'i sgra yin no/ /ngas gzugs mthong zhes brjod tshe/ ngas zhes pa byed pa po ston pa'i sgra dang / gzugs mthong zhes pa bya ba ston pa'i sgra yin pas/ gzugs mthong zhes pa de/ las dang bya ba ngo bo gcig pa'i tshul gyis ston pa'i sgra yin no//rgya skad la rnam dbye gsum pa dang / gnyis pa gang yang sbyar rgyu med par/ nga lta/ (7rsā)dang / nga mthong / (7rsāṭwā)zer/ bod skad la rnam dbye med par/ nga lta/ nga mthong zhes brjod na/ nga blta byar 'gyur/ thog mar bod skad slob mkhan gyi rgya rigs blo mthun tsho'i ngag la rnam dbye yong dka' tsam yod/rnam dbye lnga ba 'byung khungs sbyar rgyu yod med kyis kyang mi 'dra ste/dper na/ 'khor lo las bab zer rgyu la/ rgya skad la rnam dbye lnga ba 'byung khungs kyi sgra med par/ 'byung yul sngon dang bya ba rjes su 'jog ste/407

'khor bab/ (costso)zer/ bod mis go lugs la 'khor lo kho rang mar bab par go bar 'gyur ro// rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa yod med kyis kyang brjod tshul mi 'dra ste/dper na/ ngas za/ ngas 'thung / zhes brjod tshe/ rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa yod gshis/ rang nyid za ba bo dang / 'thung ba bo yin par bde blag tu go bar 'gyur/ rgya skad la rnam dbye med par/ de'i tshab tu byed pa po sngon du brjod pa tsam gyis chog pas/ nga za/ nga 'thung / (7khya 7u)zer/bod skad la rnam dbye med par de ltar brjod tshe/ rang nyid bza' bya dang /rang nyid btung bya lta bur brjod pas dgod bro ba'i gtam du 'gyur ro// rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa 'thob mi 'thob kyi khyad par gzhan yang yod de/dper na/ ngas las ka byed ces brjod tshe/ nga la rjes 'jug gi sa nges par thob ste/ byed pa po nga dang byed bya las ka gnyis so sor yod pas rnam dbye gsum pa nges par 'thob/ nga na song zhes brjod tshe nga la rjes 'jug gi sa mi 'thob ste/ na ba bo nga yin la na bya yang nga yin pas/na ba bo dang na bya gnyis so sor 'jog rgyu med gshis/ nga la rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa mi 'thob bo/ /bod yig gi ched mkhas pa blo mthun 'ga' res/ nga lag ka byed/ces rnam dbye gsum pa med par dpe brjod du bris pa ni/ yul gru 'ga' re'i skad gdangs mi gsal ba chag 'jog sa byas pa yin nam/ gang ltar bod spyi'i skad dang mi mthun no/ /de bzhin du/ nga 408

bris tshar song / zhes pa'ang nga rang gi gzugs ris bris tshar ba'i don yin na 'grig gi nga byed pa po yin na gang nas 'grig de bzhin du nga 'thung gi min/ zhes bris pa'ang nor ba shes sla/(6) bod skad la bdag gzhan dang dus gsum skul tshig dang bcas pa'i 'gyur ba yod la/ rgya skad la de med pas rgya rigs blo mthun tshos bod kyi skad yig thog mar slob dus dka' tshegs cung zad che/dper na/ bod skad la/ byed pa po'am bdag po la/ sgrub/ gzhan nam bsgrub bya la/ bsgrub/ 'das pa la/ btsubs/da lta ba la sgrub/ ma 'ongs pa la/ bsgrub/ skul tshig ga sgrubs/ zhes brjod cing 'bri/ rgya skad la tshig grogs re sbyar rgyu las gzhi gcig gi 'gyur ba 'di 'dra med 'dra/ de bzhin du/ zos/ 'das pa/ za/ da lta ba/ zo/ skul tshig yin/ rgya skad la/(lha)gcig pu 'gyur ba med par tshig grogs re sbyar rgyu red/ de bzhin du brgyab 'das pa/ rgyag da lta ba/ rgyob skul tshig yin/ —rgya skad la/ (po)gcig pu'o// bdag gzhan dus gsum skul tshig dang bcas pa'i 'gyur ba de yul gru 'ga' re ma gtogs bod kyi spyi 'gros skad la lci yang gi khyad par re ma gtogs da dung gnas bzhin pa red/ 'on kyang deng rabs kyi bod kyi skad yig ces/ rgya yig gi steng nas bshad pa mang tsam re byas te/ bod yig gi dpe brjod re gnyis re bzhag mod/ bod yig gi steng nas ri 409

brtsams na/ bod kyi mkhas pa dag gis kyang shes pas/ tshang mas dpyad pa btang na phan pa yod kyi/ rgya yig kho na'i steng nas brtsams na phan pa de tsam mi che snyam mo// (7) gsal byed kyi phrad mi 'dra ba/ bod skad la gsal byed kyi phrad/yin/ red/ ces pa gnyis yod/ rgya skad la de gnyis ka'i tshab tu/ ldogacig pu las med/ bod skad rang la'ang / yin dang red gnyis go don cung mi 'dra ste/ yin zhes pa ni/ rang gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gtso bo rang la 'jug pa'i gsal byed kyi phrad yin te/ dper na/ khyod su yin zhes dris na/ nga che ge mo yin zer ba las/ nga che ge mo red zer srol med/de bzhin du/ nga las byed pa yin/ nga tshan rig pa yin/ snezer rgyu las/ nga las byed pa red/ nga tshan rig pa red mi zer/red ces pa'i phrad ni/ rang gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gtso bo gzhan la 'jug pa'i phrad yin te/ dper na/ 'di su red ces dris na/ 'di che ge mo red zer ba las/ 'di che ge mo yin zer srol med/ de bzhin du mi gzhan dag la mdzub mo btsugs nas/ 'di las byed pa red/ 'di tshan rig pa red zer ba las/ 'di las byed pa yin/ 'di tshan rig pa yin mi zer ro//dngos po dang don la sbyar na/ rang gi blo ngor thag bcad cing dam bcas pa'i rnam pa ston pa'i phyogs la gtso cher yin zhes pa 'jug ste/410

dper na/myu gu de rgyu las skyes pa yin zhes dang / myu gu de rgyu las skyes pa yin te/ rang gi sa bon dang lud drod gsher rnams 'dzom pa las skyes pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu dang / sgra mi rtag pa yin te/ byas pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu/rang gi blo ngor thag bcad cing dam bcas pa'i rnam pa ston pa min par gsal byed tsam la gtso cher red ces pa 'jug ste/ dper na/ myu gu rgyu las skyes pa red/ 'di gser red/ 'di dngul red/ ces pa lta bu/ rgya skad la de gnyis ka'i skad dod la/ (ṣṭha)gcig pu las med gshis/ rgya rigs blo mthun tshos thog mar bod yig slob skabs yin dang red gnyis spyod sa nor sla/(8) gnas pa ston pa'i sgra la'ang mi 'dra ba yod de/ yod/ 'dugagada' rnams gnas pa ston pa'i phrad yin pa 'dra'ang khyad par yod de/yod ces pa bdag gzhan gnyis ka la 'jug ste/ bdag la 'jug pa/ nga yod/ (yi.oṃ)ces pa lta bu dang / bdag gi ba la 'jug pa/ nga la dpe cha yod/ (zaṭwāṃ.oṃ)ces pa lta— bu/ 'dug ces pa gtso bo bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan la 'jug ste/ kho 'dug(skya.oṃ)ces pa gzhan la 'jug pa dang / kho'i bca' lag 'dug(7skyilkospoṣṭha)lta bu pha rol bo'i dngos po la 'jug pa lta bu/ gda' zhes pa'ang gtso cher bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan la 'jug pa yin te/ 'di na gzhan su mi gda'/ bdag 411

gcig pu yin zhes pa lta bu/rgya skad la de gsum gyi skad dod la/ (rpā)dang / (ṣṭha)gnyis yod mod/ sbyor tshul mi 'dra ste/ (ṣṭha)zhes pa yod pa'i don du ma zad/ rag las pa'i phrad dang / dus ston pa'i phrad dang / yul ston pa'i phrad sogs la'ang 'jug pa 'dra ste/ rhapho7oṃ 2tshoṣṭhakhrizuzo7༷ 1ṣṭhaciṣṭhadzee(༷ ṣṭhanee 'i4(shāX lta bu sogs yod mod/ bod rigs blo mthun rgya skad la sbyangs pa cher ma song ba tshos khyad par 'byed par cung dka'/(9) ming tshig gi 'gyur ba'ang mi 'dra ste/ bod skad la spyir ming yin yang /ṇḍaṃtshigs grogs kyi dbang gis bya tshig tu 'gyur ba du ma zhig yod de/ dper na/ btung ba/ bdug pa/ bslab pa/ shes pa/rgyu/'gro ba rnams spyir ming yin te/ btung ba ni btung bya'i ming yin/ 'on kyang /btung ba zhim po btung ba na/ /ro 'dzin ro yis tshim par gyur/ /zhes pa lta bu'i skabs su/ btung ba snga ma ni ming dang phyi ma ni bya tshig tu gyur pa red/bdug pa ni dri bzang gi ched du bsreg bya'i dngos po'i ming yin mod/bdug pa bzang bo bdug pa na/ /tsan dan dri yis nam mkha' khyab/ /ces pa lta bu'i skabs/ bdug pa snga ma ni ming dang / phyi ma ni bya tshig red/ de bzhin du/ bslab pa ni bslab bya'i ming yin te/ bslabazupa gsum/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ shes rab kyi bslab pa zhes pa lta bu/ 'on kyang tshig grogs dang 'brel nas bya tshig tu gyur pa yod 412

de/ khyod kyis ting nge 'dzin la bslab par gyur na sems gnas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i bslab pa de ni bya tshig tu gyur pa red/ shes pa'ang ming yin te/ gsal zhing rig pa'i ming red/ 'on kyang / bden pa'i don de shes pa na/ /sems kyi spobs pa lhag par rgyas/ /zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi shes pa de/ 'das pa ston pa'i bya tshig tu gyur pa red/ rgyu zhes pa'ang ming yin te/ rgyu zhes pa skyed byed kyi ming yin pa dang / 'bras bu zhes pa skyed bya'i ming red/ bya tshig tu gyur pa yod de/ lag rtsal 'phrul las byung ba yi/ /gnam gru mkha' la rab tu rgyu/ /zhes pa'i rgyu de nyid 'gro bzhin pa'i don no/ /'gro ba zhes pa'ang sems can gyi ming yin te/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs zhes pa lta bu/ bya tshig tu gyur dziyod de/ bde ba'i lam du 'gro ba na/ /bde ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya/ /zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi 'gro ba zhes pa bya tshig yin la/ na zhes pa tshe skabaspuyin no/ /de rnams ni tshig sbyor gyi dbang gis bya tshig tu 'gyur ba yod mod/ spyir bshad na ming yin te/ bya tshig gi tshe/ dper na/ btung ba btungarsha/ bdug pa bdug bslab pa bslab/shes bya shes/ rgyu bya rgyu/ lam la 'gro/ shar la 'gro lta bu bya tshig gi tshe pa dang ba ma sbyar ba shas che'o// smin pa dang zos pa ni de dag dang mi 'dra ste/ bslab pa zhes pa bslab bya'i yul gyi ming dang / shes pa zhes pa shes byed kyi rig pa'i ming yin pa gong smos pa ltar la/ smin zhes pa bya tshig yin pa dang / de la pa 413

sbyar nas smin pa zhes grub pa'ang bya tshig red/ zos zhes pa bya tshig yin la/de la pa sbyar nas zos pa zhes grub pa'ang za bya dang za byed gang gi'ang ming ma yin par bya tshig tu gnas pa yin no/ /gzhan yang / bya tshig kha’shas la rgyu zhes pa sbyar ba/ 'gro rgyu/ zhes pa 'gro ba bo dang / snyung rgyu zhes pa snyung ba bo dang / shes rgyu zhes pa shes bya dang / byed rgyu zhes pa byed bya la go dgos la/ 'gro dang snyung la/ 'gro ba bo dang 'gro bya/ snyung ba bo dang snyung bya logs su med pas/ bya byed ngo bo gcig tu song ba zer ba de yin/nga 'gro/ nga na zhes pa'i skabs su nga la rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa sbyar mi dgos pa'i gnad kyang de la thug shes dang byed la/ shes byed dang shes bya/byed pa po dang byed bya logs su yod pas/ bya byed ngo bo tha dad yin pas/bdag gzhan gnyis so sor ngos 'dzin rgyu yod/ de'i stabs kyis/ shes pas shes/ byed pa bos byas zhes brjod tshe/ shes dang byed gnyis ka la rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa sbyar dgos/rgya skad la 'di 'dra'i zhib cha med pa 'dra ste/ rgya rigs blo mthun 'gas bod kyi skad yig bshad pa'i gsung rtsom nang du smin dang bzas la pa sbyar tshe ming du 'gyur zhes bshad pa dang / bslab pa dang shes pa zhes pa bkod 'doms kyi bya ba ston pa'i dngos po yin zer ba dang / 'gro rgyu zhes pa 'gro ba'i don dang / snyung rgyu zhes pa na ba'i don ston pa dang / phal cher ma 'ongs pa ston pa yin zer ba dang / shes rgyu zhes pa ma 'ongs 414

pa'i bya bar bkod 'doms dang / rjes sor shes rgyu kho na bstan par bshad pa sogs nya nyung bsres 'dug pa la dpag na/ rgya skad la tshig phrad 'di dag gi dod dang zhib cha med pa 'dra snyam/ (10) bdag sgra yod med kyis kyang mi 'dra ste/ bod skad la/ rta pa zhes/ rta la ba sbyar bas/ ba de nyid bdag sgrar song nas rta bzhon pa'i mi la go dgos la/ rgya skad la rta bzhon pa'i mi/ shelkophorki)zhes bdag sgra'i tshab tu bzhon pa'i mi zer dgos pa dang / bod skad la tshong ba/ zhes bdag sgra ba sbyar bas bdag por go la/ rgya skad la tshong mi/(sgrorki)zhes bdag sgra'i tshab tu mi sbyar dgos pa dang / bod skad la/ 'tshong mkhan zhes mkhan sbyar bas bdag po go ba dang / rgya skad la/ nom pa 'tshong ba'i mi/ (rsālko.o.arki)zer ba lta bu sogs mang / gzhan yang / tshig phrad mang bo zhig yod med mi 'dra ba dang / yod pa 'dra'ang / bed spyod tshul la khyad par mi 'dra ba yod do// bod rang la mtshon na deng dus kyi yig thog gi skad de spyi 'gros skad du gyur nas lo mang rab cig songe gshis/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi mi tshang mas dga' zhen byed sa zhig tu gyur yod/ 'on kyang bod yig gi slob gso'i bya ba de khyab brdal mi gtong bar rgya yig gtso bo byed pa'i stabs kyis/ bod yig shes mkhan tshos kyang bod yig bed mi chod pa dang /cung zad re bed spyod mkhan tshos kyang / brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang dag 415

yig dang tshig mdzod sogs la mi bstun par/ yul gru 'ga' re'i than ༄mong ma yin pa'i sgra re khyer yong nas yi ge gang byung bris na/ gzhi 'dzin sa dang / chag 'jog sa med pa zhig tu 'gyur/ bod kyi spyi 'gro'i skad kyi steng nas dar ba'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab ches mang bos zhib 'jug dang slob sbyong byed bzhin pa yin pas/ spyi skad ma gtor na dgos pa che zhing / gtor na gnod pa che/ sgra gdangs la zhib 'jug byed na'ang / sgra gdangs 'gyur lugs la zhib mor brtag dgos/dper na/ yod ces pa de bod kyi spyi 'gros skad red/ deng sang lha sa'i skad la/ yod pa red ces pa'i sgra de/ sgra yang zhing mgyogs tsam brjod pa'i stabs kyis/ cung zad 'gyur nas/ yo'i rjes 'jug gi da'i sgra dang pa'i sgra ha cang gsal bo rang med/ 'on kyang / yog red ces yo la rjes 'jug ga sbyar ba ni/ bod yig gi skye gnas byed rtsol sngon rjes kyi nus pa sogs gsal bo zhig ma mkhyen pa 'dra ste/ de'i sgra gdangs la rjes 'jug ga'i sgra gdangs med pa shin tu gsal lo/ /des na bod yig gi ched mkhas pa tshos/ yul gru 'ga' re'i skad rags rim re thos ma thag nas/ 'di kho na'o zhes kha tshon mi gcod par bod spyi 'gros skad lakhyang bar byed pa dang / gzhung lugs spyi dang brda sprod pa'i gzhung thun mong ma yin pa dag khong du chud par bya ba ni gnad kyi don po'o// 416

rje blo bzang grags pa'i mdzad rnam thung ngu / ༄7/ /rgyal kun ye shes chos kyi sku/ /dmar ser 'od phung mtshan dpe can/ /'jam dpal dge slong rnam rol ba/ /tsong kha ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi chos tshul nor gyi dpya/ /yongs su 'dzin mkhas sras kyi mchog /dar ma rin chen dge legs dpal/ /la sogs mkhas grub nyis 'dzoms kyi/ /skyes chen gser gyi ri bo'i 'phreng / /nyi ma stong gi 'od 'bar bas/ /snyan pa'i grags pa g.yu 'brug zla/ /dpyod ldan dag gi rna ba'i dpyid/ /'phrin las nyi ma stong gi 'od/ /gser ldan bu mo'i gos su bklubs/ /yab sras gsung gi ga bur zer/ /yongs su spros pa'i byin mthu las/ /skye 'gro'i tsha gdung kun nas bsal/ /thub bstan ku mud rab tu bzhad/ /de dag gsung rab bdud rtsi'i shater/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal bo'i zla/ /dpal du skrun pa'i dge 'bras 'bum/ /byang chen bar du zad mi 'gyur/ /de lta'i byung ba me na ka /rab tu 'dzum pa'i dge mtshan 'bum/ /deng 'dir gangs ri'i zhing khams su/ /rab tu dar ba'i dpal 'di shar/ /de yang rje tsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das slar byon pa bzhin chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor te/ bstan pa 417

rin po che'i dar mo che de nyid srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du bsgrengs par byas pa'i skyes bu rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid ni bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bod chol kha gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan mdo smad rta'i chol kha'i sa khongs tsong kha'i yul du sku bltams/ lte khrag 'phos pa'i sar tsan dan sdong bo 'khrungs pa'i sdong bo'i lo ma re re'i steng du rgyalawā seng ge'i nga ro'i sku re re rang byon du yod pa'i sdong bo la phyi rol rdo rtsig gi mchod rten/de'i phyir zangs gser gyis g.yogs shing rin po che rin thang bral ba du mas spras te bzhugs pa de la phyi gtsug lag khang rgya phibs dang mda' yab gser zangs las grub pa de la sku 'bum gser gdung chen mo zepar zhing /gnas der dgon sde chags pa rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtshos sku 'bum byams pa gling zhes mtshan gsol te bdag gir bzhes pa'i chos sde chen po de nyid da lta'i bar du dar zhing rgyas bzhin pa'o/ /gnas der sku 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni/ shar phyogs rig pa'i dpa' bo chos rje don grub rin chen zhes grags pa'i mkhas grub chen po de nyid gnas de'i phur dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor skyong bzhin bzhugs pa'i skabs su mtshan lam du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis zhal yang yang bstan/zhal dngos su mjal 'dod kyi gsol ba yang yang btab pas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhal nas sang phod da mtshams lung ba 'di'i mdor 'ong gis gsungs/ phyi lo rab byung drug pa'i me mo bya'i(1357)lor yab klu 418

'bum dge dang yum shing bza' a chos gnyis kyi sras su 'jam dpal zhi khro'i sprul ba rje bla ma 'di ba sku 'khrungs/ de'i skabs su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas sna tshogs byung ba ni rnam thar chen mor lta'o/ /de nas dgung lo gsum cibazhes tshe karma ba rol ba'i rdo rje las yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan kun dga' snying bo gsol/ de'i tshe rol ba'i rdo rjes gzhon nu 'di nyid sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu zhig 'byung zhes lung bstan tshul rol ba'i rdo rje'i rnam thar lam yig las gsungs/ de nas chos rje don grub rin chen gyis bu 'di nga la phul cig gsungs pa ltar yab kyis chos rje don grub rin rin chen la phul/ chos rje'i mdun nas klog bslabs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ 'khor lo bde mchog kye rdo rje/ phyag na rdo rje sogs kyi dbang bskur/ gsang mtshan don yod rdo rje btags/ yi dam dang jo bo rje sogs mnal lam du yang byon nas byin gyis rlabs/ dgung lo bdun bzhes tshe chos rje don grub rin chen las rab tu byung / mtshan blo bzang grags pa zhes gsol/ chos rje don grub rin chen pa'i zhal snga las mdo sngags kyi chos mang bo gsan/ dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa'i tshe/ de skabs mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che gnas yul ni dbus gtsang yin la/khong rang nyid dam pa'i chos 'tshol ba la dpa' zhing brtul phod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin gshis/ deng dus dang mi 'dra bar lam thag ring ba'i dka' ba brgya phrag la mi 'dzem par dbus gtsang du phebs bzhed kyi 419

thugs dgongs bzlog tu med pa 'khrungs shing / bla ma'i bkas kyis bskul ba la brten nas 'bri khung thil gyi 'grul ba dang 'grogs nas dbus phyogs su bzhud/ thog mar rab byung drug pa'i chu mo glang gi lo'i ston gyi dus su 'bri khung dpal gyi nags khrod du 'byor/ 'bri khung spyan snga rin po che'i drung nas theg chen sems bskyed dang / phyag chen lnga ldan la sogs pa gsan/ de nas bde ba can nas bla ma 'jam rin pa sogs kyi spyan sngar byams chos sde lnga sogs phar phyin skor la sbyangs pas mkhas par gyur te dgung lo bcu dgu'i thog tu gsang phu dang bde ba can sogs su grwa skor mdzad/ gtsang phyogs kyi zha lu/ sa skya/ la stod byang / 'dar bzang ldan/ngam ring / jo nang / bo dong / snar thang / nyang stod sogs su byon nas bla ma du ma'i mdun nas mdo sngags kyi chos du mar gsan sbyang mdzad nas chos sde du mar grwa skor mdzad/ de nas rje btsun red mda' ba chen po'i drung nas mngon pa mdzod dang dbu tshad sogs mdo sngags kyi chos shin tu mang bo gsan/ de skabs shig nas ting nge 'dzin zab mo thugs la 'khrungs pa dang / srid pa'i bde 'byor mtha' dag mi rtag cing / sgyu ma'i bslu brid dang 'dra bar rtogs pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can thugs la 'khrungs/ rnam 'grel gyi rnam bshad rigs mdzod la gzigs rtogs mdzad pas/ chos kyi grags pa'i gzhung lugs dang rigs pa'i srol la dad pa shugs drag po 'khrungs shing / dad pa'i spu long g.yos te spyan chab 420

yang dang yang du byung ba zhig byung / gzhan yang mkhas pa du ma las tha snyad kyi rig gnas sgra dang / sman rtsis/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor sogs la sbyang bas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ de nas ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa kha che'i paṇḍi ta bsod snyoms pa chen po shrī bha dra'i mkhan rgyud/ tshogs chen po'i mkhan po dka' bzhi ba tshul khrims pas mkhan po mdzad/ tshogs pa byi rdzing ba'i mkhan po gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa sher mgon pas las kyi slob dpon mdzad/ byi rdzing ba'i dbu mdzad sdom brtson bsod nams rdo rjes gsang ste ston pa mdzad cing / tshogs pa gnyis kyi dge slong kha skong du 'os pa grangs tshang bas dad pa'i dge 'dun mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa yang dag par bzhes te/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i lha'i chu bos thugs rgyud kyi bum bzang nye bar gtams shing / lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pur gyur to// de nas rje red mda' ba chen po'i zhal snga las gsang 'dus kyi dbang gsan te gsang 'dus la sbyangag bla ma dam pa rtogs ldan ye shes rgyal mtshan/ gong gsum sde chen pa chos kyidapal ba/ rin po che khyung bo lhas pa sogs las dus 'khor/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs dang / mi tra rdor phreng sogs spyi zur gyi chos bka' dbang da nga / rjes gnang khrid man ngag cho ga'i lag len/ dbyangs rta sa gsum sogs gsang sngags 421

rgyud sde bod du 'gyur ro cog gsan par ma zad/ sbyang brtson bla na med pa gnang / lhag lha du ma'i bsnyen mtsham la bzhugs te sgrub pa mthar thon par mdzad/ bla ma dbu ma ba la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs nas gsung gi bdud rtsi myong ba sngar nas yod pas/ rje 'di bar zhal dngos su ma gzigs pa'i tshulariganang ba'i sngon du bla ma dbu ma bas lo tsā mdzad de rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rje 'di ba la 'jam dbyangs chos skor sogs mdo rgyud kyi gdam pa ches mang bo gnang / stis su rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal dngos su gzigs te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad nas/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum sogs gdam pa dpag tu med pa gsan/rje rin po che 'di ni thog ma med pa nas legs par sbyangs pa'i rigs kyi nus pa yongs su smin pa'i dbang gis gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas par thos bsam sgom pa ji snyed cig mdzad pa thams cad la'ang /tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur dang / snyan grags dang / 'khor dang / 'du 'god phun sum tshog sa pa dang / bdag nyid gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa nyid du gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa sogs kyikwan slong gi dri tsam yang ma 'dres par gcig tu thams cad mkhyen pa'i ched du dmigs pa 'ba' zhig gi thugs rang dbang med par 'phrogs te/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che thugs la mngon par 'khrungs so/ /de nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la dbu ma'i lta ba dang / sngags mtshan nyid kyi khyad par rim lnga'i 422

go rim/ drang nges sogs mtha' yas paske zhig gi dri ba mdzad dogs pa chod pa'i ched du brgal zhing brtag pa'i sgo nas dri ba la sogs pa gtso bor mdzad do/ /de tshe rje 'di'i thugs yul na'ang khas len ci'ang med cing gang yang rang lugs la bzhag pa med par/ gzhan ngo 'ba' zhig la skyel ba'i dbu ma'i lta ba de cung thugs la bde bar yod pas/bdag gi dbu ma'i lta ba 'di thal rang gang gi lta bathan zhus pas/ gang gi'ang min zhes gsungs shing / gsung rab kyi gnad mang bo gsungs so/ /de'i tshe gzhan yang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs zhal nas/ da phyin chad bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad du byas pa la gsol ba 'debs pa/ sngar bsags kyi sdig ltung sbyong zhing tshogs rgya chen po gong nas gong du spel ba'i bsags sbyang la 'bad pa/ shing rta chen po rnams kyi rigs lam la brten nas mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i don la zhib tu dpyad pa gsum sum sgril du gyis la rgyun ma chad par nyams su longs dang / mdo rgyud kyi don mtha' dag la mi 'khrul ba'i nges pa rnyed par 'gyur/ da lta nas bshad pa byas kyang phan 'dogs ltar snang las mi 'ong bas/ re zhig bya bral byas te dben pa brten nas sgrub pa snying bor gyis shig ces bskul bar mdzad do/ /de ltar bskul ba dang / rje nyid kyis kyang tshul 'di legs par dgongs nas bya bral mdzad cing / dben— pa brten nas sgrub pa snying bo mdzad pa la thugs thag bcad do/ /dgung lo sum cu rtsa drug pa la skyor mo 423
