gling nas phyag bteg rin po che 'jam dkar ba/ dpal ldan grags pa dang / rtogs ldan byang seng ba/ gnas brtan rin chen rgyal mtshan/gnas brtan bzang skyong ba ste da bus pa bzhi/ bla ma rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ dge bshes shes rab grags/ dge bshes 'jam dpal bkra shis/ dge bshes dpal skyong ste mdo smad pa bzhi dang bcas pa 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad du grags pa phyag phyir khrid de/ 'ol khar bya bral la phebasu/ thog mar bsags sbyang gnad che bar dgongs te/dpon slob thams cad kyis stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bsags sbyang la shin tu 'grus par mdzad/rje rin po che rang gis kyang /ltung bshags brgya phyag dang bcas pa dang phyag sor rtse mo rnamasarmo ser gar song gi bar du maṇḍal 'bul ba sogs dpag par dka' ba'i brtson pa drag po mdzad cing /mdo sangs rgyas phal bo che sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che rnams ston pa'i mdo sde rnams la gzigs rtog zhib par mdzad do//bya bral la ma byon pa'i gong nyid nas de bar du dpyad pa nar mar mdzad na'ang mthar thug pa'i gnad la mi bde ba gtan nas log pa'i nges pa 'dren ma thub/ gnas der bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs tha mi dad du byas shing gsol ba drag tu 'debs pa dang / rig pas dpyad pa zhib tu mdzad pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can yang byung / slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyinga'agrel ba burta pā li ta legs par gzigs pas kyang 424

mtshams sbyar te mgon po klu sgrub yab sras kyi lta ba'i gnad mthar thug pa dang dgag bya'i mtshams 'dzin sogs la sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i nges pa gting tshugs pa 'khrungs shing / mtshan 'dzin gyi dmigs gtad thams cad zhig de kho na nyid kyi don la mtha' gzhan du dogs pa'i sgro 'dogs lhag ma med par chod par gyur te ston pa la shes nas dad pa thob pa'i shugs kyis drangs pa zab mo rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsungs pa'i sgo nas bstod pa legs par bshad pa'i snying bo zhes bya ba mdzad do/ /de ltar rje bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas zin kyang thun mong gi snang ngor sngar mi rtag pa dang /nges 'byung gi bsam pa khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa dang /de rjes byang chub kyi sems rin po che yang dag par thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing /da lan lta ba yang dag pa thugs la 'khrungs te legs bshad snying bo che chung / rtsa shes ṭīka chen rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal sogs dang /lam rim che chung gi lhag mthong gi skabs su lta ba rnam par dag pa gtan la phabs pas/bod kyi mkhas dgu phal mo che slob mar gyur te/zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs/ slob mar ma gyur pa'i mkhas pa dag gis kyang 'phrin yig la sogs pa'i lam nas bstod bsngags cher mdzad do/ /hūṃ hūṃ dang phaṭa phaṭa kyis bskor zer ba ni bdud kyi gtam mo//de ltar thun mong lam sbyang sngon du song nas gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i nyams len la tshe gcig tu 425

gzhol bas/ sngags lam gyi snying bo bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i tshe rgyan drug mchog galtas dang a bha ya ka ra dang /nag po spyod pa sogs paṇa grub mang bos zhal gzigs shing /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dang dus kyi 'khor lo sogs yi dam dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs shing gsung gis dbugs dbyung / der brten gsang sngags kyi bstan bcos rnam par dag pa/ gsang sngags lam rim dang / rim lnga gsal sgron/ sngas don kun gsal sogs sngags kyi gzhung shin tu mang bo mdzad/ gnam rtse lding du chos rje ṅgem gsum zhal 'dzoms te bstan pa'i gzhi ma chos 'dul ba la dag ther mdzad/gnas gzhan du byang sems dang sngags kyi sdom pa dam tshig la dag ther mdzad de sdom gsum gyi gzhung mdzad/ dbus gotsang gi chosarme sde dang gnas chen rnams su mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen du ma'i bshad pa yod pas/ chos nyan dge 'dun pa stong phrag mang bo 'dus/ slob ma mkhas chen bstan pa rin po che spel pa'i slob ma brgya phrag mang bo yod pa rnam thar ltar la/ gsang chen rgyud sde'i lam la brten nas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por slebs pa'i slob ma bgrang las 'das/de ltar 'chad pa'i yon tan ma zad rtsod pa'i yon tan ni/dbus gtsang gi chos sde che khag rnams su grwa skor mdzad pas gangs can gyi mkhas pa yongs kyi yid rang dbang med par drangs te bstod bsngags kyi rol mo dgrol/rtsom pa'i yon tan ni byang chub lam gyi rim pa che chung sogs skye bo 426

rnams thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar bgrod pa'i mdo sngags kyi legs bshad le tshan brgya phrag brtsams/ lha ldan smon lam chen mo gsar tshugs dang /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btabs/slob ma dang yang slob rnams kyis dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i chos sde che chung du ma btab ste nor 'dzin bu mo'i lto ba gang bar byas/ rje'i sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs bskyed la brten nas stod bal bo dang rgya gar nas bzung / smad rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar du zhwa ser bstan pas yongs su khyab bo/ /gzhan yang bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan sngar smon lam btab pa'i mthu grub pa yin te/ stag tshang lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ blo chen rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan snga ru/ /bzang bo'i smon lam rlabs chen grub pa'i mthus/ /grags pa'i sgra chen thub bstan 'gro ba'i dpal/ /blo bzang grags pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / rje 'di gzhon nu'i dus su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mngon par rtogs pa rgyan gyi 'grel ba legs bshad gser gyi phreng ba brtsams pas mkhas rlom kun gyi nga rgyal ri bo bsnyil ba yin te/ stag tshang lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ khyod blo'i nyi ma meezhon nu'i dus kyi tshe/ /mdo dang rgyan gyi pad tshal rgyas mthong nas/ /ba tsho/ khengs pa'i ku mud lhag par zum/ /zab yangs mkhyen pa'i gter laci phyag 'tshal lo /zhes dang / bod 'dir tshig don la mkhas shing gzhung don nyams su len mkhan srid mtha' tsam du gyur pa'i skabs su rje 'di nyid byon pa yin te/427

stag tshang lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ byang phyogs 'di na tshig tsam byang ba'ang dkon/ /don la sgro 'dogs chod pa de bas dkon/ /bstan don nyams su len mākhan srid mtha' tsam/ /'di gsum mthar phyin khyod la snying nas 'dud/ /ces dang / lung rigs gnyis ka ya bral du song bas bstan pa 'dzin par rlom pa mang bo byung ba'i skabs su lung rigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bstan pa'i bdag po rje 'di nyid byung ba yin te/stag tshang lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ la la rigs bral lung gi grub mtha' 'jogakha cig lungakhral rigs ltar snang ba tsam/ /lung rigs gnyis ka'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun/ /legs par 'byed pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / 'dul ba dang sngags gnyis tsha grang ltar 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i dus su bstan pa mtha' dag 'gal med du nyams su len pa'i rje bla ma 'di byung ba yin te stag tshang lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ kha cig 'dul ba gtsor byas gsang sngags spong / /gzhan dag sngags la mos blos 'dul ba 'gog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa mtha' dag 'galo med du/ /rdzogs par nyams su len mkhas khyod la 'dud/ /ces dang / mdo sngags gnyis ka res 'jog tu song ba'i skabs su mdo sngags mtha' dag gru bzhi lam du 'khyer ba'i rje bla ma 'di byung ba yin te/ stag tshang lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ mtshan nyid mchog bzung gsang sngags bza' chos dang / /sngags kyis khengs nas mtshan nyid kha bshad tsam/ /mdo sngags— mtha' dag ma tshang rdzogs byang 428

du/ /'gro thabs med par gzigs pa khyod la 'dud/ /ces dang / kha cig lta spyod gnyis ka 'gal bar spyod cing / rje bla ma 'di nyid kyis lta spyod gnyis ka phan tshun rgogs su shar ba'i tshul 'doms par mdzad pa yin te/stag tshang lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ la la spyod pa zhib mos lta ba 'gog /kha cig lta ba mthon pos spyod pa 'dor/ /lta spyod phan tshun grogs su shar ba yi/ /don du lhag par 'doms pa khyod la 'dud/ /ces dang / bshad smreb gnyis ka'i sgo nas lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad pa yin te/ stag tshang lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ 'ga' zhig bshad pa gtsor byas sgom la smod/ /la la sgom gyis chog 'dzin lung la smod/ /bshad sgrub gnyis kas lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /'dzin tshul gsal mdzad khyod la gus pas 'dud/ /ces dang / khyad par du rdo rje theg pa'i lam mtha' dag rje 'di nyid gcig pus gsal bar mdzad pa yin te/ stag tshang lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ mdo sngags mtha' dag khyad par rdo rje'i theg /rgyud sde mtha' dag khyad par bla med don/ /rim gnyis mtha' dag khyad par sgyu lus la/ /sngon med legs bshad gter chen khyod la 'dud/ /ces dang / de ltar bstan pa rin po che ches cher gsal bar mdzad de bstan pa'i bdag por gyur stabs gangs can gyi mkhas pa kun gyis gtsug tu bkur ba yin te/stag tshang lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ mdor na thub bstan mtha' dag ma lus pa/ /bshad sgrub gnyis kyis ches cher gsal mdzad pa/ /gangs can 'di 429

na bstan 'dzin ma tha' dag gis/ /rtag tu bsngags par 'os pa khyod la 'dud/ /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas rang nyid slar byon pa bzhin du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas bod gangs can gyi mkhas pa mtha' dag gi yid rang dbang med par 'phrog ste phal cher slob mar gyur pa dang / dngos su chos 'brel med pa dag gis kyang bstod bsngags kyi rol mo rgyun mi chad par bsgrags so/ /zhes pa 'di ni dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul bod yig rtsom sgyur cus kyis thag ring nas 'phrin yig gi lam nas bskul ba ltar sbyar ba'o/ /mkhas dbang 'ga'i 'khrungs 'das/༄༅/ /dī skya paṇa chen/ rab byung gsum pa'i chu stag spyi lo 1182 lor 'khrungs/ rab byung bzhi ba'i lcags phag spyi lo 1251 la sa paṇa lang grur 'das/ shong stong rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i dus stod tsam du la stod spyang lung shar kha'i bung rar 'khrungs/ rab yid shing glang / spyi lo 1265 lor 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags par dgongs pa zhus nas bal yul du phebs/ bod du snyan ngag bshad rgyun dngos su spel nas slob ma mang bo gso skyong gnang ngo / /dpang lo blo gros brtan pa/ rab byung lnga ba'i me byi/ spyi 430

lo1276lor 'khrungs/ rab byung drug pa'i chu rta/ spyi lo1342la 'das/zhang zhung ba chos dbang grags pa/ rab byung bdun pa'i shing sprel/spyi lo1404lor 'khrungs/ skabs der rje tsong kha ba dgung grangs zhe brgyad la slebs/ rab byung brgyad pa'i sa glang spyi lo1469lor 'das/zhwa lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang bo/ rab byung bdun pa'i lcags bya spyi lo1441 lor 'khrungs/ rab byung dgu ba'i me phag spyi lo1567lor 'das/sde ba rin spungs pa/ rin spungs nor bu bzang bos phag grur ngo log byas te phag gru'i srid dbang 'thor lo ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i shing yos spyi lo1435lo yin/rin spungs pa ngag dbang 'jigs med grags pa/ rab byung brgyad pa'i chu stag spyi lo1482lor 'khrungs/ 'das lo mi gsal/bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal/rab byung bcu ba'i sa rta/spyi lo1618lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo re gcig pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta/ spyi lo1678lor snyan ngag me long gi 'grel ba da:'i gdagongs rgyan brtsams/ 'das lo mi gsal/ si tu paṇa chen/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags 'brug spyi lo1700lor 'khrungs/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing rta spyi 431

lo1774lor 'das/'ju mi pham/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me rta spyi lo1846lor 'khrungs/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu byi spyi lo1912lor 'das/ki rti sku phreng bdun pa kun dga' chos 'phags thub bstan nyi ma rab byudzeebacu gsum pa'i me mo sbrul1797lor 'khrungs/ rab byung bcu bzhi me phag1827lor rnga yul du phebs/ dgung lo so gcig rab byung bcu bzhi sa sprel1848la dgongs pa rdzogs/ dgung lo nga gnyis yin/kun mkhyen gnyis pa rab byung bcu gnyis sa sprel1728lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu drug la gdan sar bkod / nyer lnga la dbus su byon/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags khyi1790lor sgo mang btabs/ki rti blo bzang 'phrin las ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa mo bya ste1849lo'i rgyal zla ba'i gnam gang gi mutshan mo'i thun dang bor 'khrungs/ rong bo bswe'i chu man sprul sku'i dog gnas shig yod par ྾྾ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i lcags sprel1860lo khong dgung grangs bcu gnyis thog rnga yul du phebs pa'i skabs kyi rnam thar las/ 'di dus dme'i dpon rgyud rdzogs nas/ chab 'bangs rnams dpon mo a skyong bza' bde sgron dang / blon po dme dkon gnyis kyis 'dzin pa'i skabs yin stabs/ dme dkon nas rje nyid kyi drung du sngon skyabs rje gong ma bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis dme'i rgyal sa 'di chos skyong tshangs pa dang 432

gzhi bdag dar 'dzoms la gtad/ de nas rgyal khang du khong gidabu zhwa dang / tshangs pa'i rten mdos sogs bzhugs su gsol nas mnga' thang 'phel rgyas su mdzad pa'i bka' drin bskyangs na yang / bar skabs 'dir lhung bab shin tu che bas dbu mnabs med skad dang / lha srung rnams kyang 'khu sdon sna tshogs ston pa'i gdug pa can zhig tu song bas 'ga' res chos skyong dngos med par 'dre ngan zhig gnas 'dug zer ba'ang yod pas de dag ji ltar yin gyi gsung gsal dang bcos rim gang dgos nyid nas cis kyang gnang rgyu'i bka' drin skyong dgos tshul yang yang zhus kyang re zhig la lan ma gnang / nyin zhig yongs 'dzin tshang nasade la gsung lan zhig cis kyang gnang dgos pa 'dra/ zhus par/ sku gong ma'idabu mnabs kyang yod/ chos skyong mi bzhugs pa min yang grib kyis mnol ba shin tu che bas yig brgya 'bum dang / tshangs pa'i bskang bshags khri bcas sgrubs/ bcos thabs yod gsungs shing dme dkon yang de bzhin gsungs nas/ rim gro de dag gnad smin sgrub tu bcug de'i skabs rang gzhan thams cad rgyal khang de'i nang lta zhog nye 'khor du 'gro ba'ang dogs 'dzem byed pa'i skabs yin yang / nyin zhig rje nyid rgyal khang rnying ba'i nang du byon nas da bu mnabs ngos 'dzin mdzad cing / de dang sku thang rten mdos sogs rgyal khang gsar sgrun du spyan drangs te mchod bkur sogs kyi thugs bkod dang da phyin chad sngar bzhin dar bo 'byung 433

nges kyi brtse ba'i bka' mchid gnang / zhes gsungs/ rnam thar de las chu glang 1853 lor thugs thag bcad/ shing stag 1854 lor gdan sar bkod/ dgung lo drug ste/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags rta 1870lo'i gsar chos skabs gnas bdag gi bsang mchod/ legs byas rol mtsho ljags rtsom mdzad/ tsha kho'i phyogs nas gdan drangs pa bzhin sgar btegs/ lam bar gyi mi khyim so sor 'dod chos bstsal cing / thang skor rong sgo zhes pa'i sar mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug rgyan kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng bzhi ba rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dpal bzang bo dang mjal 'dzom mdzad pa'i tshe/ skyabs rje de nyid gzims gur sgor bsu bar phebs pa la lha dar dri med rtse sprod dang rten 'byung gi dngos 'bul bstar/ ma dgon du sku mtshams dam por bzhugs/'di'i skabs skyabs rje gong ma kun dga' chos 'phags rin po che'i rnam thar skal bzang blo gsal mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bka' rtsom mdzad/ dme rgyal blon rnams nas yang yang gsol ba btab bzhin dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi sa 'tshol bar phebs/ blon tshang tī thog zer ba zhig yod pa der slebs tshe/ sa brtag bslang sbyangs pa'i skor lto 'phye'i thig gdab pa sogs mdzad nas sa mig brko ba'i skabs me tog gi char babs/ dpal shul nas dme'i sras dod du blangs pa dme rgyal lcags thar 'bum gyis 'di dus dung dkar cha gcig phul/ blon po dme dkon mchog nas dgon 434

ya 'di'i sgrig lam dang chos 'chad nyan sogs gang cir 'du khang gi rmang bting / gang ltar bla brang dang 'du khang gi rmang bting zhing shing cha sogs 'dren rgyu'i 'go brtsams shing / lcags lug 1871 lo nas bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul bsnyad par gyur ro/ /chu sprel 1872lo'i dpyid dus dbu phar gyi dmabaca' btsugs/ lo de'i drug pa'i yar tshes la khu zhang rin po che las bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/ lo de'i zla brgyad par ma dgon du phebs rnga ba'i dgon gsar du 'du khang dang gra shag kha shas grub 'dug pa la gzigs gtogs mdzad nas/ gdan sar phebs/ chu bya 1873 lo'i gsar tshes kyi dga' ston sogs dkyus ltar mdzad/ lo de'i dbyar rnga yul du phebs/ dgon pa btabs zin kyang thos bsam med par blun sgom tsam gyis sangs rgyas mi thob pa dang / cho ga'i ngag 'don byang ba tsam gyis grong chog sdud padagos pa zhan par dgongs nas/dgon gsar dge ldan legs bshad gling 'dir mtshan nyid gsar 'dzugs gnang ste/ se ra ba tshang zhes zhu ba ser smad dge bshes dkon mchog mtha' yayomakhan khri dang / bla brang dge bshes blo bzang dar rgyas dge rgan du bsko ba gnang / rnam thar las dgung lo nyer drug pa shing khyi zhes 'dug brtsis na nyer lnga yin dgos pa 'dra/ rnam thar las dgung lo so gcig pa sa yos lo gsungs/ dgung lo so brgyad pa me khyi gsar tshes/rab byung kyibaco lnga ba'i lcags sbrul 1881 lor/ rnam thar las bla brang dang 435

khyo kho'i dpal yum mi mthun pa'i gyod ngan de rgya je cher song ste khyo kho khag gsum dang mgo log khang rgan/ rnga ba'i dme rgyal sogs dpung bsgril ba la/ sde dge'i phyag mdzod btsan po mas blo brang lha sde stod smad/ mdzod dge a mchog sog po tshun gyi dmag dpung bsdus nas g.yul bkye bas/mgo log gis gtsos pha rol gyi dmag mi grangs mang bsad cing / dpal yum sde rnams bcom pa sogs 'khrug tshabs che ba byung / zhes gsungs/rab tshes chu 'brug la/ mchog rtse'i gser khri rin po che nas 'bar khams su grags pa'i bon dgon che ba zhig dge lugs su dka' tshegs chen pos bsgyur te 'du khang sogs phug rgyur/ dgung lo zhe bdun pa shing lug 1895 lor/ dme sang dang mkhar sar gyi gyod bshad/ gnam la gong mas gdan drangs pa bzhin lha chab sgar du phebs nyin skyo nyams shin tu che ba bcas gsung mgur zhig gnang ba ni/ rde ṇḍa bsang rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /thugs mkhyen rab gcig bsdus 'a5ma pa'i dbyāngs/ /yongs srid gsum gdug can 'dul ba'i phyir/ /gdangs ha har bzhud ༷'i gad rgyangs kyis/ /bdud gshin rje'i don snying lkog mar 'byin/ /dus bskal ba'i byin za 'khrugs pa'i klong / /mig sman gyi lhun po gar byed bzhin/ /lha khro tshogs kun kyang 'dar byed pa'i/ /dpal rdo rte 'jigs mdzad dus kyi dgra/ /rgyud tha mal gdul bya'i blo ngo ru/ /mgonarnabashes gnyen dam pa'i tshul bzung ste/ /rje sīb pa'i bskyan pa phyogs mthar spel/ /dpal 436

'jigs med stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang ba'i/ /lha dkyil 'khor rgya mcho'i byed po gang / /mi bdag gi mthar thug gtan gyi skyabs/ /dusad nas byang chub snying bo'i bar/ /mgon khyod kyis 'bral med skyabs mdzod la/ /phyi nang dang gsang ba'i gshin rje'i dpung / /dus myur du thul bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal snying rje'i gter chen phyag drug mgon/ /chos 'dul ba'i bstan srung ngal gsos po/ /las dge sdig shan 'byed nyi ma'i bus/ /dus byang chub bar du gtan grogs mdzod/ /chos dge ldan bstan pa'i dbu 'phang mtho/ /sde 'dus tshogs ba3da spyab dar zhing rgyas/ /yongs brtan g.yo'i byākra shīs g.yas su 'gil/ /yid don kun 'aspub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni gnam la gong ma'i lha chab sgar du 'gro ba'i lam bar du gdan sa chen po bkra shis 'khyil gyi steng thad du chu 'dzin lang long 'khrugs pa'i rkyen byas te/ 'khrul snang za zi'i bla brdol yi ge'i lam du spel ba maṅgalo zhes pa'o/ /rjes sor gzigs snang 'di'i rgyu mtshan ci ltar yin nan gyis zhus par/ zhal nas/ 'di skabs su mthong snang byung ba gtan nas min/ kun mkhyen sku phreng gong ma rnams kyi mdzad pa dang phyag rjes dran pas dad gus shugs drag skyes pa dang / bla brang thad kyi nam mkhar sprin zhig mthong bas rkyen byas yid ngor 'jigs byed zhal/phyag yongs rdzogs shin tu khros pa'i nyams can/me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na 'gying tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i rtsa zhal gyi gtsug tu skyabs rje gsum pa/437

'og tu skyes ba g.yo gyi chos skyong bcas gsal bor shar byung bas/ mos ༄ cigus drag pos mchi ma 'khrugs pa yun ring chod dka' ba byung zhing / chos sde chen po 'di rdo rje 'jigs byed rang gi gdan sa dngos yin par yid ches pas tshigs— bcad 'di dag slar yi ger bkod pa las rgyu mtshan gzhan ci yang medartso pas mu rnamasga dad pa che ba'i khul gyis bla ma zog por mi gtong bar zhu gsungs/ /zhes pa dag kyang rnam thar dag nas drangs te 'dir bkaud pa'o/ / 4 snye 438

— ri phyag chen brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ ༄༅/ /phyag chen brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ na mo ma ha mu dra ya/lhun grub sku gsum gyi gzhal yas su/ /dpal dang bo'i sangs rgyas rigs kun gtso/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhing rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /dus gsum— gyi rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yab/ /mkhyen rab 'phags pa 'jam dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dngaci / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /yul byang phyogs kha ba can ljongs 'dir/ /thub bstan la thub dbang gnyis pa je/ /rje btsun blo bzang grags pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongaso pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /'jam dbyangs kyi sras po tsong kha ba'i/ /sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /ṭwāṃsdus

ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung —'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin nes/ /'chi med kyi rig 'dzin sku brnyes pa'i/ /grub mchog rnya rmā badzra la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams— snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / chos brgyad kyi 'ching bas ma gos par/ /nges don gyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /blo bzang don yod grub pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyudo bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /sku gsum gyi pho brang nyams dga' bar/ /ngur smig gi gar gyis 'gro kun 'dren/ /mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rje grub thob gong ma'i gdan sa ru/ /dad ldan gyi gdul bya'i dpal du shar/ /paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur 440

du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zab rgyas kyi gdam pa'i mdzod bzung nas/ /nges don gyis skal ldan smin mdzad pa/ /grub dbang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /bslab gsum gyi nor bu'i mdzod bzung nas/ /dge ldan gyi bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa/ /paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /dge ldan gyi snyan brgyud bdud rtsi yis/ /ris med kyi gdul bya grol mdzad pa/ /rtogs ldan blo bzang rig grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa'i man ngag gis/ /skal ldan gyi gdul bya grol mdzad pa/ /rje btsun blo bzang 'phrin las la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas dben par rtse gcig sgrub pa mdzad/ /lam sku bzhi'i go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ /grub dbang blo bzang rnam rgyal la 441

gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bodag 'dzin 'khri ba chodasne pa dngasgo /byams snying rje byang sems 'obyongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas dben par dka' thub nyams bzhes pas/ /lam mchog thun dngos grub ma lus thob/ /yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshane la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /'chad rtsod dang rtsom pa'i man ngag gis/ /bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dgung la btegs/ /kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo la gsol brte'adebs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /ming don gyi bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bshad sgrub kyi sgron me sbar mdzad pa/ /dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zab rgyas kyi gdam pa grangs med kyis/ /skal ldan gyi gdul bya dpag med bskyangs/ /dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 442

'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /dasal phyag na rdo rje —mi yi gar/ /gsang gsum gyi mdzad pa ngo mtshar ba/ /'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chode pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /mdo sngags kyi dam chos grangs med kyis/ /snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa'i srog 'dzin pa/ /rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal ngag gi dbang phyug tsong kha ba'i/ /chos zab rgyas thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gnad/ /'doms mdzad drin can bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma lhas/ /thugs brtse bas rjes bzung dge ba'i bshes/ /blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma lhas/ /chos zab rgyas bdud rtsis legs bskyangs pa//443

'jigs med 'phrin las rgya metsho la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs//skyabs bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung nas/ /zab rgyas kyi gdam pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin 'khri ba chod pa dang / /byams snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa dang / /lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rje bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba dang / /gnas 'khor ba la zhen pa log pa dang / /ma 'gro kun sgrol ba'i khur khyer nas/ /lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /dpal zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po de/ /dus myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /dmu dge'i dgon par bla mchod dang phyag chen sbrags pa'i khrid gnang skabs kha bskang bcas bsul ba'o// 'dod gsol don gnyis lhun grub/༄dngha //bgrang yas rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs mchog /dmar ser 'od du 'tsher ba'i lha mchog che/ /phyi nang gshin rje'i mun tshogs 'joms pa'i dbang / /'jam dpal zhi khros dge legs char chen phobs/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i ring lugs rin chen mdzod/ /gong du 'degs pa'i 'jigs med spobs pa che/ /thub bstan bshad sgrub chos kyi dpal shar 444

ba/ /'phrin las 'od 'bar nyi mar gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs pa med pa'i thugs bskyed rgya mtsho las//nyer thon bstan pa'i snying bo 'od po che/ /deng 'dir gsal mdzad dbang phyug brgyad ldan pa/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyalal gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun rang gzugs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / /'phrin las sa chen khyab mdzad khri chen mchog /yab sras zung gi 'phrin las nyi ma che/ /slar yang shar ba'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde ldan zhing mgon tshe mtha' yas pa dang / /bdudabazhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal tshe yi lha/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo rje btsun tā re ma/ /lha mchog gsum gyis byin chen char du bsnyil/ /de yi mthu las yab sras nyi zla zung / /'gog med shar ba'i dge mtshan 'od snang 'bum/ /bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bar du nub med parīr/ /mdzad 'phrin 'od kyis sa chen khyab par mdzod/ /yab sras zung gi 'phrin las 'khor bsgyur gyi/ /gser gyi 'khor lo gling bzhi'ica sa chen du/ /'gog med rgyu ba nga las nu'i 'khor lo'i/ /rjes su 'gro ba'i dge mtshan dpal 'bar shog /nyi ma'i mgon dang de yi 'od stong bzhin/ /yab sras 'brel ba'i lang tsho rab rgyas te/ /lnga bdo'i rgud pa'i phun tshogs rab bcom nas/ /bde skyid rdzogs ldan pad tshal bzhad par mdzod/ /yum chen sher phyin lab kyi sgrol ma yis/ /thugs sras stong sde ngag gi dbang phyug la/ /bka' lung gsal ba'i 'od snang rab spros bzhin/ /rgyal bstan skyed tshal yongs su dar bar mdzod/ /rgya bod mkhas 445

dang grub mi'i skyes bu yi/ /lung rtogs ma lus gcig bsdus kun mkhyen gyi/ /thugs bskyed smon pa'i 'bras bu yongs smin te/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i dga' tshal rab rgyas shog /bkra shis da—pal gyi dge mtshan 'bum phrag tu/ /g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'dus sde mtsho chen las/ /mdo sngags rig gnas pad mo 'bum bzhad de/ /bskal bzang rkang drug tshogs rnams tshim par shog /ngo mtshar sna tshogs —'od kyi dpal 'bar te/ /rang bstan gser sbyangs btso ma'i rang 'od che/ /yar tshes zla ba'e dpal la rab 'gran pa'i/ /don ldan snyan pas sa steng khya ba par shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang ma hā kā—la dang / /dge sdig stangs 'dzin las gshin rnam sras sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mcho'i mthu stobs kyis/ /gang smon lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mdor na skye ba pad mo'i phreng ba ru/ /bshes gnyen nyin mo'i mgon gyis rjes bzung ste/ /lung rtogs sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston rab rgyas nas/ /sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs dpal la spyod gyur cig /ces skyabs gcig mthong ba don ldan7kun mkhyen mchog sprul rin po che dang / 7khri chen mchog sprul rin po che rnam gnyis la rtse gcig tu gsol ba 'debs shing / 'dod don gsol ba'i smon tshig 'di lta bu dgos zhes/ ma gcig grub pa'i dbang phyug gung ru mkha' 'groma'i yang sprul skal bzang dam chos sgrol ma dang / blo bzang chos 'dzin rnam gnyis kyis bkra shis pa'i lha reg dri med sogs dngos skyes du ma bcas nan tan gyis bskul ngor bris pa'o//446

rteske brgyud 'debs kha skong skor/ tso ༄7//dpal ldan rtsa ba'i ྾ / phun tshogs dge legame ྾ / zla med ston pa ྾ / shin tu dpag pa ྾ / shing rta chen po ྾ / mkhas pa gzhon nu'i lus 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /mgon de'i rnam dkar 'phrin las kyis bskrun pa'i/ /dri med blo gros kun tu rab rgyas me/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la ྾ / dmigs med brtse ba'i ྾ / rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen zhabs/ /smra ba'i nyi ma mkhasaske grub dge legs dpal/ /mkhas grub chenabyupo shākya rgyal mtshan te/ /bstan pa'i sgron me gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug don yod dpal ldan pa/ /mdo sngags kun mkhyen bsod nams grags pa'i dpal/ /pad dkar 'dzin pa brasod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ /thub bstan gsal byed gsum6 la gsol ba 'deb sa/ /mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag rigs pa seṅge dang / /bslab gsum mdzod 'dzin bkra shis rin chen pa/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag blo bzang chos rgyan zhabs/ /mtshungs med bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin blo bzang padma dang / /mang thoso mthare son sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde/ /rje btsun bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /smra mi'i dbang phyug dge 'dun 447

rgya mtsho dang / /thub bstan gsal byed 'jigs med dbang bo'i sde/ /legs bshad mdzod 'dzin dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /smra ba'i nyi ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdam pa'i mdzod 'dzin shes rab rgya mtsho dang / /rje btsun blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag a rgya'i zhabs/ /mkhas pa'i khyu mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo gros bzang bos shes bya'i gnas kun gzigs/ /byams brtse'i dpal gyis dus mthar 'gro rnams la/ /sngon med legs bshad stsol mkhas dang bo'i mgon/ /bka' drin gsum ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs med rnam dpyod sprin gyi phung bo las/ /nyan 'os dam pa'i chos zab bdud rtsi'i char/ /blo ldan rgya mtsho'i gsos su 'bebs mkhas pa/ /mchog sprul smra ba'i dbang bor gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs med stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' bshes gnyen dag /bsam dang sbyor bas bsten pa'i byin mthu las/ /gtan gyi bde la gzhol ba'i dpal ldan pa/ /gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs//༄dngha //steng dga' ldan lha brgya'i mgon po mchog /rje mi pham mgon dang dbyer med pa'i/ /pha blo bzang grags pa yab sragol/ /yid gting nas gsol ba 'debs so gson/ /bde legs kyi rtsa ba drin can rje/ /skyabs sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba dang / /tshe mi rtag long med dran gyur nas/ /tshe 'di yi 'khri ba chod par shog /ngan song gi sdug bsngal dran pa 448

dang / /'khor ba la snying bo med pa dang / /nyam thag rnams rang gi mar shes nas/ /byams snying rjes bdag rgyud gang bar shog /yang dag pa'i lta ba rnyed pa dang / /lam rim gnyis kyi nyams rtogs mthar phyin te/ /rje bla ma'i rnam par zin gyur nas/ /ma 'gro ba'i mgon du bdag gyur cig /yid rtse gcig mos pas gsol 'debs na/ /lam 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor 'byong ba dang / /thugs ye shes 'od kyi lcags kyu yis/ /zhing dga' ldan gnas su drong du gsol/ /hika྾྾྾ / zhabs brtan gsol 'debs don gnyis lhun grub/ ༄7ོ/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rin chen rdul/ /yongs brtsegs lhun po dmar ser gos kyis klubs/ /'phrin las 'od brgya 'bar ba grags pa'i mtshan/ /gang de'i shis pa 'bum —gyis khyod la srungs/ /thub pa'i thugs bcud mdo sngags bstan pa'i bcud/ /dge ldan ring lugs dri med gser sbyangs kyi/ /gdam pa rin chen bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang bo /spel mdzad bshes gnyen dam par gsolta ba 'debs/— /spyi bo'i haṃ las zla gzhon bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /sgru tī'i snod du 'khyil ba'i rten 'asbol gyis/ /tshe 449

srog gzhig med gyur pa tshe mtha' yas/ /ji bzhin khyod zhal 'gyur med zhabs brtan shog /thugs bskyed 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las 'khrungs pa'i/ /lung rtogs ljon pa'i kho lag rab rgyas te/ /'phrin las 'dab brgya 'bum phrag dgod pa yis//skal ldan bung ba'i— tshogs rnams tshim par shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang ma hā kā la dang / /dge sdig shan 'byed gshin rje chos kyi rgyal/ /'dod khams dbang mo la sogs srung ma yis/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi g.yel med lhun grub mdzod/ /skye zhing skye ba'i tshe rabs phreng ba ru/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs pad rtag bsten nas/ /yang dag gdams pa'i bcud la rol gyur te/ /skyu bzhi'i rgyal thabs yongs su zin gyur cig /mdor na mchog gsum bden pa'i byin mthu dang / /chos nyid bslu ba med pa'i dpal yon gyis/ /rgyal bstan pad mo'i 'dzum zhal mngon gyur te/ /yongs kyis bde skyid dpal la rol gyur cig /ces bya ba 'di ni dge slong lhun grub chos 'phel gyis dngul lo dang / bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas bcas dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po thub bstan dam pa'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dabs su bris pa ja yaskyo/ / rgyub pa'i bstun la thos bsam sgom pas zhugs/ /gsang chen dum pa'i gnad la dbang 'byor zhing / /ris twed gdul bya thabs kyis skyong mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ khaṃ āḥ gu ru badzra rnya ra mu ni shā sa na pā da su sarba si hūṃ hūṃ/ 450 ji

zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'dod don lhun grub/ ༄gyi/ /pad ma ra ga'i lhun po'i nyi 'od 'bum/ /gos su gyon pa'i dpal gyis rab mdzes shing / /mtshan dpe'i me tog 'bum gyis brgyan pa po/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas de yis skyongs/ /ṇḍa bsang grags pa'i blo mtsho las 'ongs pa'i/ /legs bshad bdud rtsis yongs bkrus bhab pa'i bskyan/ /marten rūb 'od kyis gsal mdzad lung rtogs kyi/ /ñtsha ༷tsho che la dbang bsgyur gsol ba 'debs/ /lte ba'i gaspyon nu dmar mos spyi bo yi//haṃ yig ba mo bzhus pa sgru tī'i dbus//'khyil las tshe srog rdo rje'i gshis gyur pa/ /tshe dpag med bzhin khyod zhabs rtag brtan shog /tshe yi lha mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /khyod zhabs bskal ba rgya mtshor brtan bzhugs nas/ /mdzad mchog gsung gi bdud rtsi'i gru char gyis/ /snyigs dus skye 'gro'i shes rgyud brlan par mdzod/ /skyes bu gsum gyi chos srung rnam gsum dang / /snang mtha'i zlos gar bswe yi khrab can sogs/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i 'phrin las g.yel med kyis/ /khyod zhabs brtan cing mdzad 'phrin rab rgyas shog /thugs bskyed sa bon grung bo'i 'bras bzang dag /dus su smin pa 'khor lo rnam gsum gyi/ /'od snang 'bum gyis rgyal 451

bstan pad mo'i tshal/ /rab tu bzhad pa'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ /bslab gsum nor bus thugs rgyud legs gtams pa'i/ /'dus sde 'jam dbyangs smra seng gling la sogs/ /ris med 'dus sde'i thos bsam sgom gsum sogs/ /dbyar gyi chu mtsho'i dpal la 'gran par mdzod/ /bdag sogs rnams kyang deng nas byang chub bar/ /brtse zhags rnon pos nam yang mi gtong bar/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i bgo bsha' rab bkyes nas/ /'chi med sku bzhi'i khri la 'god par shog /mdon na ārya tā re'i mthu dpal las/ /mdzad 'phrin 'od snang rin chen 'phreng mdzes de/ /phyogs kyi bu mo mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur nas/ /dge mtshan 'bum gyis 'jig rten khyab gyur cig /ces a mchog sprul ba'i sku rin po che 7blo bzang thub bstan mkhyen rab rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'dod don lhun grub ces bya ba 'di ni dpal ldan smra seng gling gi khri las thogs pa sprul ba'i sku shes rab grags pa rgya mtshos g.yung drung ris su bkra ba'i gos chen dang sgor nyer lnga lha dar srid du ring ba bcas thag ring nas bskul ba'i ngor bris pa'o// zhabs brtan gsol 'debs/༄ / /rgyal kun ye shes gangs kyi ri bo'i rdul/ /thugs rje nyi ma 'bar bas rab bzhus te/ /'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi yongs 'khyil ba/ /rab dkar 'phrin las lha mos dge legs stsol/ /lhag bsrum brtan pos bshes gnyen du ma yi/ /zhabs skyes gtun gyi skyabs su legs bsten nas//452

mdo sngags gdams pa'i bcud la nem rol ba//gdul bya khya mardo'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku bdag cag gser gyi mchod sdong che//bsod nams dpal gyi gzhig med g.yung drung khrir/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor rtag bzhugs nas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa lhag med gzhom par mdzod/ /thugs bskyed bsod nams zho 'thung rus pa las/ /rdo rje'i gshis su grub pa'i sku mchog ni/ /bdag cag mgon med mgon du rtag bzhugs nas/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i gru char chad med mdzod/ /lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku tshe mtha' yas/ /'chi bdag bdud las rnam rgyal lha mo dang / /'gro rnams bdud bzhi las sgrol tā re ma'i/ /thugs bskyed bden pa'i mthu dpung btsan po yis/ /snyigs dus rgud pa'i gnyen po bshes gnyen che/ /g.yo med mi 'gyur khri la rtag bzhugs nas/ /'phrin las 'od stong 'bar ba'i rtse dga' yis/ /rgud pa'i mun tshogs lhag med gzhom par mdzod/ /bar chad kun sel myur mdzad mgon po dang / /las kyi gshin rje rnam mang thos sras sogs/ /chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dus kun 'phrin las g.yel med bya ra mdzod/ /bla slob dam tshig gtsang ba'i rten 'brel las/ /bla ma'i zhabs brtan dge 'dun sde rnams rgyas/ /'dul khrims gtsang zhing rim gnyis gdengs ldan pa'i/ /'dus pa'i tshogs rnams yar zla bzhin rgyas shog /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin ma yi mi shes kun//lhag med zhi nas dge mtshan 'bum phrag gi /snang ba'i 'od kyis sa chen 453

kun khyab pa'i//rdzogs ldan dpal la kun gyis spyode gyur cig /mdor na skye dgu'i bde skyid dgos 'dod char/ /yongs su 'bebs pa'i thub bstan yongs 'du'i ljon/ /tshang la ma nor kho lag rab rgyas te/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i dpal rgyas shog /ces zhabs partan gsol 'debs 'di ni/ dge slong blo gros rgya mtshos phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcas pa'idapedang /bkra shis pa'i lha dar dri med bcas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor bris pa'o// rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la 'dod don gsol ba don gnyi sa lhun grub/༄༅/ /tshogs gnyis rin chen gser bzang las grub cing / /mkhyen brtse'i lte ba zlum po las thon pa/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las rtsibs stong du 'bar ba/ /myur ma dpa' mo yis bu bzhin du dgongs la/ /bsod nams dpal gyi rtsibs stong gi gser 'khor/ /srid zhi'i khyon la rang dbang du bsgyur nas/ /don gnyis lhun grub sbrang rtsi yi ro la/ /skye dgu yongs kyis rol ba ru mdzod cig /bde stong zung 'jug rin chen gyi sgrom bu/ /mngon mtho nges legs 'dod dgu yi gter mdzod/ /skye dgu'i re 'dod myur skong gi nor bu/ /myur ma dpa' mo yis bu bzhin du dgongs la/ /lhag bsam brtan po'i gser bzang gi yu bar/ /dad gus sham bu g.yo ba yi rtse mor/ /gus mchod bshes gnyen nor bu yi byin rlabs/ /snying zhugs dga' 464

ston myong ba ru mdzod cig /nges za/na bde stong dbyer med kyi yum chen/ /rgyal kun zag med bde ster gyi btsun mo/ /bya grub ye shes lha sku yi rang gzugs/ /myur ma dpa' mo yis bu bzhin du dgongs la/ /dal 'byor mi rtag bsam pa yi gdan— la/ /srid las nges 'byung gos bzang gis brgyan cing / /byang chub sems mchog rin chen gyis spras pa'i/ /rgyal yum 'dzum zhal mthong ba ru mdzod cig /nges don bde stong zung 'jug gi rgyal bo'i/ /gang bsam lhun grub 'phrin las kyi byed po/ /bdag cag g.yang las myur skyob kyi blon chen/ /myur ma dpa' mo yis bu bzhin du dgongs la/ /bcom ldan chos rgyal shāka thub kyi 'ja' sa/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin phyag mtshan du bsnams nas//rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kun sgrub kyi dpa' bo/ /'gro kun 'dren pa'i blon chen du mdzod cig /rgyal kun mdzad pa rin chen gyi phung bo/ /ngal med khur du bsnams pa yi lag ldan/ /tshe rabs kun du bsgrub pa yi lha mchog /myur ma dpa'u mo yis bu bzhin du dgongs la/ /mdo sngags rig gnas yon tan gyi rin chen/ tho /yongs su spungs pa rgyan khur du 'khyer zhing / /phyin drug spyod pa'i dkar mdzes kyi mche ldan/ /thal kar lag ldan rin chen du mdzod cig /'khor bde srin mo'i 'dzum ba ga gis bslus pa'i/ /skye 'gro yongs su 'dren pa yi cang shes/ /'phrin las tsholhag par myur ba yi lha mchog /myur/ ma dpa' mo yis bu bzhin du dgongs la/ /byams dang snying rje sga srab kyis mdzes pa'i/ /rnam 'byed shes rab rta 455

mchog der bzhon nas/ /shes bya'i khyon yangs yid tsam gyis bgrod de/ / don gnyis lhun gyeb thob pa ru mdzod cig /stong ba'i mdzes mar dgyes dgu ru rol ba'i/ /bde chen rgyal bo'i mngag gzhug gi 'khor los/ /bdud dpung lhag med du gzhom pa yi dpa' bo/ /myur ma dpa' mo yis bu bzhin du dgongs la/ /zhi dang— rgyas pa'i go cha yi rgyan ldan/ /'phrin las drag pos dgra sde kun gzhoms te/ /don zhags 'phrul gyis yid can kun bkug nas/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi dpa' bo ru mdzod cig /ces rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la 'dodadon gsol ba'i tshigs bcad yuladang yul can gnyis ka rgyal srid rin po che bdun la sbyar ba 'di nyid/ tha snyad pa bsam gtan rgya mtshos lha rgyal chos 'byor gling du bris pa dza yaskyo// smon tshig bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ ༄7/ /tshogs gnyis rin chen las thon dgos 'dod kun 'byung mtshan dpe'i 'od kyis 'dren byed brtan pa 'phrog /zab dang rgya che'i 'dod dgu'i dngos grub lhag par bsuṣṭha/ bas theg gsum 'gro sogs skye dgu tshim par mdzad/ /gsang gsum rtse dgu'i 'od kyis 'gro ba'i mun stug bsal dang lhan cig bde dge pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog dang dbyer med shākya'i rgyal bo zhabs rdul byang chub bar tu spyi bor 'dzin/ /byams pa lag na rdo rje 'jam dpal dbyangs//nye bar 'khor 456

dang 'od srung kun dga' bo/ /theg gsum sde snod rin chen sdud mdzad dang / /gtad rabs bdun sogs bka' drin khur du lci/ /gangs can mun pa'i gling 'di chos kyi nyi ma 'od po ches/ /yongs su khyab mdzad chos kyi rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po dang / /'jam dpal khri srong lde btsan lag na rdo rje khri ral sogs/ /brgya byin dpal la 'khu ba'i chos rgyal sku drin gzhal med gyur/ /'jam dpal mi yi gar mdzad thu mi a nu zhes bya yi//blo gros 'od kyis gnas lnga rig pa 'i pad mo'i kha phyes te/ /gangs can bod kyi yi ge gser gyi mchod sdong gsar bskrun mdzad/ /bka' drin rin chen nor de gser ldan sgeg mos theg par dka'/ /skyes sbyangs shes rab gru jings brtson pa'i dar gyis rab brgyan te/ /sngon bsags mthun pa'i rlung gis 'phags yul rin chen gling bgrod nas/ /mdo rgyud rin chen yul 'dir 'dren mdzad ka cog zhang gsum sogs/ /snga dar lo paṇa rnams kyi bka' drin gzhal dka'i gnas su gyur/ /lo chen rin bzang blo ldan shes rab 'gos lo lhas btsas zhabs/ /mar lo grags rgyal shong dpang yab sras bu ston yab sras sogs/ /phyi dar lo pan gser gyi ri bo tshar du dngar ba yi/ /bka' drin bdud rtsi snying la sim nas dad pa'i spu long g.yo/ /rgyal kun ṇḍa gros bzhin lag rnam can brtan pa'i 'khor lo che/ /mi yi gar mdzad bzung bo'i 'phrin las sa chen yongs khyab pa/ /don ldan snyan pa'i grags pas rgya mtsho'i gos can rnam par g.yogs/ /sangs rgyas 457

gnyis sa tsong kha ba la daphyod ldan su mi gus/ /smra ba'i seng chen rgyal tshab mkhas grub la sogs sras mchog rnams/ /gnam la skar tshogs bkra bzhin sa chen 'di ni yongs su bzung / /'chad rtsod rtsom pas smra ngan ri dwags ma lus pham byas nas/ /thub bstan dar chen srid rtser sgreng mdzad de dag rnam par rgyal/ /snang mtha' spyan ras gzigs dbang gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal shar te/ /mdzad 'phrin 'od po che yi snang ba rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar du/ /khyab nas chos srid zung gis gtsang ma'i thub bstan rin chen gdugs/ /dgung du 'degs mkhas rgyal ba yab sras mtshan snyan g.yu 'brug zla/ /de lta'i 'gro mgon rin chen 'phreng //rim bstar 'od kyi snang baji yīs/ /rgyal bstan lung rtogs pad mo'i tshal/ /dbyar gyi dpal la 'gran bzhin rgyas/ /don gyi rten gzhi yi ge'i 'phreng / /gcig las du ma spro ba'i thabs/ /shing gi dpar gyi 'phrul 'degs 'di/ /yul gru gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /de lta na'ang bar skabs su/ /gnod byed dug rlangs nag po yis/ /bde dge gzhom dang chabs gcig tu/ /rig pa rin chen dkrugs shing brlags/ /'on kyang rig 'phrul gsar ba yi/ /zla ba'i mdzes zhal ngom pa'i tshe/ /rig 'phrul ku mud gzhon nu gi /mdzes zhal zla ba'i dpal la 'gran/ /phyogs med grong khyer so so nas/ /nyer mkho'i yig rigs sna tshogs pa/ /glog 'phrul zab mo'i thabs mkhas las/ /byung ba rgyu skar grangs la 'khu/ /'dir yang blo mig rab phyes nag /phyi nang rig pa 458

'bum gyi snod/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i mtsho chen po/ /'gyur ro cog gi dpar chene bskrun/ /'di ltar zla ba'i dpal la 'gran pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs kyi mthus/ /'jig rten kun du phra rgyas nad 'joms rnyarma bdud rtsis yongs khyab ste/ /nad mug 'khrug rtsod la sogs mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad kun zhi zhing / /dge bcu dar dang lhan cig bde skyid yar zla'i dpal bzhin rgyas par shog /'gro ba'i nad brgya 'byin pa'i rtsi chen po/ /lung rtogs zung gis bsdus pa rnyed bkur bcas/ /phyi dar yang dar dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin du/ /mkha' la 'phyur ba'i dga' ston mthong bar shog /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde rnam bzhi la/ /thos bsam phu thag chod pa'i shes rab kyis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rnga chen rdung mkhas pas/ /yangs pa'i sa chen 'di ni gang bar shog /dri med rigs pa sna tshogs 'od can gyis/ /log smra 'byung bo'i bya rnams long byas te/ /skal ldan gzhon nu'i blo gros 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /rab tu bzhad pa'i dga' ston mthong bar shog /bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i sa gzhi la/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med rim gnyis snye ma 'bum/ /zung 'jug 'bras bu'i khur gyi bcud ldan des/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa ma lus sel bar shog /dus su sprang char zim bus tshim byed cing / /nad 'chi gsod pa'i rtsidag nus ldan shog /'gro ba'i shes rgyud snying rjes legs bsdams nas/ /phan tshun ma bu bzhin du byams gyur cig /mthu ldan srid 'dzin rnam dkar la zhugs te/ /459

srid kyi gzhung lugs rab dkar 'od spros nas/ /dmangs kyi bde skyid chu skyes ma chog rgyas pas/ /bstod tshigar yig gnyis pa'i dbyangs snyan shog /mdor na rgyal gsung bzhengs dang mthong thos kyi/ /phan yon bden pa'i gsung gis bka' bstsal bzhin/ /'di phyi gnas skabs mthar thug dus kun du/ /dpag bsam lo 'bras bzhin du smin gyur cig /ces smon tshig bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bka' rin po che 'gyur ro cog gi dpar gsar sgrun gyi las kyi sne mo ba thun mong gi 'dod mos bzhin/ rab gnas me yos ste spyi lo1987lo'i chu stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi bzang bo gnyis pa'i nyin sbyar ba'o// lam khrid 'jam dpal zhal lung gibargyud 'debs kha skong / ༄7ོ/ /lam khrid 'jam dpal zhal lung gi brgyud 'debs kha skong ni/mkhas grub chen po shes rab seṅge'i zhabs/ /thams cad mkhyen dngos dge 'dun grub pa dang / /sku gsum go 'phang mngon gyur nor bu bzang / /dpal ldan bla ma gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbyangs can bzhad pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sde/ — /smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang bo/ /mkhas grub lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang stermo/ /bshes gnyen dam pa gsum la ྾ / /phyag na padmo bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /zab don gdam pa'i bka' babasnyes chos dpal bzang / /rigs kun bdag po snang 460

mdzad rdo rje'i zhabs/ /mkhas grub chenatshupo gsum la྾ / /bka' drin mnyam med 'phrin las rab rgyas dang / /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'phrin las lhun grub zhabs/ /theg mchog bshes gnyen gsum la྾ / /rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan zhabs/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug shes rab dar rgyas mtshan/ /shes bya kun gzigs ye shes bstan sgron zhabs/ /rje btsun bla rma gsum la྾ / /slar yang 'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i rje/ /kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde/ /mang thos mthar son dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /bka' drin mnyam med gsum ྾ / /gangs can mkhas grub ྾྾྾'debs/ /dkon mchog rgyal ba'i chos kyi snying bo kun/ /gcig bsdus blo bzang bstan pa'i sa chen khyon/ /legs bshad nyi zla'i sgron me gsal mdzad pa/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol྾ / /dkon mchog rgyal ba'i chos kyi mdzod bzung nas/ /skal bzang gdul bya smin cing grol mdzad pa/ /mtshan nyid bcu ldan theg mchog dge ba'i bshes/ /bka' drin mtshungs med dmamir྾ / /legs bshad 'tshol la ngoms pa mi mnga' zhing / /thos don rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyis/ /man ngag rgya mtsho'i gter gyur dge ba'i bshes/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la྾ / /skrul bzung thar 'dod yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /bhab bsnan pad tshal bzhad pa'i nyin mor byed/ /dbang phywag brgyad ldan 'jigs bral stobs 461

baṇḍa'i bdag ༷ /mchog sgyul ༷gro bru'i mgon sdor gasdol sa 'debs/ /'digs twed stobs bcu'i dbang phyug tsong kha ba'i/ /dri med lugs bzang bshad sgrub 'gin ༷sa kyis/ /spel thā'i thugs dgongs ñtsha ༷tsho ltar zab pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs med stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' bshes gnyen dag /bsam dang sbyor bas bsten pa'i byin mthu las/ /gtun gyi bde la gzhol ba'i dpal ldan pa/ /gdul bya 〉 mardo'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /rab 'byams gsung rab ྾྾྾྾ / /skyabag gsum kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang ྾྾྾ / /mantal/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal bo dang ngo bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i zhes sbyar nas/dge'o// tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing gi brgyud 'debs kha skong /kho / /sku mkhar ma ru rte yi pho brang nas/ /gnas brtan chen po 'jam dbyangs grags pa yis/ ྾྾྾྾ /mkhas grub mched mkhar bkra shis rgya mtsho dang / /gruthā pa'i dbang phyug ngag dbang chos 'phel zhabs/ /slob dpon chen po ngag dbang bstan 'phel dang / /rje btsun dge legs 'byung gnas chen po yis/ / ྾ /rje btsun skal bzang bstan 462

pa rab rgyas dang / khaka' 'gyur bla ma dga' ldan bstan 'dzin zhabs/ /pa rnam bde— chen ye shes sbyin pa dang / /dngul chu rnyarma bha dra yab sras gnyi sa/ /lha rams ngag dbadza bstan pa yar 'phel dang / /sems nyid sgom chen ngag dbang tshul khrims kyis/ / ྾ /mkhas grub zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtsho dang / /rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho yis/ / ྾ /cimado rgyud rgya mtsho'i gter gyur paṇḍi ta/ /bka' drin mnyam med tshul khrims rgya ma'oklore zhabs// tshe rabs rjes 'dzin skor dang gsol 'debs/༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ /zhwajam dpal dbyāngs kyi ye shes pad mo'i zhal/ /rab tu bzhud pta'i bstun ༷'i rgyul marngon 'dzin/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gyur nyin mo'i mgon po des/ /byin rlabs zer gyis bstan 'gro skyongs gyur cig /blo bzang mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor rab rdzogs pa'i/ /'jigs med mchog brnyes thub bstan mkhar 'phags te/ /bshad sgrub chos kyi 'od snang 'bum 'gyed pa/ /mtshungs bral smra ba'i nyi mar gsol ba 'debs/ /b.ridag cag dad pa'i zhing sa gshin po ru/ /thugs rjes byin rlabs gru char rab phab ste/ /sa lam rtogs pa'i myu gu rab rgyas nas/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu g.yur du za bar shog /skye ba'i phreng ba sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan tshal/ /thugs rje 'od zhags rnon pos rab bzung nas/ /dge 463

mtshan 'dab ma 'bum gyi dpal ngom ste/ /skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs rnams tshim par shog /mdor na thugs bskyed skya rengs kyis drangs pa'i/ /mdzad 'phrin 'od brgya'i snang ba rab 'bar te/ /lnga bdo'i rgud pa'i smag chen yongs bcom nas/ /dge legs dpal gyi 'od stong rab 'bar shog /dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi mthu dpal dang / /skyabs mchog dam pa'i thugs bskyed yongs smin dang / /bdag cag dad pa'i rten 'brel gsum 'dzoms las/ /gang smon 'bras bu yongs su smin par shog /ces pa 'di ni skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchog khro go chu kha mar zhal bsgyur gnang skabs dge slong bstan pa dar rgyas rang gis khong la tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi smon tshig cig dgos zhes gsol ba btab par/ khong gis dmu dge bsam gtan la zhus gsungs pas/ khyed kyis rtsoms dgos zhesarangos skyes lha dar bcas bskul ngor sbyar ba'o/ / barmergyud 'debs kha skong skor/༄gyi/ —/gsang chen mdzod 'dzin shes rab seṅge dang / /srad rgyud bstan bdag dpal ldan bzang bo'i zhabs/ /rgyud chen 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun 'phel ba la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /bsam 'grub rgya mtsho'i sde dang bkra shis 'phags/ /brtson 'grus 'phags dang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang / /dkon mchog rgya mtsho dkon mchog yar 'phel la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis 464

rlobs/ /kun mkhyen chen bona'ajam dbyangs bzhad pa dang / /dngos grub rgya mtsho bde ba'i rdo tshorje datshong / /slob dpon chen po ngag dbang byams pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /ngag dbang grags dang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /pra lha'i zhabs dang blo bzang tshul khrims dang / /bka' drin nyams med dpal 'byor bzang bo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di ni chab mdo'i dwagon chen byams pa gling du grwa ba nyer gcig la bde mchog gi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid gnang skabs brgyud 'debs kyi dpe ma rnyed pas 'phral du gnang ba'o//nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i brgyud 'debs kha skong /༄ / /rdo rje 'chang dngos dbang phyug rab bstan dpal/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor mthar phyin bka' 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin ba rin chen rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs ciso lhan skyes ye shes sbyo6ba/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rin chen 'od zer dang / /grub pa'i go 'phang mchog brnyes mang thos pa /grub mchog 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang ngur smig zlos gar gyis/ /rdo rje'i grong du 'gro kun 'khrid mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa ha sa badzra la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes suthug /kun mkhyen chen po 'jigs med dbang bo'i sde/ /kun mkhyen dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i zhabs/ /465

kun mkhyen chen po 'jigs med rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /yeng na/ /'khor lo sdom pa ngag dbang mchog ldan rje/ /'khor lo'i mgon po skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /'khor ba'i 'gro 'dren blo bzang dpal ldan par/ /gsol ba 'debase so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /bstan la dbang bsgyur rol ba'i rdo rje— dang / /bstan pa'i dpal gyur rnyarma badzra zhabs/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /rgyal bstan 'dzin mdzad thub bstan nyi ma dang / /rgyal gsung thugs mdzod yongs gtam pra dzha'i mtshan/ /rgyal ba'i bstan bdag thub bstan dbang phyug la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho blo bzang tshul khrims dang / /ngag dbang thub bstan tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sde/ /mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /'ardigs twed stobs bcu'i dbang phyug tsong kha ba'i/ /dri med lugs bzang bshad sgrub 'gin ༷sa kyi/ /spel ba'i thugs dgongs gi ༷tsho ltar zab pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /skal bzang rgyal ba'i nyi ma shāka thub kyi/ — /bstan pa rin chen spel ba'i dasal thob cing / /rnam dkar 'phrin las dpal 'asdor bzang bo'i zhabs/ /gsolab 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /darkun mardog rgyal ba'i mdo sngags dam chos kun/ /thos bgam sgom pas thugs su chud mdzad nas/ /lhun 466 rme

gyub chos sku'i dpal la dbang 'byor la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes spyol/ /'jigs med stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' bshes gnyen dag khasam dab sbyorabs bsten pa'i byin mthu las/ /gtan gyi bde la gzho'i ba'i dpal ldan par/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol//dkon mchog rgyal ba'i chos kyi snying bo kun/ /gcig bsdus blo bzang bstan pa'i sa chen khyon/ /legs bshad nyi zla'i sgron mes gsal mdzad pa/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon mchog rgyal ba'i chos kyi mdzod bzung nas/ /skal ldan gdul bya smin cing grol mdzad pa/ /mtshan nyid bcu ldan theg mchog dge ba'i bshes/ /bka' drin mtshungs med dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /legs bshad 'tshol la ngoms pa mi mnga' zhing / /thos don rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyis/ /man ngag rgya mtsho'i gter gyur dge ba'i bshes/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs ྾ / /bskal bzang thar 'dod yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /thub bstan pad tshal bzhad pa'i nyin mor byed/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan 'jigs bral stobs bcu'i bdag /mchog sprul 'gro ba'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /blo bzang mkhyen brtse'i gangs ri las 'ongs pa'i/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab gang gā'i chab/ /mang thos rgya mcho'i snying bo yongs 'khyil ba/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs ྾ / /'jigs med stobs bcu'i dbang phyug tsong kha ba'i/ /dri ri 467

med lugs bzang bshad sgrub 'phrin las kyis/ /spel ba'i thugs dgongs rgya mtsho ltar zarba pa/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskal bzang rgyal ba'i nyi ma shāka thub kyi/ /bstan pa rin chen spel ba'i dpal thob cing / /rnam dkar 'phrin las dpal 'byor bzang bo'i zhabs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs med stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' bshesaganyenadag /bsam dang sbyor bas bsten pa'i byin mthu las/ /gtan gyi bde la gzhol ba'i dpal ldan pa/ /gdul bya gi mardo'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen brtse'i྾྾ / /lho brag grub chen yab rje'i gsung ltar du/ de man stag tsha ngakra shis chos gling du lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung bgyi skabs bkra shis 'khyil gyirapar ma la phri snon cung zad bgyis pa'o//bzlas brjod dang gzhung klog tshul/༄7/ /gung thang rin po che'i gsung las/ de yang spyir bzlas brjod tsam du ma zad/ gzhuje klog pa sogs la yang lung mnos pa gal che bas/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos la/ de dag gis gsung lhang lhang gis chos de nyid kyi lung bstsal ba na/ rjes su bzlos pa'i tshul gyis rang gis brjod par mos te btone na/ chos la dbang za ba'i nyes pa mi 'byung zhing / byin rlabs 'jug sla ba dngo / ring bor mi thogs par chos kyi rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin 468

thob nas sangs rgyas rnams las gdams pa dngos su nod pa'i skal ba can du byed pa sogs dgos pa du ma yod pas/ de ltar byed pa la chos spyi'i lung nod pa'i cho ga zhes grags shing / tshul de nyid jo bo yab sras kyi gsung rgyun dang phyag bzhes yin par gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ges bshad do/ /yang mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bzhugs par bsam la/ mos gus drag po'i ngang nas 'don pa'am/thub pa'i dbang bo lta bu gcig gsal btab ste/ zhan thams cad de'i rang bzhin du bzhugs par mos nas 'don pa rgya che ba'i bdag nyid du 'don pa dang/ rang bzhin med cing snang ba —brag ca'i sgra ltar mdo dang sngags de dang de'i sgra lhang lhang grags par mos nas 'don pa stong nyid kyi ngang du 'don pa ste/ de gnyis ni mdo sngags thun mong gi 'don tshul yin par rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis chos spyod rin chen phreng bar gsungs la/ rim pa bzhin/ thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /ces dang / stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog ste/ /zab cing rgya che'i sgra sgrog pa/ /zhes pa'i man ngag gi 'don tshul yin par yang de nyid kyis gsungs so/ /zhes gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung du 'byung la/ de'i mjug de ma thag tu sngags lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i 'don tshul yang gsungs 'dug de'i lag len ni/ cho ga 'don pa dang / gzhung klog pa sogs kyi thog mar/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lta 469

bu'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud dang 'dres nges par bya/ de nas/mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / /sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs/ /gang 'don chos sgra lhang lhang grags par gyur/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig ltung bshags/ /dge la yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /dge kun dam chos 'dzin pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ bdag gzhan lus ngag ma lta bu'i maṇḍal phul/ /tshogs zhing rnams kyis rang gi gang 'don bya'i chos de nyid sgra lhang lhang bsgrags par mos nas rang gis de'i rjes zlos byed par mos nas 'don par bya'o/ /mjug tu bsngo smon bya ba spyi ltar ro/ /'di'i chos la dbang za ba'i nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i thabs las/ lung rgyun yod pa'i go mi chod do/ /zhes pa 'di'ang gzhan la phan du re nas bris pa'o//oṃ su ste/ khams gsum dmu rgod 'gro ba mtha' dag gis/ /dge ba'i grib bsil dpal la spyod pa'i phyir/ /byākra shīs 'khor swo'i dasan gyi chos grwa las/ /chos rgyun mi zad bdud rtsi'i gru char spros//nyams len bya tshul rang blo'i bcud thigs/ ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ/ /'dir khyod kyis dris pa'i lan rags rim zhig brjod na/ spyir 'di phyi'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma yin 470

zhing / de nas dris pa shin tu bzang ste/ rje tsong kha ba chen pos/ de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i/ /rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i rtsa ba ni/ /lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa 'bad pa yis/ /bsam daspu sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa ru//mthong nas srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar//bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/mchod pa thams cad kyi nang nas sgrub pa'i mchod pa mchog tu gsungs pa dang / lhag par snyigs dus 'dir nyams len la 'ab5 rgyu gal che/ re sa 'chang sa gcig pu ni rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba 7yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang ni dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang mkhan te/ bka' drin gsum ldan gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/ mdo lugs nas bshad na'ang lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa ste lam rim gyi man ngag cha tshang gnang mkhan gin phyir/ bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/ sdom pa gnang mkhan gyi bla ma sogs chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma gzhan rnams kyang de'i sprul ba'am/ de dang thugs rgyud gcig tu blta dgos/ rang nyid 'dul ba'i phyir du rtsa ba'i bla ma des sdom pa gnang mkhan dang / klog slob mkhas man ngag phra mo yan chad slob pa'i rnam pa sna tshogs shig sprul ba yin/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rang re la thugs mi brtse ba ni gcig kyang mid/ de thams cad kyi 'phrin las rang re 'dul phyir rang re'i bla ma dang 'tsham par shar ba ni rtsa ba'i 471

bla ma de yin phyir/ de sgrub pas sangs rgyas thams cad sgrub pa dang / de la gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas thams cad la gsol ba btab pa yin/dngos brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad thugs rgyud gcig tu 'dres nas yod phyir/ gcig gis gsol 'debs bton pas gzhan rnams la chad song bsam rgyu med/ dper na dmigs brtse ma yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying bo yin/ de bzhin du snying bo dang gsol 'debs gang bton yang 'dra/ tshogs zhingu sgom dus ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de yin pa la/ rnam pa shākya thub pa sogs lhag lhar sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rang re'i snang ngor tha mal ba'i rnam pa bzung yod stabs/ tha mal ba'i snang ba de log nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ched yin/ lha gang dang gang sgom yang ngo bo bla ma yin la rnam pa lha de'i rnam par bsgom dgos/ skyabs 'gro dang / lam rim/ bla mchod sogs kyi tshogs zhing rang rang gi man ngag ltar sgom tshe/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de tshogs zhing gi gtso bo dang tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs gzhan rnams ni de'i sprul ba yin par bsgom dgos/ gang ltar yang lam rim ltar bshes gnyen bsten tshul la dad pa dang mos gus sbyangs pa gal che/ 'gro mgon skyob pa rin po ches/ /bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la/ /mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na/ /byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'byung bas/ /yid mos gus 'di la gzab par 'tshal/ /gsungs —pa ltar yin/ bla ma rnams la sgo sna tshogs nas dag snang sbyangs shing / rtsa 472

ba'i bla ma tshogs zhing gi gtso bor bsgoms nas gsol ba 'debs tshe/dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal/'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal rnams la bsam blo shugs drag btang nas sems skyo lhang lhang du 'gyur bar byed/ de nas rang nyams la dpag nas sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul bsam ste snying rje ci skye gang skye byed kyang / snying rje des drangs pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral 'dod dang / de'i ched du bla ma lha'i go 'phang thob 'dod kyis skyabs 'gro dang gsol 'debs sogs bya dgos/ dal 'byor ni rgyu dpe ngo bo gsum gyi sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul dang / rnyed na don che tshul nan tan gyis bsam dgos/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa'ang rtsa ba gsum dang rgyu mtshan dgu'i sgo nas bsam zhing gtso bo nam 'chi cha med bsam dgos te/ rje btsun mi las/ ngas 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom pa'i tshe/ /nam 'chi cha med yang yang sgodza/ /gsungs so/ /ngan song gi sdug bsngal ni tsha grang dang skom ltogs kyi sdug bsngal de dang de rang thog tu babs pa lta bur bsams te/ bzod mi bzod ji 'dra snyam du sgom zhing / tshe tshad la bsam na'ang ha las dgos pa zhig yin te/ dper na grang dmyal gyi tshe tshad ni mdzod las/ til sbyang nang nas lo brgya zhing / /til gcig byung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can gyi tshe yin te/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shus 'gyur/ /gsungs pa ltar dang / mi lo lngawācu ni rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i 473

nyin zhag gcig dang / de sum cu zla ba dang / de bcu zla ba dang / de bcu gnyis lo byas pa'i rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lo lnga bcu ni yang sos kyi tshe tshad/ 'og ma rnams ni rim bzhin brgyad 'gyur brgyad 'gyur du gsungs stabs/ skyes na thar rgyu med pa 'dra/ ji ltar bzod snyam du bsgom dgos/'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal yang skye rga na 'chi dang / 'dod pa btsal yang mi rnyed/mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab tshul/ mtho dman la nges pa med tshul/dgra gnyen la nges pa med tshul/ 'thab rtsod mu ge sogs mdor na mi yul du'ang dmyalī ba yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal lta bu yod tshul dang / snyigs dus kyi rgud pa mig mthong lag zin du yod pa rnams kyang re re bzhin dran te sems skyo lhang lhang e 'gro blta/ rang nyams la dpags nas sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul bsgom dgos la/ de rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas bsam tshul rtsa ba red/ de'i thog bdag gzhan mnyam brje sgom tshul gyi man ngag rnams ltar bsgoms na lhag par sa chod che/ spyir lam rim che chung dang / man ngag bde lam gyi khrid yig myur lam dang / 'jam dpal zhal lung / de'i khrid yig kun mkhyen gsungs lta bu'i lam rim khrid yig che chung gang zhig la blta thub kyang / rang rgyud dang sbyar nas dpyad sgom byas na skyed mi yong mi srid/ mdor na rgyun du las 'bras la yid ches shing dkon mchog la blo phugs gtod rgyu de ni rtsa ba yin/ skyid na bla ma dkon mchog gi drin du blta zhing / sdug na sngon las 474

su blta dgos/ sdig can la 'chi khar sdug bsngal byung na me tog kha 'bus zer ba yin/ sdug bsngal chen po'i 'bras bu smin pa'i 'go bzung ba red/chos pa la 'chi khar sdug bsngal byung na dom gsab brgyab zer ba yin/ sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu'i lhag ma dag pa yin/ spyir rang re chos pa la rkyen bzang ngan gang byung yang chos kyi gegs su mi 'gro bar lam du slob dgos/lha'i dpal 'byor lta bu 'byor na'ang nga rgyal khengs dregs dang g.yeng ba'i dbang du mi 'gro bar chos phyogs su bsgyur ci thub bya dgos/ yi dwags lta bu dbul la sdug bsngal bas kyang sems zhum par mi 'gyur bar las ngan gyi 'bras bu zad pa'i rgyu yin snyam du dga' ba sgoms/ sdug bsngal gyi yon tan ni spyod 'jug las/ gzhan yang sdug bsngal yon tan ni/ /skyo bas dregs pa sel bar byed/ /'khor ba pa la snying rje skye/ /dge la dga' zhing sdig la 'dzem/ gsungs so/ /mādor na/ snod bcud sdig pa'i 'bras bus yongs gang ste/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal char ltar babs gyur kyang / /las ngan 'bras bu zad pa'i rgyur mthong nas/ /rkyen ngan lam du slob par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsungs pa ltar/ rkyen ngan lam bsgyur lhag par gal che/ /gzhan yang sdug bsngal gyi snang ba gang byung yang / ngan song du skyes na 'di las lhag yin rgyu red snyam du ngan song dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsgoms te dge sbyor la 'bad ci thub gang thub byed/ rang nyams la dpags te ma rgan sems can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bsams 475

nas snying rje ci thub gang thub sgom zhing / sems bskyed bcos ma re tshun chad gsal btab ste/ de'i ngang nas dge sbyor la 'bad ci thub bye da/skyid sdug gang byung bla ma'i byin rlabs yin snyam du sems dga' lhang nger dge sbyor la 'bad dgos/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ srog 'tsho 'chi 'byor rgud bde sdig dang / /yang bstod smad snyan dang mi snyan sogs/ /gang byung yang bla ma'i byin rlabs yin/ /a la la ci byas glo ba dga'/ /re dogs kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /dpal zhi ba lha dang mar me mdzad/ /rje rgyal ba gnyis pa las 'ong ba'i/ /dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i gdams pa yis/ /a la la ltas ngan g.yang du len/ /rkyen ngan kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /gsungs pa ltar/ rkyen ngan lam 'khyer gyi gdams pa 'di shin tu zab/ yang rgyun du las 'bras la yid ches skyes ched/ las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa dang / byas pa chud mi za ba la nges pa 'dren ched/ dgra bcom pa sbrang rtsi'i dbyangs kyi byung ba dang rgyal bo in tra ya na'i byung ba/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi byung ba sogs/ 'dul ba lung dang / mdzangs blun/ las brgya ba sogs kyi byung ba sna tshogs la dpyad pa gtong zhing / de dag gis 'khor ba la snying bo med pa la'ang nges pa 'dren nus pas gal che/snying rje sgom tshe/ spyir dngos po thams cad kyi rdzas rgyun la thog ma med/ bye brag gang zag thams cad kyi rdzas rgyun la'ang thog ma med gshis rang gi skye ba la'ang thog ma med/ des 476

na skye ba blang ba la'ang grangs med/ de'i phyir sems can 'di'i mngal du ma skyes pa gcig kyang med/ skyes pa la grangs kyis mi chod/ mar gyur res kyis bskyangs pa tshad med tshul tshe 'di'i ma dang sbyar nas/ sgo sna tshogs nas drin che tshul bsams te/ sems can gcig mthong na'ang 'di ma rgan drin can yin snyam du bsam/ tha na khyi gcig zug pa'i sgra thos na'ang ma rgan drin can zhig grag gin 'dug snyam du bsam/ de nas rigs drug gi ma sems can thams cad nyam thag pa yin tshul dang / de dag gi sdug bsngal sna tshogs la 'dang brgyab nas snying re rje snyam ducisgoms/ byams snying rje'i gegs ni/ gtso bo zhe sdang yin gshis/ de'i mgo gnon ci jub bya/ dper na gzhan gyis rang la gnod pa byed 'ong tshe/ de ni phar khro ba'i yul min/ snying rje ba'i yul yin/ dper na rang gi ma rgan gdon gyis zin te smyos na phan 'dogs mkhan dang nad g.yog byed mkhan rnams la gshe ba dang rdung ba sogs byed pa la khro mi rigs pa ltar yin/dgra de dag kyang las ngan pa'i gdon gyis zin te/ nyon mongs pa'i nad langs nas las ngan bsags pa yin pa'i stabs/ snying rje ba'i yul yin/de dag gis rang la gnod pa byas na/ don la rang gi sdig sgrib 'dag pas sgrib sbyong du song gshis phan btags pa yin/ rang gis des gnod pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba de rang gis bsags pa'i las ngan gyi 'bras bu smin pa yin/ rang gi las ngan de'i dbang gis dgra bo khong khro skyer bcug nas 477

las ngan bsags bcug pa'i stabs kyis/ phar dgra bo de la gnod bskyal ba red/ ngas ma rgan 'di la khong khro skyer bcug pas/ de'i 'bras bu la dmyal bar skye dgos gshis sdug bsngal bzod thabs ci yod snyam du snying rje sgoms/ yang pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ dgra sdang las kyi 'khrul snang yin pa la/ /zhe sdang gdug tsub ma che ding ri ba/ /gsungs pa ltar/ sems can 'di dgrar langs nas mtha' bskor kyang / don la rang gi las kyi 'khrul snang yin/ dper na dmyal bar skyes tshe las mkhan mtha' dag laso kyi 'khrul snang las byung ba dang 'dra 'dra yin/ mdor na bzang ngan gyi snang ba gang rgyung yang dge sbyor 'phel ba'i grogs dang / byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'phel ba'i grogs su bsgyur dgos/ gang ltar rkyen bzang ngan gang byung tshe da kon mchog dang las 'bras la yid je che dang dge sbyor la brtson pa je cher song dus shig chog gi yod ni yin/ mdor na bzang ngan snang ba ci shar yang / /chos kun snying bo stobs lnga'i nyams len gyis/ /byang chub sems gnyis 'phel ba'i lam bsgyur te/ /yid bde 'ba' zhig sgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsungs pa ltar red/ de ltar du blo sbyong thub tshe bzang ngan gang byung yang sems 'tshub rgyu med par bde chab kyis yod/ stobs lnga ni/ 'phen pa'i stobs/ goms pa'i stobs/dkar bo sa bon gyi stobs/ sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi stobs te lnga'o/ /'phen pa'i stobs ni/ mi tshe stong zad du mi gtong snyam du 478

'phen pa gtong ba dang / nangs par langs nas de ring gi nyi ma 'di la'ang dge sbyor gyi dus 'da' bar bya snyam du bsam pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'dus yod/ goms pa'i stobs ni/ rgyun du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la goms pa 'di shin tu gal che gsungs/ dkar bo sa bon gyi stobs ni/ tshogs bsags pa la zer/ sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni/ sdig pa bshags pa la zer/ bsngo smon gyi stobs ni/ mjug tu bsngo smon rnam dag byed pa/ thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis gsungs pa de/ 'phen pa'i stobs dang bsngo smon gyi stobs la zer/ thog ma'i bya ba 'phen pa'i stobs gal che ste/ dper na mda' 'phen pa'i tshe thog mar shugs bskyed na/ de nas 'ben la thug gi bar du rang shugs kyis 'gro ba dang 'dra/mjug gi bya ba byang chub tu bsngo ba gal che ste/ 'bras bu dman par mi smin pa gal che/ dkar bo sa bon gyi stobs ni yar dkon mchog sogs zhing dam pa la mchod pa dang / mar dbul phongs la sbyin pa gtong ba de/deng sang rang 'byor thog nas mngon chos byed pa dka' zhing dgos pa'ang med/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing khams thams cad na me tog sogs mchod rdzas gang yod thams cad yid yul du byas te phul na bsam gyis mi khyab/ tha na chu dwangs bsil mthong ba dang / spang ljongs mthong ba/me tog dang ljon shing / shing tog sogs zas rigs/ dar gos sogs 479

gos rigs legs pa gang mthong yangaci/ de ma thag yid 'ong mchod yon sogs yid kyis bton/ bsam pa rtse gcig gis 'bul ba ni dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba yin/ yang rang gis yid kyis mchod rdzos bzang dgu nam mkha' gang ba sprul ba dang / rdul re re'i steng du rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams rgya metsho dang mchod rdzos bzang dgu sprul nas 'bul ba ni yid kyis sprul ba'i mchod pa yin la lhag par bsam gyis mi khyab/ sbyin pa ni/ rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa dang bcas pa nyin re bzhin dus drug tu bla ma la 'bul zhing /sems can rang rang gi mkho dgu'i yo byad du gyur par bsams nas/sems can la bsngo ba ni sbyin gtong gi mchog yin/ 'di dag kyang thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor nang du tshang dgos/ gcod kyi man ngag yod na de'i sgo nas mar dbul phongs dang gdon bgegs la sbyin pa gtong ba'i dmigs rnam bskyangs na zab/ de la ki si li'i tshogs bsags kyang zer/gang ltar gdams pa re re'i nang du sto/bas lnga ga tshang bar bya dgos/ sdig pa bshags pa la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mchod pa sogs tshang ma sdig bshags yin yang / spyir sdig pa bshags pa la stobs bzhi tshang dgos/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rten gyi stobs/ dug khong du song ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ sdig pa phyi ma mi byed snyam pa'i sdom sems drag po nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs/ gzungs sngags zab mo 480

dang ltung bshags sogs kyi sgo nas sgrib sbyong byed pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang bzhi'o/ /dper na rdor sems sgom bzlas lta bu la'ang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ 'gyod sems/ sdom sems/ bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyangs dang yig brgya bzla ba bzhi tshang dgos pa lta bu yin/ sdom gsum dag pa nyams len gyi mthil du 'dzin rgyu 'di rang re'i bka' gdams gsar rnying gi man ngag gtso bo yin/ so thar la mtshon na/ pham bzhi dang lhag ma bcu gsum/ chang sogs kyis gtan nas ma gos pa zhig byas te/ spang ltung gi skor la gos 'bral spang lta bu la deng dus thabs bral bas rung mthun sbyar na chog snyam/ 'chang spang yo byad byin rlabs la rnam brtags byas na chog pa 'dul ba rang las gsungs stabs des chog la/de byed tshul ni nyin re bzhin du rang la longs spyod gang yod dkon mchog la 'bul ba'am/ sems can gyi don du bsngo ba de yin/ rgyun du nyams len byed mkhan zhig la 'di zhor la 'ong / de las gzhan pa'i spang ltung sum cu'i nang srung ba'i phan yon 'byung sa las/ yul dus kyi dbang gis ltung ba 'byung sa cher med/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dang sor bshagos bzhi rnams phal cher la srung ba'i phan yon yod pa las ma srung ba'i ltung ba 'byung sa yul dus kyi dbang gis cher med pa 'dra snyam la/ 'ga' zhig la rung mthun kyang sbyar na chog snyam/ de 'dra byas na khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum de srung rgyu dka' rgyu rang med snyam/ byang sems la rtsa ltung 481

bco brgyad dang / nyes byas zhe drug red/ rtsa ltung la'ang kun dkris chen po bzhi tshang dgos sa mang gshis ltung ba dngos gzhi 'byung rgyu sla ba zhig min/ sngags la rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang / rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig bcu dgu/ sbom po brgyad sogs red/ rgyun du dran 4shes bsten na srung rgyu dka' mo ma red/ ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo bzhi yod pa'i ma gus pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo/ de'i gnyen por dkon mchog— dang las 'bras la yid ches shing /theg pa chung gi sdom pa'i spang blang gi phan yon dang nyes dmigs la yid ches shing / bslab bya la shin tu gus pa la slob dgos/ bag med pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo/ de'i gnyen por rgyun du lus ngag yid gsum bag yod par bya dgos/ nyon mongs pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo/ de'i gnyen por rang rgyud la brtagasaras nyon mongs gang shas che na de'i gnyen po sgoms/dper na/ 'dod chags kshi gnyen por mi sdug pa sgom pa dang / zhe sdang gi gnyen por byams pa sgom pa/ gti mug gi gnyen por khams kyi rab dbye sgom pā/ rnam rtog gi gnyen por dbugs 'byung rngub sgom ste rnam rtog mi 'phro bar byed pa lta bu yin/ mi shes pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo/de'i gnyen por thos bsam byarsā nas sdom pa so so'i bsrung bya rnams yid la nges par bya dgos/— 'di deng sang dka' mo red de/ sdom gsum bslab bya bsdu ma re tshun chad la rku lta re byas nas/ rags rim re yin yang nges thub na bzang / gung thang rin po che'i tshe gcig nyams len gyi 482

nang du sdom gsum bsngo bgrangs rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa zhig yod/ a khu blo gros tshang gi sdom gsum bslab bya ni shin tu legs la 'gran zla bral mod/'byor dka' rgyu red snyam/ mdor na/ rang gis shes tshod dang thub tshod nas 'bad na mi shes pa dang thabs med pa la ha cang 'dang brgyab nas rlung lang gi bcug ma bcug med/ gal te ltung ba byung na bshags sdom la 'bad dgos shing / bshags sdom byed thabs mang bo yod/ stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas rdo rje sermeṅge depa'i bsgom bzlas dang 'brel yig brgya 'bum bzlas na gsang sngags kyi rtsa ltung yang 'dag par rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs/ byang sems dang so thar gyi rtsa ltung 'dag par lta ci smos snyam/'on kyang ltung ba bcos thabs las logs su med/ sngags la dbang dang bdag 'jug gi sgo nas rtsa ltung gso dgos/ thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi blangs na bdag 'jug gi go chod gsungs/ rang res so thar ma zad sdom pa gong ma gnyis ka yang blangs yod gshis/ thun drug gi rnal 'byor gal che/ de yang yongs grags kyi thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor de'am/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma lta bu'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor la'ang de'i man ngag tshang bar byas chog khrid yig rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung na yod/ ma mtha'/ so thar byang sems rdo rje theg pa yi/ /rnam dag bcas pa'i bslab pa phra mo las/ /rmi lam du yang 'da' bar mi bya bar/ /rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bdag gis bsgrub par bya/ /zhesari pa 'di nyin lan 483

gsum mtshan lan gsum du bton te bsam na ltung ba khegs gsungs/spyir kha ton gang byed kyang don yid la dran pa gal che/ don dran thub na tshig kha nas ma bton kyang chog tshig 'don pa don dran ched red/ sngags kyi bzlas pa sgra dag gsal gsum gyi sgo nas 'don dgos par gsungs mod/ deng sang de yang yid 'don mi byed ka med yin gshis/ yid 'don byas na'ang los chog gang ltar yang rang nyid 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la 'jigs pa dang/ skyabs yul gyi tshogs zhing rnams la de las skyob pa'i nus pa yod par yid ches pa/ 'di gnyis la skyabs 'gro'i rgyu gnyis zer/ de ltar skyabs 'gro dang / de nas rang nyams la dpags te byams snying rje'i dmigs rnam bskyangs nas smon 'jug gi sems bskyed/ de nas bla ma rdo rje 'chang sogs lhag lha gang rung gi rnam par bsgoms te phyag 'tshal/ mchod 'bul/ maṇḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams byas te mthar bla ma snying kar bsdus te/ stong ba nyid la mnyam par bzhag nas/ de'i ngang nas rang nyid lhar ldang / lus longs spyod dge rtsa bcas sems can la bsngo zhing / sdom gsum bsngo bgrangs rgyas bsdus ci rigs byed pa ni thun drug gi rnal 'byor yin/ bla mchod lta bu la de los tshang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma lta bu la de tshang lugs yod/sbyar shes na cho ga gang la'ang tshang bar byas chog thun drug gi rnal 'byor zer ba ni/ nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu/ sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu 484

sbyin/ /gsungs pa lta bu'i dus drug la bsngo bgrangs dang nyams su len dgos pa'i sngags byang sems kyi sdo ma pa rnams thun gcig tu nyams su len tshul gyi man ngag zab mo grub mtha' gzhan gyi gser chos zer ba las kyang khyad du 'phags pa'i gdams pa zab mo yin/spyir mdo sngags kyi lam yongs rdzogs la bag chags 'jog ched yon tan gzhir gyur ma'am/ bla mchod kyi zhing mchog dmadze pa'am/ lam rim bsdus don lta bu re'i sgo nas lam yongs rdzogs shar sgom re byed pa ni gnad dam pa yin te/ tshul 'di thun rer bton dang nyan pas kyang / /dam chos 'chad dang thos pa'i phan yon sogs/ /rlabs chen sdud par nges pas de don bsams/ /gsungs so// mjug tu bzang po spyod pa lta bus bsngo smon rnam dag bya dgos te/thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis gsungs pa red/ rgyun du'ang bya ba gang byed sems can gyi don du bsngo ba gal che/ dper na zhing las byed pa/phyugs 'tsho ba sogs gang byed kyang / 'di lta bu'i sgo nas kyang sems can gyi don byed par gyur cig ces smon lam 'debs/ spyod 'jug smon lam gyi nang gi bsngo smon mtha' deg byang chub sems sgom gyi man ngag yin pas de ltar bya dgos/ khyod kyi 'dri tshul la bltas na nyams len byed 'dod re yod 'dra bas de ma thag lan 'di bris pa yin/ re zhig 'di'i mig byas la 'bad brtson bskyed 'tshal/ man ngag 'di tsho snod ldan re yod tshe 485
