bstan na los chog sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs pa sems can gyi don red/ de min snod min la shin— tu gsang ba gal /che/ snod min la bstan na chos byi byin rlabs nyams 'gro ba chos nyid yin/ phyi bltas rgya rgan mgo dkar te/ /nang bltas ban rgan sems da kar des/ /rang blo yol ko'i bcud thigs 'ga'/ /khyed kyi ched du sug pas spel// 'di ni mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid chen po bka' drin gzhal du med cing mtshan brjod par dka' ba slob dpon rin po che bsam gtan rgya mtsho mchog gis gang gi dngos slob 'jam dbyangs nyi ma la lo bcu'i zing 'tshub drag po'i nang mtshan mo zhig gi glog sgron 'og 'phral mar gsang ris su gnang ba lags la/ da reb par tu bsgrun pa'i dge bas 'gro ba rnams yang dag lam la bgrod par gyur cig gu/'phags pa 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang bya tshul bklags pa'i don grub/ ga ོ/ /'dir sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan 'jam dbyangs nag po'i rjes gnang bya tshul la/ stegs ji ltar 'tsham pa'i steng khebs bzang bos g.yogs pa'i steng du/ 'bru dkar gyi padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du/ malha'i khar maṇḍal gyi steng du tshom bu nag po bkod/ de'i mdun du dkar gtor skum po gsum de'i mdun du bdag mdun gyi mchod pa chu gnyis nyer spyod dang mthar mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa rgya chen pos bskor bar bya/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo dril dang bum pa rnams bshams/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang / rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa 'jam dpal nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i rnyiḥ yig las 'od zer 486

'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa 'jam depal nag po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥzhes brjod cing lag pa pad kor byas te dpung mgo gnyis kyi thad du kha nang du bstan te se gol gtogs pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas tshogs zhingamadun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ sgo gsum gus pas bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dngos bshams yid sprul muchod pa 'bul/ /thogs med nas bsags sdig pa bshags/ /dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dge ba ci bsags pa/ /thams cad byang chub chen por bsngo/ /tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā lu shuddhā sa rba dharma su bhā lwa shurjo hra hūṃ/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las baṃ las padma/ a las zla ba'i steng du rang gi sems nyid dhī yig mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs sku mdog mthing ga zhakha gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon atpal thugs kar 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba'i steng na sher phyin gyi po ti bzhugs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / 4yid tsam 'phros pa/ dar dang rus pa 487

dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ medapung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par tso thugs kar rgyu/ thugs ka'i rgyu las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'phags pa 'jam dpal nag po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥ rgyu baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rigs— lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas oṃ badzra bhā lwa a sgyi ṣi ñtsa rgyu/zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ erghaṃ.āḥrgyu/ nas shabha ā hūṃ gi bar gyi byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ mazhu shrī kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra a rghaṃ pra tī tstsha ṭwāhā/ nas shabha pra tītstsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gcig bsdus pa/ /mig sman mdangs can mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter/ /byin rlabs dngos grub mchog stsol lhag pa'i lha/ /'jam dpal khyed kyi sku gsung thugs la bstod/ /gang gi zhabs rdul gus pas bsten pa rnams//488

gdon gsum gnod pa'i dpung gis mi brdzi zhing / /nyams grib dri ma mtha' dag byang byed pa'i/ /byin rlabs gter chen khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /tse gcig yid kyis lhag pa'i lhar bsten na/ /dzamigs med thugs rje mchog gis nyer dgongs te/ /phyi dang nang gi nyer 'tshe kun snyi zhing / /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ /ces bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i nyi gdan la rnyiḥyig mthing nag gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng ba kha dog nag pos bskor ba las 'od zer dmar bo me 'od lta bu 'phros/mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod 'tshe bsam ngan sbyor tsub grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/dur ta sod/ snying mgo la chod/ kha la dzaḥ kai shaṃ tram̐ rbad phaṭa swā hā/zhes pa 'di rtsa sngags yin pas ci rigs par skabs su babs pa'i spro bsdu'i dmigs padang bcas te bzla'o/ /bzlas pa'i mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang zhing mchod bstod bya/bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa 455 du gsol/ zhes 'don don la gsol ba btab/de nas las bum sgrub pa ni las bum la dmigs te swā bha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang lus pad zla'i steng du rgyu las rin po che'i bum pa dkar bo zhabs zhum pa/lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa ring ba mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgrin pa dkris pa nang bcud bzang bos gang ba'i nang du/ pad zla'i gdan la rgyu las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang sngon/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang / g.yon de'i yu 489

ba byas pa'i dril bu bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/dzaḥ hūṃḥ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/dbang gi lhas dbang bskur mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ a rga sogs kyis mchod/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrogs shing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bkugs nas bum pa'i chu la thim par gyur/ oṃ badzra a sri ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ci 'grub bzlas mthar/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyilnga bas bdag dang slob mar rjes su gnang ba 'chad nyan byed pa la bgegs rnams bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces gsol ba btab pas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu la thim par gyur/ ces bum pa bsgrubs/ de nas mchod pa rnams la bum chu gtor zhing a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las mchod yon/490

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ a rghaṃḥ rgyu/ zhes pa nas oṃ shabha āḥhūṃ gi bar brjod de mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ tshom buli burme chu gtor zhing a phri tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las baṃ las sna tshogs padma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rnyi ཿyig mthing nag las ral gri 'bar ba dhīḥ sa mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas ral gri 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon mtheb srin gyis thugs kar utpa la'i yu ba bsnams pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba'i steng ne sher phyin gyi po ti 'dzin pa/rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ sku rngam bajid dang ldane zhing / ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar bo/ mgrin par lhadamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom pa 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi chus spyi 491

bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ mdzi shrī kā la ya sa ba ri wā ra a rghaṃ pa tī tstsha swā hā/ nas shabha pra tī tstsha su hā'i bar gyis mcho/da/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gcig bsdus pa/ /mig sman mdangs can mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter/ /byin rlabs dngos grub mchog stsol lhag pa'i lha/ /'jam dpal khyod kyi sku gsung thugs la bstod/ /gang gi zhabs rdul gus pas bsten pa rnams/ /gdon gsum gnod pa'i dpung gis mi brdzi zhing /sku /nyams grib dri ma mtha' dag byang byed pa'i/ /byin rlabs gter chen khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtse gcig yid kyis lhag pa'i lhar bsten na/ /dmigs med thugs rje mchog gis nyer dgongs te/ /phyi dang nang gi nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ /mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar nyi gdan la dhīḥ yig mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng kha dog nag pos bskor ba las 'od zer dmar bo me 'od lta bur 'phros/ mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod 'tshe bsam ngan sbyor tsub grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/slar yang 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang dang slob ma sogs la thim par gyur/ oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ dur ta sod/ snying mgo la chod/ kha la dzaḥ kai shaṃ tram̐ rbad phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci 'aspub bzla/492

mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang zhing mchod bstod bya/ mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis bdag dang slob ma dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa su ba du gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas gtor ma gsum la bum chu gtor zhing / a mṛ tas bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs‘ pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/oṃ āḥ hūṃḥ lan gsum/ mdun bskyed kyi lhas gtor ma'i bcud rnams drangs te gsol bar bsam la/ gtor ma dang bo/ oṃ mdzi shrī kā la ya oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sa rba rnya rma ṇi abya nitpanda to dā oṃ āḥ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis 'bul /oṃ mdzi shrī kā la ya sa ba ri tsā ra a rghaṃ nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyayothams cad kyi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ bstod pa'i mjug gi tshigs bcad phyi mas 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/a ka ro lan gsam gyis chos skyong la dbul/ ma rghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas kyis/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen kun sel mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /gsum pa gzhi bdag spyi dang khyad par yuladeraganas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams la a ka ro lan 493

gsum gyis bsngos la/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod de/ gzhi bdag spyi dang khyad par du/ /yul 'dir gnas pa rnams la bsngo/ /ko long phrag dog ma byed par/ /chos dang mthān pa'i mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /long yod kyang spro na rang nyid kyis mdun bskyed las rjes gnang len pa'i dmigs pa bya/ de nas rjes gnang bya ba la/slob ma rnams khrus byas/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga la/ sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba dang / dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba gnyis yod pa las/ dang bo ni slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa bya ba/mdun bskyed kyi maṇḍal gyi steng du yi dam gyi lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa dang / de la mchod pa dang bstod pa/ gtor ma 'bul ba dang /thugs rgyud bskul bar bya ba'i phyir du bzlas pa yun ring du bya dgos pa yin pas/ de dag sngon du legs par grub zin nas/ khyed rnams kyi dngos skal du gyur pa slob ma la bya ba la/ rjes su gnang ba'i sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi dang rjes kyi bya ba rnam pa gsum las/ dang bo/ mandal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang / rgyud dag par bya ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams su yod pa las/ thog mar slob dpon 'phagasartsopa 'jam dpal dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal 'bul ba sogs grub nas/ phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'dis rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 494

'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni 'gro la phan don du/ /brtse chen khyed la gsol 'debs kyi/ /ma lus rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud da—ga par bya ba'i phyir du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'phags pa 'jam dpal nag po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung chen po 'thibs pa bzhin mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa'i bdag la 'phags pa 'jam dpal nag po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin la/ dngos gzhi la/sku'i rjes gnang / gsung gi rjes gnang /thugs kyi rjes gnang dang gsum yod pa las/ thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon 'phags parī 'jam dpal dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis/slob dpon gyi thugs ka'inywaḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu dang pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyi ma shar ba lta bu 'phros pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi 495

lus la phog pas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang / khyad par du rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i phung bo khams dang skye mched gzung 'dzin tha mal du 'dzin pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyis gang bar gyur par bsam/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas/ haṃ/ zhes pa'i snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bstas pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spro ba'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu stong ba nyid du sbyangs par bsam la/ stong ba'i ngang las nam mkha'i dbyings baṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid dhīḥyig mthing nagaci gi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ khyed rang rnams 'phags pa 'jam dpal nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon utpal thugs kar 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba'i steng na sher phyin gyi po ti bzhugs pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / yid tsam khros pa/ dar dang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ slob dpon yang khyed rang rnams kyis bsgom pa lta bu'i 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos yin snyam pa'i yid kyi gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i rgyu las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems 496

dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal nag po'i sku tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lus la thim par gyur /slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas kyang 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs nag po'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/chung ba rdul phran tsam/ tshad med grangs med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga dbang bo'i sgo la sogs pa rnams la mtsho chen po la kha ba babs pa ltar lus la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/rol mo bya zhing / oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ dur ta sod/snying mgo la chod/ kha la dzaḥshaṃ kai swā hā/oṃ badzra a be shā ya aḥ aḥ.aḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes yang yang brjod cing gnyis su med par bstem/ de ltar na 'phags pa 'jam dpal nag po sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal nag po'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ de la brten nas sku bsgoms pa dang / sku'i 'phrin las mtha' dag sgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ /gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon 'phags pa 'jam dpal nag por gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rtswaḥ yig gi mthar sngags phreng 497

'jam dpal dbyangs nag por gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sgyiḥyig mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng kha dog mthing nag 'od zer 'bar ba gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi 'phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis 'char gyi tshul du byung /zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i gyiḥyig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khor bar mos te/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/dur ta sod/ snying mgo la chod/kha la dzaḥkai shaṃ tram̐ rbad phaṭa swā hā/de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas dang bos rgyud byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/gsum pas brtan par mos pa byas te/slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du/ me tog gtor nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'dis rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab/ khyed rang rnams kyis phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba de nyid slob dpon gyis sngags kyi 'phreng ba'i rang bzhin du byas te/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag nas byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod//bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi//'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyis dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi 498

rgyud la bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs nag po'i sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig de ltar 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs nag po'i gsung gi rjes gnang thob/khyed rang rnams kyi skye ba thog ma med pa nas ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs nag po'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ de la brten nas gsung bzlas pa dang /gsung gi 'phrin las mtha' dag bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ /thugos kyiphyo rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs nag por gsal ba'i zhal nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud las/ dngos po med pas sgom pa med//bsgom pa ra bya ba bsgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas//bsgom pa'ang dmigs su med pa'o//zhes gsungs te/ de'i don khyed rang lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu de nyid la yid ches kyis gtad pa la brten nas/rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer 'ja' lta bu'i tshul du ltem gyis zhu ste thugs ka'i sa bon la thim zhing / sa bon de yang je chung je phrar gyur te/ nam mkha' la 'ja' yāl ba bzhin du rang yal du yal ba la brten nas gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams 499

cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu mtshan nyid can khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa rmemadzod cig spro na me tog gtor te/ bcom ldan 'di la soges dang / thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs nag po'i thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyis skye ba thog ma med pa nas yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs nag po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bsgom pa dang / thugs kyi 'phrin las mtha' dag bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so/ /de'i khyed rang rnams la 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs nag po'i rjes su gnang ba legs par grub pa yin pas/ de dag gi dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag legs par bsrung snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' su yi ba/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /lan gsum/ lus bran du 'bul ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod//deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du//khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags gyi//khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang //cha yis kyang ni bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes rjes zlos byed/ maṇḍal 'bul du 'jug slob dpon gyis tshom bu'i mchod pa byin gyis rlabs te/ mchod bstod dang / bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing mchog 500

dang —thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ ma 'byor ba sogs kyi nongs pa bzod par gsol/rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya med na oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra maX zhes mtheb ༄༷srin gyis se gol byas te tshom ba'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la ༄thim par gyur/ bsngo smon dang shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o//zhes 'phags pa 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang bya tshul baglags pa'i don grub ces bya ba 'di ni/lhan thabs gsal ba'i me long las zhi ba'i sku la brten nas sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i chings sbyor ba yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i chings par brten sdas bris pa'o/ / — 501

'jam dbyangs darmar ser sogs 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs skor/ ༄7/ /mjam dpal dbyangs dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs nyams su len pa la/ gnas yid du 'ong bar khrus dang gtsang sbra dang ldan pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi dmigs rnam yid khul ba'i sgo nas/sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum/ khyad par gyi sems bskyed ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi//ma rig mun pa rab bsal nas//sangs rgyas sa la 'god par bya/ /de'i phyir 'jam dpal bsgom par bya/ /lan gsum/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid 'jam dpal gsal ba'i thugs ka ru/ /pad zla'i steng du gyiḥ yig dmar ser las/ /'od 'phros 'jam dpal dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems kyis bskor ba dzra sa ma dzaḥ / na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta ārya mazhu shrī sa pa ri wā ra bhyaḥ /zhes phyag bya/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya mañdzu shrī sa ba ri wā ra arghaṃ pra ti tstsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te pā bye nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi//zhes sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan pa dang / /sdug bsngal kun las bral zhing bde dga' rgyas/ /chags sdang gnyis dang bral 502

ba'i btang snyoms dang / /mi dge spang zhing dge tshogs 'phel gyur cig /ces tshad med bzhi sgom/gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/oṃ swa bha wa shu ddhaḥ sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shurjo3 haṃ/'khor 'das chos kun rang bzhin stong ba'i ngang rang snying sgo nga lta bu'i nang nyid du//baṃ las padma a las zla dkyil steng//rang gi sems nyid gyiḥyig dmar ser las//'od 'phros rang lus nang gang sdig sgrib dag /mi shes rmongs pa'i mun pa kun bsal te//dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ /slar yang de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ /rang nyid rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /phyag g.yas shes rab ral gri mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa me tog utpa la'i yu ba//thugs kar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad/ /kha phye steng na sher phyin glegs bam bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje dkyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /rin chen rgyan cha sna tshogs kyis spras shing //lha yi gos bzang dar gyi sham thabs gsol//gzhon nu bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho rgyas/ /ral ba'i zur phud lnga ldan rin chen tog /zla ba 'od ze ra 'bar ba'i rgyab yol can/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar dwangs gsal 'od rang bzhin//gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyi mtshan par gyur//thugs ka'i sa bon las 'phros 'od zer gyis//rang bzhin gnas nas bla ma 'jam dpal la//sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam chos skyong bcas//bskor ba spyan drangs dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yis//dam tshig pa dang dbyer med ro gcig gyur//slar yang 503

ri thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis//dbang lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs gsol btab pas/ /sngags dang tshigs bcad dang bcas bum chu yis/ /dbang bskur lus gang dri ma kun dag nas//chu lhag yar lud mi spyod dbu brgyan gyur//gong bzhin mchod/gzhon nu sku lus 'chang ba bo//sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ snying gar padma zla steng rtswaḥyig mthar/ /sngags 'phreng bskor ba'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las//sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la mchod pa phul//ma lus 'gro ba'i mi shes mun pū bsal/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal dang / /mkhas pa paṇḍi ta yi 'chad rtsod rtsom/ /thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab ma lus pa/ /bsdus nas sngags 'phreng sa bon bcas la thim//blo gros snang ba thogs med rgyas par gyur//oṃ a ra pa tsa na gyiḥzhes ci nus bzla/ thun 'jog khar/ lce'i rtsa bar :ཿyig mgo gre phugs su bstan nas nyal stabs su gnas pa la dmigs nas/ dbugs thengs gcig la gyiḥbargya rtsa brgyad bgrangs te gyiḥ re brjod pa dang ñtsāḥlas rang 'dra gnyis pa re chad nas snying kha'i gyiḥl thim pas me thog tu mar khu thigs pa bzhin du 'od cher 'bar te lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar bsam nas mi brjed pa'i gzungs sgrub par byed/ thun bsdu ba ni rang nyid 'od zhu snying ga'i sngags 'khor la/ /thim zhing de nyid sa bon gyiḥl thim/ /de nyid 'od zhu nam mkhar 'ja' yal ltar/ /(bsam la lta thog tu cung zad bzhag) slar yang chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin//'phags pa 'jam dpal 504

dbyangs kyi skur bzhengs gyur/ /bsam la dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa sman pa 'od gsal gyis yang yang bgil ngor spyi lo1991 lo'i zla11 tshes20la brtsams/'jam dbyangs skor/༄༅/ /'dir a ra pa tsa na dang dmigs brtse ma sbrags pa'i sgo nas shes rab sgrub tshul thun mong ba 'god pa la/ dga' ldan lha brgya'i mgon gyi thugs ka nas//zhes pa nas/ bstan pa'i snying bo ring du gsal byed shog /zhes pa'i bar khrid yig ltar yan lag bdun po ngo 'phrod par byas te rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/ rje btsun bla ma'i thugs kar pad zla'i gdan//dhīḥ yig dmar ser 'od kyi 'phro 'du las//'jam dbyangs dmar ser phyag g.yas ral gri dang //g.yon pas utpal yu ba thugs kar 'dzin// 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha phye'i steng //sher phyin glegs bam rang sgra sgrogs bzhin bzhugs/ /skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i thugs ka ru/ /gyiḥ yig dmar ser 'od zer dpag med can/ /mtha' skor a ra pa tsa dmigs brtse mas//g.yas skor bskor ba de las 'od zer tshogs/ /mkha' khyab spros pas 'gro ba'i rmongs mun bsal//rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul//sras bcas rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs ka nas//'jam dpal sku dang sa bon sngags bcas dang / /phyag mtshan glerges bam ral gri'i 'khor lo 505

sogs//spyan drangs rang gi lus la thim pa las//dug gsum sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad bsal//rang lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi phung bor gyur/ /shes bya kun la blo gros thogs med rgyas//mkhyen rab 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos lta bur gyur/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na gyiḥ dang dmigs brtse ma ci 'grub bzla/ mjug tu/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /bla ma 'jam dpal 'grub gyur nas//'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa//de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dad ldan dge slong dge 'dun rgya mtshos 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes nan tan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ brgyud ldan bla ma'i man ngag bzhin 'phral du bris pa'o//'jam dbyangs dkar bo dang dbyangs can ma sbrags pa'i sgrub thabs/ ༄7/ /'jigs med stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' bshes gnyen dag /bsam dang sbyor bas bsten pa'i byin mthu las/ /gtun gyi bde la gzhol ba'i dpal ldan pa/ /gdul bya ñtsha mardo'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs//rab dkar gangs kyi ri la co 'dri ba'i/ /sku mchog mtshan dpe'i me tog rab rgyas shing / /gsung dbyangs drug cu'i gdangs kyis 'gro kun gyi/ /rmongs mun sel mdzad 'jam dbyangs la phyag 'tshal//dri za'i bu mo'i beeḍūr rgyud mangs sgras//'gro kun rmongs pa'i gnyid las slong mdzad ma//bla ma mchog 506 ri

dang dbyer med dbyangs can mas//bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa bsal du gsol/ /oṃ wa kye rda na maḥ trīḥzhes ci nus bzla/ lhag pa'i lha dang dbyer med bla ma lha'i//byin rlabs snying la zhugs pa'i byin mthu las//bdag rgyud chos kyis brlan par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma sangs rgyas mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyu 'bras 'chol med dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngan song sdug bsngal dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro kun pha mar shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /byams dang snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brje skye bar byin gyis rlobs//chos kun gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshu'/ khrims rnam par dag pa'i gzhi bzung nas/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde mtha' dag la/ /thos bsam sgom sgrub byas pa la brten nas/ /'gro kun 'dren pa'i byed por bdag gyur cig /mdor na skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung nas/ /sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur du thob gyur te/ /ma rnams thar ba'i gling du 'dren par shog /ces pa 'di ni dge slong shes rab 'od zer gyis 'di 'dra zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor spel ba'o//507

'jam dpal —seṅge'i gdong can dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs/༄7 //mchod pa byin gyis rlardos pa ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs oṃ swa bhā wa shu ddhaḥ sarba dharmāḥ su bhā wa shurjo ྅ haṃ/ zhes pas sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/zhabs bsil/me tog bdug spos/ mar me/dri chab/zhal zas/rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' glas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sāhā/ oṃ badzra pā bye swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe swā hā/ oṃ badzra sgru be swā hāzhes sogs nas oṃ badzra shabha swā hā/ mthar rol mo dkrol te oṃ badzra rnyarmāḥ ra ṇi ta/pra ra ṇi ta/saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/sarba budha kṣe tra pra tsa li ni pratsā pa ra mi tā ma de su bhā wa/badzra sa twa sarnyo ṣa ni rgyu hūṃ/a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyi byin rlabs bya/ skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying bo la ma mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 508

rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan bdun nam gsum/thal mo snying khar sbyar te bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o//khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/de'i ched du 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgom bzlas la 'jug par bya'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas sems bskyed/ rang nyid skad cig gi 'jam dbyangs seṅge'i gdong can du gsal ba'i thugs kar padma dang zla ba'i steng du muḥ las 'od zer 'phros pa 'jam dbyangs seṅge'i gdong can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ / zhes phyag rgya dang bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ mdzi sto ṣa sa wa ri wā ra a rghaṃ ṭwāhā/ oṃ badzra pātram̐ zhes sogs nas shabha swā hā la/rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi//zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang sogs tshad med bzhi sgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod de/ rang gi phung khams— skye mched thams cad mi dmigs pa stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las seṅge sngon po mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng na baṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du muḥ dmar ser las 'od zer 'phros/ 509

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog gur kum gzhon nu'i kha dog lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon utpal bsnams pa/ral ba'i zur phud lngas brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang dar gyi na bza' can/zhabs g.yas rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar bo/mgrin par āḥdamar bo/thugs kar rgyu sngon po/rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'ide bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'jam dbyangs seṅge'i gdong can dmar ser gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes phyag rgya dang bcas spyan drangs/oṃ mdzi sto ṣa sa ba ri wā ra a rghaṃ sogs kyis gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra a rghaṃ sogs kyis sngar ltar mchod/dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badzra bha wa a sgyi ṣa ñtsa rgyu zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/sku gang /dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying kar zla 510

ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa bon muḥ yig gi mthar oṃ wā gī shwa ri muḥzhes pa'i sngar gyi 'phreng ba g.yas skorno du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang / sdig sgrib dang des bskyed pa'i nad gdon thams cad dag rig gnas rab 'byams la shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas par byas/ 'od zer phyir 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas par gyur/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muḥ zhes bzla bar bya'o//mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad skong / oṃ mdzi sto ṣa sa ba ri wā ra a rghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba bo/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa//de'i sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa sman pa 'od gsal gyis nan gyis bskul ngor bris pa'o// 'jam dpal gyi rtog pa las byung ba'i ngag gi rgyal bo gser mdog can gyi sgrub thabs/༄7/ /skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying bo la ma mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la 511

skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis ma sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs ngag gi rgyal bo gser mdog can gyi sgom bzlas nyams su len par bya'o//zhes lan gsum/sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi sgom/ dngos gzhi la/oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥ sarba rnyarmāḥ swa bhā wa shu rjohwa haṃ/ rang gi phung khams skye mched thames cad mi dmigs par stong ba nyid du gyur/stong ba'i ngang las seng ge sngon po mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du pad ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ yig gser gyi mdog can de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/sems can gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/slar 'dus/yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag gi rgyal bo gser mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad de/g.yas g.yon du gyes pa'i utpal sngon po re re 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral ba'i thor cog g.yon du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes par byas pa/zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/de'i spyi 512

bor oṃ dkar bo mgrin par āḥdamar bo/ thuṭa kar hūṃ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i rgyu las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag gi rgyal bo gser mdog can gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzraḥ.oṃ mañdzu sto ṣa sa ba ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ.oṃ pañtsa ku la sa ba ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pa'i dbang gis lha rnams kyis oṃ badzra bha wa a gi ṣi ñtsa hūṃ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang /dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ snying kar zla gdan la rgyu yig gi mthar oṃ mdzi badzra hūṃ/ zheso pa'i sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad gang / thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang des bskyed pa'i nad gdon bar chad thams cad dag shes rab kyi snang ba rab tu rgyas/ 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ shes rab me ltar 'bar bar gyur/bsam la sngags bzla/sngags ni oṃ mañdzu badzra hūṃ/mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad bskang /oṃ wā gī shwa ra sa ba ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba bo//shes rab 513

sgron me rab rgyas shing / /'jig rten gsum gyi man sel ba/ /'jam pa'i ༄dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes bstod/ nyer bsdu ni/ rang 'jam dbyangs su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa son las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog de rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/rang yang sku'i stod smad nas 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim/de yang zhabs kyu ha la thim/ ha ha'i mgo bo la thim/de thig la thim/de zla tshes la thim/de nā da la thim/de yang mi dmigs par stong bar gyur/stong ba'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis 'jam dpal dbyangs ngag gi rgyal bo gser mdog can gyi skur bzhengs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'grub gyur ma/sa/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o//zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa sman pa 'od gsal gyis yang yang brdal ngor bris pa'o// 514

'jam dbyangs nag po'i nyams len sgom bzlas/༄ //'dir 'jam dbyangs nag po'i sgom bzlas nyams su len pa la/ thog mar sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lta bu'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud dang 'dres par bya/ oṃ su bha wa shurtaḥ sarba rnyarmaḥ swa bha wa shurjo3haṃ/ chos kun rang bzhin stong ba'i ngang nyid las//baṃ las sna tshogs padma'i lte ba ru//a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ /de steng rang sems gyiḥyig mthing nag las/ /ral gri rab tu 'bar ba :ཿ sa mtshan pa/ /de las 'od 'phros rang gzhan don gnyis byas/ /tshur 'dur yongs gyur rang nyid 'jam dpal dbyangs//sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa//g.yas pas ral gri 'bar ba mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pas utpal yu ba thugs kar bsnams//'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba'i//steng na pha rol phyin pa'i glegs bam 'dzin//sku la rin po che dang rus pas brgyan//rngam bajid ldan zhing dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ /spyi bo oṃ dkar mgrin par āḥdamar bo/ /thugs kar rgyu sngon de las 'od zer 'phros/ /rang bzhin gnas nas sgom dzi dang 'dra ba'i/ /ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs pa/ /ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa la thim/ /dbang 515

lhas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag spyi gtsug gnas pa yongs gyur las/ /mi bskyod pa yis dbu la brgyan par gyur/ /mchod pa bya rgyud ltar byin rlabs bya/oṃ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/mchod sngags ni oṃ mdzi shrī ka la ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra ti tstsha swāhā/ zhes sogs rigs 'gre/ bstod pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gcig bsdus pa/ /mig sman mdangs can mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter/ /byin rlabs dngos grub mchog stsol lhag pa'i lha/ /'jam dpal khyed kyi sku gsung thugs la bstod/ /gang gi zhabs rdul gus pas bsten pa rnams//gdon gsum gnod pa'i dpung gis mi brdzi zhing //nyams grib dri ma mtha' dag byang byed pa'i/ /byin rlabs gter chen khyed la gsol bra bdebs/ /rtse gcig yid kyis lhag pa'i lhar bsten na/ /dmigs med thugs rje mchog gis nyer dgongs te/ /phyi dang nang gi nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing //mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'grub par mdzod//(bzlas dmigs ni)rang gi thugs ka'i nyi gdan la gnas pū'i/ /dhīḥ yig mthing nag mtha' ru sngags kyi 'phreng / /kha dog nag pos bskor bhas 'od 'phros pas/ /mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod 'tshe dang //bsam ngan sbyor tsub grib dang mi gtsang dang / /sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/oṃ pra sod/chu sod/ tur ṭwā sod/snying mgo la chod/kha— la dzaḥ kai shaṃ tram̐ rbad phaṭa swā hā/ 'di la sngags gsum yod kyang dam pa gong ma rnams kyis sngags 'di gtso bor mdzad pas 'dis chog gsungs/ mjug tu gong 516

tsho bzhin tshomachod bstod bya/nyer bsdu ni rang nyid 'od zhu snying ga'i sngags 'khor la/ /thim zhing de nyid sa bon rnyiḥ la thim//de nyid 'od zhu mi dmigs stong bar gyur/ /slar yang 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku ru bzhengs/ /mjug tu bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa sman pa 'od gsal gyis nan gyis bskul ngor bris pa'o//'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ṅge'i rgyun 'khyer/gango//skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud dang 'dres nges pa byas nas/tshogs zhing mchod pa sogs grub na rab yin/dngos gzhi la/oṃ shu n+ya ta tsā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko hwa haṃ/chos kun rang bzhin stong ba'i ngang / /seng las seng sngon ral ba dmar/ /kha ni gyen phyogs rin chen gyi/ /rgyan mang mdzes pa'i steng rol na/ /padma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng //rnyiḥlas ral gri rnyiḥ sa mtshan pa//de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi/ /mi shes mun pa kun bsal zhing / /shes rab snang ba'i dpal la bkod/ /tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ /rang nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/—/'char ka'i mdangs ltar mdzes pa'i sku//dmar ser gzhon nu'i lang tsho can//zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i zhal gcig dang //phyag gnyis chos 'chad phyag rgya yis/ /yutpal sdong bu bugs kar 'dzin/ /rtse mo g.yas g.yon snyan gyi thad//ral gri sher phyin glegs bam bzhugs//dbu skra ṭwāṃ/na

mthing zur phud lnga//dri zhim me tog phreng ba dang //rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /lha rdzas gos kyi na bza' klubs/ /'gying bag dang bcas skyil krung gis//bzhugs pa'i mdun du pad zla'i steng / /gliḥlas ral gri gliḥ sa mtshan pa/ /de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi/ /mi shes mun pa rab bsal nas/ /shes rab snang ba tshad med rgyas/ /tshur 'dus yongs gyur dbyangs can lha/ /sku mdog beeḍūrya ltar dag /khro 'dzum mdzes pa'i lang tsho rgyas/ /gos dar rin chen tshogs kyis brgyan/ /phyag mtshan yab dang mtshungs pa las/ /'gying bag dang bcas bzhengs stabs bzhugs//yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bo ru/ /oṃ dkar mgrin par āḥdamar bo/ /thugs kar hūṃ yig sngon po'i mtshan/ /yab kyi thugs kar sdiḥyig dang / /yum gyi thugs kar trīḥyig las//'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ /bsgoms 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ /rang girtsosnying kha nas spros pa'i/ /lha mornams kyis mchod par gyur//dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥganyis med bsnyims//slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs pas/ /dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag /chu lhag spyi bor gnas pa las/ /mi bskyod pa yi dbu rgyan gyur//snying kha nas spros lha mo yis//arghaṃ sogs kyi mchod pa 'bul//gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba bo//dri za'i bu mo rab mdzes ma//dpag med goms pa'i thugs rje yis//sgrub pa po la rab tu dgyes//ye shes mchog gi dngos grub ster/ /dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo//oṃ trīḥdhīḥm me dri pa malha 518

shrī sum̐ trīX pra dzñā watrī dha ni gli dhīX swāhā/ zhes pa man ngag ltar brgya stong sogs bzla bar (rdo ste (rdotā bya'o/ /mjug tu yig brgyas chad lhag bskang la/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs bsngo smon rnam par dag par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa sman pa 'od gsal gyis bskul ngor bris pa'o// 'jam dkar sgrub thabs /༄7ོ/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dmigs rnam yid khul ba gsal btab ste/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum/ chos rnam rang bzhin med pa'i stong bar gyur/ /stong ba'i ngang las baṃ las 'o ma'i mtsho/ /dkar la dwangs pa'i mtsho mtha' me tog dang / /ljon shing sna tshogs 'khrigs shing thal dkar gyi/ /glang chen khyu tshogs rgyu zhing pad rtswa za/ /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin du mas gang //mtsho steng me tog dra bas rab khebs shing //ngang ngur la sogs chu byas skad snyan sgrogs/ /de dbus baṃ yig las byung padma'i sdong / /yal ga lo 'dab rab tu rgyas pa'i rtser//pad dkar 'dab stong ge sar dmar ser steng / /a las zla dkyil steng du rang sems a/ /de las 'od 'phros 'gro ba'i mi shes bsal//shes rab snang ba rgyas pa'i dpal la bkod//tshur 'dus yongs gyur rang nyid 'jam dpal dkar//zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang / /g.yon pas thugs kar utpa—la 519

sdong bu 'dzin/ /utpal snyan gyi thad du kha phye'i steng / /stong phrag brgya ba'i sher phyin glegs bam bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing //dbu skra ral ba'i zur phud lnga dang ldan//brgyad gnyis lang tsho rgyas pa'i mtshan dpe'i sku//dar dang rin chen rgyan mang du mas brgyan//(bzlas dmigs ni)bdag snying rtse mo gyen bstan pad ma dkar/ /pad 'dab brgyad du rnam par phye ba'i dbus/ /'khor lo dkar bo rtsibs drug rtse mo rno/ /rtsibs drug la ni mdun nas g.yas skor du//snying bo yig drug bkod la g.yon skor 'khor//'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis//rang gzhan sdig sgrib kun dag shes rab rgyas/ /oṃ wa kye rda na maḥzhes ci nus bzla/mthar oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ci.arya margyu shrī sa ba ri wā ra a rghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du shasta'i bar sbyar te mchod/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /sogs kyis macel 'bul/ bstod pa ni spro na 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang / ma tis mdzad pa'i bstod pa don zab mos bstod/bsdu na/ ngo bo ma nor chos nyid rab mkhyen cing / /rnam pa ma lus 'ja' tshon lhang nger gzigs/ / thugs rje che dang thabs tshul dpag med kyis/ /srid mtsho mtha' yas skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs mgon khyod gus pas rjes dran zhing / /sgom bzlas legs mchod mngon par bstod pa yis//blo ngan ma rig 'thib po'i tshogs rnams kun/ /sprin med nyi ma ji bzhin dwangs par mdzod/ /bshed pas blo gsal tshogs rnams dga' bskyed cing //rtsod pas phas gol 520

ma lus zil gyis gnon/ /sdeb legs rtsom pas mkhas rnams mgu byed pa'i//'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shes rab bdag la stsol//zhes 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ mjug tu/ 'di sgrub pa las byung ba yi//dge ba bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /de yis skye bo thams cad kyis/ /'jam dbyangs shes rab thob par shog /ces dge ba bsngo/rang nyid 'jam dpal du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar bo mgrin par āḥ dmar bo/ thugs kar rgyu sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ smon lam dang shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o//zhes pa 'di ni gzhi tshang sprul ba'i sku rin po che'i sku mdun pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos 'di lta bu'i rgyun 'khyer zhig dgos zhes lha reg bcas bskul ngor/ khong gis kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng snga phyi'i gsung ji bzhin bsgrigs pa'o// — lha mo nor rgyun ma'i gter sgrub dgos 'dod char 'beb/ ༄ / /byang chub sems kyi gser ldan gzhir/ /sbyin sogs byang chub them skas btsugs/ /sku bzhi nor bu'i pho brang du//dbang 'byor dpal ldan bla mar 'dud/ /de la 'din gzungs lasakhyang ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs dang 'bril bar gter sgrub bya ba ni/ spyir nor longs spyod 'byung ba ni tshe sngon sbyinatsu pa btang ba'i 'bras bu zhig dgos te/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde zhes dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i zhal nas/ sngon bsags bsod nams lhun skug ri bo'i rtser/ /zas nor longs spyod dbyar gyi na bun bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon bsod nams ma bsags na rgyu med pas 521

'bras bu longs spyod 'byung ba mi srid/ /'on kyang tshe 'dir mchog gsum la brten nas rang gi nus tshod kyi bsod nams ci nus bsags na/ 'dzam gling 'di las kyi sa yin pas tshe 'dir bsags pa'i 'bras bu tshe 'dir smin pa dang phyi mar de bas kyang longs spyod rgya chen po 'byung bar gsungs/ khyad par du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i thabs lam la brten nas gter sgrub kyis nor sgrub tshul du ma zhig gsungs/ 'dir gzungs las byung ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma la brten nas gter sgrub tshul 'bri bar bya ste/ bkra shis pa'i sa la rin chen sna tshogs bsres pa'i rdza'am rin po che shel las grub pa'i za ma tog dang / bkra shis pa'i mtshan ma dang ldan pa'i dkar yol gas chag med pa'i za ma tog gsar ba dang rang gi mdzod phug sogs su mchod rgyu la rdza'i ga'u bzo ba mi bde na/tsan dan nam shug pa sogs shing bzang bo'i sgrom bus kyang rung la/de yang shing gi mgo mjug ma nor bar bzo ba gal che/ che chung yul de'i bre gang shong ba byed par gsungs/ de'i ngos su dkar rtsi byug la logs rnams su bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bri/mdun ngos mi nor ba'i rtags gdab/ de'i nang du nas 'bras gro til dkar la sogs pa'i 'bru sna rnyed tshad/ 'bru nag po'i rigs pra bo dang / sran ma/ nas nag sogs mi rung / bum rdzas rin po che sna tshogs dang / dug rigs dang bshal sman ma yin pa'i sman sna tshogs/ dar sna/ ja mar/mngar gsum shing tog skam po'i rigaṅge la sogs pa gtsang zhing dag thon pa skar ma bre dang lug gi nyin par ga'u'i nang du blug go /rdzas bsags pa'i skar ma rgyal dang sa ri sa ga gang rung dang gza' spen pa 'dzoms pa'i nyin bzang /gzhan yang rgyal bo chen po'i mdzod nas byung ba'i rdzas rab/yul mi rgyug po dang mi g.yang can rigs rus dang ming bzang ba/ dbang bo tshang ba'i lag nas byung ba ni 'bring / gzhan yang bla ma bzang bo dang mkhas pa paṇḍi ta dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi phyag nas byung ba rab yin par sems/rdzas de dag gza' skar so so dang 'grig pa legs kyang / gal te ma 'grig na thog ma nas rtsol sgrub byas te g.yang skar bzang ba'i nyin ga'u la blug go/de'i nang du lto ba'i stod tsam du rje btsun nor rgyun ma'i sku bris 'bur gang rung rab gnas can/ rgya shog la gser dngul lam/ ma 'byor na mtshal la sogs pas oṃ bā su rnya 522

ri ni ṭwā hā zhesadang / de'i mjug tu lha mo nor rgyun ma 'khor dang bcas pa brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas gnas 'dir ṣkadagu thams cad dbang du 'du zhing / srid zhi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rang dbang med par 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ zhesadabu can tsheg med du bris nas/ ga bur/ tsan danadakar dmar sogs dri bzang gis byug mjug nas dril ba mgo mjug ma log par byas te sku gzugs kyi mdun du bzhugs su gsol/'bru sna sogs brdzangs nas kha gcod la rdo rje rgya gram bris te kha gcod/de'i steng du dar sna ser bo dang dmar bo sogs kyis bkab ste tshon skud sna lngas mgrin pa bcing ba'i tshon skud lhag ma kha leb kyi steng du rgya gram du bsdams/de lta bu'i bum pa'am ga'u stegs mtho sar bzhag gzungs thag gis thel/ de'i mdun du 'bul gtor skum po dkar jis byugs shing mar rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ chu gnyis nyer spyod bdag mdun gyi mchod pa/ gzhi bdag gtor ma/ bgegs gtor la sogs pa bshams/ rang gi mdun du 'thor 'bru dang rdor dril sogs tshags su chud par bya'o/ /sgrub pa po rten gyi gang zag ni thun mong lam sbyang gis rgyud sbyangs te/ bla med gang rung zhig gi dbang thob nas lha 'di'i rjes gnang thob pa/yi dam gang gi las tshogs la yang yi dam de'i bsnyen pa sngon du 'gro dgos par gsungs pas/ lha 'di'i bsnyen pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa legs par grub pa'i gang zag gis zas dkar gsum la brten cing gtsang sbra dang ldan pa'i sgo nas thog mar bdag bskyed bsgomadagos pas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rgyud dang 'dres nges par byas te/ su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las gter chen po'i sa gzhi la/rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khang bzang gi dbus su/gser gyi bum pa nor bus gang ba'i khri la baṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ baṃ las rang nyid lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig 523

phyag gnyis g.yaso mchog sbyin gyi— mjil nas nor bu'i char 'beb pa g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma rab tu rgyas pa dang rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing /sgeg cing lang tsho dar la bab pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ mtha' skor du nor dpal mo la sogs pa gter gyi bdag mo'i tshogs thams cad dang / steng gi cha la sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bzhugs par gyur /thams cad kyi dpral bar skomagrin par āḥ / thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes sems ma lha mo nor rgyun ma 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/— khyed rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas oṃ badzra bha wa a sgyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa rmes rin chen 'byung ldan gyisadarbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las rghaṃ las nin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon nas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa phed pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyuraḍa/ oṃ arghaṃ 29 hūṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas/ /tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes shing / /sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i/ /dpal mo 524

nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs kar baṃ yig gi mthar oṃ bā su dha ri ni swā hā zhes pa'i sngags phreng ser bo gser btso ma lta bus bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer ser bo'i rnam par spyan drangs te sngags phreng la thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkho dgu yo byad longs spyod mtha' dag rdo khab len gyis lcags phye drangs pa bzhin du drangs te rang dang sbyin bdag gi gnas khang thams cad mer gyis gang bar bsam la snying bo bzla/ ji ltar rigs par nor rgyun ma'i gzungs 'don pa'am klog par bya'o/ /yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / mchod bstod bya/de nas bsang chu sgrub pa ni/ 'bru dkar gyis padma 'dab brgyad dang ku sha'i gdan la las bum bzhag las bum gyi nang du chus sum gnyis gang ba bzhag kha rgyan gyi mgo las bum gyi g.yas phyogs su bstan te bum pa'i mdun du bzhag swa bha was sbyangs/stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las bum pa dkar bo lto ba che ba mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/oṃ taste taste mahā taste swāhā/lha'i chu bo gaṅgā dang dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bum pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis ribaskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te hūṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas skum pa gang bar gyur/ khrobo 525

bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags brgya rtsa bzla/ mthar hūṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ de nas dkar gtor bsngo/bgegs gtor btang /de nas mdun gyi bum pa dag la dmigs nas a sbo tas bsang la su bha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las bum pa'i go sar baṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rghaṃ las rin po che'i gter bum yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du zas nor longs spyod lha dang mi'i 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gtams par gyur/ sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/bum pa'i nang du gter chen po'i sa gzhi la/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khang bzang gi dbus su/ gser gyi bum pa nor bus gang ba'i khri la baṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du baṃ yig ser bo gser btso ma lta bu yongs su gyur pa las lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil nas nor bu'i char 'bebs pa/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma rab tu rgyas pa dang rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / sgeg cing lang tsho dar la bab pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/mtha' skor du nor dpal mo la sogs pa gter gyi bdag mo'i tshogs thams cad dang / steng gi cha la sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes 526

sems ma lha mo nor rgyun ma 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas oṃ badzra bha wa a sgyi ṣi ñtsa hūṃ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /rje btsun lha mo nor rgyun ma//'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la//rab tu dang bas phyag bgyi'o//zhes phyag 'tshal/ de nas mchod pa bsangs/stong ba'i ngang las rghaṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon nas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ a rghaṃ hākho hūṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na//mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di//ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang / /sems can don kun mdzad du gsol//de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar/ bstod pa ni/gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas//tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes shing //sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'beeb pa'i//dpal mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa ma lus 'bul/ /527

thog medarna nas bsags sdig ltung thams cad bshags//skye 'phags dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / /'khor ba ma stong bar du legs bzhugs nas/ /'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /bdag gzhan dge rnams byang chub chen por bsngo//rang dang bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du baṃ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi lha klu mi'i tshe dang /bsod nams/ dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad bkug ste bum pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams dang gnyis su med par thim pas 'dod dgu zad mi shes pa'i gter gyi bum pa bzang bor gyur/ slar yang bum pa'i nang gi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa rab tu rgyas te bum pa'i kha nas lud pa dang /bum pa'i nang gi rje btsun ma'i phyag dang /sku'i cha gzhan dag dang /rgyan dang na bza' las kyang 'dod dgu sna tshogs lhug lhug bab nas gnas khang thams cad phyur bur gang bas 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor zad pa med pa la longs spyod pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur/ yi ge brgyad pa ci nus bzla/ mthar yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/a mṛ tas bsang /su bha was sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin— po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/bum pa'i lha'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te 528

gsol bar gyur/oṃ sarba beed gu ra pu ra sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags lan gsum gyis 'bul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas rjes/ gser gyi lhun po'i mdangs ldan mdzes pa'i sku//yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan 'gag med gsung //shes bya kun mkhyen g.yo med thugs mnga' ba/ /rje btsun nor rgyun lha mo thugs rje'i gter/ /khyed la yid gtad gus pas gsol 'debs na/ /'dod dgu'i gter chen bum pa bzang bo 'dir/ /'khor bcas g.yo ba med par rtag bzhugs nas/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa yi tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags longs spyod sogs/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i 'byor ba ma lus pa//drod gsher rten 'byung tshogs pa'i chu skyes bzhin//rnam par rgyas pa'i dngos grub dbyug gi char/ /da lta nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes me tog 'thor ba dang bcas 'dod don la gsol ba 'debs/ rje btsun lha mo nor rgyun ma 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ rten 'de la brtan par bzhugs nas gnas 'dir skye dgu thams cad dbang du 'du zhing srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rang dbang med par 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra sogs kyis me tog 'thor/ mjug tu gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang ste/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs nongs pa bzod par gsol/ bdag skyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rim gyis 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ de yang mi dmigs par stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las 529

slar yang rje btsun ma'i sku ru bzhengs par gyur/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo smon shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po skal bzang bsam gtan gyis nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor sbyar ba'o//khro bo'i rgyal bo sme ba brtsegs pa'i sbyin sreg dme grib sogs nyes pa kun sel / ༄na3/ /'dir khro bo smre brtsegs kyi bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi sbyin sreg byed pa la/ sasgyu ṭa las/ sbyin sreg lha rnams tshim par byed/ /tshim pa las ni dngos grub stsol/ /sngags ni lhag ma ma tshang na//thams rgad sbyin sreg dag gis skong //zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sbyin sreg ni lha mchod pa'i sgo mchog tu gyur pa dang / dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs phul du phyin par gsungs la/ byin rlabs rang rgyud la nye bar byed pa'i bsnyen pa gal che la/ bsnyen pa re'i chad lhag sogs kyis nyes pa sbyong zhing / nus pa bskyed pa'i sbyin sreg kyang dgos par gsungs so//des na 'dir khro bo smre ba brtsegs pa'i sbyin sreg byed pa la/ bya rgyud spyi ltar khrus dang gtsang spra sogs shin tu gal che zhing /de nas thog mar bdag bskyed ni/ skyabs sems rgyud dang 'dres nges pa sngon du btang la/ oṃ su bhā wa shudmāḥ sarba rnyarmāḥ su bhā wa shud dzha3haṃ gis stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūṃ yig du ba'i mdog can yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa sku mdog dud ka g.yas zhal dkar bo/ g.yon zhal dmar bo/phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang bo na rdo rje rgya gram/ gnyis pa na rdo rje rtse lnga ba/530

gsum pa na rdo rje lcags kyu/ g.yon dang bo na rdo rje dbyug pa/gnyis pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ gsum pas rdo rje sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang/rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can thod pa skam po'i 'phreng bas se ral ka byas pa/ yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan cing / mi lpags kyis stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/zhabs gnyis bgrad pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūṃ/de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas lus gang /dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/mchod pa rnams oṃ ba dzra a bṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ces bsangs/oṃ swa bhā wa shud dhāḥ sarba rnyarmāḥ swa bhā wa shud rnyo3 haṃ gis stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/zhabs bsil/me tog bdug spos/ mar me/dri chab/531

zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnams rang bzhin stong ba/ rnam pa mchog rdzas byed las dbang bo drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ lhahūṃ nas oṃ shapta āḥhūṃ zhes byin brlabs de nas 'bul ba ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang bo mchod yon 'di//bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas lo 'bul//'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol//oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa ba ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ange 'gre bar byas te/ mchod yon zhes pa'i gnas su/zhabs bsil nas rol mo rnams bcug arghaṃ zhes pa'i gnas su patram̐ nas/ shabha rnams bcug la/ tshigs bcad sngags dang sbrel la mchod/de na sa bstod pa bya ba ni/dmigs med mkha' ltar yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /gdul dka'i bgegs dang log 'dren 'dul phyir du//dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i//khro chen 'chol ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snatshogs padma nyi ma'i gdan steng du/ /dus mtha'i me chen 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis bgrad pa'i stabs//dran pas bgegs 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mche gcigs bgradahopas zhal dbus zhe sdang 'dul/ /g.yas dkar bzhad pa'i gad mos gti mug sel//g.yon zhal me 'od 'bar bas 'dod chags 'joms//spyan gsum gyen ldog khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus//dbu skra gyen brjes thod skam lnga lngas brgyan/ /na ra dan ti'i pags rlon stod 532

g.yogs can/ /mi mgo'i 'phreng ba'i do shal mgul du 'chang //stag lpags smad dkris bag yod ri mos mdzes/ /dug lnga rnam dag lto 'gro'i rgyan gyis bajid/ /rdo rje rgya gram rtse lnga lcags kyu g.yas//dbyug tho zhags pa drag po'i sdigs mdzub g.yon/ /sku gsum mthar phyin rgyud drug 'dren pa'i rtags/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug drag po'i gzugs/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung ba'i gsung / /snying rje rngams pa zhi ba'i thugs mnga' ba/ /stobs ldan khro rgyal khyod la bdag bstod kyi/ /nad gdon 'khon grib mi gtsang kun zhi zhing / /tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang //gnas skabs mthar thug skye rgu'i re 'dod rnams/ /myur du bdag la lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /ces sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar/oṃ bhūr rku mahā mā ṇa ya bhūrtsi bhūr ki ma nā se u tsuṣṭha kro rnya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra bhūr rku ri li shu darsha hur shi bi ma le u tsuṣṭha gro dha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags gnyis ka'am yang na dang bo 'dis bskor ba la dmigs te bzla'o//oṃ badzra mahā kro rnya rā dza sa ba ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du paju nas shabha'i bar la/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sbyar ba'i nyer spyod sngags rkyang gis mchod/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i lha//bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes pa'i bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum bzla/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /533

'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa//de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs//badzra muḥ bdag bskyed kyi lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /khro rgyal sme rtsegs 'grub gyuramonas//'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa //de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon gang 'tsham bya'o//de nas sbyin sreg bya ba la bdag bskyed sgom pa sngon du song rjes/cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ steng bu gru bzhi la dkar rtsi btab/ thog mar tshangs thig zur thig la sogs pa zhi ba'i thig spyi ltar btab/ thab kyi dbus su padma dkar bo 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar sna tshogs rdo rje 'bri/ skum thig nang ma'i steng na bud shing skam po'am/ dgon pa'i ba lang gi lci ba skam po srog chags med pa skum por brtsegs/ g.yas phyogs su 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la 'bul rgyu'i rdzas chen bcu gnyis dang / khyad par gyi rdzas gang 'byor bshams de'i nang du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la/ 'bul rgyu'i mchod gtor bshams/ phyi rol tu 'jig rten pa'i lha la 'bul rgyu'i bsreg rdzos rnams bkod/ g.yon phyogs su padma 'dab brgyad dkar bo bris pa la chu bzhi dang bzed zhal bsang gtor gyi ku sha'i chun po rnams 'god/ g.yas phyogs su rdor dril/ dgang gzar blugs kha sbyar/ las bum/ so rtsi/ gos zung / dpal 'bar/ rlung yab/ ku sha/ 'thor nas sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par byas te/ rang nyid kha shar du phyogs pas/ stan bde ba la padma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod nas bsang chu la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra a bṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun dang / mchod sdas rnams la g.yas skor gyis lan gsum bsang / mchod pa rnams a skṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me 534

tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/rol mo/ gzhan yang 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dpal kun tu bzang sdo'i mchod sprin lta bu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ nam mkha'i khams gang ba 'di nyid/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal bo smre ba brtsegs pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ arghaṃ āḥ hūṃ nas/ shabha āḥ hūṃ gi bar brjod/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya byas pas na maḥ sarba bud rnya bo rnyi sa tā ṭwāṃ/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ badzra spa ra ṇa khaṃ mthar sel gol dang bcas dkrol ba gsum/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur gyi gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pas phyag rgyas bsreg rdzas rnams la ston cing / oṃ swā hā/ zhes pas bsreg rdzas rnams spyir bkrus par bsam oṃ āḥ swa hās yam shing dang /oṃ shrī swā hās zhun mar dang /oṃ dzreswā hās 'bru dang /oṃ ku ru swāhās gzhan pa'i rdzas rnams sbyangs par bsam/ rdzas rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pas nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs shing dag nas phyi'i bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ me gang yang rung ba/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ lan gsum brjod de snod du bzhag la/ las sngags brjod pa dang bcas pas bsang chus g.yas bskor du lan gsum bsangs/ rtswa'i chun po dang bcas thab kyi nang du bcug la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐/ zhes gzi byin bskyed/ hūṃ/ zhes brjod de rlung g.yab kyis me sbar/ rtswa sngags gong mnyan bdun brjod la mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis me gso/ ku sha lag tu bzung la/ oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa'i lha rnams dag byed cing //dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa//sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i 535

snying / /bdag gis bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ /zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod nas ku sha gnyis gnyis rtse mo gshibs pa rang gi g.yon ngos nas brtsams te thab kyi kha khyer la rtse mo shar dang / /lho dang / nub dang / byang du bstan la snga ma'i rtse mos phyi ma'i rtsa ba non par bkram zhing / thab khung du rtse mo shar du bstan pa'i ku sha ba lang gi rna ba lta bu ha cang yang mi ring bas g.yogs/ ku sha bkram zin pa dang thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gis bgegs thams cad zhi ba dang bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab bo//gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/thog mar 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ bar du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa/mthar 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ thab sngar bzhin bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las hūṃ dkar bo zhu ba las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs zlum pa rgyar khru gang ba/ zab tu khru phyed pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/gru bzhir zla phyed rdo rje'i mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur/thab kyi nang gi dbus su sna tshogs padma'i lte bar ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las zhi ba'i me lha 'dzin byed sku mdog dmar bo 'od zer 'phro zhing 'du ba/ rwa skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang 'phreng dang g.yon spyi blug 'dzin pa/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ smin ma dang ral ba'i thod dang sma ra 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa gsus khyim che zhing gzi brjid dang ldan pa/g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar me gru gsum pa ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ drang song gi 536

tshogs dpag tu med pa'i bskor bas/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar bo/mgrin par āḥ dmar bo/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ lag pa g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya'i mthe bong g.yab cing / oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung bo che/ /me lha'i rgyal bo drang srong mchog /bsregs blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du//'di ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ /gzi bajid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa bo//thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥ thab kyi kha khyer gyi ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ amṛ ta'i sngags kyi bsangs chu 'thor zhing phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badzra saṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pa sha hūṃ/oṃ badzra sbo ṭa baṃ/oṃ badzra gaṇḍi hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ āḥ trīḥ pra wa ra sad ka ram̐ prokṣa rna pra tītstsha suhā/ zhes bsang gtor dang /prokṣa rna gyi gnas su/añtsa ma ṇi/ arghaṃ/ pābye/rnams sbyar te chu bzhi phyag len ltar 'bul/oṃ asna ye sa ba ri wā ra puṣpe pratī tstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ sgru pe/ ā lo ke gasne/ naiwi bye/ shabha/zhes sbyar ba'i mchod/ dril stabs dang bcas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal bo ṭakkis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid larnam par 'dud/ /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal bo drang srong 537

mchog /thugs rjes dbang gi sku sprul ba//rigaris sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal ba'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdza 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul ba'i theg pa bcibs/ /rig sngags gsung zhing bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan snaṇḍi bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod//'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das//zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / zhes yongs rdzogs sam/ tshigs bcad dang bo ci rigs kyis bstod/ oṃ badzra a na la mahā bhu ta dzwa lā dzwa lā ya sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba duṭaṃ hūṃ phaṭa tri shya dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa mā ya st+waṃ/sa ya haṃ/ zhes dam tshig lan gsum brjod pas las bcol ba zhal gyis bzhes par bsam mo/ /me lha'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar bo la ram̐ yig dang / dgang blugs kyi kha lo hūṃ yig 'od zer dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur/ 'dir dgang blugs kyi kha la skabs thob kyi lhag pa'i lha de'i sa bon byed pa 'thad pa yin te/ 'od snye las/ dgang gzar dang blugs gzar gyi kha la rang gi lha'i sa bon yi ge gsum gyi spel ba'i 'od zer dang bcas pa dang / me lha'i zhal du re rnam par bkod la zhes dang / spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis de'i mchan 'grel du/rang gi lha'i sa bon rgyu dang a sogs oṃ āḥrgyu gi yi ge gsum gyis spel ba'i 'od zer dang bcas pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la kha cig skyabs mgon mchog gi 'jam dkar sbyin sreg tu a yig gsungs pa yi ge ma dag par byed pa mi 'thad par mngon no/ /zhes gsungs so/ de nas byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas blugs gzar gyis mar khus dgang gzar bkang ba bzung ste/oṃ asna ye a di byā a di byā a bi sha a bee sha ma hā shrī ye ha byā ka byā ba ha nā ya/ bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing 538

sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang / nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shārnyi ku ru swāhā/ 'di bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi dbang du byas shing / gang 'dod pa'i spel tshig sbyor ba'i khyad par shes dgos so/ /lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas mtheb srin gyis yam shing gnyis gnyis rtse mo lha la bstan nas 'bul/ yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ asna yi a di byā nas ba ha nā ya/ oṃ bo rnyitsākṣa ya/ bdag cag gi nas bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang / khyad par du gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shārnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ mar khu/ oṃ asna ye zhes pa nas/ ba ha nā ya/ oṃ asna ye/ bdag cag nas/ thams cad dang / khyad par du yang 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shārnyi ku ru ye swā hā/til la/oṃ asna ye nas/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye/bdag cag nas/ thams cad dang / khyad par du sdig sgrib thams cad sharnyi ku ru ye swā hā/dur ba la/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe/ tshe la bar du gcod pa thams cad shaddha ku ru ye swā hā/ 'bras la/oṃ badzra puṣṭa ya/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shārnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ zho zan la/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad sharnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ku sha la/oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye/ grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad sharnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ yungs dkar la/ oṃ sarba aza sid rnya ye/ bgegs thams cad shārnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ so rme la/ oṃ badzra bi dzā ya/ noradang 'bru rgyas pa la bar du 539

gcod pa thams cad shārti ku ru ye swāhā/ nas la/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya/ myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shārnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā bā lā ya/ stobs rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shārnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ gro la/ oṃ badzra ghasma ri ྾ nad thams cad shārnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ khyad par gyi sa la/oṃ asna ye zhes pa nas/ bdag cag nas/ ma chog dad thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shārnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ sngar bzhin zhal bsil dang / bsang gtor 'bul/ mar khu blugs gzar gang thab tu phul nas/oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐/ me lha mer 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ thab kyi me sngar bzhin bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du hūṃ yig du ba'i mdog can de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus/ yongs su gyur pa las khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa sku mdog dud kha/ g.yas zhal dkar bo/g.yon zhal dmar bo/ phyag drug gi g.yas dang bo rdo rje rgya gram/ gnyis pa na rdo rje rtse lnga ba/ gsum pa la rdo rje lcags kyu/ g.yon dang bo na rdo rje dbyug pa/ gnyis pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ gsum pa na rdo rje sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ thod pa skam po'i phreng bas se ral ga byas/yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan cing / mi lpags kyis stod g.yogs dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/zhabs gnyis bgrad pas stabs kyis bzhugs pa/lha'i sku 540

las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phros par gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/thugs ka'i nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//bcom ldan bskal ba grangs med du ma ru//'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus —'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas//rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cija //mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir//yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par bostsal du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal ba ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang //'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol//bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyis rdzu 'phruladkuthuyes ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ541

dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/rang gi thugs rka'i rgyu las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a gi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye āḥrgyu/zhes dbang bskur lus gang /dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /bsang gtor ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis phul ba'i bsang gtor 'di//bzhes nas bdag la dngos grub stsol//oṃ āḥ gliḥ pra wa ra sad ka ram̐ prokṣa rna pra tītstsha swāhā/zhes pas bsang gtor dang / de bzhin du bsang gtor gyi gnas su/ zhal bsil/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil rnams dang / prokṣaṇi gyi gnas su/ mañtsa ma ṇi/ a / paju rnams sbyar te chu bzhi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul lo//rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /me tog ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis phul ba'i me tog 'di/ /bzhes nas bdag la dngos grub stsol//oṃ badzra mahā kro rnya rā dza sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha swāhā/de bzhin du/shabha'i bar sbyar la mchod/dmigs med mkha' ltar yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /gdul dka'i bgegs dang log 'dren 'dul phyir du/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sgrub mdzad pas/khro chen 'chol ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/lha'i zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad gdangs pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ bhūr rku mahā thā ddha ya bhurtsi khyur ki ma na se u tsuju kro rnya rgyu hūṃ phaṭa 542
