phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ asna ye swāhā/ bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin zhes pa nas/ shārnyi ku ru swāhā/zhes mar khu dgang blugs bdun phul/yam shing la rtsa sngags dang / oṃ bo rnyi brikṣu ya/ bdag cag ces pa nas/ shā rnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ de bzhin du bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams la sngags dang spel tshig gong bzhin sbyar te gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig sogs mang nyung ci rigs pas dpyad cing yam shing dang mar khu gtso bo yin pas gang mang dang / 'di btsog grib sogs la ched du bsngags pas ku sha yang gtso bor byed cing /lhag chad kyi nyes pa 4sbyong ba dgos pa'i gtso bo yin pas kha skong la til gyi grangs gsog dgos/de bzhin du khyad par gyi rdzos yang mang tsam dbul/ rtsa sngags brjod cing / mar khu dgang blugs bdun dang /mchod yon/ bsang gtor/ zhal bsil gsugasngar bzhin sngags rgyas dbul/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gīs/ /khro bo sme brtsegs sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badzra wa sa su swāhā/zhes pas gos zung dad / oṃ badzra tamu la ye swāhā/zhes pas so rtsi dbul/ nyer spyodari rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥ hūṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtorarlo ma thag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ lanajigasum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ lha'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba rnyamo ṇḍaṃ abya nutpanda twa ta ba liddha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdune gyis me nang du blugs gzar gyis phul/bstod pa ni/ dmigs med mkhe' ltar yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor 543

nas/ /gdul dka'i bgegs dang log 'dren 'dul phyir du/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /khro chen 'chol ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes bstod/bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal bo sme ba brtsegs pas bdag cag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ pha rol gyi byad ma rbad 'dre bod gtong dang / — sde 'khrugs dang dme grib la sogs pa'i nyes skyon ngan pa mtha' dag dang / sa bdag klu gnyan sogs mi dang mi ma yin pa'i nyer 'tshe nad rims gdon bgegs rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa grib dang mi gtsang ba la sogs pa thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/mdor na phyi nang gi mi mthun pa'i nyer 'tshe thams can zhi zhing mthun rkyen legs tshogs thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/zhes 'dod don la gsol ba lan gsum gdab/oṃ āḥ gliḥ pra wa ra sad ka ram̐ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes mchod yon phul/me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas/gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis//nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa//gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon pos de kun bzod par gsol/ /zhes nongs pa bzod par gsol/ yig brgya ba'is te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /rang gi yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badzra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur/ gsum pa mthar 544

'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐/ zhes brjod de/ mar khu dgang blugs gsum phul bas/ thab kyi me de nyid slar yang me lha'i skur bzhengs par gyur/oṃ asna ye zhes pa nas/ba ha nā ya puṣpe pra tī tstsha swāhā/de bzhin du/ shabha'i bar sbyar te mchod/bsang gtor dang /zhal bsil kyang phul/oṃ badzra haṃ bu la ye swāhā/zhes pas so rtsi dang /sna tshogs dbang bo nas/ gos kyis brgyan par shog oṃ badzra wa sa su swāhā/ zhes pas gos zung gul/ rdzas lhag me lha la sngar bzhin phul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug /zhes sogs kyis bstod/zhal bsil dang bsang gtor kyang phul/gtor ma bsang sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa sted pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ asna ye sogs kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gul/nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/drang srong rgyal bo gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang bskal ba bzang //longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ khyu byed ngan rnamasi med par 545

mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams rgyas shing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /oṃ ldi trīḥ pra wā ra sadaka ram̐ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs//oṃ badzra satwa āḥ oṃ rang gi don dang gzhan rgye don//sgrub sadzad bsreg bya za ba gshegs//ji bzhin dus su slar byon zhing / /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubes/ /oṃ āḥ badzra muḥ me lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas sdo gshegs/ /dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur//gsum pa jes kyi rim pa/bdag bskyed kyi mjug bsdu/bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod sogs rgyas par bya/ me ma shi bar du 'jog long med na ga'i la thabs dang las kyi rjes mi mngon pa sogagaphyag len ltar bya'o/ /spyir sbyin sreg la kun slong byang chub kyi sems dang / dngos gzhi lta bas rjes 'debs pa ni gnad kyi don po yin te/bden zhen gyi sgo nas sbyin sreg 'bul ba la/lha'i zhal du dug btab pa'i nyes pa yod par gsungs/de ltar cho ga rnom par dag pa dang / kun slong byang chub kyi sems dang / lta bas rjes 'debs pa sogs sbyor dngos mjug gsum yang dag pa zhig byung na/ rgyud las phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung bar gsungs la/ de min cho ga ma dag cing chal chol dang /kun slong sogs ma dag na phan yon yod pa phar zad/bkra mi shis pa sogs nyes skyon 'byung bas gzab par bya'o/ /'di 'bad dge 546

ba gang zhig thob pa des/ /lha mchog 'di yis rjes su 'dzin pa dang / /mkha' mnyam ma rgan 'gro ba mtha' dag gis/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig /ces khro bo'i rgyal bo smre ba brtsegs pa'i sbyinasreg bya tshul 'di ni grwa tshang rin po che'i zhabs brtan la mkho dgos byung skabs/ khong gis gung thang rin po che'i 'jam dbyangs nag po'i sbyin sreg gis bkab ste bsgrigs pa'o // dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gi dus go ༄༄ོ/ /bstan pa'i bdag po shākya'i gtso/ /bstan pa rin chen rten me'i phul/ /bstan 'dzin 'phags tshogs la btud nas/ /bstan rtsis nyung ngu gnad 'dus 'god/ /de yang bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa shākya thub pa bka' drin can de nyid/ bu ston gyi mkhas pa dga' bskyed dang / mkhas grub rin po che'i ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba ltar na zil gnon me rta la sku bltams/ rab gnas chu sprel lo 'di yan la/lo grangs nyis stong dgu brgya dang drug song / de nas lcags sbrul lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ de nas chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi la 'khor lnga sder bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gnas tshad la le'u bcu yod pas/ le'u bcu'i thog ma dgra bcom pa'i le'u 'ang 'di nas 'dren par gsungs/ le'u bcu ni/ dgra bcom gyi le'u/phyir mi 'ong gi le'u/rgyun zhugs kyi le'u gsum/'di gsum 547

la 'bras bu'i le'u zer/ shes rab kyi le'u/ ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ tshul khrims kyi le'u gsum/ 'di gsum la sgrub pa'i le'u zer/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyi le'u/ mdo sde'i sde snod kyi le'u/ 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi le'u gsum/'di gsum la lung gi le'u gsum zer/rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i le'u ste le'u bcu bo 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gnas tshad red/le'u re la lo lnga brgya lnga brgya ste sangs rgyas shākya shāb pa'i bstan pa ni lo lnga stong du gnas par gsungs/dgra bcom gyi le'u'i dus skabasaṃ su dgra bcom thob mkhan mang ba dang /phyir mi 'ong gi le'u'i dus skabs su dgra bcom thob mkhan je nyungacu du song ste phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob mkhan sngar bzhin du mang bo byung /rgyun zhugs kyi le'u'i dus skabs su phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob mkhan je nyung du song ste rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob mkhan sngar bzhin du mang bo byung /shes rab kyi bslab pa'i dusaskabs su rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob mkhan je nyung du song ste shes rab kyi bslab pa thob mkhan sngar bzhin du mang bo byung /ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'i le'u'i dus skabs su shes rab kyi bslab pa thob mkhan je nyung du song ste ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa thob mkhan sngar bzhin du mang bo byung / tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i dus skabs su ting nge 'a dzin gyi bslab pa thob mkhan je nyung du song ste tshul khrims kyi bslab pa thob mkhan sngar bzhin du mang borno 'gro bzhin yod/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyi skabs su tshul khrims srung mkhan je nyung la 548

song ste mngon pa'i sde snod la thos bsam byed mkhan sngar bzhin mang du 'byung bar 'gyur/ mdo sde'i sde snod kyi skabs su mngon pa'i sde snod la thos bsam byed mkhan je nyung du song ste mdo sde'i sde snod la thos bsam byed mkhan sngar bzhin mang du 'byung bar 'gyur/ 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi skabs su mdo sde'i sde snod la thos bsam byed mkhan nyung du song ste 'dul ba'i sde snod la thos bsamakhyed mkhan sngar bzhin mang du 'byung bar 'gyur/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i le'u'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rtags tsam las med par gsungs so//da lta'i rab gnas chu sprel lo 'di yan la tshul khrims le'u'i nang nas lo sum brgya dang don gasdig song zin/da dung tshul khrims kyi le'u la lo brgya dang nyer dgu yod 'duga'adi ni bu ston gyi mkhas padaga' bskyed dang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba ltar yin la/ sum bha'i dge ldan rtsis gsar yang 'di ltar yin no//phug lugs pas drag po lcags sprel la sku bltams par 'dod pas/ zil gnon me rta las lo zhe drug gis snga'o//da lta 'dzam gling yongs grags kyi kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs dang /gnas brtan sde ba'i lugs ni ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas/ rab gnas chu sprel lo 'di yan la lo nyis stong lnga brgya so lnga tsame song yod/de ltar na tshul khrims le'u'i steng nas lo brgyad cu las ma song stabs/ da dung tshul khrims kyi le'u la lo bzhi brgya dang nyi pashu yod 549

'dug sangs rgyas pa'i phyi lo chu rta nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lngar bya rgod phung bo'i rir sher mdo gsungs pa dang dus mnyam du dpal ldan 'bras spungs su rgyal bo zla ba bzang bo la sogs pa la dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gsungs/ de'i phyi lo rgyal bo lha dbang khrir phebs nas chos rgyal drug dang rigs ldan dgung lo brgya rer khri mdzad de chos bstan/ shing sprel lor rigs ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal khrir byon/ma kha'i yul du kla klo zhugs/rgya mtsho rnam rgyal gyis lo brgya dang gya gnyis su chos bstan/de'i 'phror rigs ldan rgyal dka' rgyal sar phebs te lo nyis brgya dang nyer gcig la chos bstan/rigs ldan de gnyis kyi khri lo bsdoms pas lo bzhi brgya dang gsum longs/de la me mkha' rgya mtsho'i 'das lo zer/ chos rgyal bdun dang rigs ldan nyer lnga'i mtshan grangs/ chos rgyal bdun ni/ rgyal bo zla ba bzang bo lha dbang /gzi bajid can/zla bas byin/lha'i dbang phyugasna tshogs gzugs/lha'i dbang ldan te bdun no/ /rigs ldan nyer lnga ni/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa/ pad ma dkar bo/ bzang bo/ rnam rgyal/ bshes gnyen bzang bo/rin chen phyagakhyab 'jug sbas pa/nyi ma grags/shin tu bzang /rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rgyal dka'/ nyi ma/ sna tshogs gzugs/ zla ba'i 'od/ mtha' yas/ sa skyong / dpal skyong / seng ge rnam gnon/ stobs po che/ ma 'gag pa/ da lta shambha lar rgyal bo ma 'gag pa 'dis dbang bsgyur ba'i skabs yin/mi yi seng ge dbang phyug chen po/mtha' yas rnam rgyal/'khor 550

lo chen po ste rigs ldan nyer lnga'o//de lta bu'i shambha la'i grong khyer de lte ba byas nas/ rigs ldan rnams kyi gdul bya/ bye ba dgu btsu rtsa drug gi grong khyer rnams kyis bskor nas yod la/ de 'dzam bu gling gi byang phyogs su mi'i yul du gtogs pa yin mod/'on kyang 'di mi yul gyi dag zhing yin pas/mi rang ga bas thos pa tsam las mthong ba dang bgrod pa'i yul las 'das pa yin te/ paṇa chen dpal ldan le shes kyis mdzad pa'i shambha la'i lam yig las/ grong khyer chen po 'dir 'jug par 'dod pas dang bor rang gi lhag pa'i lha gang yin pa de'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa byas— la/rmi lam legs par brtags te gnang ba thob pa'i mtshan ma byung ba na bgrod par bya ba yin gyis/ zhes bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa dang / yi dam lha'i gnang ba thob pa dgos par gsungs pa dang /de tsam gyis mi chog ste/yang de las/ gnang ba de thob nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi snying bo 'bum phrag brgyad bzlas nas nus pa bskyed pa'i phyir las thams cad pa'i thab kyi nang du u dum wā ra'i sbyin sreg khri phrag brgyad bya'o/ /zhes dang /bgegs thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir badzra a bṛ ta zhes sogs bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rig pa 'bum phrag bzlas nas sbyin sreg kyang khri phrag gcig bya'o/ /zhes dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs pa gshin rje gshed gang yang rung ba'i rtsa sngags 'bum phrag bzlas ti thog mar keng shu ka'i sbyin sreg stong dang /de'i 'og tu pa she'i stong phrag bcu dang /de'i 'og tu 551

tsan dan dmar bo dang / a gyi ta'i khu ba la sogs pa rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang sbyin sreg stong phrag bcus mnyes par bya ste/ zhes sogs gsungs/deng dus 'ga' zhig gis shambha la'i zhing medane ma mthong bas so zer ba ni/ rgyang 'phen pa kho na'i grub mtha'a'o//yang 'ga' zhig gis shambha la med de/ zag bcas kyi 'phrul 'khor la brten nas btsal cing mi rnyed pas so zer ba ni blun gtam kho na yin te/des btsal mkhan la yi dam gyi bsnyen sgrub yod pa phar zad/ dad pa tsam yang med pas ga la mthong / de bzhin du dus 'khor lugs kyi ri rgyal zlum po sogs mngon pa'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya sngags la ma sbyangs pa sogs kyis mthong mi thub la/ mngon pa'i lugs kyi ri rgyal de yang lha'i mig gi mngon shes ma thob par mthong mi thub par gsungs la/dngos po gcig la las dbang gis mthong tshul mi 'dra ba yod de/ rtsa ba'i rlan gsher phor gang bo de/ lha mi yi dwags gsum gyis mthong tshul mi 'dra ba dang /mi yin yang mthong tshul mi 'dra ba yod de/sngon mi gnyis po ta lar song ba'i tshe/ gcig gis lder sku thams cad lha dngos su mthong ste gsung byon pa dang chos bstan pa mthong / gcig gis lder sku kho na las lha dngos yin par ma mthong ba lta bu/o rgyan lta bu rnam 'byor bas dag pa'i zhing mchog kho nar mthong ba dang / mi phal ba rnams kyis kla klos gang ba'i 'jig rten phal ba lta bur mthong bar gsungs pa lta bu ches mang / rang re rnams kyis zhing mchog shambha la de dngos su mthong 552

ba'i skal ba med na'ang /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob nas/dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ste bsnyen sgrub sogs la 'bad na/shambha lar skyes te rigs ldan rnams kyis dngos kyi gdul byar 'gyur la / gzhan yang / bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dbyer med du bltas te gsol ba 'debs pa dang / smon lam 'debs pa sogs 'brel ci thogs byas na/rigs ldan drag po 'khor lo can gyis kla klo 'dul ba'i tshe 'khor gyi thog mar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gdams pa 'di ni rgyal bo zla ba bzang bo sogs chos rgyal rnams dang /rigs ldan lke rnams kyis shambha lar ched du bya ba'i ga dul bya rnams la bstan nas/gdul bya grangs med pa zung 'jug gi go 'phang la bkod pa yin la/shambha la nas rgya gar du dar tshul ni/ tsi lu ba shambha lar rdzu 'phrul gyis dngos su phebs te rigs ldan las byang chub sems 'grel gyi skor dang / dus 'khori gyi skor rgyas par gsan nas slar rgya gar dudze phebs te spel ba dang /dus zhabs pa chen po'i shambha la dang nye ba'i thang du rigs ldan gyi sprul ba las/ dus 'khor dang bla med kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag dang / khyad par du byang chub sems 'grel skor gsum sogs zla ba bzhi'i bar du gsan te thugs su chud nas/ slar rgya gar du byon te chos bstan pas slob ma mang du byung ba las phal cher rnal 'byor bar 'gyur/bshad pa'i srol 'dzin pa rgyal sras na len dra ba dus zhabs pa gnyis pa zhes bya ba byung /kha che zla ba mgon po 553

zhes bya bas dus zhabs pa chen po'i slorbo ma dutshos zhabos pa gnyis pa dang mjal te byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel ba skor gsum cha lag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gsan no// bod du dar tshul ni rwa lugs dang 'bro lugs te lo tsā ba'i dbang gis brgyud pa mi 'dra ba gnyis byung zhing /dpal chen rga lo na sa brgyud pa gnyis 'dres su gyur/de lta bu'i brgyud ba rnam par dag pa rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun tsong kha ba chen pos/bu ston gyi slobha ma bde chen chos kyi dpal ba la gsan/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ thugs kyi sras gcig mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang bo la gnang / mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang bo de nyid kyis ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba dang sgrub thabs la sogs pa mdzad de dbang dang gdams ngag shin tu dar bar mdzad/ de nas rim par brgyud de rgyal dbang bskal ribazang rgya mtshos sgrub thabs kyi lhan thabs sogs yig cha du ma mdzad/ de nas khyad par du kun mkhyen chen po 'jigs med dbang bos dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil du dus 'khor grwa tshang btsugs te dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gdams ngag rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa gnang ste dus kyi 'khor lo'i thig rdul tshon la sogs pa phyag len mtha' dag zhib cing phra ba shin tu dar bar mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng rim byon rnams kyis dbang dang gdams ngag sogs gnang ste dgon lag rnams la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i grwa tshang rim par 554

'dzugs par mdzad de/ chos dpal zhing dgon pa dang a mchog dga' ldan chos 'khor gling /stod phyogs 'dir zangs dkar khang dmar dgon e waṃ chos 'khor gling sogs su dar zhing rgyas pa 'di bzhin lags la/gzhan bla brang las chos dpal zhing la spel ba dang /de las ki rti dgon ma dgon bu dgon sogs su dar ro/ /bdag gis 'di'i dbang thog mar7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba rje btsun blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas thob pa dang / de'i jes su rdo rje 'chang chen po rgya zhabs drung mkhan chen rin po che bskal bzang dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun dang sta gon bcas dang /gong ma gong chen rnams thob pa dang /de'i rjes su rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po yongs 'dzin sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun bka' drin mnyam med bskal bzang dpal 'byor bzang bo'i zhal snga las/ sta gon dang bcas te byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun dang / dbang gong ma gong chen rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang dang bcas pa legs par thob/de lta bu'i dbang zab mo lha bar 'dres ma chod pa/ mi bar khyis ma chod pa/ mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba/ khyod rnams la bstsal ba'i dus skabaṃs/ lo'i dbang du byas na rab gnas chu pho sprel gyi lo ste/stod 'grel lugs kyi ang gi ra zhes pa rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu sprel lo/ sme ba brgyad dkar/dus 'khor lugs kyi 555

rtsis/ nagapa zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu gsum pa/ gza' phar ba/ ska—ra ma tsho ni bye riri thume bzhi/ sbyor ba phun tshogs sbyor/ridakar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi 'du byed/ jispar kha kham chu/ nyi ma stag sme ba gcig dkar/ dus tshod sprel gyi dus ni/ lo rang rnams la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i ju dus yin pas/ dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob pas/ dga' spro dang bcas te dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ba la 'bad par bya'o//zhes pa 'di ni rub gnas chu sprel lo'i bod lugs rtsis kyi zla gsum pa'i yar ngor/ dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon du dus 'khor dbang chen bton pa'i skabs dbang gi dus go brjod pa'i ched du gang dran thol byung du smras pa'o// 4 — 556 ci

sa bdag lto 'phye'i thig 'debs tshul rab gsal me long / ༄༅ོ/ /brtse chen zhags pa dam pos 'gro ba kun/ /nam du mi gtong khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'bral med snying ga'i pad mtshor rtag bzhugs la/ /phan bde zad pa med pa'i dga' ston stsol/ /de yang lho 'phye brtag tshul ni/ /klu thebs yod pa'i nyin zhig tu/ /gang la bya ba'i gzhi ma la/ /che chung gang dgos babs bstun nas/ /brko zhing rdo sogs zug rngu bsal/ /rdo dang shing rus sogs yod tshe/ /lus nub tsam zhig brkos nas bsal/ /shul du legs pa'i sa blugs nas/ rsha /brdung 'jags legs par byas pa'i steng / /maṇḍal mchod gtor sogs bshams nas/ sa bslangs cho ga gzhung bzhin bya//de nas phyogs lta'i tsakra sogs//brten nas shar nub nges byas te/ /tshangs zur byas rjes btsal tshul sogs/ /spyi ltar byas te gru bzhir gdab/ /phyogs re cha dgur legs bgos nas/ /cha chen thig ni gdab par bya//cha chen re la cha chung bcu//tshon mdog mi gcig thig gis gdab//phyogs rer cha chung dgu bucu re//phyogs bzhir khyon sdom sum brgya dang //drug cu yod pa lo gcig gi /khyim— zhag grangs su shes bar bya//de la 557

lto 'phye rgyu tshul ni/ /ston zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la/ (skabs 'dir ston zla ra ba ni hor zla brgyad pa la go bar bya'o)mgo bo byang shar mtshams su gnas//mjug rtse lho nub re mig tu//bzhag ste kha lhor bstan nas nyal//khyim zhag re re song ba na//mgo bo lho dang mjug rtse byang //re mig re re bgrod nas 'khor//zla ba re la g.yas skor du/ /cha chen gsum re bgrod de 'pho/ /zla ba gsum la phyogs re yi/ /cha chung dgu bcu bgrod par byed/ /hor zla brgyad dgu bcu rnams la/ /mgo shar mjug ma nub phyogs bstan/ /bcu gcig bcu gnyis dang bo la/ /mgo lho mjug ma byang phyogs su/ /gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi ba la/ /mgo nub mjug rtse shar du phyogs/ /lnga ba drug pa bdun pa la/ /mgo byang mjug ma lho phyogs bstan/ /'bring bo bzhi yi bco lnga la/ /tshangs thigadzāsteng du gnasu de dper/ /ston zla 'bring bo dgu ba yi/ /bco lnga la ni shar nub kyi//tshangs thig steng du shad kyis gnas//ra ba bzhi yi tshes gcig la//zur thig steng du gnas pa yin/ /dper na dpyid ra dbo zla yi/ /tshes gcig la ni lho nub nas//byang shar zur thig steng du gnas//'di ni tshes zhag nyin zhag dang / /rgya rtsis ltar du mi rtsi bar/ /khyim zhag dbang du byed dgos —phyir/ /zhag gi chad lhag zla bshol med/ /rtsi lugs skar rtsis gzhung bzhin bya/ /gal te ma nus tshes zhag la/ /sbyar dgos byung na zla bshol skabs/ /phyi nur byed dgos 'dra zhes gsungs/ /de ltar nyin der lto 'phye ni//nyal lugs ji bzhin nges byas nas//mgo dang mjug ma bstan phyogs 558

la/ /mi nor rtags re brgyab byas te/ /sngar gyi thig rnams legs par bsub//mgo phyogs shar dang mjug phyogs nub//byas te tshangs thig dang bo 'debs//thig chen gzhan kyang spyi ltar gdab//gru bzhi byas pa'i phyogs re la//cha chen bcu re bgos pa yang //cha chung dgu rer bgo bar bya//de la tshangs thig dang bo'i steng / /sa bdag lto 'phye 'bri tshul ni/ /gdengs ka dang ldan ro stod mi/ /lag g.yon rna ba g.yon la bkab/ /g.yas pa rin chen thogs nas su/ /dkur bkab ro smad lto 'phye'i gzugs/ /sku mdog dkar bo zhi ba'i nyams/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar dpyang can/ /g.yon du nyal stabs tshul gyis 'bri//lus kyi dkyus su cha chen bcu//gdengs ka zhal dang snying lte ba/ /gsang gnas lnga la cha chen re/ /de bzhin sbrul mjug cha chen lnga/ /zheng la cha chung dgu yod do/ /de ltar byas nas phyogs gang nas/ /gzhal kyang gsang gnas dbus su yod/ /de la tshom bu 'god tshul ni/ /spyi bor sngon po rna bar dkar/ /mgrin par dmar bo dpung bar ser/ /snying gar ljang gu lte bar dkar//gsang gnas ljang gu mjug rtser sngo//de nas sa mig btsal ba'i tshul//mgo bo ston phyogs shar byas pa'i//shar nas nub tu cha chen gsum/ /cha chung nyer bdun yod pa yin/ /nub nas shar du cha drug/lho nas byang du cha chen gsum//byang nas cha chen drug dang slar//cha chung phyed dang lnga dor lhag /brko rung mchan mdun dngos grub sa/ /che chung shar nub cha chen gcig /lho byang cha chung phyed dang lngar/ /mi nor 559

mtshan ma brtan po 'a debs/ /de nas sgrub po rnal 'byor bas/ /mchod gtor thams cad 'du byas nas//klu yi mjug phyogs su 'khod de//skyabs sems yi dam mngon rtogs nas//klu rgyal gshegs gsol byed pa'i bar//cho ga'i gzhung bzhin shes par bya/ /de name sa rko rdo slog la/ /spar kha skyon med gcig gis ni/rdo rje'i mtshan pa'i lcags kyi 'jor//dar tshon sna lngas rab brgyan te/ /lag g.yas steng dang g.yon pa 'og /byas te bzung la kha shar phyogs/ /de nyid khro bo bgegs mthar byed/ /bskyed chog cho ga bzhin byas nas/ /shar du phyogs de brko rung ba'i/ /sa nas 'jor kham bzhi tsam brko/ cho/brko ba'i sa de gtor nang dang / /me mtshams sogs su cung zad gtor//de ni dngos grub sa yin la//slar yang phyogs gzhan kha bltas te//brko zhing dbus dang phyogs gzhan nas/ /'jor khem lnga sogs brko bar bya//dngos grub blangs pa'i sa de dang //rnam 'joms bzlas pa'i gzungs chu sogs//dge slong bzhi sde'am yang na ni//rang bzhin bzang ba'i mi dag gis/ /ci tsam dgos pa'i sa la gtor/ /dngos grub sa de blangs shul du/ /sngar sgrub sta gon byas pa yi/ /rin chen sna lnga'i bum gter sba/ /mjug tu bsngo smon shis brjod dang / /dngos grub sa dang sa gzhan gyis/ /thig dang gzugs ris g.yogs bsub bya/ /las 'di dkyil 'khor mchod rten dang / /lha khang khyim phug sogs la yang / /shis pa'i las su rgyud las gsungs//khyab bdag bla ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las//rnam par spros pa'i 560

man ngag ga bur rgyun/ /blo gsar blo yi gnyen du 'bab pa'i ched/ /nag 'gros chog bsgrigs gsal ba'i me long bskrun/ ༈/rgyud kyi rgyal bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang //gsum ldan ngur smig rnam rol bla ma rje//dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /slaramong lhug pa'i tshig gis gsal bar bya/ /slar yang lhug pa'i tshig gis zhib par brjod pa la/ khungs 'god kyang dgos pa bstan pa/ lag len ji ltar byed pa'i rim pa/ mtha' cung zad dpyad pa gsum/ dang bo ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / phreng ba las lto 'phye brtag dgos par gsung la/ brtag tshul zhib par bi bhū tī'i dkyil chog las/ lha khang mchod rten khang bzang khang brtsegs dang / /rab gnas dkyil chog la sogs byed 'dod pas/ /'dir ni sa yi lto 'phye brtag bya ste/ /zhes dang / /sa gzhi gang yin de ni gru bzhir bya/ /zla ba gsum gyi nyin mo'i grangs kyis 'dir//phyogs ni so sor sa de rnam par dbye//dbang ldan nas ni mi yi mtshams kyi bar/ /shar gyi sa de dgu bcur rnam par dbye//me nas bden bral mtshams kyi bar dang ni/ /bden bral nas ni rlung gi mtshams bar dang //rlung nas 'byung bo'i bdag po'i mtshams kyi bar//de bzhin kho nar dgu bcur dbye bar bya/ /ston zla ra ba 'bring dang tha ma'i bar/ /dbang ldan mtshams la sogs pasgyur mgo bo gnas/ /bden bral mtshams la sogs par mjug ma'i cha//gsang ba'i gnas ni sa yi dbus su bzhag /lte ba'i 'og gi cha ni lto 'phye'i lus/ /stod cha gdengs ka dang 561

ldan mi yi gzugs/ /lhor lta lag pa g.yon par rna bar bzhag /g.yas pa rin chen thogs pas dkur bkab nas//sa 〈pe cha dgu khyab par nyal nas gnas/ /klu yi bdag po lus tshad mtho bcu'o/ /shar dang nub kyi mtha' mar gnas na yang //sa yi dum bu de ni 'jal ba ltar//nyi ma'i bgrod pas tshes gcig la sogs par//nyin zhag re re zhing ni cha re re//ji ltar rigs pas shar gyi cha ru rgyu//lho dang nub dang byang du'ang de bzhin no//dgun zla ra ba 'bring dang tha ma yi//dkar phyogs la sogs nub tu kha mig lta//me yi mtshams su yan lag mchog bstan te/ /rlung gi mtshams la sogs par mjug ma gnas//dpyid zla ra ba 'bring dang tha ma de'i//gnod sbyin bdag phyogs kha dang mig gis lta/ /bden bral mtshams la sogs par mgo bo gnas//dbang ldan mtshams la sogs par mjug ma'i cha//dbyar zla ra ba 'bring dang tha ma ru/ /shar phyogs su ni kha dang mig gis lta/ /rlung gi mtshams la sogs par mgo bo gnas//me yi mtshams la sogs par mjug ma'i cha/ /lo gcig la ni sa gzhi mtha' dag tu/ /'khor gcig gis ni 'bad pas kun tu khyab/ /ces gsungs so/ /dgos pa ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ gtsug lag khang dang khang bzang dang / /mchod rten dkyil 'khor grong khyer dang / /khyim dang sdum ra la sogs la/ /lto 'phye'i lto bar brko ba dang / zhes dang / sngags rim chen mo las 'di brtag pa ni mang bo zhig mkho bar snang ngo / /de la dkyil 'khor gyi khang ba byed pa la ni nges par 562

dgos la/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ rko tshe yang 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi sa mig ma nor ba dgos kyi/de las gzhan pa'i gnas su brkos na nyes mig mang bo 'byung ste/ bi bhū tīs/cha dgu'i sa yi cha la brkos na ni//pha ma bu dang bu mo spun chung ma//mna' ma rang gi skye bo mdza' bshes 'chi//gal te rgyab tu brkos na rang 'chi zhing //yang na rang gnas nas 'pho nor brlag 'gyur/ /mjug mar glang chen rta dang ma ho ra/ ba lang 'chi zhing stobs kyang nyams par 'gyur/ /gal te khams lnga'i nang du shing dang skra/ /grog mkhar skra sen thal bas gnod pa 'byung //rdo bas rlung gi 'jigs pa phub ma dang / /mgal dum gyis rims rus pas zug gzer ro/ /zhes so/rgyud dang rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa bzhin tshul bzhin du brkos na/ chos dang nor dang 'dod don thams cad 'grub cing 'phel bar 'gyur te/de nyid las/ de yis chos nor 'dod don 'phel zhing 'grub/ /zhes gsungs so/ ༈/gnyis pa lag len ji ltar byed pa'i rim pa ni/ klu thebs yod pa'i nyin gcig la/ gang la bya ba'i sa la thig che chung ji 'dra dgos pa'i sa brkos te/ rdo dang shing rus sogs yod tshe lus nub tsam re brkos nas zug ju mtha' dag bsal/gal te zug rngu dbyung rgyu med tshe de tsam brko mi dgos shing / ci tsam brko dgos pa rig pas dpyad nas bya'o/ /zug rngu mtha' dag legs par bsal ba'i shul du/ rtswa shing rus rdo sogs zug rngu ci yang med pa'i legs pa'i sa blugs nas brdung 'jags legs par 563

byas te thigs 'debs rung bar bya/ de yang sngags rim gyi dkyil 'khor spyi'i sa stegs skabs su/ de nas hūṃ dang las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i chus gtor zhing / brdungs nas sa khru phyed tsam du mtho zhing mnyam la dbus cung zad mtho ba shar dang byang yid tsam dma' bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di yang sbyar bar bya'o//de'i steng du dri bzang giwaṃg le byas pa'i maṇḍal dang / de'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams pa dang / sa bslangs cho ga 'don pa rnams chog sgrigs ltar bya/ de nas phyogs brtag 'khor lo la brten nas shar nub lho byang gi phyogs nges par byas nas/tshangs zur gyi thig dang bya rjes btsal tshul sogs spyi 'gros ltar byas te/thig gru bzhir gdab pa'i rjes/phyogs re re la cha chen dgu rer bgos te thig 'debs/ slar yang cha chen re re cha chung bcu rer bgos nas mi nor ba'i ched tshon mdog mi gcig pa'i thig 'debs/ phyogs re re la cha chung dgu bcu re yod/ phyogs bzhi ka bsdoms na cha chung sum brgya dang drug cu yod pa/ lo gcig gi khyim zhag gi grangs yin no//lto 'phye rgyu tshul ni/skabs 'di'i ston zla ra ba hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la mgo byang shar dang mjug ma lho nub tu bstan te byang shar dang lho nub kyi zur thig steng du gnas shing /kha lhor bstan nas nyal/ khyim zhag re song ba na mgo bos lho phyogs su cha chung re mig re bgrod/ mjug mas byang phyogs su cha chung re bgrod nas 'khor/ zla ba re la cha chen gsum re g.yas skor du bgrod de 564

'pho/zla ba gsum rer phyogs re'i cha chung re mig dgu bcu bo rdzogs par byed/ hor zla brgyad pa dgu ba bcu ba rnams la mgo shar dang mjug ma nub phyogs su bstan nas yod/ hor zla bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa dang dang bo rnams la/ mgo lho dang mjug ma byang phyogs su bstan nas yod/hor zla gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi ba rnams la mgo nub dang mjug—ma shar phyogs su bstan nas yod/ hor zla lnga ba drug pa bdun pa rnams la mgo byang dang mjug ma lho phyogs su bstan nas yod/ ston zla 'bring bo hor zla dgu ba'i bco lnga la mgo shar du bstan nas shar nub kyi tshangs thig steng du gnas pa yin/ dgun zla 'bring bo hor zlo bcu gnyis pa'i bco lnga la mgo bo lhor bstan nas lho byang gi tshangs thig steng du gnas/dpyid zla 'bring bo hor zla gsum pa'i bco lnga la mgo nub tu bstan nas yang shar nub kyi tshangs thig steng du shad kyis gnas/ dbyar zla 'bring bo hor zla drug pa'i bco lnga la mgo byang du bstan nas yang lho byang tshangs thig steng du shad kyis gnaṅge so//de bzhin du dpyid zla ra ba hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la lho nub dang byang shar bar gyi zur thig steng du gnas pa sogs/ ra ba bzhi yi tshes gcig la zur thig steng du gnas pa shes par bya'o/ /'di'i zhag dang zla ba tshes zhag dang nyin zhag la mi rtsi bar/khyim zhag dang /khyim zla'i dbang du byed dgos stabs/ rtsi lugs skar rtsis kyi gzhung las shes dgos so//gal te khyim zhag mimi shes par rags par 565

tshes zhag la sbyar dgos byung na gnam stong med tshe cha chung re'u mig gcig 'gom pa dang / zla lhag la phyi nur byed par pra tsā sa ra'i zin bris las gsungs so/ /de ltar brtag nyin der lto 'phye re'u mig gang du gnas pa nges par byas nas/ mgo mjug gi thad la phur ba 'debs pa'am yang na mtshan ma gzhan zhig 'debs pa gang rung gis mi nor ba'i mtshan ma brtan po bya/ thig gzhan rnams bsub nas mgo'i thad shar dang mjug ma'i thad nub byas te/tshangs thig dang bo shar nub kyi tshangs thig 'debs/de nas thig chen gzhan rnams kyang spyi ltar btab rjes/ phyogs re re cha chen bcu rer bgo ba dang cha chen re la cha chung dgu re byed/ sngar cha chen dgu dang cha chung bcu byed pa zla grangs brtsis te lto 'phye gnas sa 'tshol sla ba'i ched dang / 'dir cha chen bcu dang cha de re re la cha chung dgu re byed pa lto 'phye'i gzugs ris 'bri tshe lus kyi cha 'tshol sla ba dang /sa mig btsal tshe stabs bde ched yin/ de la tshangs thig dang bo'i steng du lto 'phye'i gzugs ris 'bri tshul ni/ klu rgyal mtha' yas dkar bo stod mi la smad sbrul mjug can rin po che'i rgyan du ma dang dar dpyang gis brgyan pa/phyag g.yas nor bu bsnams te dkur bsten pa/g.yon pas rna ba g.yon la bkab pa/ g.yon phyogs su nyal stabs su gnas pa 'bri dgos shing /tshad ni gdeng ka zhal/ snying ka lte ba gsang gnas rnams su cha chen re re/ lhag ma sbrul mjug la cha chen lnga/zheng la cha chung dgu byed dgos/de ltar byas 566

tshe phyogs gang nas gzhal kyang gsang gnas dbus su yod stabs gsang gnas yan la cha chen lnga dang /de man gyi sbrul mjug la cha chen lnga ste lus kyi dkyus su cha chen bcu yin no/ /de la tshom bu 'god tshul ni/ spyi bor mtha' yas sngon po/rna bar padma dkar bo/mgrin par 'jog po dmar bo/dpung bar padma ser bo/ snying gar nor rgyas ljang gu/ lte bar dung skyong dkar bo/ gsang gnas su stobs rgyu ljang gu/mjug rtser rigs ldan sngon po ste klu chen brgyad rang mdog gi tshom bu 'god/ de ltar tshom bu dang gzugs ris sogs rdul tshon sogs kyis gang mdzes marjesmo bris mthar sa mig btsal tshul ni/ mgo ston phyogs shar byas te shar phyoges nas cha chung nyer bdun gyi mtshams su btsal dgos stabs de phyogs nas cha chen gsum dor/nub ste mjug ma'i phyogs nas cha chen drug dor/lho ste mdun phyogs nas cha chen gsum dor/byang ste rgyab phyogs nas cha chen drug dang cha chung bzhi dang phyed dor ba'i lhag ma sa mig yin la/de'i che chung la shar nub tu cha chung dgu/ lho byang du cha chung bzhi dang phyed yod pa ma nor bar mtshan ma legs par btab sa mig nang du chud nges kyi rin chen lnga dang 'bru sna lnga'i bum gter kyang sngar nas sta gon byas med na 'di'i skabs su sgrub ste sta gon bya/de nas mchod gtor thams cad 'du byas nas/sgrub pa bo dag klu'i mjug phyogs su 'khod de skyabs sems yi dam mngon rtogs nase bzung klu rgyal gshegs gsol bar rhaga'i gzhung bzhin bya/de nas sa 567

rko rdo slog la lo spar kha skyon med zhig gis/rdo rje'i mtshan pa'i 'jor dar tshon sna lngas brgyan pa zhig lag g.yas steng dang / g.yon 'og byas te bzung /kha mgo phyogs shar du phyogs nas 'dug pa bgegs mthar byed du bskyed pa cho ga'i gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /de nas des shar du phyogs te brko rung ba'i sa mig nas 'jor kham bzhi tsam brkos pa dngos grub kyi sa yin/sa de gtor ma'i nang dang me mtshams sogs su cung zad gtor/ gzhan yang phyogs gzhan dang dbus sogasi su 'jor kham lnga sogs brko bar bya la/dngos grub kyi sa de dang rnam 'joms gzungs chu sogs dge slong bzhi sde'am mi rang bzhin bzang ba zhig gis ci tsam dgos pa'i sa la gtor bar bya'o/ /dngos grub blangs pa'i shul du sngar sta gon byas pa'i bum gter de nyid cho ga bzhin du sba zhing mjug tu bsngo smon shis brjod sogs bya/thig dang gzugs ris rnams dngos grub sa dang sa gzhan gyis bsub nas mi mngon par bya'o/ ༈/gsum pa mtha' cung zad dpyad pa la/kha cig gis khyod kyis gong du cha chen dgu byas pa dang /'og tu cha chen bcu byas pa nang 'gal lo zhe na/ klu yi rgyal bo lus tshad mtho bcu'o/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa ltar/cha bcu byed pa be dkar dang sum bha'i sngags kyi spyi don las gsungs/ cha dgu byed pa ni bi khyu tīs/ sa yi cha dgu khyab par nyal nas gnas/zhes pa'i dgongs pa yin la/cha chen bcu byed na cha chung dgu dang /cha chen dgu byed na cha chung bcu byed pa yin stabs gnad gcig tu 568

'gro'o//'on kyang thog mar klu gnas phyogs 'tshol tshe cha chen dgu byas na 'tshol sla ba'i dgos pa yod de/dper na ston zla ra ba'i tshes gcig nas zla ba gcig tsam song yod na cha chen gsum rdzogs tshar bas cha chung bgrang mi dgos par zla grangs la cha chen bgrang chog pa'i phyir/ de'i rjes thig dngos gzhi'i skabs cha chen bcu byas na klu'i lus kyi cha bgo ba dang / sa mig 'tshol ba sogs la cha chen bgrang chog stabs shin tu las sla ba'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir te/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i thig bshad las/lto 'phye cha bcur bgos na mtho bcu dang 'grig cha dgu bgos na zla ba gsum gyi zhag grangs dang 'grig ces gsungs so/ /yang 'ga' zhig gis khyod kyis gdengs ka zhal snying ga lte ba gsang gnas rnams su cha chen re byas pa mi 'thad par thal/ mgrin pa la yang cha chen gcig yod pa'i phyir te/gdengs ka la ni zhal gang ste//zhal la cha phran dgu ru shes//de ltar matpan dang thugs ka nyid/ /lte ba la ni de yi tshad/ /de nas mtshan ma'ang de tsam yin/ /lhag ma lto 'phye'i rnam pa'o//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer na ma khyab ste/de ltar byas na gsang gnas dbus su 'ong ba'i lugs dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/sngags rim chen mo las zhes gsungs pa ni gsang gnas dbus su 'ong ba'i lugs dang 'gal lam snyam mo//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/des na gang gi lung don spyir mgrin pa la de tsam yod pa'i don yin gyi 'bri ba'i tshe mgrin pa zhal smad kyis yongs su khebs pa'i dbang du byas nas zur du 569

cha chen gcig 'jog mi dawas pa sku gzugs sogs kyi skabs dang 'dra bar zhal shes su yod la/ cha chen gcig bzhag na shin tu mi mdzes par 'gyur ba'i phyir/des na bee dkar las/de yang gdengs ka zhal snying ga /lte ba gsang gnas mtho re lnga//de bzhin sbrul mjug mtho lngar 'dod/ces gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /yang kha cig sum bha'i sngags spyi las/ lte ba chung brgyad gsang gnas so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mgrin pa la cha chen gcig bzhag na yang gsang gnas dbus su 'ong ba'i lugs yod do zhe na/ mi 'thad de/de ltar byas na brko mig dpung ba'i thad sor yod la/brko ba'i sa mig mchan mdun du 'ong dgos pa'i phyir te/ bi bhū tā'i dkyil chog las/ 'di ni mchan gyi thad du thog mar brko/zhes dang /sngags rim chen mo las/ mgo shar du bstan pa'i dbang du byas na mgos re'u mig gang non pa'i phyogs de nas nub tu re'u mig dgu gsum nyer bdun dor ba'i bar la zhes pa nas/ re'u mig phyed dang lnga ni dang bor brko ba'i sa mig pa'o/ /de ni mchan gyi mdun du bzhed pas/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/de la kha cig mchan gyi thad du brko ba min par lto bar brko dgos te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ lto 'phye'i sto bar brko ba dang / zhes dang / sdom 'byung 'grel ba las lto bar brko bar bya ste/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer na/de ni lto ba'i thade kyi mdun du brko ba'i don yin te/ gdengs ka zhal snying ga gsum gyi thad so'i cha phran dgu gsum nyer bdun dor ba'i 'phror lto ba'i 570

thad kyi mdun phyogs su brko dgos par sngar bshad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/lto bar brko mi rung ste/lto 'phye'i lus kyis gang khyab kyi re'u mig tu brko mi rung ba'i phyir/bi bhū tā'i dkyil chog las/cha dgu'i sa yi cha la brkos na ni/ /pha ma bu dang bu mo spun chung ma/ /mna' ma rang gi skye bo mdza' bshes 'chi/ /zhes dang / sngags rim las lus kyi mgo mjug gis re'u mig dgu bcu non pa dang 'gal mi 'gal brtag go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/yang 'ga' zhig gis lto 'phye'i lus la tshom bu 'god tshul 'di bee dkar dang mi mthun pa'i phyir mi 'thad do zhe na/ bee dkar las gsang bar stobs rgyu dud kha gsungs mod/rang lugs 'di ltar yin te/bi bhū tā'i dkyil chog las/mjug ma'i rtse mor rigs ldan shin tu sngo//gsang gnas dur ba ltar ljang stobs kyi rgyu/ /lte bar dung skyong padma'i rtsa ba bzhin/ /dpung bar padma chen po gser dang mtshungs/ /nor rgyas snying gar gnas pa ljang gu ste//'jog po zhes pa dmar bo mgrin par gnas/ /rna bar padma dkar bo'i 'od zer can/ /spyi bo ru ni mtha' yas sngon po gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang 'ga' zhig gis/ khyod kyis skabs 'dir ston zla ra ba hor zla brgyad pa la byas pa mi 'thad de/bee dkar sogs dang mi mthun pa'i phyir zer na/rang lugs 'di ltar yin te/rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i thig bshad las/ston ra rdo rje mkha' 'gror brgyad pa dang zhes dang /rang lugs ston ra brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nas 'dzin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ smras pa/ rgyud sde 571

padma'i mtsho las nyen thon pa'i/ /'phrin las padma dkar bo'i 'dab ma stong / /brgyud ldan bla ma'i man ngag zer brgya yis/ /yongs su phyes pa'i dpal yon bla na 'phags/ /gang zhig lto rgyab kho na sems pa yi/ gzi lum pho tshod long ba'i gom 'gros kyis/ /rang rigs rmongs pa'i skye bo bslu mthong tshe//'di 'dra 'bri ba'i spobs pa bdag la skyes//rnam dag rgyud sde'i 'jings las nyer thon pa'i/ /man ngag rin chen dbang gi rgyal bo la/ /rnam dag lag len phyi bdar legs bgyis pas//sde bzhi'i dgos 'dod gru char 'jo bar shog/ ces sa bdag lto 'phye'i thig 'debs tshul rab gsal sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni/rab 'byams pa chos ldan tshogs 'phel nas bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis mtshan pa'i dkar yol bkra shis pa'i rdzas kyis bkang ba dang / yid du 'ong ba'i ri mo bkra ba'i re kha du ma dang bkra shis pa'i lha dar bcas nan tan tu bskul ba'i ngo ma bzlog par brgyud ldan bla ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin rang shag rig pa'i dga' tshal du bris pa dza yan tu// 572

lto 'phye'i bskyed chog ngag 'don gyi rim pa/༄ / /rgyud kyi ston pa gnyis paji blo bzang grags/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug kun mkhyen mchog /bka' drin gzhal med bdag gi 'dren pa rje/ /rnam gsum dbyer med zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten/ /phreng kṛ sogs kyi dgongs pa rin chen nor//lto 'phye brtag bslang sa sbyangs mchod pa'i tshul/ /kun mkhyen yab sras phyag rgyun bslad med pa//rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub phyir 'bri bar bya/ /de yang 'dir bdag gis sngar bris pa'i sa bdag lto 'phye'i thig 'debs tshul rab gsal sgron me zhes bya ba'izur rgyan gyi tshul du lto 'gye'i mchod chog nag 'gros su 'god pa la/ thog mar rdzas dang yo byad ni/ dkar gsum mngar gsum/ klu sman dang ra dkar bdamar gyi 'o ma/ gul yungs/ dri bzang gi chu/ rdul tshon dkar ser dmar ljang sngon po rnams dadzakathig skud dkar dmar gnyis/skor ru/tog tse'am gzhor dar tshon sna lnga btags pa rdo rjes mtshan pa gcigagater sdas/rnam 'joms kyi bum pa sgrub mkhan/bkra shis rtsegs pa sogs gsung dgos pa'i sla chos su ma song bar sta gon legs par bya'o//de nas brko zhing zug rngu bsal ba sogs byas te/ sa gtsang brdung 'jags legs par byas pa'i sa stegs steng du stegs kyi khar/ sa bdag zhing skyong la skum gtor dkar bo gcig sa'i lha mo la maṇḍal steng du bris thig le byas la 'bru'i tshom bu ser bo bkod pa'i mdun du/gtor ma skum po dkar bo gcig de dag gi mdun du mchod pa chu gnyis nyer spyod tshar gnyis bshams/ de nas skyabs sems rgyud dang 'dres nges pa bya/rang nyid yi dam lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas dgos pas/rang 573

nyid skad cig gis pad zla dang seng ge'i gdan gyi steng du 'phags mchog seng ge'i sgra sku mdog dkar bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ garmi sa pus mo'i steng du btsugs shing /g.yon pa gdan la brten pas sbrul gyis dkris pa'i tri shul dang sman gyis bkab pa'i thod pas mtshan pa'i padma bsnams pa/dka' thub kyi cha lugs can rgyal bo rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/mchod gtor rnams/a mṛ tas bsangs/stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ rang gi thugs ka'i rgyu gi 'od zer gyis sa bdag zhing skyong klu la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te mdun du bzhugs par gyur/oṃ bhu mi ba tī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sa rba rnyarma ṇi abya nutpanda to ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/lan gsum gyis bsngo/ mchod pa/a mṛ tas bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/zhabs bsil/me togabadug spos/snang gsal/dri chab/zhal zas/rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūṃ/sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ bhu mi ba tī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra ti tstsha rgyu swā hā/de bzhin du pāju sogs kyis mchod/de nas/ dril stabs dang bcas pas/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /574

gnod sbyin srin po'am ni gzhan/ /de dag rnams la sa 'di ni/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis bstsal tu gsol/ /'dir ni tshogs bsags rten bzhengs phyir/ /'di na gtsug lag khang bzhengs phyir/ /'di na khang khyim sogs brtsig phyir/ /'di dag skabs thob kyis sbyar/ sa rko rdo slog shing gcod la/ /ru nga phrag dog mi byed cing //phog thug nyes kun zhi bar mdzod//lan gsum/zhes gsol ba btabs pas las ci bde bar gyis shigaces gnang ba byin nas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/sa'i lha mo la sa bslang ba ni/mchod gtor sngar ltar byin rlabs byas la/de nas tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las tshom bu'i steng du baṃ las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing na bza' dkar bo gyon pa/zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon gser gyi bum pa bsnams shing padma'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du zla ba'i steng du hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas sa la lan gsum brdab pa'i sgra dang rgyu gi 'od zer gyis sa'i lha mo sa 'og nas thon te/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ gtor ma/ a ka ro lan gsum gyis 'bul/ oṃ bri thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/spos dang rdo dril 'dzin pas/skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par du//sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la//lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seṅge yis//ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom nas/ /de ltar bdag gis bdud bgegs stobs/ /bcom nas tshogs 575

bsags rten bzhengs phyir//sa rko rdo slog shing gcod la/ /ru nga phrag dog mi byed cing / /phog thug nyes kun zhi bar mdzod/ /lan gsum brjod la/ las ci bde bar byin nas/sa de nyid du thim par gyur/sa sbyangs pa ni/lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas sa la bzhag naga.oṃ āḥhūṃ/oṃ ha na ha na badzra kro rnya rgyu phaṭa/rdo rje khro bos bgegs rnams bcom zhing rdo rje gsum gyis sa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs par gyur/a sbo ta brgya rtsa bzlas te kun rdzob pa'i sbyangs pa dang /sa la sogs pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong bas stong ba nyid du gyur/zhes chos dang gang zag gi bdag med pa'i stong nyid bsgoms te/don dam pa'i sbyangs pa bya/ de nas bgegs gtor gtong ba ni/ rang nyid seṅge'i sgru 9sa skad cig gis 'jig rten gsum rgyal du bskyed de/rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal du gyur par bsams la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te rgyal bawas bcas kyi mthu stobs nus pa thams cad khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas pas/oṃ badzra ma hā kro rnya ra dzā sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma dzaḥ rgyu ye shes bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od//ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' satshan stag lpags can//log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba//rig pa'i rgyal bo khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na//'ahūṃ ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol//oṃ badzra ma hā kro rnya ra dza sa pā ri wā ra e hye nyi/ pra wa ra sad ka ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā/576 —

padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha ra dza sa ba ri wā ra arghaṃ shabha pra tī tstsha āḥhūṃ/bstod pa ni/hūṃ/ chos nyid stong ba gnyis med ngang nyid las//'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing //thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa//khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo//ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang //sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can//gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras//ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo//lhag pa'i ye shes rol ba ston mdzad cing //bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na//dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi bajid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog/khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo//rgyu 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing //bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod//de nas bgegs gtor rnams bshams la/a mṛ tas bsangs/swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum 577

tshogs par gyur/oṃ āX rgyu/gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ gnas 'dir lto 'phye brtag pa la bar chad brtson par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig gis 'dir bkug par gyur/gtor ma g.yas su bskor zhing /oṃ saza bisnan na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba talha ud ga te spa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ grisne rda ba li ta ye swāhā/ gsum gyis bsngo ba ni zhi bas sbyang ba/ ting lo'i mar me dang chang bu sbrags nas rten la phyir bskor zhing /oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūṃ/groṇḍi greṇḍa rgyu/groṇḍi pa ya groṇḍa pa ya rgyu/ā na ya ho bha ga wā na bibyā rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/lan gsum brjod pa zhi drag gyed mas sbyang ba/ de nas/ hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga yis gnas 'dir lto 'phye brtag par byed/ /khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis//gal te nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na//ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal ba brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing / /bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang /rin po che dang padma dang / las kyi rigs su zhugs pa thams cad dang /snying bo dang phyag rgya dang /gsang sngags dang /rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par 578

thams cad dang /khyad par du yang spyan ras gzigs seṅge'i sgra'i lha tshogs 'alo/ ra dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs pa la brten nas gnas 'dir lto 'phye brtag pa la sogs pa'i cho ga byed pa la bar du gcod pa sogs bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de dag thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnod pa dang 'tshe ba'i bsam pa ngan pa thams cad spongs la phan pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas rang rang so so'i gnas su songs shig gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba rnams kyis bsreg cing rnam par 'joms par gdon mi za'o/ /sum bha ni brjod de gu gul gyis bdug yungs dkar gyis brabs rol mo dang bcas bgegs bskrad/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang //mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang //mthun par 'grub cing phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /de dag ni drag po'i sbyang ba'o/ /de nas rab gsal me long ltar thig gdab lto 'phye bris/gnas rnams su go rim ltar gyi klu brgyad kyi mdog dang mthun pa'i tshom bu bkod/ de la 'o ma la sogs pa'i dkar gsum gyis mchod dgos te/ sngags rim las de 'dra'i sto 'phye bsam la/ 'o ma la sogs pa'i mchod pas mchod/ ces gsungs pa'i don bzhin stegs kyi khar rin po che lta bu'i snod du/skum gtor dkar bo mthar bshos bu brgyad kyis bskor ba'i mthar ting phor lta bu'i nang du dkar gsum mngar gsum klu sman btab cing sbrus pa'i zan ril ra dkar ba dmar gyi 'o mas bkang ba dgu dang /de'i mdun klu sman dang dri bzang btab pa'i nyer spyod kyi mchod pa 'bul yul gyi g.yas nas mgo brtsams te mdun dang mtshams su bshams la/rang lto 'bye la kha phyogs par 'dug ste/mchodi gtor rnams/a mṛ tas bsangs/579

shu rgya tas sbyang gastong ba'i ngang las rgyu las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod gtor rnams oṃ dang rang rang gi ming yig dang bo thig le brgyan pa yongos su gyur pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang klu sman dang nor bu dang ro brgya ldan pa'i bza' btung sogs mdor na klu dang sa bdag gang la gang 'dod pa'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs par gyur/sngags drug gis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ sbo bhā wa bi shudhe hormāḥ te badzra sirdzi rgyu/ na ci maḥ sasbra ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhaḥ sabra tad khaṃ ud ga te spa ra ṇa hi me ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/oṃ a skṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba rnyarmā tsā abya nud pan na twa da/ na maḥ sabra ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūṃ/oṃ ru ru sku ru dzwa la tiṣṭha sirnyi lo tsa ni sarba a rba sā rnya ni swā hā/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni//de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang //chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis//don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun//de dag thams cad ci rigs par//thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig/de nas mdun gyi lho 'phye'i gzugs tshom bu dang bcas pa/ a skṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las rang gi mdun du skyed mos tshal spang ljongs mtsho rdzing bu sogs kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su sa bdag lto 'phye chen po dung ltar dkar ba ngo bo klu mtha' yas kyi rigs can la rnam pa stod mi la smad lto 'phye gzugs can sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan zhing dar dang rin po che'i sna tshogs pas brgyan pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas yid 580

bzhin gyi nor bu thogs nas dkur brten pa/ g.yon rna ba g.yon par bkab pa/ de'i spyi bor mtha' yas sngon po/ rna bar padma dkar bo/ mgrin par 'jog po dmar bo/dpung bar padma ser bo/ snying gar nor rgyas ljang khu/ lte bar dung skyong dkar bo/ gsang gnas su stobs rgyu ljang khu/ mjug rtser rigs ldan sngon po/de thams cad kyang stod mi la smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi thugs kar rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin pa gdengs ka dang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan cha can/de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis rgya mtsho chen po la sogs pa nas klu sa bdag 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /sa 'og mun pa ma lus sel mdzad cing / /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab//klu rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//oṃ e gye hi nā ga ra dzā a rnyi ba ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/zhes dgug bstem bya/dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi//bzhes nas bdag la bka' drin rtul//oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha hūṃ swā hā/dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i//sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la bka' drin stsol//oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra pā ju pra tī tstsha 581

hūṃ swāhā/ lha yi me tog dam pa 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra puṅgā pra tī tstsha hūṃ swā hā/ /lha yi bdug spos dam pa 'dis/— /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te//mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra rnyu pe pra tī tstsha rgyu sā hā/lha yi snang gsal dam pa 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te//mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tī tstsha hūṃ sā hā/ kelha yi dri chab dam pa 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal//thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te//mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/oṃ nā ga rā dzo sa pa ri wā ra gadhe pra tī tstsha hūṃ swā hā/ lha yi zhal zas dam pa 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal//thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te//mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra tī wi bya pra tī tstsha rgyu swā hā/ lha yi sil snyan dam pa 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te//mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra shabha pra tī tstsha rgyu swā hā/rin chen dbang gi rgyal po baiḍūrya/ /sngon po la sogs kha dog dbyibs kyi gzugs/ /rnam gsum gzugs kyi rdo rje mar byas nas//klu rgyal 'khor bcas spyan la dbul bar 582

bya/ /oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra shasnya pra tī tstsha hūṃ swā hā//ma zin 'byung ba'i tshogs pa las byung ba'i/ /brjod bral dbyings la sogaṅge pa sgra yi tshogs/ /rnam gsum sgra yi rdo rje mar byas nas/tsho/klu rgyal 'khor bcas snyan la dbul bar bya//oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra shabha pra tī tstsha hūṃ swā hā/ga bur a gar dza ti la sogs pa//legs par sbyar las byung ba dri yi tshogs//rnam gsum dri yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /klu rgyal 'khor bcas shangs la dbul bar bya /oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra garnye pra tī tstsha hūṃ ṭwā hā/ gus mchog rgyas byed bdud rtsi'i zas sogs kyi//mngar skyur kha dang bska la sogs pa'i ro//rnam gsum ro yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /klu rgyal 'khor bcas lhags la dbul bar bya//oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ra sa pra tī tstsha oṃ su hā/lus la reg pa tsam gyis bde ster ba/ /dpag bsam gos la sogs pa reg bya'i tshogs/ /rnam gsum reg bya'i rdo rje mar byas nas/ /klu rgyal 'khor bcas sku la dbul bar bya//oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sparsha pra tī tstsha rgyu swā hā/zhing 'di rgyal srid sna bdun gyis//mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste//dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir//nyin rer shes rab can gyis dbul//oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sabha ratna pra tī tstsha rghaṃ swā hā/gtor ma la/na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sa ra sambha ra hūṃ/lan 'dun/de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan dang /oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba rnyarmā rṇa abya nutpan na to ta oṃ āḥ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/lan gsum gyis 'bul/rshanā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pabye puṅgā dhu 583

be ā lo ke gadhe rna wibya shabha pra tī tstsha rgyu gā hā/gang zhig sngon nas yon tan legs sbyangs pas/ /dus 'dir dpal 'byor bsod nams kyis phyug cing / /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor7dang bcas la bstod/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang bskal ba bzang //longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing //zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi//las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan//bya byed ngan rnams med par mdzod//'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang //'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang //bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang //yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/de nas sha khrag dang gla rtsi sogs kyi dri mas ma sgags pa'i klu sman sna tshogs/ dug rigs ma yin pa'i shing sna du ma/ dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs sa gtsang zhing gya nom pas klu bsang gtong bar bya ste/oṃ badzratham sbo tas bsangs swa bha was stong bar sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang bo thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las mchod gtor dang bsang rdzas rnams mchod yul spyi dang khyad par klu rigs 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mthu dad ldan par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su 584

ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya ho badzra spa ra na khaṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ swā bhā wa bi shudhe rnyarmaḥ te badzra sirnyi hūṃ/ na maḥ saza ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ saza tad khaṃ ud ga te spa ra ṇa nyi me ga ga na khaṃ sā hā/oṃ a sbo ta hūṃ phaṭa/oṃkṣim kā ro mu khaṃ sarba rnyarmā rji abya nud pan na tā da/na maḥ sabra ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru sbu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha sidhe lo tsa ni sarba aza sā rnya ni swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rin ṇḍan mang la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs rje dang chos kyi dbyings kyi bden pa'i stobs kyis klu rnams mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis tshim zhing dgyes nas sha 'khon gnod pa thams cad zhi ste byams pa'i sems kyis chos dang ldan pa'i 'phrin las tshul bzhin du sgrub par gyur cig/bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /lhun po rol mtsho bdun dang bcas pa la//gnas bcas chu yi bdag po wa ru ṇa//dga' bo nye dga' klu chen brgyad la sogs/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i klu rigs thams cad dang / /'dzam glingagadengs can bdag po ma dros pa/ /bye brag bod 585

khams 'dir gnas klu yi tshogs/ /khyad par bdag cag gnas kyi yul phyogs 'ardo'i/ /mtsho dang chu klung chu mig lteng ka dang / /ri brag sngon shing sogs la gnas pa yi/ /rigs bzhir gtogs pa'i klu gnyan ma lus pa/ /thogs med rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis 'dir gshegs shig /dkar gsum mngar gsum bza' bca' btung ba dang //rin chen rnam mang mkho dgu'i yo byad sogs//dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin phung 'dis//klu rgyal 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur cig /khyad par bzang bo'i sman sbyor brgya phrag dang / /dri zhim bsung shing sna tshogs dud pa'i sprin/ /'chi med lam kun yongs su khyab pa 'dis/ /klu dang sa bdag gnyan po ma lus bsang /rko slog thab gzhob shing bcad chu bo dkrugs//mkhar las zhing sa mtsher mal nyes pa dang //gzhan gyi mnan gtad khram la btab pa sogs//gnod pa ci mchis bsang gis dag gyur cig /dme 'khon yugs grib dmar dang ro grib kyis//bskyed pa'i don snod yan lag pags pa'i nad//gag lhog mdzi dang phol mig deg grum sogs//klu yi nad kun bsang gis dag gyur cig/sngon chad 'khrul ba'i nongs pa ci mchis pa bsang mchod dam pa 'di yis byang gyur te//deng nas ko long phrag dog ma mdzad par//rnal 'byor yon mchod kun gyi grogs mdzod cig /mi dang phyugs kyi nad yams god kha chod//sad ser than pa 'gong bo'i gnod pa srungs//sngags nag gdugs pas rbad pa'i gtad rgya khrol/ /mdor na phyi nang nyer 'tshe 586

kun las srungs//nyes spyod lnga spong gtan gyi khrims mnos te//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing / /yi dam dkyil 'khor gnyan por dam bcas— bzhin//chos ldan 'phrin las sgrub la ma g.yel cig/mi phyugs zas nor g.yang gi mtsho bhaskyil te/ /bde skyid dga' ba'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i dbus/ /chos 'byor sbrang rtsis myos pa'i rkang drug pa/ /grags snyan glu dbyangs len pa'i bkra shis stsol//sa bdag lto 'phye chen po dang //klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas kyis/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin byin brlabs pa'i/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzos 'di bzhes la//bdag cag yon mchod 'khore bcas kyis/ /nad gdon bar chad kun zhi zhing / /tshe dpal bsod nams dbang thang dang //snyan grags longs spyod gong du 'phel//gnas 'dir bkra shis byin chags shing / /lo legs rtsi bcud rgyas pa dang / /mkho dang dbang du 'du ba sogs/ /'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /'dir ni tshogs bsags rten bzhengs phyir//'dir ni khang khyim rtsig bzo'i phyir//zhes sogs skabs thob kyis kha bsgyur tshul shes dgos/ sa rko rdo slog shing gcod la/ /ru nga phrag dog mi byed cing //phog thug nyes kun zhi bar mdzod//ces tshigs bcad kyis sul la 'phrin las bcol/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing //dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad//rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /skar ma rab rib mar me dang //sgyu ma zil ba chu bur dang //rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bur//'dus byas chos rnams de ltar blta//zhes sogs kyis chos sbyin byas la/be dkar las mjug tu gshegs gsol byed rgyu 'dra ba zhig gsungs mod/ rje shes rab rgya mtshos 587

skabs 'dir gshegs gsol byed par gsungs pa ltar phyag len la'ang sngod pas/ sarba nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha/ klu rgyal 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur//zhes pas gshegs gsol bya/de nas sa rkordo sgrog sogs lo spar kha skyon med zhig gis rdo rje dang bcas 'jor gyi yu ba lag pa g.yas stengadang /g.yon 'og tu ṅges te bzung /swa bhā was sbyangs stong ba'i ngang las khro4bo bgegs mthar byed sngon po zha4gcig phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi rdo rje mtshan pa'i tog rtse bsnams shing khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs can g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas shing klu sa bdag bgegs tshogs zil gis gnon pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur pa'i 'od kyis ye shes kyis spyan drangs dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/zhes brjod la dgug bstem bya /de nas rko me de kha shar du phyogs la bslang rung ba'i sa mig nas 'jor kham bzhi brgyab nas ske bslang ba'i sa de gtor ma'i nang du spugs/ me mtshams sogs kyi phyi rol tu cung zad gtor/de nasadabus dang phyogs bzhir 'jor kham lnga blangs la rdo shing rus pa gyo mo sogs gang yod bsal te/sa de dang rnam 'joms gzungs chu sogs/dge 'dun pa bzhi sde 'am/gi gzhan ming dang rang bzhin bzang ba dag gis ci tsam dgos pa'i sa la khyad par gtor ro//rko sa'i sa mig ni/ be dkar las/ gdengs zhal snying ka cha phran ni/ /nyer bdun dor 'og byang rgyab kyi/ /tshangs pa'i jig nas cha phran ni/ /phyed dang bcu bzhi spangs pa'i mdun/ /zhes tshangs thig nas cha phran phyed dang bcu bzhi dor mtshams su sa mig yin par bshad pa dang /sum bha'i sngags kyi spyi don las/mgo mjug mdun gyi phyogs mtha' nas//rim par cha chen gsum drug gsum//rgyab nas che drug cha chung bzhi//phyed/ dor mchan 'og gyen che gcig/zheng du cha chung byed dang lnga//thog mar sko ba'i ngos gzhi'o/ /zhes gsungs te/mgo phyogs nas cha chen gsum dor/mjug ma'i phyogs nas 588

cha chen drug dor/ masdin phyogs nas cha chen gsum dor/ rgyab phyogs nas cha chen drug dang cha chung byed dang bzhi dor mtshams mchan 'og rko mig yin la/der gyen du cha chen gcig dang zheng du cha chung phyed dang lnga bar gsungs pa dag rang re'i rang lugs su bzhed do/ /de nas sa mig de'i nang du bum gter 'bul dgos pas/bum gter bsangs sbyangs byas/stong ba'i ngang las rghaṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa'i nang rin po che dang 'bru sman bzang bos yongs su gang ba'i dgos 'dod thams cad yid bzhin du 'byung ba/ bdag cag dpon slob sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing yul lha gzhi bdag sa bdag klu gnyan yul phyogs sbyin brdeg dang bcas pa la bde legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i gter chen por gyur/zhes brjod la/sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab/oṃ ye rnyarmā he tu pra bha bā he turnye ṣānta thā ga to hya ba da ta/teṣāñtsa yo ni ro rnya e waṃ wa dri ma hā tha ma ṇaḥ swā hā/nyer gcig brjod/bdag gi bsam pa'i྾྾ 'byung gyur rig ༈de nas sa mig nang du gter 'bul ba ni/kye/ ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin rlabs pa'i/ /rin chen gter gyi bum pa 'di/ /ngo bo rgyal ba rigs lnga la/ /rnam pa rin chen 'bru sna lnga/ /byed las dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba/ /nam mkha'i mdzod dang mnyam pa 'di/ /bla ma yi dam mchog gsum dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs la 'bul/ /dpon slob sbyin bdag bcas pa la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs tshangs pa che/ /kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal bo dang / /drang srong tshogs dang 'byung ba lnga//rlung rta'i lha tshogs thams cad la//dgoṅge 'dod 589

gter gyi bum pa 'bul/ /dpon slob sbyin bdag bcas pa yi/ /srog lus dbang thang rlung rta bskyed/ /khyad par yul 'di la gnas pa'i/ /lha klu gzhi bdag thams cad la//mi zad gter chen 'di 'bul lo//dpon slob sbyin bdag bcas pa yi//tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang //mnga' thang rigs rgyud 'khor 'bangs sogs/ /legs tshogs thams cad rgyas pa dang //chos srid bzhed don ma lus pa//myur du 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol//de nas/ kye༈ phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /zhes sogs g.yang 'bod bya zhing / klu rgyal dga' bo nye dge' bo//bstan la dad pa'i lha rnams dang / /rgyal bo sbyin bdag nyid dang ni/ /sems can phongs pa gzhan dag kyang / /tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs/ /gtan du bde ba thob par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon bya/ gang la ser sna rnams chags pa/ /rnam 'jom dri ma med mdzad cing //thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des//khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur//'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams//thar ba'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ /khyed la྾ //ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten//sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir//gang zhig bde bar mnga' mdzad des//khyed la྾ //skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi/ /thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ /khyed la྾ / /gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing / /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ /o la ྾ / /gang 590

zhig chos rnams mngon sum gyur//gtsang zhing bslu ba mi mnga' ba//gsung gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des//khyed la྾ //dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa/ /phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing / /don grub chos kyang grub pa des//khyed la྾ //gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni//nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing / /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ /khyed la྾ / /byang chub snying bor gshegs pa na/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing / /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des//khyed la྾ //chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing / /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ /khyed la྾ / yid 'phrog gang gis mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad de/ /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ /khyed la྾ / /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung bo kun gyi bde legs ni/ /khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig/sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang //lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis/ /khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs gyur/ /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs gyur//khyed cag lam bgrod bde gyur cig /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyin mo'i gung yang bde legs shing //nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i//dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya/ de nas sa gtsang mas gab la mi mngon 591

par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni tshogs chen 'du khang slar bzhengs skabs/ /mthong ba don ldan khri chen gung thang sprul ba'i sku rin po che 7 rje 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas lha dar che legs bcas 'di la chog sgrigs shig gyis shig ces gsung gi me tog spyi bor babs pa la brten nas kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung gzhir bzung nas sngon gyi riyig rnying dag legs sgrig giwa grub par badzees pawa// tre 592

dkyil 'khor zhal ston bsdus pa/༄༅//rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba'i srung 'khor/de'i dbus su 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas/rdo rje gur me ri dang bcas pa'i nang du/sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gsum/ gsum ga'ang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i dbus su zla nyi sgra gcan dus me'i steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/sku mdog nag gozhal bzhi/phyag nyirtsoshu rtsa bzhi/phyag dang bo gnyis kyis sna tshogs yum ser mo la 'khyud pa/shin tu rol ba'i g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ shar gyi pad 'dab la nag mo 'bar ma nag mo/lhor me dmar mo me 'bar ma dmar mo/ nub tu ser mo 'bar ma ser mo/byang du dkar mo 'bar ma dkar mo/mer du ba ma/bden bral du smig rgyu ma/rlung du mar me ma/dbang ldan du rnam snang ma'o//bde gshegs 'phags ma'i shar du don yod grub pa/lhor rin 'byung /nub tu rnam snang /byang du 'od dpag med/ shar lhor sgrol ma/ lho nub tu gos dkar mo/ nub byang du spyan ma/byang shar du mā ma ki'o//bde gshegs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi le'u tshe rnams dang steng 'og tu bum pa gnyis gnyis/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar sgo'i g.yon du kun tu bzang bo/ g.yas su nam mkha'i snying bo/ lho sgo'i 593

g.yon du phyag na rdo rje/ g.yas su sa'i snying bo/ nub sgo'i g.yon du chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ g.yas su sgrib pa rnam sel/byang sgo'i g.yon du sgra rdo rje ma/g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyugamer reg bya rdo rje ma/bden bral du ro rdo rje ma/ rlung du dri rdo rje ma/dbang ldan du gzugs rdo rje ma'o/ /shar sgor khro bo shin tu stobs/lhor sgor khro bo rmongs byed/nub sgor khro bo rengs byed/byang sgor khro bo nga rgyal byed/'dod yon gyi snam bu'i shar gyi 'dod snam la dri chab ma dang 'dod snam ma/lho'i 'dod snam la bdug spos ma dang mar me ma/nub kyi 'dod snam la sgeg mo dang bzhad gad ma/byang gi 'dod snam la bdud rtsi ma dang 'bras bu mi zad ma/ shar gyi rta babs kyi mchod pa'i lha mo'i gnas su gar ma/lhor 'dod ma/nub tu sgra ma/byang du glu ma/gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la lha mo bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi snam bu'i padma 'dab ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi lda tshes kyi lha mo rnams gnas pa'o/ /shar sgor dbyug sngon can/ lho sgor 'dod pa'i rgyal bo/ nub sgor stobs po che/ byang sgor mi g.yo ba/ steng phyogs su gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur/ 'og phyogs su gnod mdzes rgyal bo'o/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu la 'dod ma sum cu rtsa drug gnas pa'o/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar la sogs pa'i g.yas g.yon rnams su dbye bar mi 'dod ma dang /kun tu gdong bar mi 'dod ma la sogs pa phyir 'dod ma sum cu so drug po rnams sgo bzhi'i g.yas su lnga lnga dang / g.yon du bzhi bzhi ste/ phyogs re 594

rer dgu dgu gnas pa'o/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu rta babs kyi 'og klu brgyad/sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang ldan du zla ba/bden bral du nyi ma/me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor kyi dbus su dur khrod chen po gnas pa'o//lha mo'i 'phrin bcol/ ༄༅/ /kha sbyor bdun ldan rgyal thabs la dbang ba'i/ /ston pa rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa/ /gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin la snying nas 'dud/ /byin rlabs dngos grub char chen 'jo bar mdzod/ /nyajam dpal khro bo'i zlos gar gshin rje gshed/ /snang mtha' nyi ma'i zer gyi khro bo che/ /dpal chen ha ya skṛ wa la sogs pas/ /bde stong ye shes me zhags chen po yis/ /bar chad rtswa phung gzhom pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /khyad par rgyal kun 'phrin las 'od po che/ /srin mo khros pa'i gzugs su legs shar nas/ /rgyal bstan padmo'i dga' tshal skyong mdzad ma/ /'dod khams dbang mor re ltos rab 'cha' na/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i 'phrin las kyi/ /zad pa med pa'i zer brgya rab spros te/ /chos sde 'di yi bshad sgrub rgya mtsho che/ /rgyas la gnag pa'i mi dang mi min gyi/ /bsam sbyor ba mo'i tshogs kun zhi bar mdzod/ /sde 'di'i bshad sgrub bslab gsum nyams len dang / /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum rig gnas mkhyen rgya dang / /don mthun snyan pa'i grags 595

pa la sogs pa/ /dbyar gyi dpal la 'gran pa'i 'phrin las mdzod / /dbang bo rab dul brtse ldan bshes gnyen dang / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mgrin pa'i glu snyan pa/ /mdo sngags lam gyi stag ris rab bkra ba'i/ /blo gsal bung bas sde 'di gang bar shog /bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par chos sde 'di'i/ /bshad sgrub 'phrin las 'od stong 'bar ba la/ /gegs byed lha min sgra gcan 'byung bo'i tshogs/ /mthu stobs zho 'thung rus pas gzhom par mdzod/ /phyogs ris sde gcod dug gi ljon pa dag /phyi nang gang na gnas kyang drag po yi/ /gnam lcags ral gri rnon pos lhag med du/ /gcod pa'i 'phrin las g.yel ba med par mdzod/ /mdor na 'tsho ba don gnyer sbrang nag dag /ma yin lung rtogs zil mngar dpal 'tshol ba'i/ /blo gsal bhra ma ra yi khyu tshogs rnams/ /bshad sgrub padma'i mtsho 'dir 'du bar mdzod/ /mdo sngags lung rtogs sprang rtsis lus stobs rgyas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gshog glu'i sgra dbyangs snyan/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las 'phur lding gar gyis rol/ /rgyal bstan padmo'i dga' tshal mdzes par mdzod/ /sde 'dir byin bkra shis shog ces shis brjod bya/ bswe khrab can gyi 'phrin bcol/ dku/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang gshin rje gshed/ /pad ma kar dbang rta mchog rol ba che/ /la sogs yi dam lha tshogs dbyer med pa'i/ /596

rtsa brgyud bla mas byin rlabs char chen phobs/ /rgyal kun 'phrin las dbang gi 'od dmar che/ /bstan srung srog bdag dmar bo'i skur sprul ba/ /chos skyong bswe yi khrab can zhes gsol ba'i/ /mthu ldan chos skyong chen por re 'cha' na/ /sde 'di'i bshad sgrub 'phrin las 'od po che/ /gdul bya'i bsod nams mkha' la rab 'phags te/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i gzhan phan zer brgya la/ /skye dgu yongs kyis longs su spyod par mdzod/ /—lhag bsam dag pa'i sa gzhi brtan po la/ /lung rtogs dpag bsam ljon pa'i kho lag rgyas/ /gzhan phan 'bras bu g.yur du za ba yis/ /bstan srung chen po'i thugs dam skong gyur cig /khyed la rtag tu gsol mchod rgyal rnga'i dbyangs/ /chad med phul ba'i dge 'bras la brten nas/ /'dus sde'i bshad sgrub legs tshogs dge mtshan 'bras/ /mngon du 'gyur ba'i 'phrin las g.yel med mdzod/ /bstan 'gror gnod pa'i phyi nang dbyen dkrug dang / /spyod ngan 'dam du 'dren pa'i tsher ma dag /phyi nang gang na gnas kyang mthu stobs mes/ /gzhob thul sreg pa'i 'phrin las g.yel med mdzod/ /mdor na lung rig mgrin pa'i rdza rnga snyan/ /mdo sngags gshog zung dkar bo'i 'dab ma rgyas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i lus stobs rab bajid pa'i/ /ngang mo'i tshogs kyis mtsho 'di gang bar mdzod/ /phyi nang bar chad nad 'khrug mu ge sogs/ /ming tsam lhag ma med par zhi ba dang //thub bstan badmo'i dga' tshal rab rgyas te/ /'gro kun rdzogs ldan dpal 597

la spyod gyur cig /ces dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo la 'phrin las bcol ba dang / chos skyong bswe yi khrab can la 'phrin bcol zhig dgos zhes dge ba'i bshes gnyen skal bzang bsam gtan gyis dngos skyes lha dar bcas snga phyir bskul ba'i ngor bris pa'o/ /

'dod gsol byin rlabs myur 'jug༄ / /thugs bskyed 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las 'khrungs pa'i/ /tshogs gnyis padma dkar bo'i ljon pa'i rtser/ /sku bzhi'i 'dab ma dkar bos rab mdzes pa/ /'jam dpal dkar bo'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud/ /snying khung rus pa'i gting nas gsol 'debs na/ /dpag med bskal bar rab dgongs thugs bskyed kyi/ /byin rlabs nus mthu nor bu'i gru char gyise/ /bdag gi re ba'i yol go gang bar mdzod/ /dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyis/ /thabs mkhas sgyu 'phrul rol ba las byung ba'i/ /chos 'brel dngos thob bla ma thams cad ni/ /sangs rgyas dngos su mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rnyed dka' 'jig par sla ba'i rten bzang 'di/ /don med 'du 'dzi'i dbang du mi 'gro bar/ /mngon mtho nges legs sgrub pa'i lam po che/ /rgyal bstan mjal ba don dang ldan par mdzod/ /tshe la long med ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa dang / /'khor ba spyi yi sdug bsngal gsum sogs la/ /yid 'byung drag pos rang rgyud nyer bskul te/ /bstan rtsa tshul khrims dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba dang / /bde 'gror skyes kyang snyigs ma'i smag chen gyis/ /yongs su mnar ba'i mar gyur 'gro ba la/ /tshad med snying rje skye bar byin gyis 599

rlobs/ /'jig rten rgud pa'i rtsa ba ma rig mun/ /yongs su 'joms pa'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /mtha' bral rten 'byung rtogs pa'i dbu ma'i lam/ /khong du chud par mdzod cig mkhyen pa'i gter/ /blang dor gnas rnams rang stobs kyis 'byed cing / /kun byang chos kyi cha shas phra mo yang / /ma 'dres gsal bar ji bzhin 'byed pa yi/ /ches gsal shes rab stsol cig mkhyen pa'i gter/ /ma rtogs log rtog the tshom myur gcod cing / /rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi tshig don la/ /gtugs pa med par rab tu 'jug pa yi/ /myur zab shes rab stsol cig mkhyen pa'i gter/ /kun nyon rnam byang chos kun khong chud pa'i/ /yan lag gsung rab dgongs 'grel bcas pa yi/ /tshig don ma lus mi brjed rab 'dzin pa'i/ /mi brjed gzung mchog stsol cig mkhyen pa'i gter/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la byang chub nas/ /log smra tshar gcod skal ldan rjes 'dzin sogs/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i rgya bod kyi/ /paṇa chen lta bur mdzod cig mkhyen pa'i gter/ /sde snod gsum dang dgongs 'grel mtha' dag la/ /thos dang bsam dang sgom pas rab zhugs nas/ /rang gzhan kun rmongs mun pa'i smag 'joms mkhan/ /khyed rang lta bur mdzod cig mkhyen pa'i gter/ /mdor na tshe rabs padmo'i phreng ba ru/ /'jam mgon nyi ma'i zer gyis rab bskyangs te/ /lung rtogs sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar rab rgyas nas/ /skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs rnams myur skyob shog /'jam mgon byin rlabs 'od stong 600

rab 'bar nas/ /lnga bdo'i rgud pa'i smag chen rabarkebacom ste/ /rgyal bstan padmo'i dga' tshal rab rgyas nas/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa 'di ni rnyarma'i 'dod mos bzhin sbyar ba'o/ /༄7/ /bgrang yas rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs mchog /dmar ser 'od du 'tsher ba'i lha mchog che/ /phyi nang gshin rje'i phun tshogs 'joms pa'i dbang / /'jam dpal zhi khros dge legs char chen phobs/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i rang lugs rin chen mdzod/ /gong du 'degs pa'i 'jigs med spobs pa che/ /thub bstan bshad sgrub chos kyi dpal shar ba/ /'phrin las 'od 'bar nyi mar gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs pa med pa'i thugs bskyed rgya mtsho las/ /nyer thon bstan pa'i snying bo 'od po che/ /deng 'dir gsal mdzad dbang phyug brgyad ldan/ pa/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun rang gzugs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / /'phrin las sa chen khyab mdzad khri chen mchog /yab sras zung gi 'phrin las nyi ma che/ /slar yang shar ba'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ /yab sras zung gi 'phrin las 'khor bsgyur gyi/ /gser gyi 'khor lo gling bzhi'i sa chen du/ /'gog med rgyu ba nga las nu'i 'khor lo'i/ /rjes su 'gro ba'i dge mtshan dpal 'bar shog bde ldan zhing mgon tshe mtha' yas pa dang / /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal tshe yi lha/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo rje btsun tā re ma/ /lha mchog gsum gyis byin chen char du 601
