bsnyil/ /de yi mthu las yab sras nyi zla zung / /'gog med shar ba'i dge mtshan snang ba 'bum/ /bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bar du nub med par/ /mdzad 'phrin 'od kyis sa chen khyab par mdzod/ /nyin mo'i mgon dang de yi 'od stong bzhin/ /yab sras 'brel ba'i lang tsho rab rgyas te/ /lnga bdo'i rgud pa'i phun tshogs rab bcom nas/ /bde skyid rdzogs ldan pad tshal bzhad par mdzod/ /yum chen sher phyin lab kyi sgrol ma yis/ /thugs sras stong sde ngag gi dbang phyug la/ /bka' lung gsal ba'i 'od snang rab spros bzhin/ /rgyal bstan skyed tshal yongs su dar bar mdzod/ /rgya bod mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes bu yi/ /lung rtogs ma lus gcig bsdus kun mkhyen gyi/ /thugs bskyed smon pa'i 'bras bu yongs smin te/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i dga' tshal rab rgyas shog /bkra shis dpal gyi dge mtshan 'bum phrag tu/ /g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'dus sde mtsho chen las/ /mdo sngags rig gnas pad mo 'bum bzhad de/ /skal bzang rkang drug tshogs rnams tshim par shog /ngo mtshar sna tshogs 'od kyi dpal 'barno te/ /rang bstan gser sbyangs btso ma'i rang 'od che/ /ya ra tshes zla ba'i dpal la rab 'gran pa'i/ /don ldan snyan pas sa steng khyab par shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang ma hā kā la dang / /dge sdig stangs 'dzin las gshin rnam sras sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyis/ /gang smon lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mdor na skye ba pad mo'i phreng ba 602

ru/ /bshes nyen nyin mo'i mgon gyis rjes bzung ste/ /lung rtogs sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston rab rgyas nas/ /sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs dpal la spyod gyur cig /ces skyabs gcig mthong ba don ldan kun mkhyen mchog sprul rin po che dang / khri chen mchog sprul rin po che rnam gnyis la rtse gcig tu gsol/ba 'debs shing 'dod don gsol ba'i smon tshig 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes/ ma cig grub pa'i dbang phyug gung ri mkha' 'gro ma'i yang sprul/ dam chos skal bzang sgron ma dang blo bzang chos 'dzin rnam gnyis kyis bkra shis pa'i lha reg dri med sogs dngos skyes du ma bcas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor sbyar ba'o/ /ljags byin rlabs bzhugs/ ༄༅/ /rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ rang gi lce'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ yig dkar bo/ de'i mthar dbyangs yig dkar bo g.yas bskor dang / gsal byed dmar bo g.yon bskor/ ye dhar sngon po g.yas bskor du/ bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang drang srong tshangs pa brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad sngags 'phreng de dag dang rgyal srid sna bdun dang / bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs kyi rnam par drangs te oṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par gyur/ oṃ a ā i khri u u ṛ rī '-i āo e e o au e aḥ swā hā/ oṃ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa nye ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/603

a ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ kṣa swā hā/ oṃ ye dha rmā ho tu pra bha wa he turnye ṣānta thā ga to hya ba data/ te ṣā ñtsa yo nitsho ro dha e waṃ bā rī mahā skre ma ṇaḥ swā hā/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig sogs ci 'grub bzlas mthar/ oṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas ye dhar gsal byed/ gsal byed dbyangs yigadabyangs yig oṃ yig la thim/ oṃ yig 'od du zhu nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ar gyur/ a yang 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu nas lce la thim/ lce yang 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu nas phyi lce'i rnam pa la nang rdo rje rtse lnga ba'i rnam par gyur/ zhes pa 'di ni rab rgyal srin bu'i lo sar skabs sring mo chung ba bde mchog skyidasgyul gnang ba'o/ /bsang yig ༄༅/ /rang nyid lhar gsar thugs ka'i hūṃ yig las/ /'od 'phros ma dag sbyangs shing snod bcud kun/ /dag pa rab 'byams dbus su mchod pa'i sprin/ /kun bzang mchod sprin dpal la 'gran par gyur/ /oṃ āḥ hūṃ/rtsi shing rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes pa'i/ /sa 'dzin bajid cing mtho ba'i ngos yongs su/ /phyi bltas sra mkhregs brag ri'i rnam pa la/ /nang du 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gzhal med khang / /de dbus nor sbyin lha mchog yul skyong che/ /dpa' bo yum sras 'khor bcas dgyes bzhin bzhugs/ /'chi med yul la 'gran pa'i dpal mnga' zhing / /sprul ba yang sprul sgyu ma'i 604

rtse dgas rol/ /pha mes dus nas las kyi 'brel ba'i lha/ /khyod la re ba'i yid kyis mchod tshogs kyi/ /dngos po gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i tshogs/ /nam mkha'i mdzod la 'khu ba 'di dag 'bul/ /dgyes par bzhes shing dge legs rgya mtsho'i char/ /re ba'i zhing sar rtag tu 'beb par mdzod/ /bdag cag mi phyugs skyong ba'i 'phrin las kyi/ /'od dkar snang bas yul ljongs yongs khyab mdzod/ /mdor na rgud pa'i mun tshogs lhag med du/ /bcom nas dge mtshan nyi ma gsar ba yis/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten 7yongs su khyab byas te/ /bkra shis dpal gyi 'bras bu g.yur za shog /ces pa 'di ni dge slong skal bzang thabs mkhas kyis bskul ngor 'phral du bris pa'o/ /605
dzha ri kto54swārshatshocope

bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi thugs rje chen po'i dkar chag༄༅/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /rab tu bzhad pa'i dge mtshan snang ba 'bum/ /thugs bskyed pad ma dkar bo 'dab brgya ba/ /srid mtha'i bar du bdo ba'i dpal 'bar shog /zhing 'di'i dam chos nyi ma 'od po che'i/ /'od snang phyogs brgyar spro ba'i bshes gnyen 'bum/ /byang chub bar du spyi bo'i rgyan byas te/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi snying la sim par shog /bde chen snying rje'i rang gzugs myur mdzad mgon/ /rnam mang thos sras las kyi gshin rje dang / /dmag zor rgyal mo la sogs chos srung bas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i gru char 'dzad med zhu/ /thub pa'i spyan sngar bden mthongasnathub pa'i bstan/ /srung ba'i g.yar dam zhal bzhes rgyal bo che/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las sna tshogs 'od kyis gzis/ /lnga bdo'i rgud pa'i tshang tshing bsreg gyur cig /thub pa nyi ma'i zhabs kyis ma bcags shing / /snying rje'i gter chen 'od kyi snang ba 'bum/ /yongs su khyab pas thub bstan dga' tshal la/ /skye 'gro bhra ma ra yis longs su spyod/ /dang bor thro'u'i gar gyis 'gro ba spel/ /bar du rgyal — 607

bo'i zol gyis khrims la bkod/ /tha mal dam chos snang bas khyab mdzadapa/ /lo ke shwa ra'i 'phrin las bsam mi khyab/ /dbus 'gyur lnga ldan 'phags pa'i snang brnyan bzhin/ /zhing 'dir 'phags pa'i snang brnyan byin 'bar yang / /las sprin 'thug pos re zhig sgrib gyur cing / /kun mkhyen thugs bskyed sa bon slar yang smin/ /de yang 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i sku brnyan brten dang rten par bcas pa/ bdag cag gi bsod nams kyi dpal du slar yang bzhengs grub pa ni legs tshogs rten 'brel gyi sgo brgyari phyes pa yin la/ 'dir rten gtso 'phags pa'i sku'i nang rten gyi rim pa'i tho 'god pa la/ ring bsrel rnam bzhis phyur bur gtams pa las/ dang bo chos sku'i ring bsrel ni dmigs brtse ma khri gcigam ṇi 'bum gnyis/ thugs rje chen po'i gzungs ring khri gnyis lhag kun masmo sku phreng drug gi sku bstod tshar brgya re/ 'jam dbyangs dang phyag rdor gyi gzungs stong gcig go /yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel dang / sku gdung gi ring bsrel/ sku bal gyi ring bsrel rnams ni/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung srong btsan sgam po'i phyag tsha thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi sku leb sngar gyi sku'i gzungs 'jug las blangs pa/ sngar gyi gzungs 'jug gi gtso bo phyag stong spyan stong gi sku leb mdun rgyab tu sangs rgyas kyi sku chung ngu mang po yod pa so btang ba ya mtshan pa zhig srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs yul gyi thugs rje chen po'i sku che ba bshigs pa'i 608

thugs ka nas blangs pa'i lo ke shwa ra'i blugs sku li ma mtho gang tsam/ rin chen ril bus bzhengs pa'i thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal sngar gyi sku'i gzungs 'jug las blangs pa/ rang byung lnga ldan gyi gzungs bzhugs kyi tsan dan dkar dmar/ rje'i phyag tsha phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi sku leb rgyal sras sgrol ma/ rje'i gser gdung chen mo'i gur shing / gser gdung chen mo'i gzungs 'jug nā ro ba'i rus rgyan/ rje rin po che'i dbu zhwa/kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i zhabs phyags/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i na bza'/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i na bza'/kun mkhyen sku phreng bzhi ba'i na bza'/ kun mkhyen sku phreng lnga ba'i na bza'/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma rje dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i na bza'/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs phyags/ paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi na bza'/ ta ra nā tha'i sku 'gag grub chen chos pa rin po che'i na bza'/ a mchog 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i gdu nga rus dang na bza'/ smin grol chos kyi rgyal bo'i dbu nab/ rgyal bo ju nang gi phyag phreng / gzhan yang paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi na bza'/ rgyal dbang lnga ba'i na bza'/ paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma'i na bza'/ rdo rje 'chang chen po rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i na bza' dang phyag phreng / phyag tsha sgrol dkar sku/ kun mkhyen sku phreng drug pa chen po'i sku dkris/ rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i phyag tsha thugs rje chen po/609

'jigs byed/ 'jam dbyangs/ paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag tsha sgrol ma thub/ sku sogs/ rdo rje gdan gyi thub pa byang chub chen po'i na bza'/ lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i na bza'/ 'bras spungs 'jigs byed rang byon gyi na bza'/ byang chub shing gi lo ma mang bo/ tsan dan rkang gcig gi shing /bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen gzhung gi rten 'dus/ sde ba gzhung gi rten sna yongs rdzogs kyi 'dam/ rten 'dus 'dzam gling spyi nor/ rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i phyag nas 'ongs pa'i ma ṇi ril bu dang / bdud rtsi chos sman/ phyag tsha thugs rje chen po/ 'jigs byed/ 'jam dbyangs/gzhan dzam dkar dang / mgon po'i sku leb stong lnga sogs bzhugs/ de yang rang cag rnams kyi lha skal snying rje'i lha mchog 'di nyid kyi rten bzhengs mchod bstod phyag skor sogs kyi phan yon ni/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ 'dren pa'i gzugs sku rab tu mdzes byas na/ /de ni mchog gyur skyes bu mang mchod 'os/ /blo ldan phyug cing tshe nyid rgya cher ldan/ /dpal ldan 'khor mos bsgyur ba'i rgyal bor 'gyur/ /zhes thogs gnas skabs kyi phan yon dang / gtso bor gyur pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal bo las/de bzhin gser dag dang ni dngul dag dang / /tsan dan gyis ni sku gzugs bzang bo dag /mdzes shing shin tu lta na sdug par bgyis/ /ring bor mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog 'di 'thob/ /'jim pa dang ni de bzhin rdo ba dang / /shing dang ri mor bris pa'i sku gzugs dag /shin tu mdzes 610

shing lta na sdug par bgyis/ /ring bor mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog 'di 'thob/ /ces myur du yang dag pa'i lam bzang mngon du 'gyur bar gsungs pa sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab cing / tha na mtshan tsam thos pa la'ang phan yon mtha' glas pa'i tshul/ chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i mad las/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ming tsam la rtogs pa gang lags pa de'ang bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur na/ yi ger 'bri ba dang / gos dang rgyan gyi mchod pa chen po dag gis mchod pa bgyid pa dang / yi ger 'brir rtsol ba lta ci smos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' dag sel zhing / mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus pa lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ rten mchog dbang gi rgyal bo brten rten pa/ /yongs rdzogs grub pa'i dge mtshan 'bum gyi 'od/ /rab tu bzhad pa'i rten 'byung bsam las 'das/ /deng dus skye bo'i bsod nams e ma rmad/ /slar yang bzhengs pa'i bsod nams 'od po ches/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' tshal slar bzhad nas/ /mdo sngags 'dab zung g.yo ba'i rkang drug tshogs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dbyangs kyis brel bar shog /rten bzhengs 'brel thogs lus can mtha' dag gi /gnas skabs rgud pa'i smag rim nyer zhi nas/ /sa lam ljon pa'i kho lag rab rgyas te/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu g.yur du za bar shog /mdor na bstan rtsa bla ma'i zhabs brtan cing / /bstan gzhi dge 'dun thugs 611

mthun khrims gtsang zhing / /bstan pa'i sbyin bodig gegs med mthu stobs rgyas/ /bstan pa ring du gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni dgon gnyer lhan khang gi gtso 'dzin sprul ba'i sku 'jigs med bstan pa rgya mtsho dang / rten bzhengs las kyi sne mo grags pa rgya mtsho gnyis kyis bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas sogs dngos skyes bcas 'di lta bla zhig 'bri dgos zhes bskul ba ltar bris pa'o//cho thar mdo'i 'khor chen gyi dkar chag༄༅/ /skyabs gnas kunarī 'dus bla ma rta bdun dbang / /gdul bya'i bsod nams mkha' la nyer 'phags te/ /'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib rnams bsal nas/ /bde skyid pad mo'i dga' tshal rgyas par mdzad/ /de la 'dir 'phags pa thar ba chen po 'khor lo 'di'i dkar chag 'bri ba la/spyir 'khor lo'i khungs ni/ rgyud sde rnams su snying kha'i sngags 'khor bskor tshul gsungs pa dang / las bzhi sgrub byed dang / srung 'khor 'bri tshul sogs bshad pa rnams nang gi bsgom don gyi 'gros dang bstun pa yin la/de bzhin du rlung 'khor me 'khor chu 'khor lag 'khor 'di lta bu rnams kyang nang gi bsgom don gyi 'gros dang bstun nas bzhengs pa yin pas/khungs dang ldan la/ de bzhin du ma ṇi ril sgrub kyang gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ oṃ ni ri lu tsa na ka'i/ /'bru tshad tsam du bsam nas ni/ /zhes nang skye12

gi sgom don gyi 'gros dang bstun ta gsungs pa yin pas/ man ngag yang dag pa'o/ /kun gzigs lnga ba chen po'i rnarme thar du ku la'i gos bzang du/bka' 'gyur gyi glegs bam rnams brtsigs nas/ ma ṇi'i chos 'khor ltar bskor yang de la 'khor lugs kyi tha snyad med pas/ phan yon rang ni dka' ba 'dra zhes gsungs kyang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i zhal nas bskor ba'i tha snyad ji bzhin dka' yang dran pa dang / reg pa dang /mig gis mthong ba dang / rlung gis phog pas dgos pa chen po 'byung gsungs nas bka' 'gyur gyi 'khor lo chen po 'jog pa gnang ba ltar/deng sang glegs bam brtsigs nas 'khor lo byed pa phyag len la yod do//7 'khor lo bskor tshe dmigs rim ni/ de'i nang du yod pa'i mdo dang gzungs sngags rnams gser btso ma'i mdog ltar las 'od zer spros /te sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu mchod pa phul/ de dag gi byin rlabs bsdus te 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim zhing / slar yang de las 'od zer 'phros nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus la phog pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad byang ste rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ yang phyogs bcur 'phros te snod bcud thams cad kyi ma dag pa sbyangs nas dag pa'i rten dang brten par gyur/ thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu mdo dang gzungs rnams 'ur 'ur gsung zhing thugs de bzhin nyid kyi ngang du gyur par bsam pa 'khyer so gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang / yig 'bru rnams 613

las rang sgra bsgrags te gdul bya rnams smin grol la bkod pa'i dmigs pa byas na/ chos 'khor bskor ba 'i rten 'brel du'ang 'gyur bar gsungs/phan yon ni 'khor lo'i nang du yod pa'i gzungs sngags rnams bklag pa la phan yon ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad 'byung la/ bye brag tu/mdo sde thar ba chen po 'di'i phan yon ni/ mdo de las/ rigs kyi bu gang la las theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bzung ste/ 'bru gcig gam/ tshig gcig gam/ tshigs bcad gcig 'chang ngam klog na/ bsod nams 'di lta bu dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste gang gis mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa/ /sdug bsngal kun dang yongs 'bral lo/ /nam du'ang ngan 'gror mi ltung ste/ —/bde ba'i gnas su phyin par 'gyur/ /gang gis mdo sde 'di thos pa/ /phyi ma ma 'ongs dus ngan tshe/ /mtha' ru sangs rgyas 'grub par yang / /ngas ni lung du bstan par bya/ /gang gis rgyal la rtag gzhol ba/ /rgyal ba'ang rtag tu de la gzhol/ /gang gis rgyal ba'i chos bsrungs na/ /rgyal ba'ang de la bsrung bar 'gyur/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po thob pa dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar nus/ /'khor ba'i rgyud las bsgral ba dang / /bdud kyi dpung bcas 'jil yang nus/ /rgyal ba 'od mi 'gyur de las/ ngas ni mdo sde 'di thos nas/ /bzode par gnas te lung bstan pa/ /shākya thub ces bya bar grub/ /nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og na/ /gang zhig mdo sde 'di 'chang ba/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar/ /ngas kyang 614

lung du bstan par bya/ /gang gis ma 'ongs dus kyi tshe/ /mdo sde 'di yi don shes te/ /blun po rnams la rab bshad pa/ /dkon mchog gsurme gyi rigs mi 'chad/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mi bzhugs kyang / /mdo 'di 'jig rten gang gnas par/ /gnas pa'i mchod gnas de dag tu/ /sangs rgyas mngon sum bzhugs pa bzhin/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal nga mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la las dad pa skad cig ma'i sems bskyed de mdo 'di yi ger 'bri ba'am klog pa'am kha ton du skad cig mar dran te/ bsam pa'i 'du shes dang dran pa'i 'du shes dang / rtogs paṅge 'du shes su dad pa'i sems grub na/ skad cig mar bskal ba bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu bcu'i gang gā'i bye ma snyed kyi 'khor ba'i sdig sgrib phyir bsnyil bar 'gyur ro/ /ma rig pa'i sgrib pa yang gtan bral bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa yod la/ thams cad 'bri bas mi longs/ ༈ nang rten gyi dkar chag ni/ skyabs 'gro tshar brgyad stong chig brgya/ dmigs brtse ma tshar chig 'bum chig khri drug stong bdun brgya bco brgyad/ mchod pa'i sprin gzungs tshar gsum/ 'gyur sngags ci mang / 'phags pa thar ba chen po'i mdo tshar stong dang brgya so lnga/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan sngags ci mang / 'phags pa phung bo gsum pa'i mdo tshar lnga brgya dang so lnga/ spyi bshags tshar lnga brgya dang so lnga/ lus kyi las ni ma sogs tshar lnga brgya dang 615

so lnga/ skyabs mgon sku phreng lnga'i gsol 'debs/ 'phags pa bzang bo spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal bo/ 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal bo/byams pa'i sku gzugs ma/ spyod 'jug bsngo ba'i le'u/ thog mtha' ma/bde ba can gyi smon lam/ gsang 'dus smon lam/ lam rim smon lam/sngags rim smon lam/ lam rim chen mo/ sngags rim chen mo/ shambha la'i smon lam dpal ldan dang bo ma/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma/ smon lam them skas ma/ bde mchog gi cho ga yongs rdzogs/ mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga tshar gsum/ shākya thub pa'i mtshan sngags tshar brgya/ 'od dpag med kyi mtshan sngags tshar 'bum gcig dang stong bdun lnga brgya brgyad cu/ rta mgrin bsnyen pa 'bum gsum stong bdun lnga brgya brgyad cu/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi sngags/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi sngags/ phyag rdor 'khor chen dang / drag po sum dril gyi bsnyen pa/ seng gdong ma'i bsnyen pa tshar stong lnga dang brgyad brgya dgu bcu/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan sngags/ rten 'brel snying bo tshar brgya dang bco brgyad/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs/ sman bla'i gzungs/ bde gshegs bdun gyi gzungs/ yig brgya ring ba sa ya drug 'bum nyis khri nyis stong gcig dang bzhi brgya nyer gnyis/ thung ba dung phyur lhag kun rig rtsa sngags/ mu ni rnyarma tshar lnga brgya dang so lnga/ 'jam dbyangs dkar ser gyi bsnyen pa/ dbyangs gsal/ 'gyur sngags/ thugs rje chen po'i 616

gzungs ring / ma ṇi tshar dung phyur lhag dmigs brtse ma tshar stong dang bdun brgya brgyad cu/ gdugs mdo tshar gnyis/ sher snying / sgrol ma/bstod pa bcas/ tshe gzungs ring thung gnyis sum stong drug brgya lnga bcu/ rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs ring sa ya gcig chig 'bum bzhi stong nyis brgya don gnyis/ gzungs thung chig khri nyis stong / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod tshar gnyis/ gtsug tor dri med/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ dri med 'od zer/ tshul khrims rnam dag rnams kyi sngags/ nyi gzhon 'char ka ma/ lo gyon ma/ khyung khra/ seng ge sgra/ mgon po/ chos rgyal/lha mo/ rnam sras de rnams kyi sngags/ nyi khri/ brgyad stong ba/ sdud pa rnams kyi sngags/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i bsnyen pa dgu stong nyis brgya/dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i bsnyen pa nyis stong / de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying bo/ 'jam dpal gyi gzungs/ sher phyin yi ge gcig ma/ yon sbyong ba'i gzungs/ rin chen me 'od kyi mtshan dang gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa zla 'od kyi mtshan/ tshul khrims 'chal ba'i sdig pa 'dag patshi gzungs/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo klog pa dang mnyam pa'i gzungs/khro ba zhi ba'i sngags/ byang chub lam sgron tshar gnyis/ rgyan 'jug gnyis/bdud tshar gcod pa'i sngags/ khong khros dge rtsa mi 'joms pa'i sngags/smon lam 'grub pa'i sngags/ rje'i bsam lhun/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi bsnyen pa chig 'bum chig khri chig stong chig bgye re brgyad/ phyag rdor 617

bsnyen pa bzhi stong dang re ba'i// phyag rdor 'byeng 'dul gyi bsnyen pa nyis stong nyis brgya so brgyad/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i bsnyen pa brgyad stong drug brgya nga gnyis/ sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal bo'i gzungs nyis brgya so brgyad/ rigs gsum mgon po'i gzungs nyis brgya zhe gnyis/ tshe lha rnam gsum gyi gzungs brgya go drug nor rgyun ma'i gzungs nyis brgya zhe gnyis/mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs sum stong / sgrol ljang tā re chig khri brgyad stong /phur bsnyen brgyad khri bdun stong drug brgya nyi shu/ 'od zer can ma'i gzungs chig brgya so bzhi/ dus 'khor rtsa sngags lnga khri bdun stong drug brgya go gcig mchog gsum bkra shis/ bkra shis bka' rgya ma/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud sogs mdo rgyud gzungs sngags du ma'i 'khor chen byur bur gtams so//'khor chen bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang gi lha ris kyi rim pa rnams ni gyan thang dang bor sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i gtsos gyan thang gcig gyan thang gnyis par rje yab sras rnams kyis gtsos sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ mkhan slob chos gsum/ chos skyong rnams bcas/ gyan thang gsum par 'od dpag med kyi zhing lnga ldan/'jam pa'i dbyangs/ rdo rje sems dpa' bcas/ gyan thang bzhi bar/ tshe lha rnam gsum gtsos sgrol ma nyer gcig dzam bha la bcas/ gyan thang lnga bar dus 'khor/ rdo rje shugs/ rang gi bla ma rnams dang / shambha la'i rgyal 618

bo rnams/ gyan thang drug par/ thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba/ thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso/ thugs rje chen po don yon zhags pha/ thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ thugs rje chen po mig 'byed/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ yon bdag gi 'dra sku bcas/gyan thang bdun par/ shambha la'i zhing bkod/ gyan thang brgyad par srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga ba/ mchod rten cha brgyad/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten/ tshangs pa brgya byin/ rgyal chen bzhi bcas bzhengs/ 'khor shubs kyi thog la/ rnam bcu dbang ldan drug rigs gsum mgon po'i gzungs/ ma ṇi/ rje yab sras gsum gyi mtshan sngags/ a khu rin po che'i mtshan sngags/ jo bo rje'i mtshan sngags/ tshe lha rnam gsum gyi gzungs/thugs rje chen po'i gzungs ring / tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs/ yig brgya bcas lañtsar bris/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rdzas brgyad/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs bris yod/ de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo brten dang rten par bcas pa 'di ni dgon 'di'i las sna thon zin/ 'don rta dbyangs bcas thig sogs kyi dge rgan dge slong sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bstan 'gro spyi'i don du dmigs te rgyu dngos dang tshegs brtson 'grus sogs la ma 'dzem par legs par bzhengs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag dpal mnyam med ri bo dge lugs pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnaris skabs tsho 619

kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' dag gi 'gro ba thams cad gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig rab dkar sa bon grung bo la brten nas/ /'bras bu dpal gyi go 'dab rab rgyas te/ /'gro kun phongs pa'i sdug bsngal rab bsal nas/ /'gro kun bde ba'i dpal la spyod gyur cig /'di yi rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag gtsor byas pa'i/ /'brel ba che phra gang thogs 'gro ba rnams/ /gnas skabs bde dge longs spyod rab 'phel te/ /mthar thug sku bzhi'i rgyal sa zin par shog /mdor na 'gro kun sdug bsngal rgyu bcas pa/ /rab tu bsal te bsod nams ye shes kyis/ /tshogs la brten nas 'gro kun 'dren pa'i mchog /zung 'jug go 'phang myur du thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni 'di'i sbyin bdag dge slong sangs rgyam gyis gos chen kha lnga dang / srid du ring ba'i lha rdzas bcas/ snga phyir yang yang bskul ba'i ngor sbyar ba'o//༄༅/ /rigs gsum mi yi zlos gar tsong kha ba/ /sras kyi thu bo snga tshar bzhi'i ya gyal/ /mkhan chen ngag dbang grags dang dbyer med pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma spyi bo'i rgyan du 'dzin/ /rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs spyan ras gzigs/ /ma rung 'dul phyir khros pa'i gar mdzad pa/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon dang dpal lha mo/ /gnod sbyin 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho bcas la bstod/ /mkhas grub khyung bo rje dang blo bzang grags/ /mkhas grub dge legs dpal bas bka' bsgos bzhin/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang yang dgos 620

dge ldan pa'i/ /bstan pa'i snying bo skyong zhing spel bar mdzad/ /mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pa'i rjos sde 'di/ /phyag 'debs mdzad de chos skyong 'di la gtad/ /sde dgon sbyin bdag bcas pa'i nad gdon dang / / bar chad sel ba'i byung ba bgrang las 'das/ /dus 'gyur snga phyi'i mtshams sogs skabs skabs su/ /'phrin las glog zhags dmar bo'i stobs rtsal gyis/ /ma rung cham la phab pa dngos su bstan/ /gling sprul paṇa chen dgyes pa'i blo gros kyis/ /bstan 'gro spyi la dgongs nas gtsug lag khang / /nang du ka med phyi ru rtsig med pa'i/ /chos skyong dngos bzhugs bajid 'bar khang chen bskrun/ /'on kyang spyi mthun las kyi rlung nag dang / /mi bsrun brlang spyod drag po'i 'phrul 'khor gyis/ /bcom pa'i srin mo'i 'jigs gzugs ma bzod nas/ /klu spangs sprul sku'i 'phrin las 'od dkar spros/ /sbyin bdag sde dang bcas pas dngos 'bul bstabs/ /shing bzo bsod nams can gyis lag rtsal 'phrul/ /dad ldan las stsol las byed mi sna bcas/ /bsdoms pas mgon po'i khang chen slar yang bskrun/ /'di ltar bskrun pa'i las la 'brel thogs dang / /lus kyis phyag skor mchod pas bsnyen bkur dang / /ngag gis bstod sgrub yid kyis dad byed pa'i/ /skye dgu mtha' dag tshe rabs phreng ba ru/ /dal ba'i rten thob sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal/ /bshes gnyen nyin mo'i mgon gyis dgyes bskyangs te/ /sa lam rtogs pa'i zil ma rab rgyas nas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 621

'chang gi dpal thob shog /mdor na myur mdzad mgon sogs bla ma lha'i/ /byin rlabs snying la zhugs pa'i dga' ston las/ /gnas skabs nad mug 'khrug rtsod kha smras sogs/ /zhi nas chos dang bde skyid 'dzoms par shog /rgyal bstan yongs 'du dpag bsam ljon pa che/ /yang dar phyi dar kho lagatsho rab rgyas te/ /dgos 'dod dbang gis rgyal bo'i char phab nas/ /'gro kun bde skyid dpal gyis 'tsho bar shog /ces pa 'di ni klu spangs sprul ba'i sku skal bzang dam chos rab rgyas kyis bskul ba ltar sbyar ba'o// 622

dkar chag ratna'i phreng ba/༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ sgrib bral lha na skyes rgyu ma'i rol gar las/ /gsang gsum mi zad ye shes 'od 'bar bas/ /sgrib gnyis tshang tshing lhag med sreg mdzad pa/ /bde ba mchog gi dpal gyis dus kun skyongs/ /nyi zla'i 'gros bcoms mi shigs na da'i gdangs/ /mkha' khyab sgrogs pa'i lhan skyes bde ba ches/ /'khor 'das chos nyid yongs su bsdus pa las /skye 'gro bde chen mchog la sbyor bar mdzad/ /phyi nang gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /gsang gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams nyer bsdus te/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib bar chad kun/ /gzhom la bskal ba'i me dpung lta bur bsngags/ /de lta'i lha chen yab yum snang brnyan mchog /rab dwangs bsam pas legs par bzhengs pa 'di'i/ /nang rten khyad 'phags gzhal med nor bu yi/ /dkar chag ratna'i phreng ba bstar bar bya/ /de ltar byin rlabs 'od stong 'bar ba yi/ /snang brnyan bzhengs pa'i sa bon 'o ma'i mtsho/ /rang gzhan dus gsum dge tshogs rgya mtsho cher/ /yongs su 'dres nas dge mtshan rlangs pa 'bum/ /skye dgu'i bsod nams mkha' la rab 'phyur te/ /byin rlabs char chen g.yo ba'i dpal 'bar nas/ /gnas skabs rgud pa'i than chen yongs btsal nas/ /mthar thug bde chen dpal 623
ratna'i phrengasgo'i smin drusu pa dza yaskyo

rdo ma ṇi'i dkar chag༄༅ོ/ /rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs spyan ras gzigs/ /gang 'dul gdul bya'i snang ngor sku dang gsung / /cir yang 'char ba'i 'phrin las dpag med kyis/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa lhag med gzhom par mdzad/ /rdo ma ṇi zhes grags pa'i gnas 'dir ma ṇi rang byon dang yig 'bru rang byon mang bo yod/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas mchog shar dung ri'i ri rgyud la yod pa'i gser mtsho dang / gzi tsha sde dgu'i phug mtsho dang / rdo ma ni gsum ni gnas grags can yin/ bod kyi btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus dang / thang rgyal rabs kyi dus/ slob dpon bee ro tsa na yul dbus nas rgyal mo tsha ba rong du phebs nas bzhugs/ de'i rjes dmu dger phebs nas bzhugs/ de'i rjes dung ri'i phyogs kyi rdo ma ṇi'i gnas 'dir phebs te gnas sgo thog mar phyes par grags/ de'i rjes hor(yon)rgyal rabs kyi dus su sa skya'i bla ma rga a gnyan dam pa yang gnas 'dir phebs te phyogs 'dir yun ring bzhugs/ chin gong ma chan lung gi dus kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo yang phebs/ de'i rjes ras pa dam tshig rdo rje yang gnas 'dir phebs te gnas yig kyang mdzad par grags/ de'i rjes 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng bzhi ba rje bskal bzang thub bstan 625

dbang phyug kyang gnas 'dir phebs/ gzhan yang gsar rnyibye gi bla ma mang bo zhig phebs pa'i lo rgyus 'dug zer/ de dag gi snga gzhug tu bon gyi bla ma grub thob 'ga' zhig kyang phebs nas bzhugs par grags/ de ltar ban bon gsar rnying gi bla ma mang bo gnas 'dir phebs nas gnas mjal dang byin rlabs mdzad phar brten yul 'di dang phyogs kyi rgya bod kyi dad ldan mang bo'i dad pa lhag par 'phel te/ mjal phyag skor gsum byed mkhan mang du byung zhing snyan grags rgyas stabs/ chin rgyal rabs kyi mjug tu rgya bod kyi dad ldan rnams kyis lha khang bzhengs mod/ lcags phag lo'i gsar brje'i lo shas kyi rjes su dus 'khrug gi dbang gis lha khang 'jig kyang mi ring bar slar yang bzhengs/ dmar dmag rgyang bskyod kyi dus su yang zing 'khrug gi dbang gis lha khang yang 'jig na'ang mi risnge bar dad ldan mang tshogs kyis slar yang bzhengs mod/ lo bcu'i god chag chen po byung ba'i skabs su lhag med bcom/ da lta srid jus gsar ba'i 'od stong rab tu 'bar ba'i 'og dad ldan mang tshogs kyis bskyar gso'i re ba chen po byed bzhin yod do/ /zhes pa 'di ni snga 'gyur rig pa 'dzin pa gso rig pa lhun grub kyis lha dar bcas nan gyis baspul ngor1985lo'i zla9tshes22snga dro'i dus tshoḍi9 thog bris pa dza yaskyo// 626

rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun dkon mchog bsam 'grub dpal bzang bo'i sku bstod cha tsam brjod pa rgyud mang rang gdangs/༄༅/ /ches darkun lung dang rtogs pa'i rgyal bstan mardog /lhag byāsam stobs kyis legs bzung rang gzhan gyi/ /legs tshogs lhun gyis 'asīb mdzad khyed nyid ni/ /byang chub bar du gtsug gi rgyan du bsten / /khyed nyid bskal ba dpag med sngon rol nas/ /zab dang rgya che'i them skas la 'dzegs te/ /zung 'jug 'chi med dpal la dbang 'byor yang / /gdul bya'i don du paṇa chen rnam pa bzung / /sde 'dir kun mkhyen bstan pa'i bang mdzod kyi/ /legs bshad 'bras bzang thang mal brdal don du/ /gsum ldan ngur smig 'dzin pa'i tshul bzung nas/ /ris med 'dus pa'i skal ldan tshogs rnams bskyangs/ /mthun snang du yang skye ba du mar yang / /goms pa'i bag chags 'thug po rab sad de/ /gzhon nu nyid nas thos bsam sgom pa'i grwar/ /zhugs 'dod padma'i mtsho la lag ldan bzhin/ /bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'o ma'i mtshor/ /legs bshad mgrin rnga rdung ba'i grwar zhugs te/ /legs bshad 'dom la gzhal ba'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /627

mkhas dgu'i yid kyi brtan pa dbang med phrogs/ /legs bshad smra la 'gran pa'i zla bral ba/ /khu bo grags pa mtha' yas sogs bsten nas/ /dbu tshad phar phyin sogs la legs sbyangs pas/ /snyan pa'i grags pa g.yu 'brug skad lta 'gran/ /dbyangs can brda sprod daṇa hā'i me long sogs/ /thun mong rig gnas kun la blo gros kyi / /'jug pa sna tshogs 'od la 'gran gyur pas/ /paṇa chen a nu bhū ti'i mched zlar gyur/ /ltar snang thos bsam sgom pa'i mchid bu la/ /non bur zhen pa'i 'chad nyan ma yin par/ /gang thos rgyud la sbyor ba'i nyams len gyis/ /rang rgyud bslab gsum nor bu'i mdzod du gyur/ /phyogs 'dus slob ma dag la bka' pod lnga'i/ /mtshon pa'i legs bshad skyes bzang rab spel bas/ /lung rigs dpa' rtsal —'dzom zhing nyams len la/ /gzhol ba'i slob dang yang slob grangs las 'das/ /rdo rje 'chang chen a bha'i mtshan can dang / /mu ti'i zhabs sogs bshes gnyen du ma las/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi rab blangs pas/ /thugs rgyud mdo sngags bdud rtsis mere gyis gtams/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi cho ga thugs 'dzin dang / /phyag len dngos gtsang sogs la legs par sbyangs/ /bskyed rdzogs khrid yig sogs dang man ngag bzhin/ /mdo sngags nyams len kun la rtse gcig gzhol/ /thugs rgyud rin chen gser gyi bum pa bzang / /lung rtogs dam chos bdud rtsis gtamos pa na/ /skyabs mchog kun gzigs ye shes nyi ma ches/ /bka' lung gser gyi me tog rab 628

'thor te/ /khyod la rdo rje 'dzin pa'i khri 'phang la/ /dbang ba'i slob dpon go gnas sbyin no zhes/ /srung skud gser mdog lha reg dri med bcas/ /bstsal nas bstan pa'i bdag por mngal gsol to/ /de nas bzung ste dbang dang rjes gnang dang / /rgyal ba'i chos bka' 'gyur ro cog la sogs/ /lung khrid man ngag bdud rtsi'i char phabs te/ /skal ldan mang po smin grol lam la bkod/ /skyabs mgon kun mkhyen sku phreng drug pa yis/ /sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis legs gzigs nas/ /yongs 'dzin gtsug gi rgyan du legs bzhes te/ /yang dag dam chos bdud rtsi'i bgo skal bzhes/ /spyan gyi nyi zla sprin gyis bsgribs pa'i tshe/ /spyan res gzigs kyi rnal 'byor nyams bzhes pas/ /gzhi bsnyen dkyil tsam slebs skabs spyan gsal zhing / /rgyang grags tshun gyi sgra rnams gsal bar thos/ /chos kun bden pa'i stong bar gzigs pa dang / /bdag pas gzhan gces sgom pa'i byang chub sems/ / thugs la 'gran bzhin yod pa'i 'bras rtags su/ /dam chos 'chad dang dpe gzigs gsung 'phros dang / /skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar gsung gleng dang / /g.yul 'khrug mu ge sogs kyis yul khams dang / /sems can mnar tshul gsan tshe 'dren byed las/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun thigs thar thar 'bab bar mthong / /spyi mthun las kyi mi sim 'bras mthong tshe/ /nga ni tshe srog 'di dang bral gyur kyang / /dkon mchog bden pa'i chos dang las 'bras la/ /yid ches skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral 629

gsungs/ /mi bsrun brlang spyod char sprin 'thibs pa'i tshe/ /bka' gdams mes po dag gi rnam thar bzhin/ /ngo srung rdzun 'gebs gdong g.yogs dang bral bas/ /mi bzod ya nga drag po'i ra bar tshud/ /'on kyang thugs la dga' bde rab 'phel te/ /thog med nas bzung lus srog grangs med dor/ /'on kyang bstan 'gro'i don la btang ba med/ /bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag chos sde 'di'i/ /bla slob chos sde'i chos srid don gyi phyir/ /lus srog gtong rgyu byung na yid rab spro/ /zhes sogs sems dpa' chen po'i mdzad spyod la/ /skye bo phal bas yi rang tsam yang dka'/ /sku srog 'dor dgos thos tshe 'tsher med par/ /ma zad rgyal sras snying snyobs chen po dang / /bo rnyi sa twa pad ma'i ngang tshul dang / /ma ti sa ra'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes/ /de rjes rmi lam du yang bdag nyid la/ /blang dor bya byed lung du ston par mdzad/ /de ltar khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho las/ /zegs ma tsam zhig dad pa'i rten du blangs/ /de ltar brjod pa'i rab dkar dge ba 'dis/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod gtsug bsten nas/ /zhal gdams bcud chen btung bas lung rtogs kyi/ /lus stobs rgyas te sku bzhi'i sa thob shog /ces rdo rje 'ardang chen po yongs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun dkon mchog bsam 'grub dpal bzang bo'i sku bstod cha tsam brjod pa rgyud mang rang gdangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gang gi zhal slob kyi tha shal des dad pas mtshams sbyar te smras pa'o/ / 630

myur 'byon smon tshig༄༅/ /bskal bsang rnam 'dren bzhi ba'i bstan pa la/ /bshad sgrub chos kyi 'od snang 'bum 'gyed cing / /gdul bya tstsha marto 'dren pa'i dpal gyur pa/ /mchog sprul 'gro ba'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /sa lam bgrod pa'i rtogs pa mthar phyin nas/ /zag med chos sku'i dbyings su rtag bzhugs kyang / /'gro ba'i snang ngor gang 'tsham sprul ba yi/ /bkod pa sna tshogs so skyes bsam yul las/ /'das pa'i mdzad pa su yis dpag par nus/ /zhing 'di'i gdul bya mtsho skyes gnyen gcig pu/ /'gro ba'i rgud mun sel ba'i nyi ma che/ /'dus byas mtshan nyid 'gro la ston pa'i phyir/ /gzugs sku dbyings su nub pa'i mdzad pa bstan/ /re ba'i mig 'bur gtod pa'i skye bo'i tshogs/ /mya ngan mun pa'i khung bur zhugs gyur te/ /gdung ba'i smre sngags g.yu 'brug skad la 'gran/ /'dren byed khung nas nyal 'gro'i rgyun kyang 'bab/ /de'i phyir sngon gyi thugs bskyed rab dgongs te/ /re ltos 'cha' ba'i skye bo mi 'dor bar/ /slar yang bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyi ma che/ /yang sprul gzhon nu'i mdzes zhal ston par shog /rigs rus gtsang ma'i 'o ma'i mtsho chen du/ /yang sprul padma gzhon nu'i 'dab bzhad de/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam pa'i dri bsung gis/ /skal ldan bung ba'i tshogs rnams 'gug par shog /rab gtsang 'dul khrims 631

dag pa'i rgyun bskyangs te/ /thos bsam sgom pas rgyal bstan spel ba la/ /'jam mgon bla ma blo bzang grags pa yi/ /mdzad pa smon lam mtha' dag nyams bzhes mdzod/ /bka' gdams gtsang ma'i rnam thar mdzad spyod dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi 'od stong rab 'bar bas/ /snyigs dus rgud mun ma lus rab bsal nas/ /bde skyid pad mo'i dga' tshal rgyas —par mdzod/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang myur mdzad mgon po dang / /'jam dbyangs bka' sdod gshin rje rgyal bo dang / /rnam mang thos sras dmag zor rgyal mo sogs/ /bstan srung rgya mtshos 'phrin las g.yel med mdzod/ /mdor na mchog gsum bden pa'i byin mthu dang / /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /bdag cag dad 'dun dam tshig gtsang ma'i mthus/ /smon pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni7sgo mang sprul ba'i sku rin po che bskal bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho'i gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul mdzad skabs/ sku bdag 'jam dbyangs blo 'phel gyis dngul lo bcu dang bkra shis pa'i lha reg bcas thag ring nas bskul ba'i ngor7sug bris su bgyis pa'o//༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ 'dir bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi mjug tu gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs pa ni 'di ltar/ dus gsum bde gshegs sku gsum 'phrin las bcas/ /lnga bdo'i gdul bya pad mo'i dpal du shar/ /byin rlabs sbrang rtsi'i khur gyis gtams mdzad pa/ /bshes gnyen nyin mo'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde gsang 'jigs dang rigs gsum mgon po dang / /tshe yi lha mchog gsum dang sgrol ma sogs/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog kun 'dus ngo 632

bo nyid/ /bshes gnyen kun 'dus nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /theg gsum 'pharges pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog lam dang / /lung chos sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /dam chos kun 'dus 'phags nor za ma tog /bshes gnyen gdams pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang myur mdzad mgon po dang / /las kyi gshin rje rgyal chen rnam sras sogs/ /chos ldan srung ba'i srung ma kun 'dus pa'i/ /bshes gnyen 'phrin las gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdor na sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /chos skyong kun 'dus bla ma rin po che/ /rtse gcig mos pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di'i 'khri ba chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro kun pha mar shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas lugs zab mo mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rim gnyis rtogs pas rang rgyud phyug par mdzod//rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i dal 'byor rin po che/ /thob pa don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /gang byas chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos la bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab ste lam gyi gegs thams cad sbyangs tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rgyas par bsam mo/ /zhes pa 'di ni rnga stod dge ldan bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling gi dka' rams 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon dge slong dge 'dun rgya mtshos bskul ngor/ dge ldan snyan brgyud kyi man ngag bzhin du sbyar ba 'dis kyang bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po chedar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /633

rjes 'dzin smon tshig dbyar skyes rnga gsang /༄༅ོ/ /bskal bzang rnam 'dren shākya'i bstan pa la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i dpyal la dbang 'asgor te/ /gtun bde'i lam bzung mdo sngags ñtsha marto cher/ /'gro kun 'dren pa'i byed por gsol ba 'debs/ /deng nas tshe rabs pad mo'i phreng ba ru/ /bshes gnyen nyin mo'i mgon gyis rjes bzung nas/ /gdams ngag zer brgya 'bar bas legs bskyangs te/ /lung rtogs zil mngar 'bum gyi dpal thob shog /dad gus gsol 'debs dbyar skyes rnga gsang gis/ /thugs rje chu 'dzin phung bo rab bskul bas/ /byin rlabs sbrang char dus su swāb pa las/ /shes rgyud zhing sa rab tu rlan par mdzod/ /gnas skabs 'dir yang rnam dkar las kyi gegs/ /nad gdon la sogs thugs rje'i gru char gyis/ /lhag med gzhil nas mthun rkyen dpal 'bar te/ /rnam par dkar ba'i 'dab brgya bzhad par shog /mdor na dad 'dun zhing sa gshin po dang / /thugs rje char rgyun drod gsher 'dzom pa yi/ /'gyur med rgyu rkyen rten 'brel chos nyid las/ /gang smon 'bras bu g.yur du za bar shog /ces rjes 'dzin smon tshig dbyar skyes rnga gsang zhes pa 'di ni/ dad ldan byams pa rgyal mtshan gyis dngos skyes bzang bo dang lha rdzas dri med bcas bskul ma nan che ba'i ngor sbyar ba'o/ / 634

bslab bya khag gsum/ snaci ༄7/ /bla ma mkhyen/ bla ma mkhyen/ bla ma rin po che mkhyen/ rīm rig smag chen gyi klong na 'khor ba'i/ /'gro ba 'di dag la thugs rjes gzigs shig /mkha' dbyings mthon po ru nyi zla gsal bzhin/ /dpang gyur skyes mchog rnams dbyings su bzhugs mod/ /las kyi smag chen 'di rab tu 'thug pas/ /de dag mthong ba'i skal ba ni mi 'dug /log smra 'byung bya yis sa 'di khyab nas/ /don med 'khun sgra yis rna ba 'tsher ro/ /ngan rtog dbyug btsog gis thub bstan dkrugs nas/ /dri med rig pa yi 'o mtsho bsnyogs so/ /rnyed grags khe 'dod kyi 'ching bur re nas/ /kha 'chal dug rlangs kyis 'gro mig bslad do/ /log ston dbyug brda yi rjes su 'brangs te/ /sprel chung klad med dag gar la rol to/ /kye hud gtan bde yi srog rtsa bcad pa/ /dgra chen bcom pa yi ngo so byed do/ /pha ma bzang bo yi gces nor dor ba/ /don chen 'grub pa yi rgyal rnga rdung ngo / /don ldan pi lbang gi snyan sgra bsgrags pa/ /rna ba lhab lhab kyi rna bar bsgrags 'dra/ /slob ma brgya phrag la bgo skal byin kyang / /lus stobs rgyas pa ni nyin skar 'dra'o/ /'di phyi'i skyabs bcol re byed khul 'dug mod/ /bsam dkar bslab ston re rna rgyab ser bu/ /thos med thos yod kyi skya ser kun gyis/ /tshe 'di'i snang shes de mchog tu 'dzin no/ /bla ma mkhyen/ bla ma mkhyen/ bla 635

ma rin po che mkhyen/ dri med mkhyen brtse yi nam mkha'i klong nas/ /byin rlabs char chen de lhug par bstsal te/ /rtsod dus snyigs ma 'di'i tsha gdung bsal nas/ /dge ba'i lo 'bras shig 'khrungs par mdzod cig /rab rgyal me stag1986lo'i zla4ba'i tshes5la 'og 'gyu g.yo ba'i gtam thol byung du smras so//༄༅/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig bsten na legs tshogs mtha' dag ni/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal mnga' mchog gsum la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas byang chub bar/ /'bral med spyi bo'i gtsug tu brten par shog /mchog gsum spyi gzugs bshes gnyen dam pa la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa lam gyi ni/ /rtsa ba yin par shes nas bsten tshul la/ /rtse gcig nyams len snying bor shes bar bya/ /zhi dul bag yod thub pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /khas blangs tshul khrims mig gi 'bras bu ltar/ /bsrung ba ya rabs spyod pa'i dang bo yin/ /bslab bya phra zhib blta ba shin tu gces/ /ma rabs spyod pa'i nad rims la 'dzems shing / /ya rabs dam pa'i spyod pa dang du len/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i ngag nas legs thon pa'i/ /dam chos bdud rtsi 'thung bas lus stobs gso/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i pad tshal rgyas pa na/ /nyams len snying bo bdud rtsi len par bya/ /rig pa nyi ma'i 'od kyi zer brgya yis/ /rnam dpyod pad mo'i tshal rab rgyas par ga /gtan tshigs rigs pa rnon po'i mtshon cha yis/ /ma rtogs log rtog dgra bo gzhom par bya/ /'phags bod gzhung bzang 'dzin 636

ma la brten nas/ /byams dang snying rjes dga' tshal rgyas par bya/ /klu sgrub lugs bzang zla ba'i man ngag la/ /legs par sbyangs te khong du chud byas nas/ /legs par brgyan pa dbu ma'i gzhung lugs ni/ /bdag lta'i rtse mo yongs su gzhom par bya/ /sde bdun dgongs don mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis/ /bkral ba yid bzhin khong du chud byas nas/ /phung bo khams dang skye mched rab dbye sogs/ /shes bya'i rnams grangs dag la'ang sbyangs par bya/ /thub pas nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /'di ni khyed kyi ston pa zhes gsungs pas/ /'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dgongs don yang dag pa/ /yon shāka rnam gnyis gzhung bzhin sbyangs par bya/ /de yi lag len 'jam mgon yab sras kyi/ /gsungs pa ji bzhin legs par sbyangs byas nas/ /phra zhing zhib par lag tu len par bya/ /de ltar byas pas sangs rgyas bstan pa bzung / /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan pa rin chen ni/ /gnas dang mi gnas de la rag las gsungasakyi/de ltar sde snod gsum la sbyangs pa yis /dal 'byor don ldan bya rnams skal ba bzang / /log smra tshar gcod skal ldan rjes 'dzin gyi/ /thun mong rig gnas rnams kyang gal che bas/ /sngon med dpa' bo lag rdum mi byed par/ /rig gnas kun la rnam dpyod bkra bar mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni dasbyod ldan dge lhu 'ardzom dbyangs rgya mtshos nan tan gyis bskul ngor bris pa'o//༄༅/ /ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyis bskor/ /sgra dag skad 637

snyan saṃskṛ ta dang mtshungs/ /mi skad chos la sbyar du btub pa'i sa/ /yangs shing mtha' legs yon tan kun ldan pa/ /de ltar kha ba can gyi yul dbus su/ /skyes pa'i dal 'byor mi lus thob pa kun/ /yon tan slob la brtson pa ma zhan zhig /ces pa'ang rje 'dis thol byung du smras pa'o// ༄7/ /ka ma la dang zla ba'i gdan steng 5 bzhugs pa'i/ /kha ba'i mdangs ltar dkar ba'i rje btsun rdur 'dud do/ /ga bur chu rgyun lta bu'i byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsis/ /nga yis shes rgyud gyong bo rlan pa zhig mdzod cig /ca ril bzhin du kha gum lag gum gi ngang nas/ /cha lugs mchor bos mig lam mdzes thabs rke byas te/ /ja si ji sis 'gro thabs 'dug thabs dīs mi phan/ /nya mo zas la sred 'dra'i don gnyer kshi blo yis/ /ta thā ga ta'i gzhung la hur brtson zhig byas te/ /tha mal ngan spyod 'dor ba'i bya ba sa zhugs na/ /da lta'i 'khrul snang zag bcas kshi phung bo/ /na rga'i gcong rong 'di las thar ba nd+rang nges can/ /pa sangs lta bu'i lhag bsam dkar bo rdu'i ngang nas/ /pha mthar phyin pa'i slob gnyer yang dag ༷ga byas na/ /ba spu g.yo ba'i nges 'byung rnam dag sdog los skyes/ /ma lus 'gro ba sgrol ba'i sems bskyed kshi ngang nas/ /tsa ri lta bu'i dben gnas nyams dga' nd+ra song ste/ /tsha grang khyad du bsad nas sgom sgrub sa 'bad na/ /dza ya'i go 'phang rang gi lag mthil na yod do/ /wa sogs ngan song ngan 'gro'i skye gnas kshi 'gro ba/ /zha gum la sogs gcong nad sdug bsngal sgyis 638

mnar bar/ /za ma'i sbyin sogs pha rol phyin drug gi spyod pas/ /'a 'ur g.yeng ba'i 'gro ba 'di dag gi shes rgyud/ /ya mtshan rtarma'i bdud rtsi'i rlan gsher dung 'phrad kyang / /ra ltar gyong ba 'dul ba'i bskal ba zhig trebyung na/ /la lung bas mtha' gang du gnas kyang rhang 'dra'o/ /sha khrag gdos bcas zag bcas nyer len ṣṭa lus 'di/ /sa lam rten gyi sgrom bu bzang bo sa bsgyur na/ /ha sa badzra rab tu dgyes pa gi 'dzum zhal/ /a ho mthong ba'i bskalab bzang bo de los ldan/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ / mkhas rgu'i gtsug gi nor bu/ mdo sngagasatswagrub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son nas/ zab rgyas gdams pa'i gter mdzod du gyur pa/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i srog 'dzin pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smros na7bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bos ni/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma shar tsokhu kha ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo /de ltar gsung rab mtha' dag gi dgongs pa mthar thug ni/ gdul rgya sems can thams cad 'khor ba phra rags kyi rgya mtsho las sgrol ched yin par dgongs shing / gzhan dag 'khor ba phra rags los sgrol ba la sa lam gyi rim pa bgrod dgos/ de'i rtsa ba bshes gnyen dam pa tshul bzhin du —bsten dgos pa yin la/ sngar thos pa'i gzhung lugs dag bshes gnyen 639

bsten pa'i gdams ngag tu shar nas/ bshes gnyen dam pa bsam sbyor gnyis kyis sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten pas/ byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsi thugs la sim ste/ gang thos pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag tshe 'di'i snang shes 'khor ba'i zhen pa'i rang nyid gces 'dzin/ bdag 'dzin gnyis rnams gcod pa'i gdams ngag tu shar nas/ mtho mtho rlung la bskur/dma' dma' chu la bskur te/ ri dwags rmas ma bzhin du gnas dben par bsnyegs so/ /'dis mtshon rnam dkar nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /byang chen rgya mtsho dang 'dres te/ /dge mtshan chu 'dzin yongs 'phyur bas/ /rgud pa'i tsha gdung rab sel nas/ /phan bde'i sprang char rab g.yo zhing / /sa lam rtogs pa'i lo 'bras kun/ /g.yur du za ba'i dpal thob ste/ /sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs zin gyur cig /ces pa'ang thol byung du smras pa'o//༄༅ོ//srid zhi'i rgud pa kun sel rin chen nor/ /mchog gsum rin chen dbang gi rgyal bo che/ /sgo gsum rab tu gus pas rtag bsten na/ /byin rlabs zad med gter gyi dngos grub stsol/ /bcom ldan rigs ral/ lo rgyus nges shes 'dren pa'i shing rta/ rig gnas dar tshul legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ bcom ldan rigs ral gyis mdzad pa'i sgra'i bstan bcos smra ba rgyan gyi me tog ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa/ bcom ldan rigs ral ni yul phu thung ba/ phyis snar thang du phebs/ gsung rtsom pod bcu drug slob ma'i gtso bo dbus pa blo gsal byang chub ye shes dang / btsun pa 'jam 640

nyag pa sogs/ bstan rtsis lhag bsam rab dkar las gsungs/ sgra'i bstan bcos de las/ tun hong gyi yi ge sum rtags/ de'i sngon yi ge yod med/ rgyal rong dang / the bo sogs kyi skad/ shar ba'i skad/ chu chags dang /spre'u las/ lde'u jo sras kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo las/ chos 'byung chen mo bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ /rgyal bo mi yi lha zhes pa/ /litstsha sgyi rnams rigs su 'byung / /zhes chos rgyal srong btsan bstan/ thang dang 'thab tshul/bhan rnya hor gyi rgyal bo ni/ sog po gzhung drug ge sar dmag gi rgyal bo ni/o rod tsho drug skad gsar bcad sgra sbyor bam gnyis/ mdo khams kyi mdo stod dang / rmi li/ yun nan gyi/ la shes rigs dang / pe tsos zer/thang la bab tshul/ mtsho sngon/ bka' ma log the bo/ tsha kho/ dmu dge shar ba/ zung chu/ bod dmag 'kho spo/ skong po/ do spo/ dwags po/ kun dka' la/mdzod dge bzhag sdom/ co ne/ 'jing yon sad na legs la/ khri lde btsan po'ang zer/ khri dar ma 'u dum btsan la gsang chos rgyal bo las rgyal bo bkur/ bsgrags pa bon lugs lha las/ lha yab bla brdal drug sog po gzhung drug thon bka' chems pa mi chung / gser gyi shing rta las/sgra sbyor bam gnyis su ral ba can la khri lde srong btsan zer ba ni/ khri gtsug lde btsan zhes pa'i yi ge nyams pa yin la/ zhes so/ /dkar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang / 'on cang rdo/ 'u shang rdo/ byang chub sems dpa' 641

sa dang bo bas/ skad cig ma gcig la/ sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal mthong nus pa/ sangs rgyas brgyas byin gyis brlabasaze pa shes pa/ ting nge 'dzin brgya la snyoms par 'jug nus pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya g.yo bar byed nus pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgyar snang bar byed nus pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgyar 'gro nus pa/ 'gro ba brgya smin par byed nus pa/ bskal ba brgya'i sngon gyi mtha' la 'jug nus pa/ bskal ba brgya'i phyi ma'i mtha' la 'jug nus pa/ chos kyi sgo mi 'dra ba brgya ston nus pa/ rang gi lus brgya sprul nus pa/lus re re la 'khor brgyas bskor bar byed nus pa'o/ sa dang bo bas/sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal mthong ba/ sangs rgyas brgyas byin gyis brlabs pa shes pa/ ting nge 'dzine brgya la snyoms par 'jug nus pa/ 'dzig rten gyi khams brgya g.yo bar byed nus pa/ snang bar byed nus pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgyar 'gro nus pa/ 'gro ba brgya smin par byed nus pa/ bskal ba brgya'i sngon gyi mdza' dang phyi ma'i mtha' la 'jug pa/chos kyi sgo brgya ston nus pa/lus brgya sprul nus pa/lus re re la 'khor brgya brgyas bskor bar byed nus pa/ sa2la/ stong dang / 3 'bum/ 4bye ba brgya/ 5 bye ba stong /6 bye ba stong brgya/ 7 bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong / 8 stod gsum 'bum dang / 9 stong gsum 'bum grangs med sum brgya dang / 10 mtha' yas pa dang /rigs ni spyod pas ston par byed/ /'khor ba'i skyon rnams mthong 642

yang skyo ba cung zad med/ /sangs rgyas yon tan thos kyang dad pa cung zad med/ /khrel med ngo tsha med cing snying rje cung zad med/ /sdig pa bsags par spyod la 'gyod pa cung zad med/ /med drug 'dzom la sangs rgyas skal ba med/ /ces 'phags pa thogs med kyis gsungs so/ —/zhes pa'ang khong gis thol byung du smras pa yi ger bkod pa'o//rig gnas la bstod pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs/༄༅/ /thub dbang gangs ri las 'ongs bdud rtsi yis//dug lnga'i dri ma 'khrud pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /gnas lnga'i 'od stong spro ba'i nyin mo'i mgon/ /rnyarma tsakra'i gdan la rtag bzhugs gsol/ /gang de'i zhal rlangs chu shel dbeng bo las/ /rab spros bcu phrag rig pa'i zer brgya yi/ /kun phan dpal la bsngags pa'i sgra dbyangs shig /dbyu gus bskul ba'i rnga bzhin 'di na ldir/ /ke la sha yis bskor ba'i ljongs chen 'dir/ /ma rig smag gis yongs su khyab pa'i dus//bsod nams stobs kyis phyug pa'i skyes bu 'ga'/ /ljongs 'di'i skye dgu'i bsod nams dpal du shar/ /de lta'i skyes bu nyi ma'i shing rta yis//zong chen 'bum gyis mi khug sna tshogs 'od/ /bsil ldan skye dgu'i dpal du drangs pa na/ /rig gnas pad mo'i dga' tshal kun nas bzhad//de tshe thub bstan mtsho chen yar zla bzhin//chos rgyal srid kyi lhun po rngam zhing bajid/ /'khor 'bangs gser ri'i 'phreng ba'i 643

rang 'od 'tsher/ /rig gnas chu skyes 'dab ṅge 'bum phrag bzhad/ /nang don rig pa bdud rtsi sman mchog gis//'gro ba'i shes nyon sgrib pa'i nad rgya bsal//theg gsum lha dbang gdan la dbang bsgyur ba'i//pu lo ma dgra gnyis pas sa chen khyab/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i dpag bsam 'bras bu la/ /longs su spyod pa'i skabs gsum bu bu mos//bde chen mchog la rol ba'i glu len zhing / /stong ba'i dbyings la rol ba'i bro chen brdung / /thun mong thun min grub pa'i nor chen la//dbang 'byor khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin bzhin/ /gdams pa rin chen mdzod kyi sgo phyes te/ /skal ldan mu to dag ni tshim par byas//de ltar mkhas shing grub pa'i skye bo yi//lung rtogs rin chen dbang rgyal ches lci bas//kun bzod mdzes mas ma bzod 'khun pa'i sgra/ /g.yu 'brug gad rgyangs zol gyis mkha' la rgyu/ /gangs ljongs mkhas grub mdzod du gyur pa na/ /'phags yul zhes bya'i skad po che ba'i sa//sdil gyis mnan pas kho bo khengs pa'i glu//dgun gyi 'brug skad bzhin du rim gyis yal/ /de ltar kun shes byed pa'i rig pa mchog /nang don rig pa zhes bya'i sgra bo che//sa chen 'di ru rgyu bas bod ljongs 'di'i//don ldan snyan grags 'dzam gling yongs la khyab/ /log smra tshar gcod tshad ma rig pa yi/ /rno ngar zer brgya 'bar ba'i mthu stobs kyis/ /smra ngan 'byung bo'i bya rnams long gyur nas//lta ngan mun pa'i khung bur baspu la zha//log smra tshar gcod brda sprod sgra rig gis//tshig la 'khrul ba'i go skabs gtan 644

bcom ste/ /yang dag smra ba'i don ldan rtsom rig gi /glegs bam nor bus sa chen yongs su bkang / /skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i bzo rig gis/ /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gardzi sogs//ngo mtshar gzigs mo 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /sna tshogs dngos pos dmangs kyi re ba bskangs/ /yang dag gso rig rin chen ral gri yis/ /nad rims bgegs kyi sked pa dum bur bcad/ /dus min 'chi ba'i srin po skya rengs ma/ /mi mngon dbyings su nub pa'i cho 'phrul tsam//'phags yul da:'i rig pa'i gsang bar las/ /legs thon tshig rgyan rig mchog nor gyi dpya/ /gangs can mkhas dbang bye ba'i phyag son pas/ /dri za'i dbyangs kyi khengs pa'i me tog zum//dngos po gcig la brda skad sna tshogs kyis//brjod pas bcad lhug rtsom gyi gzi mdangs rgyas//dpyod ldan dga' ba'i skyes kyi mchog gyur pa/ /mngon par brjod pa'i rig pa nyi zla bzhin/ /tshig gi lci yang ngal gso'i gom 'gros kyis/ /gar stabs bsgyur ba'i sgeg mo'i mchor sgeg gis/ /shes ldan yid kyi brtan pa dbang med 'phrog /mkhas pa'i mdun sar skyes kyi mchog tu gyur//sor mo'i 'phrul gyi ri mos 'od snang gis//rgyu skar 'gros dang dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba sogs//ma 'ongs sngon mthong gser gyi ā dar sha/ /skar rtsis rig pa gangs ljongs rgyan du che//'gyur khugs glu dang phyag zhabs stangs stabs de/ /skye dgu'i snying la bran pa'i bdud rtsi bzhin/ /skye 'gro'i skyo ba'i mun pa gtan 'joms pa'i/ /zlos gar rig pa 645

'di yang rgyan du che/ /de ltar bcu phrag rig pa'i nor gyi dpya/ /rmugs 'dzin dbang bo'i mdzod las drangs pa bzhin/ /'jam dpal thugs kyi dkyil nas blangs pa bzhin/ /dbyangs can ngag gi mtsho las drangs pa bzhin//de lta'i bod kyi bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas//nyi mas gling bzhi bgrod pa'i ngang tshul ltar//deng dus 'dzam gling sa chen kun tu yang //dar zhing rgyas pa'i snyan pa dbyar rnga'i zla/ /de ltar snyan pa'i rgyud mang gis/ /gangs can rig pa rin chen dbang / /bsgrags pas 'gog stoms pa dag kyang / /mnyam par bzhag pa'i gnas las bslangs//mi tshe rtog ge la 'khyer ba'i//rgan po'i mgo skyes dung 'od 'tsher/ /lus kyi 'khri shing 'khyog na yang / /rig pa'i bcud la ngoms med spyod//gna' bo'i rig pa yid bzhin nor//gna' dus ma zad deng dus kyang //gna' bzhin 'gro ba'i dpyid du gyur//gna' bzhin ngal bas bsten par rigs/ /skyes stobs shes rab mi che yang / /yang dag 'bad pa'i 'bras bu yang //yang dag rig par 'bad na yang //yang bskyar sbyang 'dod so na gnas//snyan par smra ba'i ro 'dzin la//me tog lhan skyes dri bzhin 'khyil/ /sgyu lus rin chen pho brang du/ /rang sems byis pa rtse dgas g.yeng / /rnam par dpyod pa'i tshul la ma rmongs dge sbyong chen po'i rjes 'jug rtog ge'i tshul la rab dga' ba/ /bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros zhes bya'i gnas lnga ba yis 'di smras pas/ /rab dkar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho mkha' la 646

tsho'aphyur ba'i rlabs kyis nag po'i dri ma kun bkrus te/ /skye dgu yongs kyis sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs mchog la longs su spyod pa'i skal ba ldan gyur cig /rab dkar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che las rab 'khrungs snyan pa'i ngag /snyan tshig zla ba gzhon nur mi snyan ra ri mnga' na'ang / gzur gnas dpyod ldan mkhas pas gzur gnas blo yis rab dpyad de/ /ma dag 'khrul ba'i dri ma ma lus legs par bsal mdzod kye/ /mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul mi rigs dge rgan slob grwa nas/dpyod ldan bod kyi gso rig 'dzin grwa'i slob ma mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal zhes pas/ 'phrin yig gi lam nas nan tan chen pos bskul ma byung 'phral tshegs la ma 'dzem par/ yid kyi khye'us sor bcu'i 'dab mas bskul nas ri mo 'khya 'khyog 'di phab bo// 647

shugs 'byung ngag gi rol mo /༄༅/ /thugs bskyed kun gsal ma yi lto ba las//legs 'khrungs sa bcu'i yongs 'du ljon pa'i rtser/ /rab bzung chos sku'i rtsi sman chen po yis//skye rgu'i nad rims 'joms pa'i dpal la bsngags//nges pa lnga ldan sna tshogs 'od can las/ /spros pa'i mchog dang skye ba bzo bo'i skus/ /gang 'tsham mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul 'bum phrag gis/ /mngon par mtho dang nges legs dpal la bkod//de yi bye brag beeḍū'i 'od snang gis//log par ltung ba'i smag chen gtan 'joms shing / /gnas skabs zug rngu'i gdung ba sna tshogs kyang / /nyi zer 'bum gyis ba mo bcom dang mtshungs/ /deng dus skye rgu'i bsod nams mthu nyid las/ /de yi thabs tshul chu skyes 'bum gyi zhal//rab tu mthong ba'i skal ba 'di nyid la/ /longs su spyod pa 'di nyid ches rmad byung / /de nyid shes pa'i skye bo'i dge mtshan 'od/ /la brten tshul ldan dag gis bzang spyod la/ /gzur gnas ko ki la yi dbyangs snyan dang //mi mngon dbyings nas dgyes pa'i 'ja' 'od 'char/ /nyi ma'i 'od la brten pa'i 'dam skyes dang / /zla ba'i 'od la brten pa'i ku mud bzhin/ /slob ma'i legs tshogs rgyas pa'i gzhi rtsa che/ /bshes gnyen nyin mor byed de shes pa gces/ /bzang spyod tshul ldan nor gyis phyug pa la/ /yon tan nor gyi 'bras bu phyur gyis thog /dud chang la rol tshul min 648

phyogs zhugs la/ 4/yon tan nor gyis dgra bo bzhin du lta/ /de lta'i tshul dang tshul min shes byas nas/)ngan rtog rlung gis rnam par mi g.yo zhing / /shes brtson lus rtsal rab tu rgyas byas te/ /ma bgos nor mchog rang gis thob thabs mdzod//nor mchog thob pa'i nyi 'od 'bum phrag gis//yangs pa'i sa chen yongs su khyab gyur te/ /skye rgu'i bde skyid chu skyes me na ka'i/ /mjos zhal yongs kyis mthong ba'i smon 'dun zhu//bslab bya don gnyis lhun grub/༄7ོ//rig gzhung nor bu'i 'od kyis//bod yul mun pa sel mdzad//rgyal blon lo paṇa tshogs rnams/ /shin tu sku drin che'o/ /drin ldan a ma de yis/ /nu zho kha la bsnun nas/ /lus stobs me tog rgyas te/ /lha lus gzhon nur gyur song / /slob dpon bka' drin can gyis/ /yon tan gser chu dngul chu/ /phangs med bstsal ba'i rkyen gyis/ /rmongs pa'i dri ma sel byung / /rgyal khab bang mdzod nang nas/ /mthun rkyen dngul lor byung song / /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal nas/ /yon tan nyi ma shar song / /pha ma slob dpon rgyal khab/ /sku drin che ba gsum gyis/ /gnang ba'i bslab bya bca' khrims/ /brtsi srung gus bkur los byed/ /yon tan slob pa'i slob grogs/ /pha ma gcig las skyes pa'i/ /gcen gcung nang bzhin yin pas/ /chags sdang 'thab 'dzing ma byed//rig pa slob pār 'ongs nas/ /lag stong 649

khyim du log na/ /gzhan gyis 'phya smod byed la/ /rang nyid ngo tsha'i sdug myong / /yon tan me tog rgyas na/ /gzhan gyis bstod bsngags brjod cing / /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grupa tshe/ /kun gyis bkur ba'i gnas 'thob/ / sha dar khrag dar dus su/ /khyi rgan sgo nyalo 'dra 'o/ /nga rgyal phrag dog med na/ /kun gyi yid la 'bab 'ong / /khrel med spyod ngan can la/ /kun gyis 'char kha gtong yong / /rang tshod rang gi sa zin na/ /dus rnams kun tu dge'o//tshod med mgo rgyal gyur na//nam zhig g.yang sar lhung ngo //mdor na rgyu 'bras drang bzhag /gnyom chung tshul mthun ngos nas/ /yon tan legs par bslab na/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub yong / /mthar thug 'bras bu grub tshe/ /ston ka ku shu tsha li/ /phang phung g.yo ba ji bzhin/ /g.yur du za ba'i dpal thorbe/ / sko shis brjod tshig gi me tog ༄༅/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar dge mtshan brgya phrag gis//bkra shis sa chen yongs la bkra shis sbyin/ /bkra shis dga' bdes 'tsho ba'i mi rigs rnams/ /bkra shis dga' ston chen po 'di ru 'dus/ /zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gi me tog sil ma sngon du gtor te brjod par bya ba ni de ring gnam la nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms shing sa gzhi la mi rigs mthun sgril gyi me tog bkra ba'i dus bzang bo 'dir rang re'i las khungs 'dir 650

chab srid gros mol gyi tshogs 'du thengs brgyad pa rgyal kha'i ngang 'tshog sa thub pa 'di ni nye char tang krung dbyang gi 'thus mi'i tshogs chen thengs bcu gsum pa rgyal kha'i ngang nas 'tshogs pa'i grub 'bras bla na med pa yin no/ /chab srid gros mol u yon lhan khang 'di ni nor bu rin po che gsum gyi ya gyal mi rigs thams cad mthun sgril gcig gyur gyi ngang nas bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba la rol bzhin du thon skyed dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas par byed pa'i thabs jus 'phrul 'degs rmad du byung ba zhig yin no/ /gnam la nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms nas 'od dkar gyis phyi'i mun pa sel ba bzhin du/ /sa gzhi la dpon 'bangs thams cad 'dzoms nas shes bya rig gnas lnga dang tshan rig lag rtsal gyi blo mig 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i stobs kyis bde skyid pad mo'i 'dab ma brgya phrag stong phrag khri phrag 'bum phrag mang bo lhug lhug tu bzhad de/ de'i 'bras bu sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston la skye bo kun gyis longs su spyod par 'gyur ba'i dge mtshan chen po de deng dus mngon du gyur pa'i bkra shis bde legs kyis sa gzhi rnam par khyab yod pa 'di lags so/ /si khron zhing chen rnga ba bod rigs cha'ang rigs rang skyong khul gyi chab srid gros mol tshogs 'du thengs brgyad pa rgyal kha'i ngang 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel mtshon byed du gong 'dir bshams pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad bum gzugs ma 'di bris pa lags la/ de yang rin chen bum pa bzang bo rin chen bdud rtsis yongs su gtams pa 651

bzhin du rang re'i khul dang zhing chen rgyal khab 'di thams cad bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba bdud rtsi'i bcud lta bus 'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel lags so/ /gdugs dkar bo gser gyi yu ba can gyi 'og tu tshad pas gdung ba'i mi rnams 'tsho ba bzhin du/srid jus yang dag pa'i 'og tu mi rnams rab tu 'tsho ba mtshon pa dang /rin tshen gser gyi nya mo kha sprod kyis rin po che sna tshogs smyug pa bzhin du/ tang srid nyis 'dzoms kyi srid jus yang dag pa'i 'og nas rgyal 'bangs dpal 'byor gyi nor bu rin po che 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba mtshon pa dang / pad ma dkar bo de nyid 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyis ma gos pa bzhin du/rang cag 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir skyes kyang 'khor ba'i skyon rku jag 'phrog gsum dang / phan tshun dkrug shing byed pa sogs kyi skyon gyis ma pos pa mtshon pa dang /skye ba lnga ba'i dung dkar bo g.yas su 'khyil ba bus pas rims nad mtha' dag 'joms pa dang / dung sgra kun gyi rna bar snyan pa de bzhin du/ rang re'i snyan pa'i grags pa rab tu rgyas pa des mi mthun rgud pa'i rigs kun lhag med sel zhing snyan grags lha'i rol mo kun gyi rna bar snyan pa mtshon pa dang / rin po che dpal gyi be'u'i dra mig nas bltas pas 'dzam gling kun gsal ler mthong ba bzhisadu/ rang re'i srid jus spyi dang mi rigs kyi srid jus/chos lugs kyi srid jus/ dpal 'byor srid jus/thon skyed srid jus sogs srid jus so so nas bltas na ma 'ongs pa'i bde skyid kyi mdun 652

lam thams cad gsal ler mthong thub pa mtshon pa dang / khyung chen dang seng ge dung dang chu srin/sram dang nya la sogs pa srog chags mi mthun pa mthun par gyur pa'i mtshan ma can gyi rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan 'di ni/g.yul las rgyal ba'i dga' ston du sgrengs pa bzhin du/rang re'i chab srid dang rig gnas/ dpal 'byor sogs gang thad nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba mtshon pa dang / gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa 'di ni/ mtho ba la 'phar ba dang /dma' ba la 'bab pa dang / ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba dang / rgyal ba rnal du 'god pa bzhin du/ rang re'i lag rtsal gyis 'phrul 'khor sna tshogs bzos te/ thon skyed sna tshogs kyi thad ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba dang / rgyal ba rnal du 'god pa mtshon lags so//de'i g.yas phyogs kyi mthun pa rnam bzhi'i gzugs ris 'di'i mtshon don ni/sngon yul ka shi'i nags tshal chen po zhig gi nang du shing ne gro ta yid du 'ong ba zhig gi rtsar bya gong ma sreg cig dang / blo dang ldan pa'i ri bong zhig rtsal dang ldan pa'i spre'u zhig nyams dang ldan pa'i glang chen zhig ste bzhi 'dus/ de rnams kyis gleng mo byas te rang cag rnams las su rgan zhes phan tshun dris/bya des zer ba/ngas 'bras bujos te shing 'bras kyi nang snying 'dir dor nas shing 'di skyes pa red zer/ ri bong gis zer ba/ kho 'dir yong dus sdong bo cung tsam skyes 'dug pas lo ma zos myong zer/ spre'us zer ba/nga 'dir yong dus sdong bo che tsam skyes nas 653

'bras bu thon 'dug pas 'bras bu zos myong zer/glang bo ches zer ba nga 'dir yong dus sdong bo 'di rab tu rgyas 'dug pas 'di'i bsil grib 'og tu ngas bsil nyal byed myong zer/ de nas thams cad kyis bya rgan pa yin pa dang / de'i 'og tuskeri bong rgan pa de'i 'og tu spre'u rgan pa/ glang bo che kun las gsar ba bo red zer zhing / rgan gzhon gyi khyad par shes nas 'og mas gong mar brtsi 'dzog dang bkur ste byas te bde zhing skyid par gnas pa yin no/ /de'i tshe ri 'dabs kyi yul mi rnams kyis 'og mas gong mar mi brtsi/gzhon pas rgan par mi bkur ba dang /bu phrug gis pha mar brtsi 'jog mi byed pa sogs kyi dbang gis —mthun sgril med cing bkra mi shis pa'i skyon gyis thon skyed dang bde skyid thams cad zla ba gzas zin pa dang /me tog sad kyis khyer ba dang /lo tog ser bas bcom pa bzhin du mar mar thur thur du song / de'i skabs mi 'ga' zhig shing 'thu ba dang / shing 'bras 'thog pa dang /sman rdzos 'thu ba sogs kyi ched du nags khrod du song bas dud 'gro'i ri —dwags de dag gis phan tshun brtsi 'jog byas nas bde bar gnas pa— mthong / phyir 'ongs nas yul mi rnams la gnas tshul de dag bshad pas gcig nas gcig brgyud de kun gyis thos pas tshang ma ya mtshan skyes te rang cag gis kyang de ltar byed zer nas/ rim gyis brtsi 'jog dang mthun sgril gyi lam lugs de nyid yongs khyab tu 'phel nas 654

bde zhing skyid par gyur to/ /de bzhin du rang res kyang dpon gyis 'bangs la sha tsha ba dang /'bangs kyis dpon la brtsi 'jog byed pa/dge rgan gyis slob mar sha tsha ba dang /slob mas dge rgan la brtsi bkur zhu ba/ pha mas bu phrug la sha tsha ba dang / bu phrug gis pha ma la brtsi bkur byed pa dang / thams cad kyis 'grig lam bca' khrims sogs brtsi srung byas te bde skyid kyi ngang du gnas dgos par mtshon pa yin no//de'i g.yorne du tshe ring rnam drug gi ri mo 'di'i mtshon don mdor bsdus te bshad na/ lha tshe ring bo 'di lo grangs stong phrag khri phrag 'bum phrag sa ya du ma'i bar bzhugs pa'i drang srong chen po yin pa bzhin du/ rang re'i mi rnams kyang 'chi med tshe la dbang 'byor nas lo brgya stong khri 'bum du ma'i bar du bde zhing skyid pa'i ngang du gnas pa dang / brag tshe ring bo dang / shing tshe ring bo/chu tshe ring bo 'di rnams lo dung phyur du ma'i bar gnas pa bzhin du/ rang re'i rang byung gi sa gzhi dang / nags tshal/ri bo spang ljongs dang bcas pa la 'byung ba sa chu me rlung gang gis kyang gnod pa med par mi lo dung phyur mang bor gnas par 'gyur ba dang /ri dwags dang bya tshe ring bo 'di dag kyang mi lo dung phyur mang bor gnas pa bzhin du/ rang re'i dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad lo dung phyur mang bo'i bar du gnas par mtshon pa yin no// yang 'dir phye mar glog sgron dang ldan— pa bcu gsum bshams pa'i 655

mtshon don ni/ nas 'bru las grub pa'i sbrang dkar rtsam pa rab tu dkar ba bzhin du/ tang gi tshogs chen thengs bcu gsum pa'i srid jus rab tu dkar zhing legs pa dang / mar ni rtsi bcud sman rigs sna tshogs 'dod 'jo'i ba dang / mdzo mo dang 'bri dag gis zos te bcud thams cad 'dus pa'i 'o ma'i snying bo/ lag rtsal gyis drangs pa bzhin du/ tang gi tshogs chen thengs bcu gsum pa'i srid jus kyi mdzub ston las rigs so so'i mi dmangs la bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba bla na med pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba mtshon par byed pa yin lags so//da tshig brgya bshad kyi rtsa ba dang /phreng ba brgya yi mdo 'dzin ni mi rigs mtha' dag mthun sgril lhing 'jags kyi ngang nas bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba la rol zhing rig gnas dang thon skyed sogs gong du 'phel ba'i bya thabs sna tshogs rnam par rgyal lo/ /lha rgyal lo/ /lha rgyal lo//lha rgyal lo//dga' ba'i rol mo/༄༅/ /bho ṭa'i zlos gar nyi zer gyis/ /bdag blo dga' ba'i pad mo bzhad/ /mched grogs mi rigs gzhan dag gis/ /bsngags brjod rol mo'i mchod pa phul/ /bdag rgyal sa pe cin du yod skabs/ mtsho sngon rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi zlos gar tshogs pas mi rigs pho brang gi zlos gar khang du/ chos rgyal nor bzang gi zlos gar 'cham pa thos 'asal/ ltad 656

mo la song nas bltas pas/ 'cham stangs dang glu gos chas gang gi cha nas yid 'phrog par byed pa zhig red la/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang / rig gnas mtshon par byed pa zhig kyang red/ ltad mor lta mkhan bod rigs ma zad/ rgya rigs dang sog rigs hos rigs/ yu gur rigs sogs mi rigs mang pos zlos gar khang khengs nas yod/ tshang mas mig cer te/ha cang yid gtad nas lta ba'i rnamardzo'agyur 'aprug 'on kyang nga rang gi sems dang snang ba la ha cang legs mod/ nga rang bod la rus zhen— che bas e yin snyam ste/ 'dug grogs rgya rigs tsho la dris pas/ kho tshos/ ha cang legs po 'dug bod skad mi go yang yi ge dang / rnam 'gyur la bltas na nang don nga tshos go gin 'dug zer/ yang dge rgan chen mo 'ga' zhig gis/ 'di tsho da lta gsar bzo byas pa red dam sngon nas yod pa red/ces 'dri/ ngas kho tshor glog 'phrul gyi gzugs brnyan shar tshul sogs 'ga' zhig gsar bzo yin pa ma gtogs/ ma gzhi sngon nag yod pa red ces smras pas/ kho tshos/ spun zla mi rigs grangs nyung tsho yang sngon nas shes rig ldan pa red ang / zer/ tshur yong skabs rlangs 'khor nang du sog rigs dang yu gur rigs/ rgya rigs sogs mi mang bo zhig 'dug pa kun gyis gleng mol la/ de ring gi zlos gar 'di ha cang legs zer nas/legs tshul kha gang snga byas nas bshad de rlangs 'khor nang du 'ur di ri ri byed kyin 'dug mi 'ga' zhig gis/ mi rigs gzhan pa tshos kyang bod 657

kyi rig gnas la slob sbyong byas na yag po 'dug zer/ de'i phyi nyin rgya dang bod mi kha shas nged kyi gam du 'ongs nas/ kha sang gi zlos gar de shin tu legs/ rol mo rna bar 'jebs shing / gar bsgyur sogs mig lam du mdzes par ma zad/ nang don yang phun sum tshogs pa zhig red de/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos gsal bar mtshon zhing / mi bzang ngan bar gyi 'thab rtsod/ mi dwan gyi dbyen dkrugs ther 'don dang / mi ngan gyi dbyen 'byed la dogs zon byed dgos pa'ang mtshon yod/ zer/ lang kho tshos bod la rig gnas sgyu rtsal 'di 'dra yod pa sngar ma shes zer/ ngas bshad par/bod la'ang rig gnas sgyu rtsal med pa ma red/ 'on kyang lo bcu'i zing cha'i skabs dang / skabs gzhan dag tu/ bod la gang yod rnying bzhi dang rmongs dad kyi khongs su brtsis nas/ gtor ci thub byas pa red/ dzimi bzhi shog khag7gtor rjes su'ang 'go khrid pa kha shas kyi g.yon gyi bsam blo de sra zhing mkhregs pas/ lam sang dar spel byed dka' ba byung / da skabs tang gi srid jus yang dag nyi ma'i 'od zer gzi bajid je cher song nas/yongs la sman pa'i mthu nus bla na 'phags pa'i stabs kyis da lan mthong thub pa red/ 'dis mi rigs mthun sgril la'ang phan nus yod ces smras/kho tshos zer ba/ yag po red/ rgyun 'khyongs dang dar spel gtong rgyu gal che zer/ ngas bshad par/ de red slar gso dang / legs bcos/ dar spel/ rgyun 'khyongs byed rgyu shin tu gal che/ mes rgyal gyi rig gnas bang 658

mdzod nang gi cha shas 'di 'dra ba dag nyams rgud byung ba/ ser sna skye ba'i yul red/ ces bshad do/ /g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i ngar sgra la/ /rma bya dga' bas zlos gar bsgyur/ /phul byung sgyu rtsal gzigs mo la/ /mi mang dga' ba'i dga' sgra sgrog / bsngags pa dpyod ldan spyi nor/ ༄7/ /bdag gi shes rgyud 'dzin ma gyong bo la/ /rig pa sbrang char snyoms po 'bebs mkhas pa/ /tshad med yon tan mdzod la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /mgon de byang chub bar du spyi bor 'dzin/ /sngon byon mkhas dbang rnams kyis 'phags yul gyi/ /skad rigs bzhi yi gtso bo saṃ skṛ ta'i/ /skad las mdo rgyud bcu phrag gtsug lag ste/ /rig pa dpag med gangs can brda ru bsgyur/ /deng dus gangs can bod kyi rig pa zhes/ /nor 'dzin bu mo'i lto bar yongs grags pa/ /de lta'i rig pa'i gnas chen zhib dpyod la/ /nye bar mkho ba legs sbyar skad dang ni/ /gangs can brda skad sbyar ba'i legs bshad 'di/ /blo yi mun pa sel ba'i sgron me dang / /rig pa'i sgo chen phye ba'i lde mig phyir/ /gzur gnas dpyod ldan dag gi spyi nor yin/ /zhes pa'ang bsam gtam rgya mtshos shar mar spel/ 659

rnam 'phel rig pa'i tshigs bcad/༄༅/ /rnam par dkar ba'i mchod sbyin gyis/ /rnam mang 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel/ /rnam par grol ba'i mchod sbyin mkhan/ /rnam pa kun tu gtsug gis mchod/ /rnam thar gtsang ma'i gos bzang gis/ /rnam dkar ljongs chen g.yogs mdzad pa/ /rnam mang 'gro la dpal sbyin mkhan/ /rnam pa kun tu phyag gi yul/ /rnam mang rig pa'i char chen gyis/ /rnam dkar 'bras bu smin mdzad pa/ /rnam mang rig pa'i bang chen gyis/ /rnam par grags pa'i sa chen khyab/ /rnam par mkhyen pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /rnam par mdzes pa'i pad mo'i zhal/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i dpal yon gyis/ /rnam mang rig pa'i sbrang rtsi sbyin/ /rnam mang gzhung lugs rgya mtsho las/ /rnam par dkon pa'i yid bzhin nor/ /rnam par 'dren pa'i byed po yis/ /rnam mang 'gro ba'i rmongs pa sel/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i blo ldan pa'i/ /rnam par gzhon pa'i skyes bu dag /rnam mang rig pa'i nor ldan tshe/ /rnam par grags pa'i snyan pa 'thob/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros des/ /rnam par brtson pa'i me na kā/ /rnam rgakar khyim du rab bkug tshe/ /rnam mang rig pa'i 'byor ba 'phel/ /rnam par brtson pa'i spyod mchog gis/ /rnam mang rig pa'i gter kha 'byed/ /rnam par dkon pa'i nor 660

mchog gis/ /rnam mang 'gro ba'i dbul ba 'joms/ /rnam bkra rig dzo'i lag rtsal gyis/ /rnam pa mang bo'i longs spyod spel/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dpal rgyas pas/ /rnam par gnag pa'i dbul ba 'joms/ /rnam dkar nyi ma gzhon nu yis/ /rnam mang pad tshal rgyas par byed/ /rnam par mngar ba'i rtsi bcud kyis/ /rnam mang 'gro ba'i lus stobs rgyas/ /zhes pa 'di'ang spyi lo1991 lo'i zla6pa'i tshes7nyin bris pa'o//dbyar mtsho rgyas pa/ ༄༅/ /rig pa'i zer brgya rab spros pas/ /gangs ljongs rmongs pa'i mun bsal te/ /bde skyid pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /sngon byon mkhas dbang rnams la 'dud/ /rig pa'i pad tshal ma rgyas na/ /skye 'gro bung ba'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /bde skyid zil mngar mi thob pas/ /bde skyid rtsa ba rig gzhung yin/ /des phyir skye bo dpyod ldan dag /rig pa'i gzhung lugs rgyas phyir 'bad/ /rig pa rgyas pa'i thabs tshul la/ /nus pa yod dgu yongs su 'bul/ /deng dus skye bo blo ldan dang / /'go gtso shes rab can dag gis/ /mdo smad rig gzhung zhib 'jug gi /las khungs 'dzugs pa'i blo sgo phyes/ /'di ni dmangs kyi 'tsho ba dang / /dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i rtsa ba yin/ /rig gzhung med pa'i glen las kyis/ /'dzugs skrun byed pa gad mo'i gnas/ /de'i phyir zhib 'jug bya ba 'di/ /dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas 661

pa'i phyir/ /gong 'og kun gyi shes ldan dag /'bade pa lhur len byed par rigs/ /'dici nyid rarbe tu rgyas gyur na/ /skye bo'i blo gros padmo rgyas/ /dmangasakyi'atshoba'ibade skyidangom dpala'abyorayarango'izla bzhin/dzi / 'phel/ /'di ni〈 bod ljongs zhib 'jug 〉dusatsho deb la re ba chen po bcangs nas skun gzhi lci ba'i skabs su ched du phyag bris su mdzadapyipa lags so // 662 — rme cho

rab gsal ngag gi rol mo/༄7/ /mkhas grub lha dbang blo yi skye b.ṛ grags/ /de'i phyir mkhas 3ba chos rje zhes mtshan grags/ /dgung lo bco brgyad thog tu rje dang mjal/ /thugs kyi sras gcig zhwa ser bstan bdag gyur/ /gzhon nu nyid nas ba so chos rjer mjal/ /bsod nams phyogs kyi glang bo zhes mtshan gsol/ /bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan btsugs pas thun mong dang / /thun mong min pa'i yon tan dpag med brnyes/ /'khrungs ma thag nas ma ṇi'i gzungs sngags brjod/ /rje btsun tsong kha ba yi zhal dngos gzigs/ /rdo rje'i sku brnyes chos kyi rdo rje yis/ /jes bzung grub brnyes blo bzang don 'grub mtshan/ /mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes zhal snga las/ /sdom nod mtshan du chos kyi rgyal mtshan gsol/ /lha mo dbyangs can ma yi zhal dngos gzigs/ /mkhyen rab klong rdol bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ /paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang bo/ /paṇa chen gong ma'i yang srid nges 'drongs skyes/ /rgyal dbang lnga ba la sogs bshes gnyen bsten/ /mkhas btsun bzang ba'i rnam thar bsam las 'das/ /de yi yang sprul dpal ldan ye shes ni/ /gnas skyong rgyal bo'i gtsug gi cod pan gyur/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum bshad sgrub 'phrin las kyis/ /nor 'dzin bu mo'i lto ba 663

yongs su bkang / /de yi yang sprul bstan pa'i nyi ma'i 'od/ /'chad rtsod rtsom dang bshad sgrub lung rtogs 'bar/ /bod kyi srid bskyangs chos srid gdugs dkar bos/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal tsha gdung sel bar mdzad/ /de yi yang sprul bstan pa'i dbang phyug che'i/ /bshad sgrub 'od snang 'bum gyi rtse dga' yis/ /gangs can bstan 'gro'i pad tshal rgyas byas te/ /'gro ba dpag med thar ba'i skam sar bzhag /de yi yang sprul bstan pa'i nyi mtsho yis/ /rgya sog bod kyi sa chen zhabs kyis bcags/ /'phrin las 'od stong 'bar bas nor 'dzin khyab/ /ri bo'i gtos la 'gran pa'i byams chen bzhengs/ /de yi yang sprul sku phreng bcu ba yis/ /mdo sngags chos kyis rgyud sbyangs grub mchog brnyes/ /chos srid gser gyi 'khor lo phyag bsnams nas/ /lnga bdo'i smag rim sel ba'i 'od snang bkyes/ /de yang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'khrungs rabs ni/ 'phags yul du paṇa chen a bhya ka ra sogs paṇa grub du ma'i skye ba bzhes pa dang / bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir lo tsā ba chen po 'gos khug pa lhas btsas sogs mkhas grub du ma'i skye ba bzhes mod/ yongs grags la mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa nas 'dren par mdzad do/ /des na sku phreng dang bo 'dzam gling bstan pa'i nyi ma mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang bo ni/ rje tsong kha ba chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi sras kyi thu bo gnyis kyi ya gyal yin no/ /sku phreng gnyis pa bsod nams phyogs kyi glang bo ni/ mkhas grub rje'i skye ba 664

yin par gragasatshoshing grub la/ 'on kyang sprul sku ngos 'dzin byas te gdan sar bkod pa lta bu min no/ /sku phreng gsum pa dben sa ba blo bzang don 'grub ni/ bsod nams phyogs kyi glang bo'i skye ba yin par lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan yod par ma zad/ khong rang nyid kyis kyang mkhas grub rje'i skye ba bzhes pa dran tshul sogs gsungs/ 'on kyang 'di ba yang sprul ngos 'dzin byas nas gdan sar bkod pa minasto la/ grub pa brnyes te dben sa'i dgon pa btab pas/ dben sa ba chen po zhes grags so/ /sku phreng bzhi ba paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni tshodaben sa'i nye 'dabs su sku 'khrungs/ dben sa'i gdan sa ba mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/dben sa blo bzang don grub kyi skye ba yin zhes bdag gir gnang ste dben dgon du khrir bkod/ mdo sngags mang bo gsan sbyang mdzad/ bkra shis lhun por phebs nas gsan sbyang dang sgom sgrub mdzad pas mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur te snyan pa phyogs bcur rgyas/ rgyal dbang sku phreng bzhi ba dang lnga ba gnyis kas gtsug gi cod pan du bsten/ bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen du bzhugs/ bar skabs shig tu paṇa chen gyi khur 'edzin rgyur dgongs pa zhus kyang / bla grwa thams cad kyis da dung paṇa chen du bzhugs dgos zhes gsol ba btab pa bzhin sku tshe 'da' rag gi bar du paṇa chen gyi gdan sar bzhugs so/ / spyir bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen zhes pa/ bkra shis lhun po'i chos sde 666

'debs pa po/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi rgyal tshab tu rim bzhin bzhugs pa'i mkhas grub rnams la bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen zer/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas bzung sku phreng rnams la paṇa chen gyi mtshan gsol te/ gdan sa pa paṇa chen gzhan 'jog mi dgos par gyur to/ /go min tang gi ring la rgya mi kha shas kyis/ rgyal ba paṇa chen gnyis/rgyal tshab rje dang / mkhas grub rje gnyis kyi sprul sku red/ de rje tsong kha bas rab byung gis khyim thab mi bsten pa'i don du de ltar byas pa red ces rdzun gtam smras pa red/ bcings grol rjes su de lta bu'i dril bsgrags kyi rgya yig brtsams par ma zad/ bod yig tu'ang bsgyur nas dpar btab ste bkrams/ bod yig mi shes pa 'ga' re'ang de'i rjes su 'brangs nas smra bar byed/ de'i stabs bdag gis bod kyi rig gnas dar tshul gyi deb chung zhig brtsams pa ni/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpar du btab pa de'i nang du gsal bor bris yod kyang / rgya yig tu ma bsgyur ba dang / bod mi dag gis kyang mthong chung byas stabs go ma chod par ma zad/ snga lor paṇa chen rin po che sku 'das pa'i skabs su/ yang krung dbyang kun khyab rlung 'phrin khang nas kyang de bzhin du bsgrags/ de ni bod la lo rgyus shes mkhan med snyam ste mthong chung byed pa'i rtags red do/ /sku phreng lnga ba paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang bo ni/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sprul skur ngos 'dzin gsal bo byung ste bkra 666
