shis lhun por gdan sar bkod do//sku phreng drug pa paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes ni/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dpalal bzang bo'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin gsal bo byung ste bkra shis lhun por gdan sar bkod/ snyan grags kyis 'dzam gling la khyab bo/ /sku phreng bdun pa paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi sprul skur ngos 'dzin gsal bo byas te bkra shis lhun por gdan sar bkod/ mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom du gyur/ bod kyi rgyal bor bzhugs so/ /sku phreng brgyad pa paṇa chen bstan pa'i dbang phyug ni/ paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma'i yang sprul du lha dang bla mas lung bstan gsal bor byung ste bkra shis lhun por gdan sar bkod de chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ sku phreng dgu ba paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma ni/ paṇa chen bstan pa'i dbang phyug gi yang sprul yin par thag gcod 'khrul med byung ste/ bkra shis lhun po'i pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i chos kyi khrir bkod de/ bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen po mdzad do/ /sku phreng bcu ba khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' rje blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo ni/ paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma dpal bzang bo'i rmeng sprul 'khrul bral du lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan gsal bor byung ste/ thogaspar rje sku 'bum byams pa gling du chos kyi khrir bkod/mdo sngags bstan pa'i bdag po7bla kho rdo rje 'chang sogs bshes gnyen chos kyi spyan zhen du ma bsten nas gsan sbyang mtha' 667

chod par mdzad/ de rjes gdan sa bkra shis lhun por pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i paṇa chen gong ma'i chos khri mthon por zhabs sen mngon par bkod/ thos bsam dang 'chad spel zung rmebrel gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad/ rgyal sa pe cin pho brang du phebs nas/ chos srid zung gi gser 'khor rtsibs stong bkra ba phyag mtshan du bzhes te bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ khyad par du mi rigs bar gyi mthun sgril sra brtan dang /bde 'jags mdzad/dbus gtsang dang mdo stod mdo smad sogs su chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te/ bod dang rgya'i b.raci dogs pa ngan pa bsal nas/ phan tshun gyi goms 'dris gshis lugs la brtsi 'jog byed par gyu ra/gar phebs sar rgyal khab kyi bde 'jags dang /mi rigs kyi bde skyid la thugs khur tstsha bzhes gnang / tang dang rgyal khab kyi mi rigs srid jus dang / chos lugs srid jus yang dag pā gsal bar gsungs te/ nyams pa sor chud dang / gnas pa gong 'phel btangardzo bas/ bod rigs thams cad kyi bzhin gyi mdangs gsal bar gyur/de ltar mdzad pa rlabs che ba rnams legs par mthar phyin nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bden gsung dri ma med pa'i dgongs don— gyi chos nyid dmar rjen du ston phyir gzugs sku chos mo dbyings su bsdu rmoba'i mdzad pa bstan na'ang / yang sprul nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'dzum zhal mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba yod nges so//668

snang mtha'i zlos gar yangs pa'i gling chen 'dir/ /yongs su shar ba'i byung ba rin chen phreng / /mdor bsdus tshul gyis brjod pa'i dge 'bras las/ /'gro kun phan bde'i dpal la rol gyur cig /ces rab gsal ngag gi rol mo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ las kyi sne mo ba 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor/ rab gnas sa sbrul1990lo'i hor zla12pa'i dmar phyogs gyi dga' ba gsum par grub par bgyis pa'o//smon tshig 'bras ldan snye rīm/ ༄7ོ/ /ṇḍa chen rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa dag /mkhas btsun bakhang bo'i dpal du legs shar bas/ /grasasarmo snyan rnga sgras sa chen yongs khyab sa/ /'jam mgon rigs gsum 'dus pa'i dge legs stsol/ /ṇḍa bzung rgyal ba'i bskyan pa rin chen khur/ yongs su 'arton pa'i thugs bskyed yongs smin zhing / /ngur smrig gar gyi gdul bya'i don mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten/ /mchog gsum thugs rje chu 'dzin g.yo ba las/ /gdul bya'i mos pa rgya che'i zhing sa ru/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char chen rab phab ste/ /smon 'bras myu gu g.yur du za bar mdzod/ /nges don zag med rdo rje'i sku brnyes kyang / /rtag 'dzin 'gong bo brag ri bsnyil ba'i phyir/ /gzugs sku'i nyi ma nub rir yib tshul mdzad/ /ltos bcas mya ngan mun pa'i khung bur zhugs/ /'on kyang 'phrin 669

las yol med rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ /mchog gsum byin mtha bslu med ngo bo stonyid/ /gdul bya'i dad mos kha zhe med pa'i mthus/ /sprul ba'i zlos gar gser zhal myur mjal shog /sngon gyi thugs byubaskyed6 gzhig med rdo rje'i gshis/ /nye bar dgongs nas slar yangamo nyin mo'i mgon/ /mkhas btsun sgobazang gsum 'od stong rab 'bar bas/ /lnga bdo'i smag chen yongs su sel bar mdzod/ /rigs rus gtsang ma'i 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las/ /nyer 'khrungs sku yi yongs 'du'i ljon pa che/ /lung rtogs yal 'dab kho lag rab rgyas te/ /gzharsha phan 'bras bu g.yur du za bar mdzod/ /rgyal bstan g.yel med skyong mdzad phyag drug mgon/ /dge sdig las kyi shan 'byed gshin rje'i rgyal/ /khrims ldan tshul bzhin skyong mdzad rnam thos sras/ /la sogs srung mas 'phrin las g.yel med mdzod/ /bdag cag deng nas skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ /bshes gnyen nyin mo'i mgon gyis rjes bzung ste/ /legs gsung bdud rtsis lus stobs rab rgyas nas/ /sku gsum nor bu'i gdan la myur skyod shog /skye 'gro'i las ngan tshang tshing 'khrigs pa 'di/ /mthu stobs me chen 'bar bas rab gzhom nos/ /dge mtshan bye ba'i dga' tshal rab rgyas te/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la yongs su spyod gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni khang dmar 'dus spyi thun mong gis dge sbyong gi gos dang phyogs kyi grangs ldan dngul lo/ bkra shis pa'i lha dar srid du ring ba bcas bskul ngor bris pa'o/ /670 ci

4 mo spang ljongs dpyid rlung / ca ༄༅/ /kun khyab 'byung chen bzhi yi rgyu rkyen lgus/ /'jig rten lhun gyis grub pa'i dpalda yon dar/ /srog ldan rab tu 'tsho ba3 dga' ston la/ /skye 'gro yongs kyis longs su spyod gyur cidkug /sra zhing 'thas pa'i gzhi ngos la/ /chu yis ril 'dzin byas pa'i me/ /rlung gis smin pa'i dge mtshan rgyas/ /spang ljongs g.yu yi me long ngos/ /rig pa nor bu'i me tog bkra/ /dpal 'byor longs spyod mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /skyid pa'i glu dbyangs rna bar 'jebs/ /'byung chen gsum gyi nor 'dzin gzhir/ /rtsi shing rgyas pa'i gzhon nu de/ /rlung gi mdzes mas 'khyud pa las/ /shes rig gsar ba'i gzhon nu 'khrungs/ /gzhon nu rishā pa'i kho lag rgyas/ /thabs tshul rig pa stong phrag gis/ /bde skyid gsar ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgrongs/ /spang ljongs gsar ba'i mdzes zhal ngoms/ /zhes snyan par brjod pa 'di mdzod dge rdzong gi spang ljongs dpyid rlung gi dus deb gsar ba'i las 'dzin pa dag gis bskul ngor bris pa dza yaskyo/ / — sku bstod dngos grub bang mdzod/ ༄༄/ /bskal barbhang rnam 'dren bzhi ba'i bstan pa la/ /lhag bsam 671

gyis drangs byang chub sems bskyed de/ /gdul bya khya satsho 'dren pa'i dpal gyur pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhon nu nyid nas sngon sbyangs rig sad de/ /rnam dag bslab pas thugs rgyud legs gtams pa'i/ /bag yod brtul zhugs rab mdzes bzang spyod la/ /gzur gnas mkhas dgas bstod bsngags rol mo dkrol/ /rgyal kun spyi gzugs bshes gnyen dam pa ldi/ /zhabs rdul spyi bo'i rgyan du legs bzung bas/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs rin chen mdzod kyi sgo/ /yongs su phyes pas dga' ston bla na 'phags/ /sde snod gsum gyi rab snyan lha'i rnga bos/ /sgra dbyangs rab tu bsgrags pa'i chos grwa cher/ /zhugs nas thos pas sgro 'dogs rab bcad de/ /bsam pas blang dor gnas rnams lhang nger gzigs/ /gzhan yang bshes gnyen dam pa du ma yi/ /zhal bzang las 'ongs legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /ngoms pa med par btung ba'i thugs rgyud kyi/ /rin chen bum bzang gdams pas yongs su gtams/ /phung bo zan bsgyur dam chosazha gcod kyi/ /gdags pa chu mig brgya rtsa 'grim la sogs/ /mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i nyams len la/ /brtson pas nyams dang rtogs pa gong du 'phel/ /thugs rgyud rin chen mdzod kyi shing rta che/ /byams dang snying rje shugs drag kha lo bas/ /legs par drangs te ris med gdul bya la/ /bdud rtsi'i bgo skal 'byed mkhas khyod la 'dud/ /chos med chos rdzu seng lpags la brten nas/ /672

rloms pa'i ri dwags mgo skor mkhan dag dang / /mi mtshungs phyi gtsang nang gtsang bka' gdams pa'i/ /rnam thar lhur bzhes khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba btabs pas 'jig rten 'dir/ /nad mug 'khrug rtsod la sogs rab zhi zhing / /bstan pa rin chen nyi ma'i 'od chen pos/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten yongs su khyab gyur cig /mdor na tshe rabs kun tu khyod thugs kyi/ /lcags kyus nyer bzung dal rten rim brgyud nas/ /sa dang lam gyi them skas rim bgrod de/ /rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces sku bstod dngos grub bang mdzod ces bya ba 'di ni dge slong 'jigs med kyis nan gyis bskul ngor 'phral mar spel ba'o/ /rig grwa'i mchod yul/༄tsuo/ /yon tan dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /smra ba'i zla ba 'jam dbyangs chos rje zhes/ /sa gsum snyan pa'i ba dan rab gsal ba/ /'jam dbyangs chos rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod sngags kyi yul du gyur pa/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs lung rtogs kyi yon tan ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i smra bar zla ba 'jam dbyangs chos kyi je zhes sa gsum na mtshan snyan pa'i grags pa ba dan dkar bo de nyid rab tu gsal ba 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan pa de nyid sgo gsum gus pa chen pos mchod/673

smon lam brgya phrag du mas bskrun pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan mkhas pa'i yid rab 'phrog pa'i gsung / /legs pa'i blo gros chos kun gsal ba'i thugs/ /rab 'byams chos rje'i zhabarsā la gus phyag—'tshal/ /rgyal sras snying stobs chen pogabyang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de smon lam brgya phrag btab pa'i 'bras bu dus su smin pa'i sku mchog lham mer gsal zhing /'chad rtsode rtsom gsum gyi dpal5 phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i mkhas dbang kun gyi yid rang dbang med par 'phrog par byed pa'i legs gsung chos kyi sgra dbyangs brgyud mar sgrog pa/ rnam par dpyod pa'i legs pa'i blo gros kyi me long du ji lta ji snyed kyi chos kun ma 'dres par gsal ba'i thugs mnga' ba/ rab 'byams chos rje'i zhabs la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo pabakra shis 'khor lo'i chos sde pad ma'i mtshor/ /bsdod nasas dpal gyi byākra shis 'od snang gzis/ /ṇḍa bzung rang lugs duge legs 'dab ma 'bum/ /grol mdzad mkhas dbang gnyis la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa'i bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon zhes pa'i chos sde chen po mkhas dbang pad ma'i mtsho chen sa 'dir bsod nams 'bum phrag gi mthu dpal las grub pa'i bkra shis dge mtshan 'od snang dkar bo rab tu 'bar ba'i gzi 'od kyis/ blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rang lugs bstan 'gro yongaso la rab tu dge zhing legs pa'i pad ma'i 674

'dab ma 'bum phrag grol bar mdzad pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo rnam gnyis la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos mchod/bskal bsang rgyal ba'i nyi ma shāka thub kyi/ /bstan pa rin chen spel ba'i dasal thob kyang / /rnam dkar 'phrin las dpal 'asdor bzung sdo'i zhabs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa'i bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi ba rgyal ba'i nyi ma shākya thub pa'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid phyogs kun tu spel ba'i dpal dang mthu phul du phyin pa thob kyang / rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kyi mthu dpal phun sum tshogs pa/ sku bzhi'i go 'phang rab tu 'byor ba'i dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos mchod/ 'jigs med stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' bshes gnyen dag /bsam dang sbyor bas bsten pa'i byin mthu las/ /gtun gyi bde la gzhol ba'i dpal ldan pa/ /gdul bya tstsha mardo'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod bsngags kyi yul du gyur pa'i bla ma rin po che ni/ gzhon dus nas rab tu byung ste rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang / yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang bskarme bzang dpal 'byor bzang bo sogs bshes gnyen bcu phrag lhag bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin du bsten te mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la sbyangs pa'i byin mthu las/ rang gzhan gtan gyi bde ze la sbyor ba'i dpal mnga' 675

bas/ gdul bya rgya mtsho gang la gang 'dul gyis 'dul bar mdzad pa'i bla ma rin po che de nyid la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos mchod/ /ces pa 'di rnams chos mdzad skal bzang bstanadar gyis zhus pa bzhin 'phral du bris pa'o/ /༄7ོ/ /gang 'dul 'phrin las kyi 'od snang mkha' khyab tu spro zhing /rgud pa'i mun tshogs lhag med du gzhom pa'i chos rdo rje mi'i gar gyis rol ba tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bo paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po7rje btsun blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i zung 'jug dbang gi rgyal bo'i za ma tog mtha' dag bstan 'gro'i dpal du g.yo med bskal brgyar bzhugs nas/ mtha' med 'phrin las kyi 'od snang dkar bos yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun khyab tu gtong zhing / de'i mthu la brten nas ltos bcas skye dgu yongs kyi rgud mun lhag med du zhi nas/ bde skyid pad mo'i mdzes zhal lhug lhug rgod cing / lung rtogs zil mngar gyi bcud la lus can rkang drug tshogs ci dgar longs su spyod par 'gyur ba ྾྾྾ zhes pa 'di ni rab rgyal me stag1986lor bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du7paṇa chen rin po che'i grwa tshang la mang ja gnang skabs skyabs 'jug 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes pa bzhin bris pa'o/ / ༄༄ོ/ /rten gyi drung du mar me'i phreng ba brgya rtsa gnyis dang / dge 'dun la zhal zas 'bras chan phul bas dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang / bdag gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed mchis pa thams cad dang / phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas nam 676

mkha'i gar khyab kyi skye dgu mtha' dag gi sdug bsngal phra rags thams cad bsal nas/ gnas skabs su bde skyid nyams su myong ste/ mthar sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa rnam paṃr spong ba'i 'gog pa dam pa dang / sku gsum gyi go 'phang myur du mngon du 'gyur ba'i skyabs 'jug thugs mkhyen brtse'i rba klong nas 'dor ba med par mkhyen zhu ba dang / 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'gro ba'i bde skyid kyi rtsa ba ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la rag las pas/ nam mkha'i gar khyab tu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po ches khyab par 'gyur ba dang / der gnas pa'i ris med kyi dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyang / tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i gzhi bzung ste/ sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum la zlos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin pa byas nas/ lam bslab pa gsum rang gzhan gyi rgyud la bskyed de/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par byed pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyang thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba'i ngos nas byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba sogs thun mong lam sbyong sngon du song ba'i sgo nas/ rgyud sde rin po che la zhugs te mtshan bcas mtshan med dang / lam rim pa gnyis 677

kyi sgo nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad zung 'argag rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la 'god pa'i skyabs 'jug thugs mkhyen brtse'i gur khang nas dus nam yang mi 'dor ba'i skyabs 'jug dang / mdor na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis rgyal ba'i go 'phang bde blag tu thob par 'gyur ba'i skyabs 'jug mkhyen mkhyen/ mkhyen lags/ /zhes pa 'di ni rab gnas chu sprel1992lo'i hor zla dang bo'i tshes gcig la gya ston du grwa tshang la 'bras chan phul te skyabs 'jug tu bris pa'o/ /glang chen 'gying ri'i gnas bstod/༄༄/ /byang chub sems kyi 'dzin ma yangs shing brtan pa'i ngos dag tu/ /phyin drug spyod pa'i rin chen ri bo gong nas gong du brtsegs/ /bsdu bzhi'i lo 'dab rab rgyas rin chen ljon pa tshar du dngar/ /sku bzhi'i rin chen rdul brtsegs thub dbang lhun po rtag tu rgyal/ /rnam kun ma khyen pa'i bdag rkyen las byung sprul ba'i zlos gar ni/ /rin chen ri dang ljon shing mtsho dang chu mig la sogs dang / /spra dang spre'u bya dang ri dwags sna tshogs sprul ba yis/ /'gro don dpag med byed par bden pa gsung ba'i zhal las gsungs/ /de lta'i sprul ba'i zlos gar ni/ /dpag tu med pa'i ya gyal zhig /glang chen 'gying ri zhes grags pa/ /sum rtsen sa la 'phos pa 'dra/ /kun tu bzang bos kun bzang spyod/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i zhing 678

mchog tu/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog 'di'i/ /grags pa lha yi ngo bzhin snyan/ /ri bo'i yung rtserngo slebs pa na/ /mi yi yul du mthong dka' ba'i/ /sna tshogs ltad mo'i ngo mtshar gyis/ /skye bo kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog /dbang phyogs gnam sa'i 'phrad mtshams las/ /nyin byed mdzes zhal mngon pa yi/ /dmar ser 'od kyi 'ja' sprin de/ /mdzes sdug kun gyi snying bo bzhin/ /shing bal thang la btang 'dra ba'i/ /sprin gyi rgya mtsho'i mdzes zhal la/ /rab tu chags pa'i dbang gzhu yi/ /sna tshogs 'od kyis rtse dga' ngoms/ /mkha' dbyings smag gis khyab pa'i tshe/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyis/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sgron me'i tshogs/ /nam mkha' 'gengs pa'i ngo mtshar ngoms/ /sman gyi spos dang chu skyes kyi/ /dri bsung mngar bro'i ri bo 'gengs/ /yal ga lo 'dab rab rgyas pa'i/ /rigs mi gcig pa'i ljon pa'i tshogs/ /ri bo'i rgyan du 'gran pa bzhin/ /ngo mtshar snang bas yid dbang 'phrog /thun mong snang ba'i ngo mtshar dang / /cung zad dag pa'i snang tshul dang / /dag pa'i snang ba'i snang tshul sogs/ /bskal ba stong du brjod mi tshar/ /de lta'i ri bo'i ngo mtshar ltad mo la/ /chu bur mig gis ltad mor g.yeng ba tsam min par/ /rnam dkar sems kyis cho ga bzlas brjod bskor ba dang / /phyag mchod rtse gcig smon lam legs btab pa'i/tsho /dge 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum dge tshogs ji snyed pa/ /gcig tu sdom pa'i mthu las yangs pa'i 'jig 679

rten kun/ /dge mtshan snang ba dam pas yongs su 'dzin pa dang / /'gro kun byang sems nor gyis yongs su phyug gyur cig /ces 'phral snang shar tshul tsam zhig rab rgyal don grub ces pa sa lug1979lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin ri rtser bzhugs skabs sbyar ba'o/ / dpyid bsu ba'i khu byug gi dbyangs/ ༄7/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig rnam dkar mkhyen pa'i bdag rkyen las 'ongs rab dkar 'phrin las 'od dkar gyis/ /rnam sang 'gro ba'i shes rgyud 'dzin mar rab mang dge ba'i 'bras stang gi /phun rngogs 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i dpal tshogs mtshan ma'i phun tshogs rgyas/ /mkhas dbang 'bum gyi zhabs rdul 'thung ba'i gangs ljongs gzhir/ /rig pa 'bum gyi chu skyes la dgyes sgra ma ra/ /bag yangs 'phur lding rol ba'i zlos gar gzigs mo dang / /dar dir snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis ljongs 'dir shis pa sgrubs/ /de ltar dge ba'i sa chen 'dir/ /'dzin byed nyi ma'i gnyen can de'i/ /sgyu 'phrul srong btsan sgam po zhes/ /snyan pa'i dbyar rnga dbyings su ldir/ /thabs rtsal 'phrin las rnam bzhi yi/ /don yod kyo ba rnon po yis/ /sde bzhi'i lha mo grogs su bkug /dpal gyi 'byor bas sa chen bkang / /'phrul blon yang dag a nu'i bus/ /dka' ba 'bum gyi khur chen btegs/ /rig pa nyi zla zung gcig de/ /bsil 680

ldan yongs la mig tu byin/ /de lta'i mig gis rab brgyan pa'i/ snga /dran dbang bye ba 'bum phrag gis/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i sa chen gyi/ /rab mang rig pa'i nor bu mthong / /thos bsam rin chen gru rdzings de/ /brtson pa rlung gis rab bskyod nas/ /rin chen gling nas nor bu'i tshogs/ /drangs pa'i sku drin su yis gzhal/ /lugs gnyis gsal ba'i nyi ma yis/ /gangs ljongs rmongs pa'i smag chen bsal/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i pad mo 'bum/ /yongs su 'dzum pa'i rtse dga' rgyas/ /rnam dag rig pa'i 'od po che/ /lho nas byang du rgyu ba dang / /byang nas byang du rgyu ba'i gzis/ /dga' tshal rgyas pa'i ngo mtshar shar/ /tsong kha'i nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i ltor/ /rgyo chen bzang bo'i yongs 'du 'khrungs/ /grags pa snyan pa'i rdzo rnga che/ /phyogs kyi bu mos yang yang brdungs/ /kun rtog rtsub pa rab zhi ba'i/ /'jam pa'i yang 'jam zhal pad ma/ /bzhad pa'i dpal gyur nyi ma che/ /dus su shar ba'i dge mtshan rgyas/ /bkra shis 'od chen rab 'tsher ba'i/ /yid bzhin nor dang g.yas 'khyil dung / /'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i mtsho chen der/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i pad tshal rgyas/ /dpag bsam shing gi yal ga dag /phyogs su rgyas pa'i dpal ngom bzhin/ /yan lag yang lag chu skyes tshal/ /'dzin ma'i lto bar bkab pa bzhin/ /sgra tshad sder phreng rnon po yis/ /log pa'i gnyis 'thung klad pa 'gems/ /bzo gso nu zho mngar mo yis/ /skal ldan seng phrug yongs su gso/ /nang don nam mkha'i nor 681

bu yis/ /khong gi mun pa lhag med byed/ /gtsug lag rtsis kyi 'phrul 'degs kyis/ /lkog gyur dngos po mngon par ston/ /sgra don tshig gi rgyan mang gis/ /don gyi sgeg mo yongs su brgyan/ /mngon brjod sdeb sbyor rin chen phreng / /blo gsal gzhon nu'i mgul ba'i rgyan/ /de lta'i gna' bo'i rig pa'i 'od zhags kyis/ /deng dus sa chen 'di yang dkar khyab gtong / — /sngon gyi rin chen bahūṃn mo gzhon nu ma/ /yongs su gtong ba g.yerardzobag can gyi lugs/ /bang mdzod rin chen nor gyis gtams na yang / /slar yang nor sgrub las la 'bad pa ltar/ /spyi tshogs 'phel ba'i rig pa gsar ba dag /yongs su slob la blo ldan su mi dgyes/ /rjon pa tshan par dpyad pa yi/ /rig pas dngos po'i gshis lugs mthong / /gshis lugs yongs su bkol ba yis/ /mkho dgu'i 'byor ba mtsho ltar 'phyur/ /rgya mtsho chu yis mi ngoms shing / /sreg za shing gis mi ngoms ltar/ /rig pa shes pas mi ngoms shong / /srog dbugs tha ma'i bar du slobs/ /nyi mas pad mo skyong ba ltar/ /slob dpon mkhas pas slob ma skyong / /nyi dga' nyi mar 'khor ba ltar/ /slob mas slobarnya dpon yormes su bkur/ /pha ma bu la brtse ba lter/ /dpon gyis 'bangs la gces zhen byed/ /de ltar mthun sgril gcig gyur gyis/ /can bzhi'i las la rab 'bad na/ /bde skyid nyi ma gsar ba'i zhal/ /rings par mthong ba su yis 'gog /can bzhi'i rin chen 'dren nga/ la/ /mthun sgril lam gzhi 682

brtan po dgos/ /mthun sgril lam gzhi gding ba la/ /rang rang sems kyi dga' bde dgos/ /rang rang goms pa'i gshis lugs la/ /bag yangs spyod pa'i skabs bral na/ /dga' bde'i mdzes ma mchor sgeg can/ /khyim du bsu ba'i gzhi rtsa bral/ /ngar lcags ngar ma'i lam gzhi la/ /me yi 'khor lo 'dren pa ltar/ /mthun sgril lhing 'jags lam gzhi la/ /can bzhi'i 'khor lo yongs su 'dren/ /kha lo ba la mig med na/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba log par ltung / /rig pa'i gnas kyi mig med na/ /can bzhi 'dren pa ya ma brla/ /glog gi shugs kyi 'phrul med na/ /rlangs 'khor bgrod pa'i skabs bral ltar/ /tshan tshan rig pa'i snying med na/ /can bzhi'i skyes bu 'gro 'ong bral/ /de'i phyir stobs dang bde ldan pa'i/ /deng rabs can du 'gyur ba la/ /rig pa'i gnas kyi rmang gzhi dag /legs par 'ding ba rtsa bar zungs/ /de yang bod kyi skad yig gi /khyad 'phags rang bzhin shes gyis la/ /legs par lobs pa'i gzhi rtsa'i thog /gzhan gyi yi ge'ang bslab par bya/ /rang gi skad yig yal bor nas/ /gzhan gyi skad yig mkhas so lo/ /bod mi yin par khas 'che na/ /de 'dra'i bya spyod 'dor ba gces/ /skad rigs kun la mkhas pa de/ /mkhas pa'i grangs su los 'jog mod/ /rang gi pha skad brjed pa de/ /ngo tsha'i gnas su mkhas pas gsungs/ /de ltar rten bzang sa brtol ljon pa cher/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i me tog rnam par bkra/ /gzhan phan 'bras bu 683

g.yur du za ba la/ /skye 'gro yongs kyis longs su spyod gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni thag ring nas 'phrin yig gi lalanas bskul ngor mis pa'o/ /bsngags smon zla ba rmebum gyi snang ba/༄༅/ /thabs shes zla ba 'bum gyi snang ba 'bum/ /skye dgu'i gangs kyi ri bo la chags pas/ /dge mtshan gzi 'od 'bar ba'i ltad mo la/ /longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang slar yang smin/ /spang ljongs yid 'ong mdzes pa'i dga' tshal du/ /bde skyid me tog gsar ba'i ze 'bru la/ /rab chags don gnyis mngar ba'i bcud chen por/ /skye 'gro yongs kyis longs su spyod gyur cig /bsil ldan kun bzod ma yi lto ba ru/ /rnyarma lo ka'i yongs 'du mched zung gi /rang zhal lta bas mi ngoms bde chen la/ /g.yeng ba'i dga' bde mi thung dus su smin/ /slar yang rin chen me yi sbrang char gyis/ /bskyangs te kho lag chu skyes mdzes zhal ngom/ /mched zung 'bras bu g.yur du za ba la/ /sa chen 'gro ba kun gyis dga' bas rol/ /bod kyi gna' bo'i rig gnas bcu phrag la/ /rang rgyal nor bu'i mdzod du gzi 'od rgyas/ /nyin mo'i mgon la 'gran pa'i gzi 'od de/ /deng dus 'dzam gling yongs la lhang nger 'bar/ /mun par gnas 'cha' 'od la dgra lta ba'i/ /'byung bya long bar gyur pa rang gi gshis/ /kho rang 'khun pa'i sgra ngan rna ba'i dgras/ /dus su smin pa'i 'od stong 'gog mi nus/ /684

tshan rig bcud ldan bcu phrag nig pa'i gnas/ /dge mtshan lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzhon nu des/ /deng dus nor 'dzin lto bar gsar skyes pa'i/ /rig rtsal bu mo gzhon nu grogs su thob/ /de lta'i gzhon nu dga' mgur rol ba las/ /can bzhi'i bu dang bu mo bzhi btsas pa/ /thabs mkhas gnyor skyong srid jus gsar ba yis/ /nyer buskyangs sha dar khrag dar gzhon nur gyur/ /de lta'i gzhon nu dag gi rtse dga' la/ /gzur gnas skye bo yongs kyi 'dren byed zug /gsar rnying rig pa'i rgya mtsho 'phel ba las/ /dpal dang 'byor ba'i rlangs pa mkha' la 'phyur/ /snyan pa'i grags pa g.yuji'abrug skad la za/ /skye 'gro rma bya dga' ba'i zlos gar bsgyur/ /'tsho ba'i sprang rtsi'i bcud chen rgyas pa la/ /rgyal 'bangs rkang ba drug pas dgyes dgyer rol/ /dge mtshan bcu la spyod pa'i dpal rgyas nas/ /gtan bde dpag bsam ljon pa'i kho lag rgyas/ /mthar thug bde chen 'bras bu zad med la/ /kun gyis longs su spyod pa'i dpal thob shog / 'phrin yig sna tshogs kyi skor/༄༅/ /chos rdo rje bzhin lag gi rnam par shar ba thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa mchog gi zhabs skyes byin rlabs kyi gter chen po'i drung du/ gus 'bangs kyi tha shal bsam gtan ming can gyis gus pas gsol ba 'debs 'bras/ deng mdzad 'phrin 'od kyis sa chen g.yogs pas/685

bstan 'gro'i bde skyiwa rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la bkod pa'i skabs 'dir thugs kyi dgongs pa zab cing barming bas/ phran la'ang las don gyi bka' gser gyi me tog spyi bor bab na'ang / spyir bdag sngon bsags dman pa'idzo dbang gis/ rgasari pa'i rten 'brel lci mos non pa'i thog snga phyir na ba'i sdug bsngal bsnan te sman khang du'ang lan gnyis mi 'dod bzhin bsdad nas gnam khab gzer ba sogs sdig thog sdig brtsegs byed dgos byung ba sogs kyi dbang gis bka' gsung dang du len pa'i bsod nams chen po'i skal ba chad pa la 'gyod gdung lus sems kyi thog tu bab/da skabs yang / bla brang sogs phyogs yas mas nas 'bod bskul du ma zhig 'byor na'ang / de dag gi re 'dod skong —ma thub par rnga stod 'dir nye gnas gcig dang slob ma kha shas la brten te bsgong nas bsdad yod/khams cung zad dwangs skabs 'chad spel phran bu byed bzhin mchig slad mar yang thugs brtse chen klong yangs nas 'di phyi kun tu 'dor ba med pa mkhyen macikhyen mkhyen/ zhes gsol ba 'debs rten lha rdzas bcas rab gnas me yos lo'i zla tshes la/ sgo gsum gus pas phul/ /zhes pa ni paṇa chen rin po cher gul ba'i zhu 'phrin no// ༄7//bsnan 'gror phan pa'i rten bzang dpag bsam ljon/ /thos brtson yal ga'i kho lag rab tu rgyas/ ri /gso rig gzhan phan 'bras bu g.yur za ba/ /mched grogs yongs 'du sa brtol ga la bar/ /lhag pa'i 686

bsam pa mchog gis rang rgyud bor/ /gtun bde'i 'bras bu mchog la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /rga min bod min ngang la mgo skyes dkar/ /༷tsho khar g.yengame ba'i rgan pos mchid 'di gsol/ /dbus 'gyur rig pa nor bu'i gling mchog nas/ /rig pa sna tshogs nor bu bsam 'phel gyis/ /thugs rgyud gser gyi shing rta legs bkang ste/ /sman ljongs 'di ru 'byon pa'i skabs lags sam/ /'di na las kyi rlung shugs kyis/ /shing bal bzhin du bdas pa'i tshul/ /tsha dus rnga yul zhes byar bsdad/ /da skabs grong khyer spos ldan 'dir/ /mchis la sku dngos phebs dang lhan/ /re zhig rgas gso chu ser sman/ /me gso'i sman dang pho ba'i sman/ /nyo ba'i re ba rgyang nas byed/ /spyi sger gleng mo'i skyes dag ni/ /myur du yod pa 'i re ba byed/ /sku yon nyi ma 'od po ches/ /zer brgya spro ba'i rten 'brel zhu/ /zhes1977lo'i zla11 tshes2la mdzod dge'i sman rams pa bstan 'dzin don grub la springs so/ /༄༅/ /dbyāngs rtan rig pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i rin chen 'bum/ /dbyangs kyi nga ros drangs pa yis/ /dbyangs la dga' ba'i 'a5da pa ༷jo/ /tha snyad rig pa'i mdzod kyi sgo/ /yongs su phyes pa'i dga' ston la/ /skal bzang bung bas 'phur lding gis/ /yongs su rol ba'i skabs lags so/ /nye char rig pa'i dga' tshal che/ /dge mtshan me tog bkra ba las/ /'phrin yig bung ba gzhon nu'i gar/ /rab tu bsgyur bas dga' ba brtas/ /'di na gu ru'i mthu dpal las/ /blo gsal don 687

gnyer drug gsum la/ /mtsho ldan ma yi brda sprod gzhung / /yongs su spel ba'i dga' ston byed/ /gzhan yang bcu phrag zurnga bzhi la/— /spyi don blo gsal 'jug ngogs kyi/ /mdzub khrid gu ru'i man ngag bzhin/ /sba gsang med pa'i tshul du byed/ /gzhan yang blo gsal 'jug ngogs kyi/ /lhan thabs blo gsal dga' ston zhes/ /le'u bco lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /yongs su grub nas slar yang ni/ /shes bya'i rnam grangs tshad ma'i gzhung / /ji bzhin 'grele ba'i go bde zhig /'bri bzhin gzugs kyi rnam grangs yan/ /bris zin shes pa'i skabs la slebs/ /'di ga'i gnas bab yar zla bzhin/ /lo legs 'bras bus—'dzum zhal ngom/ /'tsho ba dbyar gyi mtsho la 'gran/ /rnyarma'i dpal la bag yangs spyod/ /ston 'bras g.yur du za ba'i skabs/ /grong khyer spos ngad ldan pa der/ /rnam par g.yeng ba'i rgya mtsho ru/ /las kyi bser bus 'ded nges 'dra/ /phan tshun gcugs pa'i brda mtshon du/ /brda sprod brda yi mchan chen dang / /sdeb sbyor sdeb legaṅge mtshams sbyor lnga'i/ /byings sgrub dang bcas gus pas phul/ /kho bo'i sug ris gzhan dag ni/ /rim gyis spyan lam bstar bar zhu/ /zhes pa ni 1988lo'i zla9ba'i tshes1 la a lags tshe tan zhabs drung tshang la springs so/ / sa / /thugs bskyed lhun pos tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ /gzugs sku'i nyi ma chos sku'i dbyings su rab 'phags te/ /'od stong 'bar bas rmongs pa'i smag chen gzhom mdzad pa/ /mañdzu sto ṣas khyed 688

cag rtag tu skyong gyur cig /dad dang dam tshig gtsang ba'i gser thag dam po yis/ /phan tshun dam du 'brel ba'i bu slob khyed cag gis/ /snyan pa'i tshig gi phreng ba la brgyus skyes kyi mchog /spyi sger gyis bsrings 'tsho byed rdzas bcas legs par 'byor/ /snyan tshig bsang gtor bran pas rgan po'i skyo ba sangs/ /bcud ldan zas la rol bas lus kyi ljon shing rgyas/ /de lta'i rgyu rkyen rten 'brel dngos rdzas kyis gsos pa'i/ /sgyu lus khang bar yid kyi khye'us bro gar bsgyur/ /rgyal khrims gser gyi 'khor lor byi dor rab bgyis pa'i/ /dus skabs bzang bo 'di ru khyed cag thugs mthun zhing / ri/bslu med bcud dang rig pa'i sbrang rtsi la rol bas /gshog glu rab snyan bung tshogs rgyas pas yid rab spro// 'di na phang 'bras tsha lu ma/ /bgrang bya'i khur gyis non na yang / /mthu dpal bdudashtsa zegs ma'i mthus/ /srog gi rlan dang ma bral tsam/ /glu chung len pa'i sgra ma ra/ /padma'i mtsho la 'khor ba bzhin/ /dbyar gyi lang tsho rgyas pa'i dus/ /rang cag 'phrad pa'i re 'dod skyes/ /skyes sbyang ljon pa las 'khrungs pa'i/ /'bras bu sa la ma rul gong / /ser sna'i mdud pa rab bcad de/ /bgo bsha' stob pa'i bsam pa bzung / /'on kyang shing lo gser mdog can/ /dri bzhon gsar bas bdas pa bzhin/ /las kyi rlung shugs btsan po deso/ /dbus 'gyur dga' ba'i tshal du ded/ /skad po che yi gna' bo'i dngos/ /phal che mi rtag chom pos 689

bcom/ /zhig ral bong rgan rna ba bzhin/ /mthong tshe tshogs drug rta rgod 'phyo/ /'on kyang byin rlabs 'od 'bar ba'i/ /gna' bo'i phyag rjes lhag ma dag /'dren byed yul du gyur pa na/ /dga' dad gsar ba'i myu gu 'khrungs/ /gtsug lag khang dang rten gsum sogs/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa la bltas tshe/ /rang rigs gna' bo'i shes rab dang / /dpa' rtsal che ba'i rang bzhin mthong / /dbus 'gyur byings kyi skye bo yis/ /bong ba gser mthong dpe bzhin du/ /gus 'dud lhur len dpe zla bral/ /rig ba'i bcud la 'thung 'dod byed/ /gzhan yang spyi zla bcu gnyis par/ /rang rgyal lho ngos grong khyer che/ /hrang ho la sogs grong khyer dgur/ /lta skor tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso byas/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i gna' rjes dang / /lha yul zhes bya'i skad po che/ /sa la 'phos 'dra'i yul ljongs dang / /'phrul 'khor gsar ba'i nus pa'ang mthong / /da lta rgyal sa'i grong khyer nas/ /mi rigs slob grwa'i gdan 'dren 'phrin/ /glog gi 'phrul la rab brten te/ /yang yang 'byor ba'i bka' dgongs bzhin/ /sos dal sdod pa'i skabs med par/ /bgrang bya bdun cu'i ngo thog tu/ /rgan po'i lus kyi ljon pa che/ /thag ring yul du bskyod dgos 'dra/ /'di dag rgan po'i gnas tshul tsam/ /khyed cag rig pa gdong lnga bas/ /kun rmongs ri dwags bsad pa'i khrag /rab tu dmar ba'i re ba byed/ /de lta'i gtam 'di mgo skyes spra ba'i me tog la 'gran zhing / /mthong byed nyi zla zung gi 'od 690 ci

zer bgrang bya'i dbang gis nyams/ /lang tsho'i chu skyes 'dab ma rga ba'i rten 'brel sad kyis khyer/ /dran shes spre'u'i rtsal nyams rgan po de yis gang dran smras/ /slad mar rang cag 'brel ba'i mdza' ba nam yang mi gtong zhing / /khyed cag rig pa gzhon nu rang bzhin bzang bo'i gos kyis klubs/ /lnga rig me tog gsar bas skal bzang yid dbang 'phrog byed pa'i/ /dge mtshan snang ba dam pas yangs pa'i 'jig rten khyab gyur cig /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten gyi/ /khur bo rab lci 'degs nus pa/ /sa yi khams kyi kha dog dang / /mthun pa'i lha rdzas dri med bcas/ /zhes pa ni dasges nas phyir phebs te hrang ho sogs lho phyogs su gzigs skor la phebs nas mdzod dge'i bzhag ldom gyi bod yig slob 'bring gi dge slob rnams dang / mdzod dge'i bod sman khang gi dge slob rnams la gnang ba'i 'phrin yig go / ༄7/ /nee ba'i che mchog drang srong chen po yi/ /grub mtha' bzang shos dge ldan zhes grags pa'i/ /srol 'byed spyal byā'i skyu mardog blo bzang grags/ /'khrungs yul chos sde'i mgon po gang de'i drung / /bsam dang sbyor ba'i yon tan gyis dben zhing / /gtan gyi 'dun ma rgyang ring yul du lus/ /'chi bdag snge la re zhig ma tshud pa'i/ /'khor mardo'i nya mo de yi ma3da 'di 'bul/ khastan 'gror gangawān mdzad bzang 'od stong gis/ /rgud pa'i mun tshogs bcom dang chabs cig tu/ /gzugs sku'i nyi ma nye zhos ma reg par/ /skye dgu'i dpal du lham mer bzhugs logs sam/ /'di na g.yeng ba'i 'khor lo che/ /'khor ba'i shugs kyis 'di phyi'i don/ /691

stor ba'i rgan po'i zag phung la/ /gsar 'tshes re zhig ma reg tsam/ /snga lor dbyar gyi dpal yon dag /mngon par rgyas pa'i dus gyi char/ /lha ldan lha yi grong khyer du/ /gser zhal mjal ba'i skal bzang ba/ de skabs yid la re ba'i don/ /gang gi rin chen snyan du phul/ /zhal bzang gser gyi bum pa las/ /gsung lan bdud rtsi lhug par bstsal/ /de lta'i gsung gi bdud rtsi yis/ /sems kyi khye'u rab tshims te/ /slar yang re zhu glu chung zhig /nyan byed gser gyi bu gar 'bul/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo mi yi gar/ /'jam dpal snying bo'i gsung 'bum gtso'i/ /chos sde de gar gang bzhugs pa'i/ /gsung rab tshar gnyis 'dir drangs te/ /ma rig mun tshogs bsal ba dang / /lhan cig byen rlabs 'dod dgu'i gter/ /zhu 'dod re ba shugs che bas/ /re ba don smin brtse bas skyongs/ /bskal bar goms pa'i thugs rje yis/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal la rab dgongs te/ /yid la brnag pa'i don de dag /'grub pa'i 'phrin las g.yel med zhu/ /slad mar bstan 'gro'i don dang gser mdog cod pan ring lugs che/ /yun nas yun du dpyid kyi dpal la 'gran paldi don po che/ /thugs gsang dpal gyi be'ur bcangasanas bskal brgyar ba zhugs yar zhu/ /gang zhus rin chen ljon par re ba'i 'bras bu smin par mdzod/ /ces pa a lags che shos la lha rdzas me tog bcas spyi lo1982lo'i zla2tshes2la zings pa'o/ / — ༄7ོ/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po a lags yang kyā muchog gi 692

drung du/ gus phran dmu dge bsam gtan gyis gus pas zhu gsol/ da lo bdag la dgos pa'i dpe/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum tshar gnyis/ gser tog gsung 'bum/ dpar khang chen mo'i nang gi mtshan nyid skor sogs gang yod tshar gnyis/ rgyud pa'i 'du khang thog gi dpe cha gang yod tshar gnyis/ a kyā yongs 'dzin gsung 'bum tshar gnyis/ bstan dar lha rams pa'i gsung 'bum tshar gnyis/ a kyā sku gong ma'i gsung dbang sogs zin bris sogs gang yod tshar gnyis/ che shos nang chen nang du gang yod tshar gnyis dgos pas dpar thabs rogs ram re mkhyen mkhyen/ mkhyen/ bdag zla bdun pa dang brgyad pa gang rung zhig la len du yong nges yin/ sku mkhyen/ gsung mkhyen/ /zhes pa ni a lags yang kyā la springs so/ / ༄༄/ /rnam dag rngo rabs phreng bar legs goms pa'i/ /rnam dag yon tan tshogs kyis rab brgyan pa'i/ /rnam mdzes zhakhas zung 'gyur med khri'u'i khar/ /rnam par chags pa'i tpāng du 'di skad gsol/ /bsam pa gtun gyi bde la sred na yang / /khya min bod min marto yi nya mo bzhin/ /zas la sred pa'i gser mig g.yo bzhin du/ /mgo skyes gangs kyi dpal la 'gran de'i mchid/ /legs skyes gtamu gyi sbyor ba'i 'dab chags zung / /rnga yul g.yu yi thang gzhung rab brgyud nas/ /'phrin bzang mgrin pa'i rdza rnga rdung bzhin du/ /rgan po'i 'dzin byed yal 'dab rtse ru 'byor/ /de 693

lta'i mod la lus khang gi /sems kyi khye'u dga' bas brel/ /myos byed bcud la rol ba bzhin/ /gcig pu yin yang ca co 'phel/ /gzhan yang de ga nas 'ong ba'i/ /'phros 'os zla ba gzhon nu des/ /gtam gyi bsil zer spro ba la/ /ku mud nang nas 'dzum mdangs rgyas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi bcud/ /paṇa grub 'bum gyi gdams pa'i mchog /byang chub sems sgom glur bzhes pa'i/ /bslab bya'i deb kyang gsos su smin/ /gang gi dgongs pa skong ba'i slad/ /sems kyi 'char sgo gang yod dag /dbyar gyi rgya mtsho'i rlangs pa bzhin/ /zol med mchod pa'i sprin du 'bul/ /srid jus gsar ba'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /yangs pa'i sa la 'phros pa'i dge mtshan gyis/ /skye 'gro dga' ba'i 'dab ma rab bzhad de/ /spro glu bhra ma ra yi glu dbyangs snyan/ /zhes pa yang a lags tshe tan zhabs drung tshang la springs pa'o/ /༄༅/ /legs smon kun bzod ma yi lto ba las 'khrungs gzugs sku'i ljon pa che/ /rnam smin yon tan bdun gyi kho lag rab tu rgyas pa'i rtse dga' ba/ /yongs su spyod pari gzhan phan 'bras bu'i lang tsho'i mdzes pa ci yang ngom/ /lnga bdo'i rngo na rig byed yon tun char 'bebs zhubs kyi padmo'i 5nga / /rin chen rtse mo'i mthu byin 'bar ba yis/ /snyigs ma rgud pa'i smag chen bcom dang lhan/ /dge legs gsar ba'i mdzes zhal ston pa la/ /re ba'i rgya mtsho 'phyur ba deng gi char/ /chos srid zung gi 'phrin 694

las mdza' na mos/ /nyi zla zung gi mdzes pa 'phrog pa la/ /lus ngag zung gi rtsol ba 'jug pa'i tshul/ /rna ba zung gi bu gar/bdud rtsir gyur/ /'di na 'byung bzhi'i rten khog la/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung gi dal med 'thab/ /bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog la g.yel te/ /sug bzhi'i g.yo ba ma bsdus tsam/ /'jig rten spyi dang bye brag tu/ /mi rtag srin mo khros pa'i nyams/ /mtsho chen dwangs pa'i zla gzugs dang / /dwangs mo mkha' yi zla bzhin gsal/ /gsar rnying rig byed rig pa yi/ /rnam grangs 'bum phrag bzlo na yang / /mu ni chen po'i rdo tshig la/ /zho 'thung rus pas gzhig thabs bral/ /mgo skyes spra ba'i me tog gis/ /gangs kyi bu mor 'gran dus 'dir/ /su ma ti yi snying bcud la/ /yid kyi khye'us re ltos 'cha'/ /de lta na'ang sngon bsags kyi/ /rgyal bo gtum po mthu che bas/ /re ba'i rgyal khams chen po ru/ /bag yangs skyod pa'i go skabs bral/ /deng dus mes stopo'i rig pa'i nyi/ /chu lhar gzhol ba'i rten 'brel grub/ /smag la mdung skor byed pa'i las/ /dpa' bo'i las su brtsi bas skyo/ /skyo na'ang skyo ba'i 'bras bu la/ /kha btsum mig btsum tsam zhig las/ /gnad la khel ba'i bya ba zhig /ri bong rwa yi mched zlar gyur/ /ma dag snang ba'i snang ngo la/ /grong khyer chen po'i grong 'gram du/ /mi gtsang bcud kyi ngad pa la/ /dri 'dzin bu mos spyod bzhin mchis/ /dbyar gyi lang tsho rgyas pa'i dus/ /rnga yul g.yu yi thang gzhung du/ /brda sprod spro ba'i sgros la brten/ /bag 695

yangs skyod pa'i rtsis gzhi yod/ /nyid kyi mdzad pa sna tshogs 'od can la/ /sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan dga' ba'i 'dzum dang ldan/ /dpyad gzhi'i zur yig ge sar lang tsho la/ /spyan ras bung ba gzhon nu yid tsam rol/ /de lta'i 'phrin yig dpyid kyi rgyal mo des/ /dogs med mgrin pa'i rdza rnga rdung bzhin du/ /gnyen gcugs dar gyi zhu rten mkhar btegs nas/ /lung rtogs dge mtshan rgyas pa'i mdun sar thal/ /zhes pa yang a lags tshe tan zhabs drung tshang la springs pa'o/ /༄༅/ /gau gros sna tshogs 'od kyi dkyil 'khor che/ /bzung bo'i ngad ldan pad ma'i dpyid du smin/ /mdzad 'asdin snang ba gsal ba'i rtse dga' che/ /rigs tshul sas la gzhol ba de yi drung / /'di na bsam sgom las la rab g.yel zhing / /gtun 'dun 'bras bu'i rgyu 'gal bag med las/ /ñtsha chen sa yi rdul dang marto chen bzhin/ /khur du lci ba de yis mchid 'di gsol/ /srid jus ri bong can gyi mdzes zhalarī las/ /kun la phan pa'i ga — bur thigs phreng 'phel/ /skye rgu dga' ba'i kun da gsar ba yi/ /dge mtshan 'dab brgya grol ba deng gi char/ /phyi nang rig pa rin chen nor bu yis/ /phyur bur gtams pa'i thugs rgyud rgya mtsho las/ /'gro ba'i re skong yid bzhin nor phyungs te/ /bgo bsha' stob pa'i las kyis brel lags sam/ /da lan nyid kyi snyan pa lha'i rnga sgra/ /rna ba'i bu gar lhung ba'i yid drangs te/ /gam du snyegs pa'i ngag dbang tshul khrims 'di/ /rjes su 696

'dzin pa'i thugs 'dud lhod med zhu/ /'di na gang gi don la nyer mkho'i las/ /bgyi ba phra rags gang mchis bka' stsal tshe/ /rgan po'i rang nus dbyung ba'i khas len la/ /thugs kyi mkha' dbyings som nyis 'chang mi dgos/ /de lta'i rgan po'i tshig gi gleng ba'i sgra/ /snyan gyi bu gar 'bul ba'i rten mtshon dang / /dngos zhal mjal ba'i tshab tu rgan po'i dpar/ /spyan ras bung ba g.yo ba'i stegs su 'bul/ /zla tshes la/ zhes dang /༄༅/ /ṇḍa gros rte bdun dbang bo'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gzhan phan bsang bo'i 'od kyis kun nas 'khyud/ /mdzad 'gin dpal gyi rig lam 'bum spro ba'i/ /༷sa chen phrag par bzhes pa de yi drung / /gang gi thugs kyi mkhyen klong sprin rim las/ /lnga phrag rig pa'i sgra brgya rgod pa yis/ /blo gsal mdongs mtha' mo yi shes rgyud la/ /rig pa'i mngal khur ster ba deng gi char/ /mkhyen dpyodanyangs pa'i lha lam las/ /thabs shes gshog zung g.yo ba can/ / gzur gnas ko ki la yi sprin/ /rgan po dga' ba'i gsos su smin/ /phyag ris dpyid kyi me tog la/ /mig gi bung ba rol bar gyur/ /don ldan brjod bya'i mdzes dpal la/ /yid kyi khye'u lhag par chags/ /ma mthong rgyang— gi gnyen gcugs te/ /mig gi lam du lhung ba bzhin/ /legs gsung snyan pa'i rnga bo che/ /grag pa bzhin dang thos pa bzhin/ /rgan po dga' ba'i rtse dga' la/ /yongs su spyod pa'i bskal ba de/ /'phags chen zag med bde ba la/ /yongs su gzhol ba'i da pal la 697

'gran/ /'di na las kyi rlung gis dbang med du/ /bdas pa'i ngang tshul 'di la skyo bzhin du/ /re zhig 'du ba snyom pa'i snang tshul la/ /g.yeng bzhin gnyis med ngang du mi tshe bskyal/ /slad mar gsung 'phrin sman pa'i sbrang char de/ /dus su stsol ba'i yid kyi dga' ston la/ /bdag gid char sdod bye'us re ltos 'cha'/ /de'i phyir 'phros 'os lha chu'i rgyun bzhin zhu/ /zhes zla4tshes28la dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las tshang la springs pa'o/ /༄༅/ /ches daspun dal ba'i rten bzang ljon pa la/ /rig pa martog gi 'bras bu g.yur du za/ /deng dus nd+ra na gzhung lugs brgal 'dod pa'i/ /bsam pa btun pa'i grogs la glo ba dga'/ /lhag bsam mchog gi nor gyi 'byor bas dbul/ /gtun gyi 'dun ma'i lam la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /ñtsha min bod min chu mtsho'i nya mo bzhin/ /g.yeng ba'i dbang gyur de yi ma3da 'di zhu/ /snyan pa'i ngag gi 'phrin bzang de/ /rgan po'i rna ba'i dpyid du smin/ /yid kyi khye'u dga' bas brel/ /'dren byed bung ba gar la rol/ /'di na gangs can rig gzhung la/ /brtson pa'i re ba ma btang yang / /rnam g.yeng rlung gis bya spu bzhin/ /gar 'gro gtol med ngang du gda'/ /slad mar ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /rig pa padmo'i sbrang rtsi la/ /'thung ba'i mdzad bzang mi 'dor bar/ /snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs chad med zhu/ /zhes pa ni dkon mchog tshe brtan la sprengs pa'i 'phrin yig go /༄༅/ /lhag bsam rgya mtsho'i 'jing las thon pa'i rnam dpyod nyi zla'i 698

zer gyis gangs ljongs rig pa'i padmo rnam par bzhad pa'i dpal gyi mtho ba gang gi drung du/ — ban rgan mgo ser de'i zhu mchid/ rang rigs yongs 'dus ljon pa'i kho lag rgyas pa'i dpyid dpal mngon pa'i dus kyi char 'dir/ lhag bsam dge ba'i phyag 'phrin yid kyi khye'u dga' ba'i dpal du thob pas/yid kyi rgya mtshos yar zla'i dpal la 'gran par gyur/ spyir bod kyi yig rigs thig khongs nas drangs pa'i dpe dpar bris sna tshogs shig bcings 'grol sngon mthong mod/ de'i rjes gcig kyang mig lam du ma byung yang /dpang lo chen po nas brgyud pa'i bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi bris rgyun legs pa zhig gzhon dus sbyangs par ma zad gzhan la'ang khrid spel byas /mod/ da lan na rgas shing 'dren byed kyang mi gsal stabs lag bris legs po yong rgyu rngo mi thogs pas/ rang gi slob ma drung yig smon lam la 'brir bcug nas/ thugs bzhed ltar ming 'dogs kyang yig chung gi mchan bu btab yod/ khyung bo g.yu khri'i rin chen sgrom bu dang / khyung bo'i lugs kyi sgyu gu'i bstan bcos/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mcho'i shes bya kun khyab rnams la gtugs yod mod/ gtso cher khrid rgyun bzhin dang khyung bo'i rtsa tshig la bstun pa yin/ 'on kyang 'di ni yang dag pa yin gyi/gzhan dag ni gti mug go zer ba ga la yin/ des na 'di khyed cag gi dpyad gzhir phul ba yin pas 'dor len yang dag pa gnang nas gangs 699

ljongs bod kyi rig gnas yongs 'du sa brtol ljon pa'i kho lag slar yang rgyas pa'i thabs tshul rmad du byung ba la brtson par zhu zhes thal mo sbyar te zhu ba lags so/ /zhes pa ni〈 bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par〉khang gi zhus lan du springs pa'i 'phrin yig go / ༄༅/ /lo ka nā tha'i 'o mtsho las byung zer brgya'i nus mthu yis / /rgud mun bcom dang lhan cig 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i dpal yon che/ /yongs rdzogs rkang ba drug sa'i nyer 'tsho gcig pu 'tsho gzhes pa/ /yongs kyi re ba'i mig 'bur gtod sa'i sna tshogs 'od can nyid/ /zag med dbyings su gnas brtan bzhengs min rgyal thabs zin gyur kyang / /rtog med yongs 'du sa brtol bzhin du kun phan rtse 'jor rol/ /ri rna can gyi lto bar rgyu ba kun gyi bshes gcig pu/ /gzhan zhig btsal kyang shes bya'i khongs las rnyed pa'i go skabs bral/ /mkhyen brtse 'jig rten mig zung hwa bar nas/ /byin gzi rab 'bar bka' nor phebs pa na/ /nang gi 'dab brgya bzhad dang chabs cig tu/ /phyi yi 'dzin byed 'dab bcu rnam par zum/ /thugs rje'i rlabs dang ratna bsam 'phel dang / /zla ba'i khang bzang ri mo bcu phrag zung / /'byung 'dus ljon pa rgas 'khogs 'khyog po yang / /sngo ljang ljon par 'gyur ba'i gsos su smin/ /lo ka ratna 4 thub pas yongs bkang yang / /gzhal med drin gyi nor bu 'di ko zhes/ /yan lag mchog gi yas kyi bu ga nas/ /lha chab sngon mo'i rgyun bzang lhug 700

par 'bab/ /gshis ngan lang shor dge legs chom rkun bdag /dam bca' gzhig med rno lcags ra ba ru/ /btson du bcug las gtan du mi gtong bar/ /phra rgyas srog rtsa gcod pa'i chad las zhu/ /dgag bya'i mtsho mo che bas rab gzur te/ /kyag gyog lam 'phrang zab mo brgal ba'i mthus/ /tshig gi gom 'gros 'khyol ba'i gshis lugs de/ /zag med kun gsal bu mos ci'i mi dgongs/ /dmu thag lha yis bzung ba'i lha yi yul/ /dge bcu yul la tshang ba'i yul gyi ljongs/ /bsam pa bcud la 'khor ba'i snod kyi bcud/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma 'tshol ba'i gtan sdod pas/ /yid kyi dung ba rlung gi ngar shugs kyis/ /ngag gi dbyar gyi rnga gsang dbang med ldir/ /lus kyi ljon pa thang la 'gyel bzhin du/ /chu skyes chun po 'di ni yar la btegs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sna tshogs 'od/ /'bar ba'i snying bcud sa gsum sgron ma mchog /deng dus smag chen 'thibs pa'i gshed ma ru/ /spro mdzade gang de'i mdun sa dam pa der/ /bsam pa'i khye'u rmongs pa'i gzeb tu chud/ /gtun 'dun nyi 'od mthong ba'i skabs bral zhing / /rgya gin bod min nya mos zas 'tshol ltar/ /g.yeng ba'i marto ru gnas pa de yi mchid/ /thugs gsang dpal be'u'i dra ba las/ /brtse b.ram̐ 'od rnon spro ba'i 'bras rtags su/ /rab gsal dngul lor bcu dang zla ba'i mdangs/ /'phrog pa'i dar dkar dang bcas spyi bor son/ /yid kyi khye'u dga' ba'i rkang bro zhig /sgyu lus 701

lke khang khyim kog po'i nang du 'khyam/ /khang rgan rnying ral brten pa gzhon nu yis/ /re zhig ma btang tsam du gnas so lo/ /slad mar thugs gsang ra ba btsan po ru/ /nam yāng lhod med dam du bcug nas ni/ /ngan song gshed ma drag po'i dmar lag tu/ /nam yang mi gtod bdag gnyer zhu 'tshal lo/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i nyi ma 'bum gyi zer/ /'gro ba'i pad mor rjes chags ngur smrig gi /rnam par rol ba'i lnga bdo'i rta bdun dbang / /bstan 'gro'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen gcig go /gtum mo'i tsha zer rnon pos rab bzhus pa'i/ /haṃ yig zla gzhon bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma che/ /dhī ti'i snod du 'khyil las tshe srog gi /rdo rje gshis su grub pa nges pa'i don/ /'on kyang chu bur mig gi snang ngo ru/ /gzugs sku'i zla bar nye zho'i ra ri zhig /chags pa'i gtam gyi rna ba'i tsher ma zhig /snying la zug pa'i zug rngu'i tshor ba myangs/ /de lta na yang thugs bskyed rdo rje'i gshis/ /'gyur med go cha brtan po rab bgos te/ /lnga bdo'i rgud pa 'joms pa'i dpa' stobs kyis/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor rtag bzhugs 'tshal/ /nā ga rdzu na bgrang bya drug brgya dang / /bo rnyi sa twa dgu brgya'i bgrang bya la/ /bzhugs nas bstan 'gro'i khur chen bsnams pa'i tshul/ /thugs gsang dpal be'u yi gces nor 'tshal/ /bdag kyang gang gi thugs rje zer brgya la/ /brten nas tshe srog padmo ma zum tsam/ /hung yon rdzong gi dpon 'bangs re ba bzhin/ /zla ngo gcig la brda sprod khrid 702

khul byas/ /'on kyang zag bcas rang gshis mngon gyur te/ /cham nad mkhal nad gnyis kyis re zhig gdungs/ /da lta re zhig dwangs pa'i khul yin mod/ /mjal skabs lta bu'i dwangs mo rang mi gda'/ /spyi zla phyogs kyi tshes 'gor 'bar khams su/ /zhag shas ngal bso bgyis te rnga yul du/ /bzhud nas sos dal sdod pa'i 'dun pa yod/ /'on kyang zla ba grags pa'i /pha rgan bzhin/ /ma 'ongs sngon bsu 'di la skyag gtad ci/ /gang gi sngon gyi thugs bskyed g.yar dam bzhin/ /thugs gsang bde chen rdo rje'i rwa gur nas/ /namatshoyang 'dor med skyong ba'i bka' drin zhu/ /gong zhus ltar du gzhig med rdo rje'i khrir/ /g.yo med rdo rje'i gshis su rtag bzhugs nas/ /zab rgyas bdud rtsi'i gru char yongs phab ste/ /gdul bya'i lung rtogs lo 'bras yongs smin mdzod/ /ces zhu rten lha reg dri med bcas sgo gsum gus pa chen pos/ gung thang rin poce lan gru ru sku bskung bzhes pa thos pa la brtan bzhugs dang 'brel ba'i zhu 'phrin du springs pa'o/ /༄༄/ /rnam dag bslab pa gsum gyis thugs rgyud gtams shing /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'od zer 'bum du spros pas/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gyi smag chen rab tu bsal te/ gzhan phan rta bdun dbang bo'i zer brgya 'bar bas/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid kyi pad tshal rgyas par byed pa/ lha yi chab rgyun bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zung gi bar du chags pa'i 'dus sde rin po che'i zhabs kyi ṅgedmo'o drung du/ gus ldan dmu dge bsam gtan gyis sor bcu'i 'dab ma snying khar 703

zum ste gus pas gsol 'bras/ thugs la btags pa'i bdag cag skyel mi rnams kyis dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon du legs par bab/'di ga'i bla ma dge 'dun chos skyong dang bcas pa thugs dges shing tshim pa'i ngang nas/ las kyi rdo rje shes rab rgya mtshos lam grogs zhus te grong khyer spos ldan(khrin tu)phyogs su legs par bzhud do/ /spyi lo1990lo'i zla9ba'i tshes11la/ ༄༄ོ/ /rin chen sems mchog sa bon grung bo las/ /sku bzhi yongs 'du ljon pa'i kho lag rgyas/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las 'bras bu g.yur za ba/ /bshes gnyen dpag bsam ljon pas rtag tu skyongs/ /thog med nas bzung 'khor ba'i g.yang sa cher/ /dpag med sdug bsngal brgya yis mnar gyur cing / /da dung dmus long g.yang sar phyogs pa bzhin/ /sdug bsngal rgyu la 'jug pa'i ngang tshul gzigs/ /lcags kyi gting la gzhug pa'i btsa' chen bzhin/ /goms pa brtan pas bag chags shugs chen 'dis/ /rang rgyud chud zos gtong ba'i ngang tshul la/ /sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ /bsil ba'i reg byar sred pa'i lag ldan de/ /'gog med 'dam chur zhugs pa'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /'dod pa'i yon tan myos chur dbang med du/ /rol ba'i shes rgyud 'di yis ngang tshul gzigs/ /gces pa'i bu gcig g.yang sar gom 'khyol ba/ /brtse ba'i ma yis glo bur mthong ba bzhin/ /thar med 'khor bar 'jug pa'i rgyun 704

phyogs lam/ /brtse ba'i phyag gis myur du drangs du gsol/ /'dod yon dug chur rol ba'i nyen kha las/ /myur du skyob pa'i 'phrin las g.yel med du/ /dad dang tshul khrims thos dang gtong ba sogs/ /'phags pa'i nor gyis bdag rgyud phyug par mdzod/ /nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba dang / /rim gnyis lam gyi rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /glog gi rol rtsed dang 'grogos g.yu 'brug mo/ /bzhad dang lhan cig gru char 'jo ba bzhin/ /gdung ba'i yus kyis gling bu bsgyur ba dang / /chabs cig byin rlabs dngos grub char ltar phobs/ /dad dang re ba'i bdag sems yol go de/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis mer bar mdzod/ /lung rtogs padmo 'dzum zhal mdzes par mdzod/ /gzhan phan sbrang rtsis 'gro kun tshim par mdzod/ /ces pa ni chab mdo'i dgon chen byams pa gling la springs pa'o/ /༄7/ /drug pa lhag bsam mchog la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /gtun pa med pa'i sbyin sogs ring du dor/ /khya khyab chos nyid btsal ba'i blo mig bral/ /srid mardo'i gnas su 'cha' ba de yi mardid/ /rdo rde theg la mos blo mi dman zhing / /kun nyon dgra bo 'a5la ba la btsan pa/ /bsdod nasas stobs kyis bsgrubs pa'i bde 'gro'i rten/ /nd+rab btan dge la bkol ba ga la bar/ /gtam snyan 'phrin gyi ko ki la/ /legs gsol ljon pa'i rtser son tshe/ /yid kyi khye'u garaphumakhan des/ /dga' ba'i bro gar ci yang bsgyur/ /'di na rten gyi ljon pa che/ /me tog dkar bo'i thod bcings 705

te/ /za nyal gtam gyi yal 'dab khur/ /lci ba'i byung ba gnas tshul lags/ /'on kyang rnyarma'i me tog 'ga'/ /'dren byed bung ba'i longs spyod kyi/ /dpal du shar tshe lta byed khung / /zung nas bdud rtsi'i zil ba 'babs/ /'di gar ma dag zhing gi rang gshis dag /losald mod de 'on kyang deng dus zikyi/ /phyi tshul gzhal tshe khyad chos 'dab brgya ba/ /bzhad pa'i dpal la dbang bos rgyang nas lta/ /bhā ma ra yi gshog glu lerne pa'i tshe/ /ge sar gzhon nu'i mdzes sdug ngoms pa bzhin/ /phun tshogs bcud kyi dpal de ma nyams phyir/ /zas gos gnas mal 'don la 'tsher mi dgos/ /khrims kyi rno skud dam lhod ran pa 'i phyir/ /sems ldan bya spyod gang la'ang bag re yangs/ /phan tshun dogs pa'i g.ya' de dag pa'i phyir/ /'gro 'chag smra brjod gser gyi rang 'od 'tsher/ /gzhi med gtam brjod na bun dwangs pa'i phyir/ /rang gzhan sems kyi nam mkha' sngo dwangs se/ /de lta'i gnas tshul lha chu'i 'byung khungs dag /lung rigs sgron 'od spros te btsal ba na/ /lnga bdo'i tshang tshang 'khrigs pa'i skyibs dag la/ /rnam dkare bdud rtsi'i mtshe'u dpag tu med/ /thos pa rin chen sgron me 'degs pa dang / /bsam sgom rlabs phreng gnyer ma shig ge shig /dad gtong na bun mtsho rlung ji li li/ /byin rlabs padma dkar bo'i mgo lcog ldem/ /zhi ba de bas bde ba 'byung ba'i gzhi /ngos gzung rdo rje'i tshig de'i rang gdangs gsal/ /de lta mthong tshe rgan khog brang khang 706

nas/ /rang sems bu mo gzhon nu zlos gar bsgyur/ /da skabs nor 'dzin g.yo ba'i 'ur sgra la/ /srid kyi zlos gar ba dag g.yeng ba'i phyir/ /'bod ngag rgyud mang sgra yi bskul ba na/ /'di gar 'bras ldan dus la longs spyod snyam/ /spyi dge dus gnas lha yi rol mo'i sgra/ /dus su bsgrags pa'i 'dun pa mi nyams zhu/ /kar 'od la sogs snying gi ze'u 'bru la/ /bsnyun 'dri 'tshams zhu'i bdud rtsi bran par zhu/ /de lta'i zhu 'phrin 'jol mo khyod/ /'bar khams yul gyi rgyab phyogs kyi/ /me tog 'bras bu ri sul du/ /song la mgrin pa'i rdza rnga rdungs/ /zhes dngos slob rdo rje dgra 'dul dang /bsod nams rab brtan gnyis la rab rgyal me 'brug1976lo'i ston khar rnga ba nas springs pa'o//༄༅/ /glo bur rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings nyid las/ /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'od chen spro der 'dud/ /dkar ba'i sems dang yangs pa'i mkhyen dpyod kyis/ /rnam dkar las la gzhol ba de yi drung / /rdo tre lta bu'i dam bca' 'gyur med dngos/ /rgyul khams yongs la phan pa'i tshad ma'i 'od/ /spros pa'i gzhi ma dpar gzhi 'od sdo che/ /yongs su spros pa'i mdzad bzang rgyas pa la/ /rgan po'i rgas pa'i lus khog shing sdong gis/ /dga' ba'i me tog gsar ba'i 'dzum zhal ngom/ /phran gyi sug las gya gyog 'bu rjes la/ /bong ba gser gzigs yon te(sgor sum brgya lhag)sug par 'byor/ /da lan bstsal ba'i bsdus gzhung deb gsum po/ /shes ldan shes rab grags pa'i lag nas 'byor/ /lhag bsam chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i 707

klong yangs nas/ /'phrin yig g.yu 'brug gad mo rna ba'i dpyid/ /slad sku 'tsho ba rin chen sgrom bu la/ /rab tu gces pa'i gces spras lhod med zhu/ /zhes1985lor rgan po dmur bsam gyis mtshams kyi thun bar nas rdo rje rgyal bo la 'byor lan du springs pa'o/ /༄7/ /beeḍūr lhun po'i mdangaso 'phrog pa'i/ /ye shes sku mchog mtshan dpe'i gzi/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od rnon gyis/ /rnam pa kun tu khyod la srungs/ /skyes mchog dpal gyi ljon pa la/ /sbyangs stobs lo 'dab rab ldan pa'i/ /grib bsil rgya khyon mi chung bar/ /phan bde'i mtsho la rol gyur cig /nye char 'phrin yig rten bcas 'byor bas spro dga' rgyas/rgan po'ang 'du ba snyoms ngos nas dpe khrid re'i las la brtson khul byās nas yod/ yig glog tsus brgyud blo gsal rigs sgo dang / bka' blon rtogs brjod bskur yod/ de lugs bkra shis pa'i me tog bcas spyi zla tshes la/ zhes pa ni sman pa dpal bzang rgya mtsho la sgrings pa'o/ /༄༅ོ/ /rten bzang rkang 'thung gi sngon pa'i kho lag rgyas/ /rnam dpyod g.yu lo gi 'dab ma phang phung g.yo/ /bag yod me tog gi dri bsung thul thul 'thibs/ /mkhyen ldan sa brtol gyi sngon pa ga la bar/ /skya min ser min sdi rgan po rgya na de/ /rgya min bod min khya dus 'da' zhing / /gnyid min sad min skyu snang ba yol ngang / /dkar min nag min sdis mi tshe yol bar byas/ /dal rten shing sdong de rgas shing khogs gyur kyang / /708

kun rtog gzhon nu ldis gos dkar mdzes gsol tshe/ /mgo skyes me tog gi gzhon nu phrag dog nas/ /rang mdangs rab dkar 〉 lang tsho rab tu ngoms/ /ngo 'phrad gleng mol sdi bdud rtsi mngar bo de'i/ /tshab tu snyan tshig gi 'bras bu 'di gsol la/ /yid kyi khye'u de dga' bdes tshim gyur nas/ /gcig pur 'dzum mdangs kyi reng 'od spro bar mdzod/ /ces pa'ang rdo rje dgra 'dul dang bsod nams rab brtan gnyis la springs pa'o/ /༄༅/ /bsam gtan gyi yi ge rdo bsod gnyis la ched don/ nga rang tshes12nyin dus tshod12dang skar5thog khrin tur 'byor/ san tung cha'o sne len khang du song na'ang da dung der spos med stabs/ men u la glog skad btang bas/ 'phral du bo khre zhig yong nas bsus te/ sngar gyi 'dug gnasi su song / khang ba'ang sngar rgye de red/ kru'u rin bkra shis tshe ring gis 'gan 'khur gyin 'dug nyin shas gros mol byas te/ pe cin du lcags bya'i nang nas 'gro rgyu byas/ tshes20nyin gyi dus tshod3skar ma40steng gi lcags bya'i 'dzin byang nyos yod/ lcags bya san khra ce zer ba de red/ dus tshod gnyis kyis pe cin du slebs rgyu red/ krung dbyang gis chog mchan ltar/ dag yig chung ba de mtshams bzhag nas rgyas pa de'i thog tu da dung lo rgyus/ rtsis rigasto sgra rig sman rig chos lugs sogs kyi ming tshig mang bo bsnan ṅges rgyas shing rgyas pa zhig bzo rgyu byas/sngar gyi 'bring ba de ma yig byed rgyu'i ched se tshar stong tsam dpar rgyu byas 709

nas dpar bsgrig rgyu'i 'go bzung tshar/ de yang dge bshes chos grags kyi dag yig lta bu kha shas yod/ san tung cha'o sne len khang du khang mig bzhi bcu rtsa grangs shig dang / gzhung las khang kha shas bcas phud nas gra sgrig byed kyin yod/ lha sa nas rdo rje rgyal bo sogs mi kha shas/ mtsho sngon nas tshe tan zhabs drung sogs mi kha shas/ kan lho nas nged kyi dge phrug smon lam sogs mi kha shas/ pe cin nas go pen khrin sogs mi kha shas gdan 'dren zhu rgyu byas yod la/ khyon bsdoms bod yig ched mkhas pa nyi shu rtsa grangs shig dang / mnyam du mi bzhi bcu lnga bcu zhig yod rtsis yin/gzhung nas rgyu nor ci dgos gtong zer zhing / nged cag lo na mtho ba dag phar 'gro tshur 'gro'i don du rlangs 'khor chung ba zhig kyang gnang rgyu thag bcad/ pe cin du 'gro mkhan kru'u rin bkra shis tshe ring / khru'u krang dzin han/ dge 'dun/ zla ba/ dbyang khrin pe bcas nged cag mi drug yod/da lta g.yas phyogs pa yod tshad kyi zhwalpen rgyu sogs srid jus rab dang rim pa lag len du bstar bzhin yod gshis/ mi tshang ma rang blo bag pheb sa kyi ngang du rang 'gan sgrub bzhin mchis/ da lor yang lo legs kyi rnam pa yod/ pe cin nas yar thon 'phral yi ge bskur nges/ de lugs1978lo'i zla4tshes18la/༄7/ /bsam gtan gyi yi ge rdo bsod gnyis la ched 'bras/ nged cag tshes20nyin dus tshod4dang skar ma50thog pe cin du bde bar 710

'byor/ lcags bya'i nang shin tu skyid kyang tshodus tshod gnyis kyis slebs song / tshes21 nyin rang bsam gyis 'khyam skyod byas/ dgong mo rol chas zlos gar la bltas/tshes22nyin snga dro gsar brje'i gna' dngos bshams ston khang du lta skor byas/ phyi dro nang ston glog brnyan zhig la bltas/tshes23nyin snga dro ma'o kru'u zhi'i gdung la mjal/ phyi dro rang bsam gyis 'khyam skyod byas/ 'dug sa rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi sne len khang gnyis pa'i nang du yod la/ 'dug sa bzang la 'gro byed sdo khre zhig 'dugatshes24nas tshogs 'du'i 'go tshugs rgyu red/ nyin māng bo mi 'gor ba 'dra/ 'on kyang ci tsam 'gor ba da dung mi shes/ don dag gtso bo tshig mdzod chen lo'i don red/ der brten yi ge spyi'i— don la'ang gros mol re byed dgos pa 'dra/ yar khrin tur 'byor nas yi ge bskur nges lags/ de lugs1978lo'i zla4tshes23la/ ༄7/ /bsam gtan gyis/ shes rab la/ da lan blo don gyis bskur ba'i yi ge dang debe/ khyod kyis bskur ba'i 'phrin dang sher gri'i lag nas gsal bshad bcas 'byor/nged cag sngar rgyun bzhin spyi zla drug pa'i tshes lnga'i yar mar zhig la/ da lor slorbe grwa nas thon pa ste/ mthar phyin rgyu'i slob ma kha shas khrid nas khrin tu ru song nas gza' 'khor gcig 'gor las che/ sa der pho brang po ta la dang /sto—bhakra shis lhun po'i dgon pa yod/sngar sa de'i ming la bod yig tu zhe ho zer/ 7rin po che dang 'jam pa'i 711

dbyangs tshang 'di gar phebs yod/ 7 paṇa chen rin po che yang rgyun bzhugs ngos phran la mar rtsam thud sogs gnang sbyin gyi sku drin skyong bzhin/ saṃ bod shan sbyar la nged kyis thog mar/ gzungs sngags zab mo bod skad du bsgyur ba/ bye brag rtogs byed chen mo/ sgra sbyor bam gnyis/rnam thar chos 'byung kha shas las btus pa'i shog nye brgya phrag kha shas bzos pa yin/ 'on kyang bzo lugs skor gsal bshad byed dam/ rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag byed dam mjug byang byed/ rjes sor gros byas choga'adi ga dpe skrun khang gis gso ba rig pa'i tshig mdzod g.yu thog dgongs rgyan dpar yod/ de'i nang du'ang saṃ skṛ ta'i skad mi nyung ba yod pa bshad pa dang bcas bsdus na legs snyam/ stod cha saṃ bod dang smadu cha bod saṃ byed dgos/ zhib cha dang / gsal 'grel dgos nges la tshegs la lta mi nyan/ blo bzo dang ham spyod ma byed/ 'dang zhib mo rgyob/ snyan ngag gi nang na'ang / ba phyugs la sa chad pa sogs sa mtha' chad pa kha shas dang /thengs la thang dang / ta mtha' yang ba dang na mtha' yang ba zhes pa lta bu skyon kha shas mthong / la ṭa la lags zer ba dang / tshong 'dus mgur mo la tshogs 'dus mgur mo zer ba lta bu'i ham las ma byed/ gang ltar spus dag cig e yong rem/ ngas deb thog la da dung skad dod re gnyis phab yod rjes sor 'khyer yong / slob sbyong 'dzin grwa 'dzugs min ji 'dra/ blo don la bskur dus/ shog nye zhig yod mod ma 'phrod pa 'dra/ lo rab mi 712

'dug gal te 'dzugs na/a khu bsam 'grub dang badzra gnyis kyang gdan 'dren zhus na snyam/ bsod nams rgya mtsho lha sa la 'gro dgos stabs de gar yong na'ang cher 'dug khom med 'dug kho yong bsam yod kyang /'dug khom med na rang red bsam yod/ slob ma'ang bsal 'dems byed dgos/ kan mtsho gnyis nas nga 'bod kyin yod mod/ da lo 'gro rtsis min/gal te slob grwa ma btsugs na yar yong nas/ hong yon la 'gro dgos rgyu red bsam yod/ kho tshos na ning gzhes ning nas re ba cher byed kyin yod/de nas rnga bar song ste lus lhod sems lhod kyis/ thag ring la 'dang brgyab nas 'dug 'dod yod/ bstan 'dzin dang blo bzang rgya mtsho gnyis la sgra sdeb sbyor bcas mthar phyin par rem zhes shod/ sa gzhung re gnyis gra sgrig byed thub na legs/ byams pa 'phrin las yang 'di gar tshogs 'du la yong yod/ nga 'di gar yong ba'i dgos pa slob ma tsho la phan cung zad re e thogs snyam la/ nga rang gis dpe ltos dga' rab zhig byed thub song / a lags tshe tan tshang yang 'di gar yod/ dung dkar tshang dang rnam pa gnyis kas nga la thugs 'phrad byung ba la dga' tshor dpe me da gnang gin 'dug rnam pa gnyis la'ang slob ma tshos gus 'dun che'ang /tshe tan tshang gi gsung skad de dbus gtsang phyogs kyi slob ma tshos gtan nas mi go bar 'dug zer/ dung dkar tshang gi gsung skad de a mdo ba tshos gtan nas mi go bar 'dug zer/ nged kyi ra ma lug gi skad de tshang 713

mas go gi 'dug zer/ chas gsal yang brtan cing brtson 'grus che ba zhig yin mod/ shes rab 'bring tsam zhig red/ nga la rogs nyams re byung / bstan 'dzin blo don sogs tshang ma la 'tshams 'dri/ de lugs spyi lo1983zla5tshes27la bskur ba yin/ 'di rnams kyang rnag thog gtsag khel gyis bslab bya ru pe cin nas gnang ba'o// rsha ༄7/ /bsam gtan gyis/ shes rab sogs la ched du brjod 'bras/ khyed cag nye zho dang bral ba'i ngang bdag la bsrings pa'i 'dzin yig dang 'phrin snga phyi gnyis nyin lnga tsam gyis lag 'byor dang / sngar gyi deb nyi shu dang / rjes kyi deb bco lnga gnyis mnyam du zla3tshes28la lag tu 'byor/rin tshang ma rjes sor mnyam du bskur/ de ring da dung 'dus ma tshar/'di ga'i gsab sbyong 'dzin grwa'i slob ma rnams ya rabs spyod bzang don gnyer can sha stag yin pa dang / yon tshad kyang cung mtho ba'i gras mang /gzhan zur zhugs pa mi nyung tsam re yod/ 7snang mtha' mi yi gar mdzad zhal snga nas bong ba gser gzigs kyis sku mdun du bcar skabs yar bzhengs pa sogs bkur bzos mdzad par ma zad/ khyed 'dir phebs pa'i dga' ston yin gsungs nas/ gsol zas thengs gcig drangs pa dang / gsol zas skabs nged kyi rgyus yod/ rdo rje rgyal bo/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal/ bhaṅga lar jo bo rje'i rjes dran tshogs 'dur zhugs mkhan bkris lhun sprul sku dang / bde ldan pho brang gi spyi khyab blo bzang dge legs rnams kyang gdan drangs/ thengs rjes mar mjal skabs mnyam du 714

par zhig bskyon dgos gsungs nas/ khong dang phran mnyam du par blangs —pa dang / yang nged kyi 'gro grogs pan kru'u rin 'brug thar dang chos gsal nged cag bzhi mnyam du par rgyag pa sogs dang / zhal 'phros shin tu rgyas/ yong skabs khong gilharlangs 'khor gyis skyel ba sogs bka' drin bskyangs/ deng skabs 'di gar dge rgan dang slob ma tshang ma/ sems lhod cing ya rabs kyi spyod tshul dang du len pa sogs bkra shis pa'i mtshan ma zhig mngon 'dug nged gnyis la'ang sa chu 'phrod pa sogs khams bde'i ngang du mchis/ thugs rje chen po'i dgon pa'i yi ge phyag tu phul yod/khong gis brtags pa nan tan byed gsungs/ lan gyi bka' shog nga'i lag tu 'jog gsungs/ de ring da dung ma gnang / gnang ba dang 'phral du skur nges yin/ 'di tshe dpal gyis nga'i lag tu bskur stabs/ kho la shod/ de lugs1983zla3tshes29la bskur/༄༅/ /dmur bsam gyi yi ge rdo bsod gnyis la ched 'bras/ sngar dpal mgon skyabs kyi lag nas bskur ma rnams 'byor bar ma zad/sangs rgyas skyabs kyi lag nas kyang 'bru yig dang yig bskur kyang 'byor byung / de rjes bso skyes 'gro skabs nged cag gis gros tshogs kyi 'go 'dzugs kyin yod gshis brel 'tshub kyi rkyen las yi ge 'bri ma khom na'ang de lugs skad bskur gsal rgyas dang / sman yig sna kha gnyis bcas bskur mod/ 'phrod min cha ma 'tshal/ nged cag gi slob sbyong 'dzin grwar 715

slob sbyong la zhugs mkhan dngos zhugs lnga bcu rtsa gcig dang / zur zhugs kha shas bcas yod/ mi gsum bzhi tsam ma gtogs bod yig gi rmang gzhi yod pa sha stag red/ tshang mas 'di 'dra zhig gi go skabs thob dka' zer zhing 'bad brtson ya mtshan pa byed kyin yod/ khul u dang rdzong us kyang rgyab skyor bla na med pa byed kyin yod/ 'tsho ba'ang ha cang bzang / slob sbyong gros tshogs kyi sngon du hru'u ci mo ba bsod nams 'di gar yong / rdzong u'i hru'u ci khrin yang khrid nas mtshams 'drir 'ong ste dus rjod ring bor bsdad cing bkur bzos dpe med byed kyin 'dugatshogs 'du'i skabs tsho dang tā pu'u krang gnyis sogs kyis 'go khrid gnang ste gtam bshad/ ngas kyang gtam legs po zhig bshad yod/ tsho gza' 'khor gcig lhag la bsdad/ tsho nged ming sring gnyis sogs rlangs 'khor chung ba'i nang du bsdad nas dkar chen sman chu'i khar nyin gcig gi skyo sangs kyi zhor la sman chu 'thung du byin/ gnam gshis legs shing skyid po byung / kha sang tshes brgyad kyi zhogs par yang hru'u ci nged cag gi khyim du 'ong nas nang zas gsol te dus tshod gcig lhag la bsdad/ spyi sger gyi gsung mol 'byams klas pa gnang / slob sbyong 'tshogs thub pa la ha cang dga' 'dug zla dgu ba'i zla stod du bkra shis tshe ring yang nged cag la blta bar yong rgyu yin zhes glog skad 'byor byung /nged ceg gi slob sbyong sa bcad dang bo gsum khrid tshar nas/ —da skabs sa bcad bzhi ba 716

rtags 'jug khrid kyin yod/ sa bcad drug pa'ang brtsams tshar nas dpar rgyag gin yod/ ngas gza' 'khor rer dang bo gsum pa lnga ba rnams kyi snga dro song nas khrid kyin yod/ de'i bar la zur khrid pa dag gis zur khrid dang / rang sbyong dpe brjod 'bri ba sogs byed kyin yod/ dpe brjod 'jog mi thub mkhan gsum tsam las/ gzhan tshang mas skar ma bdun cu brgyad cu yan len thub/ skar brgya re len mkhan kha shas yod la/mang phyogs brgyad cu dang dgu bcu'i bar red/ sangs rgyas skyabs kyis rtag par brgya len/ dpal mgon skyabs kyang ha cang snying rus che 'dug7 des kyang skar ma brgya sha stag len gyin 'dug phalda cher skar ma brgya len mkhan bcu yar mar zhig yod/ karma tshul khrims kyang je bzang la 'gro bzhin yod/ da skabs skar mu brgyad cu yar mar lon 'dug khyed cag gi gnas tshul la yig lan yod par 'tshal/de lugs1978lo'i spyi zla9tshes9la /༄༄/ /mgo la me tog ser bo'i thod/ /phyag tu glegs bam sngon po bsnams/ /mig gi don gnyer can la lta/ /zhal nas bslab bya du ma sgrogs/ /gzugs phung che la bajid nyams che/ /spyan gyis phyogs bcu kun tu gzigs/ /stag gzig dom dred kun thon kyang / /nyam nga med par dpa' nyams ston/ /zhes pa ni slob bu bsod nams rab brtan la rab rgyal shing yos1975lo la gnang ba'o/ / ༄༅/ /rgya snag bzang bos nang gang ba'i/ /rgya sgyug bzang bos yi ge 717

bris/ /rgya mi min yang rgya yig shes/ /rgya skad bshad tshe rgya dang 'dra/ /zhes pa ni bsod rab la gnang ba'o/ / ༄༅/ /spos mchog yid 'ong dri mchog ldan/ /spos dri bzang bos nam mkha' khyab/ /spos 'di'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /spos 'di nyos na phan pa che/ /sgor zur 'ga' yi rin pa red/ /seratshusna ma byed khyod kyis nyos/ / bsod nams rab brtan khyod kyis ni/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i yi ge la/ /bsod nams blo gros 'jug gyis la/ /bsod nams dam pa'i las sgrub ste/ /bsod nams mchog gi 'bras bu la/ /bsod nams ldan pas rol bar mdzod/ /bsod nams dal ba'i rten rnyed kyang / /bsod nams sa lam 'byor bas dman/ /bsod nams them skas ma bgrod par/ /bsod nams rten gyi mgo skyes dkar/ /bsod nams lus 'di rgas mthar son/ /bsod nams phyi ma sgrub dgos mod/ /bsod nams med pa'i 'ur zing la/ /bsod nams rten 'di'i mgo bo 'khor/ /bsod nams sgrub pa'i go skabs bral/ /bsod nams la sred sems 'di skyo/ /bsod nams sngon ma'i mthu dbang gis/ /bsod nams rab brtan khyod dang lhan/ /bsod nams dge la gzhol thub na/ /bsod nams 'di ni e ma rmad/ /ces spos la bstod pa 'di 'ang shing yos ste1975lo'i zla12tshes25nyin me tog 'bras bu'i ri sul gyi khang bzang nyi 'od 'khyil bar sos dal sdod skabs/ gces pa'i snying gi bu bsod nams rab brtan la ku re'i tshul du thol byung du smras pa'o// 718

༄༅/ /drang srong ngag gi bdud rtsi de/ /rig 'dzin bye bas myong ba'i mthus/ /sbyor sdeb 'chi med bcud len gyis/ /'byung 'dus zug rngu rnam par bcom/ /sa lam mchog gi sbyor sdeb yis/ /mthar thug ye shes bdud rtsi brnyes/ /nyer bdun karma'i rtsi chen gyis/ /duḥ kha ma lus 'joms par shog /rin chen rtse mo'i nyi ma 'bar ba'i 'od/ /nam yang mi nyams dar ba'i rtse dga' la/ /rjes chags 'gro ba'i bde skyid padma dkar/ /rab tu bzhad pa'i mdzes pa mi nyams shog /mdzi'i blo yi blo bcud rig pa 'bum/ /ge sar rtsi yi rtsi bcud 'khyil ba la/ /yongs su spyod pa'i spyod pa dpa' bo'i lugs/ /'dzin mkhan mkhas pa'i mkhas tshul dpal thob shog / ༄༅/ /zur phud lnga ba'i masmo dang brtse ba'i nor/ /skyes sbyangs shes rab zong gis rab nyos te/ /thugs kyi bang mdzod nor gyis yongs gtams nas/ /skye dgu'i dbul ba sel ba'i mgon gyis skyongs/ /gang gi yon tan sprin phung las/ /gdams pa nor gyi char phab ste/ /gdul bya'i shes rgyud kun bzod mar/ /yon tan lo 'bras g.yur du za/ /g.yu thog gangs kyi ri bo las/ /legs 'ongs gdams 6pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'gro ba'i dpal du legs drangs pas/ /skye rgu'i tsha gdung rab tu bsal/ /kun la phan pa'i brtse sems kyis/ /gdul bya'i shes rgyud rab btul te/ /rang bzhin bzang zhing spyod bzang ba'i/ /shes ldan 'gro ba'i dpal du skrun/ /719

ltar snang bshes gnyen mkhas rlom gyi/ /bshad yams lta bu ma yin zhing / /glegs bam tsam la brten nas ni/ /gzhan mgo bskor ba ma yin par/ /— brgyud ldan bla ma'i zhal gyi lung / /'chi med bdud rtsi nor gyi mchog /sreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /rang 'od 'tsher ba yongs su spel/ /khral 'jal ngang tshul gtan min par/ /gzhan la phan pa'i phan sems kyis/ /sman gyi sbyin dang yang dag dpyad/ /'tsho byed gzhon nu'i dpal la 'gran/ /de lta'i bde gshegs sras kyi spyod/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar thob/ /shes nas dad pas shes rgyud gang / /dga' dang spro bas 'dren byed brlan/ /e ma smag rum yongs sel ba'i/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyi rtse dga' mthong / /bdag cag skye ba padmo'i 'phreng / /nyi ma'i 'od dang 'bral med smon/ /de lta'i nyin mo'i mgon po yis/ /dus kyi smag chen yongs bsal te/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i padmo'i tshal/ /srid mtha'i bar du skyong gyur cig /'chi med dpal la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /drang srong chen po'i ye shes kyi/ /nyer len las byung gso dpyad kyis/ /zug rngu 'joms pa'i dpal yon rgyas/ /bde ba che dang stong ba che/ /ngo bo dbyer med sbyor ba yis/ /dngos 'dzin rtsa ba'i nad bcom pas/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong yal ga skems/ /zhes pa ni sman pa dpa' rgyam la gnang ba'o/ / ༄7/ /rnyarma bdud rtsi sman bcud che bas/ /lnga bdo'i gcung nad bcom pa'i dga' ston la/ /skye rgu yongs kyis dgyes dgur rol ba yis /720

ngo mtshar ltad mo 'di ni e ma rmad/ /drang srong mkhas pa'i zhal gyi gangs ri las/ /legs par 'ong ba'i gso rig nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /ngoms med 'thung bas lus stobs rab rgyas te/ /phyi nang gcong nad 'joms pa'i dpa' bor gyur/ /zhes pa mdzo mo'i tshu tshan khar gsungs/ ༄༅/ /rlabs chen mdzad pa rgya mtsho las/ /gsung mchog nyi ma stong gi 'od/ /yongs su 'byung ba'i dga' ston la/ /dga' ba'i rgya mtsho kun nas 'phyur/ /rdzogs chen slob grwa ru spyi lo1982zla12tshes1 la rgyal rong chos 'dzin gyis zhus pa bzhin gnang ba'o/ / kho / /dmigs med/ spros bral stong ba'i mdzes zhal la/ /dgyes dgur rol ba'i bde chen sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /sprin dgra bcom nas zung 'jug rgyal thabs la/ /btsan dbang bsgyur ba'i grub pa che rnams kyi/ /rten 'di bskrun pa'i dge mtshan 'od po ches/ /lnga bdo'i smag chen rgud pa rab bsal te/ /rgyal bstan padmo'i 'dzum mdangs rab rgyas nas/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu g.yur du za bar shog /'di ni ki rti'i dge bshes blo bzang thabs mkhas kyis grub chen brgyad cu'i zhal thang brkos pa'idapar byang smon tshig zhus pa'i ngor bris pa'o// ༄༅/ /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'od zhags dmar bo yis/ /rmongs mun rgud pa mtha' dag lhag med gzhom/ /ye shes sgyu 'dzul rol ba sna tshogs kyis/ /skye 'gro yongs su 'dren pa'i dbang sgyug rgyal/ /zhes pa rab rgyal chu phag lo'i li tho'i mgo brjod du bris/ 721

༄༅/ /sems gnyis rtsibs stong 'bar ba'i bgrod shugs kyis/ /sa lam rtogs pa'i gling la dbang bsgyur te/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong 'od zer rnon po yis/ /rgun mun 'joms mdzad nyi ma'i gnyen der 'dud/ /mig dmar zhes pa 'byung ba bzhi ldan shing pho byi ba'i lo'i li tho bkra shis sgo 'byed ces bya ba'i mgo brjod du bris//༄7/ /rdza ri smug po'i mgo nas/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer shar byung / /lha shing shug pa'i rtse nas/ /khu byug gsung skad grags byung / /me tog ser chen kha la/ /sbrang ma stag chung 'khor 'dug /ra phug dben pa'i gnas 'dir/ /nga rang nyams len 'phel byung / /a sngon sprin pas bkab dus/ /gdug pa'i sprin rdo gtor byung / /ser chen 'dab ma bcom nas/ /sbrang bu'i khyu tshogs 'thor song / /rdza lung mthon po'i sked 'dir/ /nga rang sems pa skyo byung / /nga rang sems pa skyo nas/ /glu chung ngag nas thal song / /zhes pa ni rang lo so brgyad steng ra phug ri khrod du bris//༄༅/ /bskal bar goms pa'i snying rje yis/ /gzigs pa nam yang mi 'dor zhing / /zag med ye shes ral gri yis/ /'ching ba kun gcod de la 'dud/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rab dkar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba las/ /legs 'khrungs sku ba zhi'i pad dkar sdong bur gzhan phan lo 'dab phang phungarmo g.yo/ /phyin drug spyod pa'i mche brtse drug ldan glang chen thal dkar gyis bskor zhing / /gangs kyi ri bo'i sku mnga' lhag pa'i lha de 'bral med spyi bor bsten/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis rang gzhan 722

gyi/ /rgyud sbyangs lung rtogs lus stobs rab rgyas te/ /ma ti grags pas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan che/ /'dzin mdzad bshes gnyen zhabs rdul spyi bor 'dzin/ /deng nas tshe yi rin chen phreng ba ru/ /bco brgyad tshang ba'i rten mchog rab brgyud nas/ /mgon po khyod kyi zhabs skyes dbang gi rgyal/ /'bral med yan lag mchog gi rgyan 'gyur shog /'di ni grong smad dar rgyas kyis 'di 'dra zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor gnang ba'o/ / ༄༅//dam chos bu ram gor mo'i bcud/ /rab myong lung rtogs lus stobs rgyas/ /zhi dul bag yod spyod pa yis/ /rgyal kun dgyes pa'i 'dzum 'chor shog /'di ni rab 'byams pa chos ldan tshogs 'phel la gnang ba'o//༄7/ /gzhan phan thugs bskyed 'dzin ma'i lto ba las/ /legs 'khrungs bstun pa'i dpal gyur skrengs 'du'i ljon/ /'phrin las yal ga kho lag rab rgyas par/ /gsol ba 'debs so gzhan phan snang ba stsol/ /zhes pa 'di ni gso rig pa blo tshul gyi 'dod mos bzhin— bris pa'o// ༄7/ /grangs med rgyal ba'i nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od/ /gcig bsdus brtan pa'i 'khor lo zhes gsol ba/ /gtan gyi skyabs su bsten pa'i mthu dpal gyis/ /rmongs pa'i dgra tshogs ma lus 'joms gyur cig /skyid sdug las kyi snang ba gang byung yang / /blo phugs mchog gsum rin chen la gtod dgos/ /bya bzhag gang la'ang las 'bras mi bslu bar/ /yid ches dpang bor byed pa gnad kyi don/ /skyabs kyi dam pa nyi ma 'od po che'i/ /byin rlabs zer brgya 'bar ba'i mthu dpal la/ /gcig tu brten na legs 723

tshogs 'dab ma 'bum/ /lhug par grol ba 'di la yid ches mdzod/ /spyod ngan dug la zhen pa'i skye bo dag /'go nad bzhin du bltas nas ring du spong / /rang bzhin bzang zhing yon tan la dga' ba'i/ /skye bo dag la yi rang mig gis ltos/ /chang dud dag la zhen pa'i 'dod sred— can/ /grogs su bsten na gyod kha 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /'dod sred chung zhing gzhan phan sems brtan zhing / /ngo lkog med— pa dag ni grogs kyi mchog /dus kyi 'gyur ba brlang spyod rlung 'tshub dkyil/ /sra brtan tshugs thub gshis su gnas par bya/ /mdor na skyid pa'i nyi ma shar ba'i tshe/ /snang ba 'ur gyis mi 'khyer lhod de gnas/ /sdug bsngal smag rum 'thib po'i nyams shar tshe/ /las su bltas nas dge ba'i bogs 'don mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni khro kho'i zhal shul dgon gyi grwa rigs bkra shis rgya mtshos zhus pa bzhin bstsal ba'o//༄༅ོ/ /bde gshegs mkhyen pa'i ye shes chu klung 'bum/ /thugs kyi yol gor 'khyil ba'i rnam 'dren mchog /thugs bskyed spyin tshogs dbyings su 'thib pa las/ /mchog thun char gyis shes rgyud brlan par shog /ces pa 'di ni rab rgyal shing glang1986lor bsang chu rdzong du slob sbyong 'dzin grwa 'dzugs skabs slob ma thub chos kyi 'dod mos bzhin gnang ba'o//༄༄ོ/ /rnam par dge ba'i rin chen gsum gyi mdangs/ /rnam par gsal ba'i dge mtshan— dga' ston la/ /rnam par rol ba'i dga' ba bskal brgya'i bar/ /rnam par rgyas pa'i dpal gyis 'tsho gyur cig /rten mchog zhing sa gshin por yid kyi khye'u mtho ris kyi lo 'bras phun sum 724

tshogs pas 'tsho zhing / rnam dkar so nam gyis gtan bde'i sa bon dpag med 'debs par gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni de dus bka' srung gi 'dod mos bzhin gnang ba'o// ༄༄/ /ma rig mun pa rab sangs shing / /blo gros 'dab ma rab rgyas nas/ /bde ba'i thang la rab gshegs te/ /skyed yum thang der rab 'god mdzad/ /phun tshogs dpal der mngon phyogs pa/ /mngon par dga' ba—'i gnas der slebs/ /ma slebs lam gyi ljon pa der/ /g.yur du za ba'i 'bras bu yod/ /'bras la spyod pa'i dpung tshogs kyis/ /shes nyon dgra yi g.yul ngo bzlog /stobs bcu'i rgyal thabs la dbang nas/ /'dug min kun gyi mgon du 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di'ang shar ba khri dmag dar rgyas kyi 'dod mos bzhin gnang ba'o// ri༄7/ /las nyon tsub reg gtan spangs pa'i/ /'jam pa chos skus thugs rgyud phyug /drug cu'i dbyangs kyis skal ldan rnams/ /sku bzhi'i grong du khrid des skyongs/ /bkra shis dpal gyi 'od snang gis/ /rgud pa'i smag chen rab bcoms nas/ /bkra shis bde skyid pad mo'i tshal/ /rab tu rgyas pa'i dpal thob shog /ces pa 'di'ang bkra don gyi 'dod mos bzhin gnang ba'o//༄7/ /rin chen gsum gyi 'od snang che/ /snying la zhugs pa'i dga' bde'i dpal/ /kun nas rgyas pa'i rtse dga' la/ /skye 'gro yongs kyis spyod gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang blo gros kunadaga'i 'dod mos bzhin gnang ba'o//༄7/ /gzhal med rin chen gsum gyi mdzes zhal las/ /legs 725

'ordze sa bdud rtsi'i zegs rme —ma'i sgosasolhul’gyig /mtha'ad ga skye rgu'i gshis rgyud ra babarlanate/ /do ske genyis dzabraso su— gachurodu zabar— shog— rnyed dka'i rten 'di'i nus pa don sted du/ /mi gtong thabaso la gyi'obad ba gnad dzu che/ /de ciphyiremi2de dporam̐ malhage mertsoborteno rnaso risu/ /yoske tan rgya mtsho'i gling du bgrod sgerasdu mdzode/ rsha/ces spro'alnge slosde zu zhig sgo phoṅged meshā —rbezhin sprerme ngasace(// shā rī — —ju ci la 7 / ci— — 〈 phya — —— — — ci lke— 4 — — — rpāci snye dro ri ༄༅ / /thugs bskyed rgya mtsho'i klung yar4nas/ rna /tshogs gnyis— rlangs snapa tsākha' la 'a byur/rngutredzo— /sku bahāsko redzeenastson 'khrigs pa las/—— /da ma cho sa ba dud rtsi'i'acar3) rgyun/ /chad medasgomasayar —bab ba—las/ci /skal ldan zhing sa rab brlan te/ ri /rnaspe dkar sa bon yongs su —smin/ /gtan bde'i 'bras bu g.yur zar shog /dge bar gyur cig /bdud lir gnang ba'o⑪ — — ༄mya / — /rname par chodekar ba'i 'phrin lase kyi/dzha ci /'ode dkar 'bum phrag sprose rba na/ rī/bsten— 'egro'irī bde skyidaci pade dkodza— gyi/ khoga' tshale chen —so rab tu rgyas/ /nyi ma lung gitsāb gyelizho krang bstan rmerdzon gyis— zhus ngor sbyar ba'o / /rwa mo — —tsā༄ / /kun la phan ba'i 'ode zer 'e—rbugo /mkhyen ba'ichi nyispa las spros pas/ /'jam pa'i 'dab ma la chags pa'i/ /budza ba gzhon nu'i debyangs snyenañtsapo/ /lnga rig 'darbe brgya sdozhed dngo lten/— /kun gsal yangs pa'i klong du gragasre/ ci ski shes rdo rje rtse rbargya yiso/ /rgud pā'i milha min lhag med 'joms/ /'di bla brang mi rigs slob grwa 'aming ba'i khang cheno gyi spen —thog 'ogo tu 'ebri rgyu rahoshing glang 1986 'oḥṭahor zla bzhi ba'i tshes gsum bris/ /ci— tsho ri tre 726
