ཿ rwa ༄77/ dzwa khadzam dpal nyi ma'i 'ode snang gis/ :/rgud pa'i rtsabo5 cirmong stso phun—boco ma/kā/rig gadzhas parjo'i 'dzum cizhal ga /longs— su spyodatre pa'i dpas khrobabarsāgacitwoci nye/cesasta 'odidang /—rngo mchog gsum byin rlabs sbrang char gyis/ —/gshis snedarngonor 'dzin rlan gyur te/ /—yone —tan ma lus stobasabyurgyas nas/ /phan bde'i 'bras bu cigayur za shog /ces pa 'dikanyis sangasalhas rgya mtshos zhus pa cibazhin btanang ba'o// rwa ri ci — —rme ༷ cipasdu sgyuṇichi — rwa — rkuchi — — ༄7 / ci /sngon bsags gser ldan bu mo'i ltod/rji /dge— —'bras ljon pā rab tu rgyas/ /yon tan kho ltag rgyas pazhi rtser/tsho /sta lam 'bras bu smrin gyur cig /rnam dag— bsag pra'i stobs shugs ldas/ci /rnam dzwabyukar chu ciskyesu 'dab ma brgya/ — /rab— tu bzhadadro pra'itsho dga'— ston lda/ dzici /skyetsho rgu yongasga kyis spyod gyur cig /ces sta'ang slo0 bu re cil ci5nang ba'o/'i 4 ‘ ri rngu——nge cu kṛ — — ཿ —— rtsa — ༄7tsho/ —/dge mdzanadu gyi bkra 'isnya gdugasari dkar/ —/skye 'gro yi dbu lke 'khor nas/ ri/phan tpāṣka ldi gribha bsiol 'jam pyos/5 ju /bde tshormid kyi dga'atsa ston byin song— / /dge ༷dzhan— gyi rpākra zhis gserṣa nyakhri/sdo— rīg gi gser mig 'khyilā —nas/ /sdeg garnos kyi /rgya mtshoru shtsakhyug stas/ sdu/shes bya— yi5 pha mthārwa brgal mosong lta/ byu /dge —mtshan ghi rpākkodzi kkis tham bzang / /'uchi med kyiX ba dudadzi dzhais gang ba/ /bsod zhenamus chi ngurpālu du rwashārā— ༄sa/— — /longs cispyod dang4 dze dpal rgyas song / /dge mtshan gyi bkra shis :puṅge la/ /daṅgel 'byor gyi 'dasgebargya bzhad de—/ kharjo ba tma— nee544 matsābalha'ig ༷rdzang— tshogs kyi re ba 7 727

khengs song / /dge mtshan gyi bkra shis dung dkar/ /snyan grags kyi sgra dbyangs snyan po/ /phyogs med du grags pa'i stobs kyis/ /ris med kyi skye 'gros bkur song / /dge mtshan gyi bkra shis dpal be'u/ /mthun sgril gyi ri mo 'brel zhing / /thabs tshul gyi dra mig mdzes pas/ /mi kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog song / /dge mtshan gyi bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ /rnam rgyal gyi ri mo bkra ba/ /ri rgyal gyi rtse mor bsgrengs pas/ /phyogs kun las rnam par rgyal song / /dge mtshan gyi bkra shis gser 'khor/ /rtsibs stong gi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ /myur shugs kyis gling kun bgrod pas/ /dpal ldan gyi mnga' thang rgyas song / /zhes pa'ang gling dkar stod kyi spang gzhung du bris/༄༅/ /brtse ba'i rang gzugs mi dbang / /bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i/ /'phrin las dgung la bsnyegs nas/ /mtha' bzhi dbang du 'dus song / /mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs mi dbang / /rgya rgyal thang gi the tsung / /rig gzhung mchog la dgyes pas/ /bde skyid dga' tshal rgyas song / /'phrin las rang gzugs kong jo/ /bod rje'i khab tu bsus nas/ /bod rgya mthun pa'i gser thag /gzhig med dam por 'brel song / /mi rigs mthun sgril gzhi la/ /lhing 'jags zhing sa gshin por/ /can bzhi'i lo tog 'bras bu/ /g.yur du za bar skeg cig /ces pa'ang 'bar dge slob grwa'i lnga bzhi'i dga' snyon gyi ched du bris pa'o//༄ / /nor bu gsum gyi 'od snang gis/ /smag chen bsal ba'i dge 728

mtshan gyis/ /bde skyid lang tsho dar ba'i dpyid/ /skye rgu yongs kyi dpal du smin/ /sa la bkra shis rtsi shing rgyas/ /g.yu lo bkod pa'i dpal la 'gran/ /zhing la gro nas rab tu smin/ /ston bsdu 'bras bu g.yur du za/ /gnam la bkra shis sprin dkar g.yo/ /sbrang char snyoms pos dngos grub ster/ /char chu dus su 'bab pa'i mthus/ /zhing phyugs 'byor ba yar zla bzhin/ /bar la bkra shis phyug dar 'dzom/ /mi yi bzhin la 'dzum mdangs rgyas/ /phan tshun mdza' ba'i mdza' bshes bzhin/ /mthun sgril dpal gyi lang tsho ngom/ /rang bzhin bzang ba'i gzhon nu tshos/ /rig pa'i nor la hab thob byed/ /skyes thob 'o ma'i mtsho chen la/ /sbyangs stobs bdud rtsi'i chab bsnan pas/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rab tu rgyas/ /gnas bab bzang bo'i rtse dga' la/ /longs su spyod 'di e ma ho/ /e ma 'di 'dra'i dga' ba la/ /a ho skyid pa'i glu zhig len/ /'di'ang gling dkar stod kyi spang gzhung du mdzod dge'i bzhag sdom kung hre'i zlos gar tshogs pa'i zhus ba ltar mdzad pa'o//༄༅/ /dge mtshan 'bum bkra g.yas 'khyil dung / /rnam pa shis pa'i sgra dbyangs che/ /yongs su bsgrags pa'i dge legs kyis/ /byāde skyid dga' ston kun nas rgyas/ /dge legs 'bum gyi ri mo byākra/ /shis pa'i dbyangs kyis srid gsum khyab/ /nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi bas byāde/ /legs pa'i mtshan ma kun nas dar/ /zhes pa'ang bsam gtan rgya mtshos mdzad/dku/ /gung khran tang zhes grags pa'i rtsa 'dzugs tshe/ /krung go'i rgyal 729

khaci 'dzin—ma'i sa gzhiram̐chesari shenyici ma/ bzhin du shar nag da lta'i bar/— /lo ngo bzhi bcu 'khor ba 'di go —rmad/ /ma le ring— lugs khyogs la nyer drang—sa pa'i/ /thabs jus brgya phrag rin— chenatsho shater bkratso/ ste/ ske/dmangs kyi rgud pa brasal 0'i— 2pal can ga 5901 ba— ciyongaṣka kyis bstod bsngagaso dbyangs su gyer/ ge/rgyal nang gsaraci —rsā'i ru satshogacher phywar te/3 /dmangag kyi mgo bo gnone pa'i ri boñtsa'abum/ rṇalko/ phran chib zhin du dzhabarlags pha'i— dpa' ngar la/ ltadzozla skad tshogs dgaX kyangatsho ltad mor cigayeng /dngha cu/sbyi tsogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun dpag bsam kyiljon/—/glo bucha mkha'atshal snyegs pa'i yal 'dacib ngoms/ /de tshe rlolge 'dir khengs ldan yod do cog /khengs sgyupa'i ri bo bsnyil nacis had de 'dug tsho/rgyal sa thabs jus gseng —gyi mu khyud des/—4tso /'jig rten spyi tshogarsā gsor 'khor 3bas ma —ru/ hūṃ ci 7rī /rabra tu bsdus pa'i grags ba 'brug gyi sgrasakhri /bu tsan rgyal smyo ham can dag brgyal bar gyas/ho5 —/ krin tang yang dag 'di yis/ra/ba bzungarte ba'i/ /spung rdo— gsar bsazhesakha'i ming snyanesme phos/tsho dku 'jigartidzorili —bo'iworus rmu khyabaru ba— yi/—riske —ṭā /dus rabs gsar ba 'di la dargarme zhidzi jispro/ dzo— ༷ṭwā ke/skoso thedzangabesimo gtene ce mtshos sher 4mer bri sa pa'o 4 2rme ci ci—ri— ོ ju ri dngha ༷ — tsho ci pyodhe ske— tsho ci ru snye — — ske rī ci sto sto //brtse chen phrin gyi bamaim tshog sdoci las/ /a snyomarsā rdzosachanee zim pa'i dga' ston lwakyā — /shestse rab nyi ma4 gzhon nu'i 'dzum zerha gyis/ swā /grogasadhebyas phudma sdozhon—rī rinu 'i snagan tshalargyasgapa ༷/rab gnas byulhagarsā mo lug 730

gica bgrang bya5'dir/ /mbing char snyoms pa'i dgo' ston lo bcu song / /de 'i b.ro rige pa'i dga' tshal rgyas pa la/ /rgan po 'i sor rbacu'i 'edab ma snying gare zum/ /marwa 'ongs dus —rabaseltasashu 'i3nga dgotu/khe ltawās —chad med 'odatsho snang spro ba rba'in/ /treng char— snyoms pos 'gro ba'i rgyude brlen te/— /shes rgyud zhing rmeratredege ba'o 'bras smrene —shoge ho lte — /ces3 ba 'di'ang 〈 sprangajichasdo rte gsar spel byas nas gle 'khor bcu lone rmerme dga'e ston rdu khros pa'o/—/ — tsho tsho — ༄7/— /'edir jirange giṅka bsamerdon/ 4— bode yig gesar 'chigyur 'edi— ni rgyarme khab kyi rig ñtsargenas deng depol 'byore gadza zed lo gel che ba'i —reng sto — bye rbezhin dalnge nden —rbe —zheg skrene mod/ṅkatsho ‘trerno rgoje glerge gange thad nacis skermermesgo dorgerme ma nyadalnge stabag/4— —tshociskyoneca cha— ske nyuta re byeng rbe depere— na/ ci 'bri— la rgeyag mo zer ba/ ciyu mo la phe rmo zetshod rbe cidalnge— —/ shenya rtsedze shwa sgrog sdore rbe dang/ /— rgeyārge che zhing tsho sdi la/— che tsho ldan pa'i g.yagabye ces rubha—dargeci sgra sbyorde bha sdogaso/ boshe— kyi brda sprod rigawa pa'i rgezhud lugag— dang— miru mehūṃn zhingadzha / bod dgangarme— rshaskyeX gomag 'dris skad lhags dang sde cimathun —pa'i rnadagod sdo ba'i gtamu mung rtse byung / de'i stabs kyis gsar 'gyur nyo rmekhan shīn tu dkon zhing —/ lta 'dod mkhan yang cher med/ dper na rdzong khag dang / rī 'bar khams kyi las khungs/ khul srid gros khang gi mi lta bus kyang bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon gyi tshags par nyo rgyu las/ rnga ba'i gsar 'gyur mi nyo ba'i gnas tshul byung / de ni sngar gyi gnas tshul red/ nye char bdag kan su'u phyogs su 731

yod skabs/ de moga'i mi dag gis bshad don/ da skabs glo bar du rnga ba'i ༄gsar 'gyur je legs la song 'dug nged cag gis yang nyo dgos/ khyed kyis rogs byed dgos zer/ bdag phyir rang khul du 'byor nas gsar 'gyur btsal nas bltas pas/ je legs la song ba bden 'dug khyad chos dang bo/ chab srid dang srid jus phyogs gang thad nas gal che ba dang /mi rigs sa gnas la mkho che ba dag bkod 'dug pa las/ sa gnas rang dang 'brel med dang / don cher med pa dag je nyung la song 'dug khyad chos gnyis pa/ mi rigs rang gi rig gnas snyan ngag sogs bkod yod stabs bod mang tshogs dga' spro skyes 'dug khyad chos gsum pa/ bod rang gi sa gnas kyi gnas tshul dngos bden pa bden thub bkod 'dugaskyon cha ni yig nor kha shas dang / bsgyur skyon re gnyis re shor 'dug mod/de ni tshags par dang dus deb sogs gang dang gang gi thog tu bzlog tu med pa 'byung nges shig yin mod de yang legs bcos byed rgyur hur brtson bya dgos/ spyir bshad na je legs la song 'dug pas/ bdag dga' spro 'phel ba'i ngang nas glo bur du bris so/ /zhes pa ni〈rnga ba'i bod yig gsar 'gyur〉bklags rjes thol byung du smras pa'o// 732

slob bu dag la gnang ba'i brda sprod kun byed kyi mtshan/ ༄7/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig mtshan dpe'i me tog rab tu mdzes/ /yan lag drug cu'i gsung gdangs snyan/ /thugs kyi shes bya kun la khyab/ /mtsho ldan ma yis khyod la srungs/ /tshogs kyi gangs ri las 'ong mtsho chen dbus/ /dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i ngo mtshar dga' ba brgyas/ /grangs med rig pa'i blo gros 'dab ma 'bum/ /bzhad pa'i dpal de bskal brgyar spyi bor 'dzin/ /1 rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i rgya ༷tsho 'phyur ba'i rlabs/ /phul byāng 'jo sgeg gar gyis rtsen pa'i lha/ /kun nas dga' byā'i ṇḍa sdos sgo 'byed pa/ /mtsho byung lha mos khyod la srung gyur cig /(tshul khrims bstan 'dzin ye shes la gnang ba'o)2 rlabs chen spyod pa'i rtsibs stong 'khor lo yis/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i khyon la dbang bsgyur zhing / /ye shes ral gri rnon po gdengs tsam gyis/ /'ching byed lhag med gcod mdzad spyi bo'i rgyan/ /lhag bsam sems mchog gser ldan 'dzin ma'i ltor/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i rgya ༷tsho yongs 'khyil las/ /legs byāng dakṣes ༷'i zhal nas 'dod 'jo ma/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma des skyongs/ /(kun 733

dga' blo gros bstan pa'i snying bo la gnang ba'o)3 thabs shes rin chen khams kyi nyin byed des/ /bcu phragu rig pa'i 'od snang rab spros nas/ /lnga bdo 'i rgud pa'i smag rum rabarsha cibaṅgel— te/ /rgyal bstan pade tshal rgyas pa'i dpal thob shog /dasdethas sdunaridages pū'i 〉miXtshorwa las/ /rig pa'i bcud ldan sprin tshogs rgyas/ /(skal bzang dam chos la gnang ba'o)'bu dbyāngs cwan rdig ༷'i bang mandedagluso/ /skal bzang 'thud pa ༷jo ba ra shog (blo bzang thabs mkhas la gnang ba'o) 5 swātsho ldan zag med da3'a ༷'i 'atsum/ /nyi ma'i sdor la 'granahopar shog (kun dga' shes rab 'od zer la gnang ba'o)6 ༷tsho byāng dges ༷'i spub pa'i mchog /rdo rje'i gshis su brtan gyur cig (blo bzang 'jam dpal rgyarmotsho la gnang ba'o)7 dbyāng sa sdun dig ༷'i bdud rtsi yis/ /lung rtogaso ༷nga rto rab rgyas shog (theg mchog bstan pa'irta mar gnang ba'o) 8 ༷tsho sdun nol byā 'i gzhung〈snags krita cho /sa ma'i rgya mūtsho rgyas gyu ra cig ('jam dbyangastso blogros bstan pa'i sgron mer genang ba'o)9 dbyāngs rtswan lhazhe mo dakhyes swā'i nyams/ /〉 sa 'bum3) da pal la 'gran/ /( tshul khrims rgyaspatsho la gnar pa'o)10 ༷cho'ildun dga' byā'i rgya mtsho las/ ri /ṇḍasdos paddha'i 'dzum zha latsādagod/ — /(danonaspuchog bkra shis la gnang ba 'o) 1tsho1 ༷tsho byāng gsung gis tshicasapa na/ /rab tugestesas ༷'i ༷nga rngo rgyas/ khoskalabazadzwalungalhags rgya mtsho la gnang ba'o/)12 ༷tsho— rgyung dga' byā'i— ngag gi dpal/ /yongasaca su 'dzin pa'i dasa' bo rgya la/ /(grags pa 4bstad dar la gnatha ba'o)18 dadra/ngas ༈na lha mo 734

tshosaspyo rtezla༄/tsho.ayolhage'asuyo gyi dzwapaṃl lo 'askragasnakṣibri— gteni rgya kṣel ciganang ba'o/ 〉྾ — sgraribyangasatālha dku gzi4 sa rtsi bye—//rig tyā sgye ma g.yurī du za / /(blo ༷ ༷ sgo— gi bzang —bhazod pa la rītsāb ba'o)po — da hrūsaci cwan lha phrodwag/pho dpālpi ci ṭā 3 /dbyāja thang marjog gi mmu mmushog /('asis rked dku tso —rgya satsho la dzi 0 ngu rshapa'o )1ne ci dbyangusu rtanaX mdzes māci zagadu myedarte kyi/ tshe riri5 ḍadu /sgog sta'i namal de— rdo —rje bzhin/ /(brtson krog spa ṭatsho la gnata phro7— cisngoci sgyung da—0 mu 2rdol byā'ipa gnas/ /kho gi— ge ga/ra rabulke rgya5ci shogā /(bskal bhasgronganyi sdodku kālasru sdo cimāsdo la rigaswāng lhaphyo/ /)chosmitt+waṃ — sgra 5byadāsu 0byātshe ldan gyubra —pū'i ci—ngosnas/la /blasudra brazhi sa rngudhwa marje gā bhobyā shog sto/(sdosmon martog lhag— rab lhatsho gnang sdi'orngemādzo lhanā dasgyes pāzhi lung rto/ — /rgyatsholta kun jag rtegi rgyu murto rioche/marngu/skalnga ldan dāgyeg— pyasnyisna dasal du rmebru/ rme/༷dzhan dpe'i lad tshosngo kwa3bu —rgas— pa/ /dābyadasu cwan lha cimyos ske sa —sud—ga/tsho/rngoo /ngarge chil— dathebang 4busnare cingag gi lhazhi/ — — /sgon gabha —snyingasnye dzarsha sdin patree warge/ snyes/ ༷sngugyu nee/rdiṅgā games3 bucuci phrugarku snyerig stobasu 4rgyug/— /rdza zlotram̐nu/ ram̐n rjen —rgyul gyun gi gas mi/'di ni blo ṅgezang rgya rmetsho la 1983 lo'i ruzlo zheṅgene cispolnge sdobyarngo— mi ṣeg/zlo slob ṅge tstsharno rmer sdope — — snyeshārdo rgesdardawa skebasde brisahaṃ shāther— ༷masda su stesde sde rdo rdo/ /༷ ci ༷ cho ༷wa wa rda — dzā ༷ — — — 2— wa/ skre — tsho— — kṣ-ikha ri— byo 5rngo phyin na rshamo skrerdorna spre lnga gnangasngo sta bye tsho sto ci — catrehācisna —sgo sdu — — —tre ci rngo — sne chocitrersha rba'i citshogesi tāgetegro hwa/ cho rderte tsho — / snapecho ༷ shī sto cirka ༷dwarte — zi wi dzo ci tram̐ cirwari 3 —— ci skreskerdo —wa ༅ sgro— ⑫ ji / kā ptaṭwā za/kko dze pasdu sa de ri dzā — rdo rī kru shā—tsho tsāprobyu྾ /— — — /'o —lngo— rsha ṇḍarnya — ji —māṃryāwoyesotshor mernga tho rme 736

mkha' 'gro dkar mo 'bum phrag gdardo zlodzoms pa'i mdun jur gang zhu na/ de yang phar phyin ston mo nye logs dang bcas pa tshogs pa'i skabs 'dir skyor dpon gyi tshogs gtam re 'bul rgyu'i phyag srol yod pa kun gyi thugs na mnga' ba de bzhin lags la/ spyir tshogs gtam zer ba rab byung na/ so sor thar ba'i sdom pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya/ rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig dang 'brel ba'i gtam/ de min yang / mkhas pa dgyes par byed pa'i gtam/ blun po dang ba 'dren pa'i tshig zhig zhu dgos mod/ blun po jibadag la de lta bu'i sems kyi 'char sgo lus kyi bzo lta/ ngag gi smra brjod sogs gang thad nas mi dmigs na'ang / sa bcad ma stong ba tsam zhig zhu khul byas na/ dekṣang 'gro ba ma lus pa'i mdzad bshes chen po rnam 'dren shākya'i rgyal bo de nyid kyi bdag cag rnams kyi don du dang bo sems bskyed/ bar du tshogs bsags/ mthar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mngon du byas nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum sogs bskor bar mdzad de/ mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan rjes su/ bka' bsdu ba rim pa gsum dang / bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ shar gsum mkhan po sogs mkhas grub rim byon rnams kyis bstan pa rin po che rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa dang / bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yang /chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams kyi drin las bshad sgrub kyis bsdus pa'i bstan pa 736

rin po che 'di nyid snga phyir dar te srol 'dzin rnams kyis nyin mo bzhin du gsal bar mdzad la/ khyad par du mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal bos dge ldan du༄gro gleng gi srol btsugs pa nas bzung ste/ rang re'i dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i dgon sde che phra rnams su dar ba bzhin du/rang re'i dgon pa 'dir yang / mkhas dbang paṇḍi ta khrims rgya mkho rnam gnyis kyis 'chad nyan gyi srol btsugs pa nas bzung da lta'i bar du dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa 'di bzhin lagasi la/ nged cag nas kyang phar phyin lo brgyad kyi ring la/ rang la nus pa ci yod kyi sgo nas thos bsam rigs lung brgal brtag sogs kyi sgo nas bstan pa rin po che 'dzin khul byas pa'i rgyun/ de ring nas bzung ste/ khyed gzhung la gsar 'bud kyi 'dzin grwa rnams kyi phyag tu gtad pa yin pas/ khyed rnams kyis kyang bstan pa'i las kyi la rgya thugs la dgongs te/ kun mkhyen yab sras kyi yig cha dri ma med pa 'di nyid gzhir bzung / rgya bod kyi gzhung chen mo rnams gong bsgrigs te/ rje yab sras kyi legs bshad dri ma med pa rnams hor khungs su ma lus par gus rtags sbyor ba'i brtson pa drag pos sbyangs te/ bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par du gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang / yang sgos su grwa tshang rang gi 'chad nyan mi nub gong 'phel du byed pa zhig ci nas kyang thugs la 'dzin par zhu ba dang / dam bca' 737

'odzog mokhanosarnams kyi.āorkyangagerngo46lan 4'dibs mugogo —gezhungekhudon negrel tshulakhaso lerna rghaṃdzinamadzomaso— logaso tsong dzo/ji rna yig 7 cabarsā.a tshodango’ldanagyi po'i sgo zhirbe grwa —sa chen poldo/ migaspyos ma nyayosau gortoro adegome/ rdeX rī —dri da dzwadag junu ba— tho lomyo stoyopha/ ro tsha snye stengawakhon mkhadzwa rnamesmo tsu ci— dzi4thoms rarīltakhyen ddhameblu byur 'a gro/ cwa/ sorngob3dzoci nartsorkya' stso rke'asnadrinedu rmi — dpal rdu skyoriso/muro —u/rī/zhertso.odi sna dī rtsidzoparyāci gakha rngowesto rṣa / /snye 9sko/sku — — — ༄ 7 ⑪'ortsolagarsāsmo phun sum tshogs/rngo3shā pe zhesosna rpā’mnyarme ched tsā sa ga tsang0 gi sraso po de āoṃd kyiwāgasokhyibrangasodzodmo rnamartob—ra bospyongarsā paso zhal gyi dkyilakhebaso par rmodzarda nai mirdzo cici snye rnam bzhi'i tshangs dbya0sa kyis 3 shis/par borjod pa'icabaden dzig maṅge ro ba'i silo ma 'etho/ ra balha'i: du mo ne ba—tong sto gingadhe zhu narda yang rna moho'—droneci songs rgyasdo stongashigimo nang— —nalge padzee decikarardobocaltar ri6 sdog godku mnyam thesna gyirarmacho3/4ba cizheso cigra gas snyan baX don cidekaphu bo snye gsusto na mngon par moṅge ba de— nyidaci ni yab rgyalartirgo zasmorī gtsang la btsunelosmyoganyim lodardzo pa'i pyuob cib sna— lasum̐l lho mo cio—ོciotreomatshan — 7spyo — khungarisu g.yasogisahū'iltomaso nasosauonalha'i3rngosnangatsod —ltar drin lan — blosapa medojiltanertidang —bo dmyal ba'i rten la cismonasnyemaso 4skyed/ — — — de nas shākya dzudza pa— chen— ñtsagos mrujucig sems beskyed/ b.re rdu rbaskal juchenaci gratharsā sped gesumildu tshogasarosagos/ — byu lnge motrem—tharashāg) min ༷rdu nges pa lnga ldanaci gyi longoso skye'i ngo bor sangasotrergyasamonasmokodrol mya snamasadzo ci'akhoralharma gyurim tse rī dku 738

gsumaskor nas theg pa gsum smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad/ de nas lus can rna mas kyi bsod namasakasog pa'i zhing dam pa sku gsung thugs mirten ba zhengs pa'i phan yon bshad pa la/ — rten skegasum po ngos bzung ba/ de sngon ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus/ de ji ltar mezheng sa tshug de— bzhengs pa'i phan yon/ de rnams la phyag mchod༄la ba'i phan yon bshad pa dang lnga/ dnge bo la sku'i rten/ gsung giten/ thugs kyi rten dang gsum/ dang bo la rgyan bcas dang rgyan med kyi sku gnyis/ dang bo la zhi ba'i sku zhi ma khro'i sku drag po'i sku dang gsum yod/ gnyis palhan med kyi sku ni rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can shākya thu ba pa'i sku lta bu 'o/ /gnyis pa gsung gi rten ni/ bstodanyapa brgya lnga bcu ba las/ mkhas pa rnams kyi dga' ba bskyed/sgyu /bar ma rnams kyi blo gros spel/ /tha ma'i rab rib rnams 'jomasapa'i/ /gsung 'di skye dzhabo kugal sman/ /zhes gsungs pa darnga / rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas mdzad pa kun las gsung gi mdzad pa ni/ mdzad pa— mchog yin zhas sogs gsungs pa ltar mdzadathupa thams cad las gsutsā gi mdzad pa ni mchog yin te/ 3 dbang bo rab 'bring tha gsum gyi do stosgrub tharasgrobyed pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'ad sa kyis legs par gsungs pa'i gaphung rathasayan lag bcu gnyis kyi tshig yi gerawānod pa'i glegs bam rnams dbarke kto kā de'i dgong sa pa 'grel bar byedawu'i bstan bcos 'phags— rpā 'og7 sha mu/khyo mdzadawā'i glegs 739

bam rnams dang / dril bu dang bgrang 'phreng sogs gsung gi rten du shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa thugs kyi rten mchod rten te chos sku'i rten yang yin no/ /de la so so skye bo'i mchod rten/ nyan thos kyi mchod rten/ rang rgyal gyi mchod rten/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten dang bzhi yod/ dang bo gdugs chos 'khor gyi rim pa dang mi ldan pa'i mchod rten nas bzhi gechos 'khor rim pa bcu gsum dang ldan pa'i mchod rten sogs bzhi yod/gnyis pa de sngon du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la sku'i rten gsung gi rten thugs kyi rten byung tshul dang gsum/ dang bo la lung las gsungs tshul dang / bka' chem ka khol ma las gsungs pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang bo sku'i rten ni sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su byung ba yin de/ yul dbus kyi rgyal bo gzugs can snying bo dang / sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal bo u tra ya na gnyis thag ring na gnas kyang mdza' mthun du gyur te/ rgyal bo u tra ya na nas rgyal bo gzugs can snying bo la rin po ches bang ba'i sgrom skyes su bskur te/ shed mthun khyod bdag gis ma mthong ba'i grogs lags te zhes sogs gsungs nas bram ze dbyar tshul gyis lha snyed kyi yul du sangs rgyas byon pas des sku gzugs bris la bskur zhig ces thabs gsol ba bzhin/ ston pa la zhus pas gnang ba thob ste/ lha bzo la 'brir bcug pas ci tsam brtags kyang tshad ma lon pa na yid chad pa dang / ston pa khrus kyi rdzing bu'i steng du bzhugs nas gzugs brnyan chu nang du shar ba snyer 740

dpe byas de/ ras kyi ngos la lha bzo bra tshornams kyis tshon gyis bri bar byas te/ de lta bu'i sku brnyan la thub pa chu lon mar grags/ 'og tu skyabs su 'gro ba sogs bris nas gos sna tshob/sa kyis dkris te skyes su rim gyis sgra sgrogs su phyin cing / 'phrin yig de khyer nas rgyal bo u dra ya na la phul de tshogs pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ci nus pa brjod de mgu bar byas so/ /dpag bsam 'khri shing sogs las gsungs tshul mang du yod la mdor na dad ldan rnams kyis dge 'dun gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa na ston pa byon ma thub pa'i tshe gral gyi mgo stong ba dang 'dra bar mthong nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis rin po che du ma las ston pa'i sku gzugs bgyis de gral gyi dbu la bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ /zhes ston pa la gsol ba btabs pas gnang ba thob ste/ rin po che sna bdun las ston pa'i sku brnyan zhig bzhengs nas dge 'dun gyi gral dbur bzhugs su bcug go de ni 'bur sku'i thog ma yin zhing de nyid ni 'dul ba lung las gsungs pa'i tshul bkod pa'o/ /gnyis pa bka' chems ka khol ma las gsungs tshul ni/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'da' bar nye ba'i tshe 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su 'gro ba rnams bsod nams bsag pa'i zhing dang / mu stegs 'dul ba'i rten du la bgyi zhes zhus pas lan du nga'i snang brnyan bzhengs par gyis shig gsungs nas zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer gsum spros 741

de gcigatshangs pa dngagacig brgya byinadang gcig khyab 'jug la phog pas de gsum po so soratsā b.rūs3sa sangs rgyas kyi drud du song nas sku gsum bzhengame ba'i sna dge byed par zhursā tepi shwa karmas bzo bo dang ka byams pas dkon gnyer da nga / phyag rdor gyisahwasku srung dang / gtsang ris dpal dgon gyis srung mar khas blang sa so/ dngha de nas tshang sa pa—sa lha'i rin po che sna tshogs spungs galas chos sku'i rtenaspachod rten zlum po tshangs pa'i 'dom gang yod pa/ kha dog du ba 'dra ba/ ske phyi nang rgya la ba'i ring bsre la gyis bkang ba zhig bzheng sa pa o rgyan gyi yul du mkha'adzha'agro ma rnams kyis spyan drangs nas rten gyi sputso bor buzhugs shing lha dang mkha' 'gro ma sarnams kyi don mdzad do/ de la dad pa'i sgo nas lan bdun bskor ba byas na mchog—gi dngos grubatsho thob ces bshad do/ /khyab 'jug gis klu'i rin wo che spungs pawās longs sku'i3na thu ba param snangari gang—sacan mtshozhes bya ba de la dpag tshad brgyad cu yod — pa/— phyag ciganyis menyam bzhag tu yod pa/ dbu gtsug tu norobu chu shel gyis 6brgyanarteb zhigabazhengasapa phyi'i rgya mtsho'i nang du bzhugayote/ dngha lte bci rman chad kyis klu dang skesrog chags rnam sa kyi don ma dzad/ lte ba yana'ad kyis lhan0 dri za sogs kyirdan mdzad do/ — /dbu'i steng du bya tha gos pa spogang oṃri ltarasabarmugs shingasna — bco lnga'i mtshanatsā zla bsteshar ba'i tshe spyi gtsug3 nor bu༄ shel las chu rgyun ba bas te khruyogasol bstse prisaramasadag parabyos/ khyus chal de 742

'byungalastsekhismokhi —nedagapa— so.ayo gesum̐snesatshospyabyemide— nilngoghospyodelkorgartse pa'i sku'ortenang noshā ༷sna snyeci 94lte'o nabre dzo.āo7 dkudze byin gyici ya —rme sogs lha'i nawostserdzadage/ j-i ༷ji shulatsho rnasomi'i'anetso che lnge los caspyo rnyo— ci — ri 'angachungagasum̐m bzhe'iso phar phartsamalhotshi/’—ci—rirmyo chi pi zheswo rdoko mo so stonapha'i —zha ba —sa mokyilahphu chung lam̐ thig4armibatogagyirnas 'dzalo brgatshadaX rma ne rteparoñtsaraci lo ga 3/ stogaba'i zhalo naso zhiro 'di'i gardul byo'isna snang ngo 0darīgung rdzo0dalosna nga btsotsosadathokariX ci jirinyerotso7dardzi oṃ gecugasaram ba gtsam bzhedzwasaspuramadzod —cig ga.oṃgo —rsha — nyer lngebatre ṣka dkul bya amogabardzisnasadzo sdetha btson spyos skug tso3 ldaspyo legeso par chibazhe ngasnete/ —ji rī dzotrīrsātro'itshistu rlu ciṣkagho'akho teskyogosum labastemernakherabartu gnas 6 —mdzadacodorte—/da shutha lo nyeralnga'i sku dzodzo tshepadri tsotrī rtswartsa gsumalha lha rnalo (kyi rtogatsho sa.asna sa sa/4 'bring rpāculjaganyisaja' 0 nilhalha yul o rgyan mgilha⑫ gar0ldag’lis su skye gyi rnameso kyis — — bcud nams gsogaḥ sa'iru 'ing 0 nugs/rtechi ༷ rdzude'i rjesaṣkarjos gyol sronge— btsan glopho'i dzibatsun mo dzirgya lo 'azodkurṣa medu chi.armedrathasnye pa lha rsā —dzo porigaboceske zhes ci ci raditsan ne /tshe rme/5 rsā〈khoyalo brgyagayo skyo —ne’casadzibol bo'i yul du 0shugs sa/ /shāchisongatsā sna4 po'i bakhe bo btsusto ྾— blus pa'i rtenaskra lta/ stadu spyan graphagreyadza wobo.i batshoskyosno rdo rjer sko rtorsha gregayogade yinano/— citsho khi sa 'i radzozherotsāsngo ldarna jo bo bcugacig nelogyi nya43

srog shing tsandan sbrul gyi snying bo'i lo rgyus ni sprul ba'i rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po'i thugs dgongs la nga kha ba can gyi bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/bod kyi mi chos la gzigs shing dad pa bskyed pa'i rten 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku zhig bzhengs dgongs te/ de sa dang rdo las byas na ni rgyu ngan/ shing las byas na ni 'gas/ gser dngul las byas na ni dus kyi tha ma sems can rnams brnab sems skyes nas bshig nyen che bas rin po che zangs dang ra gan la bya'am snyam pas/ tshes brgyad kyi srod la lha'i bu mang bo sprin gyi gseb nas lus phyed thon nas/ lha'i gdugasadang lha'i sil snyan gyi sgra sogs bsgrags nas/ mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces smras so/ /sprul ba'i rgyal bo byang chub sems dpa' rgya gar gyi lho phyogs 'dzam bu gling gi mthar thug pa na/ siṅga la'i gling rgya mtsho'i 'gram bye ma'i gling bcom ldan 'das kha sar pa ṇi rang byung du byon pa'i sku rgyab/ glang po che nyal ba'i 'og na/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying bo las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi sku rang byung dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa de spyan drongs dang / kha ba can gyi sems can gyi don 'grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas rgyal bo'i thugs dgongs la lha de spyan 'dren pa la bod dang rgya gar gyi mthar 'gro ba la mi'i spyan mi 'drongs pas/ sprul ba gcig gtong bar thugs kyis dgongs nas rgyal bo'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer gcig bkye 744

ste/ dge slong a kar shī la mā ti zhes bya ba/ dbu la sangs rgyas 'od dpag med yod pa gcigasprul nas/ des rdzu 'phrul gyis skad cig tsam la rgya gar shar phyogs kyi grong khyer shang thags can zhes bya bar byon no/ /grong khyer gyi mi rnams la sangs rgyas 'od dpag med las 'od zer spros te/ rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul mang bo bstan byams snying rje'i chos bshad/ mdun du thugs rje chen po byon te/ yi ge drug pa'i chos gsungs pas gnas de la yang yi ge drug pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sa zhes grags so/ /jo bo 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer drug 'phros pas bod kha ba can gyi ri 'thug po la phog pas yi ge drug pa rang byung du 'char bar byin gyis brlabs so/ /dge slong lho sgogs siṅga lar byon nas/ rgyal bo u nan ta ge sar zhes bya ba nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i yon bdag yin pa la/ mu stegs pa'i bstan pa bzung nas gtsug lag khang thams cad bshig mi dge bcu'i khrims bcas pa sogs dge bcu'i khrims la bkod/lha ru dkon mchog mchod cig ces bka' stsal pas/ rgyal bos smra ba tsandan sbrul gyi snying bo ni 'og min lha yul na yod pa las mi yul nas mi rnyed/ gor shi sha nad rims la phan pa yod de sbrul gyi dkris nas yod pas gcod mi nus zhes pa dang / dge slong gis smras pa/ sbrul gyi snying bo phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram jo bo kha sar pa ṇi'i sku rgyab na yod/ gor shi sha ri bo ta la'i byang phyogs na nags tshal gyi mtha' thug pa na/ tshes bco lnga'i nub 746

rdzomilhag dzhal za sde — de yinasgo3rtsespos4 sokṣe— /spyolajibosabye smras pa/ tsandasna1rūlatsithingarhastoopludzoba'iṅgā ci ligs/—lodagegleṣātsho gis /smrase pa/ tsho'akhor rgo —'jigaspu chugyirdu chos stonalalka ci'oshas/ niri gyishi'i bu dang4 tsu mo rnam tshomo rtogophangazathoḥkhyer narnasadzwagho gyolhul mchod pazlobyed sum̐ zhorgo ci co ba'i lamartedupadzobosgo sgrohrergaṇi li ma— cizo da de datho saglel āoṃng —dzor rgyurane0oṃ kherolagyiṇi phyagalhuso berdudabirtsi bachi.āoṃ ṣpedzothe —rtogal thirmā sge sa/ kāho tsarnan sdome bo skyesasgyubari 7na2/moredīni 6ngastsergyas shrīkhor/be 'ejigathomya ngastolokhri 'das bro'i duso —su lo 'dab rgyarme/ cersha 'ode phyeng — myo —ngaspyo lososke'adas pa4'i dus same tog shar/ru—gyumi — dzo3 dushārkya rmyobaphopasna myo ngon las 'des pa'i dus su 'gralge bu smin te/ hwa kha za dzārtsabahphaste bsoglesdong bo 'ogyelo kas bye ma tshunge gis bta babipa'i 'ogotsu sum̐b bsu steldatshen glaldarmabo —tshe nyalade tsho' du shos kyidku chosgo mici rtag sprasgom patsayonarmeno zhelge dku ṅgeci — — ba dado // de dasacal bo dang dgi slong de —jilen me maṣṭhaso te/dzodo purdza gi༅gisayangaldo dngaX ba—cas byis kāṣā— bo tshetrenyagyorbe'i 'ogaspyoparko sa bag rsā na sdongatsodzigardotu rgyure te/—ོ ci de kṣeresarorgyabammu dngamo/— rsha cho'od tsheng jig tshosgyethaltete dāru4dalīphyowod cig cesatsoci ba'i smre cirgyuthāwoci —/ padro rna meede ltar sha shegasamedzeeskong rnosorjortsandan gyitson ra sa gekhrigos3la phacukacig phadu khri0kha gi tshad༄tshoba'i —ོ༷ṣpesheso dzi/ — rgyadriso dpaspu tshan btsusgo khisaca' ṣpezhecigasnyonamomezhi sno rnas tshul ciba'i dge skeslod gisgro phya ge tu yang tsaldenajigyitholapagasnyegabasnams/ klacu — rteb zhin gzhan 746 —

rnams rgyal bo'i 'khor rnams kyis khyer nas phyin pa dang / lha brgya rtsa ji ba rgyad byas de / lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad du bzhugs su gsol/ sprul ba'i dge slong yang sprul ba'i rgyal bo'i smin mtshams su thim par gyur te/sangs rgyas rnams kyi ring bsrel dang sprul ba'i sku re re bzhugs par gzigs nas sa bre brgyad kyang blangs chu bo ne rādzi na'i bye ma re re'i nang na byang chub sems dpa' 'bum 'bum bzhugs par gzigs nas/ phye ma bre gang blangs tsandan gor shismokadang sbrul gyi snying bo'i tshal ba re re yang 7 bsnams nas/ bod yul du phebs te spyan ras gzigs kyi sku sogs sku mang bo cibazhengs pa'o/ /gnyis pa gsung gi rten byung ba'i lo rgyus ni/ sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i dus nas gsung rab glegs bam la bris te bcu bdun sde la sogayopas— mtshan mo mar me'i 'od la brarten nasu sde snod dacig— sbyangs pa sogs 'dul ba lung las gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas zhal bzheg—sa pa'i dus nas gsung gi rten gsung rab kyi glegs bam dag yod la/ rgyal bo marngo skye'akhodagra'i sras u pa zhes bya bas /rgyal bo'i bka' thams cad glergesaca bam du byas par gsungs pawācha /— dus 'khor 'grel dri med 'od las/ 6ri sdud pa bo rnamarsā kyisarngoolde— dzhasnodakyi gsum yi ger bkod pa sogs —rsāngs rgyas zhal bzhugs dus nasne gyudzwal/ bod 'dicha tswayang thon rdzisasto ṭarngo—nas bzung ste lo tsā tshob/rnams kyi sku tshormin las ribaka' dang bstan bcos mang bo bod skad du bsgyur te glegs thām du sprusgrigs pa bka' dngha 747

no 'gyur bstan 'gyur zhes grags pa dang / rje yab sras sogs kyi gsung 'bum glegs bam’brgya phrag du ma yod pa dag go /gsum pa thugs kyi rten byung ba'i lo rgyus ni/ ston pa thugs rje can gyi mdzad pa khyad par can la brten nas yul ljongs de dang de'i skye bo rnams spro ba skyes te/ so so'i dus ston bya ba'i phyir du bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad brtsigs pa sogs la bsten nas bod 'a dir yang chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum sogs kyi skabs su gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten mang bo bzhengs pa sogs bod chol kha gsum du ches cher dar ba 'di bzhin no/ /gsum pa ji ltar bzhengs tshul bshad pa la/ sbyin bdag gi khyad par/ bzo bo'i khyad par/ yo byad kyi khyad par dang gsum/ dang bo sbyin bdag gi skyon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rten gsum bzhengs pa'i cho ga dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las/ sdig la mi 'dzem dad 'dun chung / /phan yon ma mthong yid mi ches/ /bsgrub blo med pa'am yod na yang / /tshe 'di'i khe 'dod grags 'dod phyir/ /rkyen dang mi 'tsham blo rgya byed/ /ngang thung blo dog bzod bsran chung / /lha dang bzo bo smod byed cing / /'gyod pa skyes nas 'phro 'jog pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sdig pa la mi 'dzem pa sogs kyi skyon dang ldan pa'o/ /yon tan gyi mtshan nyid ni/ /de nyid las/ phan yon mthong ba'i shes rab can/ /rtse gcig sems pa'i bsam gtan can/ /brtan cing spro ba'i brtson 'grus 748

can/ /dka' spyad mi skyo bzod bsran can/ /ngang ring tshig 'jam tshul khrims can/ /g.yo med gtong phod sbyin par ldan/ /rim gyis dga' spro bsgom pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yon tan dang ldan pa dgos/ gnyis pa bzo bo'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ de nyid las/ yon tan mi mkhas nga rgyal che/ /'grog pa mi bde bkur sti 'dod/ /'phral du tshig rtsub phugs 'dod che/ /yon rgyags gla thang tshad med 'bebs/ /des kyang mi tshim rgyu cha rku/ /cung zad tsam la bzo 'phro 'jog /'gro sdigs byed cing mnog chung 'tshol/ /dge las sdig par bsner mkhan yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi skyon dang ldan pa'o/ /bzo bo'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid ni/ /rgyud sasbu ṭa las/ dul zhing dad ldan lang tsho ldan/ /dbang bo rnams gsal rnam rtog med/ /khro med lkog 'phya mi byed cing / /shin tu mkhas la spro ba che/ /bzo ldan snying rje chen po can/ /zhes dang / rgyud sdom 'byung las/ dul zhing bzo rnams kun shes la/ /cho ga mthong zhing mnyam bzhag pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yon tan dang ldan pa dgos/ /gsum pa ni/ sku gzugs kyi rgyu rab rin po che mchog tu gyur pa dang / gser dang / dngul dang / zangs dang / ra gan dang / li la sogs pa dang /rang nyid la yod bzhin du ser sna'i dbang gis rgyu ngan ngon tsam gyis bsgrub pa ni shin tu mi rung bas rgyu gang bzang dang / spus gang dag bsgrubs te bsod nams bsags pa don dang ldan par bya'o/ /lnga ba zhar 749

byung mchod sdordang chiphyag dzeeskor byas byepo'i phaskemoyonetre batshoshad wapa— la/ mchodadkupa sum̐l ba'i phane yon ni/ dmanyachosacohūṃdatsho dekarakāl4sa/— deṭwāṃspuzhin gshegs pa rnamasagyu kyi rija bsrelo dang —/— khidzim tshospru'i gzugs dang mchod rtonadagolo mingaX/— /rtsig ngos bris dang rdul phume mchosdorterna snye/dku cikhre oṃṣpetogadab3 spos gsol —te/ /der ni gang gigo rab snyanahocatharmetemu dang|ske /dung dang mornga chen rol mo'i skra byedartsibacug chizlo /rgyaspu 'kho'imarnyog thireb mchoske rmar bya— ba'i — phyiro/ cho5/gang gis rnga rnamasajirapormudhe brdungokhyedartsecing ci/ /pi wang daroni phege dang mkhar cachenaju 4cirngagi/ ca /rdzahūṃngo rgyudaca gasgye—ga4gling bu yidaji'ong —dngaka tsho /tmadhego da āoṃrab spyo snyan 'byin pha/du/de dego thams rīo—ོ byang chublo thob pāralko'agyus /zhes de ba zhin ga shegasi cipa'i ring bosreladetha /ri sku gzugs dadzaka — ༷ mchod rtenaske sogos la me— toganee dngaci rī/ spome dang /— rol mo'i khyad par du masamod pa ra byaspopa la brten nasartsobloge rimedewa' rgyangothob〉thob gocir gsum̐ng sa/3 'phags po spyan ras gezigs kyi medo rmelas/ ci kong gnyis māchogo— lo sketse'id bya sa nas/ /de ni tshe rabs tham4ced— du/ /chags pa med cidza zhe sdang med/ci —/brkam— pa med cing dbang bo bsdamesabyu/ rdzi9/zhes —tshe rabaso rjams cad du 'dodaci chags dang / zhe sdong dang / ser sna la sogs pa'i —skyon gyis mi gos shing3bang bo— rnamasarsha zhi zhing dul bar 'argyur bar gsungs/ gzhan yang /rme nor rdzas longs spyod la4 rgyal bo dang chom rkun gyi 'a jigerme pa med spu —dang / gyichi medengo chusi gachinodami pa med par gesungs/ — lgirnga—de khyade lis / rshaske750

'a jig rten sgronasgo mchod byed pa/ /tshe rabs dag ni 4tham cad du/ /mya than skumed cing gnod med dang / 'khorasmolosacho bsgyur ba 'byor chen 'gyur/ /zhes tshe rabs snyothams rshacad du mya ngan dang nad med pa dang— / 'khor lorsā bsgyur ba dang / 4 'byong ba rngon’po dang ldan par 'gyur bar gsungs pha dang / rtso — — tshe rabs thams cadaci dusna lhaci dad mi'i— bde— ba rnam pa— mang bo 'thob pa dgyung —/ zi— mi'i rgyal bo gzhan lo phan 'dogs pa dang / phyug sding 'byor ba chen mipo dang ldan par 'gyurha la gling bzhi laste dbang rī balhar ba'i rin chen 7bdun ldan gyi zhakhor losadngha bsgyur bra'i —rgyal bor — 'gyur ro/ 4/phyag btsakṣa/ ba'i —phaṣka yon ni/ci kāgasal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdoru las/ mi rnams gang dag lkengs rgyas mchod rten nagaci nasku gzushas dag lgo mgos gtugs phyag 'tshwardzi ba / sdu /de dag lharnamasari dang ni dzirnashas i ske /che ltang che bar bku ra bzhi gnas su 'gyun/ tsho — pre /zhesda dngardzi / ri 'i—'azhoratwelo sa ba sgyur ba'i rgyal shochi laskye bo yams trad kyis gus parto'adudadri pa— cini snyerwas rī rma snga la phyag 'tshal ba'i 'azasnga bu khrin nywar cigasungaswo'i yaja de nyid las/ spo sgyes〉 da tsam gyis gcitsor kyār pā 'i/3 /rtagaskespyo— —(4 —po'i tshorigs skye zhing / /stadang glung bros rgyu byed pā/tshoglurnga /deci dra3 bla mā 'uphugag pa la/sru— 3/līgs pa ra — phyag rmi byas pa yin/ ༷nu ci /stanan rlosdingu māṃgs —mthonasne poru byuskyersha babyu dngaspru rta dang glang bo sogs bzhon sta'i mchogaju dngudu ldanazi pa ni bla ma la phyag byas pa'i 'brasu buragasubs/— —wā skor brdzubyasasta'i phakoyon ni/ ciji ga/ sal morgyal 751

gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ su zhig dad pas thub pa'i mchod rten nam/ /sku gzugs dag lasgyubaskor ba byed pa de/ /phyi ma'i tshe la dgra chen rnams kyis btud/ /ces dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /de ni tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du/ /tshangs pa'i dbang phyug mkhas 'gyur zhing / /lha rnams bye bas mchod par 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la/ /mi gang bskor ba byed pa yi/ /bsngags pa bska la ba bye bar yang / /brjod pas zad par byed mi nus/ /zhes so/ /de ltar sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang / mchod pa phul ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang / bskor ba byas pa'i phan yon rgya cher gsungs pa de dag ni/ gcam bu tsam ma yin gar don la gnas pa ni/sangs rgyasacho kyis zhal gyis 'ches pas nam yang mi bslu ba ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal bo las/ zla ba skar mar bcas pa gnas ltung zhing / /ri dang grong du bcas pa'i sa zhig la/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam pa gzhan gyurarmekyang / /khyod ni mi bden pa yin tshig mi gsung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na skye bo bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi gsung la yid ches bskyed de rnam par dkar ba'i bsod nams rlabs po che gsog pa'i tshul 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni sngar rten bshad cig yod pa 'thor zhig tu song bsade'i ched du 'di bris pa'o//༄dngha //'o de yang ji skad du/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan 752

gyi zhal nas/ bde gshegs sku gsum rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni/ /thabs mkhas sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'jo sgeg las/ /tha sdal tshul gyis 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /skyabs mgon thugs rje can ྾྾ zhes gsungs pa ltar dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa mtha' dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ thabs la mkhas pa'i dbang gis sprul ba'i zlos gar cir yang bsgyur ba las bdag cag mgon med rnams kyi mgon du mi'i gar gyi rnam par rol ba/ snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smros na oṃ āḥ gu ru ba dzra rnya rā bhya shā sa na sle shwa ro sgyu ta bi ta di shā dwo dza ya sa si rnyi3 hūṃ/ bod skad du bsgyur na/ 7bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad stsol cig ces pa'o/ /'jigs med sku bzhi'i bdag nyid tsong kha ba'i/ /dri bral mdo sngags gdams pa'i rgya mtsho che/ /phyogs brgyar spel ba'i snying stobs mchog brnyes sge/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhachibs la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun mkhyen yi shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /gzhan phan mkhas btsun bzang bo'i 'phrin las kyi/ /grags pa skal bzang rna ba'i rgyan gyur pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs med stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' bshes gnyen dag /bsam dang sbyor bas bsten pa'i byin mthu las/ /753

gtan gyi bde la gezho dpa97ldanami/ ༷ /gdulge bya rgya mtsho'i mgon la gsol ba rindedebs(sne/au.ālha stsoru cibadzrarnya ra ba na sa radkubra' rnyihūṃ ṭwāṃ/ 〉ju ༄tsho/ medo thugs rje'iganatetsha chenaspyanaris gzigs/ /rgyal ru kun mkhyen pa'i radarnegazugasnga 'ojamad — byangs/ cisna— nga /—ོchiorkun lge thu stobs gcig sasdus ga sedzaba'i bdag chi/dbyer ched yos can mgon tre po sa rṣa gyurartecig — /chos —dzeechedangasna sku gtsotsho rsāso kyimirten/ —ོ pe /bzhetreyo bro'irnam dkar dgedngha ba'i byinaspathu las/tre ji ༷rikharsā riwo'i bde o rtsa rga rgyal ba'i bstan/ ci /dargyaragyici chu lagater4 dzeedusporgyas rpā dang / ci /lus ngag yidanakyis 9'brelatrethospyo sems cun kune/ rmege —/gasgosasnabs chos ldan dpago lorole ba3ngatsā/ droci —/swothar —thugasingatshoske rgyasau go 'arsā myure duthotho shogaci — ci/tses pa ri 'di'anganeṣpeṣpe bla ma gas zhedzinatswa leg྾newo ྾chags sgyubibazhin gisadkucho/ci/ ༷ — co 4 dku/ drotsho— /lto 'du la hphuphrinarwa ra snang mkha' khyab tu rdzo zhing cirgud pa'i mun tshogs— lhagarngu rsā tpasmi gasto 3pa'ichoci rdo rje mi'i gan gyis thidzo ba rtso mtha'achi yas sto'i rngo bo logan cen thams cagaspe rṣa rgazigs zen po —rjene btsun blo sazang 'adku snyo ske yi carsā spyortsal/ mtshan dpasmra bzang5 — tre bo'i zung zhojug da0tari gi rgyal cho'i za mdzwa tog mtha' dag ba.a wo'iho ca —dpaladu shayo cimedabaskal brgyar thāzhugs nalha nematha' mesna 'aṇḍin lasacho kyi 'od snang dkaro lngos/‘ pings po'i rgyal khams dkar kyāb tu— ga tong zhingaṇḍaṃ /de'i mthu— lngatwobartenaljan—smo ltosdo— btso skye rgu yoṇḍas kyiṭaṃrgud chi.a ⑫ edarngo— tshodu 754 ri

gi nag cishās/ de skyidasnepad mo'i ca5rngos zhal lhag lhag rgod cipaṃ༈ mo dzotshoralha/ gas zicil mngur gyi —bcud kha lusmo tsanakongacho drug tshog—sa ci dgar cilong sposaspyod par 'argyu' ba kko mo cirki tre — zhes dzi 'asdi ṣkakunagazigs paṇacenatsān motsā ches bla a bkyashis 'khyil ṇa satsā sta gil skabakha— skya9sa 'jug cig phris zhes kunarakhyen rin po ches sdoka' —bzhin bris te phul dhebasdo /—/ —— byu ( rī cho —— cidāzhe — — sdu — lke 4ji rwa dī sdu rici rī ༄༅ //gradas med se༈sa cane sgrol ba'i thabs 'asdilda —lag/ /bde chen 'od snang ā li kā ldildi —gahūṃgs6/— hūṃno /tha‘byerge dad sherge— /rdebam̐ri hūṃng bagle/ rnam dener lag/ sna/lnga ṅgedo'i smrugadzi bhen— desdengasdedngha sdi cidag rmene ciXge /—de yang lami wahūṃkā zhe/ so pa'i ldi ge rmerdo dag sde ṅge skṛ —rte'i smre ge gyusde/ne la/ sbode gangs canekā sgye sngongeṅge 'dir bstan pa stedzha dare sgya sum̐cisruri su thon smre cisgobhosnyo snye dzegs lo tsā bha rnarmese kyis yi —ge 'asde'i stedring snyenablo mdo rghaṃd ma4lngertswa boske phredaci yig tu bsgyur zhing / khyad par du khri srong sde btsan dang / mnga' bdag khri ral gyi dume su lo bte rnams dkus 'thags yīrme— rnerme gderne drajes rme'i lan war dang /paṇḍi— ta'i— yi geci phra mos dzra sa pa'i rigyeswā despa— shirnerī tu mang bo bsarim yas kyi — getsug lag khalnge du banugaso tshoyode le—/ mnyerma mido rje bo chen po —gernas der 'e spres skabs/ laṇa waragyis bris me'i medo tergyude bstan bcose shin tu mosdebo yod pa gzigs ne so/ ci ya rmatshanasnye —zhing tsādzha las te/ bod 'dir bstan ༷ dar —ba 'dra baphyorgya ger du yang— tsā byungo ltebu ri'idra— gsungs/ bstan pacophyi darangagyi skabs —su go paṇilharnams374 ko'owaṃstanacharig gnasa'ishin tu mdza — bo gdane drangase pa/ —ra( sgreng —gtsugatamos/dgong dzñasmrab zhugs pa rgyalakhab 765

phyi nang gi mkhas pa rnams la grags pa ltar yin la/ da lta sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i yang thog tu ta la'i lo ma'i thog tu bris pa'i lami'i dpe mang bo yod pa dang / bkra shis lhun po'i pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i yang thog tu yang yod/ des na 'ga' zhig gis lami phyis su dar ba las gna' dus med zer ba ni shes rgya chung zhing ma brtag byung rgyal du smra ba la dga' ba tsam mo/ /da lta latshi'i khrid rgyun yang dag med par bris bshus lag bde byas pa dag la snying bo med par mthong nas bdag gi slob ma 'gas bkra shis 'ikhyil gyi khrid rgyun ltar bris pa dpar la bkod pa yang yod/ da lan yang sgyug thogs dkon mchog gis ma yig cig 'bri 'dun yod skabs 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di rang bris pa lags so —dku/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i zer brgya yis/ /rmongs mun stug po 'joms mdzad pa/ /gu ru mchog gi zhabs skyes rdul/ /byang chub bar du gtsug tu 'dzin/ /'dir zla zer ba dag gi 'dod mos bzhin/ chos sde chen po dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil du mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa ji ltar dar ba'i tshul mdor bsdus te brjod pa la/ bsod nams stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba ji nang chang wang gis kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing nas spyan drangs te/ bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos 756

sde 'di nyid phyag 'debs mdzad/ gzhung bka' pod chen po lnga'i 'chad nya na dang / gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad sgrub kyi sde btsugs/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas par gnang ste/ thugs sras mkhas grub chen po bswe ngag dbang bkra shis mchog la bstan pa gtad de bswe ngag dbang bkra shis dpal bzang bos lo sum cu'i bar du gdan sa bskyangs pa nas bzung gdan rabs gser gyi phreng bas rim par bskyangs/ slar yang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje mchog gi yang sprul kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo mchog gdan sar bkod de thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin par mdzad/ dgon sde 'di nyid kyi mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa bdag gir mdzad pa dang /tshig rgyugs dang rtsod rgyugs 'don rgyugs sogs rgyun ldan du len par mdzad de sngar yod kyi 'chad nyan mi nyams gong 'phel du btang / paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dpal bzang bo'i bka' lung bzhin e waṃ chos 'khor gling phyag 'debs mdzad de/ 'don rta dbyangs gar thig dbyangs gsum sogs dang / sgra snyanangag sogs rgyugs sprod rgyu btsugs/ gzhan yang rig gnas chen po lnga'i ya gyal gso ba rig pa dar spel gtong dgos dgongs nas gso rig gzhan phan gling phyag 'debs mdzad/ dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing nas slob dpon spyan drangs te rgyud bzhi cha lag man ngag dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /kun mkhyen 'jigs 757

med dbang bo de nyid kyis dbyig gya paṇḍi ta slob dpon du bsten te/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po dang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa nas brgyud pa'i rig gnas sgra snyan ngag sdeb sbyor sogs gsan pra ti rin chen don grub nas brgyud pa'i rig gnas gsan/ mdo smad 'dir phebs nas/de skabs si tu paṇa chen rig gnas phyogs la mkhas grags che bas khong dgon pa 'dir gdan 'dren zhus mod/ khong sku na smin pa'i dbang gis phebs ma thub/ slob ma kun dga' sangs rgyas gdan drangs te/ de'i drung nas khong 'jigs med dbang bo slob ma dang bcas pas si tu nas brgyud pa'i rig gnas mtha' dag bslabs te/ dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil 'di rig gnas kyi gter mdzod du gyur nas mdo smad yongs dang /sog yul yan chod kyi rig pa'i gnas kyi 'byung khungs gcig pur gyur to/ /gzhan yang mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi bla ma mang bo'i zhal nas grub mtha' ris med nas brgyud pa'i dbang lung man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan te/ gsan yig ma dros klung chen mdzad/ tshogs chen 'du khang dang gser khang chen mo sogs lha khang rten dang brten par bcas pa mang bo bzhengs/ a mchog dgon chen sogs phyogs yas mas su dgon pa mang bo phyag 'debs mdzad do// de bzhin du sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho dang sku phreng bzhi ba rje bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug sku phreng lnga ba 'jam dbyangs 758

ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi bar du dar zhing rgyas mod/ bar skabs su re zhig rkyen dbang du song na yang / legs bshad las/ mkhas pa re zhig rgud gyur kyang / /de la gdung ba skye mi dgos/ /zla ba re zhig gzas zin yang / /de ma thag tu grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skyabs mgon sku phreng drug pa chen po'i 'phrin las kyi 'od brgya 'bar bar brten/'chad nyan dbyar mtsho bzhin rgyas bzhin pa 'di lags so/ /'dir 'chad nyan byed lugs ni/ spyir thos bsam gling la kha dog dkar dmar mi 'dzin grwa nas dka' rams bar 'dzin grwa bcu gsum yod/ chos thog zla chos bzhi dang bar chos bzhi yod/ zla chos zla ba gcig gi yun dang bar chos ni nyin nyi shu'i ring 'tshogs pa shas che/ gzhung bka' pod lnga'i 'chad nyan dang rtsod pa hor khungs su mi lus pa'i ched du bca' yig bzhag yod stabs/ rang rang gi thad kyi gzhung tshad gang yin chos mtshams su blor 'dzin pa dang / rang rang gi dge rgan gyi mdun nas dpe khrid zhu ba dang 'phros pa dogs gcod dpe char blta ba sogs byas te chos thog tu 'bel gtam rtsod pa byed rgyu gra sgrig byas te chos thog tu rang rang gi thad ka'i gzhung de'i thog nas rtsod pa byed cing / dge bskul gyis 'dzin grwa 'og ma rnams 'dzin grwa gong mar dam bca' gtong ba dang /'dzin grwa gong 'og bsres te rigs lam brdar sha chod pa yong bar byed/spyir nyin re la zhogs kha'i chos grwa gung tshigs chos grwa sku rim ste gsum 759

yod/ gung tshigs chos grwa dang sku rim yar 'tshogs la rang bsam gyis gnyis re cha byas te 'dzin grwa gong ma dag tu dam bcar 'gro/ dpon slob khri rin po che skabs 'gar chos grwar phebs te rtsi bzhag gnang / dbyar chos skabs khri rin po che phebs nas lam rim chen mo 'chad/ dbyar chos chen mo'i mjug gi nyin bco lnga'i ring rigs grwa'i tshogs langs pa rnams dam bca' bzhag nas rtsod pa shog chen po gnang / ston chos chen mo'i nang / rtags rigs gsar rtsod/ don bdun cu gsar rtsod/ chos 'khor gsar rtsod de gsar rtsod gsum yod/ de gsum la dam bca' yar gtong mar gtong sogs kyi sgo nas rtsod pa shog chen po byed pa ma zad/'dzin grwa res mtshan phud gsum bzhi re byas te rtsod pa brdar sha chod pa byed do// 'dir chos grwar thog mar zhugs skabs khri rin po cher ngo ston zhus nas khri rin po ches dge rgan zhig gnang / dge rgan des zhal ngo / dge bskul sogs kyi mdun du ngo ston la khrid/ de nas tshogs dang chos grwar zhugs/ khri rin po ches gnang ba'i dge rgan de dang / de las gzhan rang gang la dad pa'i dge bshes re dge rgan du bsten nas dpe khrid zhus/— rtsod pa sngon song yin na don bdun cu nas zhugs chog de min kha dog dze dkar dmar 'dzin grwa ra zhugs/ de nas kha dog gong / bsdus 'bring /bsdus chen te bsdus grwa'i 'dzin grwa bzhi'i skabs su tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 760

rigs lam gyi gnad bsdus pa bsdus grwa zhes grags pa de la slob gnyer yongs su rdzogs par byed/ de nas rtags rigs gsar rtsod byas te rtags rigs 'dzin grwar slebs nas rtags rigs blo rigs gnyis la slob gnyer byed/ de nas ston don bdun cu gsar rtsod byas te dgun 'dzin grwa gzhung gsar 'dzin grwar spor/ gzhung gsar/ gzhung gong / skabs dang bo/ skabs bzhi ba ste phar phyir 'dzin grwa bzhi'i skabs su phar phyin gyi slob gnyer byed/ dgun chos chen mor 'dzin grwa spo skabs/ skabs bzhi ba'i 'dzin grwas phar phyin dam bca' 'jog de nas dbu ma gsar ba/dbu ma rnying ba'i 'dzin grwa gnyis kyi skabs su dbu ma la slob gnyer 'chad nyan byed/ 'di man chod kyi 'dzin grwa rnams lo re yin mod/ mdzod kyi 'dzin grwar slebs nas mngon pa mdzod la slob gnyer byed/ 'dzin grwa 'dir lo bzhir bzhugs pa red/ de nas dka' rams du slebs nas 'dul ba la slob gnyer byed/ dpe cha ba bzang ba dag la/ bla brang dang /tshogs chen khri rin po che gang rung gis rdo rams pa'i mdud pa 'dogs/de nas rdo rams pa rnams rgyun du dam bca' la 'gro ba sogs chos grwa'i rtsod pa'i 'gan 'khur/ de nas rgan gzhon go rim ltar dbyar dgun gyi rdo rams pa'i dam bca' 'jog dam bca' 'jog pa'i gong du bla brang nang du song ste khri rin po che'i sku mdun nas 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i rgyugs sprod/ 'dzin grwa bcu gsum re rer dam bca' la 'gro dgos/ dbyar 761

ji yin na rigs grwa'i mejug dang / dgun yin na smon lam gyi mjug tu tshogs dbus su gzhung po ti lnga la nyin lngar dam bcar 'jog dam bca' bzhag tshar nas bla brang gzim chung legs bshad dga' tshal du rin po cher mjal kha zhu zhing / gdan cha'i steng du bzhugs nas bla brang chen mos dem ja phul ba bzhes shing rin po che'i zhal snga nas lha dar dang phyag mdud ser bo gnang ste bla ma'i go sa gnang / de phyin chad/ dam bca' thon zin pa'i dmigs gsal du sngar bzhin chos grwa chad med byed mi dgos/ de nas rgyud stod smad dus 'khor kye rdor grwa tshang gang rung du zhugs nas sngags la sbyangs te lo shas nas sngags kyi dam bca' 'jog cing / sngags rams pa'i ming btags len/ de nas rang rang gi yon tan gyi bab 'os sogs dang bstun nas grwa tshang so so'i khri ba dang bla ma dbu mdzad rdo rje 'dzin pa༈tshogs chen khri sogs la bzhugs pa'i srol yod do// gzhung bka' pod lnga sngags dang bcas pa la slob gnyer byed pa gzhir bzung nas/ bla ma dmadzāpa'i zhal snga las/ dbang rjes gnang man ngag khrid lung sogs nyan pa dang / sgra snyan ngag rtsis sa ris sman sogs bslabs te/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa khong du chud par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis chos sde chen po 'di nyid bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dang /man ngag gi gter mdzod/ rig pa'i gnas kyi 'byung khungs su gyur pa 762

yin no/ /phyogs gzhan gyi chos sde dag gi dbang lung man ngag phyag len dgon sde 'di nas ma brgyud pa med cing / mtshan nyid rig gnas sogs 'di nas ma brgyud pa med pas chu klung mtha' dag 'byung ba'i gnas mtsho chen po ma dros pa lta bur gyur to/ /zhes pa 'di ni〈 zla zer〉rtsom sgrig khang gi 'gan 'khur ba dag gis skyes bzang dang bcas bskul ngor gang dran thol byung du smras pa'o//༄༅/ /'o lags so/ /phan bde 'byung gnas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu thams cad sku khams bzang / /lus can kun la bde skyid 'byung ba'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rtag tu rgyas gyur cig /ces shis pa brjod pa ltar/ 'gro ba yongs kyi phan pa dang bde ba'i gzhi gcig pu ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa la rag las pa yin la/ de nyid ston pa dang spel ba'i gang zag rnams rim par byon pa yin pas de'i tshul ni/ spyir 'gro ba kun la rgyu med par mnyes gshin pa'i rnam 'dren rgyal ba thams cad dang / khyad par snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus su mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byon nas/ rnye 'bras kyi theg pa'i chos 'khor ma lus pa bskor bar mdzad pa ston pa shākya thub pa rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid ni 'phral yun‘ kun— du bka' drin che ba kun gyi rtsa ba yin la/ de nas bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ nā ro te lo/ lū nag dril gsum/ la lī ta badzra/ chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams dang / dus zhabs pa 763

che chung sogs mdo sngags so so'i bshad sgrub kyi khur 'dzin pa'i paṇḍi ta dang grub pa'i dbang phyug gnam gyi skar tshogs lta bu rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che/bstan pa rin po che gangs can gyi ljongs su 'dren pa'i rgyal blon rnams dang / lo tsā ba ska cog zhang gsum/ lo chen rin chen bzang bo/rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ mar mgos rnam gnyis sogs lo tsā ba 'jig rten gyi mig tu gyur pa rnams shin tu bka' drin che/ phyi gtsang nang gtsang padma'i sbubs lta bu'i bka' gdams kyi bstan pa rin po che spel zhing 'dzin skyong byed pa'i jo 'brom yab sras dang /bka' gdams kun mkhyen gsum sogs bka' drin che/khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dag ther gyis gser sbyangs btso ma lta bur mdzad de ston pa rang nyid slar byon pa bzhin du ka ri ka lnga bcu ba nas rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bar gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu'i bstan pa rin po ches rgya mcho'i gos can mtha' dag khyab par mdzad pa'i rgyal ba gnyis pa shar tsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa shin tu bka' drin che/ bstan pa de nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa'i rgyal ba paṇa chen yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa bka' drin che/ bstan pa rin po che de nyid bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin cing spel bar byed pa'i 764

mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyu ga kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje sku phreng rim byon yab sras brgyud padang bcas pa shin tu bka' drin che/ khyad par pru dgon sde 'di nyid phyag 'degs mdzad pa po mkhas grub chen po stag tsha sku phreng bzhi ba sprul ba'i sku rje btsun blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho bka' drin che/ stag tsha sku phreng lnga ba sprul ba'i sku rin po che mtshan brjod par bka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho bka' drin che/ sngon gyi thugs bskyed rlabs po che mthu grub cing smon lam rnam par dag pa'i dbang gis dgon sde lha 'bangs dang bcas pa mas bu bzhin du skyong bar mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po mtshan brjod par bka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo thog mtha' bar gsum du bka' drin che/ chos sde 'di nyid kyi mtshan nyid gsar tshugs mdzad de skyong bar byed pa'i khri rabs gser gyi phreng ba rnams kyi khri rabs dang bo mkhas pa'i dbang phyug chen po thal dge bshes rje btsun blo bzang chos ldan dpal bzang bo bka' drin che/ khri rabs gnyis pa dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi mdo sngags gnyis ka'i rams 'byams pa bka' drin mnyam med rje don 'grub rgya mtsho zhes bya bas dgon sde 'di nyid mdo sngags bshad sgrub nyams min gang cha nas ma'i bu bzhin du lo bcu gcig gi ring 765

la skyongs par mdzad pa'i dge bshes chen po de nyid shin tu bka' drin che/khri rabs gsum pa bka' drin mnyam med mtshan brjod par dka' ba stag tsha sprul ba'i sku sku phreng drug pa rje btsun bskal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo rang nyid khrir bzhugs te chos sde 'di nyid chos srid gang cha nas ma'i bu bzhin du skyongs bar mdzad pas shin tu bka' drin che/ khri rabs bzhi ba mkhas btsun dam pa skal bzang lung rtogs de nyid bka' drin che/ khri rabs lnga ba mkhas btsun bzang bo'i bdag nyid can skal bzang rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo de nyid bka' drin che/ khri rabs drug pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa bskal bzang bzod pa bka' drin che/ chos sde 'di nyid la mdo sngags kyi bshad pa dang dbang lung man ngag sogs kyi sgo nas 'dzin skyongs spel bar byed pa'i bshes gnyen bka' drin can rnams thog mtha' bar gsum du shin tu bka' drin che/de ltar bshes gnyen bka' drin can rnams kyi bka' drin rjes su dran nas bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bsgrubs te bka' bzhin pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byede pa dang / sems can gyi bde skyid ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la rag las pa dang / bstan pa gnas mi gnas dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las pa yin la/ dge 'dun gyi sdes kyang bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin dgos pas/ khyed dge 'dun pa 766

rnams kyis thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba'i ngos nas gzhung po ti lnga'i 'chad nyan/ rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par byed pa thugs la 'dzin par zhu/ /zhes pa 'di ni lhag bsam rnam par dkar zhing 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i gdung 'tshob bstan pa sman rgan ngag stobs kyis lha rdzas dri med bcas bskur ngor sbyar ba'o/ /༄༅/ /zag med ye shes mtsho las padma dkar/ /byung ba'i ngo mtshar sprul ba'i zlos gar lhan/ /gsung dbyangs rgyud mang sgra yi brtan g.yos dngos/ /zag med bde bas khyab mdzad de yis skyongs/ /mtsho byung dges pa'i ge sar rgyas pa lasku /byung ba'i sbrang rtsi mngar bo'i shis pa 'bum/ /yongs su 'khyil ba rig pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /dge mtshan chu 'dzin yongs su 'phyur gyur cig /brda sprod nam mkha'i glang bo ngal ba'i rdul/ /sprin gyi me tog rig pa'i zil shugs kyis/ /dge legs 'bras bu 'bum gyi mdzes zhal la/ /skye rgu yongs kyis longs su spyod gyur cig /dbyangs ldan rig pa rgya mcho'i nor bu la/ /rab tu dga' bas nye bar spyod pa na/ /blo gros snang ba'i 'od zed 'bum phrag gis/ /rgud pa'i smag chen yongs su 'joms par nges/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /skye rgu'i dpal du shar ba'i dpal yon des/ /'dod pa'i rtsi shing lo 'dab rab rgyas shing / /gtan gyi 'bras bu g.yur du za bar shog /'di ni khong gis slob bu zhig la kun bshad kyi mtshan gnang ba'i tshe 'phral mar sbyar ba'o/ /༄༅/ /'bum phrag brjod bya rjod byed 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /mkhyen pa 767

nyi ma gzhon nus yongs bzung ste/ /'phrin las gsung mchog 'od kyi rtse dga' yis/ /rnam par gsal mdzad bzhi ldan rgyal gyur cig /'dir brjod par bya ba ni/ spyir gzhung lugs dag la lta zhing sbyang bar byed pa la ming gi brda khyad shes pa gal che ste/ brda skad ma sheyon brjod bya'i don ga la shes/ des na ming brda'i 'jug pa shes pa shin tu gal che mod/ ji skad du/ gangs can ming brda'i 'jug pa mtha' yas phyir/ /sngon byon mkhas pas dag yig brda'i bstan bcos/ /thor bu don bsdus la sogs mdzad na yang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon gyi mkhas pa dag gis mdzad pa'i brda sprod thor bu 'ga' dang / dag yig rgyas bsdus 'ga' mchis na'ang / 'ga' zhig tu nyung ngu tsam las med pa dang / 'ga' zhig tu 'grel mi gsal zhing dper brjod med gshis/ deng dus kyi gsar bu dag la brda sprod rgyas pa zhig shin tu mkho che'o//des na/ rig pa'i gnas la lhag bsam dang brtson pa che zhing rnam dpyod bkra ba btsan lha ngag dbang gis legs bsgrigs byas pa'i brda sprod gser gyi me long 'di nyid rgyas shing 'grel ba dpe brjod bcas yod stabs/ sngar gyi brda sprod rgyas bsdus gang las kyang khyad thon pas/ rig pa'i gnas la sbyang ba dang / khyad par du gzhung lugs rab 'byams lta klog byed pa'i mig tu gyur 'dug go /nyer len shes bya shes pa'i sa bon las/ /rnam 'byed shes rab rgyas pa'i mdzes zhal ngom/ /lam dang sa yi kho 768

lag rab rgyas pas/ /so rig bzhi ldan rgyal sa thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang rab gnas me yos spyi lo1987lo'i chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang bo'i dang bo zla7 pa'i tshes27la bris pa'o//dku༅ོ/ /'jigs med stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' bshes gnyen dag /bsam dang sbyor bas bsten pa'i byin mthu las/ /gtun gyi bde la 'god pa'i dpal ldan pa/ /gdul bya 〉 masna'i mgon la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi zhal lung yang yang thob pa'i mthus/ /tshe rabs gser gyi phreng bar dal 'byor gyi/ /'od chags lung rtogs nor bus rab brgyan te/ /sa lam rtogs pa'i them skas bgrod par shog /khyad par skye ba'i phreng ba padmo'i tshal/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas bshes gnyen nyi ma yis/ /rgud pa'i mun tshogs ma lus nyer bcom nas/ /lung rtogs sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston rgyas par shog /mdor na rgyal bstan yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /ris med 'gro bas bkur zhing rab mchod de/ /mi shis mtshan ma'i smag rim nyer zhi nas/ /dge mtshan 'od snang dkar bos khyab gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni ra phug mkha' 'gro'i rdzong chen gyi ri khrod pa blo bzang gis nan tan gyis bskul ngor bris pa'o// ༄cu/ /na mo gu ru juḥ lhag bsam dag pas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /gtan gyi bde ba'i don du thos bsam sgom/ /byas pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho chen po yis/ /snyigs dus bstade pa'i srog 'dzin khyod la 'dud/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying bo'i bar/ /bshes gnyen nyin mo'i mgon gyis rab bskyangs te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i dpal gyi 'byor 769

ba rgyas/ /sku bzhi'ipyigo 'phang myur du thob gyur cig /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byings pa'i ma rgan rnams/ /rang dang gzhan la khyad par yod min gyis/ /sems can kho na'i don du bdag gzhan gyi/ /mnyam brje'i rtogs pa rgyud la skyes gyur cig /de la brten nas sa lam rab bgrod de/ /sdug bsngal brgya —phrag gis mnar sems can rnams/ /'dren pa'i byed po nyid du bdag gyur nas/ /sims can thams cad bde la 'god gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni dge slong mdo sde rgya mtshos snga mo nas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor bris pa'o//༄༅/ /ches dkon mdo sngags marngog la rtag rol bas/ /lung rtogs dum rtos bdud rtsi'i bcud thob ste/ /gdul bya sgo mardo'i mgon gyur dge ba'i bshes/ /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /'di'ang skal tshul gyis bskul ngor bris/༄༅/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes bde ba che/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku/ /yongs grub bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon 'od po che/ /mchog sprul smra ba'i nyi mar gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di ni khā stod sprul ba'i sku skal bzang rgya mtshos thag ring yul nas 'phrin yig dngos skyes bla na med pa dang bcas bskur ngor bris pa'o//༄7ོ/ /bde stong ye shes sman gyi bdud rtsi yis/ /bdag 'dzin la sogs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /gtan du bcom ste sku bzhi'i go 'phang la/ /mnga' bsgyur baiḍūrya yi 'od la 'dud/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs gsang las 'ong ba'i/ /sman gyi bdud rtsis 'gro rnams skyong mkhas pa'i/ /770

g.yu thog snga phyi gnyis dang 'phags bod kyi/ /brgyud 'dzin mkhas grub rnams la snying nas 'dud/ /lnga rig ya gyal gso ba rig pa ni/ /'gro ba'i dbugs 'byin bla na med pa yin/ /de phyir rmad byung sman gyi gzhung lugs dag /yongs su spel ba mkhas pa'i bya ba yin/ /deng dus phyugs nad gso ba'i sman dag ni/ /sgrig cing spel ba'i bya ba nyung bar gyur/ /des na phyugs nad bcos pa'i gzhung lugs ni/ /spel ba 'di ni kha tsha dgos gtug yin/ /'di ni rig pa'i bya ba mchog yin te/ /gzhan gyi srog skyobs dge bcu'i dang bo yin/ /dpal 'byor gong du spel la nges dgos te/ /phyugs rigs 'phel ba nor gyi rtsa ba yin/ /des na phyugs nad gso ba'i sman 'di dag /rang gis nyams myong bsags te gzhung lugs su/ /bsgrigs pa 'di ni do gal che ba yin/ /des phyir las 'di la ni glo ba dga'//sto༅ོ/ /rnam dag mkhyen pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba'i mun pa sel mdzad pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzigs mchog /drin can bla ma rgyun du mchod/ /rnam par dkar ba'i byin rlabs mchog /'o ma'i rgyun bzhin 'bab pa yis/ /gshis rgyud gyong bo rab brlan te/ /rnam dkar me tog rab rgyas shog /dge ba'i lo tog rab smin nas/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi bkres skom gyi/ /gdungs pa ma lus rab bsal nas/ /bde skyid dpal la rol bar shog /rnam dag sems kyi sa gzhi la/ /phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i them skas btsugs/ /thabs lam zab mo'i goms stabs kyis/ /sku bzhi'i gling du 771

bgrod par shog /mkhyen ldan 'jigs med kyis rtsom bsdus mgor 'jog rgyu zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor sbyar ba'o//༄༅/ /num dag mdzad pa'i skya rengs kyis/ /'gro bde'i nyi ma 'admen pa'i dpal/ /dgra las rgyul kha dpa' bo'i phul/ /khyod nyid gtsug gi rgyan du 'dzin/ /zhal gyi chu gter las 'ongs pa'i/ /rig pa nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor che/ /phan bde'i zer brgya rab spro ba'i/ /sna tshogasari 'od can rin chen gdugs/ /gangs can mkha' la nyer 'dren pa'i/ /lo paṇa snyan pa g.yu 'brug zla/ /zhes pa'ang kan lhortsom bsgyur cus kyi blo mthun dag gis bskul ngor bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag dang / lo paṇa dag gi mtshan byang dpar du bkod pa'i mgo brjod du bris/༄༅//e waṃ bde chen 'od stong gzis//shes nyon rlan gsher dbyings su dag /stong gzugs sku yi dpal thob pa/ /skyabs kun 'dus zhal bla ma rgyal/ /sna tshogs las kyi bzo bo'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /sna tshogs snang ba'i gar la rab 'khrul nas/ /sna tshogs rang snang khams la rab 'khyams pa'i/ /sna tshogs 'gro ba'i snalnge ba brjod las 'das/ /'onaci kyang gnyis med rgyu skar 'khor lo'i mgon/ /dang bo'i mgon de'i thun min gdul bya la/ /nang gi khams dang bstun pa'i 'khor lo zhig/bstan pa'i dag pa'i snang ba 'di ko rmad/ /dag min chu bur 'dren byed nyi zla zung //res kyis bgrod de mthong bar re na'ang / /nor bur 'gran pa'i skye bo'i skal ba'i nor/ /mthong ba'i skal ba ri bong rwa'i mched zla/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum 'khor lo khong chud nas/ /stong gzugs rgyal thabs che la spyod pa'i phyir/ /brgyud ldan mkhas 772

pa'i phyag rgyun rmad byung 'di//gzur gnas blo gsal dag la gzigs mor bkram/ /'dis mtshon bdag gzham/ dus gsum 'o ma'i mtsho/ /mtha' dag yangs pa'i mkha' la rab 'phyur te/ /las kyis nongs pa'i ma dag kun bkrus nas/ /byang chen rgya mtsho'i klong du sim gyur cig /de ltar snod kyi 'jig rten gyi snang tshul mtha' yas mod/ mu stegs pa kha cig gis steng rtseg mar 'dod pa mi 'thad par gsungs la/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i nyi ma'i go la 'di la'ang /(1)'dul 'dzin chen po rgya dmar ba sogs kyi phyi bskyed ma dang / (2)yang mkhas pa kha cig gis 'dod pa'i steng bskyed ma dang / (3)snar thang ba sogs kyis 'dod pa'i lcags sgrog ma'i lugs dang / (cizhal lung mkhan po phug pa yab sras sogs kyis 'dod pa'i gru chags ma'i lugs te bzhi yod pas 'dir gru chags ma'i lugs su/ rab rgyal shing byi lo'i ston khar spyi lo1984lo slob grwa 'dir skar rtsis sogs slob pa'i slob sbyong 'dzin grwa btsugs dus su go la'i mdzub khrid bgyis skabs/ slob ma lag khra la byang ba dag la 'brir bcug pa yin yang / phran skyes sbyangs kyi shes rab zhan stabs khrid stangs nor 'khrul gyi dri ma yod nges pas/rig pa'i gnas la blo mig yangs pa dag gis legs par bcos par zhu/ ༄7//bla ma dang lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dran pas rmongs pa'i mun tshogs lhag med 'joms/ /yid la rol bas 773

lung rtogs 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'phel/ /ngag gi dpal ster dbyangs can zla ba rtag bsten nas/ /rig gnas bcud kyis skal ldan bung ba tshim gyur cig /bcu phrag rig pa'i ge sar la/ /rtag tu rol ba'i bung ba 'bum/ /padma'i tshal la rab zhugs nas/ /dar dir dbyangs kyis yid dbang 'phrog /rta bdun dbang bo'i zer brgya bzhin/ /rig pa'i 'od tshogs rab rgyas te/ /rmongs pa'i dgra tshogs rab bcoms nas/ /lung rtogs pad tshal rgyas par shog /shes rgyud gser gyi ke la sha /yon tan bcud kyis yongs gang ste/ /'gro ba'i bkres skom nad sel ba'i/ /bcud ldan gter gyi bum pa mdzod/ /rig pa'i 'od chen 'bum spros pas/ /bde skyid pad tshal rab rgyas te/ /yon tan sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar la/ /skye 'gro yongs kyis spyod gyur cig /bkra shis dge mtshan 'bum phrag gis/ /yangs pa'i sa chen yongs khyab nas/ /gtan du bde ba'i rgyal thabs la/ /skye rgu yongs kyis spyod gyur cig / dza yantu// 774
sngon ṅgermeṅge———
—————— ———da — ——— rāng gzhi tsheg

'di ni khong gis lo bcu phrag gi sngon nas brtsams kyang / nga tshos bed spyod ma byas pas/ glog rdul rtsis 'khor dang / glog 'phrin te(ten po)ku re rtsed mo gsang tshig sogs gang la'ang bed spyad na chog 'di slob pa la bod yig gi yon tshad mtho mi dgos/ sngon 'jug dang / ming gzhi/ dbyangs dang rjes 'jug rnams gsal bo ngos zin mkhan gyis skar ma 'gar bslabs pas shes/ ci'i phyir na/sngon bod yig gsar bzo spus legs pa dang / da lta khong gis sgrig tshul legs pa'i dbang gis so/ /'di rang dgar bskyur ba la blo phangs par snyam nas da lta par du bskrun pa'o/ /

par byang smon tshig ༄༅//legs gsung nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer gyis/ /gdul bya'i lung rtogs padmo 'bum 'byed pa/ /mi mjed zhing gi mgon po shākya'i tog /'khor tshogs byang sems nyan rang bcas la 'dud/ /mgon de'i zhal bzang gangs kyi ri bo las/ /legs 'ongs mdo sde gang gā'i mchod yon che/ /'gro ba'i las nyon ma dag 'khrud pa'i bcud/ /rgyal dang de sras kun gyi bsngags pa'i yul/ /de yi phyi mo gcig las 'bum spro ba'i/ /dpar gyi dngos po sgrub pa'i rnam dkar la/ /'brel thogs kun gyis dal 'byor rten thob kyang / /skye kun dam chos dpal gyis 'tsho bar shog /thugs bskyed bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho yongs 'khyil las/ /legs 'khrungs lung rtogs dpag bsam ljon pa che/ /sa bcu lam lngazhi kho lag rab rgyas te/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu g.yur du za bar shog /gnas skabs 'dir yang gang gi byin rlabs gzis/ /nad mug 'khrug rtsod la sogs mi mthun pa'i/ /rkyen ngan rgud pa'i mun tshogs rab bsal nas/ /chos spyod bde skyid dpal la rol bar shog /rgyal khams 'di'i mtshon 'jig rten kun du yang / /rkyen ngan rgud pa'i ming tsam mi 'byung zhing / /rgyal bstan nyin mo'i 'od kyis khyab pa dang / /bde skyid pad mo'i 'dzum zhal rab rgyas shog /bstan 778

pa'i rtsa lag bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /dge 'dun thags zushāthun chos ra spyod bshad sgrub 'phel/ /mchod sbyin byed po'i dpal dang 'byor ba dang / /mnga' thang dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin rgyas par shog /tses pa 'di ni khang dmar dgon gyi dab mdzad dge slong sangs rgyas rgya mtshos masde sde thar ba chen po'i dpar shing ༄ gsar skrun skabs bris pa'o/ / 7tsho — 779

༄7//ston de'i legs gsung brgyad khri bzhi stong mchog /legs 'dus sde snod gsum dang de'i dgongs 'grel/ /theg gsum chos dang rgyud sde bzhi'i legs bshad/ /byang chub snying bo'i bar du skyabs su 'dzin/ /ston de'i sus kyi thu bo byams 'jam dbyangs/ /gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin phyag na rdo rje dang / 'od srung kun dga' bo dang nye bar 'khor/ /'khor tshogs dgra bcom rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sa ra ha sogs rgyud sde'i mdzod 'dzin dang / /klu sgrub la sogs dbu ma'i srol 'byed dang / /thogs med sku mched la sogs sbas don sgya/ /mngon rtogs gsal mdzad rnams la phyag bgyid do/ /'phags yul rin chen gling sogs yul gru nas/ /legs bshad rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta ṅge/ /sasto ṭa dang ska cog zhang gsum dang / /chos rgyal mes dbon gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen bzang bo blo lden shes rab dang / /lo chen lhas btsas mar 'gos la sogs dang / /shong dpang yab sras grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs/ /'jig rten mig gyur rnams ni phyag gi yul/ /bka' bstan legs sgrig mdzad pa'i mkhas pa che/ /bcom ldan rig ral yab sras kun mkhyen bu/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras brgyud par bcas/ /bka' drin gzhal med rnams la su mi gus/ /deng skabs snang mtha'i zlos gar paṇa chen rjes/ /dge mtshan dze'od dkar 'bum gyi sgo phyes nas/ /legs bshad 'od phreng gzi bajid slar rgyas te/ /rmongs pa'i dgra chen dpung tshogs lhag med bcom/ /mi 782

dbang pho lha'i bsod nams stobs rgyas tshe/ /rin chen dang bos bzhengs pa'i bstan 'gyur mchog /'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje'i dkar chag bcas/ /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du bzhugs/ /de 'dra'i dga' ldan dpe de gzhir bzung nas/ /rnga ba bod rigs srid gros lhan khang gis/ /lis rdzong bod yig dpar khang chen mo nas/ /'phrul dpar bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog de bskrun/ /'di la las 'dzin rgyab skyor zhu dag dang / /ngal rtsol rgyu dngos 'brel thogs la sogs pa/ /'brel yod sems can kun gyis thog drangs pa'i/ /'gro kun byang chub thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten kun du nad mug dang / /'khrug rtsod la sogs mi shis rgud pa kun/ /lhag med zhi nas chos 'byor bde skyid kyi/ /dpal la rtag tu spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig /khyad par phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan/ /'jig rten kun du nyi ma'i 'od bzhin khyab/ /bde skyid padmo'i 'dzum zhal lhag lhag rgod/ /dam chos sbrang rtsi'i ro la spyod gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rnam dpyod rab tu yangs pa'i las kyi sne mo ba dag gis yang yang bskul ngor/ 'bar khams chos srid 'bar ba'i grong rdal gyi rang shag rig pa'i lding khang nas rab gnas lcags rta lo'i hor zla bdun pa'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang bor sbyar ba'o// ༄༅//rgyal kun chos sku'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /lhag pa'i lha ru shar ba mtsho skyes ma'i/ /'gro ba'i rmongs mun sel byed brda sprod gzhung / /'phags bod paṇa chen dag gi thugs kyi bcud/ /mtsho byung ma yi dgyes zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs/ /khyod kyi snying la phog pa'i mthu dpal las/ /blo 783

gros 'bum gyi me tog rab rgyas te/ /skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs rnams tshim gyur cig /oṃ 'khyil zhes bya'i paṇa chen phyag rgyun dag /khyod thugs rin chen yol gor 'khyil ba yi/ /dge mtshan snang ba rgyas pa'i mthu dpal las/ /rgyal bstan yongs 'du'i ljon pa dar bar shog /bcu phrag nyi ma'i 'od chen ma spros par/ /shags 'gyed me khyer 'od dmar spros tsam gyis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i chu skyes 'dab ma stong / /bzhad pa'i zil mngar bcud chen myong mi nus/ /de phyir phyogs rer ma gyur thos bsam gyis/ /gtsug lag rab 'byams mtsho chen rab brgal te/ /sku bzhi rin chen gling du legs phyin nas/ /mtha' dag 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel bar shog/༄//'dir smras pa/ bu ram shing ba'i bdud rtsi rlabs po ches/ /yongs su khyab pa'i bsil ldan 'dzin ma'i gzhi/ /drod gsher 'dzoms pa'i snod ldan gshin po'i zhing / /byed po phyi nang mkhas dbang gzi 'od ches/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs pa'i brjod dang gtam/ /sna tshog sa 'od can la 'khu'i glegs bam 'di/ /phyi dar shā sa na yi gsos su smin/ /'di la bya brtson lhur len lhag bsam can/ /de dag gtsor byas rgyud 'byung skye gnas chu/ /khams me sa bug skye rgu mtha' dag gis/ /sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs mchog la dbang 'byor shog /yang dar phyi dar dpal gyi ljon pa che'i/ /kho lag rab rgyas bde skyid 'bras bzang che/ /g.yur du za ba'i bzhin ras cher ngoms nas/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la kun gyis spyod gyur 784

cig /ces snying nas smon pa bo ni bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros so/ / ༄༅ོ//zung 'jug nor bu'i gling du bgrod pa'i thabs/ /rmad byung sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i theg /gsang chen rim gnyis man ngag skal ldan la/ /gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung chen 'di go rmad/ /'chi med lam gyi ri mo can gyi gzugs/ /'bum phrag rdzing bur 'char ba'i rten 'brel bzhin/ /dpar gyi phyi mo gcig las grangs med du/ /'char ba'i 'phrul 'di slar yang bsod nams dpal/ /de ltar dgongs te blo bzang ngag dbang gis/ /'bad pa du mas dpar 'di slar yang bskrun/ /'di'i mtshon kha ba ltar dkar dge tshogs kyis/ /rgyal bstan dri med slar yang dar bar shog /khyad par rgyal bstan snying bo rang lugs che/ /slar yang nyi ma bzhin du rab gsal nas/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun tu rgud pa'i tshogs/ /lhag med zhi nas rdzogs ldan dpal dar shog /'brel thogs kun kyang gnas skabs rkyen ngan kun/ /lhag med zhi zhing tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas/ /'jam dpal zhi khro'i rjes su bzung ba'i mthus/ /sa lam bgrod pa myur du mthar phyin shog /ces rim gnyis kyi rnam bzhag 'di'i dpar sngar lha sa'i dpar ma dpar gzhi byas nas tsha kho tsho bdun bkra shis rdos gling dgon 'dir dpar du 'khod yod kyang / brlag skyon shor/ da lan blo bzang ngag dbang gis sngar gyi dpar ma dpar gzhi byas nas dgon 'dir slar yang dpar du bsgrun pa'i dpar byang smon tshig cig dgos zhersā bkra shis pa'i lha dar dri med bcas bskul ngor bris pa dge legs 'phel/ / 785
